response: {"headword":"abandon","explanation":"動詞「放棄、拋棄」。常用於指放棄計畫、信念或拋棄家人、寵物。常用搭配：abandon the plan (放棄計畫), abandon hope (放棄希望)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Due to the sudden storm, the captain ordered the crew to <target>abandon</target> the ship immediately to save the passengers' lives.","translation":"由於突如其來的風暴，船長命令船員立即棄船，以挽救乘客的生命。","explanation":"動詞「拋棄、離開」。指在危險情況下離開某處。"},{"sentence":"The homeless dog was <target>abandoned</target> by its previous owner in a park, but luckily, a kind family found it and took it home.","translation":"這隻流浪狗被之前的主人遺棄在公園裡，但幸運的是，一個善良的家庭發現了它並把它帶回家。","explanation":"動詞「遺棄」。指不再照顧某人或某物。"},{"sentence":"After several failed attempts to fix the old machine, the engineer decided to <target>abandon</target> the project and focus on a new design.","translation":"經過幾次嘗試修理這台舊機器失敗後，工程師決定放棄這個計畫，並專注於新的設計。","explanation":"動詞「放棄」。指停止嘗試做某事。"}],"related_forms":["abandoned","abandonment"]}

{"headword":"absolute","explanation":"形容詞「絕對的、完全的」。常用於強調程度。常考搭配：absolute silence (絕對安靜), absolute truth (絕對真理), absolute power (絕對權力)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The room fell into <target>absolute</target> <pattern>silence</pattern> when the teacher entered, as every student was focused on the upcoming exam results.","translation":"當老師走進來時，房間裡陷入了絕對的安靜，因為每個學生都專注於即將到來的考試結果。","explanation":"形容詞「絕對的」。常用搭配 absolute silence (絕對的安靜)。"},{"sentence":"While some people believe in luck, others argue that hard work is the <target>absolute</target> <pattern>truth</pattern> behind every successful career.","translation":"有些人相信運氣，而有些人則認為努力工作是每個成功事業背後的絕對真理。","explanation":"形容詞「絕對的」。常用搭配 absolute truth (絕對的真理)。"},{"sentence":"The king of the ancient empire had <target>absolute</target> <pattern>power</pattern> over his people, making decisions that affected the entire nation without any opposition.","translation":"古代帝國的國王對他的人民擁有絕對的權力，在沒有任何反對的情況下做出影響整個國家的決定。","explanation":"形容詞「絕對的」。常用搭配 absolute power (絕對權力)。"}],"related_forms":["absolutely"]}

{"headword":"absorb","explanation":"動詞「吸收」。可用於實體（如海綿吸水）或抽象（如吸收知識、吸收衝擊）。常用搭配：absorb knowledge (吸收知識), absorb water (吸收水)。","entries":[{"sentence":"A sponge can <target>absorb</target> a large amount <pattern>of</pattern> water quickly, which makes it a very useful tool for cleaning the kitchen.","translation":"海綿能快速吸收大量的水，這使它成為清潔廚房的一個非常有用工具。","explanation":"動詞「吸收」。指實體液體的吸收。"},{"sentence":"The students were encouraged to read widely to <target>absorb</target> <pattern>new knowledge</pattern> and expand their understanding of the world around them.","translation":"學生們被鼓勵廣泛閱讀，以吸收新知識並擴展他們對周圍世界的理解。","explanation":"動詞「吸收」。指心智上的吸收。"},{"sentence":"The new sneakers are designed with a special sole that can <target>absorb</target> <pattern>the shock</pattern> of walking on hard surfaces, protecting the feet.","translation":"這款新運動鞋的鞋底設計特殊，能夠吸收在硬表面行走時的衝擊，保護足部。","explanation":"動詞「吸收」。指能量或衝擊的吸收。"}],"related_forms":["absorption","absorbent"]}

{"headword":"abstract","explanation":"形容詞「抽象的」。指非具體、非實體的概念。常用於描述藝術或複雜的理論。常用搭配：abstract art (抽象藝術), abstract concept (抽象概念)。","entries":[{"sentence":"For many students, the idea of justice is an <target>abstract</target> <pattern>concept</pattern> that is difficult to understand without real-life examples.","translation":"對於許多學生來說，正義的概念是一個抽象的概念，在沒有現實生活例子的情況下很難理解。","explanation":"形容詞「抽象的」。常用搭配 abstract concept (抽象概念)。"},{"sentence":"The gallery displayed various pieces of <target>abstract</target> <pattern>art</pattern>, using bold colors and strange shapes instead of painting realistic people or landscapes.","translation":"畫廊展出了各種抽象藝術作品，使用大膽的顏色和奇怪的形狀，而不是繪製寫實的人或風景。","explanation":"形容詞「抽象的」。常用搭配 abstract art (抽象藝術)。"},{"sentence":"Philosophy classes often discuss <target>abstract</target> <pattern>theories</pattern> about existence and morality, challenging students to think deeply and critically.","translation":"哲學課經常討論關於存在和道德的抽象理論，挑戰學生深入且批判性地思考。","explanation":"形容詞「抽象的」。常用搭配 abstract theories (抽象理論)。"}],"related_forms":["abstraction"]}

{"headword":"academic","explanation":"形容詞「學術的、學校的」。名詞「學者」。常用於描述與學校、研究或學習相關的事物。常用搭配：academic achievement (學術成就), academic performance (學術表現)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university provides several scholarships for students who demonstrate exceptional <target>academic</target> <pattern>achievement</pattern> during their first year of study.","translation":"大學為在第一年學習中表現出卓越學術成就的學生提供多項獎學金。","explanation":"形容詞「學術的」。常用搭配 academic achievement (學術成就)。"},{"sentence":"Some parents are too focused on their children's <target>academic</target> <pattern>performance</pattern>, forgetting that social skills and emotional health are also important.","translation":"有些家長過於關注孩子的學術表現，而忘記了社交技巧和心理健康同樣重要。","explanation":"形容詞「學術的」。常用搭配 academic performance (學術表現)。"},{"sentence":"The professor is a well-known <target>academic</target> in the field of environmental science, having published many influential papers in international journals.","translation":"這位教授是環境科學領域著名的學者，在國際期刊上發表過許多有影響力的論文。","explanation":"名詞「學者」。"},{"sentence":"Students are encouraged to balance their <target>academic</target> <pattern>life</pattern> with extracurricular activities to develop a well-rounded personality.","translation":"學生被鼓勵在學業生活與課外活動之間取得平衡，以培養一個全面發展的性格。","explanation":"形容詞「學術的/學校的」。常用搭配 academic life (學業生活)。"}],"related_forms":["academy","academia"]}

{"headword":"accent","explanation":"名詞「口音；重音」。指說話時的獨特發音方式。常用搭配：strong accent (強烈的口音), foreign accent (外國口音)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Even though she has lived in New York for ten years, she still speaks with a strong <target>accent</target> <pattern>from</pattern> her hometown.","translation":"儘管她在紐約住了十年，但她說話仍然帶著強烈的家鄉口音。","explanation":"名詞「口音」。常用搭配 strong accent (強烈口音)。"},{"sentence":"The tourist struggled to understand the local guide's thick <target>accent</target>, but he eventually understood the directions to the museum.","translation":"遊客很難理解當地導遊濃厚的口音，但最後他還是明白了去博物館的方向。","explanation":"名詞「口音」。常用搭配 thick accent (濃厚的口音)。"},{"sentence":"In English class, the teacher explained how to <target>accent</target> the correct syllable in a word to improve pronunciation and clarity.","translation":"在英文課上，老師解釋了如何對單字中的正確音節著重音，以提高發音和清晰度。","explanation":"動詞「著重音」。"},{"sentence":"The speaker's British <target>accent</target> made his presentation sound more formal and elegant to the international audience.","translation":"演講者的英國口音使他的演講對國際觀眾來說聽起來更正式且優雅。","explanation":"名詞「口音」。常用搭配 British accent (英國口音)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"acceptance","explanation":"名詞「接受、認同」。指接受某人、某事或接受某種狀態。常用搭配：social acceptance (社會認同), acceptance letter (錄取通知書)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After weeks of waiting and worrying, the student finally received an <target>acceptance</target> <pattern>letter</pattern> from her dream university in the United States.","translation":"經過數週的等待和擔心，這名學生終於收到了她夢想中的美國大學錄取通知書。","explanation":"名詞「錄取通知書」。常用搭配 acceptance letter (錄取通知書)。"},{"sentence":"The new policy faced initial resistance, but it eventually gained wide <target>acceptance</target> <pattern>among</pattern> the public after several successful trials.","translation":"新政策最初面臨阻力，但經過幾次成功的試驗後，最終在公眾中獲得了廣泛的認同。","explanation":"名詞「認同、接受」。常用搭配 acceptance among (在...之中被認同)。"},{"sentence":"Self-<target>acceptance</target> is the first step toward happiness, as it allows people to embrace their flaws and focus on their strengths.","translation":"自我認同是通往幸福的第一步，因為它讓人們能夠接納自己的缺點並專注於自己的優點。","explanation":"名詞「接受」。常用搭配 self-acceptance (自我認同)。"}],"related_forms":["accept"]}

{"headword":"access","explanation":"名詞「進入、通路」；動詞「進入、獲取」。常用於描述進入物理空間或獲取數位資訊。常用搭配：have access to (有權進入/獲取), gain access to (獲取進入權限)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Students who have <target>access</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the school library can borrow up to five books at a time for their research.","translation":"有權進入學校圖書館的學生一次最多可以借五本書來進行研究。","explanation":"名詞「通路、權限」。常用搭配 have access to (有權使用/進入)。"},{"sentence":"The new password was changed to ensure that only authorized personnel could <target>access</target> the confidential files on the company's server.","translation":"新密碼被更改以確保只有授權人員才能進入公司伺服器上的機密文件。","explanation":"動詞「進入、獲取」。指進入數位系統或檔案。"},{"sentence":"The mountain village is very remote, and during the winter, heavy snow often blocks the only <target>access</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the town.","translation":"這個山村非常偏遠，而且在冬天，大雪經常阻塞通往小鎮的唯一通道。","explanation":"名詞「通路」。指物理上的進入路徑。"},{"sentence":"Many people in rural areas still lack <target>access</target> <pattern>to</pattern> basic healthcare services, making it difficult for them to receive timely treatment.","translation":"許多鄉村地區的人們仍然缺乏獲得基本醫療服務的管道，使他們難以獲得及時的治療。","explanation":"名詞「獲取渠道」。常用搭配 lack access to (缺乏獲取...的渠道)。"}],"related_forms":["accessible"]}

{"headword":"accidental","explanation":"形容詞「意外的、偶然的」。指非刻意為之的事物。注意與 intentional (刻意的) 相反。常用搭配：accidental death (意外死亡), accidental discovery (偶然發現)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The spill of coffee on the important document was completely <target>accidental</target>, and she apologized sincerely to her boss immediately.","translation":"咖啡灑在重要文件上的事完全是意外，她立即向老闆誠懇地道歉。","explanation":"形容詞「意外的」。指非刻意發生的事。"},{"sentence":"Many great scientific discoveries were <target>accidental</target>, such as when a scientist found a new medicine by mistake during an experiment.","translation":"許多偉大的科學發現是偶然的，例如科學家在實驗中不小心發現了一種新藥。","explanation":"形容詞「偶然的」。常用搭配 accidental discovery (偶然發現)。"},{"sentence":"The fire was caused by an <target>accidental</target> <pattern>leak</pattern> of gas in the old kitchen, which led to a quick evacuation of the building.","translation":"火災是由舊廚房中氣體的意外洩漏引起的，導致建築物迅速撤離。","explanation":"形容詞「意外的」。常用搭配 accidental leak (意外洩漏)。"}],"related_forms":["accident","accidentally"]}

{"headword":"accompany","explanation":"動詞「陪同、伴隨」。常用於指人陪人，或某事伴隨著另一件事發生。常用搭配：be accompanied by (由...陪同/伴隨)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young boy was <target>accompanied</target> <pattern>by</pattern> his parents as they visited the national museum for the first time during the summer break.","translation":"這個小男孩在暑假第一次參觀國家博物館時，由他的父母陪同。","explanation":"動詞「陪同」。常用被動態 be accompanied by。"},{"sentence":"The heavy rain was <target>accompanied</target> <pattern>by</pattern> strong winds, making it very dangerous for drivers to stay on the highway.","translation":"大雨伴隨著強風，使駕駛者留在高速公路上的情況變得非常危險。","explanation":"動詞「伴隨」。指自然現象同時發生。"},{"sentence":"The singer's beautiful voice was <target>accompanied</target> <pattern>by</pattern> a professional pianist, creating a wonderful atmosphere for the audience.","translation":"歌手優美的聲音由一名專業鋼琴家伴奏，為觀眾營造了美好的氛圍。","explanation":"動詞「伴奏」。指音樂上的伴奏。"},{"sentence":"She decided to <target>accompany</target> her friend to the doctor's office because her friend felt very nervous about the upcoming medical check-up.","translation":"她決定陪她的朋友去診所，因為她的朋友對即將到來的體檢感到非常緊張。","explanation":"動詞「陪同」。"}],"related_forms":["accompaniment","accompanist"]}

{"headword":"accomplish","explanation":"動詞「完成、達成」；名詞 accomplishment 「成就、才能」。常用於達成目標、完成任務。注意 accomplish 側重於透過努力完成某事，而 achieve 則更強調達成一個高水準的目標或地位。","entries":[{"sentence":"By working hard and managing their time effectively, the students were able to <target>accomplish</target> all their assignments before the deadline.","translation":"透過努力工作並有效地管理時間，學生們能夠在截止日期前完成所有作業。","explanation":"動詞「完成」。指完成設定的任務或作業。"},{"sentence":"The team felt a great sense of pride after they <target>accomplished</target> <pattern>their goal of</pattern> winning the national debate competition.","translation":"在贏得全國辯論比賽的目標後，團隊感到非常自豪。","explanation":"動詞「達成」。常用搭配 accomplish one's goal (達成某人的目標)。"},{"sentence":"Learning a second language is a significant <target>accomplishment</target> that requires years of dedication, practice, and persistence.","translation":"學習第二語言是一項重大的成就，需要多年的奉獻、練習和堅持。","explanation":"名詞「成就」。指透過努力而獲得的成果。"},{"sentence":"Besides her academic success, her ability to play the piano beautifully is one of her most impressive <target>accomplishments</target>.","translation":"除了學業上的成功，她能優美地彈奏鋼琴是她最令人印象深刻的才能之一。","explanation":"名詞「才能」。指個人擁有的技能或才藝。"}],"related_forms":["accomplishment","accomplished"]}

{"headword":"accountant","explanation":"名詞「會計師」。指負責記錄、分析和審計財務記錄的專業人士。","entries":[{"sentence":"After graduating from the university with a degree in finance, Sarah decided to become a certified public <target>accountant</target>.","translation":"在大學獲得財務學位畢業後，莎拉決定成為一名特許公共會計師。","explanation":"名詞「會計師」。指專業的財務管理人員。"},{"sentence":"The small business owner hired a professional <target>accountant</target> to help him <pattern>manage</pattern> his <pattern>taxes</pattern> and financial records accurately.","translation":"這家小企業主聘請了一名專業會計師來幫助他準確地管理稅務和財務記錄。","explanation":"名詞「會計師」。常用搭配 manage taxes (管理稅務)。"},{"sentence":"The company's <target>accountant</target> spent the entire week analyzing the budget to find ways to reduce unnecessary expenses.","translation":"公司的會計師花了一整週分析預算，以尋找減少不必要開支的方法。","explanation":"名詞「會計師」。描述其分析預算的工作內容。"}],"related_forms":["accounting"]}

{"headword":"accuracy","explanation":"名詞「準確性、精確度」。常用於描述數據、翻譯或預測的精確程度。形容詞為 accurate。","entries":[{"sentence":"The scientist checked the data several times to ensure the <target>accuracy</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the experimental results before publishing the report.","translation":"科學家在發表報告前多次檢查數據，以確保實驗結果的準確性。","explanation":"名詞「準確性」。常用搭配 accuracy of sth (某事的準確性)。"},{"sentence":"In the translation exam, students are graded not only on their fluency but also on the <target>accuracy</target> of their vocabulary choice.","translation":"在翻譯考試中，學生不僅根據流利度，還根據詞彙選擇的準確性來評分。","explanation":"名詞「精確度」。指對原意的準確傳達。"},{"sentence":"The new weather forecasting system has improved the <target>accuracy</target> <pattern>of</pattern> long-term predictions, helping farmers plan their crops better.","translation":"新的天氣預報系統提高了長期預測的準確性，幫助農民更好地規劃農作物。","explanation":"名詞「準確性」。常用搭配 accuracy of predictions (預測的準確性)。"}],"related_forms":["accurate","accurately"]}

{"headword":"accuse","explanation":"動詞「指控、控告」。常用句型 accuse someone of something (指控某人某事)。注意介係詞必須使用 of，不能用 for。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher had to <target>accuse</target> the student <pattern>of</pattern> cheating on the final exam after finding a cheat sheet under his desk.","translation":"在書桌下發現作弊條後，老師不得不指控該學生在期末考試中作弊。","explanation":"動詞「指控」。常用句型 accuse someone of doing sth (指控某人做某事)。"},{"sentence":"It is unfair to <target>accuse</target> someone <pattern>of</pattern> theft without having any concrete evidence to support the claim.","translation":"在沒有任何具體證據支持主張的情況下指控他人偷竊是不公平的。","explanation":"動詞「指控」。常用句型 accuse someone of sth (指控某人某事)。"},{"sentence":"The company was <target>accused</target> <pattern>of</pattern> polluting the local river by dumping chemical waste illegally into the water.","translation":"該公司被指控非法將化學廢料排入水中，污染了當地河流。","explanation":"動詞「指控」。此處為被動語態 be accused of (被指控)。"}],"related_forms":["accusation","accuser"]}

{"headword":"acid","explanation":"名詞「酸」；形容詞「酸的」或「尖酸的」。在科學語境中指 pH 值低於 7 的物質；在描述語言或態度時，指刻薄或尖銳。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the chemistry lab, the students learned that lemon juice contains citric <target>acid</target>, which gives it a sour taste.","translation":"在化學實驗室中，學生們了解到檸檬汁含有檸檬酸，這使其具有酸味。","explanation":"名詞「酸」。指化學上的酸性物質。"},{"sentence":"The soil in this region is too <target>acid</target> for some types of plants to grow, so farmers must add lime to balance it.","translation":"這個地區的土壤對於某些類型的植物來說太酸了，因此農民必須添加石灰來平衡。","explanation":"形容詞「酸的」。描述物質的化學性質。"},{"sentence":"The critic's <target>acid</target> <pattern>remarks</pattern> about the new movie offended the director and sparked a heated debate in the media.","translation":"評論家對這部新電影的尖酸評論冒犯了導演，並在媒體中引起了激烈的辯論。","explanation":"形容詞「尖酸的」。常用搭配 acid remarks/comments (尖酸的評論)。"}],"related_forms":["acidic","acidity"]}

{"headword":"acquaintance","explanation":"名詞「熟人」或「認識」。指不如朋友親密的人。常用片語 make someone's acquaintance (認識某人)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although he has many <target>acquaintances</target> from his time at university, he only has a few close friends he can truly trust.","translation":"儘管他在大學期間有很多熟人，但他只有幾個真正可以信任的親密朋友。","explanation":"名詞「熟人」。指認識但關係不深的人。"},{"sentence":"I only have a passing <target>acquaintance</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the history of ancient Rome, so I cannot answer your detailed questions.","translation":"我對古羅馬歷史僅有初步的了解，因此無法回答你的詳細問題。","explanation":"名詞「認識/了解」。常用搭配 have an acquaintance with sth (對某事有了解)。"},{"sentence":"The two businessmen were pleased to <pattern>make</pattern> each other's <target>acquaintance</target> during the international trade fair in Tokyo.","translation":"這兩位商人很高興在東京的國際貿易展覽會上認識彼此。","explanation":"名詞「認識」。常用片語 make someone's acquaintance (認識某人)。"}],"related_forms":["acquaint","acquainted"]}

{"headword":"acquire","explanation":"動詞「獲得、習得」。常用於獲得知識、技能、語言或財產。注意 acquire 側重於透過時間、努力或過程而逐漸獲得。","entries":[{"sentence":"Students can <target>acquire</target> <pattern>essential skills</pattern> such as critical thinking and problem-solving through active participation in class discussions.","translation":"學生可以透過積極參與課堂討論，習得批判性思考和解決問題等基本技能。","explanation":"動詞「習得」。常用搭配 acquire skills (習得技能)。"},{"sentence":"It takes many years of practice for a person to <target>acquire</target> <pattern>fluency in</pattern> a foreign language.","translation":"一個人需要多年的練習才能掌握一門外語的流利度。","explanation":"動詞「習得」。常用搭配 acquire fluency in (掌握...的流利度)。"},{"sentence":"The museum worked for decades to <target>acquire</target> <pattern>rare artifacts</pattern> from around the world to enhance its historical collection.","translation":"該博物館數十年來致力於從世界各地獲取稀有文物，以豐富其歷史收藏。","explanation":"動詞「獲得」。指獲取具體的物品。"}],"related_forms":["acquisition","acquisitive"]}

{"headword":"adapt","explanation":"動詞「適應」或「改編」。常用搭配 adapt to (適應...)。注意 adapt (適應) 與 adopt (採取/領養) 容易混淆。","entries":[{"sentence":"Moving to a new city can be challenging, but most students eventually <target>adapt</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the local environment and lifestyle.","translation":"搬到一個新城市可能具有挑戰性，但大多數學生最終會適應當地的環境和生活方式。","explanation":"動詞「適應」。常用搭配 adapt to sth (適應某事)。"},{"sentence":"Many animals have developed unique physical features to <target>adapt</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the extreme cold of the Arctic region.","translation":"許多動物已經發展出獨特的身體特徵，以適應北極地區的極端寒冷。","explanation":"動詞「適應」。指生物演化以生存。"},{"sentence":"The famous novel was <target>adapted</target> <pattern>into</pattern> a movie, but some fans felt the film changed too many important plot details.","translation":"這部著名小說被改編成了電影，但一些粉絲覺得電影改變了太多重要的情節細節。","explanation":"動詞「改編」。常用搭配 adapt into (改編成)。"}],"related_forms":["adaptation","adaptable","adaptability"]}

{"headword":"addict","explanation":"名詞「上癮者」；動詞「使上癮」。常考片語 be addicted to (對...上癮)。注意名詞 addict 指的是人，而 addiction 指的是上癮這種狀態。","entries":[{"sentence":"The documentary warned that many teenagers are becoming smartphone <target>addicts</target>, spending hours scrolling through social media every day.","translation":"這部紀錄片警告說，許多青少年正成為智慧型手機上癮者，每天花好幾個小時瀏覽社群媒體。","explanation":"名詞「上癮者」。指對某物產生依賴的人。"},{"sentence":"He realized he had become a caffeine <target>addict</target> when he found it impossible to concentrate on his work without a cup of coffee.","translation":"當他發現沒有一杯咖啡就無法集中注意力工作時，他意識到自己已經成了一個咖啡上癮者。","explanation":"名詞「上癮者」。"},{"sentence":"Many people are <target>addicted</target> <pattern>to</pattern> online gaming, which can lead to a lack of sleep and poor performance in school.","translation":"許多人對線上遊戲上癮，這可能導致睡眠不足和學校表現不佳。","explanation":"形容詞/分詞「上癮的」。常用句型 be addicted to sth (對某事上癮)。"}],"related_forms":["addiction","addictive"]}

{"headword":"adequate","explanation":"形容詞「足夠的、適當的」。指在數量或品質上達到最低要求。注意 adequate 僅表示「夠用」，而 sufficient 則較正式且常用於數量，ample 則表示「充足且有餘」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school ensures that every student has <target>adequate</target> <pattern>access to</pattern> the library resources needed for their research projects.","translation":"學校確保每位學生都能獲得研究專案所需的充足圖書館資源。","explanation":"形容詞「足夠的」。常用搭配 adequate access to (充足的獲取管道)。"},{"sentence":"Without <target>adequate</target> <pattern>preparation</pattern>, it is very difficult for students to perform well in a high-pressure exam like the GSAT.","translation":"如果沒有充分的準備，學生很難在像學測這樣的高壓考試中表現良好。","explanation":"形容詞「充分的」。常用搭配 adequate preparation (充分的準備)。"},{"sentence":"The emergency shelter provided <target>adequate</target> <pattern>food and water</pattern> for the victims of the earthquake during the first few days.","translation":"緊急避難所為地震災民在最初幾天提供了足夠的食物和水。","explanation":"形容詞「足夠的」。指滿足基本需求。"}],"related_forms":["adequately","adequacy"]}

{"headword":"adjust","explanation":"動詞意為「調整」或「適應」。當指調整物理位置或設定時，常用 adjust sth；當指適應新環境時，常用 adjust to sth。名詞形式為 adjustment，常用搭配 make an adjustment to sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new student spent a few weeks trying to <target>adjust</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the strict rules and fast pace of the high school.","translation":"新學生花了幾個星期試圖適應高中的嚴格規定和快節奏。","explanation":"動詞「適應」。常用搭配 adjust to sth。"},{"sentence":"You can <target>adjust</target> the height of the chair to make it more comfortable for your back while studying for long hours.","translation":"你可以調整椅子的高度，讓你在長時間學習時背部更舒適。","explanation":"動詞「調整」。指改變某物的設定或位置以達到理想狀態。"},{"sentence":"The company had to <pattern>make</pattern> a few <target>adjustments</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the original plan to reduce costs and improve efficiency.","translation":"公司必須對原計劃進行一些調整，以降低成本並提高效率。","explanation":"名詞「調整」。常用搭配 make an adjustment to sth。"},{"sentence":"It often takes time for people to <target>adjust</target> <pattern>to</pattern> a new climate when they move to a different country for the first time.","translation":"人們第一次搬到不同的國家時，通常需要時間來適應新的氣候。","explanation":"動詞「適應」。"}],"related_forms":["adjustment","adjustable"]}

{"headword":"admirable","explanation":"形容詞，意為「令人欽佩的」或「值得讚賞的」。通常用來描述某人的品質、行為或成就。注意與 admirer (欽佩者) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"Her <target>admirable</target> courage in the face of great difficulty inspired many of her classmates to never give up on their dreams.","translation":"她在面對巨大困難時那令人欽佩的勇氣，激勵了許多同學永不放棄自己的夢想。","explanation":"形容詞「令人欽佩的」。常用於描述特質或行為。"},{"sentence":"The volunteers showed <target>admirable</target> dedication by spending their entire summer helping the homeless people in the city.","translation":"志工們投入整個夏天幫助城市裡的無家可歸者，表現出令人讚賞的奉獻精神。","explanation":"形容詞「值得讚賞的」。"},{"sentence":"It is <target>admirable</target> that he decided to donate most of his savings to the local orphanage to help children in need.","translation":"他決定將大部分積蓄捐給當地孤兒院以幫助需要幫助的孩子，這令人欽佩。","explanation":"形容詞「令人欽佩的」。常用句型 It is admirable that..."}],"related_forms":["admire","admiration"]}

{"headword":"admiration","explanation":"名詞，意為「欽佩」或「讚賞」。常用搭配 have admiration for someone 或 look at someone with admiration。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young artist looked at the famous painting with deep <target>admiration</target>, wondering how the creator could capture such emotion.","translation":"年輕的藝術家以深深的欽佩之情注視著這幅名畫，好奇創作者如何能捕捉到如此強烈的情感。","explanation":"名詞「欽佩」。常用搭配 with admiration。"},{"sentence":"Many students have great <target>admiration</target> <pattern>for</pattern> their teacher because of her passion for teaching and her kindness to everyone.","translation":"許多學生非常欽佩他們的老師，因為她對教學的熱情以及對每個人的友善。","explanation":"名詞「欽佩」。常用搭配 have admiration for someone。"},{"sentence":"His hard work and honesty won the <target>admiration</target> of everyone in the office, leading to his quick promotion to manager.","translation":"他的勤奮與誠實贏得了辦公室所有人的欽佩，使他很快被晉升為經理。","explanation":"名詞「欽佩」。常用搭配 win the admiration of someone。"}],"related_forms":["admire","admirable"]}

{"headword":"admission","explanation":"名詞，具有多種含義：1. 「准許進入」或「入場券」；2. 「入學」；3. 「承認（錯誤或事實）」。注意 admission fee (入場費) 和 admission to (進入/入學...的許可) 的用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"The museum offers free <target>admission</target> to students on weekends, provided they show a valid student ID card at the gate.","translation":"博物館在週末向學生提供免費入場，前提是在門口出示有效的學生證。","explanation":"名詞「入場」。常用搭配 free admission (免費入場)。"},{"sentence":"Competition for <target>admission</target> <pattern>to</pattern> top universities is becoming more intense every year, forcing students to study even harder.","translation":"進入頂尖大學的競爭每年變得更加激烈，迫使學生更加努力地學習。","explanation":"名詞「入學許可」。常用搭配 admission to university。"},{"sentence":"The suspect's <target>admission</target> of the crime surprised the police, as he had previously denied everything during the interrogation.","translation":"嫌疑犯對罪行的承認讓警方感到驚訝，因為他之前在審問中否認了一切。","explanation":"名詞「承認」。指對某事（通常是不好的事）的認可或承認。"},{"sentence":"The <target>admission</target> <pattern>fee</pattern> for the art gallery is twenty dollars, but children under twelve can enter for free.","translation":"美術館的入場費是二十美元，但十二歲以下兒童可以免費進入。","explanation":"名詞「入場費」。常用搭配 admission fee。"}],"related_forms":["admit"]}

{"headword":"adopt","explanation":"動詞，意為「領養（孩子或寵物）」或「採納/採取（方法、態度、計畫）」。注意與 adapt (適應/改編) 的拼寫區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The couple decided to <target>adopt</target> a child from an orphanage because they wanted to give a loving home to a child in need.","translation":"這對夫婦決定從孤兒院領養一個孩子，因為他們想給需要幫助的孩子一個充滿愛的家。","explanation":"動詞「領養」。指法律上將他人孩子視為己出。"},{"sentence":"The school board decided to <target>adopt</target> a new teaching method to encourage students to be more active in the classroom.","translation":"學校董事會決定採取一種新的教學方法，以鼓勵學生在課堂上更加積極。","explanation":"動詞「採納/採取」。指開始使用某種方法或計畫。"},{"sentence":"To improve their health, many people have started to <target>adopt</target> a healthier lifestyle by eating more vegetables and exercising daily.","translation":"為了改善健康，許多人開始採取更健康的生活方式，例如多吃蔬菜和每天運動。","explanation":"動詞「採取」。常用搭配 adopt a lifestyle / adopt a habit。"},{"sentence":"The city council voted to <target>adopt</target> the proposed policy to reduce plastic waste in all public parks and markets.","translation":"市議會投票通過採取該擬議的政策，以減少所有公共公園和市場中的塑料垃圾。","explanation":"動詞「採納」。指正式接受或通過某項計畫。"}],"related_forms":["adoption","adoptive"]}

{"headword":"agency","explanation":"名詞，意為「代理機構」、「代理店」或「機構」。常見於 travel agency (旅行社) 或 employment agency (人力派遣公司)。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you are planning a trip to Japan, it might be easier to book your flights and hotels through a travel <target>agency</target>.","translation":"如果你計劃去日本旅行，通過旅行社預訂機票和酒店可能會更容易。","explanation":"名詞「代理機構」。常用搭配 travel agency (旅行社)。"},{"sentence":"The government established a special <target>agency</target> to monitor environmental pollution and protect the endangered species in the forest.","translation":"政府成立了一個特別機構來監控環境污染並保護森林中的瀕危物種。","explanation":"名詞「機構」。指由政府或組織設立的執行單位。"},{"sentence":"After graduating from college, he contacted an employment <target>agency</target> to help him find a job that matched his skills.","translation":"大學畢業後，他聯繫了一家人力派遣公司，幫助他找到一份與其技能相匹配的工作。","explanation":"名詞「代理店」。常用搭配 employment agency (人力派遣公司)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"agent","explanation":"名詞，意為「代理人」、「經紀人」或「藥劑/化學物質」。在商務情境中，常指代表他人處理事務的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The famous actor hired a talent <target>agent</target> to handle his contracts and find the best movie roles for his career.","translation":"這位著名演員聘請了一位經紀人來處理他的合約，並為他的職業生涯尋找最好的電影角色。","explanation":"名詞「經紀人」。常用搭配 talent agent (演藝經紀人)。"},{"sentence":"The real estate <target>agent</target> showed the young couple several houses in the neighborhood before they finally decided which one to buy.","translation":"房地產經紀人向這對年輕夫婦展示了社區裡的幾棟房子，直到他們最後決定買哪一棟。","explanation":"名詞「代理人」。常用搭配 real estate agent (房地產經紀人)。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are developing a new chemical <target>agent</target> that can effectively remove oil spills from the ocean without harming marine life.","translation":"科學家正在開發一種新的化學藥劑，可以有效地清除海洋中的溢油而不會傷害海洋生物。","explanation":"名詞「藥劑/化學物質」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"aggressive","explanation":"形容詞，意為「好鬥的」、「咄咄逼人的」或「積極進取的」。在商務或學習語境中，aggressive 可以是褒義（積極），但在人際關係中通常是貶義（具有攻擊性）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The dog became <target>aggressive</target> when the stranger tried to touch its food, barking loudly and showing its teeth.","translation":"當陌生人試圖觸碰它的食物時，這隻狗變得具有攻擊性，大聲吠叫並露出牙齒。","explanation":"形容詞「好鬥的、有攻擊性的」。"},{"sentence":"The company launched an <target>aggressive</target> marketing campaign to attract more customers and increase its market share within six months.","translation":"公司發起了一場積極進取的行銷活動，旨在六個月內吸引更多顧客並增加市場份額。","explanation":"形容詞「積極進取的」。在此處為褒義，指力度強且有目標的。"},{"sentence":"Some students can be too <target>aggressive</target> during group discussions, often interrupting others and refusing to listen to different opinions.","translation":"有些學生在小組討論時太過咄咄逼人，經常打斷他人且拒絕聽取不同意見。","explanation":"形容詞「咄咄逼人的」。指態度強勢且不禮貌。"}],"related_forms":["aggressively","aggression"]}

{"headword":"agreeable","explanation":"形容詞，意為「令人愉快的」或「欣然同意的」。注意與 agree (同意) 的區別，agreeable 描述的是事物或人的特質，而非動作。","entries":[{"sentence":"The weather during our vacation in Switzerland was very <target>agreeable</target>, with mild temperatures and clear blue skies every day.","translation":"我們在瑞士度假期間的天氣非常令人愉快，每天氣溫溫和，天空蔚藍。","explanation":"形容詞「令人愉快的」。常用於描述天氣、環境或氛圍。"},{"sentence":"She is an <target>agreeable</target> person who always tries to find a compromise that makes everyone in the group feel happy.","translation":"她是一個隨和的人，總是試圖找到一個讓小組中每個人都感到滿意的折衷方案。","explanation":"形容詞「隨和的、令人愉快的」。描述人的性格。"},{"sentence":"The manager found the proposed terms of the contract <target>agreeable</target> and signed the document immediately after the meeting.","translation":"經理發現擬議的合約條款是可以接受的，並在會議後立即簽署了文件。","explanation":"形容詞「欣然同意的、可接受的」。"}],"related_forms":["agreeably"]}

{"headword":"alcohol","explanation":"名詞，意為「酒精」或「酒類」。常用於討論健康、法律或化學。注意 alcohol-free (無酒精的) 的用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"Doctors advise people to limit their intake of <target>alcohol</target> to avoid serious liver damage and other health problems in the future.","translation":"醫生建議人們限制酒精的攝入量，以避免未來出現嚴重的肝臟損傷和其他健康問題。","explanation":"名詞「酒精」。指化學成分或含酒精飲料。"},{"sentence":"The law strictly prohibits anyone under the age of eighteen from purchasing <target>alcohol</target> in most countries around the world.","translation":"在世界上大多數國家，法律嚴格禁止十八歲以下的人購買酒精飲料。","explanation":"名詞「酒類」。"},{"sentence":"To keep the wound clean and prevent infection, the nurse used <target>alcohol</target> to disinfect the skin around the cut.","translation":"為了保持傷口清潔並防止感染，護士使用酒精對切口周圍的皮膚進行消毒。","explanation":"名詞「酒精」。在此指用於醫療消毒的酒精。"}],"related_forms":["alcoholic"]}

{"headword":"alert","explanation":"可作形容詞「警覺的」、動詞「警告」或名詞「警報」。形容詞用法常搭配 to (alert to sth)。動詞用法常搭配 about 或 of (alert someone to/about sth)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The lifeguard remained <target>alert</target> <pattern>to</pattern> any signs of danger while watching the swimmers at the crowded beach.","translation":"救生員在擁擠的海灘上監視游泳者時，對任何危險跡象都保持警覺。","explanation":"形容詞「警覺的」。常用搭配 alert to sth。"},{"sentence":"The security system is designed to <target>alert</target> the owners <pattern>to</pattern> any unusual activity in the house through a mobile app.","translation":"這個安全系統旨在透過行動應用程式，在房屋內有任何異常活動時警告屋主。","explanation":"動詞「警告」。常用搭配 alert someone to sth。"},{"sentence":"The government issued a weather <target>alert</target> <pattern>warning</pattern> students to stay indoors due to the approaching heavy rain and strong winds.","translation":"政府發布了天氣警報，警告學生在強風大雨即將到來時留在室內。","explanation":"名詞「警報」。常用搭配 weather alert。"}],"related_forms":["alertness"]}

{"headword":"allowance","explanation":"名詞「津貼；零用錢；限額」。常指由父母或雇主定期支付的金額，或在特定規定下允許的數量或額度。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many teenagers receive a weekly <target>allowance</target> <pattern>from</pattern> their parents to cover their small expenses and learn how to manage money.","translation":"許多青少年每週從父母那裡領取零用錢，以支付小額支出並學習如何理財。","explanation":"名詞「零用錢」。"},{"sentence":"The company provides a monthly travel <target>allowance</target> <pattern>to</pattern> its employees, helping them pay for transportation costs when commuting to work.","translation":"公司為員工提供每月交通津貼，幫助他們支付通勤上班的交通費用。","explanation":"名詞「津貼」。"},{"sentence":"Passengers are informed that there is a strict baggage <target>allowance</target> <pattern>of</pattern> twenty kilograms per person on this flight.","translation":"乘客被告知，此次航班每人的行李限額為二十公斤。","explanation":"名詞「限額」。常用搭配 baggage allowance。"}],"related_forms":["allow"]}

{"headword":"alternative","explanation":"可作形容詞「替代的；另一種選擇的」或名詞「替代方案；選擇」。名詞用法常接介系詞 to (an alternative to sth)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Since the main road was closed for repairs, the driver had to find an <target>alternative</target> route to reach the city center.","translation":"由於主路因維修而封閉，駕駛者必須尋找另一條替代路線以到達市中心。","explanation":"形容詞「替代的」。"},{"sentence":"Solar power is often seen as a clean <target>alternative</target> <pattern>to</pattern> fossil fuels, which cause significant pollution to the environment.","translation":"太陽能常被視為化石燃料的一種清潔替代方案，因為化石燃料會對環境造成顯著污染。","explanation":"名詞「替代方案」。常用搭配 an alternative to sth。"},{"sentence":"When the first plan failed, the team discussed several <target>alternatives</target> to ensure the project could be completed on time.","translation":"當第一個計畫失敗時，團隊討論了幾個替代方案，以確保計畫能按時完成。","explanation":"名詞「選擇/方案」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"amateur","explanation":"可作形容詞「業餘的」或名詞「業餘愛好者」。指不以該活動為職業的人。與 professional (專業的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although he is an <target>amateur</target> photographer, his pictures are so high-quality that many people think he is a professional.","translation":"雖然他是一名業餘攝影師，但他的照片品質如此之高，以至於許多人認為他是專業的。","explanation":"名詞「業餘愛好者」。"},{"sentence":"The local community center organized an <target>amateur</target> drama competition to encourage residents to express their creativity through acting.","translation":"當地社區中心舉辦了一場業餘戲劇比賽，鼓勵居民透過表演來表達他們的創造力。","explanation":"形容詞「業餘的」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"ambiguous","explanation":"形容詞「模稜兩可的；含糊不清的」。指意思不單一或不明確，容易引起誤解。常用搭配：ambiguous answer/statement/meaning。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher asked the student to rewrite the sentence because its <target>ambiguous</target> meaning could lead to different interpretations.","translation":"老師要求學生重寫該句子，因為其模稜兩可的意思可能會導致不同的解釋。","explanation":"形容詞「模稜兩可的」。"},{"sentence":"Because the instructions for the assignment were <target>ambiguous</target>, many students were confused about what they were supposed to do.","translation":"由於作業指令含糊不清，許多學生對他們應該做什麼感到困惑。","explanation":"形容詞「含糊不清的」。"}],"related_forms":["ambiguity"]}

{"headword":"ambitious","explanation":"形容詞「有野心的；雄心勃勃的」。可用於形容人對成功、權力或地位的渴望，也可以用來形容計畫或目標「宏大的」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>ambitious</target> student set a goal to master three different languages by the time she graduated from high school.","translation":"這位有野心的學生設定了一個目標，在高中畢業前精通三種不同的語言。","explanation":"形容詞「有野心的」。"},{"sentence":"The city government has proposed an <target>ambitious</target> plan to build a new park and library within two years.","translation":"市政府提出了一項宏大的計畫，打算在兩年內建造一座新公園和圖書館。","explanation":"形容詞「宏大的」。指計畫、目標等規模大且困難。"}],"related_forms":["ambition"]}

{"headword":"amuse","explanation":"動詞「逗樂；使娛樂」。名詞形式 amusement 意為「娛樂；樂趣」。常用搭配：amuse oneself with sth (用...來娛樂自己)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The clown at the party used funny tricks and jokes to <target>amuse</target> the children, making them laugh throughout the evening.","translation":"派對上的小丑用有趣的技巧和笑話來逗樂孩子們，讓他們整個晚上都在笑。","explanation":"動詞「逗樂」。"},{"sentence":"During the long flight, the young boy <target>amused</target> <pattern>himself</pattern> <pattern>with</pattern> a coloring book and some small toys to pass the time.","translation":"在漫長的飛行中，小男孩用一本著色本和一些小玩具來娛樂自己以消磨時間。","explanation":"動詞片語 amuse oneself with sth 表示「用...娛樂自己」。"},{"sentence":"The local <target>amusement</target> park is a popular destination for families during the summer holidays, offering various exciting rides.","translation":"當地的娛樂公園是一個夏季假期中家庭出遊的熱門目的地，提供各種刺激的遊樂設施。","explanation":"名詞「娛樂」。amusement park 指「遊樂園」。"}],"related_forms":["amusement"]}

{"headword":"analysis","explanation":"名詞「分析」。指將複雜的事物拆解成細節以理解其本質。常用搭配：conduct an analysis, detailed analysis。","entries":[{"sentence":"After gathering all the data, the researcher conducted a detailed <target>analysis</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the results to identify any patterns.","translation":"在收集所有數據後，研究人員對結果進行了詳細的分析，以找出任何模式。","explanation":"名詞「分析」。常用搭配 analysis of sth。"},{"sentence":"The chemical <target>analysis</target> of the water sample showed that it contained harmful pollutants, which led to a public health warning.","translation":"對水樣的化學分析顯示其中含有有害污染物，這導致了公眾健康警告。","explanation":"名詞「分析」。"}],"related_forms":["analyze","analytical"]}

{"headword":"analyze","explanation":"動詞「分析」。指詳細地研究某事以發現其本質或意義。注意美國英語拼寫為 analyze，英國英語為 analyse。","entries":[{"sentence":"Students are required to <target>analyze</target> the themes of the poem and explain how the author uses imagery to convey emotion.","translation":"學生被要求分析詩歌的主題，並解釋作者如何使用意象來傳達情感。","explanation":"動詞「分析」。"},{"sentence":"The detective spent hours <target>analyzing</target> the security camera footage to determine the exact time the thief entered the building.","translation":"偵探花了好幾個小時分析監視器畫面，以確定小偷進入建築物的確切時間。","explanation":"動詞「分析」。"}],"related_forms":["analysis","analytical"]}

{"headword":"ancestor","explanation":"名詞「祖先」。指在一個人的家族中，早於該人出生之前的親屬。常用搭配：common ancestor。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many people visit their <target>ancestors</target>' graves during the Qingming Festival to show respect and remember their family history.","translation":"許多人在清明節期間祭拜祖先的墳墓，以表示尊重並紀念家族歷史。","explanation":"名詞「祖先」。"},{"sentence":"Scientists believe that humans and chimpanzees share a <pattern>common</pattern> <target>ancestor</target> that lived millions of years ago.","translation":"科學家認為人類和黑猩猩擁有一個生活在數百萬年前的共同祖先。","explanation":"名詞「祖先」。常用搭配 common ancestor。"}],"related_forms":["ancestry"]}

{"headword":"anniversary","explanation":"名詞，意為「週年紀念日」。通常用於慶祝結婚、公司成立或重大歷史事件的週年。常用搭配：wedding anniversary (結婚週年紀念), 10th anniversary (十週年紀念)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The couple hosted a grand party to celebrate their silver <target>anniversary</target>, marking twenty-five years of marriage and happiness.","translation":"這對夫婦舉辦了一場盛大的派對來慶祝他們的銀婚週年，標誌著二十五年婚姻的幸福。","explanation":"名詞「週年紀念日」。silver anniversary 指的是二十五週年結婚紀念日。"},{"sentence":"The city organized a parade and several exhibitions to commemorate the hundredth <target>anniversary</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the university's founding.","translation":"城市組織了一場遊行和幾個展覽，以紀念大學成立一百週年。","explanation":"名詞「週年紀念日」。常用搭配：anniversary of... (某事的週年紀念)。"}],"related_forms":["anniversaries"]}

{"headword":"annoy","explanation":"動詞，意為「使惱怒、使煩躁」。常用搭配：be annoyed with someone (對某人感到惱怒), be annoyed by something (對某事感到惱怒)。注意與 irritate 的區別：annoy 較為通用，而 irritate 則更強調生理上的刺激或極度煩躁。","entries":[{"sentence":"The loud noise from the construction site next door continued to <target>annoy</target> the students who were trying to concentrate on their final exams.","translation":"隔壁工地傳來的巨大噪音持續讓那些試圖專注於期末考的學生感到惱怒。","explanation":"動詞「使惱怒」。指因某事而感到煩躁。"},{"sentence":"Sarah was deeply <target>annoyed</target> <pattern>with</pattern> her brother for forgetting to pick her up from the airport as promised.","translation":"莎拉對她的哥哥深感惱怒，因為他忘了按照約定去機場接她。","explanation":"形容詞用法 (被動)，表示「對某人感到惱怒」。常用搭配：be annoyed with someone。"},{"sentence":"I was <target>annoyed</target> <pattern>by</pattern> the constant interruptions during the meeting, which made it difficult to follow the main points of the discussion.","translation":"我對會議中不斷的打斷感到惱怒，這使得很難跟上討論的主點。","explanation":"形容詞用法 (被動)，表示「對某事感到惱怒」。常用搭配：be annoyed by something。"}],"related_forms":["annoying","annoyance"]}

{"headword":"annual","explanation":"形容詞，意為「年度的、每年的」。名詞則指「年刊」。常用於描述週期性每年一次的活動，如 annual report (年度報告), annual meeting (年度會議), annual budget (年度預算)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company's <target>annual</target> <pattern>report</pattern> provides a detailed analysis of its financial performance and goals for the coming year.","translation":"公司的年度報告提供了對其財務表現和來年目標的詳細分析。","explanation":"形容詞「年度的」。常用搭配：annual report (年度報告)。"},{"sentence":"The school holds an <target>annual</target> <pattern>sports meet</pattern> every May, allowing students to showcase their athletic abilities and team spirit.","translation":"學校每年五月舉行一次年度運動會，讓學生們展現他們的運動能力和團隊精神。","explanation":"形容詞「每年的」。常用搭配：annual sports meet (年度運動會)。"},{"sentence":"Many birds migrate to warmer regions during the winter as part of their <target>annual</target> <pattern>cycle</pattern> of movement.","translation":"許多鳥類在冬季遷徙到較溫暖的地區，作為其年度移動週期的部分。","explanation":"形容詞「年度的」。常用搭配：annual cycle (年度週期)。"}],"related_forms":["annually"]}

{"headword":"anxiety","explanation":"名詞，意為「焦慮、不安」。常用搭配：suffer from anxiety (患有焦慮症), ease anxiety (緩解焦慮), social anxiety (社交焦慮)。注意與 anxious (形容詞) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students felt a great deal of <target>anxiety</target> <pattern>about</pattern> their upcoming final exams and the results of their university applications.","translation":"學生們對即將到來的期末考和大學申請結果感到非常焦慮。","explanation":"名詞「焦慮」。常用搭配：anxiety about... (對...的焦慮)。"},{"sentence":"Regular exercise and mindfulness meditation are often recommended as effective ways to <target>reduce</target> <pattern>anxiety</pattern> and improve mental well-being.","translation":"規律運動和正念冥想通常被推薦為緩解焦慮和改善心理健康的有效方法。","explanation":"名詞「焦慮」。常用搭配：reduce anxiety (減少/緩解焦慮)。"},{"sentence":"Many people experience <target>social</target> <target>anxiety</target> when speaking in front of a large crowd, which can make them feel nervous and shy.","translation":"許多人在大眾面前演講時會經歷社交焦慮，這會讓他們感到緊張和害羞。","explanation":"名詞「焦慮」。常用搭配：social anxiety (社交焦慮)。"}],"related_forms":["anxious"]}

{"headword":"apology","explanation":"名詞，意為「道歉」。常用搭配：make an apology (道歉), offer an apology (提供道歉), sincere apology (真誠的道歉)。注意與 apologize (動詞) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"After realizing he had made a mistake, the manager <pattern>offered</pattern> a sincere <target>apology</target> <pattern>to</pattern> his employees for the confusion caused.","translation":"在意識到自己犯了錯後，經理向他的員工們提供了真誠的道歉，以彌補所造成的混亂。","explanation":"名詞「道歉」。常用搭配：offer an apology to someone (向某人道歉)。"},{"sentence":"The company issued a formal <target>apology</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the technical failure of their new product, promising to fix the issue immediately.","translation":"公司針對其新產品的技術故障發布了正式的道歉，並承諾立即修復該問題。","explanation":"名詞「道歉」。常用搭配：apology for something (對某事的道歉)。"},{"sentence":"She decided to <pattern>make</pattern> an <target>apology</target> to her best friend after they had a heated argument about a group project.","translation":"在他們針對一項小組專案發生激烈爭執後，她決定向她最好的朋友道歉。","explanation":"名詞「道歉」。常用搭配：make an apology (道歉)。"}],"related_forms":["apologize","apologetic"]}

{"headword":"apparent","explanation":"形容詞，意為「明顯的」或「表面上的」。常用搭配：become apparent (變得明顯), for all apparent reasons (就表面原因而言)。注意：當它表示「明顯的」時，與 obvious 相似；當它表示「表面上的」 (seeming) 時，則是指事實可能不同。","entries":[{"sentence":"It soon <target>became</target> <target>apparent</target> that the team had not prepared enough for the presentation, as they struggled to answer the judge's questions.","translation":"很快就變得明顯，這個團隊沒有為簡報充分準備，因為他們在回答評審的問題時顯得吃力。","explanation":"形容詞「明顯的」。常用搭配：become apparent (變得明顯)。"},{"sentence":"Although his <target>apparent</target> <pattern>calmness</pattern> suggested he was not nervous, his shaking hands revealed his true feelings of anxiety.","translation":"儘管他表面上的冷靜建議他並不緊張，但他顫抖的雙手揭露了他的真正焦慮感。","explanation":"形容詞「表面上的」。指表面現象，但事實可能不同。"},{"sentence":"The cause of the accident was <target>apparent</target> to everyone who saw the crash, as the driver had been speeding for several minutes.","translation":"對於所有看到車禍的人來說，事故的原因是很明顯的，因為駕駛者已經超速行駛了數分鐘。","explanation":"形容詞「明顯的」。"}],"related_forms":["apparently"]}

{"headword":"applicant","explanation":"名詞，意為「申請人」。常用於就業、大學入學或獎學金申請。常用搭配：successful applicant (成功的申請人/錄取者), job applicant (求職者)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company received hundreds of <target>applicants</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the marketing position, and they had to carefully screen each resume.","translation":"公司針對該行銷職位收到了數百名申請人，他們必須仔細地篩選每一份履歷。","explanation":"名詞「申請人」。常用搭配：applicant for... (...的申請人)。"},{"sentence":"Only the most <target>successful</target> <target>applicants</target> will be invited to the second round of interviews to discuss their qualifications in detail.","translation":"只有最成功的申請人（錄取者）才會被邀請參加第二輪面試，以詳細討論他們的資質。","explanation":"名詞「申請人」。常用搭配：successful applicant (成功的申請人)。"},{"sentence":"Each <target>applicant</target> must provide a letter of recommendation from a teacher to support their application for the university scholarship.","translation":"每位申請人必須提供一封來自老師的推薦信，以支持他們申請大學獎學金。","explanation":"名詞「申請人」。"}],"related_forms":["apply"]}

{"headword":"application","explanation":"名詞，意為「申請」或「應用/軟體」。常用搭配：application form (申請表), submit an application (提交申請), mobile application (行動應用程式/App)。注意區分其不同義項。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please make sure to fill out the <target>application</target> <pattern>form</pattern> completely and submit it before the deadline to avoid any delays.","translation":"請確保完整填寫申請表並在截止日期前提交，以避免任何延遲。","explanation":"名詞「申請」。常用搭配：application form (申請表)。"},{"sentence":"The scientist explained how the new theory could have practical <target>applications</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the field of medicine, such as treating rare diseases.","translation":"科學家解釋了這個新理論如何能在醫學領域有實際的應用，例如治療罕見疾病。","explanation":"名詞「應用」。指將理論或知識應用於實際操作。"},{"sentence":"With the rise of smartphones, many people now rely on a variety of <target>applications</target> to organize their daily schedules and track their health.","translation":"隨著智慧型手機的普及，研究人員現在依賴各種應用程式來組織他們的日常行程表並追蹤他們的健康。","explanation":"名詞「應用程式/軟體」。"}],"related_forms":["apply","applicant"]}

{"headword":"appoint","explanation":"動詞，意為「任命、指定」。常用搭配：appoint someone as something (任命某人為...), appoint a date (指定日期)。名詞 appointment 則指「約會、預約」或「任命」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The board of directors decided to <target>appoint</target> him <pattern>as</pattern> the new CEO of the company because of his exceptional leadership skills.","translation":"董事會決定任命他為公司的新執行長，因為他擁有卓越的領導能力。","explanation":"動詞「任命」。常用搭配：appoint someone as... (任命某人為...)。"},{"sentence":"The teacher <target>appointed</target> a date for the group project deadline, ensuring that all students had enough time to complete their work.","translation":"老師指定了一個小組專案的截止日期，確保所有學生都有足夠的時間完成工作。","explanation":"動詞「指定」。指指定時間或地點。"},{"sentence":"I have an <target>appointment</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the school counselor tomorrow morning to discuss my future career options and university choices.","translation":"我有個明天早上的學校諮詢師約會，以討論我未來的職業選擇和大學選擇。","explanation":"名詞「約會、預約」。常用搭配：appointment with someone (與某人預約)。"},{"sentence":"The <target>appointment</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the new principal was announced by the school board, and he is expected to start his duties next month.","translation":"新校長的任命被學校董事會宣布，他預計下個月開始履行職責。","explanation":"名詞「任命」。常用搭配：appointment of... (對...的任命)。"}],"related_forms":["appointment"]}

{"headword":"appreciation","explanation":"名詞，意為「感激、欣賞」或「增值」。常用搭配：show appreciation for (對...表示感激), in appreciation of (為了感激...), deep appreciation (深切的感激)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students organized a surprise party <pattern>in</pattern> <target>appreciation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> their teacher's hard work and dedication throughout the school year.","translation":"學生們組織了一場驚喜派對，以感激他們老師在整個學年中的辛勤工作和奉獻。","explanation":"名詞「感激」。常用搭配：in appreciation of... (為了感激...)。"},{"sentence":"Studying art history helps students develop a deeper <target>appreciation</target> <pattern>for</pattern> classical paintings and the techniques used by ancient artists.","translation":"學習藝術史能幫助學生培養對古典繪畫和古代藝術家所用技術的更深層次的欣賞。","explanation":"名詞「欣賞」。指對某事物的價值或美感地深刻理解和欣賞。"},{"sentence":"The homeowner noticed a significant <target>appreciation</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the value of his property after the new subway station was built nearby.","translation":" ","explanation":"名詞「增值」。指資產價值的增加。"}],"related_forms":["appreciate"]}

{"headword":"appropriate","explanation":"形容詞意為「適當的、合適的」。常用於描述行為、服裝或語言符合特定場合。注意與 suitable 的近義關係。動詞用法較少見，意為「撥款」或「挪用」，在 GSAT 中主要考形容詞用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"Wearing a suit to a formal job interview is considered <target>appropriate</target>, as it shows respect for the company and the interviewer.","translation":"在正式的求職面試中穿西裝被認為是適當的，因為這顯示了對公司和面試官的尊重。","explanation":"形容詞「適當的」。描述服裝符合場合。"},{"sentence":"The teacher reminded the students to use <target>appropriate</target> <pattern>language</pattern> when writing their academic essays to maintain a professional tone.","translation":"老師提醒學生在撰寫學術論文時使用適當的語言，以維持專業的語調。","explanation":"形容詞「適當的」。常用搭配：appropriate language (適當的語言)。"},{"sentence":"It is not <target>appropriate</target> <pattern>to</pattern> interrupt others while they are speaking during a class discussion, as it is considered rude.","translation":"在課堂討論中，當他人說話時打斷他們是不適當的，因為這被認為是不禮貌的。","explanation":"形容詞「適當的」。常用結構：It is appropriate to V (做某事是適當的)。"}],"related_forms":["appropriately","appropriateness"]}

{"headword":"approval","explanation":"名詞，意為「贊成、批准」。常用於正式的許可或對某事的認可。常見搭配包括 get/win someone's approval (得到某人的認可) 或 subject to approval (有待批准)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students' plan to organize a charity bake sale was <pattern>subject</pattern> <target>to</target> <pattern>approval</pattern> from the school principal.","translation":"學生們組織慈善烘焙義賣的計畫有待校長的批准。","explanation":"名詞「批准」。常用片語 be subject to approval (有待批准)。"},{"sentence":"Young children often seek their parents' <target>approval</target> by working hard in school and following all the house rules.","translation":"年幼的孩子經常透過在學校努力學習並遵守所有家規來尋求父母的認可。","explanation":"名詞「認可」。指對某人的行為表示贊同。"},{"sentence":"After reviewing the final draft of the project, the manager gave her <pattern>final</pattern> <target>approval</target>, allowing the team to start production.","translation":"在審閱專案的最終草稿後，經理給予了最終批准，讓團隊可以開始生產。","explanation":"名詞「批准」。常用形容詞：final approval (最終批准)。"}],"related_forms":["approve"]}

{"headword":"aquarium","explanation":"名詞「水族館」或「魚缸」。指展示水生生物的公共場所或家用的小容器。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the school field trip, the students visited a large city <target>aquarium</target> to learn about different species of marine life.","translation":"在學校的校外教學期間，學生們參觀了一座大型城市水族館，以了解不同種類的海洋生物。","explanation":"名詞「水族館」。指公共展示場所。"},{"sentence":"My brother spent the entire weekend cleaning the <target>aquarium</target> to make sure his colorful tropical fish remained healthy.","translation":"我哥哥花整個週末清理魚缸，以確保他的彩色熱帶魚保持健康。","explanation":"名詞「魚缸」。指家用的小容器。"},{"sentence":"The <target>aquarium</target> featured a magnificent tunnel that allowed visitors to walk under sharks and stingrays swimming overhead.","translation":"水族館有一個壯觀的隧道，讓遊客可以走在頭頂游過的鯊魚和魟魚下方。","explanation":"名詞「水族館」。"}],"related_forms":["aquariums"]}

{"headword":"arch","explanation":"名詞指「拱門」，動詞則指「使成拱形」或「拱起」。在建築描述或身體動作（如貓拱背）中常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tourists stopped to take photos under the ancient stone <target>arch</target> that served as the main entrance to the old city.","translation":"遊客們停下來在古老的石拱門下拍照，該拱門是古城的正門。","explanation":"名詞「拱門」。"},{"sentence":"The cat <target>arched</target> its back and hissed when it saw the strange dog entering its territory for the first time.","translation":"當貓第一次看到陌生狗進入它的領地時，它拱起了背並發出嘶嘶聲。","explanation":"動詞「拱起」。描述身體部位彎曲成拱形。"},{"sentence":"Architects often use the <target>arch</target> in their designs because it can support more weight than a simple flat beam.","translation":"建築師經常在設計中使用拱形，因為它比簡單的平樑能承受更多重量。","explanation":"名詞「拱形/拱門」。"}],"related_forms":["arches","arched"]}

{"headword":"arise","explanation":"動詞，意為「出現」或「發生」。常用於描述問題、困難或機會的突然出現。注意其不規則變化：arise - arose - arisen。注意與 rise (上升) 的區別：arise 通常接抽象名詞（如 problem, difficulty, issue）。","entries":[{"sentence":"If any unexpected problems <target>arise</target> during the experiment, the students should inform their teacher immediately for guidance.","translation":"如果在實驗過程中出現任何意外問題，學生應立即通知老師以尋求指導。","explanation":"動詞「出現」。常用搭配：problems arise (問題出現)。"},{"sentence":"A serious conflict <target>arose</target> <pattern>between</pattern> the two teammates because they could not agree on how to divide the workload.","translation":"兩名隊友之間產生了嚴重的衝突，因為他們無法就如何分配工作量達成一致。","explanation":"動詞「發生」。此處為過去式 arose。"},{"sentence":"New opportunities for career growth often <target>arise</target> when people are willing to step out of their comfort zones and try new things.","translation":"當人們願意走出舒適圈嘗試新事物時，職業成長的新機會往往會隨之而來。","explanation":"動詞「出現」。常用搭配：opportunities arise (機會出現)。"}],"related_forms":["arose","arisen"]}

{"headword":"arms","explanation":"名詞，有兩種完全不同的意思。第一是指身體的「手臂」；第二是指「武器」（此時為複數形式，不可數或集體名詞）。在 GSAT 中，常考武器之意，如 arms race (軍備競賽) 或 bear arms (攜帶武器)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two old friends hugged each other tightly, wrapping their <target>arms</target> around one another after years of separation.","translation":"這兩位老朋友在分開多年後緊緊相擁，雙臂環繞著彼此。","explanation":"名詞「手臂」。指身體部位。"},{"sentence":"The government decided to reduce its spending on <target>arms</target> and instead invest more money in education and healthcare.","translation":"政府決定減少在武器上的支出，轉而將更多資金投入到教育和醫療保健中。","explanation":"名詞「武器」。指軍事裝備。"},{"sentence":"The historical museum displayed a variety of ancient <target>arms</target> and armor used by soldiers during the Middle Ages.","translation":"歷史博物館展出了中世紀士兵使用的各種古代武器和盔甲。","explanation":"名詞「武器」。常用搭配：arms and armor (武器與盔甲)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"artificial","explanation":"形容詞「人造的、人工的」。指非天然產生的。常用於科技、材料或情感。注意與 fake 的區別：artificial 強調人造過程（如 artificial intelligence），而 fake 強調欺騙目的（如 fake news）。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many food companies use <target>artificial</target> <pattern>sweeteners</pattern> instead of sugar to reduce the calorie count in their soft drinks.","translation":"許多食品公司在軟飲料中使用人工甜味劑代替糖，以降低熱量。","explanation":"形容詞「人工的」。常用搭配：artificial sweeteners (人工甜味劑)。"},{"sentence":"The development of <target>artificial</target> <pattern>intelligence</pattern> has changed the way people work and communicate in the modern world.","translation":"人工智慧的發展改變了現代人工作和溝通的方式。","explanation":"形容詞「人工的」。常用搭配：artificial intelligence (人工智慧, AI)。"},{"sentence":"To keep the indoor plants alive in the winter, the gardener used <target>artificial</target> <pattern>lighting</pattern> to simulate natural sunlight.","translation":"為了讓室內植物在冬天存活，園丁使用人工照明來模擬自然陽光。","explanation":"形容詞「人造的」。常用搭配：artificial lighting (人工照明)。"}],"related_forms":["artificially","artificiality"]}

{"headword":"artistic","explanation":"形容詞「藝術的、有藝術天賦的」。可用於描述作品（如 artistic style）或人的能力（如 artistic talent）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student's painting showed great <target>artistic</target> <pattern>talent</pattern>, impressing all the judges at the school's annual art competition.","translation":"這名學生的繪畫展現了極高的藝術天賦，讓學校年度藝術比賽的所有評審都印象深刻。","explanation":"形容詞「有藝術天賦的」。常用搭配：artistic talent (藝術天賦)。"},{"sentence":"She decided to study interior design because she wanted to apply her <target>artistic</target> <pattern>vision</pattern> to create beautiful living spaces.","translation":"她決定學習室內設計，因為她想運用她的藝術眼光來創造美麗的居住空間。","explanation":"形容詞「藝術的」。常用搭配：artistic vision (藝術眼光/願景)。"},{"sentence":"The museum exhibition highlighted the <target>artistic</target> <pattern>style</pattern> of the Renaissance period, focusing on realism and perspective.","translation":"博物館的展覽強調了文藝復興時期的藝術風格，重點在於寫實主義和透視法。","explanation":"形容詞「藝術的」。常用搭配：artistic style (藝術風格)。"}],"related_forms":["artistically","artist"]}

{"headword":"ashamed","explanation":"形容詞「感到羞愧的」。通常與介係詞 of 搭配，表示對某事或某人感到羞愧。注意與 shy (害羞) 的區別：ashamed 是因為做錯事而感到愧疚或丟臉。","entries":[{"sentence":"The boy felt <target>ashamed</target> <pattern>of</pattern> his behavior after he realized that he had been mean to his younger sister.","translation":"男孩在意識到自己對妹妹很刻薄後，感到很羞愧。","explanation":"形容詞「羞愧的」。常用搭配：feel ashamed of sth (對某事感到羞愧)。"},{"sentence":"She was <target>ashamed</target> <pattern>to</pattern> admit that she had failed the math test despite spending weeks studying for it.","translation":"儘管花了好幾週準備，她仍然很羞愧地承認數學考試沒及格。","explanation":"形容詞「羞愧的」。常用結構：be ashamed to V (羞於做某事)。"},{"sentence":"He told his friend not to be <target>ashamed</target> <pattern>of</pattern> making mistakes, as that is the best way to learn a new language.","translation":"他告訴朋友不要為犯錯而感到羞愧，因為那是學習新語言的最佳方式。","explanation":"形容詞「羞愧的」。常用搭配：ashamed of making mistakes (為犯錯而羞愧)。"}],"related_forms":["ashamedly"]}

{"headword":"aspect","explanation":"名詞「方面、面貌」。指事物的一個特定部分或特徵。常用搭配包括 every aspect of (每一個方面) 或 a positive aspect (正面的一面)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher encouraged the students to consider every <target>aspect</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the problem before drawing a final conclusion.","translation":"老師鼓勵學生在得出最終結論前，考慮問題的每一個方面。","explanation":"名詞「方面」。常用搭配：every aspect of... (每一個方面)。"},{"sentence":"One positive <target>aspect</target> <pattern>of</pattern> living in a big city is the convenience of having many public transportation options.","translation":"住在大城市的一個正面方面是公共交通選擇多，非常便利。","explanation":"名詞「方面」。常用搭配：positive aspect (正面的一面)。"},{"sentence":"The documentary explored the social <target>aspects</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the industrial revolution and how it changed family structures.","translation":"這部紀錄片探討了工業革命的社會方面以及它如何改變家庭結構。","explanation":"名詞「方面」。此處使用複數 aspects。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"aspirin","explanation":"名詞「阿斯匹靈」。一種常用於緩解疼痛和降低發燒的藥物。在 GSAT 英文中，通常出現在健康或醫療相關的閱讀文章中。","entries":[{"sentence":"When the student developed a mild headache after studying for hours, he took an <target>aspirin</target> to relieve the pain.","translation":"學生在學習數小時後感到輕微頭痛，於是服用了一顆阿斯匹靈來緩解疼痛。","explanation":"名詞「阿斯匹靈」。常用動詞搭配：take an aspirin。"},{"sentence":"The doctor warned the patient not to take too many <target>aspirins</target> on an empty stomach to avoid irritating the stomach lining.","translation":"醫生警告患者不要在空腹時服用太多阿斯匹靈，以免刺激胃黏膜。","explanation":"名詞「阿斯匹靈」。指代藥物種類或具體藥錠。"},{"sentence":"Although <target>aspirin</target> is widely available over the counter, people with certain health conditions should consult a physician before using it.","translation":"雖然阿斯匹靈在藥局隨處可買，但有特定健康狀況的人在服用前應諮詢醫生。","explanation":"名詞「阿斯匹靈」。over the counter 指的是非處方藥。"}],"related_forms":["aspirins"]}

{"headword":"assemble","explanation":"動詞「組裝」或「聚集」。組裝指將零件拼湊在一起；聚集指人或物聚集在同一地點。注意區分這兩種截然不同的用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students were asked to <target>assemble</target> the science kit following the detailed instructions provided by the teacher in the lab.","translation":"學生被要求按照老師在實驗室提供的詳細說明來組裝科學套件。","explanation":"動詞「組裝」。指將零件拼湊在一起。"},{"sentence":"All the students were told to <target>assemble</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the main courtyard at 8 a.m. for the morning announcements.","translation":"所有學生被告知早上八點在主庭院聚集，以聽取早晨的公告。","explanation":"動詞「聚集」。常用搭配：assemble in a place。"},{"sentence":"The company's engineers worked together to <target>assemble</target> the new prototype of the electric car within a few weeks.","translation":"公司的工程師們共同努力，在幾週內組裝出了電動車的新原型。","explanation":"動詞「組裝」。指將零件拼湊在一起。"}],"related_forms":["assembled","assembling"]}

{"headword":"assembly","explanation":"名詞「集會」或「組裝」。指一群人聚集在一起的活動，或將零件組裝成產品的過程。常見搭配：school assembly (全校集會)。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the weekly school <target>assembly</target>, the principal announced the winners of the regional science competition and praised their hard work.","translation":"在每週的學校集會期間，校長宣布了區域科學競賽的獲勝者並稱讚他們的努力。","explanation":"名詞「集會」。常用搭配：school assembly (學校集會)。"},{"sentence":"The <target>assembly</target> <pattern>line</pattern> in the electronics factory was upgraded to include robotic arms to increase production efficiency.","translation":"電子工廠的組裝線被升級，加入了機械手臂以提高生產效率。","explanation":"名詞「組裝」。常用搭配：assembly line (組裝線)。"},{"sentence":"The students spent the entire afternoon in the <target>assembly</target> <pattern>hall</pattern>, listening to a guest speaker talk about future career options.","translation":"學生們整個下午都在集會大廳裡，聽著一位客座演講者談論未來的職業選擇。","explanation":"名詞「集會」。常用搭配：assembly hall (集會大廳)。"}],"related_forms":["assemble"]}

{"headword":"assign","explanation":"動詞「指派」或「分配」。常用於指派任務、工作或分配資源。常用片語 assign sth to sb (將某事指派給某人)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher decided to <target>assign</target> a group project <pattern>to</pattern> the students to encourage them to collaborate and share ideas.","translation":"老師決定指派一個小組計畫給學生，以鼓勵他們合作並分享想法。","explanation":"動詞「指派」。常用片語 assign sth to sb。"},{"sentence":"The company <target>assigned</target> a special assistant <pattern>to</pattern> the new CEO to help him manage his busy schedule and meetings.","translation":"公司指派了一名特別助理給新任執行長，以幫助他管理繁忙的日程和會議。","explanation":"動詞「指派」。常用片語 assign sth to sb。"},{"sentence":"The school administration <target>assigned</target> specific lockers <pattern>to</pattern> each freshman, ensuring that everyone had a place to store their books.","translation":"學校行政部門為每位新生分配了特定的置物櫃，確保每個人都有地方存放書籍。","explanation":"動詞「分配」。常用片語 assign sth to sb。"}],"related_forms":["assignment","assigned","assigning"]}

{"headword":"assignment","explanation":"名詞「作業」或「指派」。指被指派的工作或任務。在校園生活中，這通常指老師給的功課。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university student spent the entire weekend completing his history <target>assignment</target>, as the deadline was coming up quickly.","translation":"這名大學生整個週末都在完成他的歷史作業，因為截止日期很快就到了。","explanation":"名詞「作業」。指被指派的學習任務。"},{"sentence":"The manager <pattern>gave</pattern> a challenging <target>assignment</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the new employee, testing his ability to handle complex problems.","translation":"經理給了新員工一個具挑戰性的任務，測試他處理複雜問題的能力。","explanation":"名詞「指派」。指被指派的工作任務。常用搭配：give an assignment to sb。"},{"sentence":"She was very proud of her <target>assignment</target> to the foreign office in Tokyo, as it was her first time working abroad.","translation":"她對被指派到東京的外交辦公室感到非常自豪，因為這是她第一次在國外工作。","explanation":"名詞「指派」。指被指派到特定地點的工作任務。"}],"related_forms":["assign"]}

{"headword":"assistance","explanation":"名詞「幫助」或「援助」。比 help 更正式，常用於指在專業、金錢或技術上的協助。常用搭配：provide assistance, offer assistance。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new student from Japan needed some <target>assistance</target> <pattern>with</pattern> his English, so the teacher assigned a classmate to help him.","translation":"來自日本的新學生在英文方面需要一些幫助，由於此，老師指派了一位同學幫助他。","explanation":"名詞「幫助」。常用搭配：assistance with sth。"},{"sentence":"The government provided financial <target>assistance</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the farmers after the earthquake, helping them rebuild their homes and farms.","translation":"政府在地震後向農民提供了財政援助，幫助他們重建家園和農場。","explanation":"名詞「援助」。常用搭配：provide assistance to sb。"},{"sentence":"If you encounter any technical issues while using the school's online portal, please contact the IT department for <target>assistance</target>.","translation":"如果您在使用學校的線上入口網站時遇到任何技術問題，請聯繫 IT 部門尋求幫助。","explanation":"名詞「幫助」。指技術上的協助。"}],"related_forms":["assist","assistant"]}

{"headword":"associate","explanation":"作為形容詞指「副的、助理的」；作為名詞指「夥伴、同事」；作為動詞指「將...與...聯繫在一起」。動詞用法最常見，常用片語 associate A with B (將 A 與 B 聯繫起來)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university's <target>associate</target> professor has published several important papers on environmental science in international journals.","translation":"這所大學的副教授在國際期刊上發表了幾篇關於環境科學的重要論文。","explanation":"形容詞「副的」。指職位等級較低於 full professor。"},{"sentence":"Many people <target>associate</target> the smell of fresh cinnamon rolls <pattern>with</pattern> their childhood memories of visiting their grandmother's house.","translation":"許多人將新鮮肉桂捲的香味與他們童年時光訪問祖母家的記憶聯繫在一起。","explanation":"動詞「聯繫」。常用片語 associate A with B。"},{"sentence":"As a business <target>associate</target>, he worked closely with the lawyer to ensure that all the legal documents were correct.","translation":"作為一名商業夥伴，他與律師密切合作，以確保所有法律文件均正確無誤。","explanation":"名詞「夥伴」。指在工作中合作的人。"},{"sentence":"The doctor warned that smoking is often <target>associated</target> <pattern>with</pattern> an increased risk of lung cancer and heart disease.","translation":"醫生警告說，吸煙通常與肺癌和心臟病的風險增加有關。","explanation":"動詞「聯繫」。被動語態 associate be associated with sth。"}],"related_forms":["association","associates","associating"]}

{"headword":"association","explanation":"名詞「協會」或「聯繫」。指一群有共同目的的人組成的組織，或兩件事物之間的關係。","entries":[{"sentence":"She decided to join the student <target>association</target> to meet new friends and participate in various campus activities and events.","translation":"她決定加入學生協會，以結識新朋友並參加各種校園活動和事件。","explanation":"名詞「協會」。指一個組織。"},{"sentence":"Scientists have found a strong <target>association</target> <pattern>between</pattern> regular exercise and improved mental health among teenagers.","translation":"科學家發現了定期運動與青少年心理健康改善之間存在強烈的聯繫。","explanation":"名詞「聯繫」。常用搭配：association between A and B。"},{"sentence":"The local sports <target>association</target> organizes an annual marathon to raise funds for the children's hospital in the city.","translation":"當地體育協會組織每年一次的馬拉松，以籌集資金給城市裡的兒童醫院。","explanation":"名詞「協會」。指一個組織。"}],"related_forms":["associate"]}

{"headword":"assurance","explanation":"名詞「保證」或「信心」。指對某事會發生或真實的正式承諾，或對自己能力的信心。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher gave the students an <target>assurance</target> that the final exam would not include any material from the outside of the textbook.","translation":"老師向學生保證，期末考將不會包含任何課本以外的材料。","explanation":"名詞「保證」。指一個正式的承諾。"},{"sentence":"Despite her nervousness, she spoke with great <target>assurance</target> during her presentation, impressing the judges with her confidence.","translation":"儘管她很緊張，她在簡報期間說話非常有信心，讓評審們對她的自信心印象深刻。","explanation":"名詞「信心」。指對自己能力的自信。"},{"sentence":"The company provided a written <target>assurance</target> that all the products would be delivered on time and meet the quality standards.","translation":"公司提供了一份書面保證，所有產品將按時交付並符合品質標準。","explanation":"名詞「保證」。指正式的承諾。"}],"related_forms":["assure"]}

{"headword":"assure","explanation":"動詞「向...保證」。用於指向某人承諾某事以消除其疑慮。常用句型：assure sb that... 或 assure sb of sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"The principal <target>assured</target> the worried parents <pattern>that</pattern> the school had implemented new security measures to keep all students safe.","translation":"校長向擔心的家長保證，學校已實施新的安全措施以確保所有學生安全。","explanation":"動詞「保證」。常用句型 assure sb that...。"},{"sentence":"The travel agent <target>assured</target> me <pattern>of</pattern> the quality of the hotel in Paris, promising that it was the most comfortable one in the city.","translation":"旅行社代理人向我保證了巴黎那家飯店的品質，承諾它是城市中最舒適的一家。","explanation":"動詞「保證」。常用句型 assure sb of sth。"},{"sentence":"I <target>assure</target> you <pattern>that</pattern> if you work hard and stay focused, you will be able to achieve your dream university goals.","translation":"我向你保證，如果你努力工作並保持專注，你將能夠達成你的夢想大學目標。","explanation":"動詞「保證」。常用句型 assure sb that...。"}],"related_forms":["assurance","assured"]}

{"headword":"athletic","explanation":"形容詞「運動的」或「體能強健的」。常用於描述人的體格或與體育相關的活動。常用搭配：athletic ability (運動能力), athletic event (體育項目)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school's <target>athletic</target> <pattern>department</pattern> is organizing a sports day next month, encouraging all students to participate in various events.","translation":"學校的體育部門下個月將組織一次運動會，鼓勵所有學生參加各種項目。","explanation":"形容詞「運動的」。常用搭配：athletic department (體育部門)。"},{"sentence":"Because of his <target>athletic</target> <pattern>build</pattern>, he was naturally gifted at basketball and quickly became the star player of the school team.","translation":"因為他強健的體格，他在籃球方面天賦異稟，很快就成了學校球隊的明星球員。","explanation":"形容詞「體能強健的」。常用搭配：athletic build (強健的體格)。"},{"sentence":"The university offers various scholarships for students with exceptional <target>athletic</target> <pattern>abilities</pattern>, supporting their education and sports careers.","translation":"這所大學為具有卓越運動能力的學生提供各種獎學金，支持他們的教育和體育職業。","explanation":"形容詞「運動的」。常用搭配：athletic ability (運動能力)。"}],"related_forms":["athlete"]}

{"headword":"atmosphere","explanation":"名詞「氣氛」或「大氣層」。前者指環境給人的感覺，後者指地球周圍的空氣層。注意搭配形容詞如 tense (緊張的) 或 relaxed (放鬆的) 來描述氣氛。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher created a relaxed <target>atmosphere</target> in the classroom, which encouraged students to ask questions and express their opinions freely.","translation":"老師在教室裡營造了放鬆的氣氛，鼓勵學生自由地提問並表達意見。","explanation":"名詞「氣氛」。指環境給人的感覺。"},{"sentence":"During the final examination period, the <target>atmosphere</target> in the library became incredibly tense, as everyone was focused on their studies.","translation":"在期末考期間，圖書館的氣氛變得異常緊張，因為每個人都專注於學習。","explanation":"名詞「氣氛」。常用搭配：tense atmosphere (緊張的氣氛)。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are studying how pollution affects the Earth's <target>atmosphere</target>, leading to global warming and changes in weather patterns.","translation":"科學家正在研究污染如何影響地球的大氣層，導致全球暖化和天氣模式的改變。","explanation":"名詞「大氣層」。指地球周圍的空氣層。"}],"related_forms":["atmospheric"]}

{"headword":"atom","explanation":"名詞「原子」。科學術語，指物質的基本組成單位。通常出現在科普文章中。","entries":[{"sentence":"In chemistry class, the teacher explained that an <target>atom</target> consists of a nucleus and electrons that orbit around it.","translation":"在化學課上，老師解釋說一個原子由原子核和繞其運行的電子組成。","explanation":"名詞「原子」。"},{"sentence":"Because <target>atoms</target> are far too small to be seen with a regular microscope, scientists use specialized equipment to observe them.","translation":"因為原子太小，無法用普通的顯微鏡看到，所以科學家使用專門的設備來觀察它們。","explanation":"名詞「原子」（複數）。"}],"related_forms":["atomic"]}

{"headword":"atomic","explanation":"形容詞「原子的」或「原子能的」。常用於描述與原子結構或原子能相關的事物，如 atomic energy (原子能) 或 atomic bomb (原子彈)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The discovery of <target>atomic</target> <pattern>energy</pattern> has provided a powerful source of electricity, although it also brings significant environmental concerns.","translation":"原子能的發現提供了一個強大的電力來源，儘管它也帶來了顯著的環境憂慮。","explanation":"形容詞「原子能的」。常用搭配：atomic energy (原子能)。"},{"sentence":"Historians often discuss the devastating impact of the <target>atomic</target> <pattern>bomb</pattern> used during World War II on the civilian population.","translation":"歷史學家經常討論第二次世界大戰期間使用的原子彈對平民人口造成的毀滅性影響。","explanation":"形容詞「原子能的」。常用搭配：atomic bomb (原子彈)。"}],"related_forms":["atom"]}

{"headword":"attach","explanation":"動詞「附上」或「連接」。常考片語 attach to (連接到.../對...感興趣)。注意與 attachment (附件/依戀) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please remember to <target>attach</target> your resume <pattern>to</pattern> the email before sending it to the company for the internship application.","translation":"在將電子郵件發送給公司申請實習之前，請記得將你的簡歷附在郵件中。","explanation":"動詞「附上」。常用搭配：attach A to B。"},{"sentence":"The student <target>attached</target> a detailed map <pattern>to</pattern> his research paper to help the reader understand the geographical location better.","translation":"這名學生在研究論文中附上了一張詳細的地圖，以幫助讀者更好地理解地理位置。","explanation":"動詞「附上」。"},{"sentence":"He didn't seem to <target>attach</target> <pattern>much importance</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> the teacher's warnings, which eventually led to his failure in the mid-term exam.","translation":"他似乎並不十分重視老師的警告，這最終導致他在期中考中失敗。","explanation":"動詞片語 attach importance to sth 表示「重視某事」。"}],"related_forms":["attachment","attached","detachable"]}

{"headword":"attachment","explanation":"名詞「附件」或「依戀」。在電子郵件中指附帶的文件；在心理學中指對某人的情感依戀。","entries":[{"sentence":"I cannot open the <target>attachment</target> in your email because the file format is not supported by my computer's software.","translation":"我無法打開你電子郵件中的附件，因為我的電腦軟體不支援該檔案格式。","explanation":"名詞「附件」。指電子郵件中附帶的文件。"},{"sentence":"Psychologists believe that a strong emotional <target>attachment</target> <pattern>between</pattern> a child and their parent is essential for healthy development.","translation":"心理學家認為，孩子與父母之間強烈的情感依戀對健康成長至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「依戀」。指對某人的強烈情感聯繫。"}],"related_forms":["attach"]}

{"headword":"attraction","explanation":"名詞「吸引力」或「景點」。常用片語 tourist attraction (觀光景點)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city is famous for its many <pattern>tourist</pattern> <target>attractions</target>, such as the ancient palace and the modern art gallery.","translation":"這座城市以其許多觀光景點而聞名，例如古老的宮殿和現代美術館。","explanation":"名詞「景點」。常用搭配：tourist attraction (觀光景點)。"},{"sentence":"The most powerful <target>attraction</target> of the new school is its state-of-the-art science laboratory and extensive library resources.","translation":"這所新學校最大的吸引力在於其最先進的科學實驗室和豐富的圖書館資源。","explanation":"名詞「吸引力」。指某物吸引人的特質。"}],"related_forms":["attract","attractive"]}

{"headword":"audio","explanation":"形容詞「聲音的」或「音頻的」。常用於描述與聲音記錄或播放相關的設備或文件。","entries":[{"sentence":"The English teacher provided an <target>audio</target> <pattern>recording</pattern> of the listening test so students could practice at home.","translation":"英文老師提供了一份聽力測驗的錄音，以便學生可以在家練習。","explanation":"形容詞「聲音的」。常用搭配：audio recording (聲音錄音)。"},{"sentence":"When purchasing a new computer, you should check if the <target>audio</pattern> <pattern>quality</pattern> is clear enough for online meetings.","translation":"購買新電腦時，應檢查音質是否足夠清晰，以便進行線上會議。","explanation":"形容詞「音頻的」。常用搭配：audio quality (音質)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"authentic","explanation":"形容詞「真實的、正宗的」。常用於描述食物、文物或情感。注意與 genuine (真誠的/真實的) 的區別：authentic 側重於符合原版或傳統的特質，而 genuine 側重於非偽造且真實的情感或材質。","entries":[{"sentence":"The restaurant is highly recommended because it serves <target>authentic</target> <pattern>Italian cuisine</pattern>, using recipes passed down through generations.","translation":"這家餐廳非常推薦，因為它提供正宗的義大利料理，使用代代相傳的食譜。","explanation":"形容詞「正宗的」。常用搭配：authentic cuisine (正宗料理)。"},{"sentence":"Experts spent months examining the painting to determine if it was an <target>authentic</target> work of art or a clever fake.","translation":"專家們花了好幾個月檢查這幅畫，以確定它是真實的藝術品還是巧妙的贗品。","explanation":"形容詞「真實的」。指非偽造的。"}],"related_forms":["authentically","authenticity"]}

{"headword":"authority","explanation":"名詞「權威」或「官方/當局」。指有權力的人、機構或在某領域具有專業知識的人。常用片語 be an authority on (是...方面的權威)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The local <target>authorities</target> issued a warning to the residents after the heavy rain caused severe flooding in the downtown area.","translation":"大雨導致市中心嚴重淹水後，當地當局發出了警告。","explanation":"名詞「當局/官方」。常用複數形式 authorities。"},{"sentence":"Professor Lee is recognized as a leading <target>authority</target> <pattern>on</pattern> ancient Greek history, having written several influential books on the subject.","translation":"李教授被認為是古希臘歷史的領先權威，他在該主題上寫過幾本有影響力的書。","explanation":"名詞「權威」。片語 be an authority on... 表示「是...方面的權威」。"},{"sentence":"The students were told that they must follow the school <target>authority</target>'s rules to maintain order and a safe learning environment.","translation":"學生們被告知必須遵守學校當局的規定，以維持秩序和安全的學習環境。","explanation":"名詞「權威/權力」。指管理者的權限。"}],"related_forms":["authoritative","authoritarian"]}

{"headword":"autobiography","explanation":"名詞「自傳」。指作者自己寫的關於自己生活的書。注意與 biography (傳記) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"After retiring from politics, the former president wrote an <target>autobiography</target> to share his life experiences and lessons with the world.","translation":"從政後退休，前總統寫了一本自傳，與世界分享他的生活經驗和教訓。","explanation":"名詞「自傳」。"},{"sentence":"Reading the <target>autobiography</target> of a famous scientist can inspire students to pursue their dreams and overcome challenges in their studies.","translation":"閱讀知名科學家的自傳能激勵學生追求夢想並克服學習中的挑戰。","explanation":"名詞「自傳」。"}],"related_forms":["autobiographical"]}

{"headword":"autograph","explanation":"名詞「簽名」；動詞「簽名」。名詞時指名人簽的名簽名。注意與 signature (簽名) 的區別：autograph 專指名人簽名作為紀念品，而 signature 則是指在合約或文件上簽名以示確認。","entries":[{"sentence":"After the concert, many fans waited in line for hours just to get the singer's <target>autograph</target> on their favorite album.","translation":"音樂會結束後，許多粉絲排隊等了數小時，只為了在他們最喜歡的專輯上獲得歌手的簽名。","explanation":"名詞「簽名」。指名人的紀念簽名。"},{"sentence":"The young athlete was thrilled when the professional player <target>autographed</target> his basketball, making it a priceless treasure for him.","translation":"這名年輕運動員非常激動，因為那位職業球員在他的籃球上簽了名，對他來說這變成了無價之寶。","explanation":"動詞「簽名」。指名人為他人簽名。"}],"related_forms":["autographed"]}

{"headword":"await","explanation":"及物動詞「等待」。比 wait 更正式，且必須接賓語（不可用 await for）。常考搭配：await a reply (等待回覆), await approval (等待批准)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After submitting their university applications, the students are now <target>awaiting</target> <pattern>a reply</pattern> from their dream schools with nervousness.","translation":"在提交大學申請後，學生們現在正緊張地等待夢想學校的回覆。","explanation":"及物動詞「等待」。後面直接接賓語 a reply。"},{"sentence":"The new laws regarding environmental protection are currently <target>awaiting</target> <pattern>approval</pattern> from the city council before they can be implemented.","translation":"關於環境保護的新法律目前正等待市議會的批准才能實施。","explanation":"及物動詞「等待」。常用搭配 await approval。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"bald","explanation":"形容詞「禿頭的；明顯的」。常用於描述頭髮脫落或缺乏覆蓋物，也可比喻為缺乏細節或裝飾的。常用搭配：go bald (變禿)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The professor, who had <target>gone</target> <target>bald</target> in his thirties, often joked about his lack of hair during his lectures.","translation":"這位教授在三十多歲時變禿了，他經常在講座中開自己沒頭髮的玩笑。","explanation":"形容詞「禿頭的」。片語 go bald 表示「變禿」。"},{"sentence":"The witness provided a <target>bald</target> <pattern>statement</pattern> of the facts without any supporting evidence or detailed explanation to the police.","translation":"證人向警方提供了一份僅有事實的陳述，沒有任何支持證據或詳細解釋。","explanation":"形容詞「明顯的、簡單的」。指缺乏詳細說明或裝飾的陳述。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"ballet","explanation":"名詞「芭蕾舞」。注意發音中末尾的 t 不發音。常用搭配：ballet dancer (芭蕾舞者), ballet performance (芭蕾舞表演)。","entries":[{"sentence":"She has practiced <target>ballet</target> since she was five years old, dreaming of becoming a professional <target>ballet</target> <pattern>dancer</pattern> one day.","translation":"她從五歲起就練習芭蕾舞，夢想著有一天能成為一名專業的芭蕾舞者。","explanation":"名詞「芭蕾舞」。常用搭配 ballet dancer。"},{"sentence":"The school's arts festival featured a stunning <target>ballet</target> <pattern>performance</pattern> that combined classical music with modern dance styles.","translation":"學校的藝術節以一場結合古典音樂與現代舞風格的精彩芭蕾舞表演為特色。","explanation":"名詞「芭蕾舞」。常用搭配 ballet performance。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"bandage","explanation":"名詞「繃帶」；動詞「用繃帶包紮」。常用搭配：wrap a bandage around (在...周圍纏繞繃帶)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The nurse carefully wrapped a <target>bandage</target> <pattern>around</pattern> the athlete's sprained ankle to provide support and prevent further injury.","translation":"護理師小心地在運動員扭傷的腳踝周圍纏繞繃帶，以提供支撐並防止進一步受傷。","explanation":"名詞「繃帶」。常用搭配 wrap a bandage around。"},{"sentence":"After cleaning the wound, the doctor decided to <target>bandage</target> the cut on the student's arm to keep it clean and sterile.","translation":"在清理傷口後，醫生決定將學生手臂上的割傷處包紮起來，以保持清潔與無菌。","explanation":"動詞「用繃帶包紮」。"}],"related_forms":["bandages","bandaging"]}

{"headword":"bankrupt","explanation":"形容詞「破產的」；動詞「使破產」；名詞「破產者」。常用搭配：go bankrupt (破產)。注意 bankrupt 除了指財務破產，也可比喻指精神或道德上的枯竭 (morally bankrupt)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many small businesses <target>went</target> <target>bankrupt</target> during the economic crisis because they could not pay their debts to the bank.","translation":"在經濟危機期間，許多小企業因為無法償還銀行債務而破產。","explanation":"形容詞「破產的」。常用片語 go bankrupt 表示「破產」。"},{"sentence":"The company's unethical behavior and greed eventually <target>bankrupted</target> the firm, leading to the loss of thousands of jobs.","translation":"該公司不道德的行為和貪婪最終使該公司破產，導致數千個工作崗位丟失。","explanation":"動詞「使破產」。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer specialized in assisting <target>bankrupts</target> in reorganizing their finances to start a new life after their financial failure.","translation":"這名律師專門協助破產者重新整理財務，以便在財務失敗後開始新生活。","explanation":"名詞「破產者」。"}],"related_forms":["bankruptcy"]}

{"headword":"bargain","explanation":"名詞「便宜貨、協議」；動詞「討價還價、達成協議」。常考片語：strike a bargain (達成協議), a real bargain (真正的便宜貨)。","entries":[{"sentence":"I found a beautiful vintage jacket at the thrift store, and it was a <target>real</target> <target>bargain</target> because it cost only ten dollars.","translation":"我在二手店發現了一件漂亮的復古夾克，而且它非常便宜，因為只要十美元。","explanation":"名詞「便宜貨」。a real bargain 指「真正的便宜貨」。"},{"sentence":"The two countries spent months <target>bargaining</target> <pattern>over</pattern> the terms of the trade agreement to ensure a fair deal for both sides.","translation":"這兩個國家花了好幾個月在貿易協定的條款上討價還價，以確保雙方都能獲得公平的交易。","explanation":"動詞「討價還價」。常用搭配 bargaining over sth。"},{"sentence":"After hours of negotiation, the buyer and seller finally <target>struck</target> a <target>bargain</target> on the price of the old house.","translation":"經過數小時的談判，買家和賣家終於在舊房子的價格上達成協議。","explanation":"名詞「協議」。片語 strike a bargain 表示「達成協議」。"}],"related_forms":["bargains"]}
