{"headword":"barrier","explanation":"名詞「障礙、屏障」。常用於指物理上的阻隔或抽象的心理、語言、文化上的障礙。常用搭配：language barrier (語言障礙), break down barriers (打破障礙)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police set up a concrete <target>barrier</target> to block the traffic and prevent people from entering the restricted area during the parade.","translation":"警方設置了混凝土屏障以阻擋交通，防止人們在遊行期間進入禁區。","explanation":"名詞「屏障」。指物理上的阻隔物。"},{"sentence":"For many international students, the <target>language</target> <target>barrier</target> is the biggest challenge they face when trying to integrate into a new society.","translation":"對於許多國際學生來說，語言障礙是他們在嘗試融入新社會時面臨的最大挑戰。","explanation":"名詞「障礙」。常用搭配 language barrier (語言障礙)。"},{"sentence":"The government hopes that the new cultural exchange program will help <target>break</target> <target>down</target> <target>barriers</target> between different ethnic groups.","translation":"政府希望新的文化交流計畫能幫助打破不同族群之間的障礙。","explanation":"名詞「障礙」。片語 break down barriers 表示「打破障礙」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"basin","explanation":"名詞「盆地、洗臉盆」。常用於地理描述或家居用品。常用搭配：river basin (河流流域/盆地)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The Amazon <target>basin</target> is one of the largest river basins in the world, supporting a vast array of diverse plant and animal species.","translation":"亞馬遜盆地是世界上最大的河流流域之一，支持著極其多樣的植物和動物物種。","explanation":"名詞「盆地、流域」。常用搭配 river basin。"},{"sentence":"She filled the <target>basin</target> with warm soapy water to wash her hands before starting to prepare the meal for her family.","translation":"她用溫肥皂水裝滿洗臉盆，在為家人準備餐點前先洗手。","explanation":"名詞「洗臉盆」。指家居中用於洗滌的容器。"}],"related_forms":["basins"]}

{"headword":"battery","explanation":"名詞「電池、一組」。常用於電子設備，或指一組相似的測試或設備。常用搭配：run out of battery (沒電), a battery of tests (一系列測試)。","entries":[{"sentence":"My smartphone <target>ran</target> <pattern>out of</pattern> <target>battery</target> just as I was about to send the important email to my professor, which was very frustrating.","translation":"正當我要把重要電子郵件發給教授時，我的智慧型手機沒電了，這令人非常沮喪。","explanation":"名詞「電池」。片語 run out of battery 表示「沒電」。"},{"sentence":"The researchers administered a <target>battery</target> <pattern>of</pattern> <target>tests</target> to the participants to evaluate their cognitive abilities and memory capacity.","translation":"研究人員對參與者進行了一系列測試，以評估他們的心智能力和記憶力。","explanation":"名詞「一組」。a battery of tests 指「一系列測試」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"beggar","explanation":"名詞「乞丐」。常用搭配：beg for money (乞討錢財), a beggar's plea (乞丐的請求)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young man, who had become a <target>beggar</target> after losing his job and home, sat on the street corner asking for help.","translation":"這名年輕男子在失去工作和家後成了乞丐，坐在街角請求幫助。","explanation":"名詞「乞丐」。"},{"sentence":"Despite having very little money, the student decided to give a few coins to the <target>beggar</target> who was shivering in the cold wind.","translation":"儘管錢很少，這名學生還是決定給那個在寒風中發抖的乞丐幾枚硬幣。","explanation":"名詞「乞丐」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"behavior","explanation":"名詞「行為、表現」。指一個人的舉止或反應。常用搭配：good/bad behavior (好/壞的行為), exhibit behavior (表現出某種行為)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher praised the students for their <pattern>excellent</pattern> <target>behavior</target> during the field trip, as they followed all the safety rules.","translation":"老師稱讚學生在校外教學期間表現優異，因為他們遵守了所有的安全規則。","explanation":"名詞「行為、表現」。常用搭配：excellent behavior。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are studying the <target>behavior</target> <pattern>of</pattern> dolphins to understand how these intelligent animals communicate with each other in the ocean.","translation":"科學家正在研究海豚的行為，以了解這些聰明的動物在海洋中如何互相溝通。","explanation":"名詞「行為」。常用搭配：behavior of sth/sb。"},{"sentence":"Parents are often concerned about their children's <target>behavior</target> at school, hoping they will be respectful and hardworking.","translation":"父母經常擔心孩子在學校的行為，希望他們能有禮貌且勤奮。","explanation":"名詞「行為、表現」。"}],"related_forms":["behavioral","behave"]}

{"headword":"bin","explanation":"名詞「垃圾桶；儲藏箱」。在英國英語中常用 bin 指垃圾桶 (trash can/garbage can)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please remember to throw your empty plastic bottles <pattern>into</pattern> the recycling <target>bin</target> after you finish your drinks.","translation":"請記得在喝完飲料後將空的塑膠瓶丟進回收桶中。","explanation":"名詞「垃圾桶」。常用搭配：throw into the bin。"},{"sentence":"The farmer stored the harvested corn in a large metal <target>bin</target> to keep it dry and safe from pests.","translation":"農民將收穫的玉米儲存在一個大型金屬儲藏箱中，以保持乾燥並防止害蟲。","explanation":"名詞「儲藏箱」。指用於儲存大量物料的容器。"},{"sentence":"The janitor emptied the waste <target>bins</target> in every classroom every evening to maintain a clean learning environment.","translation":"管理員每天晚上清空每個教室的廢物桶，以維持乾淨的學習環境。","explanation":"名詞「垃圾桶」。"}],"related_forms":["bins"]}

{"headword":"biography","explanation":"名詞「傳記」。指詳細記錄某人一生故事的書籍。注意與 autobiography (自傳) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"For her history project, Sarah decided to read a <target>biography</target> <pattern>of</pattern> Abraham Lincoln to learn about his leadership skills.","translation":"為了她的歷史專題，莎拉決定閱讀一本亞伯拉罕·林肯的傳記，以學習他的領導能力。","explanation":"名詞「傳記」。常用搭配：biography of sb。"},{"sentence":"The library has a vast collection of <target>biographies</target> that describe the lives of famous scientists, artists, and political leaders.","translation":"圖書館擁有大量描述著名科學家、藝術家和政治領袖生活的傳記。","explanation":"名詞「傳記」。"},{"sentence":"Writing a <target>biography</target> requires a lot of research and interviews to ensure that the facts about the person's life are accurate.","translation":"撰寫傳記需要大量的研究和訪談，以確保關於此人生活的事實是準確的。","explanation":"名詞「傳記」。"}],"related_forms":["biographical","biographer"]}

{"headword":"biology","explanation":"名詞「生物學」。研究生物及其生命過程的科學。","entries":[{"sentence":"In <target>biology</target> class, students use microscopes to examine the structure of plant cells and understand how they function.","translation":"在生物課上，學生使用顯微鏡來檢查植物細胞的結構並了解它們如何運作。","explanation":"名詞「生物學」。"},{"sentence":"Many students find <target>biology</target> fascinating because it explains the complex biological processes that keep humans and animals alive.","translation":"許多學生覺得生物學很迷人，因為它解釋了維持人類和動物生存的複雜生物過程。","explanation":"名詞「生物學」。"},{"sentence":"The research paper focused on the <target>biology</target> <pattern>of</pattern> deep-sea creatures, exploring how they survive in extreme pressure and darkness.","translation":"該研究論文聚焦於深海生物的生物學特性，探討它們如何在極端壓力與黑暗中生存。","explanation":"名詞「生物學」。常用搭配：biology of sth。"}],"related_forms":["biological","biologist"]}

{"headword":"blade","explanation":"名詞「刀刃；葉片；草葉」。指物體的鋒利邊緣，或像葉子一樣長而扁平的形狀。","entries":[{"sentence":"The chef carefully sharpened the <target>blade</target> <pattern>of</pattern> his knife to ensure that he could slice the vegetables thinly and precisely.","translation":"廚師小心地將他的刀刃磨利，以確保他能將蔬菜切得薄且精確。","explanation":"名詞「刀刃」。"},{"sentence":"The wind turbine's huge <target>blades</target> spin slowly in the breeze, generating clean energy for the entire village.","translation":"風力發電機巨大的葉片在微風中緩緩旋轉，為整個村莊產生乾淨的能源。","explanation":"名詞「葉片」。指機械裝置上的旋轉葉片。"},{"sentence":"After the rain, a single <target>blade</target> <pattern>of</pattern> grass stood out against the dark soil, showing the first sign of spring.","translation":"雨後，一根草葉在深色土壤中顯現，預示著春天的第一個跡象。","explanation":"名詞「草葉」。常用搭配：a blade of grass。"}],"related_forms":["blades"]}

{"headword":"blend","explanation":"動詞「混合、融合」；名詞「混合物」。指將兩種或多種事物結合在一起，使其形成一個統一的整體。","entries":[{"sentence":"The artist decided to <target>blend</target> different colors <pattern>together</pattern> on the canvas to create a smooth transition between the light and shadow.","translation":"藝術家決定在畫布上將不同顏色混合在一起，以在光影之間創造平滑的過渡。","explanation":"動詞「混合、融合」。常用搭配：blend together。"},{"sentence":"The chef uses a special <target>blend</target> <pattern>of</pattern> spices to give the dish a unique flavor that attracts many food lovers.","translation":"廚師使用一種特殊的香料混合物，讓這道菜具有吸引許多美食愛好者的獨特風味。","explanation":"名詞「混合物」。常用搭配：a blend of sth。"},{"sentence":"Modern architecture often <target>blends</target> traditional styles <pattern>with</pattern> modern materials to create buildings that are both beautiful and functional.","translation":"Modern architecture often blends traditional styles with modern materials to create buildings that are both beautiful and functional.","explanation":"動詞「融合」。常用搭配：blend sth with sth。"},{"sentence":"The singer's voice <target>blended</target> perfectly <pattern>with</pattern> the piano music, creating a peaceful atmosphere in the concert hall.","translation":"歌手的聲音與鋼琴音樂完美融合，在音樂廳中營造出寧靜的氛圍。","explanation":"動詞「融合」。指聲音或風格的融合。"}],"related_forms":["blended","blending"]}

{"headword":"blessing","explanation":"名詞「祝福；幸運的事物」。常用片語 a blessing in disguise (塞翁失馬，焉知非福)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The unexpected rain was a <target>blessing</target> for the farmers, as it ended the long drought and saved their crops.","translation":"這場意外的雨對農民來說是一個祝福，因為它結束了長期的乾旱並救了他們的作物。","explanation":"名詞「祝福；幸運的事物」。"},{"sentence":"Losing his first job was a <target>blessing</target> <pattern>in disguise</pattern>, as it forced him to find a better career path that he truly loved.","translation":"失去第一份工作是塞翁失馬，因為這迫使他找到了他真正熱愛的更好職涯路徑。","explanation":"名詞片語 a blessing in disguise，意為「看似不幸但最終證明是有益的」。"},{"sentence":"The couple thanked their parents for their <target>blessings</target> and support as they started their new life together as a married couple.","translation":"這對夫婦感謝父母的祝福與支持，因為他們開始了作為夫妻的共同新生活。","explanation":"名詞「祝福」。"}],"related_forms":["bless"]}

{"headword":"blink","explanation":"動詞「眨眼；閃爍」；名詞「眨眼之間」。指快速地閉上並打開眼睛。","entries":[{"sentence":"The bright sunlight made her <target>blink</target> several times before she could see the road clearly through her sunglasses.","translation":"強烈的陽光讓她眨眼好幾次，才能在戴著太陽眼鏡的情況下清楚地看到道路。","explanation":"動詞「眨眼」。"},{"sentence":"The red light on the computer monitor <target>blinked</target> slowly, indicating that the system was still processing the large file.","translation":"電腦螢幕上的紅燈緩慢地閃爍，表示系統仍在處理這個大檔案。","explanation":"動詞「閃爍」。指光線的快慢交替出現。"},{"sentence":"The summer vacation passed <pattern>in</pattern> a <target>blink</target> of an eye, and soon the students had to return to school for the new semester.","translation":"暑假在眨眼之間就過去了，很快學生們就得回學校開始新學期。","explanation":"名詞片語 in a blink of an eye，意為「極快地、瞬間地」。"}],"related_forms":["blinks","blinked","blinking"]}

{"headword":"bloom","explanation":"名詞「開花；花朵」；動詞「開花；繁榮」。常用於描述植物開花或某人進入最美好地時期。","entries":[{"sentence":"The cherry blossoms reach their full <target>bloom</target> in early spring, attracting thousands of tourists to the park every year.","translation":"櫻花在早春達到全開狀態，每年吸引數千名遊客來到公園。","explanation":"名詞「開花」。常用搭配：in full bloom (盛開)。"},{"sentence":"After weeks of careful watering and sunshine, the roses in the garden finally began to <target>bloom</target> in vibrant red colors.","translation":"經過數週的細心澆水和陽光照射，花園裡的玫瑰終於開始開出鮮紅色的花朵。","explanation":"動詞「開花」。"},{"sentence":"The young artist's career began to <target>bloom</target> after her paintings were exhibited in a famous gallery in the city center.","translation":"這位年輕藝術家的事業在她的畫作被展出於市中心一家著名畫廊後開始繁榮。","explanation":"動詞「繁榮」。比喻用法，指事業或能力進入成長期。"}],"related_forms":["blooming","bloomed"]}

{"headword":"blossom","explanation":"名詞「花；花蕾」；動詞「開花；發展」。與 bloom 相似，但 blossom 通常指果樹開的花，或比喻指人的發展。","entries":[{"sentence":"The apple tree is covered in beautiful white <target>blossoms</target> every spring, signaling the start of the growing season for the fruits.","translation":"蘋果樹每年春天都開滿美麗的白色花朵，預示著果實生長季節的開始。","explanation":"名詞「花」。通常指果樹的花。"},{"sentence":"Their friendship <target>blossomed</target> <pattern>into</pattern> a deep romance after they spent the entire summer volunteering together at the local animal shelter.","translation":"在他們整個夏天一起在當地動物收容所擔任志工後，他們的友誼發展成了深厚的浪漫關係。","explanation":"動詞片語 blossom into sth，意為「發展成為...」。"},{"sentence":"The shy student <target>blossomed</target> <pattern>into</pattern> a confident public speaker after taking a few months of drama classes.","translation":"這名害羞的學生在參加了幾個月的戲劇課後，發展成了自信的公開演講者。","explanation":"動詞片語 blossom into sth，比喻指人的成長與發展。"}],"related_forms":["blossoming","blossomed"]}

{"headword":"boast","explanation":"動詞意為「自誇、吹噓」，名詞意為「自誇的話」。常用片語 boast about/of sth (自誇某事) 或 boast sth (擁有值得自豪的事物)。注意 boast 與 brag 的區別：boast 可指正面的自豪，而 brag 通常帶有負面地吹噓的意味。","entries":[{"sentence":"He likes to <target>boast</target> <pattern>about</pattern> his high scores in every English test, which sometimes makes his classmates feel uncomfortable.","translation":"他喜歡吹噓他在每場英文考試中的高分，這有時讓他的同學感到不舒服。","explanation":"動詞「吹噓」。常用片語 boast about sth。"},{"sentence":"The small town <target>boasts</target> <pattern>a beautiful</pattern> <target>beach</target> and several historic temples, attracting many visitors during the summer holidays.","translation":"這個小鎮擁有一座美麗的海灘和幾座歷史悠久的寺廟，在夏季假期吸引了許多遊客。","explanation":"動詞「擁有(值得自豪的事物)」。此處指小鎮具備優勢條件。"},{"sentence":"It was a <pattern>bold</pattern> <target>boast</target> to claim that he could finish the entire project in one day, but he surprisingly succeeded.","translation":"聲稱他能在一天內完成整個計畫是一次大膽的自誇，但令人驚訝的是他成功了。","explanation":"名詞「自誇的話」。常用形容詞搭配：bold boast。"}],"related_forms":["boasts","boasting","boasted"]}

{"headword":"bond","explanation":"名詞指「紐帶、聯繫」或「債券」，動詞指「建立聯繫」或「黏合」。常考片語 form a bond (建立紐帶/關係)、emotional bond (情感紐帶)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Spending time together during the school camping trip helped the students <target>form</target> a <pattern>strong</pattern> <target>bond</target> with their classmates.","translation":"在學校露營旅行期間一起共度時光，幫助學生與同學建立了強烈的紐帶。","explanation":"名詞「紐帶、聯繫」。常用搭配：form a strong bond (建立強烈的關係)。"},{"sentence":"The chemistry teacher explained how atoms <target>bond</target> <pattern>together</pattern> to create different molecules through the sharing of electrons.","translation":"化學老師解釋了原子如何通過共享電子而黏合在一起，從而創造出不同的分子。","explanation":"動詞「黏合、結合」。常用搭配：bond together。"},{"sentence":"Many investors prefer to buy government <target>bonds</target> because they are generally considered safer than investing in the stock market.","translation":"許多投資者更喜歡購買政府債券，因為它們通常被認為比投資股市更安全。","explanation":"名詞「債券」。指金融產品。"},{"sentence":"The two teammates <target>bonded</target> <pattern>over</pattern> their shared love for basketball, becoming best friends within a few weeks.","translation":"這兩名隊友因為共同對籃球的喜愛而建立了深厚的情誼。","explanation":"動詞「建立聯繫」。常用片語 bond over sth。"}],"related_forms":["bonded","bonding"]}

{"headword":"bounce","explanation":"動詞指「彈起、跳回」，名詞指「彈跳」。在口語中，bounce back (恢復、彈回) 是一個常用的片語，表示從困境中恢復。","entries":[{"sentence":"The basketball <target>bounced</target> <pattern>off</pattern> the rim and flew away, leaving the player frustrated with the missed shot.","translation":"籃球從籃圈彈開並飛走了，讓球員對這次投籃失手感到沮喪。","explanation":"動詞「彈起」。常用搭配：bounce off sth。"},{"sentence":"Young children love to watch a rubber ball <target>bounce</target> up and down on the floor, laughing as it moves unpredictably.","translation":"小孩子喜歡看橡膠球在地板上上下彈跳，在它不可預測的移動時大笑。","explanation":"動詞「彈跳」。"},{"sentence":"Despite facing several failures in the first semester, the student showed great resilience and managed to <target>bounce</target> <pattern>back</pattern> quickly.","translation":"儘管在第一學期面臨多次失敗，這名學生展現了極強的韌性，並成功地快速恢復。","explanation":"動詞片語 bounce back 意為「恢復、從困境中重新振作」。"}],"related_forms":["bounced","bouncing","bounces"]}

{"headword":"bracelet","explanation":"名詞「手鍊、手鐲」。通常指佩戴在手腕上的裝飾品。","entries":[{"sentence":"For her sixteenth birthday, her grandmother gave her a beautiful silver <target>bracelet</target> <pattern>with</pattern> a small heart-shaped charm.","translation":"在她十六歲生日時，她的祖母送了她一條帶有小心形墜飾的精美銀手鍊。","explanation":"名詞「手鍊」。常用搭配：bracelet with [decoration]。"},{"sentence":"She wore a colorful <target>bracelet</target> made of woven threads, which she had learned to make during her art class last month.","translation":"她戴著一條用編織線製成的彩色手鍊，這是她上個月在藝術課上學會製作的。","explanation":"名詞「手鍊」。"}],"related_forms":["bracelets"]}

{"headword":"breed","explanation":"名詞指「品種」，動詞指「繁殖、培育」或「導致」。注意其與 breed (v.) 導致 (cause) 的用法，常用於描述負面結果，例如 breed distrust (導致不信任)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The Golden Retriever is a <pattern>popular</pattern> <target>breed</target> of dog known for its friendly nature and patience with young children.","translation":"黃金獵犬是一種以友善天性和對小孩有耐心而聞名的熱門犬種。","explanation":"名詞「品種」。常用於動物。"},{"sentence":"Farmers often <target>breed</target> specific types of cattle to increase the amount of milk produced on their dairy farms.","translation":"農民經常培育特定類型的牛，以增加他們乳牛場的產奶量。","explanation":"動詞「培育、繁殖」。"},{"sentence":"The lack of communication between the two managers <target>bred</target> <pattern>deep</pattern> <target>distrust</target> within the office, leading to several conflicts.","translation":"兩位經理之間缺乏溝通導致辦公室內產生深厚的不信任，進而導致多次衝突。","explanation":"動詞「導致」。breed sth (通常指負面事物) 意為「導致/產生」。"},{"sentence":"In the wild, some animals <target>breed</target> <pattern>during</pattern> the spring to ensure their offspring have enough food to survive the winter.","translation":"在野外，有些動物在春季繁殖，以確保後代有足夠的食物在冬天生存。","explanation":"動詞「繁殖」。"}],"related_forms":["breeds","breeding","bred"]}

{"headword":"groom","explanation":"名詞指「新郎」，動詞指「精心打理(外表)」或「培訓(某人)以擔任某職」。注意 bridegroom 是其完整形式，但 groom 較為常用。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>groom</target> looked nervous as he waited at the altar, repeatedly adjusting his tie before the bride finally walked in.","translation":"新郎在祭壇前等待時顯得很緊張，在新娘終於走進來之前反覆調整他的領帶。","explanation":"名詞「新郎」。"},{"sentence":"Before the big competition, the rider spent an hour <target>grooming</target> her horse to make sure its coat was shiny and clean.","translation":"在大賽之前，騎手花了一個小時為她的馬梳理毛髮，以確保它的皮毛光亮且乾淨。","explanation":"動詞「打理、梳理」。指對動物或人的外表進行打理。"},{"sentence":"The senior manager has been <target>grooming</target> the young assistant <pattern>for</pattern> a leadership role within the company for several years.","translation":"高級經理幾年來一直培訓這位年輕助理，使其能擔任公司內部的領導職務。","explanation":"動詞「培訓」。groom someone for sth 意為「培訓某人以擔任某職」。"}],"related_forms":["grooms","groomed","grooming"]}

{"headword":"broke","explanation":"形容詞，意為「沒錢的、破產的」。這是 break 的不規則形式，但在作為形容詞時，指財務狀況極差。注意與 broken (損壞的) 的區別：broke 是指錢沒了，broken 是指東西壞了。","entries":[{"sentence":"I would love to go to the concert with you, but I'm completely <target>broke</target> until my next allowance arrives next Friday.","translation":"我很想和你一起去音樂會，但我得等到下週五下次零用錢到才完全沒錢。","explanation":"形容詞「沒錢的」。常用搭配：completely broke, flat broke。"},{"sentence":"After spending all his savings on a new laptop, the college student found himself <target>broke</target> and unable to afford daily meals.","translation":"在將所有積蓄花在一部新筆記型電腦後，這位大學生發現自己沒錢且無法支付日常餐費。","explanation":"形容詞「沒錢的」。"}],"related_forms":["break"]}

{"headword":"broom","explanation":"名詞「掃帚」。常用於清潔地板。","entries":[{"sentence":"The janitor used a large <target>broom</target> to sweep the fallen leaves from the school hallway, making it look clean and tidy.","translation":"管理員用一把大掃帚將學校走廊上的落葉掃走，讓走廊看起來乾淨整潔。","explanation":"名詞「掃帚」。"},{"sentence":"She reached for the <target>broom</target> in the corner of the kitchen to quickly clean up the broken glass from the floor.","translation":"她伸手拿廚房角落的掃帚，以便快速清理掉地板上的碎玻璃。","explanation":"名詞「掃帚」。"}],"related_forms":["brooms"]}

{"headword":"brutal","explanation":"形容詞「殘酷的、野蠻的」。可用於描述暴力行為、氣候極端或誠實得令人難受 (brutally honest)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The refugees escaped from a <target>brutal</target> <pattern>dictatorship</pattern>, where they had endured years of violence and lack of basic human rights.","translation":"難民們從一個殘酷的獨裁政權中逃脫，在那裡他們忍受了多年的暴力和基本人權的缺乏。","explanation":"形容詞「殘酷的」。常用搭配：brutal dictatorship (殘酷的獨裁政權)。"},{"sentence":"The winter in the northern mountains is <target>brutal</target>, with temperatures often dropping far below zero and heavy snow blocking all roads.","translation":"北部山區的冬天非常殘酷，氣溫經常降至零下許多度，且大雪封路。","explanation":"形容詞「極端的、嚴酷的」。用於描述氣候。"},{"sentence":"I know you might not like the answer, but I have to be <pattern>brutally</target> <target>honest</target> with you about the quality of your work.","translation":"我知道你可能不喜歡這個答案，但關於你的工作品質，我必須對你坦白得令人難受。","explanation":"形容詞片語 brutally honest 意為「極其坦白、直言不諱」。"}],"related_forms":["brutality","brutally"]}

{"headword":"bulletin","explanation":"名詞「公告、快訊」。通常指正式的簡短通知，常用於學校、公司或新聞媒體。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school <target>bulletin</target> <pattern>board</pattern> is the best place to find information about upcoming club activities and sports competitions.","translation":"學校公告欄是尋找即將到來的社團活動和體育競賽資訊的最佳地點。","explanation":"名詞「公告」。常用搭配：bulletin board (公告欄)。"},{"sentence":"The news station released a special <target>bulletin</target> to inform the public about the sudden weather warning and the expected heavy rain.","translation":"新聞台發布了一則特別快訊，以告知大眾關於突然的天氣警告和預期的強降雨。","explanation":"名詞「快訊」。指正式的簡短通知。"},{"sentence":"The government issued an <pattern>official</pattern> <target>bulletin</target> regarding the new health guidelines to prevent the spread of the virus in the community.","translation":"政府發布了一份官方公告，關於防止社區內病毒傳播的新健康指南。","explanation":"名詞「公告」。常用搭配：official bulletin (官方公告)。"}],"related_forms":["bulletins"]}

{"headword":"burglar","explanation":"名詞「竊賊」。指潛入他人房屋或建築物偷東西的人。注意與 robber (搶匪) 的區別：burglar 強調「潛入」的行為，而 robber 強調「搶劫」的暴力或威脅行為。","entries":[{"sentence":"The homeowners were shocked to find that a <target>burglar</target> had broken into their house while they were away on vacation.","translation":"屋主驚訝地發現，在他們度假期間，一名竊賊潛入了他們的家。","explanation":"名詞「竊賊」。常用搭配：break into (潛入/闖入)。"},{"sentence":"Police are currently reviewing security camera footage to identify the <target>burglar</target> who stole several expensive jewelry pieces from the store.","translation":"警方目前正在審查監視器畫面，以辨識出從店中偷走幾件昂貴珠寶的竊賊。","explanation":"名詞「竊賊」。"}],"related_forms":["burglary","burglarize"]}

{"headword":"cabinet","explanation":"名詞「櫥櫃」或「內閣」。在日常生活中指儲物櫃；在政治語境中指指政府的高級官員團隊。","entries":[{"sentence":"She carefully placed the new set of dishes in the kitchen <target>cabinet</target>, making sure they were organized and easy to reach.","translation":"她小心地將新的一套盤子放入廚房櫥櫃中，確保它們被整理好且容易拿取。","explanation":"名詞「櫥櫃」。指用於儲存物品的家具。"},{"sentence":"The president met with his <target>cabinet</target> to discuss the new economic policies and how to implement them across the country.","translation":"總統與他的內閣會議，討論新的經濟政策以及如何在全國範圍內實施。","explanation":"名詞「內閣」。指政府的最高行政管理團隊。"}],"related_forms":["cabinets"]}

{"headword":"calculate","explanation":"動詞「計算、推算」。指使用數學或邏輯來得出結果，或根據現有資訊推測可能發生的情況。","entries":[{"sentence":"Students are required to <target>calculate</target> the total cost of the trip, including transportation, food, and accommodation, before submitting the plan.","translation":"學生被要求在提交計劃前，計算出這次旅行的總費用，包括交通、食物和住宿。","explanation":"動詞「計算」。指使用數學得出數值。"},{"sentence":"The engineers had to <target>calculate</target> the exact amount of weight the bridge could hold to ensure the safety of all vehicles.","translation":"工程師必須推算出橋樑能承載的準確重量，以確保所有車輛的安全。","explanation":"動詞「推算」。指根據科學數據進行估算。"},{"sentence":"He decided to <target>calculate</target> the risks involved in starting his own business before investing all of his life savings.","translation":"他決定在投入所有積蓄前，先推算開創自己事業所涉及的風險。","explanation":"動詞「推算/估計」。常用搭配：calculate the risk (評估風險)。"}],"related_forms":["calculation","calculable","calculator"]}

{"headword":"calculation","explanation":"名詞「計算、估算」。指計算的過程或結果，也可以指經過深思熟慮後的計畫或行為。","entries":[{"sentence":"According to my <target>calculation</target>, we should arrive at the museum by noon if the traffic remains light throughout the journey.","translation":"根據我的計算，如果旅途中的交通保持順暢，我們應該在中午前到達博物館。","explanation":"名詞「計算」。指透過數學得出的結果。"},{"sentence":"The scientist checked her <target>calculations</target> several times to ensure there were no errors before publishing the results of the experiment.","translation":"科學家在公布實驗結果前，將她的計算檢查了多次，以確保沒有錯誤。","explanation":"名詞「計算」。指數學運算的過程。"},{"sentence":"The politician's move to support the local charity was seen as a cold <target>calculation</target> to win more votes from the public.","translation":"這位政治家支持當地慈善機構的舉動被視為一種冷靜的算計，旨在贏得更多公眾的選票。","explanation":"名詞「算計/估算」。指經過精心策劃的行為。"}],"related_forms":["calculate"]}

{"headword":"calorie","explanation":"名詞「卡路里」。一種衡量食物提供能量的單位。常用於討論健康、飲食或運動。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many people read the nutrition labels on food packaging to track the number of <target>calories</target> they consume every day.","translation":"許多人閱讀食品包裝上的營養標籤，以追蹤他們每天攝取的卡路里數量。","explanation":"名詞「卡路里」。常用於飲食健康討論。"},{"sentence":"Running for an hour can help you burn a significant amount of <target>calories</target>, making it an effective way to lose weight.","translation":"跑步一小時可以幫助你燃燒大量卡路里，使其成為一種有效的減重方式。","explanation":"名詞「卡路里」。常用搭配：burn calories (燃燒卡路里)。"}],"related_forms":["calories"]}

{"headword":"campaign","explanation":"名詞「活動、競選」；動詞「發起活動、競選」。指為了達到特定目標（如政治、社會或商業）而進行的一系列有計畫的行動。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student council launched a <target>campaign</target> <pattern>to</pattern> reduce plastic waste on campus by encouraging everyone to use reusable bottles.","translation":"學生會發起了一項減少校園塑料垃圾的活動，鼓勵每個人使用可重複使用的水瓶。","explanation":"名詞「活動」。指為了特定目的而進行的系列行動。"},{"sentence":"During the presidential <target>campaign</target>, the candidate traveled to various cities to share his vision for the future of the country.","translation":"在總統競選期間，候選人前往各個城市分享他對國家未來的願景。","explanation":"名詞「競選」。指選舉前的宣傳活動。"},{"sentence":"The environmental group is <target>campaigning</target> <pattern>for</pattern> stricter laws to protect endangered species from illegal hunting and habitat loss.","translation":"該環保團體正致力於爭取更嚴格的法律，以保護瀕危物種免於非法狩獵和棲息地喪失。","explanation":"動詞「發起活動/爭取」。常用搭配：campaign for sth (為某事而奮鬥/爭取)。"},{"sentence":"The company spent millions of dollars to <target>campaign</target> <pattern>against</pattern> the new tax law that would increase the price of their products.","translation":"該公司花費數百萬美元來反對這項會增加產品價格的新稅法。","explanation":"動詞「反對」。常用搭配：campaign against sth (反對某事)。"}],"related_forms":["campaigner"]}

{"headword":"candidate","explanation":"名詞「候選人、申請人」。指在選舉中競爭職位的人，或申請工作、入學的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hiring manager interviewed five <target>candidates</target> for the position, looking for someone with both technical skills and leadership experience.","translation":"招聘經理為該職位面試了五位候選人，尋找一位同時具備技術能力和領導經驗的人。","explanation":"名詞「候選人/申請人」。指申請工作的競爭者。"},{"sentence":"Each <target>candidate</target> was given ten minutes to present their goals and explain how they could improve the school environment.","translation":"每位候選人有十分鐘的時間來陳述他們的目標，並解釋他們如何能改善學校環境。","explanation":"名詞「候選人」。指參加選舉的人。"},{"sentence":"After reviewing the application forms, the university selected the most qualified <target>candidates</target> for the final round of interviews.","translation":"在審核申請表後，大學選擇了最合格的申請人進入最終輪的面試。","explanation":"名詞「申請人」。"}],"related_forms":["candidacy"]}

{"headword":"cane","explanation":"名詞「手杖、甘蔗」。指用來輔助行走的人用棍子，或一種高大的草本植物。","entries":[{"sentence":"The elderly man leaned on his <target>cane</target> as he walked slowly down the street, needing the extra support for his legs.","translation":"那位老人走在街上時倚著他的手杖，因為他的腿需要額外的支撐。","explanation":"名詞「手杖」。指輔助行走的工具。"},{"sentence":"During the trip to the tropical island, the students learned how local farmers harvest <target>cane</target> to produce sugar.","translation":"在前往熱帶島嶼的旅行中，學生們學習了當地農民如何收割甘蔗來生產糖。","explanation":"名詞「甘蔗」。"}],"related_forms":["canes"]}

{"headword":"canoe","explanation":"名詞「獨木舟」；動詞「划獨木舟」。","entries":[{"sentence":"We rented a <target>canoe</target> and spent the afternoon paddling slowly along the quiet river to enjoy the natural scenery.","translation":"我們租了一艘獨木舟，花了一個下午的時間沿著寧靜的河流緩緩划行，欣賞自然風景。","explanation":"名詞「獨木舟」。"},{"sentence":"For the school's outdoor adventure club, the students learned how to <target>canoe</target> safely in the lake during the summer break.","translation":"對於學校的戶外探險社，學生們在暑假期間學習如何在湖中安全地划獨木舟。","explanation":"動詞「划獨木舟」。"}],"related_forms":["canoeing"]}

{"headword":"capacity","explanation":"名詞「容量、能力、職能」。指容器能容納的量，或一個人具備的心理或身體上的能力。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new stadium has a seating <target>capacity</target> <pattern>of</pattern> 50,000 people, making it one of the largest sports venues in the city.","translation":"這座新體育場的座位容量為五萬人，使其成為市內最大的體育場館之一。","explanation":"名詞「容量」。常用搭配：capacity of... (容量為...)。"},{"sentence":"The teacher praised the student's amazing <target>capacity</target> <pattern>for</pattern> learning new languages, as she could speak four fluently within two years.","translation":"老師稱讚這名學生學習新語言的驚人能力，因為她在兩年內就能流利地說四種語言。","explanation":"名詞「能力」。常用搭配：capacity for sth (做某事的能力)。"},{"sentence":"In his <target>capacity</target> <pattern>as</pattern> the head of the student council, he is responsible for organizing the annual school festival.","translation":"以他作為學生會會長的身份，他負責組織年度學校祭典。","explanation":"名詞「職能/身份」。常用搭配：in one's capacity as... (以某人的身份)。"}],"related_forms":["capacities"]}

{"headword":"capital","explanation":"名詞用法多樣：1. 「資本」指投入生產的資金；2. 「首都」指國家的政治中心；3. 「大寫字母」。注意 capital (資本) 相關的派生詞 capitalism (資本主義) 和 capitalist (資本家)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government is trying to attract more foreign <target>capital</target> to build new factories and create more jobs for local workers.","translation":"政府正試圖吸引更多外國資本來建造新工廠，並為當地工人創造更多就業機會。","explanation":"名詞「資本」。指用於投資或生產的資金。"},{"sentence":"Taipei is the <target>capital</target> of Taiwan, where most of the central government offices and important political decisions are located.","translation":"台北是台灣的首都，大多數的中央政府機關和重要的政治決定都在這裡做出。","explanation":"名詞「首都」。"},{"sentence":"Remember to start every sentence with a <target>capital</target> letter and end it with a proper punctuation mark to ensure clarity.","translation":"記得每個句子的開頭要用大寫字母，並以正確的標點符號結束，以確保清晰。","explanation":"名詞「大寫字母」。"},{"sentence":"The rise of <target>capitalism</target> during the Industrial Revolution led to significant changes in how goods were produced and distributed globally.","translation":"工業革命期間資本主義的興起，導致全球商品生產和分配方式發生了重大變化。","explanation":"名詞「資本主義」。由 capital 衍生的名詞。"}],"related_forms":["capitalism","capitalist","capitals"]}

{"headword":"capitalist","explanation":"名詞指「資本家」，即擁有生產資料並投資以獲利的人；形容詞指「資本主義的」。","entries":[{"sentence":"In a <target>capitalist</target> economy, prices are determined by the laws of supply and demand rather than by government control.","translation":"在資本主義經濟中，價格是由供給與需求的定律決定，而非由政府控制。","explanation":"形容詞「資本主義的」。"},{"sentence":"The wealthy <target>capitalist</target> invested his fortune in several promising tech startups, hoping to earn a high return on his investment.","translation":"這位富有的資本家將他的財富投資於幾家有前途的科技初創公司，希望獲得高投資回報。","explanation":"名詞「資本家」。"}],"related_forms":["capitalism","capitalists"]}

{"headword":"cargo","explanation":"名詞「貨物」，通常指由船、飛機或卡車運送的大宗貨物。注意與 goods 或 freight 的區別：cargo 側重於運輸過程中的貨物。","entries":[{"sentence":"The massive <target>cargo</target> ship was carrying thousands of containers filled with electronic products from Asia to Europe.","translation":"這艘巨大的貨輪運著數千個裝滿亞洲電子產品的貨櫃前往歐洲。","explanation":"名詞「貨物」。常用於海運或空運背景。"},{"sentence":"Due to the severe storm, the plane had to dump some of its <target>cargo</target> to reduce weight and land safely at the nearest airport.","translation":"由於強烈的風暴，飛機必須捨棄部分貨物以減輕重量，並在最近的機場安全著陸。","explanation":"名詞「貨物」。"},{"sentence":"The port workers used giant cranes to unload the <target>cargo</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the ship and move it into the storage warehouse.","translation":"港口工人使用巨大的起重機將貨物從船上卸下，並將其移至儲藏倉庫。","explanation":"名詞「貨物」。搭配 from the ship 表示從船上卸貨。"}],"related_forms":["cargos","cargoes"]}

{"headword":"carrier","explanation":"名詞「運送者；載體；電信公司」。在 GSAT 中，常指運輸公司（如航空公司、貨運公司）或生物學中的載體（如基因載體）。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many international <target>carriers</target> have increased their ticket prices due to the rising cost of fuel and airport taxes.","translation":"由於燃料成本和機場稅的上升，許多國際航空公司增加了機票價格。","explanation":"名詞「運送者/航空公司」。此處指提供運輸服務的公司。"},{"sentence":"The courier company is a reliable <target>carrier</target> for sending urgent documents across the country, ensuring delivery within twenty-four hours.","translation":"這家快遞公司是跨國發送緊急文件的可靠運送商，確保在24小時內送達。","explanation":"名詞「運送者/貨運商」。"},{"sentence":"In biology, a <target>carrier</target> is a person who has a genetic mutation but does not show any symptoms of the disease.","translation":"在生物學中，載體是指具有基因突變但沒有表現出任何疾病症狀的人。","explanation":"名詞「載體」。指攜帶特定基因的人。"}],"related_forms":["carriers"]}

{"headword":"carve","explanation":"動詞「雕刻；切開」。常用搭配：carve out (開闢/爭取)。注意其名詞形式 carving (雕刻品)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The artist spent several months using a sharp tool to <target>carve</target> a beautiful statue <pattern>out of</pattern> a single piece of marble.","translation":"藝術家花了好幾個月時間，用鋒利的工具將一塊大理石雕刻成一座美麗的雕像。","explanation":"動詞「雕刻」。搭配 carve out of sth 表示將某物雕刻成某樣東西。"},{"sentence":"During the holiday dinner, the father carefully <target>carved</target> the roast turkey <pattern>into</pattern> small slices to serve to the family members.","translation":"在假期晚餐時，父親小心地將烤火雞切成小片，分給家人們食用。","explanation":"動詞「切開」。搭配 carve into slices 表示切成片狀。"},{"sentence":"The young entrepreneur worked tirelessly to <target>carve</target> <pattern>out</pattern> a niche <pattern>for</pattern> himself in the competitive tech industry.","translation":"這位年輕的創業家不懈地工作，以在競爭激烈的科技產業中為自己開闢一個利基市場。","explanation":"動詞片語 carve out a niche 表示「開闢一個利基/特定領域」。"}],"related_forms":["carved","carving"]}

{"headword":"catalogue","explanation":"名詞「目錄」；動詞「將...編入目錄」。注意美式拼法為 catalog。","entries":[{"sentence":"The library has a digital <target>catalogue</target> that allows students to search for books by author, title, or subject online.","translation":"圖書館有一個數位目錄，允許學生在網上根據作者、書名或主題搜尋書籍。","explanation":"名詞「目錄」。"},{"sentence":"The fashion company sends a seasonal <target>catalogue</target> to its customers, showcasing the latest trends and prices for the upcoming winter.","translation":"這家時尚公司向其客戶發送季節性目錄，展示即將到來的冬季的最新趨勢和價格。","explanation":"名詞「目錄」。"},{"sentence":"The museum staff spent weeks <target>cataloguing</target> the ancient coins found in the cave to ensure every item was properly recorded.","translation":"博物館工作人員花了好幾週將洞穴中發現的古幣編入目錄，以確保每件物品都被正確記錄。","explanation":"動詞「編入目錄」。此處為現在分詞 cataloguing。"}],"related_forms":["catalogued","cataloguing"]}

{"headword":"category","explanation":"名詞「類別；範疇」。常用搭配：fall into a category (屬於某類)。","entries":[{"sentence":"When organizing the school library, the students divided the books <pattern>into</pattern> different <target>categories</target> based on their genres, such as mystery or science.","translation":"在整理學校圖書館時，學生們根據書籍的類型（如推理或科學）將其分為不同的類別。","explanation":"名詞「類別」。搭配 into different categories 表示分為不同類別。"},{"sentence":"This specific type of whale <target>falls</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the <target>category</target> <pattern>of</pattern> endangered species and requires immediate protection efforts.","translation":"這種特定類型的鯨魚屬於瀕危物種這一類，需要立即採取保護措施。","explanation":"名詞「類別」。片語 fall into the category of... 表示「屬於...類別」。"}],"related_forms":["categories"]}

{"headword":"cease","explanation":"動詞「停止」。比 stop 更正式。常用搭配：cease to V (停止做某事), cease doing sth (停止做某事)。名詞形式為 cessation (停止/終止)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two countries finally agreed to <target>cease</target> <pattern>all</pattern> military operations to allow humanitarian aid to reach the affected civilians.","translation":"兩國最終同意停止所有軍事行動，以便人道主義援助能到達受影響的平民。","explanation":"動詞「停止」。常用於正式語境，如 cease all operations。"},{"sentence":"After the rain <target>ceased</target>, the outdoor concert continued, and the crowd began to cheer loudly for the performing musicians.","translation":"雨停之後，屋外音樂會繼續進行，群眾開始大聲為表演的音樂家歡呼。","explanation":"動詞「停止」。常用於描述自然現象的停止。"},{"sentence":"The company decided to <target>cease</target> <pattern>production of</pattern> the old model of the smartphone because it was no longer popular among young consumers.","translation":"公司決定停止生產舊款智慧型手機，因為它在年輕消費者中已不再受歡迎。","explanation":"動詞「停止」。常用搭配 cease production of sth。"}],"related_forms":["ceased","cessation"]}

{"headword":"celebration","explanation":"名詞「慶祝活動」。常用搭配：in celebration of (為了慶祝...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The entire city was filled with lights and music in <target>celebration</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the national holiday, attracting thousands of tourists.","translation":"整個城市充滿了燈光和音樂，以慶祝國定假日，吸引了數千名遊客。","explanation":"名詞「慶祝活動」。片語 in celebration of... 表示「為了慶祝...」。"},{"sentence":"After winning the national championship, the basketball team held a grand <target>celebration</target> at the school gym for all the students and teachers.","translation":"在贏得全國錦標賽後，籃球隊在學校體育館為所有學生和老師舉辦了一場盛大的慶祝活動。","explanation":"名詞「慶祝活動」。"}],"related_forms":["celebrate","celebrated","celebrating"]}

{"headword":"chamber","explanation":"名詞「房間；會議室；心室/心房」。在 GSAT 中，常指正式的會議室（如 legislative chamber）或生物學中的心室。","entries":[{"sentence":"The members of parliament gathered in the legislative <target>chamber</target> to debate the new laws and vote on the budget for the next year.","translation":"國會議員在立法會議室聚集，討論新法律並對明年的預算進行投票。","explanation":"名詞「房間/會議室」。指正式的大型會議室。"},{"sentence":"The human heart consists of four <target>chambers</target>, which work together to pump blood efficiently throughout the entire body.","translation":"人類的心臟由四個心室組成，共同運作以將血液高效地泵送到整個身體。","explanation":"名詞「心室」。生物學專業術語。"},{"sentence":"Archaeologists discovered a hidden <target>chamber</target> beneath the pyramid, containing ancient treasures and the mummy of a powerful king.","translation":"考古學家在金字塔下方發現了一個隱藏的房間，包含著古代寶藏和一位強大國王的木乃伊。","explanation":"名詞「房間」。指封閉的空間。"}],"related_forms":["chambers"]}

{"headword":"championship","explanation":"名詞，意為「冠軍賽」或「冠軍頭銜」。常用搭配 championship match (冠軍賽) 或 win the championship (贏得冠軍)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The national basketball <target>championship</target> <pattern>match</pattern> will be held in the city stadium next month, attracting fans from all over the country.","translation":"全國籃球冠軍賽將於下個月在市體育場舉行，將吸引來自全國各地的球迷。","explanation":"名詞「冠軍賽」。指爭奪冠軍的最後比賽。"},{"sentence":"After years of hard training and discipline, the young tennis player finally <pattern>won</pattern> the <target>championship</target> in her first professional tournament.","translation":"經過多年的刻苦訓練和紀律，這位年輕的網球選手終於在她參加的第一場職業賽事中贏得了冠軍。","explanation":"名詞「冠軍頭銜」。win the championship 指贏得冠軍地位。"}],"related_forms":["champion"]}

{"headword":"characteristic","explanation":"可作名詞（特徵、特性）或形容詞（典型的、特有的）。名詞時常搭配 characteristic of (是...的特徵)。形容詞時常指某人或某物特有的性質。","entries":[{"sentence":"The most striking <target>characteristic</target> <pattern>of</pattern> this species of bird is its bright blue feathers, which help it attract a mate.","translation":"這種鳥最顯著的特徵是其鮮藍色的羽毛，這有助於它吸引配偶。","explanation":"名詞「特徵」。指某物特有的性質或特點。"},{"sentence":"Patient and kind behavior is a <target>characteristic</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a good teacher, helping students feel comfortable and supported in the classroom.","translation":"耐心且親切的行為是一位好老師的特徵，能讓學生在教室中感到舒適且得到支持。","explanation":"名詞「特徵」。常用搭配 characteristic of sth。"},{"sentence":"The artist's <target>characteristic</target> <pattern>style</pattern> of using bold colors and strong lines is easily recognized by art historians worldwide.","translation":"這位藝術家使用大膽顏色和強烈線條的典型風格，很容易被全球的藝術史學家所辨識。","explanation":"形容詞「典型的、特有的」。指某人或某物特有的風格或行為。"}],"related_forms":["characteristically","characterized"]}

{"headword":"charity","explanation":"名詞，意為「慈善」或「慈善機構」。常用搭配 donate to charity (捐款給慈善機構) 或 charitable organization (慈善組織)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many wealthy business people decide to <pattern>donate</pattern> a portion of their wealth <pattern>to</pattern> <target>charity</target> to help the poor and homeless.","translation":"許多富有的商人決定將其財富的一部分捐給慈善機構，以幫助貧困者和無家可歸者。","explanation":"名詞「慈善」。指幫助需要幫助的人的行為或概念。"},{"sentence":"The school organized a bake sale to raise money for a local <target>charity</target> that provides free meals to children in need.","translation":"學校組織了一次烘焙義賣，為當地一家提供免費餐點給貧困兒童的慈善機構籌集資金。","explanation":"名詞「慈善機構」。指從事慈善工作的組織。"}],"related_forms":["charitable"]}

{"headword":"chemistry","explanation":"名詞，意為「化學」或「（人與人之間的）化學反應/契合度」。在 GSAT 中，除了學科名稱外，常在描述人際關係時使用，指兩人之間自然的吸引力或默契。","entries":[{"sentence":"In our high school <target>chemistry</target> class, we learned how to combine different elements to create chemical reactions and observe the results.","translation":"在我們的高中化學課上，我們學習了如何將不同的元素結合以產生化學反應並觀察其結果。","explanation":"名詞「化學」。指科學學科。"},{"sentence":"The two lead actors in the movie had great <target>chemistry</target>, making their romantic relationship on screen feel very natural and convincing.","translation":"電影中的兩位主角有很棒的化學反應，使他們在螢幕上的浪漫關係感覺非常自然且具有說服力。","explanation":"名詞「契合度/默契」。指人與人之間自然的吸引力。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"cherish","explanation":"動詞，意為「珍愛」或「心中珍藏（想法、回憶）」。常用搭配 cherish the memory of (珍藏...的回憶) 或 cherish a dream (懷抱夢想)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Even after many years, she still <target>cherishes</target> the <pattern>memory of</pattern> her first trip to Paris with her grandfather when she was ten.","translation":"即使過了許多年，她仍然珍藏著十歲時與祖父第一次去巴黎旅行的回憶。","explanation":"動詞「珍藏」。指對回憶或情感的深深眷戀。"},{"sentence":"The young musician <target>cherishes</target> <pattern>the dream of</pattern> performing at the world's most famous opera house one day in the future.","translation":"這位年輕的音樂家懷抱著有一天能在未來世界最著名的歌劇院表演的夢想。","explanation":"動詞「懷抱」。指長期且深切地持有某個願望或想法。"},{"sentence":"Parents often <target>cherish</target> <pattern>every moment</pattern> with their children, knowing that they will grow up and leave home very quickly.","translation":"父母經常珍愛與孩子在一起的每個時刻，因為知道他們很快就會長大並離開家。","explanation":"動詞「珍愛」。指對某人或某物的深厚情感。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"chew","explanation":"可作動詞（咀嚼）或名詞（咀嚼）。動詞片語 chew over (仔細考慮)。注意其過去式與過去分詞為 chewed。","entries":[{"sentence":"Dentists always remind students to <target>chew</target> their food <pattern>slowly</pattern> and thoroughly to help with digestion and avoid choking.","translation":"牙醫總是提醒學生慢慢且徹底地咀嚼食物，以幫助消化並避免噎到。","explanation":"動詞「咀嚼」。指用牙齒將食物磨碎的動作。"},{"sentence":"The puppy liked to <target>chew</target> <pattern>on</pattern> his old shoes, which made his owner very angry but the dog seemed happy.","translation":"小狗喜歡啃他的舊鞋子，這讓主人很生氣，但小狗看起來很開心。","explanation":"動詞「啃/咀嚼」。chew on sth 指持續地咬或啃某物。"},{"sentence":"The manager asked for more time to <target>chew</target> <pattern>over</pattern> the proposal before making a final decision about the project budget.","translation":"經理要求更多時間仔細考慮這項提議，在對專案預算做出最終決定之前。","explanation":"動詞片語 chew over 意為「仔細考慮」。"}],"related_forms":["chewing"]}

{"headword":"choke","explanation":"可作動詞（噎住、使窒息、哽咽）或名詞（窒息）。常用片語 choke up (因情緒激動而哽咽)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The lifeguard quickly used the Heimlich maneuver to help the boy who began to <target>choke</target> <pattern>on</pattern> a piece of candy.","translation":"救生員迅速使用海姆立克法來幫助那個開始被一顆糖果噎住的男孩。","explanation":"動詞「噎住」。常用搭配 choke on sth。"},{"sentence":"The city's streets were <target>choked</target> <pattern>with</pattern> heavy traffic during the rush hour, making it impossible for cars to move forward.","translation":"在尖峰時段，城市的街道被沉重的交通流量堵塞，使得車輛無法前進。","explanation":"動詞「堵塞」。choke with sth 指被某物填滿而無法通過。"},{"sentence":"The student <target>choked</target> <pattern>up</pattern> with emotion as he gave his graduation speech, struggling to finish his last few sentences.","translation":"學生在發表畢業演講時因情緒激動而哽咽，很難完成最後幾句話。","explanation":"動詞片語 choke up 意為「（因情緒）哽咽」。"}],"related_forms":["choking"]}

{"headword":"chorus","explanation":"名詞，意為「合唱團」或「（歌曲的）副歌」。在音樂語境中，副歌是重複出現的部分。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school <target>chorus</target> practiced every afternoon for the annual winter concert, hoping to perform a beautiful harmony for the parents.","translation":"學校合唱團每天下午練習，為了年度冬季音樂會，希望為家長們表演一段美妙的和聲。","explanation":"名詞「合唱團」。指一群人共同歌唱的組織。"},{"sentence":"Everyone in the room began to sing along when the song reached the <target>chorus</target>, as it was the most catchy part.","translation":"當歌曲進入副歌時，房間裡的每個人都開始跟著唱，因為那是最朗朗上口的部分。","explanation":"名詞「副歌」。指歌曲中重複且最核心的部分。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"circular","explanation":"形容詞，意為「圓形的」或「循環的」。名詞時可指「通告/傳單」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students used a compass to draw a perfect <target>circular</target> shape on their geometry paper for the math exam.","translation":"學生們使用圓規在他們的幾何試卷上畫出一個完美的圓形，以準備數學考試。","explanation":"形容詞「圓形的」。指形狀像圓圈的。"},{"sentence":"The company sent out a <target>circular</target> to all employees to inform them about the new office rules and working hours.","translation":"公司發出了一份通告給所有員工，以告知他們關於新辦公室規定和工作時間的消息。","explanation":"名詞「通告/傳單」。指發給許多人的正式通知。"},{"sentence":"The water in the pond moves in a <target>circular</target> <pattern>motion</pattern>, creating small whirlpools near the edges of the lake.","translation":"池塘裡的水以圓周運動方式移動，在湖邊創造出小漩渦。","explanation":"形容詞「圓形的/循環的」。circular motion 指圓周運動。"}],"related_forms":["circularly","circle"]}

{"headword":"circulate","explanation":"動詞，意為「循環」或「流傳/散佈」。常用搭配 circulate information (散佈資訊) 或 blood circulates (血液循環)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The heart pumps blood to ensure that oxygen <target>circulates</target> <pattern>throughout</pattern> the entire body, keeping our organs healthy.","translation":"心臟泵血以確保氧氣在整個身體中循環，保持我們的器官健康。","explanation":"動詞「循環」。指液體或氣體在系統中持續移動。"},{"sentence":"A false rumor began to <target>circulate</target> <pattern>through</pattern> the school, causing many students to feel anxious about the upcoming exam dates.","translation":"一個錯誤的謠言開始在學校流傳，導致許多學生對即將到來的考試日期感到焦慮。","explanation":"動詞「流傳」。指資訊、消息在人群中散佈。"},{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to <target>circulate</target> the worksheet <pattern>around</pattern> the classroom so that everyone could read the answers.","translation":"老師要求學生將工作單在教室內傳閱，以便每個人都能閱讀答案。","explanation":"動詞「傳閱」。指將某物從一個人傳到另一個人。"}],"related_forms":["circulation","circulatory"]}

{"headword":"circulation","explanation":"名詞，主要有三種考點：1. 報刊雜誌的「發行量/流通量」；2. 血液或空氣的「循環」；3. 圖書館書籍的「借閱」。常用搭配：in circulation (流通中), wide circulation (廣泛發行)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The local newspaper has a <pattern>wide</pattern> <target>circulation</target> throughout the city, making it a primary source of news for most residents.","translation":"這份地方報紙在全市有廣泛的發行量，使其成為大多數居民的主要新聞來源。","explanation":"名詞「發行量」。"},{"sentence":"Regular exercise, such as walking or jogging, helps to improve blood <target>circulation</target> and maintain a healthy heart.","translation":"規律的運動，如散步或慢跑，有助於改善血液循環並維持心臟健康。","explanation":"名詞「循環」。"},{"sentence":"The library has a <target>circulation</target> <pattern>desk</pattern> where students can borrow books or return them after they have finished reading.","translation":"圖書館有一個借閱櫃檯，學生可以在那裡借書，或在閱讀完畢後還書。","explanation":"名詞「借閱」。circulation desk 指的是圖書館的借還書櫃檯。"},{"sentence":"Because the rare book is <pattern>in</pattern> <target>circulation</target>, it is currently available for students to borrow from the university library.","translation":"由於這本稀有書籍目前在流通中，學生現在可以從大學圖書館借閱。","explanation":"名詞「流通」。in circulation 表示該物品目前可供使用或流通。"}],"related_forms":["circulate"]}

{"headword":"circumstance","explanation":"名詞「情況，環境」。通常以複數形式 circumstances 出現，指影響事件發展的具體條件。常用片語 under the circumstances (在這種情況下), in circumstances (在...情況下)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Due to unexpected <target>circumstances</target>, the school decided to postpone the graduation ceremony until the following month.","translation":"由於不可預見的情況，學校決定將畢業典禮延期至下個月。","explanation":"名詞「情況」。常用搭配：unexpected circumstances (不可預見的情況)。"},{"sentence":"Under the <target>circumstances</target>, it was impossible for the team to finish the project on time, so they asked for an extension.","translation":"在這種情況下，團隊不可能按時完成項目，因此他們請求延長期限。","explanation":"名詞「情況」。片語 under the circumstances 表示在目前特定的條件下。"},{"sentence":"The witness was asked to describe the <target>circumstances</target> <pattern>surrounding</pattern> the accident to help the police identify what happened.","translation":"證人被要求描述事故發生時的周圍情況，以幫助警方查明發生了什麼。","explanation":"名詞「情況」。surrounding circumstances 指的是事件發生時的環境或背景。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"civilian","explanation":"可作形容詞或名詞，指「平民的」或「平民」。核心在於區分於軍隊 (military) 或警察 (police)。常用搭配：civilian casualties (平民傷亡), civilian clothes (便服)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government promised to protect <target>civilians</target> during the conflict to minimize the loss of innocent lives.","translation":"政府承諾在衝突期間保護平民，以最大限度地減少無辜生命的損失。","explanation":"名詞「平民」。"},{"sentence":"The officer was wearing <target>civilian</target> <pattern>clothes</pattern> so that he could blend in with the crowd and observe the suspects unnoticed.","translation":"該警官穿著便服，以便能融入人群並在不被發現的情況下觀察嫌疑人。","explanation":"形容詞「平民的」。civilian clothes 指的是非制服的便服。"},{"sentence":"After retiring from the army, he found it difficult to adjust to <target>civilian</target> <pattern>life</pattern> and find a new career path.","translation":"退伍後，他發現很難適應平民生活並找到新的職業路徑。","explanation":"形容詞「平民的」。civilian life 與 military life 相對。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"civilization","explanation":"名詞「文明」。指人類社會在文化、技術和政治上的高度發展狀態。常與 ancient (古代的) 或 modern (現代的) 搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"Students in the history class learned about the <pattern>ancient</pattern> <target>civilization</target> of Egypt and its impressive pyramids.","translation":"歷史課的學生們學習了古埃及文明及其令人印象深刻的金字塔。","explanation":"名詞「文明」。常用搭配：ancient civilization (古代文明)。"},{"sentence":"The discovery of fire and agriculture played a crucial role in the development of early human <target>civilization</target> thousands of years ago.","translation":"火和農業的發現在數千年前早期人類文明的發展中起到了至關重要的作用。","explanation":"名詞「文明」。指人類社會的演進過程。"},{"sentence":"The museum exhibits various artifacts that show how <pattern>modern</pattern> <target>civilization</target> has evolved through technological advancements in communication.","translation":"博物館展出各種文物，展示了現代文明如何透過通訊技術的進步而演進。","explanation":"名詞「文明」。常用搭配：modern civilization (現代文明)。"}],"related_forms":["civilize","civilized"]}

{"headword":"clarify","explanation":"動詞「澄清，闡明」。用於使某事變得清晰易懂，常接 that 子句或名詞。常用搭配：clarify the situation (澄清情況), clarify a point (闡明一點)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher asked the student to <target>clarify</target> his answer because the original explanation was too brief and confusing.","translation":"老師要求學生澄清他的答案，因為原本的解釋太簡短且令人困惑。","explanation":"動詞「澄清/闡明」。指使意思更明確。"},{"sentence":"To avoid any misunderstandings, the manager decided to <target>clarify</target> the <pattern>new rules</pattern> during the staff meeting on Monday.","translation":"為了避免任何誤會，經理決定在週一的員工會議上闡明新規定。","explanation":"動詞「闡明」。常用搭配：clarify the rules/points。"},{"sentence":"Could you please <target>clarify</target> <pattern>whether</pattern> the deadline for the essay is this Friday or next Monday?","translation":"您能否請您澄清一下，論文的截止日期是本週五還是下週一？","explanation":"動詞「澄清」。後接 whether 引導的間接問句。"}],"related_forms":["clarification","clear"]}

{"headword":"clash","explanation":"名詞或動詞。指「衝突」或「不協調」。可用於意見的分歧 (conflict of opinions)、時間的重疊 (clash of schedules) 或色彩/風格的不匹配。常用搭配：clash with (與...衝突)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two political leaders had a serious <target>clash</target> over the new tax policy, leading to a long and heated debate.","translation":"兩位政治領袖在新稅收政策上發生了嚴重衝突，導致了一場漫長且激烈的辯論。","explanation":"名詞「衝突」。指觀念或意見上的劇烈分歧。"},{"sentence":"I cannot attend the basketball game because it <target>clashes</target> <pattern>with</pattern> my piano lesson on Saturday afternoon.","translation":"我不能參加籃球賽，因為它與我週六下午的鋼琴課時間衝突。","explanation":"動詞「衝突/時間重疊」。常用搭配：clash with (something)。"},{"sentence":"Many fashion experts believe that the bright orange shirt <target>clashes</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the purple pants, creating an unpleasant look.","translation":"許多時尚專家認為，亮橘色襯衫與紫色長褲不協調，營造出不愉快的視覺效果。","explanation":"動詞「不協調」。指顏色或風格不匹配。"},{"sentence":"The police intervened to stop the <pattern>violent</pattern> <target>clash</target> between the two rival groups of supporters outside the stadium.","translation":"警方介入以阻止體育場外兩組對立支持者之間的暴力衝突。","explanation":"名詞「衝突」。常用形容詞：violent clash (暴力衝突)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"classification","explanation":"名詞「分類，分級」。指將事物按類別排列的過程或系統。常用搭配：classification system (分類系統), biological classification (生物分類)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The library uses a complex <target>classification</target> <pattern>system</pattern> to organize thousands of books so that users can find them easily.","translation":"圖書館使用一套複雜的分類系統來組織數千本書籍，以便使用者能輕鬆找到它們。","explanation":"名詞「分類」。常用搭配：classification system。"},{"sentence":"In biology class, students learned about the <target>classification</target> <pattern>of</pattern> animals into different groups based on their physical characteristics.","translation":"在生物課上，學生學習了根據身體特徵將動物分入不同組別的分類方法。","explanation":"名詞「分類」。常用搭配：classification of...。"},{"sentence":"The security <target>classification</target> <pattern>of</pattern> this document is 'Top Secret', meaning only a few high-ranking officials can read it.","translation":"這份文件的安全分級為「最高機密」，意味著只有少數高階官員可以閱讀。","explanation":"名詞「分級」。指機密程度的等級。"}],"related_forms":["classify"]}

{"headword":"classify","explanation":"動詞「將...分類」。指將人或物歸入特定類別。常用搭配：classify as (將...歸類為)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Scientists <target>classify</target> whales <pattern>as</pattern> mammals, even though they spend their entire lives living in the ocean.","translation":"科學家將鯨魚歸類為哺乳動物，儘管牠們一生都生活在海洋中。","explanation":"動詞「歸類」。常用搭配：classify ... as ...。"},{"sentence":"The company <target>classifies</target> its employees <pattern>into</pattern> three different levels based on their experience and job performance.","translation":"公司根據經驗和工作表現將員工分為三個不同的等級。","explanation":"動詞「分類」。常用搭配：classify into (groups/levels)。"},{"sentence":"Many librarians <target>classify</target> books by genre and author to make the shelving process more organized and efficient.","translation":"許多圖書管理員按類型和作者對書籍進行分類，使上架過程更有條理且高效。","explanation":"動詞「分類」。"}],"related_forms":["classification"]}

{"headword":"claw","explanation":"名詞「爪」；動詞「用爪抓」。注意其在描述動物行為時的用法，以及在比喻用法中表示「艱苦地攀爬/爭取」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The cat used its sharp <target>claws</target> to climb up the curtains, leaving several small holes in the fabric.","translation":"這隻貓用它鋒利的爪子爬上窗簾，在布料上留下了幾個小洞。","explanation":"名詞「爪」。"},{"sentence":"The eagle <target>clawed</target> the fish from the surface of the water and flew back to its nest in the mountains.","translation":"老鷹用爪子從水面抓起魚，飛回山上的巢穴。","explanation":"動詞「用爪抓」。"},{"sentence":"Despite the heavy rain and mud, the hikers <target>clawed</target> <pattern>their way up</pattern> the steep mountain slope to reach the summit.","translation":"儘管大雨泥濘，登山者仍艱苦地攀登陡峭的山坡以到達山頂。","explanation":"動詞「艱苦地前進/攀爬」。claw one's way up 是常見的比喻用法。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"cliff","explanation":"名詞「懸崖，峭壁」。常用於描述地理景觀。常用搭配：on the edge of a cliff (在懸崖邊緣), fall off a cliff (從懸崖掉落)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tourists stood <pattern>on the edge of</pattern> the <target>cliff</target>, admiring the breathtaking view of the blue ocean below.","translation":"遊客們站在懸崖邊緣，欣賞下方蔚藍大海的壯麗景色。","explanation":"名詞「懸崖」。常用搭配：on the edge of a cliff。"},{"sentence":"Because the path was narrow and dangerous, the guide warned the students not to get too close to the <target>cliff</target>.","translation":"由於路徑狹窄且危險，導遊警告學生不要太靠近懸崖。","explanation":"名詞「懸崖」。"},{"sentence":"The small village was built on a high <target>cliff</target> to protect the residents from enemy attacks during ancient times.","translation":"這個小村莊建在高懸崖上，以便在古代保護居民免受敵人攻擊。","explanation":"名詞「懸崖」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"clumsy","explanation":"形容詞「笨拙的、不靈活的」。常用於描述人的動作不協調，或指某物設計粗糙、不便使用。常考搭配：clumsy fingers (笨拙的手指), a clumsy mistake (笨拙的錯誤)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Because he was <target>clumsy</target>, the boy accidentally knocked over the vase while trying to clean the table in the living room.","translation":"因為這個男孩很笨拙，他在試圖清理客廳桌面時，不小心撞倒了花瓶。","explanation":"形容詞「笨拙的」。指動作不協調，容易造成意外。"},{"sentence":"The new software had a <target>clumsy</target> <pattern>interface</pattern>, making it difficult for new users to find the settings they needed.","translation":"這款新軟體有一個笨拙（不便）的介面，使得新使用者很難找到他們需要的設定。","explanation":"形容詞「笨拙的」。此處指設計不佳、不便使用。"},{"sentence":"She felt embarrassed after making a <target>clumsy</target> <pattern>mistake</pattern> during her first presentation in the English class.","translation":"她在英文課的第一次發表後，因為犯了一個笨拙的錯誤而感到尷尬。","explanation":"形容詞「笨拙的」。搭配 mistake 指犯了低級或不夠靈活的錯誤。"}],"related_forms":["clumsily","clumsiness"]}

{"headword":"coarse","explanation":"形容詞「粗糙的、粗劣的」。可用於描述物體的表面觸感，或指人的言行粗魯、缺乏教養。注意與 course (課程/方向) 讀音相同但意義不同。","entries":[{"sentence":"The workers used <target>coarse</target> <pattern>sandpaper</pattern> to smooth the rough surface of the old wooden door before painting it.","translation":"工人使用粗糙的砂紙來磨平舊木門的粗糙表面，然後再進行塗漆。","explanation":"形容詞「粗糙的」。指物理表面不平滑。"},{"sentence":"The teacher reminded the students that using <target>coarse</target> <pattern>language</pattern> is not acceptable in the classroom, regardless of the situation.","translation":"老師提醒學生，無論在什麼情況下，在教室裡使用粗魯的語言都是不可接受的。","explanation":"形容詞「粗魯的」。指言行缺乏教養。"},{"sentence":"The fabric of the old blanket was too <target>coarse</target> for the baby's sensitive skin, causing a slight rash.","translation":"這條舊毯子的布料對嬰兒敏感的皮膚來說太粗糙了，導致了輕微的紅疹。","explanation":"形容詞「粗糙的」。指材質不細膩。"}],"related_forms":["coarsely","coarseness"]}

{"headword":"code","explanation":"名詞「代碼、密碼、法典」。動詞「編碼」。在資訊科技中指程式碼，在法律中指成文法。常用片語：crack the code (破解密碼), a code of conduct (行為準則)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The computer science student spent the entire night writing <target>code</target> for his final project to create a simple mobile app.","translation":"這名電腦科學系學生花了一整晚為他的期末專案編寫代碼，以建立一個簡單的手機應用程式。","explanation":"名詞「代碼」。指電腦程式碼。"},{"sentence":"To ensure a safe environment, the school has a strict <target>code</target> <pattern>of</pattern> <pattern>conduct</pattern> that all students must follow.","translation":"為了確保安全的環境，學校有一套嚴格的行為準則，所有學生都必須遵守。","explanation":"名詞「準則」。片語 a code of conduct 表示行為準則。"},{"sentence":"The spy tried to <target>code</target> his secret message so that the enemy would not be able to understand its true meaning.","translation":"間諜試圖對他的秘密訊息進行編碼，以便敵人無法理解其真實含義。","explanation":"動詞「編碼」。將資訊轉換為密碼形式。"},{"sentence":"The team of experts worked for weeks to <target>crack</target> the secret <target>code</target> used by the ancient civilization in their inscriptions.","translation":"專家團隊花了好幾週時間才破解了古代文明在銘文中使用過的秘密密碼。","explanation":"名詞「密碼」。片語 crack the code 表示破解密碼。"}],"related_forms":["coding","coder"]}

{"headword":"collapse","explanation":"動詞「崩塌、倒塌、昏倒」。名詞「崩潰、倒塌」。注意其在身體健康（昏倒）與物理結構（倒塌）及心理/經濟（崩潰）等不同語境下的用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"The old building <target>collapsed</target> during the powerful earthquake, leaving many people trapped under the heavy concrete ruins.","translation":"這棟舊建築在強震中倒塌，導致許多人被困在沉重的混凝土廢墟之下。","explanation":"動詞「倒塌」。指物理結構的損毀。"},{"sentence":"Due to the extreme heat and lack of water, the marathon runner <target>collapsed</target> just a few meters before the finish line.","translation":"由於極端高溫和缺水，這名馬拉松跑者在距離終點線僅幾公尺處昏倒了。","explanation":"動詞「昏倒」。指因身體不適而突然失去意識。"},{"sentence":"The sudden increase in oil prices caused the local economy to <target>collapse</target>, leading to widespread unemployment in the small town.","translation":"油價的突然上漲導致當地經濟崩潰，使得這個小鎮出現了廣泛的失業現象。","explanation":"動詞「崩潰」。指系統或經濟體系的失效。"},{"sentence":"The peace talks <target>collapsed</target> after both sides failed to reach an agreement on the border dispute between the two countries.","translation":"在雙方未能就兩國邊境爭議達成協議後，和平談判崩潰（失敗）了。","explanation":"動詞「崩潰」。指計畫或談判的失敗。"},{"sentence":"The sudden <target>collapse</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the bridge was a shock to everyone, prompting the government to inspect all other bridges in the city.","translation":"橋樑的突然倒塌令每個人都感到震驚，促使政府檢查市內所有其他橋樑。","explanation":"名詞「倒塌」。指物理結構的損毀。"}],"related_forms":["collapsible"]}

{"headword":"colleague","explanation":"名詞「同事」。指與同一機構或專業領域工作的人。注意與 coworker 的區別：colleague 通常更正式，且可用於學術或醫療專業領域。","entries":[{"sentence":"Ms. Lee is a highly respected <target>colleague</target> who always shares her knowledge and helps new employees adapt to the office environment.","translation":"李小姐是一位深受尊敬的同事，她總是分享她的知識並幫助新員工適應辦公室環境。","explanation":"名詞「同事」。指同一公司工作的人。"},{"sentence":"The professor discussed his latest research findings with a <target>colleague</target> <pattern>from</pattern> another university during the international conference.","translation":"教授在國際會議期間與另一所大學的同事（同行）討論了他的最新研究發現。","explanation":"名詞「同事」。此處指同一專業領域的同行。"}],"related_forms":["colleagues"]}

{"headword":"combination","explanation":"名詞「結合、組合」。指兩個或多個事物結合在一起。常用搭配：a combination of (...的結合), in combination with (與...結合)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The success of the movie was a <target>combination</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a great script, talented actors, and an experienced director.","translation":"這部電影的成功是出色劇本、才華橫溢的演員和經驗豐富的導演共同結合的結果。","explanation":"名詞「結合」。片語 a combination of... 表示...的結合。"},{"sentence":"The athlete's training program is a <target>combination</target> <pattern>of</pattern> strength exercises and flexibility training to improve overall performance.","translation":"這名運動員的訓練計畫是力量訓練和靈活性訓練的結合，以提高整體表現。","explanation":"名詞「組合」。指不同元素的結合。"},{"sentence":"To unlock the safe, you must enter the correct <target>combination</target> of numbers in the specific order required by the lock.","translation":"要打開保險箱，你必須按照鎖具要求的特定順序輸入正確的數字組合。","explanation":"名詞「組合」。指開啟密碼鎖所需的數字序列。"}],"related_forms":["combine","combined"]}

{"headword":"comedy","explanation":"名詞「喜劇」。指以幽默、有趣的方式呈現，並通常以快樂結局結尾的戲劇或電影。相對詞為 tragedy (悲劇)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After a stressful week of exams, the students decided to watch a romantic <target>comedy</target> to relax and lift their spirits.","translation":"經過壓力巨大的考試週後，學生們決定看一部浪漫喜劇來放鬆並振奮精神。","explanation":"名詞「喜劇」。指幽默且結局快樂的電影類型。"},{"sentence":"The play was a brilliant <target>comedy</target> that used satire to criticize the social norms of the eighteenth century.","translation":"這齣戲是一部出色的喜劇，利用諷刺來批評十八世紀的社會規範。","explanation":"名詞「喜劇」。此處指具有諷刺意味的戲劇。"}],"related_forms":["comedic","comedian"]}

{"headword":"commander","explanation":"名詞「指揮官、司令」。指在軍隊或緊急救援行動中負責指揮的人。常用搭配：commander-in-chief (總司令)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The army <target>commander</target> developed a strategic plan to capture the city, ensuring that his soldiers could move safely without being noticed.","translation":"軍隊指揮官制定了一項戰略計畫以奪取該城市，確保他的士兵能安全移動而不被發現。","explanation":"名詞「指揮官」。指軍事行動的領導者。"},{"sentence":"The president serves as the <target>commander</target>-<pattern>in-chief</pattern> of the armed forces, making the final decisions on national security matters.","translation":"總統擔任武裝部隊的總司令，對國家安全事務做出最終決定。","explanation":"名詞「總司令」。片語 commander-in-chief 指軍隊最高領導者。"}],"related_forms":["command"]}

{"headword":"comment","explanation":"名詞「評論、意見」。動詞「評論」。注意其搭配介系詞 on (對...發表評論)。常用片語：no comment (不予評論)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher wrote a helpful <target>comment</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the student's essay, providing suggestions on how to improve the grammar and structure.","translation":"老師在學生的文章中寫下了一條有幫助的評論，針對如何改進語法和結構提供了建議。","explanation":"名詞「評論」。搭配介系詞 on 表示對某事發表評論。"},{"sentence":"When the reporter asked the celebrity about the scandal, the actor simply replied, \"<target>No</target> <target>comment</target>,\" and walked away.","translation":"當記者詢問這位名人關於醜聞的事時，這位演員簡單地回答：「不予評論」，然後走開了。","explanation":"名詞「評論」。片語 no comment 是常見的拒絕回答方式。"},{"sentence":"The social media platform allows users to <target>comment</target> <pattern>on</pattern> a post, enabling them to share their opinions and engage in discussions.","translation":"這個社交媒體平台允許使用者對貼文發表評論，以便他們分享意見並參與討論。","explanation":"動詞「評論」。搭配介系詞 on 表示針對某事發表看法。"},{"sentence":"She didn't want to <target>comment</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the decision, as she felt it was not her place to judge others' choices.","translation":"她不想對這個決定發表評論，因為她覺得自己沒有資格評判他人地選擇。","explanation":"動詞「評論」。"}],"related_forms":["commentary","commentator"]}

{"headword":"commerce","explanation":"名詞「商業、貿易」。指大規模的買賣活動，通常指國際貿易或電子商務。常用搭配：e-commerce (電子商務), chamber of commerce (商會)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The development of high-speed internet has led to a huge increase in e-<target>commerce</target>, changing the way people shop for clothes and electronics.","translation":"高速網路的發展導致電子商務的巨幅增加，改變了人們購買衣服和電子產品的方式。","explanation":"名詞「商業」。e-commerce 指電子商務。"},{"sentence":"The local <pattern>chamber</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> <target>commerce</target> works to support small businesses and promote economic growth within the city.","translation":"當地商會致力於支持小企業並促進市內的經濟成長。","explanation":"名詞「商業」。片語 chamber of commerce 指商會。"},{"sentence":"In the past, the Silk Road was a vital route for international <target>commerce</target>, connecting the East and the West through the exchange of goods.","translation":"在過去，絲路是國際貿易的 vital route (重要路線)，將東西方透過貨物交換連接起來。","explanation":"名詞「商業」。指大規模的貿易活動。"}],"related_forms":["commercial"]}

{"headword":"commit","explanation":"動詞，意為「承諾」或「犯（錯/罪）」。常用搭配：commit to V/doing sth (承諾做某事), commit a crime/mistake (犯罪/犯錯)。注意 commit oneself to sth (致力於某事) 的用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"After months of planning, the city council decided to <target>commit</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the new environmental project to reduce urban pollution.","translation":"經過數月的計畫，市議會決定致力於新的環境計畫以減少城市污染。","explanation":"動詞「承諾/致力於」。常用搭配 commit to sth。"},{"sentence":"The police are investigating the man who is suspected of having <target>committed</target> a serious <pattern>crime</pattern> in the downtown area.","translation":"警方正在調查一名涉嫌在市中心地區犯下嚴重罪行的男子。","explanation":"動詞「犯（罪）」。常用搭配 commit a crime。"},{"sentence":"It is common for students to <target>commit</target> a few <pattern>mistakes</pattern> when they are learning a new language, but practicing regularly is key.","translation":"學生在學習新語言時犯一些錯誤是很常見的，但定期練習才是關鍵。","explanation":"動詞「犯（錯）」。常用搭配 commit a mistake。"},{"sentence":"She <target>committed</target> <pattern>herself</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> volunteering at the local animal shelter every weekend to help homeless pets find new homes.","translation":"她致力於每個週末在當地動物收容所擔任志工，幫助無家可歸的寵物找到新家。","explanation":"動詞片語 commit oneself to sth 表示「致力於某事」。"}],"related_forms":["commitment","committed"]}

{"headword":"communication","explanation":"名詞，意為「溝通」或「通訊」。常用搭配：lack of communication (缺乏溝通), effective communication (有效溝通), communication skills (溝通技巧)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Effective <target>communication</target> <pattern>skills</pattern> are essential for students who want to work in teams and collaborate on complex school projects.","translation":"對於想要團隊合作並共同完成複雜學校計畫的學生來說，有效的溝通技巧至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「溝通」。常用搭配 communication skills。"},{"sentence":"The argument between the two friends was caused by a complete <pattern>lack</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> <target>communication</target>, leading to a long misunderstanding.","translation":"這兩個朋友之間的爭吵是由於完全缺乏溝通而引起的，導致了長期的誤解。","explanation":"名詞「溝通」。常用搭配 lack of communication。"},{"sentence":"Modern technology has revolutionized the way we handle <target>communication</target>, allowing people to stay connected regardless of the distance between them.","translation":"現代科技徹底改變了我們處理通訊的方式，使人們無論距離多遠都能保持聯繫。","explanation":"名詞「通訊」。指透過科技設備傳遞資訊。"},{"sentence":"The teacher encouraged the students to maintain open <target>communication</target> <pattern>with</pattern> their parents about their academic struggles and goals.","translation":"老師鼓勵學生與父母就學業困難和目標保持開誠布公的溝通。","explanation":"名詞「溝通」。常用搭配 communication with sb。"}],"related_forms":["communicate"]}

{"headword":"community","explanation":"名詞，意為「社區」或「共同體」。常用搭配：local community (當地社區), a sense of community (社區意識/歸屬感), the international community (國際社會)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The local <target>community</target> <pattern>organized</pattern> a food drive to collect supplies for families who were affected by the recent earthquake.","translation":"當地社區組織了一次食物募捐活動，為近期受地震影響的家庭收集物資。","explanation":"名詞「社區」。指居住在同一地區的人們。"},{"sentence":"Participating in school clubs can help students develop a strong <pattern>sense</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> <target>community</target> and build lasting friendships with their peers.","translation":"參加學校社團可以幫助學生培養強烈的社區意識，並與同儕建立持久的友誼。","explanation":"名詞「社區意識」。片語 a sense of community 表示「歸屬感」。"},{"sentence":"The <target>community</target> <pattern>of</pattern> scientists worldwide is working together to find a more effective cure for the rare disease.","translation":"全球的科學家群體正共同努力尋找治療這種罕見疾病更有效的方法。","explanation":"名詞「共同體」。指具有共同興趣或專業的人群。"},{"sentence":"Many immigrants struggle to integrate into the new <target>community</target> because of the language barrier and different cultural traditions.","translation":"許多移民因為語言障礙和不同的文化傳統而難以融入新的社區。","explanation":"名詞「社區」。"}],"related_forms":["communal"]}

{"headword":"companion","explanation":"名詞，意為「同伴」或「伴侶」。常用搭配：constant companion (形影不離的同伴), a loyal companion (忠誠的同伴)。","entries":[{"sentence":"For many people, a dog is more than just a pet; it is a loyal <target>companion</target> that provides comfort and love.","translation":"對許多人來說，狗不僅僅是寵物；它是一個忠誠的同伴，提供安慰和愛。","explanation":"名詞「同伴」。常用搭配 a loyal companion。"},{"sentence":"During his journey across the mountains, his only <target>companion</target> was a small notebook where he recorded every detail of his adventure.","translation":"在他穿越山脈的旅程中，他唯一的同伴是一本小筆記本，他記錄了冒險的每一個細節。","explanation":"名詞「同伴」。在此指替代人類的隨身物品。"},{"sentence":"She found a great <target>companion</target> <pattern>for</pattern> travel in her best friend, as they both enjoyed exploring new cities and trying local foods.","translation":"她在好友身上發現了一個絕佳的旅行同伴，因為他們都喜歡探索新城市和嘗試當地美食。","explanation":"名詞「同伴」。常用搭配 companion for sth。"}],"related_forms":["companionship"]}

{"headword":"competition","explanation":"名詞，意為「競爭」或「競賽」。常用搭配：stiff competition (激烈競爭), win/enter a competition (贏得/參加競賽), in competition with (與...競爭)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two tech companies are <pattern>in</pattern> <target>competition</target> <pattern>with</pattern> each other to develop the most advanced smartphone for the global market.","translation":"這兩家科技公司正彼此競爭，以開發出最先進的智慧型手機供應全球市場。","explanation":"名詞「競爭」。常用搭配 in competition with sb/sth。"},{"sentence":"Due to the <pattern>stiff</pattern> <target>competition</target> for university admission, students often spend their entire weekend studying in the library.","translation":"由於大學入學的激烈競爭，學生經常整個週末都在圖書館讀書。","explanation":"名詞「競爭」。常用搭配 stiff competition (激烈競爭)。"},{"sentence":"She was thrilled to <pattern>win</pattern> the national <target>competition</target> <pattern>for</pattern> photography, receiving a gold medal and a scholarship.","translation":"她很高興贏得全國攝影競賽，獲得了金牌和獎學金。","explanation":"名詞「競賽」。常用搭配 win a competition。"},{"sentence":"The school decided to <pattern>enter</pattern> a <target>competition</target> <pattern>for</pattern> sustainable architecture to encourage students to think about green building designs.","translation":"學校決定參加一項關於永續建築的競賽，以鼓勵學生思考綠色建築設計。","explanation":"名詞「競賽」。常用搭配 enter a competition。"}],"related_forms":["compete","competitive","competitor"]}

{"headword":"competitive","explanation":"形容詞，意為「競爭的」或「有競爭力的」。常用搭配：competitive price (競爭力的價格/便宜的價格), competitive advantage (競爭優勢), highly competitive (高度競爭的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"To attract more customers, the new bookstore offered <target>competitive</target> <pattern>prices</pattern> that were lower than those of the larger chains.","translation":"為了吸引更多顧客，這家新書店提供了比大型連鎖店更低的競爭力價格。","explanation":"形容詞「競爭力的/便宜的」。常用搭配 competitive prices。"},{"sentence":"The company's focus on research and development gave them a significant <target>competitive</target> <pattern>advantage</pattern> over their rivals.","translation":"公司對研究與開發的關注使其在面對對手時具有顯著的競爭優勢。","explanation":"形容詞「競爭力的」。常用搭配 competitive advantage (競爭優勢)。"},{"sentence":"Applying for a prestigious internship is <pattern>highly</pattern> <target>competitive</target>, as hundreds of students apply for only a few positions.","translation":"申請一個享有盛譽的實習機會是高度競爭的，因為數百名學生僅申請幾個職位。","explanation":"形容詞「競爭的」。常用搭配 highly competitive。"}],"related_forms":["compete","competition","competitor"]}

{"headword":"competitor","explanation":"名詞，意為「競爭者」。常用搭配：fierce competitor (兇猛的競爭者), a tough competitor (強勁的對手)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The athlete trained hard every day to ensure he could outperform his <target>competitors</target> in the upcoming Olympic Games.","translation":"這名運動員每天刻苦訓練，以確保他在即將到來的奧運會上能超越他的競爭者。","explanation":"名詞「競爭者」。指在比賽或市場中競爭的人或公司。"},{"sentence":"The local bakery became a fierce <target>competitor</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the supermarket, as more people preferred the fresh, homemade bread.","translation":"由於更多人喜歡新鮮的自家製麵包，當地麵包店變成了超市的強勁競爭對手。","explanation":"名詞「競爭者」。常用搭配 competitor to sth。"},{"sentence":"Despite being the youngest <target>competitor</target> in the chess tournament, she managed to defeat the world champion.","translation":"儘管她是西洋棋錦標賽中 youngest 的競爭者，她仍成功擊敗了世界冠軍。","explanation":"名詞「競爭者」。"}],"related_forms":["compete","competition","competitive"]}

{"headword":"complicate","explanation":"動詞，意為「使複雜化」。常用搭配：complicate the issue (使問題複雜化), further complicate (進一步使複雜化)。注意其形容詞形式 complicated (複雜的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Adding too many unnecessary rules will only <target>complicate</target> the <pattern>issue</pattern>, making it harder for students to follow the guidelines.","translation":"增加太多不必要的規則只會使問題複雜化，讓學生更難遵循準則。","explanation":"動詞「使複雜化」。常用搭配 complicate the issue。"},{"sentence":"The sudden change in weather <target>complicated</target> the <pattern>rescue</pattern> <pattern>efforts</pattern>, as the heavy rain made the roads impassable.","translation":"天氣的突然變化使救援行動複雜化，因為暴雨使道路無法通行。","explanation":"動詞「使複雜化」。指使情況變得困難或複雜。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer argued that the new evidence would <target>complicate</target> the <pattern>legal</pattern> <pattern>process</pattern> and delay the final verdict of the case.","translation":"律師辯稱新證據將使法律程序複雜化，並延遲此案的最終判決。","explanation":"動詞「使複雜化」。"}],"related_forms":["complicated","complication"]}

{"headword":"compose","explanation":"動詞，意為「組成/構成」或「作曲/寫作」。常用搭配：be composed of (由...組成), compose a letter/poem (寫信/詩), compose oneself (使冷靜)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The jury <target>is</target> <pattern>composed</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> twelve citizens who must carefully evaluate the evidence before reaching a decision.","translation":"陪審團由十二名公民組成，他們必須在做出決定前仔細評估證據。","explanation":"動詞「組成」。常用被動語態 be composed of (由...組成)。"},{"sentence":"The talented student decided to <target>compose</target> a <pattern>piece</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> music for the graduation ceremony to express his gratitude to his teachers.","translation":"這名才華橫溢的學生決定為畢業典禮作曲，以表達對老師的感激之情。","explanation":"動詞「作曲」。指創造音樂作品。"},{"sentence":"She took a deep breath to <target>compose</target> <pattern>herself</pattern> before stepping onto the stage to deliver her speech in front of the entire school.","translation":"她在踏上舞台在全校面前發表演講前，深呼吸以使自己冷靜下來。","explanation":"動詞片語 compose oneself 意為「使自己冷靜」。"}],"related_forms":["composition","composer"]}

{"headword":"composer","explanation":"名詞，意為「作曲家」。常用搭配：a famous composer (著名的作曲家), a classical composer (古典作曲家)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Beethoven is one of the most influential <target>composers</target> in history, known for his powerful symphonies that still inspire musicians today.","translation":"貝多芬是歷史上最具影響力的作曲家之一，以其強而有力的交響曲聞名，至今仍啟發著音樂家。","explanation":"名詞「作曲家」。"},{"sentence":"The music class teacher introduced the students to several classical <target>composers</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the Romantic era, explaining their different styles.","translation":"音樂課老師向學生介紹了幾位浪漫主義時期的古典作曲家，並解釋了他們不同的風格。","explanation":"名詞「作曲家」。常用搭配 composer from [period/region]。"},{"sentence":"The young <target>composer</target> spent months refining her latest symphony, hoping it would be recognized by the national orchestra.","translation":"這位年輕的作曲家花了好幾個月完善她的最新交響曲，希望它能被國家管弦樂團認可。","explanation":"名詞「作曲家」。"}],"related_forms":["compose","composition"]}

{"headword":"composition","explanation":"名詞「作文；組成；構圖」。在 GSAT 中，最常考的是「作文」或「組成成分」。注意其搭配：the composition of (...的組成)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to write a short <target>composition</target> about their summer vacation to practice their English writing skills.","translation":"老師要求學生寫一篇關於暑假的短文，以練習他們的英文寫作技巧。","explanation":"名詞「作文」。指在學校或考試中寫的文章。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are studying the chemical <target>composition</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the soil in the rainforest to understand how different plants grow.","translation":"科學家正在研究雨林土壤的化學組成，以了解不同植物是如何生長的。","explanation":"名詞「組成」。指物體由哪些成分構成。"},{"sentence":"The photographer carefully adjusted the <target>composition</target> of the shot, ensuring the mountain was perfectly centered in the frame.","translation":"攝影師小心地調整了照片的構圖，確保山脈完美地處於畫面中心。","explanation":"名詞「構圖」。指視覺藝術中元素的排列。"}],"related_forms":["compositions"]}

{"headword":"concentrate","explanation":"動詞「專注；集中」。最常用的搭配是 concentrate on (專注於...)。注意它與 focus on 的同義性。","entries":[{"sentence":"To get a high score on the exam, you need to <target>concentrate</target> <pattern>on</pattern> your studies and avoid distractions like social media.","translation":"為了在考試中獲得高分，你需要專注於學習並避免社交媒體等分心之事。","explanation":"動詞「專注」。常用片語 concentrate on sth。"},{"sentence":"The company decided to <target>concentrate</target> its resources <pattern>on</pattern> developing a new smartphone that is more energy-efficient than previous models.","translation":"公司決定將資源集中在開發一款比之前型號更節能的新款智慧型手機上。","explanation":"動詞「集中」。指將資源、力量或注意力集中在某處。"}],"related_forms":["concentrated","concentrating","concentration"]}

{"headword":"concentration","explanation":"名詞「專注力；濃度」。指心智的集中或化學物質在溶液中的比例。常考搭配：lack of concentration (缺乏專注力), high concentration of (高濃度的...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many students find that a <target>lack</target> <pattern>of</pattern> <target>concentration</target> often occurs when they are tired, making it hard to follow the lecture.","translation":"許多學生發現，當他們疲倦時，經常會缺乏專注力，導致很難跟上講座內容。","explanation":"名詞「專注力」。指將注意力集中在單一對象上的能力。"},{"sentence":"Environmentalists are concerned about the high <target>concentration</target> <pattern>of</pattern> pollutants in the river, which could harm the local fish population.","translation":"環保人士擔心河流中污染物的高濃度，這可能會對當地魚類種群造成危害。","explanation":"名詞「濃度」。指化學物質在特定空間或溶液中的含量。"}],"related_forms":["concentrated","concentrate"]}

{"headword":"concept","explanation":"名詞「概念；觀念」。指對某事物的抽象理解。常考搭配：grasp the concept (理解概念), basic concept (基本概念)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Before moving to advanced calculus, students must first <pattern>grasp</pattern> the basic <target>concept</target> of limits and continuity in mathematics.","translation":"在進入高等微積分之前，學生必須首先理解數學中極限和連續性的基本概念。","explanation":"名詞「概念」。指對某個理論或原則的初步理解。"},{"sentence":"The architect presented a new <target>concept</target> for the city park, focusing on creating a green space that integrates nature with urban life.","translation":"建築師為城市公園提出了一個新概念，重點在於創造一個將自然與都市生活結合的綠地空間。","explanation":"名詞「觀念/設計理念」。指一個新穎的想法或計畫。"}],"related_forms":["conceptual","conceptualization"]}

{"headword":"concerning","explanation":"介系詞「關於」。與 about 或 regarding 同義，但較正式。常在書信或正式文書中使用。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school principal sent an email <target>concerning</target> the upcoming changes to the graduation requirements, which caused some confusion among students.","translation":"校長發了一封關於即將變動的畢業要求的電子郵件，這在學生中引起了一些困惑。","explanation":"介系詞「關於」。相當於 about。"},{"sentence":"If you have any further questions <target>concerning</target> your application process, please contact the admissions office during office hours.","translation":"如果您對申請流程有任何進一步的問題，請在辦公時間內聯繫招生辦公室。","explanation":"介系詞「關於」。用於正式詢問或說明。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"concrete","explanation":"形容詞「具體的」；名詞「混凝土」。形容詞時，與 abstract (抽象的) 相對。常考搭配：concrete example (具體例子)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Instead of talking about general ideas, the teacher asked the student to provide a <target>concrete</target> <pattern>example</pattern> to support his argument.","translation":"老師要求學生不要只談論一般性的想法，而要提供一個具體的例子來支持他的論點。","explanation":"形容詞「具體的」。指可以用實例或實物證明的事物。"},{"sentence":"The construction workers poured liquid <target>concrete</target> into the wooden frames to build a strong foundation for the new library building.","translation":"建築工人將液體混凝土倒入木框架中，以為新圖書館大樓建立強固的基礎。","explanation":"名詞「混凝土」。指一種用於建築的建築材料。"}],"related_forms":["concretely","concretization"]}
