{"headword":"conductor","explanation":"名詞「指揮家；導體；列車長」。在 GSAT 中，最常見的是「指揮家」或科學課的「導體」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The orchestra performed beautifully under the guidance of the famous <target>conductor</target>, who was known for his precise movements and passion.","translation":"在著名指揮家的指導下，管弦樂團表現出色，該指揮家以其精確的動作和熱情而聞名。","explanation":"名詞「指揮家」。指領導管弦樂團的人。"},{"sentence":"In science class, we learned that copper is an excellent <target>conductor</target> <pattern>of</pattern> electricity, while rubber is an insulator.","translation":"在科學課上，我們了解到銅是電力的優良導體，而橡膠則是絕緣體。","explanation":"名詞「導體」。指允許電或熱量通過的物質。"},{"sentence":"The train <target>conductor</target> walked through the carriage, checking the tickets of all the passengers before the train left the station.","translation":"列車長走過車廂，在火車離開車站前檢查所有乘客的車票。","explanation":"名詞「列車長」。指負責管理火車車廂內秩序的人。"}],"related_forms":["conduction"]}

{"headword":"conference","explanation":"名詞「會議」。指正式的討論會或大型討論會。常用搭配：attend a conference (參加會議), hold a conference (舉行會議)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many professors from different universities <pattern>attended</pattern> the international <target>conference</target> to share their latest research findings on climate change.","translation":"許多來自不同大學的教授參加了這次國際會議，以分享他們關於氣候變遷的最新研究結果。","explanation":"名詞「會議」。指正式的討論會。"},{"sentence":"The student council <pattern>held</pattern> a press <target>conference</target> to announce the new rules regarding the use of the school cafeteria.","translation":"學生會舉行了一場新聞發佈會，以宣布關於學校餐廳使用的新規定。","explanation":"名詞「會議」。在此處指新聞發佈會 (press conference)。"}],"related_forms":["conferences"]}

{"headword":"confess","explanation":"動詞「承認；坦承」。常用搭配：confess to (承認做某事)。注意與 admit (承認) 的同義性，但 confess 較常指承認錯誤或罪行。","entries":[{"sentence":"After hours of questioning, the suspect finally <target>confessed</target> <pattern>to</pattern> stealing the expensive jewelry from the museum gallery.","translation":"經過數小時的詢問，嫌疑犯終於承認偷了博物館展廳裡的昂貴珠寶。","explanation":"動詞「承認」。常用片語 confess to V-ing/N。"},{"sentence":"I must <target>confess</target> that I have never read the book the teacher recommended, even though I said I had.","translation":"我必須坦承，儘管我說我讀過，但我從未讀過老師推薦的那本書。","explanation":"動詞「坦承」。指承認某件令人尷尬或隱藏的事實。"}],"related_forms":["confession"]}

{"headword":"confidence","explanation":"名詞「信心；信任」。常用搭配：have confidence in (對...有信心), gain/lose confidence (獲得/失去信心), in confidence (秘密地)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Practicing your speech in front of a mirror can help you <pattern>gain</pattern> more <target>confidence</target> before you present it to the class.","translation":"在鏡子前練習演講可以幫助你在向全班演示之前獲得更多信心。","explanation":"名詞「信心」。指對自己能力的信任。"},{"sentence":"The coach has full <target>confidence</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the team's ability to win the championship, despite the recent losses in the playoffs.","translation":"儘管最近在季後賽中失利，教練對球隊贏得冠軍的能力充滿信心。","explanation":"名詞「信任」。常用片語 have confidence in sth/sb。"},{"sentence":"She told me her secret <pattern>in</pattern> <target>confidence</target>, asking me not to share it with anyone else in the school.","translation":"她秘密地告訴了我她的秘密，要求我不要與學校裡的任何其他人分享。","explanation":"名詞「信任」。片語 in confidence 意為「秘密地」。"}],"related_forms":["confident","confidently"]}

{"headword":"confusion","explanation":"名詞「困惑、混亂」。常用搭配 include confusion about sth (對...感到困惑) 或 in confusion (困惑地)。","entries":[{"sentence":"There was a great deal of <target>confusion</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the new school rules, as the announcement was not clearly explained to the students.","translation":"由於公告沒有向學生清楚解釋，關於新校規引起了很大的困惑。","explanation":"名詞「困惑」。指對某事不理解而產生的狀態。"},{"sentence":"The sudden change in the schedule caused total <target>confusion</target> among the travelers, who did not know which platform to use.","translation":"時間表的突然變更讓旅客們陷入完全的混亂，他們不知道該使用哪個月台。","explanation":"名詞「混亂」。指情況混亂、缺乏秩序。"},{"sentence":"He stared at the complex math problem <pattern>in</pattern> <target>confusion</target>, wondering why the answer he calculated was so different from the textbook.","translation":"他困惑地盯著那道複雜的數學題，想知道為什麼他計算出的答案與課本如此不同。","explanation":"名詞片語 in confusion 意為「困惑地」。"}],"related_forms":["confused","confusing"]}

{"headword":"congratulate","explanation":"動詞「祝賀」。常用搭配 congratulate sb on sth (祝賀某人某事)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The principal decided to <target>congratulate</target> the entire basketball team <pattern>on</pattern> their victory in the national championship game last weekend.","translation":"校長決定祝賀整個籃球隊在上週末的全國錦標賽中獲勝。","explanation":"動詞「祝賀」。固定搭配 congratulate someone on something。"},{"sentence":"I would like to <target>congratulate</target> you <pattern>on</pattern> receiving the scholarship, as your hard work and dedication have finally paid off.","translation":"我想祝賀你獲得獎學金，因為你的努力與奉獻終於得到了回報。","explanation":"動詞「祝賀」。用於慶祝成就或好消息。"}],"related_forms":["congratulations"]}

{"headword":"congress","explanation":"名詞「國會、代表大會」。常用於描述政治體制或專業領域的正式會議。","entries":[{"sentence":"The members of <target>congress</target> are currently debating a new law that aims to reduce plastic pollution in the ocean.","translation":"國會議員目前正在辯論一項旨在減少海洋塑料污染的新法律。","explanation":"名詞「國會」。指國家的立法機關。"},{"sentence":"Scientists from all over the world gathered at the annual medical <target>congress</target> to share their latest research findings on cancer treatment.","translation":"來自世界各地的科學家聚集在年度醫療代表大會上，分享他們關於癌症治療的最新研究發現。","explanation":"名詞「代表大會」。指特定專業領域的大型正式會議。"}],"related_forms":["congressional","congressman"]}

{"headword":"conquer","explanation":"動詞「征服、克服」。可指軍事上的征服，也可指克服恐懼、困難或疾病。","entries":[{"sentence":"The ancient empire managed to <target>conquer</target> neighboring lands, expanding its territory through a series of successful military campaigns.","translation":"這個古代帝國成功征服了鄰近的土地，透過一系列成功的軍事行動擴張了領土。","explanation":"動詞「征服」。指用武力奪取控制權。"},{"sentence":"It took several years of practice and patience for the young speaker to <target>conquer</target> <pattern>his fear of</pattern> public speaking.","translation":"這位年輕的演講者花了好幾年的練習和耐心才克服了對公開演講的恐懼。","explanation":"動詞「克服」。常用搭配 conquer one's fear of sth。"},{"sentence":"With determination and strong support from her family, she finally <target>conquered</target> the challenging mountain peak during her summer vacation.","translation":"憑著決心和家人的強力支持，她在暑假期間終於征服了這座具有挑戰性的山峰。","explanation":"動詞「征服/克服」。指成功地完成一件困難的事情。"}],"related_forms":["conqueror"]}

{"headword":"conscience","explanation":"名詞「良心」。常用搭配 a clear conscience (問心無愧) 或 a guilty conscience (內心愧疚)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Even though no one saw him cheat on the test, his <target>conscience</target> bothered him, so he decided to admit his mistake to the teacher.","translation":"儘管沒有人看到他考試作弊，但他的良心讓他不安，所以他決定向老師承認錯誤。","explanation":"名詞「良心」。指內心對對錯的判斷力。"},{"sentence":"She could sleep peacefully at night because she had a <pattern>clear</pattern> <target>conscience</target>, knowing she had helped everyone she could.","translation":"她晚上能安穩入睡，因為她問心無愧，知道自己已經盡力幫助了所有人。","explanation":"名詞片語 a clear conscience 意為「問心無愧」。"},{"sentence":"The thief was haunted by a <pattern>guilty</pattern> <target>conscience</target> after stealing the money, which eventually led him to return it to the owner.","translation":"小偷在偷走錢後被內心的愧疚感所困擾，這最終導致他將錢歸還給主人。","explanation":"名詞片語 a guilty conscience 意為「內心愧疚」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"consequence","explanation":"名詞「結果、後果」。常用於描述不好的結果。常用搭配 as a consequence (結果是) 或 face the consequences (承擔後果)。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you continue to ignore the warning signs of climate change, the <target>consequences</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the planet will be devastating.","translation":"如果你繼續忽視氣候變遷的警告信號，對地球產生的後果將是毀滅性的。","explanation":"名詞「後果」。通常指不好的結果。"},{"sentence":"The student failed the final exam <pattern>as a</pattern> <target>consequence</target> <pattern>of</pattern> skipping too many classes throughout the semester.","translation":"由於本學期缺課太多，這名學生期末考不及格。","explanation":"名詞片語 as a consequence of sth 意為「由於...而導致」。"},{"sentence":"He knew that lying to his parents would have serious <target>consequences</target>, but he still decided to do it to avoid immediate trouble.","translation":"他知道對父母撒謊會有嚴重的後果，但他仍然決定這樣做以避免立即的麻煩。","explanation":"名詞「後果」。常用搭配 serious consequences。"}],"related_forms":["consequential"]}

{"headword":"consequent","explanation":"形容詞「隨之而來的、結果的」。指因為某事而產生的結果。","entries":[{"sentence":"The heavy rainfall caused a flood in the city, and the <target>consequent</target> <pattern>loss of</pattern> property was enormous.","translation":"大雨導致城市淹水，隨之而來的財產損失非常巨大。","explanation":"形容詞「隨之而來的」。指因果關係中後發生的事情。"},{"sentence":"The company suffered a sharp decline in sales and the <target>consequent</target> <pattern>drop in</pattern> profits during the economic recession.","translation":"公司在經濟衰退期間遭受了銷售額的急劇下降以及隨之而來的利潤下降。","explanation":"形容詞「隨之而來的」。"}],"related_forms":["consequently"]}

{"headword":"conservative","explanation":"形容詞「保守的」；名詞「保守主義者」。形容詞用法常指對改變持保留態度或估計較為謹慎。","entries":[{"sentence":"My grandfather has very <target>conservative</target> views on marriage and family, believing that traditional roles should be maintained.","translation":"我的祖父在婚姻和家庭方面的看法非常保守，認為應該維持傳統角色。","explanation":"形容詞「保守的」。指思想或行為不傾向於改變。"},{"sentence":"The architect proposed a <target>conservative</target> <pattern>estimate of</pattern> the renovation costs to avoid surprising the client with unexpected expenses.","translation":"建築師對翻修成本提出了一個保守的估計，以避免讓客戶因意外支出而感到驚訝。","explanation":"形容詞「保守的」。指估計時採取謹慎、不誇大的方式。"},{"sentence":"The <target>conservative</target>s in the party argued that the proposed new taxes were too risky for the national economy.","translation":"黨內的保守主義者認為，擬議的新稅收對國家經濟而言風險過高。","explanation":"名詞「保守主義者」。指持有保守觀點的人。"}],"related_forms":["conservatism","conservatively"]}

{"headword":"consist","explanation":"動詞「由...組成」。固定搭配 consist of (由...組成)。注意與 comprise 或 compose 的區別：consist 必須使用 of 且不可用被動語態。","entries":[{"sentence":"The final exam <target>consists</target> <pattern>of</pattern> three main sections: multiple-choice questions, a short answer section, and a long essay.","translation":"期末考試由三個主要部分組成：選擇題、簡答題和長篇論文。","explanation":"動詞片語 consist of 意為「由...組成」。"},{"sentence":"A healthy diet should <target>consist</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a balance of proteins, carbohydrates, and healthy fats to maintain overall well-being.","translation":"健康的飲食應該由蛋白質、碳水化合物和健康脂肪的平衡組成，以維持整體健康。","explanation":"動詞片語 consist of 意為「由...組成」。"}],"related_forms":["consistency","consistent"]}

{"headword":"consistent","explanation":"形容詞「一致的、始終如一的」。常用搭配 consistent with (與...一致)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The athlete's performance has been <target>consistent</target> throughout the season, making him a strong candidate for the gold medal.","translation":"這位運動員在本賽季的表現始終如一，使其成為金牌的有力競爭者。","explanation":"形容詞「始終如一的」。指在時間或品質上保持穩定。"},{"sentence":"The witness's second statement was not <target>consistent</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the evidence found by the police at the crime scene.","translation":"證人的第二次陳述與警方在犯罪現場發現的證據不一致。","explanation":"形容詞片語 consistent with 意為「與...一致」。"},{"sentence":"To achieve success in learning English, it is important to maintain a <target>consistent</target> <pattern>study routine</pattern> every single day.","translation":"為了在學習英語方面取得成功，保持每天一致的學習習慣至關重要。","explanation":"形容詞「一致的」。常用搭配 consistent study routine。"}],"related_forms":["consistently","consistency"]}

{"headword":"constitute","explanation":"動詞「組成、構成」。常用於正式場合，描述部分如何組成整體，或某行為是否構成法律上的違規。常用搭配：constitute a threat (構成威脅), constitute a crime (構成犯罪)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The small group of dedicated volunteers <target>constitutes</target> the core of the organization, providing essential support for the local community.","translation":"這群獻身的志願者構成了該組織的核心，為當地社區提供了必要的支持。","explanation":"動詞「組成」。描述部分組成整體。"},{"sentence":"Using a phone during the exam is strictly forbidden and <target>constitutes</target> a <pattern>serious</pattern> <pattern>violation</pattern> of school rules.","translation":"考試期間嚴禁使用手機，這構成了對學校規則的嚴重違反。","explanation":"動詞「構成」。指某行為在法律或規則上被定義為某種罪名或違規。"}],"related_forms":["constitutes","constituted","constituting"]}

{"headword":"constitution","explanation":"名詞「憲法；體質」。指國家的最高法律，或一個人的身體健康狀態。注意區分其作為法律術語和健康術語的用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"The nation's <target>constitution</target> guarantees fundamental rights and freedoms to all citizens, ensuring that the law applies equally to everyone.","translation":"該國的憲法保證了所有公民的基本權利和自由，確保法律平等地適用於每個人。","explanation":"名詞「憲法」。指國家的最高法律。"},{"sentence":"Despite his small size, the athlete has a strong <target>constitution</target> that allows him to recover quickly from illness and intense training.","translation":"儘管身材嬌小，這位運動員擁有強健的體質，使他能從疾病和高強度訓練中快速恢復。","explanation":"名詞「體質」。指身體的健康狀態或組成。"}],"related_forms":["constitutional"]}

{"headword":"construct","explanation":"動詞「建造、構建」。指物理上的建築或抽象概念的建立。常用搭配：construct a bridge (建造橋樑), construct an argument (構建論點)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city plans to <target>construct</target> a new public library in the center of town to provide students with more resources for learning.","translation":"市政府計畫在市中心建造一座新的公共圖書館，以提供學生更多學習資源。","explanation":"動詞「建造」。指物理上的建築。"},{"sentence":"In the debate competition, the student had to <target>construct</target> a <pattern>logical</pattern> <pattern>argument</pattern> to persuade the judges of his point of view.","translation":"在辯論比賽中，這個學生必須構建一個邏輯嚴密的論點來說服評審認同他的觀點。","explanation":"動詞「構建」。指抽象概念、理論或論點的建立。"}],"related_forms":["constructs","constructed","constructing"]}

{"headword":"construction","explanation":"名詞「建築；建築業；構造」。可指建築過程、建築物本身或對文字的解釋方式。","entries":[{"sentence":"The road <target>construction</target> caused heavy traffic jams during the morning rush hour, forcing many students to take alternative routes to school.","translation":"道路施工導致早晨尖峰時段交通擁堵，迫使許多學生採取替代路線上學。","explanation":"名詞「建築/施工」。指建築過程或工程。"},{"sentence":"The architect explained that the unique <target>construction</target> of the building was designed to withstand strong earthquakes and typhoons.","translation":"建築師解釋說，該建築的獨特構造設計旨在抵禦強烈的地震和颱風。","explanation":"名詞「構造」。指物體或建築物的組成方式。"}],"related_forms":["construct"]}

{"headword":"constructive","explanation":"形容詞「建設性的」。常用於描述意見、批評或討論，指能提供實質幫助而非僅僅是指責的建議。常用搭配：constructive criticism (建設性的批評/建議)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Instead of just pointing out mistakes, the teacher provided <target>constructive</target> <pattern>criticism</pattern> to help the students improve their writing skills.","translation":"老師沒有僅僅指出錯誤，而是提供了建設性的批評，以幫助學生提高寫作技巧。","explanation":"形容詞「建設性的」。常用搭配：constructive criticism。"},{"sentence":"The two countries held a <target>constructive</target> <pattern>dialogue</pattern> to resolve their trade disputes and reach a mutually beneficial agreement.","translation":"兩國舉行了建設性的對話，以解決貿易爭端並達成互利共贏的協議。","explanation":"形容詞「建設性的」。常用搭配：constructive dialogue。"}],"related_forms":["constructively"]}

{"headword":"consult","explanation":"動詞「諮詢、請教、查閱」。指尋求專業建議或參考書籍、地圖等資料。常用搭配：consult a doctor (諮詢醫生), consult a dictionary (查閱字典)。","entries":[{"sentence":"If the pain in your wrist continues, you should <target>consult</target> <pattern>a</pattern> <pattern>specialist</pattern> to get a proper diagnosis and treatment.","translation":"如果你的手腕疼痛持續，你應該諮詢專科醫生以獲得正確的診斷和治療。","explanation":"動詞「諮詢」。指尋求專業人士的建議。"},{"sentence":"Whenever I encounter an unfamiliar word while reading an English novel, I usually <target>consult</target> <pattern>a</pattern> <pattern>dictionary</pattern> to find its exact meaning.","translation":"每當我在讀英文小說遇到不熟悉的單字時，我通常會查閱字典以找出其精確含義。","explanation":"動詞「查閱」。指參考書籍或資料。"}],"related_forms":["consults","consulted","consulting"]}

{"headword":"consultant","explanation":"名詞「顧問」。指提供專業建議的人。常用搭配：business consultant (商業顧問), financial consultant (財務顧問)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school hired an educational <target>consultant</target> to help them develop a new curriculum that better meets the needs of modern students.","translation":"學校聘請了一位教育顧問，幫助他們開發一套更能滿足現代學生需求的全新課程。","explanation":"名詞「顧問」。指提供專業建議的人。"},{"sentence":"As a financial <target>consultant</target>, her job is to give advice to clients on how to invest their money wisely to ensure future security.","translation":"作為一名財務顧問，她的工作是給客戶建議如何明智地投資金錢以確保未來安全。","explanation":"名詞「顧問」。常用搭配：financial consultant。"}],"related_forms":["consult","consultancy"]}

{"headword":"consume","explanation":"動詞「消耗、消費、吃掉」。指能源的消耗、產品的購買或食物的攝取。常用搭配：consume energy (消耗能量), consume time (耗時)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Modern air conditioners <target>consume</target> <pattern>less</pattern> <pattern>energy</pattern> than older models, helping homeowners save money on electricity bills.","translation":"現代空調比舊款機型消耗更少的能量，幫助屋主節省電費。","explanation":"動詞「消耗」。指能量或資源的消耗。"},{"sentence":"The project was so complex that it <target>consumed</target> <pattern>all</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> <pattern>his</pattern> <pattern>time</pattern> and energy, leaving him with no leisure activities.","translation":"這個計畫如此複雜，以至於耗盡了他所有的時間和精力，讓他沒有任何休閒活動。","explanation":"動詞「消耗」。指時間或精力的損耗。"},{"sentence":"Doctors advise that we should not <target>consume</target> <pattern>too</pattern> <pattern>much</pattern> <pattern>sugar</pattern> in our diet to avoid health problems like diabetes.","translation":"醫生建議我們在飲食中不應攝取過多糖分，以避免糖尿病等健康問題。","explanation":"動詞「攝取/吃掉」。指食物或飲料的攝取。"}],"related_forms":["consumes","consumed","consuming"]}

{"headword":"consumer","explanation":"名詞「消費者」。指購買商品或服務的人。常用搭配：consumer behavior (消費者行為), consumer rights (消費者權益)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Companies often conduct market research to understand <target>consumer</target> <pattern>behavior</pattern>, allowing them to design products that people actually want.","translation":"公司經常進行市場研究以了解消費者行為，使他們能設計出人們真正想要的產品。","explanation":"名詞「消費者」。常用搭配：consumer behavior。"},{"sentence":"The government passed a new law to protect <target>consumer</target> <pattern>rights</pattern>, ensuring that customers can get refunds for defective products.","translation":"政府通過了一項新法律來保護消費者權益，確保客戶能為瑕疵產品獲得退款。","explanation":"名詞「消費者」。常用搭配：consumer rights。"}],"related_forms":["consume","consumption"]}

{"headword":"container","explanation":"名詞「容器；貨櫃」。可指家用小容器或大型運輸貨櫃。常用搭配：plastic container (塑膠容器), shipping container (貨櫃)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please put the leftovers in a <pattern>plastic</pattern> <target>container</target> and place it in the refrigerator to keep the food fresh for tomorrow.","translation":"請將剩菜放入塑膠容器中並放入冰箱，以保持食物在明天依然新鮮。","explanation":"名詞「容器」。指家用小容器。"},{"sentence":"The port is equipped with giant cranes to move heavy <target>containers</target> from ships to the dock, facilitating global trade.","translation":"港口配備了巨大的起重機，將沉重的貨櫃從船上移至碼頭，促進全球貿易。","explanation":"名詞「貨櫃」。指大型運輸貨櫃。"}],"related_forms":["containers"]}

{"headword":"content","explanation":"作為名詞時，發音為 /'kɒntent/，指「內容」或「滿足感」；作為形容詞時，發音為 /kən'tent/，意為「滿足的」。注意形容詞用法中常搭配 be content with sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to review the <target>content</target> of the chapter before the exam to ensure they understood the main points.","translation":"老師要求學生在考試前複習該章節的內容，以確保他們理解重點。","explanation":"名詞「內容」。指書籍、文章或容器中的東西。"},{"sentence":"The digital <target>content</target> on the website is updated daily to provide users with the latest news and educational resources.","translation":"網站上的數位內容每天更新，以為使用者提供最新的新聞和教育資源。","explanation":"名詞「內容」。指媒體、網路上的資訊。"},{"sentence":"After finding a stable job and a supportive family, he felt <target>content</target> <pattern>with</pattern> his life and no longer sought constant change.","translation":"在找到一份穩定的工作和一個支持他的家庭後，他對自己的生活感到滿足，不再追求不斷的改變。","explanation":"形容詞「滿足的」。常用搭配：be content with sth (對...感到滿足)。"},{"sentence":"Although the salary was not very high, she was <target>content</target> to stay in her hometown and take care of her elderly parents.","translation":"雖然薪水不高，但她很滿足於留在故鄉照顧年邁的父母。","explanation":"形容詞「滿足的」。後接 to V 表示滿足於做某事。"}],"related_forms":["contents"]}

{"headword":"contentment","explanation":"名詞，意為「滿足感」。是形容詞 content 的名詞形式，描述一種心靈平靜且滿意的狀態。","entries":[{"sentence":"The old man lived a simple life in the countryside, finding great <target>contentment</target> in gardening and reading books by the fire.","translation":"這位老人住在鄉下過著簡單的生活，在園藝和在火爐旁閱讀書籍中找到了巨大的滿足感。","explanation":"名詞「滿足感」。描述一種長期的心理狀態。"},{"sentence":"True <target>contentment</target> comes from appreciating what you have rather than constantly chasing after material wealth and fame.","translation":"真正的滿足感來自於感激你所擁有的，而不是不斷追求物質財富和名聲。","explanation":"名詞「滿足感」。"}],"related_forms":["content"]}

{"headword":"contest","explanation":"名詞指「競賽、比賽」；動詞指「爭論、對...提出異議」。名詞用法常見搭配 a contest for/of (關於...的比賽)；動詞用法常考片語 contest the results (對結果提出異議)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school organized an annual writing <target>contest</target> to encourage students to express their creativity and improve their English skills.","translation":"學校舉辦了一年一度的寫作競賽，以鼓勵學生發揮創意並提高英語能力。","explanation":"名詞「競賽」。指一種競爭性的活動。"},{"sentence":"After the debate, the winner of the <target>contest</target> was announced, and the audience gave a loud round of applause.","translation":"辯論賽後，競賽的獲勝者被宣布，觀眾們發出了雷鳴般的掌聲。","explanation":"名詞「競賽」。"},{"sentence":"The athlete decided to <target>contest</target> the referee's decision, claiming that the foul was not called correctly during the game.","translation":"運動員決定對裁判的決定提出異議，聲稱比賽過程中犯規的情況未被正確判定。","explanation":"動詞「提出異議」。指對某個決定或結果表示不認同並試圖改變它。"},{"sentence":"Some residents <target>contested</target> the new city plan, arguing that the construction of the highway would destroy the local environment.","translation":"一些居民對新的城市計畫提出異議，認為高速公路的建設會破壞當地環境。","explanation":"動詞「提出異議」。"}],"related_forms":["contests"]}

{"headword":"context","explanation":"名詞，意為「上下文」或「背景」。在閱讀理解中，context clues (上下文線索) 是重要概念。指事物發生時的環境、情況或背景資訊。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you encounter an unknown word while reading, you can often guess its meaning by looking at the surrounding <target>context</target>.","translation":"閱讀時如果遇到不認識的單字，通常可以透過觀察周圍的上下文來推測其意思。","explanation":"名詞「上下文」。指文字周圍的資訊。"},{"sentence":"To fully understand the historical events described in the book, it is important to consider the social and political <target>context</target> of that era.","translation":"為了全面理解書中描述的歷史事件，將那個時代的社會和政治背景考慮進來是很重要的。","explanation":"名詞「背景」。指事情發生時的環境或情況。"},{"sentence":"The quote was taken <pattern>out of</pattern> <target>context</target>, making the speaker's original intention seem completely different from what was actually said.","translation":"這段引言被脫離上下文地引用，使得說話者的原意看起來與實際說話的情況完全不同。","explanation":"名詞「背景/上下文」。片語 take sth out of context 表示「脫離上下文（而引用）」。"}],"related_forms":["contexts"]}

{"headword":"continual","explanation":"形容詞，意為「接連不斷的、反覆的」。強調的是「頻繁地重複發生」，但中間可能有短暫的中斷。常用於描述令人厭煩的事物，如 continual complaints (不斷的抱怨)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company faced <target>continual</target> <pattern>complaints</pattern> from customers regarding the slow delivery service, forcing them to improve their logistics.","translation":"公司面臨客戶對送貨服務緩慢的不斷抱怨，迫使他們改善物流。","explanation":"形容詞「接連不斷的」。強調反覆發生。"},{"sentence":"The student struggled to focus on his studies due to the <target>continual</target> noise from the nearby construction site.","translation":"由於附近建築工地不斷傳來的噪音，這名學生很難專注於學習。","explanation":"形容詞「反覆的」。指事情頻繁地發生。"}],"related_forms":["continually","continuation"]}

{"headword":"continuous","explanation":"形容詞，意為「連續的、不間斷的」。強調的是「在時間或空間上沒有中斷」，如 a continuous line (一條連續的線) 或 continuous rain (連續不斷的雨)。注意與 continual 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The region experienced <target>continuous</target> rain for three days, leading to severe flooding in several small villages near the river.","translation":"該地區經歷了連續三天的降雨，導致河流附近幾個小村莊發生嚴重水災。","explanation":"形容詞「連續的」。強調完全沒有中斷。"},{"sentence":"The athletes ran along a <target>continuous</target> path that circled the entire lake, providing a beautiful view of the scenery.","translation":"運動員們沿著一條環繞整個湖泊的連續路徑奔跑，提供了極美的風景。","explanation":"形容詞「連續的」。指空間上的不間斷。"},{"sentence":"The <target>continuous</target> hum of the air conditioner in the library helped some students concentrate better on their reading.","translation":"圖書館裡冷氣機連續不斷的嗡嗡聲幫助一些學生更好地專注於閱讀。","explanation":"形容詞「不間斷的」。指聲音或狀態在時間上的持續。"}],"related_forms":["continuously","continuity"]}

{"headword":"contrary","explanation":"形容詞意為「相反的」；名詞意為「相反的事物」。常用片語 on the contrary (恰恰相反) 以及 be contrary to (與...相反/違背)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The results of the experiment were <target>contrary</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the scientist's initial expectations, leading to a new discovery in the field.","translation":"實驗結果與科學家的初步預期相反，導致該領域的一項新發現。","explanation":"形容詞「相反的」。常用搭配 be contrary to (與...相反)。"},{"sentence":"She thought the movie would be boring; <pattern>on the</pattern> <target>contrary</target>, it was one of the most exciting films she had ever seen.","translation":"她以為這部電影會很無聊；恰恰相反，這是她看過最令人興奮的電影之一。","explanation":"名詞「相反之處」。片語 on the contrary 用於強調前述內容是不正確的。"},{"sentence":"The witness's testimony was <target>contrary</target> to the evidence found at the crime scene, making the jury doubt his honesty.","translation":"證人的證詞與犯罪現場發現的證據相反，使陪審團懷疑他的誠實。","explanation":"形容詞「相反的」。指內容或意見不一致。"}],"related_forms":["contrariwise"]}

{"headword":"contrast","explanation":"名詞指「對比、差異」；動詞指「對比」。名詞常用片語 in contrast (相比之下), by contrast (相比之下)；動詞用法常搭配 contrast A with B (將A與B對比)。","entries":[{"sentence":"There is a sharp <target>contrast</target> <pattern>between</pattern> the modern skyscrapers of the city center and the old houses in the suburbs.","translation":"市中心現代化的摩天大樓與郊區的舊房子之間有著鮮明的對比。","explanation":"名詞「對比」。常用搭配 contrast between A and B。"},{"sentence":"The white snow <target>contrasted</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the dark grey rocks, creating a stunning visual effect that attracted many photographers.","translation":"白雪與深灰色的岩石形成對比，創造出令人驚嘆的視覺效果，吸引了許多攝影師。","explanation":"動詞「對比」。常用搭配 contrast A with B 或 contrast with B。"},{"sentence":"The first half of the book is very slow, but <pattern>in</pattern> <target>contrast</target>, the second half is filled with action and excitement.","translation":"這本書的前半部非常緩慢，但相比之下，後半部則充滿了行動與刺激。","explanation":"名詞「對比」。片語 in contrast 用於對比兩個不同的事物。"},{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to <target>contrast</target> the two different political systems to understand their advantages and disadvantages.","translation":"老師要求學生對比兩種不同的政治制度，以理解其優缺點。","explanation":"動詞「對比」。指分析兩者之間的差異。"}],"related_forms":["contrasting","contrasted"]}

{"headword":"contribute","explanation":"動詞「貢獻、捐助、導致」。常用片語 contribute to (導致/對...有貢獻)。注意 contribute to 的 to 是介係詞，後接名詞或動名詞 (V-ing)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many local businesses <target>contributed</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the school's new library fund to provide students with better reading materials.","translation":"許多當地企業捐助了學校的新圖書館基金，以提供學生更好的閱讀材料。","explanation":"動詞「捐助」。常用搭配 contribute to + N (捐款/捐物)。"},{"sentence":"Regular exercise and a balanced diet <target>contribute</target> <pattern>to</pattern> better health and a longer life for people of all ages.","translation":"規律的運動和均衡的飲食有助於所有年齡段的人擁有更好的健康和更長壽的生命。","explanation":"動詞「有助於」。常用搭配 contribute to + N (對...有正面影響)。"},{"sentence":"Heavy rain and strong winds <target>contributed</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the traffic jam on the highway, making many commuters late for work.","translation":"暴雨和大風導致了高速公路上的交通堵塞，使許多通勤者上班遲到。","explanation":"動詞「導致」。常用搭配 contribute to + N (對...產生負面影響)。"},{"sentence":"Every student in the class <target>contributes</target> different ideas <pattern>during</pattern> the group discussion, making the final project more complete.","translation":"班上每位學生在小組討論中都貢獻了不同的想法，使最終的計畫更完整。","explanation":"動詞「貢獻」。指提供想法、時間或金錢。"}],"related_forms":["contribution","contributor"]}

{"headword":"contribution","explanation":"名詞「貢獻、捐款」。是動詞 contribute 的名詞形式。常用片語 make a contribution to (對...做出貢獻)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The scientist's research on renewable energy made a significant <target>contribution</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the fight against climate change.","translation":"這位科學家對可再生能源的研究為對抗氣候變遷做出了重大貢獻。","explanation":"名詞「貢獻」。常用片語 make a contribution to sth。"},{"sentence":"The charity organization relies on the generous <target>contributions</target> <pattern>of</pattern> donors to provide food and medicine to poor children.","translation":"慈善組織依靠捐贈者的慷慨捐款來為貧困兒童提供食物和藥品。","explanation":"名詞「捐款」。常用搭配 contribution of someone。"},{"sentence":"The students' hard work and <target>contribution</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the school festival were highly praised by the principal and teachers.","translation":"學生們的努力和對學校祭典的貢獻受到了校長和老師們的高度讚賞。","explanation":"名詞「貢獻」。"}],"related_forms":["contribute","contributor"]}

{"headword":"convenience","explanation":"名詞「方便；便利設施」。常考搭配：for your convenience (為了您的方便), at your convenience (在您方便的時候)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hotel is located near the subway station, providing great <target>convenience</target> for tourists who want to explore the city easily.","translation":"這家飯店位於地鐵站附近，為想要輕鬆探索城市的遊客提供了極大的便利。","explanation":"名詞「便利」。"},{"sentence":"Please reply to this email <pattern>at</pattern> your earliest <target>convenience</target> so that we can finalize the meeting schedule for next week.","translation":"請在您最早方便的時候回覆此電子郵件，以便我們能確定下週的會議行程。","explanation":"常用片語 at your convenience，指在對方方便的時候。"},{"sentence":"Modern apartments often include various <target>conveniences</target>, such as dishwashers and smart home systems, to make daily life more comfortable.","translation":"現代公寓通常包含各種便利設施，例如洗碗機和智能家居系統，使日常生活更舒適。","explanation":"名詞「便利設施」。此處為複數形。"}],"related_forms":["convenient"]}

{"headword":"convention","explanation":"名詞「慣例；習俗；大會」。指社會普遍接受的行為方式，或指特定專業領域的集會。常考搭配：social convention (社會慣例)。","entries":[{"sentence":"In many cultures, shaking hands when meeting someone for the first time is a common social <target>convention</target> that shows respect.","translation":"在許多文化中，初次見面時握手是一種常見的社會慣例，用以表示尊重。","explanation":"名詞「慣例；習俗」。"},{"sentence":"Thousands of fans from all over the world gathered at the comic <target>convention</target> to celebrate their favorite characters and artists.","translation":"來自世界各地的數千名粉絲聚集在漫畫大會上，慶祝他們最喜愛的角色和藝術家。","explanation":"名詞「大會；集會」。"},{"sentence":"The writer decided to break with <target>convention</target> by using a non-linear timeline in her novel, which surprised many of her readers.","translation":"這位作家決定打破慣例，在她的小說中使用非線性時間線，這讓許多讀者感到驚訝。","explanation":"名詞「慣例」。片語 break with convention 表示打破傳統或慣例。"}],"related_forms":["conventional"]}

{"headword":"conventional","explanation":"形容詞「傳統的；慣例的」。指遵循普遍接受的標準或方式，常與 unconventional (非傳統的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"While some people prefer <target>conventional</target> medicine, others are more interested in natural remedies to treat their mild health problems.","translation":"雖然有些人偏好傳統醫學，但有些人對使用天然療法治療輕微健康問題更感興趣。","explanation":"形容詞「傳統的」。指一般被大眾接受的標準醫療方式。"},{"sentence":"The company's <target>conventional</target> <pattern>approach</pattern> to marketing failed to attract younger customers, who preferred more creative and digital strategies.","translation":"公司傳統的行銷方法未能吸引年輕顧客，他們更偏好更具創意和數位化的策略。","explanation":"形容詞「傳統的」。常用搭配：conventional approach (傳統方法)。"},{"sentence":"Her <target>conventional</target> <pattern>style</pattern> of painting follows the rules of the 19th century, focusing on realistic details and natural light.","translation":"她的繪畫風格很傳統，遵循 19 世紀的規則，注重寫實的細節和自然光線。","explanation":"形容詞「傳統的」。"}],"related_forms":["conventionally"]}

{"headword":"converse","explanation":"動詞「交談；對話」。名詞「相反的事物」。形容詞「相反的」。在 GSAT 中，動詞用法較常考，指正式的交談。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the break, the professors began to <target>converse</target> <pattern>with</pattern> each other about the new research findings in biology.","translation":"在休息時間，教授們開始就生物學的新研究結果互相交談。","explanation":"動詞「交談」。常用搭配：converse with someone。"},{"sentence":"The student found it difficult to <target>converse</target> <pattern>fluently in</pattern> French, even though he had studied the language for three years.","translation":"儘管他學習法語已有三年，但這名學生發現很難用法語流利地交談。","explanation":"動詞「交談」。"},{"sentence":"Some people believe that money brings happiness, but the <target>converse</target> is also true: happiness can lead to more success.","translation":"有些人認為金錢帶來幸福，但相反的情況也是如此：幸福能帶來更多的成功。","explanation":"名詞「相反的事物」。"},{"sentence":"The two theories provide <target>converse</target> <pattern>viewpoints</pattern> on the cause of the climate crisis, leading to a heated debate among experts.","translation":"這兩種理論對氣候危機的原因提供了相反的觀點，引發了專家之間激烈的爭論。","explanation":"形容詞「相反的」。"}],"related_forms":["conversation"]}

{"headword":"convey","explanation":"動詞「傳達；運送」。最常用於傳達訊息、情感或意思。常考搭配：convey a message/feeling (傳達訊息/情感)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The author uses vivid descriptions and strong imagery to <target>convey</target> the deep sadness of the main character after the loss.","translation":"作者使用生動的描述和強烈的意象來傳達主角在失去之後的深沉悲傷。","explanation":"動詞「傳達」。指傳達情感或意涵。"},{"sentence":"It is sometimes difficult to <target>convey</target> complex ideas <pattern>through</pattern> a short text message, which often leads to misunderstandings.","translation":"有時很難透過簡短的簡訊來傳達複雜的想法，這經常導致誤解。","explanation":"動詞「傳達」。"},{"sentence":"The pipeline was built to <target>convey</target> natural gas from the remote northern fields to the cities in the south.","translation":"這條管道的建設是為了將天然氣從偏遠的北方田區運送到南方的城市。","explanation":"動詞「運送」。指物質的運輸。"}],"related_forms":["conveyance","conveyor"]}

{"headword":"convince","explanation":"動詞「說服；使信服」。常考句型：convince someone of something 或 convince someone to do something。注意與 persuade (說服某人去做某事) 的區別，convince 更強調改變想法。","entries":[{"sentence":"The lawyer tried to <target>convince</target> the jury <pattern>of</pattern> the defendant's innocence by presenting new evidence from the crime scene.","translation":"律師試圖透過出示犯罪現場的新證據，使陪審團相信被告是清白的。","explanation":"動詞「使信服」。句型 convince someone of something。"},{"sentence":"My parents finally <target>convinced</target> me <pattern>to</pattern> study medicine instead of art, arguing that it would provide more stability in the future.","translation":"我的父母最終說服我學習醫學而不是藝術，理由是這在未來能提供更多穩定性。","explanation":"動詞「說服」。句型 convince someone to do something。"},{"sentence":"The salesman was so persuasive that he managed to <target>convince</target> the customer <pattern>that</pattern> the expensive vacuum cleaner was a necessary investment.","translation":"那個銷售員非常有說服力，他成功地使顧客相信這台昂貴的吸塵器是一項必要的投資。","explanation":"動詞「說服」。句型 convince someone that..."}],"related_forms":["convincing","convinced"]}

{"headword":"cooperate","explanation":"動詞「合作」。指為了共同目標而一起工作。常考搭配：cooperate with someone (與某人合作)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two neighboring countries agreed to <target>cooperate</target> <pattern>with</pattern> each other to reduce air pollution and protect the shared river.","translation":"這兩個鄰國同意相互合作，以減少空氣污染並保護共用的河流。","explanation":"動詞「合作」。常用搭配：cooperate with someone。"},{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to <target>cooperate</target> during the group project to ensure that the work was completed on time.","translation":"老師要求學生在小組專題中合作，以確保工作能按時完成。","explanation":"動詞「合作」。"},{"sentence":"The witness refused to <target>cooperate</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the police, which made it very difficult for them to solve the case quickly.","translation":"證人拒絕與警方合作，這使得他們很難快速破案。","explanation":"動詞「合作」。"}],"related_forms":["cooperation","cooperative"]}

{"headword":"cooperation","explanation":"名詞「合作」。指合作的行為或過程。常考搭配：international cooperation (國際合作), close cooperation (密切合作)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The success of the space mission was the result of close <target>cooperation</target> between scientists from several different countries.","translation":"這次太空任務的成功是來自幾個不同國家的科學家之間密切合作的結果。","explanation":"名詞「合作」。常用搭配：close cooperation。"},{"sentence":"The school hopes to increase <target>cooperation</target> <pattern>between</pattern> teachers and parents to better support the students' emotional growth.","translation":"學校希望增加教師與家長之間的合作，以更好地支持學生的情感成長。","explanation":"名詞「合作」。"},{"sentence":"Global warming is a complex problem that requires international <target>cooperation</target> to implement effective laws and protect the environment.","translation":"全球暖化是一個複雜的問題，需要國際合作來執行有效的法律並保護環境。","explanation":"名詞「合作」。常用搭配：international cooperation。"}],"related_forms":["cooperate","cooperative"]}

{"headword":"cooperative","explanation":"形容詞「合作的；樂於合作的」；名詞「合作社」。形容詞用法常描述人的態度，名詞用法指共同擁有的企業。","entries":[{"sentence":"The staff at the tourist information center were very <target>cooperative</target>, helping the visitors find the best routes to the local landmarks.","translation":"遊客資訊中心的職員非常樂於合作，幫助遊客找到前往當地地標的最佳路線。","explanation":"形容詞「樂於合作的」。"},{"sentence":"The students worked in a <target>cooperative</target> <pattern>manner</pattern> to clean up the campus after the school festival ended.","translation":"學生們以合作的方式在學校祭典結束後清理校園。","explanation":"形容詞「合作的」。常用搭配：cooperative manner。"},{"sentence":"The local farmers formed a <target>cooperative</target> to sell their organic vegetables directly to consumers and avoid paying high fees to middlemen.","translation":"當地農民成立了一個合作社，將他們的有機蔬菜直接賣給消費者，以避免支付高額的中間商費用。","explanation":"名詞「合作社」。"}],"related_forms":["cooperate","cooperation"]}

{"headword":"cope","explanation":"動詞「應對；處理」。指在困難或壓力下成功地應對。必須接介系詞 with：cope with (應對...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many students find it challenging to <target>cope</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the immense pressure of preparing for final exams while maintaining a social life.","translation":"許多學生發現，在維持社交生活的同時，應對準備期末考的巨大壓力具有挑戰性。","explanation":"動詞「應對」。固定搭配：cope with something。"},{"sentence":"The city government is struggling to <target>cope</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the sudden increase in traffic after the new shopping mall opened.","translation":"在新的購物中心開幕後，市政府正努力應對突然增加的交通流量。","explanation":"動詞「應對」。指處理困難的局面。"},{"sentence":"After the sudden loss of his pet, the young boy needed some time and support from his family to <target>cope</target> <pattern>with</pattern> his grief.","translation":"在突然失去寵物後，這個小男孩需要時間以及家人的支持來應對他的悲傷。","explanation":"動詞「應對」。指處理負面情感。"}],"related_forms":["coping"]}

{"headword":"copper","explanation":"copper 作為名詞時指「銅」；作為形容詞時指「銅製的」或「銅色的」。在 GSAT 中，通常出現在科學或歷史背景的閱讀中。注意與 bronze (青銅) 的區別：copper 是純銅，而 bronze 是銅與錫的合金。","entries":[{"sentence":"The ancient civilization used <target>copper</target> to create tools and weapons, marking a significant shift in human technological development.","translation":"這個古代文明使用銅來製作工具和武器，標誌著人類技術發展的一個重要轉折。","explanation":"名詞「銅」。指一種紅棕色的金屬。"},{"sentence":"The electrician replaced the old wiring with new <target>copper</target> <pattern>wires</pattern>, as copper is an excellent conductor of electricity.","translation":"電工將舊電線更換為新的銅線，因為銅是極佳的電導體。","explanation":"形容詞「銅製的」。常用搭配：copper wire (銅線)。"}],"related_forms":["coppers"]}

{"headword":"cord","explanation":"名詞「繩索、電線」。指較細且強韌的繩子，或連接電子設備的電源線。常見搭配 include power cord (電源線) 和 bungee cord (彈力繩)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please make sure the <target>cord</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the electric kettle is not touching any water to avoid a dangerous electrical short.","translation":"請確保電熱水壺的電線沒有接觸到任何水，以避免危險的電路短路。","explanation":"名詞「電線」。指連接設備與電源的線材。"},{"sentence":"The climbers used a strong <target>cord</target> to secure their gear to the backpack, ensuring nothing would fall during the ascent.","translation":"登山者使用一條強韌的繩索將裝備固定在背包上，以確保在攀登過程中沒有任何東西掉落。","explanation":"名詞「繩索」。指較細且耐用的繩子。"}],"related_forms":["cords"]}

{"headword":"correspond","explanation":"動詞「通信、一致、相符」。常用片語 correspond with (與...通信) 和 correspond to (與...相符/相當)。注意 with 和 to 的用法區別：with 指人，to 指事物。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the exchange program, the student <target>corresponded</target> <pattern>with</pattern> a peer in Japan to practice their language skills and learn about local culture.","translation":"在交換計畫期間，這名學生與一名日本同儕通信，以練習語言技能並了解當地文化。","explanation":"動詞「通信」。常用片語 correspond with someone (與某人通信)。"},{"sentence":"The research findings <target>correspond</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the theory proposed by the scientists, confirming that the initial hypothesis was correct.","translation":"研究結果與科學家提出的理論相符，證實了最初的假設是正確的。","explanation":"動詞「相符、相當」。常用片語 correspond to something (與某事相符)。"}],"related_forms":["correspondence","corresponding"]}

{"headword":"costume","explanation":"名詞「服裝、戲服」。通常指為了特定目的（如表演、節日或歷史再現）而穿的衣服，而非日常服飾 (clothes)。常見搭配如 traditional costume (傳統服裝) 或 Halloween costume (萬聖節服裝)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students spent weeks designing an elaborate <target>costume</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the school play, aiming to make the character look authentic.","translation":"學生們花了好幾週設計一件精緻的學校戲劇服裝，旨在讓角色看起來真實。","explanation":"名詞「戲服」。指為了表演而穿的衣服。"},{"sentence":"During the cultural festival, many visitors wore traditional <target>costumes</target> to showcase the unique heritage of their home countries.","translation":"文化節期間，許多訪客穿著傳統服裝，以展示他們家鄉獨特的文化遺產。","explanation":"名詞「傳統服裝」。指代表特定民族或文化之服飾。"}],"related_forms":["costumes"]}

{"headword":"cottage","explanation":"名詞「小屋、村舍」。通常指位於鄉間、簡樸且小巧的房屋。常考片語 a cozy cottage (溫馨的小屋)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The retired couple decided to buy a small <target>cottage</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the countryside, hoping to enjoy a peaceful life away from the city.","translation":"這對退休夫婦決定在鄉間買一棟小房屋，希望能遠離城市，享受平靜的生活。","explanation":"名詞「小屋」。指位於鄉間的簡樸房屋。"},{"sentence":"Hidden among the tall trees, the cozy <target>cottage</target> looked like something from a fairy tale, attracting many curious photographers.","translation":"隱藏在高大樹木之間，那棟溫馨的小屋看起來像童話故事中的場景，吸引了許多好奇的攝影師。","explanation":"名詞「小屋」。常用形容詞 cozy (溫馨的) 搭配。"}],"related_forms":["cottages"]}

{"headword":"council","explanation":"名詞「議會、委員會」。指一個被選出或任命來管理、諮詢或制定法律的團體。注意與 counselor (顧問/輔導員) 的區別：council 是組織，counselor 是人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student <target>council</target> <pattern>met</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> discuss the new rules for the school library, ensuring that every student's voice was heard.","translation":"學生會開會討論學校圖書館的新規定，確保每位學生的聲音都能被聽見。","explanation":"名詞「委員會、學生會」。指一個管理或決策團體。"},{"sentence":"The city <target>council</target> <pattern>voted</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> build a new community center to provide more recreational activities for local residents.","translation":"市議會投票決定建造一座新的社區中心，以提供更多休閒活動給當地居民。","explanation":"名詞「議會」。指地方政府的決策機關。"}],"related_forms":["councils"]}

{"headword":"counter","explanation":"counter 可作名詞（櫃檯）、動詞（反擊/反對）或形容詞/副詞（相反的）。名詞用法最常見，指商店或銀行中的服務台。動詞用法常指在辯論或體育中對應以反擊。形容詞/副詞用法常指方向或性質相反。","entries":[{"sentence":"The customer <pattern>placed</pattern> his bag <pattern>on</pattern> the <target>counter</target> while he waited for the cashier to process his payment.","translation":"顧客在等待收銀員處理付款時，將他的包包放在櫃檯上。","explanation":"名詞「櫃檯」。指商店中用於交易的平面台面。"},{"sentence":"When the opponent presented a strong argument, the lawyer <target>countered</target> <pattern>with</pattern> a piece of evidence that proved the witness was lying.","translation":"當對手提出強而有力的論點時，律師以一份證明證人撒謊的證據進行反擊。","explanation":"動詞「反擊、反對」。常用片語 counter with something (以...反擊)。"},{"sentence":"The two cars were traveling in <target>counter</target> <pattern>directions</pattern>, which made the traffic accident on the narrow bridge almost inevitable.","translation":"兩輛車正朝相反方向行駛，這使得窄橋上的交通事故幾乎不可避免。","explanation":"形容詞「相反的」。常用搭配 counter-direction (相反方向)。"}],"related_forms":["counteract","countermeasure"]}

{"headword":"courageous","explanation":"形容詞「勇敢的」。指面對危險、恐懼或困難時展現出勇氣。注意與 brave 的區別：courageous 較為正式且強調面對恐懼時的內在精神力量。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>courageous</target> <pattern>firefighter</pattern> risked his own life to save a trapped child from the burning building during the earthquake.","translation":"在地震期間，這位勇敢的消防員冒險用自己的生命將一名受困的孩子從燃燒的建築中救出。","explanation":"形容詞「勇敢的」。常用於描述面對危險時的行為。"},{"sentence":"It was a <target>courageous</target> <pattern>decision</pattern> for her to leave her stable job and start her own business in a competitive market.","translation":"對於她來說，離開穩定的工作並在競爭激烈的市場中創業，是一個勇敢的決定。","explanation":"形容詞「勇敢的」。此處指面對不確定性時的勇氣。"}],"related_forms":["courage","courageously"]}

{"headword":"courtesy","explanation":"名詞「禮貌、好意」。指對他人展現出的文明行為或禮貌。常見搭配 include act of courtesy (禮貌行為) 或 by courtesy of (經由...的許可/提供)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hotel staff treated all the guests with extreme <target>courtesy</target> and professionalism, making them feel welcome and valued.","translation":"飯店員工以極其禮貌且專業的態度對待所有客人，使他們感到受歡迎且受重視。","explanation":"名詞「禮貌」。指文明且有禮的行為。"},{"sentence":"The rare photographs of the historic battle were published <pattern>by</pattern> <target>courtesy</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the national museum's archives.","translation":"這些關於這場歷史之戰的罕見照片是由國家博物館的檔案館提供而出版的。","explanation":"名詞片語 by courtesy of (經由...的許可/提供)。"}],"related_forms":["courteous"]}

{"headword":"coward","explanation":"名詞「膽小鬼」。指缺乏勇氣面對危險或困難的人。注意與 cowardly (形容詞，膽小地) 的區別：coward 是名詞，cowardly 是形容詞/副詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"He called his brother a <target>coward</target> for refusing to enter the haunted house, even though it was just a game.","translation":"他稱呼他的哥哥是個膽小鬼，因為他拒絕進入那間鬼屋，儘管那只是一個遊戲。","explanation":"名詞「膽小鬼」。指缺乏勇氣的人。"},{"sentence":"Despite his loud talking, the man proved to be a <target>coward</target> when he ran away from the scene of the accident without helping.","translation":"儘管他口頭上很強勢，但這個男人在不幫助他人而從事故現場逃走時，證明了自己是個膽小鬼。","explanation":"名詞「膽小鬼」。指在關鍵時刻缺乏勇氣的人。"}],"related_forms":["cowardly","cowardice"]}

{"headword":"crack","explanation":"名詞「裂縫；破裂聲」；動詞「破裂；破解；揭露」。注意動詞片語 crack down on (嚴厲打擊)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Due to the strong earthquake, a large <target>crack</target> appeared in the wall of the old school building, causing concern among the staff.","translation":"由於強烈地震，舊校舍的牆上出現了一道巨大的裂縫，引起了教職員的擔憂。","explanation":"名詞「裂縫」。指物體表面出現的細長開口。"},{"sentence":"The sudden <target>crack</target> of thunder woke the students from their deep sleep, making them realize a heavy storm was approaching.","translation":"突然的一聲雷響驚醒了熟睡中的學生，讓他們意識到一場大雨即將到來。","explanation":"名詞「破裂聲」。指突然而尖銳的聲音。"},{"sentence":"The computer expert was able to <target>crack</target> the encrypted password in just a few minutes, granting him access to the hidden files.","translation":"電腦專家在短短幾分鐘內就破解了加密密碼，讓他能夠進入隱藏文件。","explanation":"動詞「破解」。常用於破解密碼或複雜的謎團。"},{"sentence":"The local police decided to <target>crack</target> <pattern>down on</pattern> illegal parking in the school zone to ensure the safety of the students.","translation":"當地警察決定嚴厲打擊校區內的違法停車現象，以確保學生的安全。","explanation":"動詞片語 crack down on 表「嚴厲打擊」。"}],"related_forms":["cracked"]}

{"headword":"craft","explanation":"名詞「手工藝；技巧；船隻/飛機」。指透過練習而獲得的熟練技術。常用搭配 a master of one's craft (精通其技藝的人)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The elderly woman spent her afternoons teaching the local children the traditional <target>craft</target> <pattern>of</pattern> weaving baskets from bamboo.","translation":"這位年長的婦女下午時分教當地孩子們用竹子編織籃子的傳統手工藝。","explanation":"名詞「手工藝」。指傳統的製作技巧。"},{"sentence":"The young author worked tirelessly to improve his <target>craft</target>, spending hours reading classic novels to learn how to structure a story.","translation":"這位年輕的作者不懈地努力提升他的寫作技巧，花許多小時閱讀經典小說以學習如何建構故事。","explanation":"名詞「技巧」。指在特定領域中透過練習獲得的熟練度。"},{"sentence":"The coast guard spotted a small fishing <target>craft</target> drifting aimlessly in the middle of the ocean after the severe storm passed.","translation":"海岸警衛隊在強風暴過後，發現一艘小型漁船在海洋中心漫無目的地漂流。","explanation":"名詞「船隻/飛機」。在正式語境中常用於指代小型船隻或飛行器。"}],"related_forms":["craftsmanship","craftsman"]}

{"headword":"creation","explanation":"名詞「創造；作品」。指創造某物的過程或被創造出來的東西。常用搭配 the creation of (某物的創造)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>creation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the internet has fundamentally changed the way people communicate and access information across the globe.","translation":"網路的創造從根本上改變了人們在全球範圍內溝通和獲取資訊的方式。","explanation":"名詞「創造」。指創造某物的過程。"},{"sentence":"The artist's latest <target>creation</target> is a giant sculpture made entirely of recycled plastic, which aims to raise awareness about pollution.","translation":"藝術家的最新作品是一座完全由回收塑料製成的巨大雕塑，旨在提高人們對污染的意識。","explanation":"名詞「作品」。指被創造出來的藝術品或產品。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are studying the <target>creation</target> of the universe to understand how stars and galaxies were formed billions of years ago.","translation":"科學家正在研究宇宙的創造，以了解數十億年前恆星和星系是如何形成的。","explanation":"名詞「創造」。指自然或宇宙的形成過程。"}],"related_forms":["create","creator","creative"]}

{"headword":"creativity","explanation":"名詞「創造力」。指能夠產生新想法或原創作品的能力。常用搭配 spark creativity (激發創造力), foster creativity (培養創造力)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher encouraged her students to express their <target>creativity</target> by allowing them to choose their own topics for the final art project.","translation":"老師鼓勵學生透過讓他們自行選擇最終藝術項目的主題來表達他們的創造力。","explanation":"名詞「創造力」。指產生原創想法的能力。"},{"sentence":"Providing a flexible learning environment can <target>foster</target> <target>creativity</target> in children, helping them find innovative solutions to complex problems.","translation":"提供靈活的學習環境可以培養孩子的創造力，幫助他們找到解決複雜問題的創新方案。","explanation":"名詞「創造力」。常用搭配 foster creativity (培養創造力)。"},{"sentence":"Visiting an art gallery often <target>sparks</target> <target>creativity</target> in young artists, giving them new ideas for their own future paintings.","translation":"參觀藝術畫廊通常會激發年輕藝術家的創造力，給予他們未來繪畫的新靈感。","explanation":"名詞「創造力」。常用搭配 spark creativity (激發創造力)。"}],"related_forms":["creative"]}

{"headword":"creep","explanation":"動詞「悄悄爬行；緩慢移動」。指為了不被發現而緩慢移動，或某種狀態緩慢地增加。","entries":[{"sentence":"The spy tried to <target>creep</target> <pattern>up on</pattern> the guard without making any noise, hoping to steal the secret documents from the safe.","translation":"間諜試圖在不發出任何聲音的情況下悄悄接近警衛，希望從保險箱中偷走機密文件。","explanation":"動詞「悄悄接近」。常用片語 creep up on (悄悄接近某人)。"},{"sentence":"As the deadline for the final exam approached, a feeling of anxiety began to <target>creep</target> <pattern>into</pattern> his mind.","translation":"隨著期末考截止日期的臨近，一種焦慮感開始悄悄進入他的腦海。","explanation":"動詞「緩慢進入」。常用於描述情緒或感覺的緩慢出現。"},{"sentence":"The cat began to <target>creep</target> slowly through the tall grass, keeping its eyes fixed on the small bird resting on the branch.","translation":"貓開始在高草叢中緩慢爬行，目光緊盯著休息在樹枝上的小鳥。","explanation":"動詞「悄悄爬行」。指動物的緩慢移動。"}],"related_forms":["creepy"]}

{"headword":"critic","explanation":"名詞「評論家；批評者」。指專業地對藝術、文學或電影進行評論的人，或對某事持批評態度的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The famous movie <target>critic</target> gave the new science fiction film a glowing review, praising its stunning visual effects and deep plot.","translation":"著名的電影評論家對這部新的科幻電影給予了極高評價，讚揚其震撼的視覺效果和深厚的劇情。","explanation":"名詞「評論家」。指專業地評估作品的人。"},{"sentence":"Although the politician's plan was popular among some, he faced harsh <target>critics</target> who argued that the cost was too high.","translation":"雖然這位政治家的計劃在某些人中很受歡迎，但他面臨著激烈的批評者，他們認為成本太高。","explanation":"名詞「批評者」。指對某事持反對或批評態度的人。"},{"sentence":"As a food <target>critic</target>, she travels to different cities to taste local dishes and write detailed reports for a famous magazine.","translation":"作為一名美食評論家，她前往不同的城市品嚐當地美食，並為一家著名的雜誌撰寫詳細的報告。","explanation":"名詞「評論家」。指在特定領域提供專業評價的人。"}],"related_forms":["critical","criticize","criticism"]}

{"headword":"critical","explanation":"形容詞「關鍵的；極其重要的」或「批判的；挑剔的」。在醫學或災害語境中也可指「危急的」。注意 critical thinking (批判性思考) 是 GSAT 常考詞組。","entries":[{"sentence":"The first few minutes after an accident are <target>critical</target>, as immediate medical attention can save a person's life.","translation":"事故發生後的前幾分鐘至關重要，因為立即的醫療救治可以挽救人的生命。","explanation":"形容詞「關鍵的、至關重要的」。指對結果有決定性影響的時刻。"},{"sentence":"Students are encouraged to develop <target>critical</target> <pattern>thinking</pattern> skills to analyze information objectively rather than accepting everything they read online.","translation":"學生被鼓勵培養批判性思考能力，以客觀分析資訊，而不是接受他們在網上讀到的所有內容。","explanation":"形容詞「批判的」。常用搭配 critical thinking (批判性思考)。"},{"sentence":"The professor was very <target>critical</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the student's research paper, pointing out several logical errors in the argument.","translation":"教授對學生的研究論文非常挑剔，指出了論證中的幾個邏輯錯誤。","explanation":"形容詞「挑剔的」。常用搭配 critical of (對...挑剔)。"},{"sentence":"After the severe car crash, the patient remained in <target>critical</target> condition in the hospital, and the doctors fought to save him.","translation":"在嚴重的車禍後，患者在醫院中仍處於危急狀態，醫生們努力救他。","explanation":"形容詞「危急的」。常用於醫療語境描述生命垂危。"}],"related_forms":["critic","criticism","criticize"]}

{"headword":"criticism","explanation":"名詞「批評；評論」。指對某事的不滿表達或專業的評估。注意 distinguish between (區分) criticism and praise (稱讚)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young artist learned to accept constructive <target>criticism</target> from her teachers to improve her painting techniques and style.","translation":"年輕的藝術家學會接受來自老師的建設性批評，以提升她的繪畫技巧和風格。","explanation":"名詞「批評」。常用搭配 constructive criticism (建設性批評)。"},{"sentence":"The government's new environmental policy faced severe <target>criticism</target> from activists who argued that it did not do enough to protect the forest.","translation":"政府的新環境政策面臨來自活動家的嚴重批評，他們認為該政策對保護森林做得不夠。","explanation":"名詞「批評」。指表達不滿或指責。"},{"sentence":"Literary <target>criticism</target> allows students to explore the deeper meanings of a novel by analyzing the author's use of language and symbols.","translation":"文學評論讓學生能夠透過分析作者對語言和符號的使用，來探索小說的深層意義。","explanation":"名詞「評論」。指對文學作品的專業分析。"}],"related_forms":["critic","critical","criticize"]}

{"headword":"criticize","explanation":"動詞「批評；指責」。指指出某人的缺點或錯誤。常用搭配 criticize someone for something (因某事而批評某人)。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is unfair to <target>criticize</target> the students <pattern>for</pattern> their mistakes when the teacher did not explain the instructions clearly enough.","translation":"當老師沒有將指令解釋得足夠清楚時，批評學生犯錯是不公平的。","explanation":"動詞「批評」。常用搭配 criticize someone for sth (因某事而批評某人)。"},{"sentence":"Many people <target>criticize</target> the city's public transportation system for being too slow and unreliable during the rush hour.","translation":"許多人批評城市的公共交通系統在尖峰時段太慢且不可靠。","explanation":"動詞「批評」。指指出系統或服務的缺陷。"},{"sentence":"Instead of just <target>criticizing</target> the problem, the student council proposed a practical solution to reduce waste in the school cafeteria.","translation":"學生會不再只是批評問題，而是提出了一個減少學校食堂垃圾的實際解決方案。","explanation":"動詞「批評」。指對問題表達不滿。"}],"related_forms":["critic","critical","criticism"]}

{"headword":"cruelty","explanation":"名詞「殘酷；殘忍」。指對他人或動物造成痛苦的行為。常用搭配 cruelty to animals (對動物的殘忍)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The animal rights group fought against the <target>cruelty</target> <pattern>to</pattern> animals in laboratories, demanding that all tests be replaced with safer methods.","translation":"動物權利組織反對實驗室中對動物的殘忍行為，要求所有測試都以更安全的方法取代。","explanation":"名詞「殘忍」。常用搭配 cruelty to animals (對動物的殘忍)。"},{"sentence":"Reading about the <target>cruelty</target> of war in history books made the students realize the importance of maintaining global peace and stability.","translation":"在歷史書中閱讀關於戰爭殘酷面的內容，讓學生意識到維護全球和平與穩定的重要性。","explanation":"名詞「殘酷」。指戰爭導致的痛苦與死亡。"},{"sentence":"The judge expressed deep anger at the <target>cruelty</target> shown by the defendant toward the homeless man, sentencing him to a long prison term.","translation":"法官對被告對一名無家可歸者的殘忍行為表示深切憤怒，判處其長期監禁。","explanation":"名詞「殘酷」。指刻意造成他人痛苦的行為。"}],"related_forms":["cruel"]}

{"headword":"crunchy","explanation":"形容詞「酥脆的」。常用於描述食物的質地，如 crunchy snacks (酥脆的零食) 或 crunchy cereal (酥脆的穀片)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many students prefer <target>crunchy</target> <pattern>snacks</pattern> like potato chips or apple slices while studying for their final exams in the library.","translation":"許多學生在圖書館準備期末考時，更喜歡吃像洋芋片或蘋果片這樣酥脆的零食。","explanation":"形容詞「酥脆的」。描述食物口感。"},{"sentence":"The fresh carrots were so <target>crunchy</target> and sweet that they became the most popular addition to the school cafeteria's salad.","translation":"新鮮的胡蘿蔔如此酥脆且甜美，以至於成為學校食堂沙拉中最受歡迎的添加物。","explanation":"形容詞「酥脆的」。"},{"sentence":"As the autumn leaves dried, they became <target>crunchy</target> <pattern>underfoot</pattern>, making a satisfying sound as the students walked to school.","translation":"隨著秋天的葉子變乾，它們在腳下變得酥脆，學生們走在去學校的路上時發出令人滿足的聲音。","explanation":"形容詞「酥脆的」。此處用於描述非食物的乾燥物體。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"crush","explanation":"動詞「壓碎；強力壓制」；名詞「壓碎；迷戀」。注意其在口語中常用於描述對某人的強烈但短暫的迷戀 (have a crush on someone)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hydraulic press was used to <target>crush</target> the old cars into small metal blocks for easier recycling in the factory.","translation":"液壓機被用來將舊車壓成小金屬塊，以便在工廠中更容易回收。","explanation":"動詞「壓碎」。指用力將物體壓扁或壓碎。"},{"sentence":"The dictator used his military power to <target>crush</target> the peaceful protest, showing a total disregard for the citizens' basic rights.","translation":"獨裁者利用軍事力量強力壓制和平抗議，顯示出對公民基本權利的完全漠視。","explanation":"動詞「強力壓制」。指用權力或武力消除反對意見。"},{"sentence":"Many teenagers experience their first <target>crush</target> during high school, often feeling nervous and shy when they are around that person.","translation":"許多青少年在高中時期經歷他們的第一個迷戀對象，在那個人的身邊時經常感到緊張和害羞。","explanation":"名詞「迷戀」。指對某人的強烈情感。"},{"sentence":"Sarah has <pattern>had</pattern> a <target>crush</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the captain of the basketball team for months, but she is too shy to tell him.","translation":"莎拉好幾個月來一直迷戀著籃球隊隊長，但她太害羞而不敢告訴他。","explanation":"名詞「迷戀」。常用片語 have a crush on someone。"}],"related_forms":["crushing","crushed"]}

{"headword":"cube","explanation":"名詞「正方體；冰塊」。動詞「將...切成正方體」。常考搭配：ice cube (冰塊)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The chemistry teacher used a plastic <target>cube</target> to demonstrate the concept of volume to the students in the science classroom.","translation":"化學老師在科學教室裡用一個塑膠正方體向學生演示體積的概念。","explanation":"名詞「正方體」。指形狀為正方體的物體。"},{"sentence":"He added a few <target>cubes</target> <pattern>of</pattern> ice to his lemonade to keep the drink cold during the hot summer afternoon.","translation":"他在檸檬水裡加了幾塊冰塊，以便在炎熱的夏日午後保持飲料冰涼。","explanation":"名詞「冰塊」。常用搭配 ice cube 或 cubes of ice。"},{"sentence":"The recipe for the fruit salad requires the chef to <target>cube</target> the watermelon and pineapple into small, equal pieces.","translation":"水果沙拉的食譜要求廚師將西瓜和鳳梨切成小而相等的正方體塊。","explanation":"動詞「將...切成正方體」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"cue","explanation":"名詞「暗示；信號」。動詞「給予暗示/信號」。常考片語：take a cue from (從...得到啟發/暗示)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The actor waited for his <target>cue</target> from the director before stepping onto the stage for the final scene of the play.","translation":"演員在踏上舞台表演最後一場戲之前，等待導演給他的信號。","explanation":"名詞「信號」。指表演中提示進入的信號。"},{"sentence":"When the teacher stopped talking and looked at the class, it was a clear <target>cue</target> for the students to be quiet.","translation":"當老師停止說話並看向全班時，這是一個明顯的暗示，讓學生們安靜下來。","explanation":"名詞「暗示」。指一種不需要言明而能被察覺的信號。"},{"sentence":"If you are unsure how to dress for the formal dinner, you can <target>take</target> a <target>cue</target> <pattern>from</pattern> your classmates' outfits.","translation":"如果你不確定正式晚餐該怎麼穿，你可以從同學的著裝中得到啟發。","explanation":"名詞「暗示/啟發」。片語 take a cue from sth。"},{"sentence":"The conductor <target>cued</target> the violinists to begin playing the melody together, creating a harmonious sound in the concert hall.","translation":"指揮向小提琴手示意開始共同演奏旋律，在音樂廳中創造出和諧的聲音。","explanation":"動詞「給予信號」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"cunning","explanation":"形容詞「狡猾的；靈巧的」。名詞「狡猾；機智」。注意其褒貶義之分：形容詞時常用於描述人的性格，通常帶有負面色彩（狡猾），但有時也可指靈巧的技巧。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>cunning</target> fox quickly found a way to steal the cheese from the crow, proving its reputation for being a clever animal.","translation":"狡猾的狐狸很快找到了偷走烏鴉奶酪的方法，證明了它作為聰明動物的名聲。","explanation":"形容詞「狡猾的」。指利用機智但不正當的手段達成目的。"},{"sentence":"The detective realized that the thief had used a <target>cunning</target> <pattern>plan</pattern> to enter the building without triggering any security alarms.","translation":"偵探意識到小偷使用了一個狡猾的計畫來進入建築物，而沒有觸發任何安檢警報。","explanation":"形容詞「狡猾的/靈巧的」。指計畫精巧但帶有欺騙性。"},{"sentence":"In the ancient fable, the protagonist's <target>cunning</target> allowed him to escape from the dangerous trap set by the giant.","translation":"在古代寓言中，主角的狡猾/機智使他能從巨人的危險陷阱中逃脫。","explanation":"名詞「狡猾；機智」。指一種能力。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"curiosity","explanation":"名詞「好奇心；奇珍異寶」。常用片語：out of curiosity (出於好奇)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young student's endless <target>curiosity</target> about space and stars led her to read dozens of astronomy books in the school library.","translation":"這名年輕學生對太空和星星的無盡好奇心，使她在學校圖書館閱讀了數十本天文學書籍。","explanation":"名詞「好奇心」。"},{"sentence":"I asked the teacher about the meaning of the word <pattern>out</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> <target>curiosity</target>, even though the lesson had already ended.","translation":"雖然課已經結束了，但我還是出於好奇詢問了老師關於這個單字的意思。","explanation":"名詞「好奇心」。片語 out of curiosity 表示「出於好奇」。"},{"sentence":"The museum's collection includes several rare <target>curiosities</target> from around the world, attracting many visitors who love unusual objects.","translation":"博物館的收藏包括來自世界各地的一些稀有奇珍異寶，吸引了許多喜歡不尋常物體的參觀者。","explanation":"名詞「奇珍異寶」。指不尋常且有趣的事物。"}],"related_forms":["curious"]}

{"headword":"curl","explanation":"名詞「捲曲；捲髮」。動詞「捲曲；使捲曲」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The girl spent an hour using a heating tool to <target>curl</target> her hair for the graduation party, hoping to look more elegant.","translation":"女孩花了一小時使用加熱工具將頭髮捲起來，為了參加畢業派對，希望看起來更優雅。","explanation":"動詞「使捲曲」。"},{"sentence":"The old photograph showed a woman with tight <target>curls</target> in her hair, which was a popular fashion style in the early twentieth century.","translation":"這張舊照片顯示一名女性留著緊湊的捲髮，這是二十世紀初流行的時尚風格。","explanation":"名詞「捲髮」。"},{"sentence":"As the heat increased, the edges of the old paper began to <target>curl</target> upward, making it difficult to read the ancient text.","translation":"隨著熱度增加，舊紙的邊緣開始向上捲曲，使得閱讀古代文字變得困難。","explanation":"動詞「捲曲」。指物體自然地彎曲。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"curse","explanation":"名詞「詛咒；禍根」。動詞「詛咒；咒罵」。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the fairy tale, the evil witch placed a <target>curse</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the princess, making her sleep for a hundred years.","translation":"在童話故事中，邪惡的巫婆對公主下了詛咒，使她睡了一百年。","explanation":"名詞「詛咒」。常用搭配 a curse on someone。"},{"sentence":"The sudden loss of his memory was a terrible <target>curse</target> for the musician, as he could no longer play the piano.","translation":"突然的記憶喪失對這名音樂家來說是一個可怕的禍根，因為他再也無法彈鋼琴了。","explanation":"名詞「禍根」。指帶來持續不幸的事物。"},{"sentence":"The angry driver began to <target>curse</target> loudly when his car was scratched by another vehicle in the parking lot.","translation":"當他的車在停車場被另一輛車刮到時，憤怒的駕駛開始大聲咒罵。","explanation":"動詞「咒罵」。指使用粗魯的語言。"},{"sentence":"Many people <target>cursed</target> the bad weather that ruined their long-awaited beach holiday, expressing their frustration through complaints.","translation":"許多人詛咒這糟糕的天氣，因為它毀了他們期待已久的沙灘假期，他們透過抱怨來表達沮喪。","explanation":"動詞「詛咒」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"curve","explanation":"名詞「曲線；彎曲處」。動詞「彎曲；使彎曲」。常用搭配：learning curve (學習曲線)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The road has a sharp <target>curve</target> ahead, so the driver must slow down to avoid sliding off the road in the rain.","translation":"前面有一段陡峭的彎道，所以駕駛在雨中必須減速，以避免滑出路外。","explanation":"名詞「彎曲處」。指道路或線條的彎曲部分。"},{"sentence":"The artist used a gentle <target>curve</target> in the drawing to create a sense of softness and movement in the portrait.","translation":"藝術家在畫作中使用溫柔的曲線，來在肖像畫中創造出一種柔軟感和動感。","explanation":"名詞「曲線」。"},{"sentence":"New students often face a steep <pattern>learning</pattern> <target>curve</target> when they first start learning a complex programming language like Python.","translation":"新學生在剛開始學習複雜的程式語言如 Python 時，經常面臨陡峭的學習曲線。","explanation":"名詞「學習曲線」。片語 learning curve 指學習某事所需時間與進度之比。"},{"sentence":"The gymnast <target>curved</target> her body into a perfect ball during the flip, showing her incredible flexibility and strength.","translation":"體操運動員在翻轉時將身體彎曲成一個完美的球形，展現了她驚人的靈活性和力量。","explanation":"動詞「彎曲」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"cushion","explanation":"名詞「墊子；緩衝」。動詞「緩衝；減輕」。","entries":[{"sentence":"She placed a soft <target>cushion</target> on the wooden chair to make it more comfortable for her to sit and read for hours.","translation":"她在木椅上放了一個柔軟的墊子，讓她坐著讀書幾個小時更舒適。","explanation":"名詞「墊子」。"},{"sentence":"The government provided financial aid to <target>cushion</target> <pattern>the blow</pattern> of the economic crisis for low-income families.","translation":"政府提供了財務援助，以緩衝經濟危機對低收入家庭的打擊。","explanation":"動詞「緩衝/減輕」。片語 cushion the blow 表示「減輕打擊/衝擊」。"},{"sentence":"The thick foam in the new running shoes is designed to <target>cushion</target> the impact on the feet during long distances.","translation":"新跑鞋中的厚泡沫旨在緩衝長距離奔跑時對腳部的衝擊。","explanation":"動詞「緩衝」。指物理上的減震。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"damp","explanation":"形容詞指「潮濕的」，通常指不舒服的微濕狀態；名詞指「潮濕」或「陰冷」；動詞則較少見，指「抑制」或「 damp down 減弱」。在 GSAT 中，最常考的是形容詞用法，注意與 wet (完全濕) 或 humid (氣候潮濕) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"Because of the rainy season, the basement felt <target>damp</target> and smelled of mold, making it an unpleasant place to store old books.","translation":"因為雨季，地下室感覺潮濕且有霉味，使其成為存放舊書的不快場所。","explanation":"形容詞「潮濕的」。描述環境或物品微濕且不舒服。"},{"sentence":"After walking through the heavy rain, her clothes were still <target>damp</target> even though she had dried them with a towel.","translation":"經過大雨行走後，她的衣服仍然微濕，儘管她已經用毛巾擦過了。","explanation":"形容詞「潮濕的」。"},{"sentence":"The cold <target>damp</target> of the winter morning made the students shiver as they waited for the school bus in the open air.","translation":"冬日早晨的陰冷潮濕讓學生們在戶外等校車時發抖。","explanation":"名詞「潮濕、陰冷」。"},{"sentence":"The government tried to <target>damp</target> <pattern>down</pattern> the public's excitement about the new policy to avoid unrealistic expectations.","translation":"政府試圖壓低大眾對新政策的興奮情緒，以避免不切實際的期望。","explanation":"動詞片語 damp down 表「抑制、減弱」。"}],"related_forms":["dampness","dampen"]}

{"headword":"deadline","explanation":"名詞「截止日期」。常用搭配：meet a deadline (趕上截止日期), miss a deadline (錯過截止日期), extend a deadline (延長截止日期)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students were stressed because they had to <pattern>meet</pattern> a strict <target>deadline</target> for their final history project by the end of the week.","translation":"學生們壓力很大，因為他們必須在週末前趕上最終歷史項目的嚴格截止日期。","explanation":"名詞「截止日期」。搭配 meet a deadline。"},{"sentence":"If you <pattern>miss</pattern> the <target>deadline</target> for the scholarship application, you will not be considered for the award regardless of your grades.","translation":"如果你錯過了獎學金申請的截止日期，無論你的成績如何，你都不會被考慮授予該獎項。","explanation":"名詞「截止日期」。搭配 miss a deadline。"},{"sentence":"The teacher decided to <pattern>extend</pattern> the <target>deadline</target> for the essay by two days to give students more time to revise their work.","translation":"老師決定將論文的截止日期延長兩天，給學生更多時間修改作品。","explanation":"名詞「截止日期」。搭配 extend a deadline。"}],"related_forms":["deadlines"]}

{"headword":"declare","explanation":"動詞「宣布」或「申報」。常用於正式場合的宣布，或在海關申報物品。常用搭配：declare that... (宣布...), declare war on... (向...宣戰), declare customs (海關申報)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The president officially <target>declared</target> that the city would be a holiday zone for the next month to celebrate the national festival.","translation":"總統正式宣布這座城市在下個月將成為度假區，以慶祝國家節日。","explanation":"動詞「宣布」。後接 that 子句。"},{"sentence":"When arriving at the airport, travelers must <target>declare</target> all expensive goods and alcohol they are carrying to the customs officers.","translation":"抵達機場時，旅客必須向海關人員申報所有攜帶的昂貴商品和酒精飲料。","explanation":"動詞「申報」。指在海關申報物品。"},{"sentence":"After months of tension, the two neighboring countries finally <target>declared</target> <pattern>war on</pattern> each other, leading to a major international conflict.","translation":"在數月的緊張局勢後，這兩個鄰國最終向彼此宣戰，導致了一場重大國際衝突。","explanation":"動詞「宣布」。搭配 declare war on。"}],"related_forms":["declaration"]}

{"headword":"decoration","explanation":"名詞「裝飾」或「裝飾品」。可指裝飾的行為或裝飾後的成品。常用搭配：holiday decorations (節日裝飾), interior decoration (室內裝飾)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students spent the entire afternoon putting up colorful <target>decorations</target> in the classroom to prepare for the upcoming winter party.","translation":"學生們花了一整個下午在教室裡布置彩色裝飾品，為即將到來的冬季派對做準備。","explanation":"名詞「裝飾品」。指具體的裝飾物件。"},{"sentence":"The interior <target>decoration</target> of the new library is modern and bright, creating a relaxing environment for students to study and read.","translation":"新圖書館的室內裝飾現代且明亮，為學生創造了一個放鬆學習和閱讀的環境。","explanation":"名詞「裝飾」。指整體的裝飾風格或設計。"},{"sentence":"She added a small lace <target>decoration</target> to the edge of the curtains to make the living room look more elegant and cozy.","translation":"她在窗簾邊緣增加了一個小蕾絲裝飾，使客廳看起來更優雅舒適。","explanation":"名詞「裝飾品」。"}],"related_forms":["decorate","decorative"]}

{"headword":"defeat","explanation":"動詞「擊敗」；名詞「失敗」或「挫敗」。注意其作為動詞時常接直接對象，而作為名詞時常搭配 admit defeat (承認失敗)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The national team worked hard during training and finally <target>defeated</target> their strongest opponent in the final match of the tournament.","translation":"國家隊在訓練期間努力工作，終於在錦標賽的決賽中擊敗了他們最強的對手。","explanation":"動詞「擊敗」。指在比賽或戰鬥中獲勝。"},{"sentence":"Although the small army was outnumbered, they managed to <target>defeat</target> the enemy by using a clever strategy and surprising attacks.","translation":"儘管小軍隊在人數上處於劣勢，他們仍設法通過使用聰明的策略和出其不意的攻擊擊敗了敵人。","explanation":"動詞「擊敗」。"},{"sentence":"After losing three games in a row, the captain of the team refused to <pattern>admit</pattern> <target>defeat</target> and encouraged his players to keep fighting.","translation":"在連續輸掉三場比賽後，球隊隊長拒絕承認失敗，並鼓勵他的球員繼續戰鬥。","explanation":"名詞「失敗、挫敗」。搭配 admit defeat。"},{"sentence":"The candidate suffered a crushing <target>defeat</target> in the election, losing most of the votes in the rural areas of the country.","translation":"該候選人在選舉中遭遇了慘敗，在該國農村地區失去了大部分選票。","explanation":"名詞「失敗」。指選舉或比賽中的慘敗。"}],"related_forms":["defeated"]}

{"headword":"defend","explanation":"動詞「防禦」或「辯護」。指保護某人或某物免於攻擊，或在法律或論辯中為其正當性提供理由。常用搭配：defend oneself (自我防衛), defend a title (衛冕)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The soldiers were ordered to <target>defend</target> the border with all their strength to prevent the enemy from entering the city.","translation":"士兵們接到命令，要竭盡全力防守邊境，防止敵人進入城市。","explanation":"動詞「防禦」。指保護某個地點免於攻擊。"},{"sentence":"When the other students criticized her idea, Sarah decided to <target>defend</target> her opinion with logic and strong evidence from her research.","translation":"當其他學生批評她的想法時，莎拉決定用邏輯和研究中的強力證據來為她的觀點辯護。","explanation":"動詞「辯護」。指為某種觀點或行為提供理由。"},{"sentence":"The champion tennis player is preparing to <target>defend</target> <pattern>his title</pattern> in the upcoming tournament next month.","translation":"這位冠軍網球選手正準備在下個月的錦標賽中衛冕他的冠軍頭銜。","explanation":"動詞「衛冕」。搭配 defend a title。"},{"sentence":"In a court of law, a lawyer is hired to <target>defend</target> the accused person and ensure that they receive a fair trial.","translation":"在法庭上，聘請律師是為了幫被告辯護並確保他們獲得公正的審判。","explanation":"動詞「辯護」。"}],"related_forms":["defense","defensible","defensive"]}

{"headword":"defense","explanation":"名詞「防禦」或「辯護」。注意 defense (美式) 和 defence (英式) 的拼寫區別。常用搭配：in defense of (為了辯護...), line of defense (防線)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city built a high stone wall as a first line of <target>defense</target> against the invading army from the north.","translation":"這座城市建造了一道高石牆，作為對抗北方入侵軍隊的第一道防線。","explanation":"名詞「防禦」。指物理上的防護措施。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer presented several pieces of evidence <pattern>in</pattern> <target>defense</target> <pattern>of</pattern> his client, arguing that the man had acted in self-defense.","translation":"律師提交了幾項證據為其客戶辯護，主張該男子是出於自我防衛而行動。","explanation":"名詞「辯護」。搭配 in defense of (為了辯護...)。"},{"sentence":"The basketball team has a very strong <target>defense</target>, making it almost impossible for the opposing team to score any points.","translation":"這支籃球隊有著非常強的防守，使得對手幾乎不可能得分。","explanation":"名詞「防守」。用於體育賽事中。"}],"related_forms":["defend","defensible","defensive"]}

{"headword":"defensible","explanation":"形容詞「可辯護的」或「可防禦的」。指某個觀點、決定或行為在邏輯上是站得住腳的，或者某個地點在地理上容易防守。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although many people disagreed with the manager's decision, his explanation made the choice <target>defensible</target> in the eyes of the board.","translation":"儘管許多人不同意經理的決定，但他的解釋使得這個選擇在董事會眼中是合理的。","explanation":"形容詞「可辯護的」。指決定在邏輯上可被接受。"},{"sentence":"The castle was built on a high cliff, making it a highly <target>defensible</target> position for the soldiers during the war.","translation":"城堡建在高懸崖上，使其在戰爭期間成為士兵們一個極其容易防守的位置。","explanation":"形容詞「可防禦的」。指地點容易防守。"},{"sentence":"The student's argument in the essay was not <target>defensible</target> because it lacked sufficient evidence and logical reasoning.","translation":"這名學生在論文中的論點是不成立的，因為它缺乏足夠的證據和邏輯推理。","explanation":"形容詞「可辯護的」。指論點站不住腳。"}],"related_forms":["defend","defense"]}

{"headword":"defensive","explanation":"形容詞「防禦性的」或「心態上防禦的」。可指物理上的防禦，也可指心理上的防禦（如感到被攻擊而變得敏感）。常用搭配：defensive driving (防禦性駕駛), on the defensive (處於防禦狀態)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The army adopted a <target>defensive</target> strategy to protect the capital city, focusing on building walls and preparing traps.","translation":"軍隊採取了防禦性策略以保護首都，重點在於建造牆壁和準備陷阱。","explanation":"形容詞「防禦性的」。指物理上的防禦。"},{"sentence":"When the teacher questioned his mistake, the student became <target>defensive</target> and started arguing that it was not his fault.","translation":"當老師質疑他的錯誤時，這個學生變得敏感且具防禦心，並開始爭辯說這不是他的錯。","explanation":"形容詞「防禦性的」。指心理上的防禦，表現為敏感或反擊。"},{"sentence":"To avoid accidents on the highway, the police encourage drivers to practice <target>defensive</target> <pattern>driving</pattern>, such as keeping a safe distance.","translation":"為了避免高速公路上的事故，警方鼓勵駕駛者練習防禦性駕駛，例如保持安全距離。","explanation":"形容詞「防禦性的」。搭配 defensive driving。"},{"sentence":"The politician was <pattern>on</pattern> the <target>defensive</target> throughout the interview, struggling to explain the controversy surrounding his campaign.","translation":"這位政治家在整個採訪過程中都處於防禦狀態，努力解釋圍繞在他競選活動中的爭議。","explanation":"形容詞「防禦性的」。搭配 on the defensive (處於防禦狀態)。"}],"related_forms":["defend","defense"]}

{"headword":"definite","explanation":"形容詞「明確的」或「確定的」。指沒有模糊地帶或疑問的。常用搭配：a definite answer (明確的答案), definite evidence (確定的證據)。注意與 definite (明確的) 和 indefinite (不確定的) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"We are still waiting for a <target>definite</target> <pattern>answer</pattern> from the university, so we cannot decide which city to move to yet.","translation":"我們還在等待大學的明確答案，所以我們還不能決定要搬到哪個城市。","explanation":"形容詞「明確的」。搭配 a definite answer。"},{"sentence":"The police have <target>definite</target> <pattern>proof</pattern> that the suspect was at the crime scene, making it easy to convict him in court.","translation":"警方有確定的證據證明嫌疑人當時在犯罪現場，使其在法庭上很容易定罪。","explanation":"形容詞「確定的」。搭配 definite proof (確定的證據)。"},{"sentence":"There is no <target>definite</target> way to predict the weather perfectly, but scientists use advanced computers to make better guesses.","translation":"沒有一種明確的方法可以完美預測天氣，但科學家使用先進的電腦來做出更好的推測。","explanation":"形容詞「明確的」。"},{"sentence":"The teacher gave us a <target>definite</target> <pattern>deadline</pattern> for the project, which means we must submit it by Friday afternoon.","translation":"老師給了我們一個明確的截止日期，這意味著我們必須在週五下午提交。","explanation":"形容詞「明確的」。搭配 definite deadline。"}],"related_forms":["definitely","definition"]}

{"headword":"delicate","explanation":"形容詞「精緻的、脆弱的、微妙的」。指物體構造精巧或易碎，或指人皮膚嬌嫩、身體虛弱。在 GSAT 中常考「微妙的」或「需要小心處理的」含義，如 a delicate balance (微妙的平衡)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The old painting was so <target>delicate</target> that the museum staff had to handle it with extreme care to avoid any damage.","translation":"這幅古畫如此精緻脆弱，博物館的工作人員必須極其小心地搬運，以避免任何損壞。","explanation":"形容詞「精緻的、脆弱的」。指物體構造精巧或易碎。"},{"sentence":"The diplomats spent hours discussing the <target>delicate</target> issue of border disputes, hoping to reach an agreement without causing further conflict.","translation":"外交官們花了好幾個小時討論邊境爭端這個微妙的問題，希望在不引起進一步衝突的情況下達成協議。","explanation":"形容詞「微妙的」。指需要小心處理的情況或問題。"},{"sentence":"She has <target>delicate</target> skin that burns easily in the sun, so she always applies sunscreen before going outdoors.","translation":"她的皮膚很嬌嫩，在陽光下很容易曬傷，所以她總是在出門前塗抹防曬霜。","explanation":"形容詞「嬌嫩的」。指皮膚或身體組織容易受損。"}],"related_forms":["delicately","delicateness"]}

{"headword":"delight","explanation":"名詞「欣喜、樂趣」；動詞「使高興」。常考片語 take delight in (以...為樂) 或 to someone's delight (令某人欣喜的是)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young children <target>took</target> <pattern>delight</pattern> <pattern>in</pattern> playing with the colorful bubbles in the garden, laughing loudly as they popped.","translation":"年幼的孩子們以在花園裡玩彩色泡泡為樂，在泡泡破裂時大聲笑著。","explanation":"名詞「欣喜、樂趣」。常用片語 take delight in sth (以...為樂)。"},{"sentence":"The unexpected visit from her grandmother <target>delighted</target> her, making her smile for the rest of the afternoon.","translation":"祖母意外的到訪令她很高興，讓她整個下午都帶著微笑。","explanation":"動詞「使高興」。指讓某人感到極大的快樂。"},{"sentence":"To the <target>delight</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the entire audience, the magician performed a final trick that seemed completely impossible.","translation":"令全場觀眾欣喜的是，魔術師表演了一個看似完全不可能的最後把戲。","explanation":"名詞「欣喜」。常用搭配 to the delight of someone。"}],"related_forms":["delighted","delightful"]}

{"headword":"delightful","explanation":"形容詞「令人愉快的、迷人的」。通常用於描述環境、經驗或人的性格。","entries":[{"sentence":"We spent a <target>delightful</target> afternoon walking through the small village and chatting with the friendly local residents.","translation":"我們在小村莊裡散步並與友好的當地居民聊天，度過了一個愉快的下午。","explanation":"形容詞「令人愉快的」。描述經驗或時間。"},{"sentence":"The hotel garden was <target>delightful</target>, filled with rare tropical flowers and the soothing sound of a small waterfall.","translation":"酒店的花園非常迷人，種滿了稀有的熱帶花卉，並伴隨著小瀑布舒緩的聲音。","explanation":"形容詞「迷人的」。描述環境或景色。"},{"sentence":"The new exchange student is a <target>delightful</target> person who always brings positive energy to our class discussions.","translation":"這位新來的交換學生是一個非常討人喜歡的人，總是為我們的課堂討論帶來正能量。","explanation":"形容詞「令人愉快的」。描述人的性格。"}],"related_forms":["delight","delightfully"]}

{"headword":"demand","explanation":"名詞「需求、要求」；動詞「要求、需要」。注意 demand 作為動詞時，其賓語子句常使用 an should be implied (虛擬語氣) 或直接接 that 子句。在經濟學中， demand refers to the quantity of a good that consumers are willing to buy.","entries":[{"sentence":"The company <target>demands</target> that all employees <pattern>submit</pattern> their reports <pattern>by</pattern> Friday afternoon to ensure the project stays on schedule.","translation":"公司要求所有員工在週五下午前提交報告，以確保項目按計劃進行。","explanation":"動詞「要求」。接 that 子句，子句中動詞使用原形（虛擬語氣）。"},{"sentence":"Due to the sudden rise in popularity of the new game, there has been a <pattern>huge</pattern> <target>demand</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the latest gaming consoles.","translation":"由於這款新遊戲突然走紅，市場對最新遊戲主機的需求量巨大。","explanation":"名詞「需求」。常用搭配 a demand for sth。"},{"sentence":"The workers <target>demanded</target> <pattern>a higher salary</pattern> and better working conditions before they agreed to return to the factory.","translation":"工人們要求提高薪水和改善工作條件，然後他們才同意回到工廠。","explanation":"動詞「要求」。指強烈要求某事。"},{"sentence":"Learning a second language <target>demands</target> <pattern>a great deal of</pattern> patience and constant practice over a long period of time.","translation":"學習第二語言需要大量的耐心和長時間的持續練習。","explanation":"動詞「需要」。指某事需要特定的特質或努力。"}],"related_forms":["demanding"]}

{"headword":"demonstrate","explanation":"動詞「證明、論證、示範、遊行」。常考用法：demonstrate that... (證明...) 或 demonstrate how to... (示範如何...)。注意與 prove 的區別：demonstrate 更強調通過證據或實例來展示展示出某事，而 prove 則更強調最終的結論。","entries":[{"sentence":"The science teacher <target>demonstrated</target> <pattern>how to</pattern> conduct the experiment safely by showing the students the correct steps one by one.","translation":"科學老師示範了如何安全地進行實驗，向學生們一步步展示正確的步驟。","explanation":"動詞「示範」。指通過行動展示如何做某事。"},{"sentence":"Recent studies <target>demonstrate</target> <pattern>that</pattern> regular exercise can significantly improve a person's mental health and reduce stress levels.","translation":"最近的研究證明了定期運動可以顯著改善一個人的心理健康並降低壓力水平。","explanation":"動詞「證明」。指通過證據或研究結果來論證某事。"},{"sentence":"Thousands of people gathered in the city center to <target>demonstrate</target> <pattern>against</pattern> the new government policy on environmental protection.","translation":"數千人聚集在市中心，抗議新政府的環境保護政策。","explanation":"動詞「遊行抗議」。常用搭配 demonstrate against sth。"}],"related_forms":["demonstration"]}
