{"headword":"demonstration","explanation":"名詞「示範、證明、遊行」。由 demonstrate 衍生而來。常用搭配：a demonstration of (某事的示範/證明)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The software company provided a free <target>demonstration</target> <pattern>of</pattern> their new app, allowing potential customers to see its useful features.","translation":"這家軟體公司為其新應用程式提供了一次免費示範，讓潛在客戶能看到其有用的功能。","explanation":"名詞「示範」。指通過行動展示某事。"},{"sentence":"The sudden increase in temperature was a clear <target>demonstration</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the long-term effects of global warming on the planet.","translation":"溫度的突然升高是全球暖化對地球長期影響的一個明顯證明。","explanation":"名詞「證明」。指作為證據地證明某事。"},{"sentence":"The police were called to manage the large <target>demonstration</target> in the street, as the protesters were blocking the main road.","translation":"警察被召喚來管理街道上的大規模遊行，因為抗議者正堵塞主路。","explanation":"名詞「遊行」。指為了表達意見而進行的集體行動。"}],"related_forms":["demonstrate"]}

{"headword":"dense","explanation":"形容詞「濃密的、稠密的」。可用於描述森林、霧氣、人口密度等。常用搭配：dense fog (濃霧), dense population (稠密的人口)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The driver had to slow down significantly because of the <target>dense</target> <pattern>fog</pattern> that covered the entire highway during the early morning.","translation":"由於清晨整個高速公路被濃霧覆蓋，司機不得不大幅減速。","explanation":"形容詞「濃密的」。描述霧氣。"},{"sentence":"Many animals find shelter in the <target>dense</target> <pattern>forests</pattern> of the Amazon, where the thick leaves block most of the sunlight.","translation":"許多動物在亞馬遜的濃密森林中尋找庇護，那裡的厚葉子遮擋了大部分陽光。","explanation":"形容詞「濃密的」。描述森林或植被。"},{"sentence":"Taipei is a city with a <target>dense</target> <pattern>population</pattern>, which means that housing is often expensive and space is limited.","translation":"台北是一個人口稠密的城市，，這意味著住房通常很昂貴且空間有限。","explanation":"形容詞「稠密的」。描述人口密度。"}],"related_forms":["density","densely"]}

{"headword":"depart","explanation":"動詞「離開、出發」。常用片語 depart from (從...離開)。注意與 leave 的區別：depart 更正式，常用於交通工具的時刻表。","entries":[{"sentence":"The train is scheduled to <target>depart</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the main station at 8:00 AM, so please arrive at least thirty minutes early.","translation":"火車預計於上午 8 點從主車站出發，所以請至少提前 30 分鐘到達。","explanation":"動詞「離開」。常用片語 depart from (從...離開)。"},{"sentence":"As the plane <target>departed</target> for New York, the passengers looked out the window to see the city shrinking below them.","translation":"當飛機飛往紐約時，乘客們看向窗外，看著城市在下方逐漸縮小。","explanation":"動詞「出發」。指交通工具離開目的地。"},{"sentence":"In his latest book, the author decided to <target>depart</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the traditional style of writing, trying a new and experimental approach.","translation":"在他的最新一本書中，作者決定背離傳統的寫作風格，嘗試一種全新的實驗性方法。","explanation":"動詞片語 depart from (背離/偏離)。指不再遵循某種習慣或標準。"}],"related_forms":["departure","departed"]}

{"headword":"departure","explanation":"名詞「離開、出發」。由 depart 衍生而來。常用搭配：departure gate (登機門), departure time (出發時間)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please check the <target>departure</target> <pattern>board</pattern> to find out which gate your flight is leaving from and what time it starts boarding.","translation":"請檢查出發公告板，以找出您的航班從哪個登機門出發以及什麼時候開始登機。","explanation":"名詞「出發」。指交通工具的離開。"},{"sentence":"The sudden <target>departure</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the head coach caused a lot of confusion among the players and the school's athletic department.","translation":"總教練的突然離開導致球員們和學校體育部門之間產生了許多混亂。","explanation":"名詞「離開」。指人的離開或職位卸任。"},{"sentence":"Changing the school's grading system was a significant <target>departure</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the traditional methods used for decades.","translation":"改變學校的成績評分系統是一個顯著的背離，與數十年來使用傳統方法截然不同。","explanation":"名詞片語 departure from (背離/偏離)。指與以往的不同。"}],"related_forms":["depart"]}

{"headword":"dependent","explanation":"形容詞「依賴的、視...而定的」；名詞「受扶養者」。形容詞用法常考片語 dependent on (依賴於...)。注意與 independent (獨立的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many young children are completely <target>dependent</target> <pattern>on</pattern> their parents for food, clothing and basic care in their early years.","translation":"許多年幼的孩子在早年完全依賴他們的父母提供食物、衣服和基本照顧。","explanation":"形容詞「依賴的」。常用片語 dependent on (依賴於...)"},{"sentence":"The success of our outdoor graduation party <target>is</target> <pattern>dependent</pattern> <pattern>on</pattern> the weather, so we have a backup plan in case of rain.","translation":"我們戶外畢業派對的成功取決於天氣，所以我們準備了一個備案，以防下雨。","explanation":"形容詞「視...而定」。指某事的结果取决于另一件事。"},{"sentence":"The government provides special financial assistance to parents who have three or more <target>dependents</target> in their household.","translation":"政府為家中擁有三名或更多受扶養者的父母提供特殊的財務援助。","explanation":"名詞「受扶養者」。指需要他人照顧的人，如小孩或老人。"}],"related_forms":["depend","dependence","independent"]}

{"headword":"depression","explanation":"名詞，具有多種含義。最常見的是指心理上的「憂鬱」或「沮喪」，以及經濟上的「大蕭條」或「不景氣」。此外，在地理或物理上可指「凹陷」。在 GSAT 中，重點在於心理狀態和經濟術語的區分。","entries":[{"sentence":"After losing his job and facing financial difficulties, he fell into a deep <target>depression</target> and struggled to find motivation for his daily life.","translation":"在失去工作並面臨財務困難後，他陷入了深深的憂鬱，努力在日常生活中尋找動力。","explanation":"名詞「憂鬱、沮喪」。指心理上的低落狀態。"},{"sentence":"The Great <target>Depression</target> of the 1930s caused widespread poverty and unemployment, leading to a global economic crisis that lasted for years.","translation":"1930年代的大蕭條導致了廣泛的貧困和失業，引發了一場持續多年的全球經濟危機。","explanation":"名詞「大蕭條、經濟不景氣」。指長期且嚴重的經濟衰退。"},{"sentence":"The geologist pointed out a shallow <target>depression</target> in the ground, where water collected during the rainy season to form a small pond.","translation":"地質學家指出地面上的一個淺凹陷處，雨季時水會在此聚集形成一個小池塘。","explanation":"名詞「凹陷」。指地表或物體表面上的低窪處。"}],"related_forms":["depressed","depressing"]}

{"headword":"deserve","explanation":"動詞「值得」。用於描述某人因為其行為、品質或努力而應該獲得某種結果（無論好壞）。常接賓語或 to V 結構，例如 deserve a reward (值得獎勵) 或 deserve to be punished (值得被懲罰)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After working tirelessly for months on the science project, the students <target>deserved</target> a break and a celebratory dinner together.","translation":"在科學計畫中不懈地工作了數月後，學生們值得一次休息以及一起享用一頓慶祝晚餐。","explanation":"動詞「值得」。指應得的獎勵或休息。"},{"sentence":"The brave firefighter <target>deserves</target> <pattern>to be</pattern> honored for his courage in saving people from the burning building during the earthquake.","translation":"勇敢的消防員因為在地震期間將人們從燃燒的建築中救出而展現的勇氣，值得被表彰。","explanation":"動詞「值得」。常用結構 deserve to be + 過去分詞，表示「值得被...」。"}],"related_forms":["deserving"]}

{"headword":"desperate","explanation":"形容詞「絕望的」或「極其渴望的」。前者指在困難情況下感到失去希望；後者指因為處於窘迫境地而強烈地想要某物。注意其搭配，例如 desperate for (渴望) 或 desperate to V (渴望做某事)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The lost hikers were <target>desperate</target> <pattern>for</pattern> water and food after wandering in the dense forest for three days without any supplies.","translation":"迷路的登山客在茂密的森林中徘徊三天且沒有任何補給後，極其渴望水和食物。","explanation":"形容詞「極其渴望的」。常用搭配 desperate for sth。"},{"sentence":"Feeling <target>desperate</target>, the man tried every possible way to find his missing dog, but unfortunately, no one had seen the animal.","translation":"感到絕望，這個男人嘗試了所有可能的方法來尋找他失蹤的狗，但不幸的是，沒有人見過這隻動物。","explanation":"形容詞「絕望的」。指在極端困難的情況下失去希望。"},{"sentence":"The government is <target>desperate</target> <pattern>to</pattern> find a solution to the housing crisis to prevent further social unrest among the citizens.","translation":"政府極其渴望找到解決住房危機的方案，以防止公民之間進一步的社會動盪。","explanation":"形容詞「渴望的」。常用搭配 desperate to V。"}],"related_forms":["desperately","desperation"]}

{"headword":"despite","explanation":"介係詞「儘管」。後接名詞或代名詞，不能接子句。注意與 despite the fact that... 或 in spite of 的區別：despite 是介係詞，而 although 和 even though 是連接詞，後接子句。","entries":[{"sentence":"The team won the championship <target>despite</target> their lack of experience and the strong opposition from the opposing team.","translation":"儘管缺乏經驗且面對對手強大的反對，該團隊仍贏得了冠軍。","explanation":"介係詞「儘管」。後接名詞短語 their lack of experience。"},{"sentence":"The elderly woman continued to walk to the market <target>despite</target> the heavy rain and the strong wind blowing from the north.","translation":"儘管下著大雨且北風強勁，這位年長的女性仍繼續走向市場。","explanation":"介係詞「儘管」。後接名詞短語 the heavy rain。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"destruction","explanation":"名詞「破壞、摧毀」。指將某物徹底摧毀或使其無法運作的狀態。常用搭配：cause destruction (造成破壞), total destruction (完全摧毀)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The powerful earthquake caused widespread <target>destruction</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the city's infrastructure, leaving thousands of people without homes and electricity.","translation":"強大的地震對城市的基礎設施造成了廣泛的破壞，導致數千人失去家園和電力。","explanation":"名詞「破壞」。常用搭配 cause destruction to sth。"},{"sentence":"The <target>destruction</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the ancient rainforest was caused by illegal logging, leading to the loss of many rare species of plants and animals.","translation":"古代雨林的摧毀是由於非法伐木造成的，導致許多稀有植物和動物物種的喪失。","explanation":"名詞「摧毀」。常用搭配 destruction of sth。"}],"related_forms":["destroy","destructive"]}

{"headword":"detective","explanation":"名詞「偵探」；形容詞「偵查的」。名詞用法最常見，指負責調查犯罪或神秘事件的人員。在 GSAT 中，重點在於其名詞形式及其相關的調查過程描述。","entries":[{"sentence":"The experienced <target>detective</target> carefully examined the evidence at the crime scene to identify the suspect and solve the mystery.","translation":"經驗豐富的偵探仔細檢查了犯罪現場的證據，以辨識嫌疑犯並解開謎團。","explanation":"名詞「偵探」。指負責調查犯罪的人員。"},{"sentence":"The police used advanced <target>detective</target> <pattern>work</pattern> to track the stolen jewelry and recover it from the hidden warehouse in the suburbs.","translation":"警方利用先進的偵查工作，追蹤到被盜的珠寶並從郊區的隱藏倉庫中將其找回。","explanation":"形容詞「偵查的」。常用搭配 detective work (偵查工作)。"}],"related_forms":["detect","detection"]}

{"headword":"determination","explanation":"名詞「決心」或「決定」。在 GSAT 中，最常考的是指一個人強烈的意願要達成某著目標的意願。常用搭配：show determination (展現決心), with determination (帶著決心)。","entries":[{"sentence":"With great <target>determination</target>, the athlete trained every single day for four years to achieve his dream of winning an Olympic gold medal.","translation":"帶著強大的決心，這位運動員四年來每天訓練，以實現贏得奧運金牌的夢想。","explanation":"名詞「決心」。指強烈的意願。"},{"sentence":"The committee's final <target>determination</target> <pattern>regarding</pattern> the new school policy was announced after a long and intense debate among the members.","translation":"委員會關於新學校政策的最終決定在成員之間經過長時間且激烈的辯論後公布。","explanation":"名詞「決定」。指經過考慮後的正式決定。"}],"related_forms":["determined"]}

{"headword":"device","explanation":"名詞「裝置、設備」或「手段、技巧」。最常用於指電子設備或小型機械。在 GSAT 中，常出現於科技類文章中，指代代一個具體地實體設備。","entries":[{"sentence":"The modern smartphone is a versatile <target>device</target> that allows people to communicate, access information, and manage their schedules all in one place.","translation":"現代智慧型手機是一個多功能的裝置，允許人們在一個地方進行溝通、獲取資訊並管理他們的行程。","explanation":"名詞「裝置」。指電子設備。"},{"sentence":"The scientist invented a new <target>device</target> <pattern>for</pattern> measuring air quality, which can detect small amounts of pollution in the atmosphere.","translation":"科學家發明了一種用於測量空氣品質的新裝置，能偵測到大氣中微量的污染。","explanation":"名詞「裝置」。常用搭配 device for V-ing。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"devise","explanation":"動詞「設計、發明、想出」。指通過思考和思考，創造出一個新的方法、計畫或系統。常用搭配：devise a plan (想出計畫), devise a system (設計系統)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The engineers had to <target>devise</target> <pattern>a new way</pattern> to strengthen the bridge's structure to withstand the strong winds and potential earthquakes.","translation":"工程師們必須想出一種新方法來加強橋樑的結構，以承受強風和潛在的地震。","explanation":"動詞「想出、設計」。指創造出一個新的解決方案。"},{"sentence":"To improve student performance, the school <target>devised</target> <pattern>a special program</pattern> that encouraged students to practice speaking English in daily conversations.","translation":"為了提高學生表現，學校設計了一個特別計畫，鼓勵學生在日常對話中練習說英語。","explanation":"動詞「設計」。指制定一個計畫或系統。"}],"related_forms":["device"]}

{"headword":"devote","explanation":"動詞「奉獻、致力於」。常用搭配：devote sth to sth/sb (將某事奉獻給某人/某事)。注意 to 是介係詞，因此後接名詞或動名詞 (V-ing)，而非原形動詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor decided to <target>devote</target> <pattern>his entire life to</pattern> helping the poor and providing free medical care in remote villages.","translation":"這位醫生決定將他的一生奉獻給幫助窮人以及在偏遠村落提供免費醫療。","explanation":"動詞「奉獻」。常用搭配 devote sth to sth/sb，to 為介係詞。"},{"sentence":"Many students <target>devote</target> <pattern>a significant amount of time to</pattern> studying for the GSAT, hoping to enter their desired university and major.","translation":"許多學生將大量的時間致力於準備 GSAT，希望進入他們理想的大學和專業。","explanation":"動詞「致力於」。常用搭配 devote time to V-ing。"}],"related_forms":["devotion","devoted"]}

{"headword":"dew","explanation":"名詞「露水」。指清晨出現在植物葉片或地面上的小水滴。常用於描述自然環境或文學語境。","entries":[{"sentence":"The grass was wet with morning <target>dew</target> when the students walked to school, making their shoes slightly damp.","translation":"學生們走路去學校時，草地上的晨露讓他們的鞋子稍微受潮。","explanation":"名詞「露水」。"},{"sentence":"Early in the morning, tiny droplets of <target>dew</target> glittered like diamonds on the flower petals in the garden.","translation":"清晨，花瓣上的小露珠像鑽石一樣閃閃發光。","explanation":"名詞「露水」。"},{"sentence":"As the sun rose higher in the sky, the cold morning <target>dew</target> slowly evaporated from the leaves of the trees.","translation":"隨著太陽升起，清晨的露水慢慢從樹葉上蒸發了。","explanation":"名詞「露水」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"diagram","explanation":"名詞「圖表、示意圖」；動詞「用圖表表示」。常用於學術報告或教科書中，用以簡化複雜的過程或結構。注意搭配 draw a diagram (畫圖表)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The biology teacher asked the students to <pattern>draw</pattern> a <target>diagram</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the human heart to better understand its blood flow.","translation":"生物老師要求學生畫一張人體心臟的示意圖，以便更好地理解其血流方向。","explanation":"名詞「示意圖」。常用搭配 draw a diagram of sth。"},{"sentence":"To explain the complex water cycle, the presenter used a clear <target>diagram</target> on the screen to show how water evaporates and rains.","translation":"為了解釋複雜的水循環，報告者在螢幕上使用了一張清晰的圖表來展示水如何蒸發和下雨。","explanation":"名詞「圖表」。"},{"sentence":"The manual <target>diagrams</target> the assembly process step by step, showing exactly where each screw should be placed.","translation":"這本手冊逐步地用圖表表示了組裝過程，明確顯示了每顆螺絲應該放在哪裡。","explanation":"動詞「用圖表表示」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"differ","explanation":"動詞「不同、有差異」；「意見分歧」。常用於比較兩者或多者。注意搭配 differ from (與...不同), differ in (在...方面不同), differ with (與...意見不合)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although the two brothers look very similar, their personalities <target>differ</target> <pattern>greatly</pattern> <pattern>from</pattern> each other in terms of hobbies.","translation":"儘管這對兄弟長得很像，但他們的性格在愛好方面截然不同。","explanation":"動詞「不同」。常用搭配 differ from sth/sb。"},{"sentence":"The two political parties <target>differ</target> <pattern>in</pattern> their approach to solving the current economic crisis, leading to long debates.","translation":"這兩個政黨在解決目前經濟危機的方法上有所不同，導致了長久的辯論。","explanation":"動詞「在...方面不同」。常用搭配 differ in sth。"},{"sentence":"I <target>differ</target> <pattern>with</pattern> you on this issue because I believe the students should have more freedom to choose their courses.","translation":"我在這個問題上與你意見不合，因為我認為學生應該有更多選擇課程的自由。","explanation":"動詞「意見分歧」。常用搭配 differ with sb。"},{"sentence":"The results of the two experiments <target>differed</target> <pattern>significantly</pattern>, forcing the scientists to review their initial data again.","translation":"這兩次實驗的結果顯著不同，迫使科學家再次審視他們的初始數據。","explanation":"動詞「不同」。"}],"related_forms":["different","difference"]}

{"headword":"digest","explanation":"動詞「消化（食物或資訊）」；名詞「文摘、摘要」。動詞用法中，digest 資訊指將其理解並吸收。注意與 digest (n.) 的發音區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"After a heavy meal, some people find it helpful to take a short walk to help their body <target>digest</target> the food more quickly.","translation":"在大餐後，有些人發現散步有助於身體更快地消化食物。","explanation":"動詞「消化（食物）」。"},{"sentence":"The lecture was so full of complex information that the students needed a few days to <target>digest</target> everything the professor said.","translation":"這場講座充滿了複雜的資訊，學生們需要幾天時間來消化教授所說的一切。","explanation":"動詞「消化（資訊、理解）」。"},{"sentence":"The monthly <target>digest</target> provides a brief summary of the most important news stories from around the world for busy professionals.","translation":"這份月度文摘為繁忙的專業人士提供了全球最重要新聞故事的簡短摘要。","explanation":"名詞「文摘、摘要」。"}],"related_forms":["digestion","digestible"]}

{"headword":"digital","explanation":"形容詞「數位的」。指使用 0 和 1 的二進位系統處理資訊。常用於描述科技產品或時代，如 digital age (數位時代), digital device (數位裝置)。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the <target>digital</target> <pattern>age</pattern>, students can easily access a vast amount of knowledge through the internet and online libraries.","translation":"在數位時代，學生可以輕鬆地透過網路和線上圖書館獲取海量知識。","explanation":"形容詞「數位的」。常用搭配 digital age。"},{"sentence":"The school replaced the old analog clocks with <target>digital</target> <pattern>clocks</pattern> to provide students with the exact time to the second.","translation":"學校將舊的類比時鐘更換為數位時鐘，以便為學生提供精確到秒的時間。","explanation":"形容詞「數位的」。常用搭配 digital clock。"},{"sentence":"Many artists now use <target>digital</target> <pattern>tools</pattern>, such as tablets and software, to create stunning artwork without using traditional paint.","translation":"許多藝術家現在使用數位工具，如平板電腦和軟體，來創作令人驚嘆的藝術品而無需使用傳統油漆。","explanation":"形容詞「數位的」。常用搭配 digital tools。"}],"related_forms":["digitize","digitally"]}

{"headword":"dignity","explanation":"名詞「尊嚴、莊重」。指一個人被尊重地對待的權利或一種穩重地行為舉止。常用搭配 preserve one's dignity (維護尊嚴), lose one's dignity (失去尊嚴)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Even though he lost the competition, the athlete handled the defeat with <target>dignity</target>, shaking hands with the winner politely.","translation":"儘管他輸了比賽，這位運動員仍以尊嚴面對失敗，禮貌地與贏家握手。","explanation":"名詞「尊嚴」。"},{"sentence":"Every human being, regardless of their social status or wealth, deserves to be treated with <target>dignity</target> and respect.","translation":"每個人，無論其社會地位或財富，都應該被尊嚴地對待並受到尊重。","explanation":"名詞「尊嚴」。常用搭配 treat with dignity。"},{"sentence":"The elderly woman maintained her <target>dignity</target> by refusing to ask for help, preferring to do everything by herself.","translation":"這位年長的女性透過拒絕請求幫助，堅持由自己完成所有事情，以此維護她的尊嚴。","explanation":"名詞「尊嚴」。"}],"related_forms":["dignified"]}

{"headword":"diligence","explanation":"名詞「勤勉、勤奮」。指持續地努力工作或學習。常用搭配 show diligence (表現出勤勉), with diligence (勤奮地)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher praised the student for her <target>diligence</target> in studying English, as she always completed her homework on time.","translation":"老師稱讚這名學生學習英文的勤勉，因為她總是準時完成作業。","explanation":"名詞「勤勉」。"},{"sentence":"Success in academic research requires not only intelligence but also great <target>diligence</target> to gather and analyze data carefully.","translation":"學術研究的成功不僅需要智力，還需要極大的勤奮來仔細地收集和分析數據。","explanation":"名詞「勤奮」。"},{"sentence":"Through constant <target>diligence</target> and hard work, the young musician managed to master the difficult piano piece in a month.","translation":"透過不斷的勤勉和努力，這位年輕的音樂家在一個月內掌握了這首困難的鋼琴曲。","explanation":"名詞「勤奮」。"}],"related_forms":["diligent"]}

{"headword":"diligent","explanation":"形容詞「勤奮的」。指對工作或學習認真且持續地努力。常用於描述學生或員工。","entries":[{"sentence":"The most <target>diligent</target> students in the class usually achieve the best grades because they review their notes carefully every day.","translation":"班上最勤奮的學生通常能獲得最好的成績，因為他們每天仔細複習筆記。","explanation":"形容詞「勤奮的」。"},{"sentence":"The manager hired her because she was a <target>diligent</target> worker who always paid attention to the smallest details of the project.","translation":"經理聘請她是因為她是一名勤奮的員工，總是關注項目的每一個微小細節。","explanation":"形容詞「勤奮的」。"},{"sentence":"Despite the difficult circumstances, the <target>diligent</target> researcher continued to collect samples from the remote forest for several months.","translation":"儘管環境艱難，這位勤奮的研究員仍持續數月在偏遠的森林中收集樣本。","explanation":"形容詞「勤奮的」。"}],"related_forms":["diligence","diligently"]}

{"headword":"diploma","explanation":"名詞「畢業證書、文憑」。指完成某個教育階段或課程後獲得的官方證明。常用搭配 earn a diploma (獲得文憑), receive a diploma (領取證書)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After four years of hard work at the university, the students were proud to finally <pattern>receive</pattern> their <target>diplomas</target> during the ceremony.","translation":"在大學四年的努力之後，學生們很自豪地在典禮上領取了他們的畢業證書。","explanation":"名詞「畢業證書」。常用搭配 receive a diploma。"},{"sentence":"Many people decide to go to vocational schools to earn a <target>diploma</target> in a specific skill, such as automotive repair or nursing.","translation":"許多人決定去職業學校以獲得特定技能的文憑，例如汽車維修或護理。","explanation":"名詞「文憑」。常用搭配 earn a diploma。"},{"sentence":"The job application requires candidates to upload a scanned copy of their high school <target>diploma</target> as proof of education.","translation":"工作申請要求應徵者上傳高中畢業證書的掃描件作為教育證明。","explanation":"名詞「畢業證書」。"}],"related_forms":["diplomas"]}

{"headword":"diplomat","explanation":"名詞「外交官」。指代表國家在國外工作，負責處理國際關係的政府官員。","entries":[{"sentence":"A skilled <target>diplomat</target> must be able to handle sensitive international issues with tact and patience to avoid any conflict.","translation":"一名熟練的外交官必須能夠以機智和耐心處理敏感的國際問題，以避免任何衝突。","explanation":"名詞「外交官」。"},{"sentence":"The <target>diplomat</target> spent several years living in Europe, which allowed him to learn multiple languages and understand different cultures.","translation":"這位外交官在歐洲生活了數年，這使他能夠學習多種語言並理解不同文化。","explanation":"名詞「外交官」。"}],"related_forms":["diplomacy","diplomatic"]}

{"headword":"disability","explanation":"名詞「殘疾、失能」。指身體或心智上的長期缺陷。常用於描述社會福利或權利，如 disability benefits (殘疾津貼) 或 disability rights (殘疾人權利)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government provides special <target>disability</target> <pattern>benefits</pattern> to help people with physical or mental impairments live more independently.","translation":"政府提供特別的殘疾津貼，以幫助身體或心智受損的人能更獨立地生活。","explanation":"名詞「殘疾」。常用搭配 disability benefits (殘疾津貼)。"},{"sentence":"Modern technology, such as screen readers and voice-to-text software, has greatly reduced the barriers for students with a learning <target>disability</target>.","translation":"現代科技，如螢幕閱讀器和語音轉文字軟體，大大降低了學習障礙學生的障礙。","explanation":"名詞「失能/障礙」。常用於描述學習或心智上的功能受損。"},{"sentence":"The university is committed to ensuring that students with any <target>disability</target> have equal access to all campus facilities and academic resources.","translation":"大學致力於確保任何有殘疾的學生都能平等地使用所有校園設施和學術資源。","explanation":"名詞「殘疾」。指身體或心智上的長期缺陷。"}],"related_forms":["disabled"]}

{"headword":"disadvantage","explanation":"名詞「不利條件、缺點」；動詞「使處於不利地位」。名詞常用片語：at a disadvantage (處於不利地位), take advantage of (利用 - 注意此處 advantage 為正向，disadvantage 為負向)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Students who do not speak the local language fluently are often <pattern>at a</pattern> <target>disadvantage</target> when competing for university scholarships.","translation":"不精通當地語言的學生在競爭大學獎學金時通常處於不利地位。","explanation":"名詞「不利條件」。片語 at a disadvantage 表示處於不利的狀態。"},{"sentence":"One major <target>disadvantage</target> <pattern>of</pattern> living in a small town is the lack of public transportation and a wider variety of entertainment options.","translation":"住在小鎮的一個主要缺點是缺乏大眾運輸工具和更多樣的娛樂選擇。","explanation":"名詞「缺點」。常用搭配 disadvantage of sth。"},{"sentence":"The new rule may <target>disadvantage</target> students from low-income families, as they might not have access to the same expensive study tools.","translation":"這項新規則可能會使低收入家庭的學生處於不利地位，因為他們可能無法獲得同樣昂貴的學習工具。","explanation":"動詞「使處於不利地位」。指讓某人處於較差的競爭條件中。"}],"related_forms":["disadvantaged"]}

{"headword":"disappoint","explanation":"動詞「使失望」；名詞 disappointment「失望」。注意 disappoint 是及物動詞，直接接對象。常用片語：be disappointed with/at/by (對...感到失望)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young athlete worked hard for months, but his poor performance in the final race <target>disappointed</target> his coach and teammates.","translation":"這名年輕的運動員努力了數月，但他在最終比賽中的糟糕表現讓他的教練和隊友感到失望。","explanation":"動詞「使失望」。直接接對象。"},{"sentence":"Many students were deeply <target>disappointed</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the final exam results, as they had spent countless hours studying every night.","translation":"許多學生對期末考結果深感失望，因為他們每晚花費了無數小時學習。","explanation":"形容詞用法（分詞）。常用片語 be disappointed with sth (對某事感到失望)。"},{"sentence":"To her great <target>disappointment</target>, the art gallery was closed for renovations during the week she visited the city.","translation":"令她非常失望的是，藝術畫廊在她訪問該城市的那一周內因裝修而關閉。","explanation":"名詞「失望」。常用片語 to one's disappointment (令某人失望的是)。"}],"related_forms":["disappointment","disappointing"]}

{"headword":"disaster","explanation":"名詞「災難、慘劇」。可指自然災害（如 earthquake, flood）或指某事徹底失敗（a total disaster）。常考片語：natural disaster (自然災害)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The local government has implemented new safety laws to better prepare the city for any potential <pattern>natural</pattern> <target>disaster</target> in the future.","translation":"地方政府已實施新的安全法，以在未來更好地讓城市準備好應對任何潛在的自然災害。","explanation":"名詞「災難」。常用搭配 natural disaster (自然災害)。"},{"sentence":"The first date was a <pattern>total</pattern> <target>disaster</target> because they had nothing in common and the conversation was awkward and silent.","translation":"第一次約會是一場徹底的災難，因為他們沒有共同點，且對話尷尬且沉默。","explanation":"名詞「慘劇/失敗」。指某事完全失敗或結果極其糟糕。"},{"sentence":"The forest fire was an environmental <target>disaster</target> that destroyed thousands of acres of trees and killed countless wild animals.","translation":"這場森林大火是一場環境災難，摧毀了數千英畝的樹木並殺死了無數野獸。","explanation":"名詞「災難」。指造成大規模損失的事件。"}],"related_forms":["disastrous"]}

{"headword":"discipline","explanation":"名詞「紀律、自律」或「學科」。動詞「訓練、懲戒」。注意在學術語境中， a discipline 指的是一個特定的研究領域（如 sociology 或 biology）。","entries":[{"sentence":"Learning a new language requires a great deal of self-<target>discipline</target> and consistent practice every single day to make real progress.","translation":"學習一種新語言需要大量的自律以及每天持續的練習才能取得真正的進步。","explanation":"名詞「自律」。指控制自己的行為以達成目標的能力。"},{"sentence":"Sociology is a <target>discipline</target> that focuses on the study of human society, social interactions, and the patterns of social relationships.","translation":"社會學是一門研究人類社會、社會互動以及社會關係模式的學科。","explanation":"名詞「學科」。指一個特定的研究或學習領域。"},{"sentence":"The coach believed that strict <target>discipline</target> in the locker room was necessary to ensure that the team worked together as a single unit.","translation":"教練認為更衣室裡嚴格的紀律是必要的，以確保球隊能像一個整體一樣協作。","explanation":"名詞「紀律」。指對規則的遵守。"},{"sentence":"The teacher had to <target>discipline</target> the students who were talking loudly during the lecture to maintain a quiet and productive learning environment.","translation":"老師必須懲戒那些在講座期間大聲喧嘩的學生，以維持一個安靜且高效的學習環境。","explanation":"動詞「懲戒/訓練」。指透過限制或懲罰來矯正行為。"}],"related_forms":["disciplined"]}

{"headword":"discourage","explanation":"動詞「使沮喪、勸阻」。名詞 discouragement「沮喪」。常用片語：discourage someone from doing something (勸阻某人做某事)。注意與 encourage (鼓勵) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The high cost of tuition may <target>discourage</target> many talented students <pattern>from</pattern> pursuing a degree in medicine at private universities.","translation":"高昂的學費可能會使許多有才華的學生被勸阻而無法在私立大學追求醫學學位。","explanation":"動詞「勸阻/使沮喪」。常用片語 discourage someone from doing sth。"},{"sentence":"Despite facing many failures in his early career, he refused to let <target>discouragement</target> stop him from achieving his ultimate goal.","translation":"儘管在事業早期面臨許多失敗，他仍拒絕讓沮喪感停止他實現最終目標的腳步。","explanation":"名詞「沮喪」。指失去信心或希望的狀態。"},{"sentence":"The school administration decided to install more security cameras to <target>discourage</target> students <pattern>from</pattern> skipping classes during the day.","translation":"學校行政部門決定安裝更多安全攝影機，以勸阻學生在白天翹課。","explanation":"動詞「勸阻」。指透過創造不利條件來讓某人不想做某事。"}],"related_forms":["discouragement","discouraging"]}

{"headword":"disguise","explanation":"動詞「偽裝、掩飾」；名詞「偽裝」。常用於描述改變外貌或隱藏真實情感。例如：in disguise (偽裝中)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The famous actor decided to <target>disguise</target> his voice and wear a large hat to walk through the city without being recognized.","translation":"這名知名演員決定偽裝他的聲音並戴上一頂大帽子，以便在城市中行走而不會被認出。","explanation":"動詞「偽裝」。指改變外貌以掩蓋身份。"},{"sentence":"She tried to <target>disguise</target> her nervousness by smiling and talking confidently, although her hands were still shaking slightly.","translation":"她試圖透過微笑和自信地交談來掩飾她的緊張，儘管她的手仍在輕微地顫抖。","explanation":"動詞「掩飾」。指隱藏真實的感受或性質。"},{"sentence":"The spy entered the enemy camp <pattern>in</pattern> <target>disguise</target>, pretending to be a simple farmer to gather important intelligence for his country.","translation":"間諜偽裝成一名簡單的農民進入敵軍營地，為他的國家蒐集重要的情報。","explanation":"名詞「偽裝」。片語 in disguise 表示「在偽裝狀態下」。"}],"related_forms":["disguised"]}

{"headword":"disgust","explanation":"名詞「厭惡、反感」；動詞「使厭惡」。常用片語：be disgusted with (對...感到厭惡)。注意與 disgust 相同的是，它通常指生理上的噁心感或強烈的道德反感。","entries":[{"sentence":"The smell of the rotting fish in the old market filled her with <target>disgust</target>, making her cover her nose with a handkerchief.","translation":"舊市場裡腐爛魚的氣味讓她充滿了厭惡感，使她用手帕遮住鼻子。","explanation":"名詞「厭惡」。指生理上的強烈反感。"},{"sentence":"Many people were <target>disgusted</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the politician's dishonest behavior and decided not to vote for him in the next election.","translation":"許多人對這位政治家的不誠實行為感到厭惡，並決定在下次選舉中不再投票給他。","explanation":"形容詞用法（分詞）。片語 be disgusted with sth (對某事感到厭惡)。"},{"sentence":"The sight of the dirty, insect-filled water in the abandoned building <target>disgusted</target> him, so he quickly turned away and left the area.","translation":"廢棄建築中髒污且充滿昆蟲的水讓他感到噁心，所以他趕快轉身離開了該區域。","explanation":"動詞「使厭惡」。指引起生理或心理上的反感。"}],"related_forms":["disgusting"]}

{"headword":"dismiss","explanation":"動詞「解僱、開除」；「解散」；「不予考慮、排除」。常考用法：dismiss an idea (不予考慮某個想法)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company decided to <target>dismiss</target> the manager after discovering that he had been stealing funds from the business for years.","translation":"公司在發現經理多年來一直從公司盜取資金後，決定將其解僱。","explanation":"動詞「解僱」。指將某人從工作中開除。"},{"sentence":"After the final bell rang, the teacher <target>dismissed</target> the class, allowing the students to pack their bags and go home.","translation":"最後一聲鐘響後，老師解散了班級，允許學生們收拾書包回家。","explanation":"動詞「解散」。指允許某人離開。"},{"sentence":"The scientist <target>dismissed</target> the theory as too simple, refusing to consider it as a valid explanation for the complex phenomenon.","translation":"這位科學家認為該理論太過簡單而將其排除，拒絕將其視為對該複雜現象的有效解釋。","explanation":"動詞「不予考慮」。指認為某事不重要或不正確而無視之。"}],"related_forms":["dismissal"]}

{"headword":"disorder","explanation":"名詞「紊亂、失調、疾病」；動詞「弄亂」。在 GSAT 中，名詞用法最常見，特別是指心智或生理上的疾病 (eating disorder, sleep disorder)。","entries":[{"sentence":"An eating <target>disorder</target> can be a serious medical condition that requires professional therapy and a healthy diet to recover.","translation":"飲食失調是一種嚴重的醫療狀況，需要專業的治療和健康飲食才能康復。","explanation":"名詞「失調/疾病」。指生理或心理上的功能異常。"},{"sentence":"The sudden <target>disorder</target> in the streets during the protest caused a lot of confusion and forced the police to intervene.","translation":"抗議期間街道上突然的混亂使人感到困惑，並迫使警察介入。","explanation":"名詞「紊亂」。指缺乏秩序的狀態。"},{"sentence":"The careless student <target>disordered</target> the books on the shelf, making it difficult for others to find the materials they needed.","translation":"那個粗心的學生把書架上的書弄亂了，使得其他人很難找到他們需要的材料。","explanation":"動詞「弄亂」。指打破原有的秩序。"}],"related_forms":["disordered"]}

{"headword":"dispute","explanation":"可作為名詞「爭論、糾紛」或動詞「爭議、質疑」。作名詞時，常與 have a dispute 或 settle a dispute 搭配；作動詞時，常指對某事的正確性或合法性提出質疑。注意其名詞形式 dispute 與動詞形式相同。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two neighboring countries have been involved in a long-standing <target>dispute</target> <pattern>over</pattern> the ownership of the islands.","translation":"這兩個鄰國長期以來一直陷入關於島嶼所有權的爭端。","explanation":"名詞「爭端、糾紛」。常用搭配：dispute over sth (關於...的爭端)。"},{"sentence":"After hours of negotiation, the labor union and the company finally <pattern>settled</pattern> their <target>dispute</target> regarding wages and working hours.","translation":"經過數小時的協商，工會和公司終於解決了他們關於工資和工作時間的爭議。","explanation":"名詞「爭議」。片語 settle a dispute 表示「解決爭議」。"},{"sentence":"Some historians <target>dispute</target> the claim that the ancient city was built by a single ruler in less than a year.","translation":"一些歷史學家質疑該古代城市是在一年內由一位統治者建造的這一說法。","explanation":"動詞「質疑、爭議」。指對某種說法或事實提出異議。"},{"sentence":"The referee's decision was <target>disputed</target> <pattern>by</pattern> several players, who argued that the ball had gone out of bounds.","translation":"裁判的決定受到了幾名球員的質疑，他們認為球已經出界了。","explanation":"動詞「質疑」。此處為被動語態 disputed by...。"}],"related_forms":["disputable","disputably"]}

{"headword":"distinct","explanation":"形容詞「截然不同的；清晰的」。常用於描述兩者之間有明顯的差異，或某種感覺/聲音非常清晰。注意與 distinctively (副詞) 和 distinction (名詞) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although they are twins, the two sisters have <target>distinct</target> personalities and very different interests in school.","translation":"雖然她們是雙胞胎，但這兩姐妹有截然不同的個性，在學校的興趣也完全不同。","explanation":"形容詞「截然不同的」。強調差異明顯。"},{"sentence":"There is a <target>distinct</target> <pattern>possibility</pattern> that the flight will be delayed due to the heavy rain and strong winds.","translation":"由於大雨和強風，航班很有可能會延誤。","explanation":"形容詞「明顯的」。常用搭配：distinct possibility (明顯的可能性)。"},{"sentence":"The bird has a <target>distinct</target> <pattern>call</pattern> that makes it easy for researchers to identify it in the dense forest.","translation":"這隻鳥有獨特的叫聲，使研究人員在茂密的森林中很容易辨認出它。","explanation":"形容詞「清晰的、獨特的」。"}],"related_forms":["distinctly","distinction"]}

{"headword":"distinguish","explanation":"動詞「區分、辨別」。最常見的用法是 distinguish A from B (將 A 與 B 區分開來) 或 distinguish oneself (表現出色)。注意其形容詞形式 distinguished 意義完全不同。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is often difficult for young children to <target>distinguish</target> <pattern>between</pattern> a dream and reality after they wake up.","translation":"幼兒在醒來後，通常很難區分夢境與現實。","explanation":"動詞「區分」。常用搭配：distinguish between A and B (區分 A 和 B)。"},{"sentence":"The experienced guide could easily <target>distinguish</target> the rare orchid <pattern>from</pattern> other common flowers in the valley.","translation":"經驗豐富的導遊能輕易地將這種稀有蘭花與山谷中其他常見的花朵區分開來。","explanation":"動詞「區分」。常用搭配：distinguish A from B (將 A 與 B 區分開來)。"},{"sentence":"The young pianist <target>distinguished</target> <pattern>himself</pattern> <pattern>by</pattern> winning the international competition at the age of fifteen.","translation":"這位年輕的鋼琴家在十五歲時贏得了國際比賽， thereby 脫穎而出。","explanation":"動詞片語 distinguish oneself by... 表示「透過...而脫穎而出」。"}],"related_forms":["distinguishable","distinguishable"]}

{"headword":"distinguished","explanation":"形容詞「卓越的、著名的」。用於描述某人在其領域取得了極高的成就而被他人尊重。注意與 distinguish (區分) 的字義區分，此詞為其分詞形式轉化為形容詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university invited a <target>distinguished</target> <pattern>professor</pattern> from Oxford to give a special lecture on quantum physics.","translation":"大學邀請了一位來自牛津大學的卓越教授來做關於量子物理的特別講座。","explanation":"形容詞「卓越的、著名的」。常用搭配：distinguished professor (卓越的教授)。"},{"sentence":"He is a <target>distinguished</target> <pattern>career</pattern> in diplomacy, having served as an ambassador to several different countries.","translation":"他在外交領域有著卓越的事業，曾擔任過數個不同國家的大使。","explanation":"形容詞「卓越的」。指其成就高且受人尊敬。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"distribute","explanation":"動詞「分發、分佈」。常用於描述將物品分給多人，或事物在空間/時間上的分佈情況。常考搭配：distribute A to B (將 A 分發給 B)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher <target>distributed</target> the test papers <pattern>to</pattern> the students quickly so that they could begin the exam on time.","translation":"老師快速地將試卷分發給學生，以便他們能準時開始考試。","explanation":"動詞「分發」。常用搭配：distribute A to B。"},{"sentence":"The company plans to <target>distribute</target> free samples of its new skincare product to potential customers in the city center.","translation":"公司計劃在市中心向潛在客戶分發其新護膚產品的免費樣品。","explanation":"動詞「分發」。"},{"sentence":"Certain plant species are <target>distributed</target> <pattern>unevenly</pattern> <pattern>across</pattern> the continent, depending on the climate and soil quality.","translation":"某些植物物種在整個大陸上的分佈並不均勻，這取決於氣候和土壤品質。","explanation":"動詞「分佈」。此處為被動語態，表示物體在空間上的分佈。"}],"related_forms":["distribution","distributive"]}

{"headword":"distribution","explanation":"名詞「分佈、分發」。指物品的分發過程或事物在某個區域的分佈狀態。常用搭配：distribution network (分銷網路), wealth distribution (財富分佈)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>distribution</target> <pattern>of</pattern> wealth in the country is very unequal, with a small percentage of people owning most of the assets.","translation":"該國的財富分佈非常不均，少數人擁有大部分資產。","explanation":"名詞「分佈」。常用搭配：distribution of wealth (財富分佈)。"},{"sentence":"The logistics company is working to improve its <target>distribution</target> <pattern>network</pattern> to ensure that products reach customers faster.","translation":"物流公司正努力改善其分銷網路，以確保產品能更快地到達客戶手中。","explanation":"名詞「分銷/分發」。distribution network 指「分銷網路」。"},{"sentence":"The charity organization handled the <target>distribution</target> <pattern>of</pattern> food and medicine to the victims of the earthquake.","translation":"慈善組織負責將食物和藥品分發給地震災民。","explanation":"名詞「分發」。"}],"related_forms":["distribute","distributor"]}

{"headword":"district","explanation":"名詞「地區、區域」。通常指行政劃分後的區域或具有特定特徵的區域。例如 financial district (金融區) 或 school district (學區)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The financial <target>district</target> is always crowded with office workers during the weekdays, especially during the lunch break.","translation":"金融區在工作日總是擠滿了上班族，尤其是在午休時間。","explanation":"名詞「地區」。financial district 指「金融區」。"},{"sentence":"The city government decided to build a new park in the residential <target>district</target> to provide more green space for families.","translation":"市政府決定在住宅區建立一座新公園，為家庭提供更多綠地。","explanation":"名詞「區域」。residential district 指「住宅區」。"},{"sentence":"Many students move to this specific school <target>district</target> because the local high schools are known for their high academic standards.","translation":"許多學生搬到這個特定的學區，因為當地的中學以高學術標準而聞名。","explanation":"名詞「區域」。school district 指「學區」。"}],"related_forms":["districts"]}

{"headword":"disturb","explanation":"動詞「打擾、擾亂」。常用於指打擾某人的專注狀態，或擾亂原本平靜的秩序。常考片語：do not disturb (請勿打擾)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please do not <target>disturb</target> the students while they are taking the final exam, as they need complete silence to concentrate.","translation":"請不要在學生參加期末考試時打擾他們，因為他們需要完全的安靜來集中注意力。","explanation":"動詞「打擾」。"},{"sentence":"The loud noise from the construction site next door <target>disturbed</target> her sleep, making her feel tired the next morning.","translation":"隔壁建築工地的巨大噪音擾亂了她的睡眠，使她在第二天早上感到疲倦。","explanation":"動詞「擾亂」。"},{"sentence":"Environmentalists warn that human activities might <target>disturb</target> the <pattern>natural balance</pattern> of the ecosystem, leading to the extinction of some species.","translation":"環保主義者警告說，人類活動可能會擾亂生態系統的自然平衡，導致某些物種滅絕。","explanation":"動詞「擾亂」。常用搭配：disturb the natural balance (擾亂自然平衡)。"}],"related_forms":["disturbance","disturbed"]}

{"headword":"diverse","explanation":"形容詞「多樣的、不同的」。用於描述一個群體或系統中包含許多不同的類型或元素。注意其名詞形式 diversity。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university attracts students from <target>diverse</target> <pattern>backgrounds</pattern>, creating a rich environment for cultural exchange and learning.","translation":"這所大學吸引了來自不同背景的學生，為文化交流和學習創造了豐富的環境。","explanation":"形容詞「多樣的」。常用搭配：diverse backgrounds (不同背景)。"},{"sentence":"The city's <target>diverse</target> <pattern>population</pattern> is reflected in the wide variety of restaurants and shops found in every neighborhood.","translation":"這座城市多樣的人口組成反映在每個社區都能發現的各式各樣的餐廳和商店中。","explanation":"形容詞「多樣的」。diverse population 指「多樣的人口」。"},{"sentence":"To solve the complex problem, the team needed <target>diverse</target> <pattern>perspectives</pattern> from experts in different fields of science.","translation":"為了-解決這個複雜的問題，團隊需要來自科學不同領域專家的多樣觀點。","explanation":"形容詞「多樣的」。diverse perspectives 指「多樣的觀點」。"}],"related_forms":["diversity","diversify"]}

{"headword":"diversity","explanation":"名詞「多樣性、差異」。指一個群體中存在多種不同類型或形式的狀態。常用搭配：cultural diversity (文化多樣性), biodiversity (生物多樣性)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher encouraged the students to respect the cultural <target>diversity</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the classroom, promoting an atmosphere of tolerance.","translation":"老師鼓勵學生尊重課堂上的文化多樣性，以營造一種包容的氛圍。","explanation":"名詞「多樣性」。cultural diversity 指「文化多樣性」。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are deeply concerned about the loss of <target>diversity</target> in the rainforests, which could threaten the survival of many species.","translation":"科學家們深切關注雨林中生物多樣性的喪失，這可能會威脅到許多物種的生存。","explanation":"名詞「多樣性」。在此指生物多樣性 (biodiversity)。"},{"sentence":"Promoting <target>diversity</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the workplace allows companies to bring together different ideas and improve their creative problem-solving abilities.","translation":"在職場中促進多樣性使公司能將不同的想法聚集在一起，並提高他們的創造性解決問題的能力。","explanation":"名詞「多樣性」。"}],"related_forms":["diverse","diversify"]}

{"headword":"divine","explanation":"形容詞「神聖的、非凡的」。常用於描述來自神靈、宗教性質或極其美好的事物。注意與 divine (v.) 「預言」的區別，但在 GSAT 級別中，形容詞用法最為常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"The ancient temple was built to honor the <target>divine</target> power of the sun god, attracting thousands of pilgrims every year.","translation":"這座古廟是為了紀念太陽神的聖力而建，每年吸引數以千計的朝聖者。","explanation":"形容詞「神聖的」。指與神靈相關的性質。"},{"sentence":"After a long day of hiking, the taste of the cold water was simply <target>divine</target>, providing an instant feeling of refreshment.","translation":"經過一整天的徒步旅行，冰水的味道簡直太棒了，立即帶來了清爽的感覺。","explanation":"形容詞「非凡的、極好的」。在非正式語境中，常用來描述極其愉悅的感官體驗。"}],"related_forms":["divinity","divinely"]}

{"headword":"divorce","explanation":"名詞「離婚」；動詞「離婚」。常考搭配：get a divorce (離婚), file for divorce (申請離婚)。注意其延伸含義，可用於描述兩個概念之間的完全分離。","entries":[{"sentence":"After years of constant arguing, the couple finally decided to <target>divorce</target> and divide their assets equally to start new lives.","translation":"經過多年的不斷爭吵，這對夫婦終於決定離婚，並平分資產以開始新生活。","explanation":"動詞「離婚」。"},{"sentence":"The parents tried their best to remain friends after their <target>divorce</target>, ensuring that their children felt loved and supported.","translation":"父母在離婚後盡力保持朋友關係，以確保孩子們感受到愛與支持。","explanation":"名詞「離婚」。"},{"sentence":"The philosopher argued that there should be a complete <target>divorce</target> <pattern>between</pattern> religion and state politics to maintain social stability.","translation":"這位哲學家主張宗教與國家政治之間應完全分離，以維持社會穩定。","explanation":"名詞「分離」。指兩個事物之間的完全脫節或分開。"}],"related_forms":["divorced"]}

{"headword":"dodge","explanation":"動詞「躲避、閃避」；名詞「閃避的動作」。常考搭配：dodge a question (避而不答), dodge a bullet (化險為夷)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The agile player managed to <target>dodge</target> the incoming tackle from the opposing team, allowing him to score a goal.","translation":"這名靈活的球員成功閃避了對手球隊的衝撞，使他得以得分。","explanation":"動詞「閃避」。指身體上的快速移動以避開某物。"},{"sentence":"During the press conference, the politician tried to <target>dodge</target> <pattern>the question</pattern> about the tax increase, giving a vague answer instead.","translation":"在記者會上，這位政治家試圖避開關於增稅的問題，給出了一個模糊的答案。","explanation":"動詞「避開」。指刻意避開困難的問題或責任。"},{"sentence":"The driver performed a quick <target>dodge</target> to avoid hitting a cat that suddenly ran across the busy highway.","translation":"駕駛員做了一個快速的閃避動作，以避免撞到突然跑過繁忙公路的一隻貓。","explanation":"名詞「閃避的動作」。"}],"related_forms":["dodger"]}

{"headword":"dominant","explanation":"形容詞「佔主導地位的、顯著的」。常用於描述權力、特徵或物種。注意與動詞 dominate 的關係。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>dominant</target> feature of the landscape was a massive volcano, which could be seen from almost every part of the city.","translation":"這片景觀的主導特徵是一座巨大的火山，幾乎在城市的每個地方都能看到。","explanation":"形容詞「顯著的、主導的」。指最明顯或最重要的特徵。"},{"sentence":"In some animal societies, the <target>dominant</target> male usually has priority access to food and the best nesting sites.","translation":"在某些動物社會中，主導雄性通常擁有優先獲取食物和最佳築巢地點的權利。","explanation":"形容詞「佔主導地位的」。指擁有最高權力或控制力。"},{"sentence":"English has become the <target>dominant</target> language for international business and science, enabling people from different countries to communicate.","translation":"英語已成為國際商業和科學的主導語言，使不同國家的人能夠交流。","explanation":"形容詞「佔主導地位的」。指最廣泛使用或影響力最大的。"}],"related_forms":["dominate","dominance","dominantly"]}

{"headword":"dominate","explanation":"動詞「主宰、控制、佔據」。常用於描述權力控制或在視覺上佔據主導地位。常考搭配：dominate the market (佔據市場), dominate the conversation (主導對話)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The large skyscraper began to <target>dominate</target> the city skyline, making all the older buildings around it look small.","translation":"那座巨大的摩天大樓開始主宰城市的天際線，使周圍的所有舊建築顯得渺小。","explanation":"動詞「佔據、主導」。指在視覺上最突出。"},{"sentence":"The tech giant continues to <target>dominate</target> <pattern>the market</pattern> by introducing innovative products that competitors cannot easily replicate.","translation":"這家科技巨頭通過推出競爭對手無法輕易複製的創新產品，繼續佔據市場主導地位。","explanation":"動詞「控制、主宰」。常用搭配 dominate the market。"},{"sentence":"During the group discussion, one student tended to <target>dominate</target> <pattern>the conversation</pattern>, leaving little room for others to share their ideas.","translation":"在小組討論中，一名學生傾向於主導對話，讓其他人幾乎沒有空間分享他們的想法。","explanation":"動詞「主導」。指控制對話的進程。"}],"related_forms":["dominant","domination","dominance"]}

{"headword":"draft","explanation":"名詞「草稿；徵兵」；動詞「起草；徵召」。注意 draft (n.) 作為草稿時常用搭配：first draft (初稿), final draft (終稿)。作為徵兵時，常考片語：be drafted into (被徵召入伍)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student wrote a quick <target>draft</target> of her essay before refining the arguments and checking for grammar errors.","translation":"這名學生在完善論點並檢查語法錯誤之前，先快速寫了一篇論文初稿。","explanation":"名詞「草稿」。指初步的寫作版本。"},{"sentence":"The lawyers spent several weeks <target>drafting</target> the new contract to ensure that every legal detail was clearly defined.","translation":"律師們花了好幾週時間起草新合約，以確保每個法律細節都被明確定義。","explanation":"動詞「起草」。指撰寫文件的初步版本。"},{"sentence":"During the war, many young men were <target>drafted</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the army to defend their country against the invasion.","translation":"在戰爭期間，許多年輕男子被徵召入伍以保衛國家免受入侵。","explanation":"動詞片語 be drafted into 表示「被徵召入伍」。"}],"related_forms":["drafts","drafting"]}

{"headword":"dread","explanation":"名詞「恐懼；憂慮」；動詞「恐懼；害怕」。注意動詞用法 dread doing sth (害怕做某事) 或 dread sth (害怕某事)，通常指對未來即將發生的事情感到不安。","entries":[{"sentence":"As the final exam approached, many students began to <target>dread</target> <pattern>taking</pattern> the test because they had not studied enough.","translation":"隨著期末考接近，許多學生開始害怕參加考試，因為他們沒有讀夠書。","explanation":"動詞「恐懼」。常用搭配 dread doing sth。"},{"sentence":"She felt a sense of <target>dread</target> when she realized that she had forgotten to submit her important assignment on time.","translation":"當她意識到自己忘記準時提交重要作業時，她感到一種恐懼感。","explanation":"名詞「恐懼、憂慮」。指對即將到來的不快之事的恐懼。"},{"sentence":"The children <target>dreaded</target> the thought of going to the dentist, imagining the loud noise of the drill and the pain.","translation":"孩子們害怕想到要去牙醫那裡，想像著鑽頭的巨大噪音和疼痛。","explanation":"動詞「恐懼」。指對某種可能性或想法的恐懼。"}],"related_forms":["dreadful","dreadfully"]}

{"headword":"drift","explanation":"動詞「漂流；漂移」；名詞「漂流；趨勢」。動詞常用於描述物體在水面上或空氣中隨風隨流而動。延伸含義可用於描述想法或對話的偏離。常用片語：drift apart (疏遠)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The small boat began to <target>drift</target> <pattern>away from</pattern> the shore after the engine failed, leaving the passengers stranded.","translation":"引擎故障後，小船開始從岸邊漂走，使乘客們陷入困境。","explanation":"動詞「漂流」。指隨水流或風而移動。"},{"sentence":"Over the years, the two best friends began to <target>drift</target> <pattern>apart</pattern> as they moved to different cities for college.","translation":"經過多年，這兩個最好的朋友因為大學就讀不同城市而逐漸疏遠。","explanation":"動詞片語 drift apart 意為「逐漸疏遠」。"},{"sentence":"The teacher noticed that the student's speech began to <target>drift</target> <pattern>off</pattern> the main topic, requiring a gentle reminder.","translation":"老師注意到學生的演講開始偏離主題，需要溫柔地提醒。","explanation":"動詞片語 drift off 表示「偏離」或「漸漸入睡」。"},{"sentence":"A massive <target>drift</target> of snow blocked the main road, making it impossible for vehicles to pass through the village.","translation":"大量的積雪阻塞了主路，使車輛無法通過村莊。","explanation":"名詞「積雪堆」。指風吹積聚的雪或沙。"}],"related_forms":["drifting","drifted"]}

{"headword":"drill","explanation":"名詞「鑽頭；練習；操練」；動詞「鑽孔；訓練」。在 GSAT 中，drill 常指重複性的練習 (drill exercises) 或軍事操練。注意與 drill (工具) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The construction worker used a powerful electric <target>drill</target> to make holes in the concrete wall for the new shelves.","translation":"建築工人使用強力的電鑽在混凝土牆上打孔，以便安裝新層架。","explanation":"名詞「鑽頭」。指用於打孔的工具。"},{"sentence":"The school conducts a fire <target>drill</target> every semester to ensure that all students and staff know how to evacuate safely.","translation":"學校每學期進行一次消防演習，以確保所有學生和教職員知道如何安全撤離。","explanation":"名詞「演習、操練」。常用搭配 fire drill (消防演習)。"},{"sentence":"To improve their speaking skills, the students performed a series of grammar <target>drills</target> to automate their use of tenses.","translation":"為了提高口說能力，學生們進行了一系列語法練習，以使他們對時態的使用自動化。","explanation":"名詞「練習」。指重複性的訓練。"},{"sentence":"The coach <target>drilled</target> the team for hours, making them repeat the same movement until it became a natural habit.","translation":"教練對球隊進行了數小時的訓練，讓他們重複同一個動作直到它成為自然習慣。","explanation":"動詞「訓練」。指透過重複練習來使某人掌握某技能。"}],"related_forms":["driller"]}

{"headword":"drowsy","explanation":"形容詞「昏昏欲睡的」。常用於描述因疲倦、藥物或環境而感到想睡覺的狀態。注意與 sleepy 的區別：drowsy 更強調一種朦朧、不清醒的狀態。","entries":[{"sentence":"The warm sunlight streaming through the window made the student feel <target>drowsy</target> during the long afternoon lecture.","translation":"窗外射入的溫暖陽光讓學生在漫長的下午課堂上感到昏昏欲睡。","explanation":"形容詞「昏昏欲睡的」。"},{"sentence":"Some cold medicines can make you feel <target>drowsy</target>, so you should avoid driving a car after taking them.","translation":"某些感冒藥會讓你感到昏昏欲睡，因此服用後應避免開車。","explanation":"形容詞「昏昏欲睡的」。常用於描述藥物副作用。"},{"sentence":"After a heavy meal, he felt <target>drowsy</target> and struggled to keep his eyes open while reading his history textbook.","translation":"經過一頓大餐後，他感到昏昏欲睡，在閱讀歷史教科書時很難睜開眼睛。","explanation":"形容詞「昏昏欲睡的」。"}],"related_forms":["drowsiness","drowsily"]}

{"headword":"durable","explanation":"形容詞「耐用的、持久的」。常用於描述物品材質堅固，能長時間使用而不損壞。","entries":[{"sentence":"Parents often prefer to buy <target>durable</target> <pattern>materials</pattern> for their children's toys to ensure they last longer and are safer.","translation":"父母通常更傾向於為孩子的玩具購買耐用的材質，以確保它們可以使用更久且更安全。","explanation":"形容詞「耐用的」。常用搭配 durable materials (耐用材質)。"},{"sentence":"Since she plans to travel across Europe for six months, she invested in a <target>durable</target> <pattern>suitcase</pattern> that can withstand rough handling.","translation":"由於她計劃在歐洲旅行六個月，她投資買了一個耐用的行李箱，能夠承受粗魯的搬運。","explanation":"形容詞「耐用的」。常用搭配 durable suitcase (耐用行李箱)。"},{"sentence":"The company focuses on producing <target>durable</target> <pattern>goods</pattern> like refrigerators and washing machines, rather than disposable plastic products.","translation":"這家公司專注於生產如冰箱和洗衣機等耐用消費品，而非一次性塑料產品。","explanation":"形容詞「耐用的」。durable goods 指「耐用消費品」。"}],"related_forms":["durability"]}

{"headword":"dusty","explanation":"形容詞「佈滿灰塵的」。常用於描述長期未被清理的環境或物品。","entries":[{"sentence":"After staying in the abandoned house for many years, the old books on the shelf became <target>dusty</target> and yellowed.","translation":"在廢棄的房子裡待了許多年後，書架上的舊書變得佈滿灰塵且發黃。","explanation":"形容詞「佈滿灰塵的」。"},{"sentence":"The travelers walked along the <target>dusty</target> <pattern>road</pattern> for hours, their clothes becoming covered in a thin layer of gray powder.","translation":"旅人們在佈滿灰塵的道路上走了好幾個小時，他們的衣服上覆蓋了一層薄薄的灰色粉末。","explanation":"形容詞「佈滿灰塵的」。常用搭配 dusty road (佈滿灰塵的路)。"},{"sentence":"She spent the entire weekend cleaning her <target>dusty</target> <pattern>attic</pattern>, finding many childhood memories hidden in old boxes.","translation":"她花了一整個週末清理她佈滿灰塵的閣樓，在舊盒子裡發現了許多童年回憶。","explanation":"形容詞「佈滿灰塵的」。"}],"related_forms":["dust"]}

{"headword":"dye","explanation":"名詞「染料」；動詞「染色」。注意與 die (死亡) 讀音相同但意義完全不同。","entries":[{"sentence":"The artist used a natural <target>dye</target> <pattern>made from</pattern> berries to create a deep red color for the handmade fabric.","translation":"藝術家使用一種由漿果製成的天然染料，為手工織物創造出一種深紅色。","explanation":"名詞「染料」。常用搭配 dye made from sth (由...製成的染料)。"},{"sentence":"Many teenagers decide to <target>dye</target> <pattern>their hair</pattern> bright colors to express their individuality and follow the latest fashion trends.","translation":"許多青少年決定將頭髮染成鮮豔的顏色，以表達他們的個性和追隨最新的時尚趨勢。","explanation":"動詞「染色」。常用搭配 dye one's hair (染髮)。"},{"sentence":"To give the old white T-shirt a new look, she decided to <target>dye</target> <pattern>it</pattern> <pattern>blue</pattern> using a simple kit from the store.","translation":"為了讓舊的白色 T 恤有新的外觀，她決定用商店買的簡單工具組將其染成藍色。","explanation":"動詞「染色」。用法為 dye sth + 顏色。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"dynamic","explanation":"形容詞「動態的、充滿活力的」。可用於描述性格、環境或系統，強調變化與活力。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company is looking for a <target>dynamic</target> <pattern>leader</pattern> who can adapt quickly to the rapidly changing market and inspire the team.","translation":"公司正在尋找一位充滿活力的領導者，能夠快速適應快速變化的市場並激勵團隊。","explanation":"形容詞「充滿活力的」。常用搭配 dynamic leader (充滿活力的領導者)。"},{"sentence":"The city's <target>dynamic</target> <pattern>environment</pattern> attracts many young artists and entrepreneurs who are eager to experiment with new ideas.","translation":"這座城市動態的環境吸引了許多渴望嘗試新想法的年輕藝術家和創業家。","explanation":"形容詞「動態的、多變的」。常用搭配 dynamic environment (動態環境)。"},{"sentence":"Modern software often uses <target>dynamic</target> <pattern>content</pattern> that changes based on the user's preferences and browsing history.","translation":"現代軟體經常使用根據用戶偏好和瀏覽歷史而改變的動態內容。","explanation":"形容詞「動態的」。常用搭配 dynamic content (動態內容)。"}],"related_forms":["dynamically"]}

{"headword":"dynasty","explanation":"名詞「朝代、王朝」。指由同一家族成員統治的國家時期。","entries":[{"sentence":"In history class, we learned about the great achievements of the Tang <target>dynasty</target>, including its poetry and open trade with other nations.","translation":"在歷史課上，我們學習了唐朝的偉大成就，包括其詩歌以及與其他國家的開放貿易。","explanation":"名詞「朝代」。"},{"sentence":"The archaeologists discovered several ancient tombs that belonged to a forgotten <target>dynasty</target> that ruled the region thousands of years ago.","translation":"考古學家發現了幾個屬於數千年前統治該地區的被遺忘王朝的古代墳墓。","explanation":"名詞「王朝」。"},{"sentence":"The fall of the last imperial <target>dynasty</target> marked the beginning of a new era of government and social change in the country.","translation":"最後一個帝國王朝的倒台標誌著該國政府和社會變革新時代的開始。","explanation":"名詞「朝代」。"}],"related_forms":["dynastic"]}

{"headword":"earnest","explanation":"形容詞「認真的、誠懇的」；名詞「定金」。形容詞用法最為常見，指對待事情態度認真或真誠。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite his young age, the student made an <target>earnest</target> <pattern>effort</pattern> to improve his English speaking skills by practicing every day.","translation":"儘管年紀小，這名學生仍努力地嘗試提高他的英語口說能力，每天練習。","explanation":"形容詞「認真的」。常用搭配 earnest effort (認真努力)。"},{"sentence":"She looked at her parents with an <target>earnest</target> <pattern>expression</pattern> on her face, pleading for them to let her study abroad.","translation":"她臉上帶著誠懇的表情看著父母，請求他們讓她出國留學。","explanation":"形容詞「誠懇的」。常用搭配 earnest expression (誠懇的表情)。"},{"sentence":"The buyer paid a small amount of money as an <target>earnest</target> to ensure the house would be reserved for him until the contract was signed.","translation":"買家支付了一小筆錢作為定金，以確保房子在簽約前會為他保留。","explanation":"名詞「定金」。指支付以證明購買意圖的款項。"}],"related_forms":["earnestly"]}

{"headword":"earphone","explanation":"名詞「耳機」。常用複數形式 earphones，指夾在兩耳之間的小型耳機。","entries":[{"sentence":"To avoid disturbing other students in the library, he always wears <target>earphones</target> when listening to music or watching educational videos.","translation":"為了避免打擾圖書館裡的其他學生，他聽音樂或看教學影片時總是戴著耳機。","explanation":"名詞「耳機」。常用複數形式。"},{"sentence":"The new smartphone comes with a pair of high-quality <target>earphones</target> that can block out background noise effectively.","translation":"這款新智慧型手機附帶一對高品質的耳機，可以有效地屏蔽背景噪音。","explanation":"名詞「耳機」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"economic","explanation":"形容詞「經濟上的、與經濟相關的」。指國家、地區或全球的經濟體系。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government is implementing new <target>economic</target> <pattern>policies</pattern> to reduce unemployment and encourage more small businesses to start.","translation":"政府正在實施新的經濟政策，以減少失業並鼓勵更多小企業創業。","explanation":"形容詞「經濟上的」。常用搭配 economic policies (經濟政策)。"},{"sentence":"Many countries are facing severe <target>economic</target> <pattern>crises</pattern> due to the sudden increase in the prices of oil and food.","translation":"許多國家因為油價和糧食價格的突然增加而面臨嚴重的經濟危機。","explanation":"形容詞「經濟上的」。常用搭配 economic crises (經濟危機)。"},{"sentence":"The trade agreement between the two nations was designed to boost <target>economic</target> <pattern>growth</pattern> and create more jobs for the local people.","translation":"兩國之間的貿易協定旨在促進經濟增長並為當地人創造更多工作機會。","explanation":"形容詞「經濟上的」。常用搭配 economic growth (經濟增長)。"}],"related_forms":["economically"]}

{"headword":"economical","explanation":"形容詞「節約的、省錢的」。指使用資源（如金錢、時間、燃料）時非常有效率且不浪費。","entries":[{"sentence":"Buying food in bulk from the warehouse store is often more <target>economical</target> than purchasing small packages from the convenience store.","translation":"從倉庫商店大批量購買食物通常比從便利店購買小包裝更省錢。","explanation":"形容詞「節約的」。"},{"sentence":"The new hybrid car is much more <target>economical</target> because it uses less fuel to travel the same distance as a traditional gasoline car.","translation":"這款新油電混合動力車更省油，因為它行駛相同距離所使用的燃料比傳統汽油車少。","explanation":"形容詞「省錢的、省油的」。"},{"sentence":"She decided to use a small, <target>economical</target> <pattern>apartment</pattern> for her studio, as it was cheaper to heat and maintain.","translation":"她決定用一一個小而省錢的公寓作為她的工作室，因為加熱和維護成本較低。","explanation":"形容詞「節約的」。"}],"related_forms":["economically"]}

{"headword":"economics","explanation":"名詞「經濟學」。指研究資源分配和生產、消費的學科。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you are interested in how the global market works, taking a course in <target>economics</target> would provide you with valuable knowledge.","translation":"如果你對全球市場如何運作感興趣，然後就讀經濟學課程將為你提供有價值的知識。","explanation":"名詞「經濟學」。指學科名稱。"},{"sentence":"The professor of <target>economics</target> explained how inflation affects the purchasing power of the average consumer in simple terms.","translation":"經濟學教授用簡單的術語解釋了通貨膨脹如何影響普通消費者的購買力。","explanation":"名詞「經濟學」。"},{"sentence":"Many students choose to major in <target>economics</tag> because they want to understand the relationship between supply and demand in a market.","translation":"許多學生選擇主修經濟學，因為他們想理解市場中供給與需求的關係。","explanation":"名詞「經濟學」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"economist","explanation":"名詞「經濟學家」。指研究經濟原則、生產、分配及消費的人。常用搭配 include leading economists (包括領先的經濟學家)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government invited a famous <target>economist</target> to provide advice on how to reduce unemployment and boost the national growth.","translation":"政府邀請了一位著名的經濟學家，就如何降低失業率並促進國家成長提供建議。","explanation":"名詞「經濟學家」。指專業研究經濟的人。"},{"sentence":"Many <target>economists</target> believe that investing in renewable energy will create more jobs and protect the environment in the long run.","translation":"許多經濟學家認為，從長遠來看，投資可再生能源將創造更多就業機會並保護環境。","explanation":"名詞「經濟學家」。複數形式 economists。"},{"sentence":"In the university seminar, the <target>economist</target> explained how changes in interest rates can affect the spending habits of consumers.","translation":"在大學研討會上，這位經濟學家解釋了利率的變化如何影響消費者的消費習慣。","explanation":"名詞「經濟學家」。"}],"related_forms":["economics"]}

{"headword":"economy","explanation":"名詞「經濟」。可用於指國家的經濟系統 (national economy) 或指「節約」(economy of effort/time)。注意 economy (經濟/節約) 與 economic (經濟上的) 及 economical (節約的) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The global <target>economy</target> has faced many challenges recently, leading to higher prices for food and fuel in many countries.","translation":"全球經濟最近面臨許多挑戰，導致許多國家的食品和燃料價格上漲。","explanation":"名詞「經濟」。指一個國家或地區的生產、分配與消費系統。"},{"sentence":"To improve the local <target>economy</target>, the city council decided to build a new shopping center to attract more tourists.","translation":"為了改善當地經濟，市議會決定建造一座新的購物中心以吸引更多遊客。","explanation":"名詞「經濟」。"},{"sentence":"The author's writing style is characterized by an <target>economy</target> <pattern>of</pattern> words, conveying deep meanings without using unnecessary language.","translation":"這位作者的寫作風格特點在於文字的精簡，無需使用不必要的語言即可傳達深刻的含義。","explanation":"名詞「節約、精簡」。指在資源或文字上的節省。"},{"sentence":"Many students choose <target>economy</target> class tickets when traveling abroad to save money for other experiences during their trip.","translation":"許多學生在出國旅行時選擇經濟艙機票，以便為旅途中的其他體驗省錢。","explanation":"名詞「經濟」。此處 economy class 為固定搭配，指機票的經濟艙。"}],"related_forms":["economic","economical","economically"]}

{"headword":"efficiency","explanation":"名詞「效率」。指在最短時間或使用最少資源完成任務的能力。常用搭配 improve efficiency (提高效率) 或 energy efficiency (能源效率)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company introduced new software to increase the <target>efficiency</target> <pattern>of</pattern> its production line and reduce waste.","translation":"公司引入了新軟體以提高其生產線的效率並減少浪費。","explanation":"名詞「效率」。指工作完成的速度與品質之比。"},{"sentence":"Improving the <target>efficiency</target> <pattern>of</pattern> public transportation is essential for reducing traffic congestion in big cities like Taipei.","translation":"提高大眾運輸的效率對於減輕像台北這樣大城市的交通擁堵至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「效率」。"},{"sentence":"Modern appliances are designed for higher energy <target>efficiency</target>, helping homeowners save money on their monthly electricity bills.","translation":"現代電器被設計為具有更高的能源效率，幫助屋主節省每月電費。","explanation":"名詞「效率」。常用搭配 energy efficiency (能源效率)。"}],"related_forms":["efficient","efficiently"]}

{"headword":"elastic","explanation":"形容詞「有彈性的」，名詞「橡皮筋」。作為形容詞時，除了物理彈性，也可指價格或需求的靈活性 (elastic demand)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The athlete wore <target>elastic</target> bands around his wrists to provide support and prevent injuries during the intense game.","translation":"這名運動員在手腕上戴著彈性帶，以便在激烈的比賽中提供支持並防止受傷。","explanation":"形容詞「有彈性的」。指物體能恢復原狀的能力。"},{"sentence":"She used a small <target>elastic</target> to tie her hair back, making it easier to focus on her studies without distractions.","translation":"她用一根小橡皮筋把頭髮紮起來，讓她能更容易專注於學習而不會分心。","explanation":"名詞「橡皮筋」。"},{"sentence":"In economics, if a small change in price leads to a large change in demand, the product is said to have <target>elastic</target> <pattern>demand</pattern>.","translation":"在經濟學中，如果價格的微小變化導致需求的巨大變化，則該產品被認為具有彈性需求。","explanation":"形容詞「有彈性的」。在經濟學中指對價格變動敏感的需求。"}],"related_forms":["elasticity"]}

{"headword":"electronics","explanation":"名詞「電子產品」或「電子學」。通常指與電路、晶片相關的設備。注意 electronics (電子學/產品) 與 electric (電力的) 及 electronic (電子的) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The store sells a wide variety of consumer <target>electronics</target>, including the latest smartphones, laptops, and smart watches.","translation":"這家店銷售各式各樣的消費電子產品，包括最新的智慧型手機、筆記型電腦和智慧手錶。","explanation":"名詞「電子產品」。指由電子零件組成的設備。"},{"sentence":"Students majoring in <target>electronics</target> learn how to design complex circuits and develop new hardware for computers.","translation":"主修電子學的學生學習如何設計複雜的電路並為電腦開發新硬體。","explanation":"名詞「電子學」。指研究電子的科學或技術。"},{"sentence":"Due to the rapid growth of <target>electronics</target>, many traditional tools have been replaced by digital devices in modern classrooms.","translation":"由於電子產品的快速成長，許多傳統工具在現代教室中已被數位設備取代。","explanation":"名詞「電子產品」。"}],"related_forms":["electronic","electronically"]}

{"headword":"elegant","explanation":"形容詞「優雅的、高雅的」。可用於描述人的舉止、服裝，或指解決方案、理論非常簡潔且巧妙 (an elegant solution)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The actress looked stunning in her <target>elegant</target> black dress, which perfectly matched the formal atmosphere of the award ceremony.","translation":"這位女演員穿著優雅的黑色禮服，與頒獎典禮的正式氣氛完美契合，看起來令人驚艷。","explanation":"形容詞「優雅的」。指外表或舉止高雅。"},{"sentence":"The mathematician proposed an <target>elegant</target> <pattern>solution</pattern> to the problem, solving it in just a few simple steps.","translation":"這位數學家為該問題提出了一個巧妙的解決方案，僅用幾個簡單的步驟就將其解決。","explanation":"形容詞「簡潔巧妙的」。常用搭配 elegant solution (巧妙的解決方案)。"},{"sentence":"The hotel lobby was decorated in an <target>elegant</target> style, with crystal chandeliers and marble floors that impressed all the guests.","translation":"飯店大廳的裝飾風格高雅，水晶吊燈和大理石地板給所有客人都留下了深刻印象。","explanation":"形容詞「高雅的」。指環境或設計精美。"}],"related_forms":["elegance","elegantly"]}

{"headword":"elementary","explanation":"形容詞「基礎的、初級的」。常用於指教育階段 (elementary school) 或事情非常簡單 (elementary logic)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Before moving to advanced calculus, students must first master <target>elementary</target> <pattern>algebra</pattern> to build a strong mathematical foundation.","translation":"在進入高等微積分之前，學生必須先掌握基礎代數，以建立強大的數學基礎。","explanation":"形容詞「基礎的」。指最基本的知識或技能。"},{"sentence":"Children in <target>elementary</target> <pattern>school</pattern> focus on learning basic reading, writing, and arithmetic skills through play and exploration.","translation":"小學的孩子們透過遊戲和探索，專注於學習基礎的閱讀、寫作和算術技能。","explanation":"形容詞「初級的」。常用搭配 elementary school (小學)。"},{"sentence":"The detective explained that the clue was <target>elementary</target>, and anyone with a bit of common sense could have found it.","translation":"偵探解釋說這個線索非常簡單，任何有點常識的人都能發現。","explanation":"形容詞「簡單的」。指不複雜且容易理解的。"}],"related_forms":["element","elementarily"]}

{"headword":"eliminate","explanation":"動詞「消除、排除、剔除」。常用於指去掉不需要的東西、排除錯誤或在比賽中被淘汰 (be eliminated from)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government is trying to <target>eliminate</target> poverty by providing better education and job training for people in rural areas.","translation":"政府正試圖透過為農村地區的人們提供更好的教育和職業培訓來消除貧困。","explanation":"動詞「消除」。指完全去掉不希望存在的事物。"},{"sentence":"To find the correct answer in a multiple-choice test, students are often taught to <target>eliminate</target> the obviously wrong options first.","translation":"在選擇題考試中，為了找到正確答案，學生通常被教導先排除明顯錯誤的選項。","explanation":"動詞「排除」。指剔除不正確的可能性。"},{"sentence":"The team played well, but they were <target>eliminated</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the tournament after losing the final match in the second round.","translation":"該隊表現良好，但在第二輪最後一場比賽失利後被淘汰出局。","explanation":"動詞「淘汰」。常用搭配 be eliminated from (從...中被淘汰)。"}],"related_forms":["elimination"]}

{"headword":"elsewhere","explanation":"副詞「在其他地方」。常用於對比目前討論的地方與其他地方。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you cannot find the book you need in the school library, you might have to look for it <target>elsewhere</target>.","translation":"如果你在學校圖書館找不到需要的書，你可能得去其他地方找找看。","explanation":"副詞「在其他地方」。"},{"sentence":"The store was too crowded during the holiday, so we decided to move <target>elsewhere</target> to find a quieter place to shop.","translation":"假期期間商店太擁擠了，所以我們決定移到其他地方找個安靜一點的地方購物。","explanation":"副詞「在其他地方」。"},{"sentence":"While some birds stay in the same area all year, others migrate <target>elsewhere</target> to find warmer weather and more food.","translation":"雖然有些鳥全年留在同一區域，但其他鳥類會遷移到其他地方以尋找更溫暖的天氣和更多食物。","explanation":"副詞「在其他地方」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"embarrass","explanation":"動詞「使尷尬」。名詞形式 embarrassment 指「尷尬的事」或「尷尬的感覺」。注意其拼寫 (雙 r, 雙 s)。","entries":[{"sentence":"I didn't want to <target>embarrass</target> my friend by pointing out the food stain on his shirt in front of everyone.","translation":"我不想在大家面前指出他襯衫上的食物污漬而讓他感到尷尬。","explanation":"動詞「使尷尬」。指讓某人感到侷促不安。"},{"sentence":"The student felt a sense of <target>embarrassment</target> when she realized she had been calling her teacher by the wrong name.","translation":"這名學生意識到自己一直叫錯老師的名字時，感到十分尷尬。","explanation":"名詞「尷尬」。指心理上的尷尬感覺。"},{"sentence":"To my great <target>embarrassment</target>, I forgot the lyrics of the song halfway through my performance at the school talent show.","translation":"令我非常尷尬的是，在學校才藝表演時，我唱到一半忘了歌詞。","explanation":"名詞「尷尬」。常用片語 to one's embarrassment (令某人尷尬的是)。"},{"sentence":"The boy's clumsy mistake <target>embarrassed</target> him deeply, making him blush and wish he could disappear from the room.","translation":"這個男孩笨拙的錯誤讓他深感尷尬，使他臉紅並希望自己能從房間裡消失。","explanation":"動詞「使尷尬」。此處為過去式 embarrassed。"}],"related_forms":["embarrassment","embarrassing","embarrassed"]}

{"headword":"embassy","explanation":"名詞「大使館」。指代表一個國家在另一個國家設立的外交使團。常用搭配：at the embassy (在大使館), go to the embassy (去大使館)。","entries":[{"sentence":"To apply for a travel visa, the student had to visit the <target>embassy</target> of her home country in the capital city.","translation":"為了申請旅遊簽證，這名學生必須前往位於首都的本國大使館。","explanation":"名詞「大使館」。"},{"sentence":"The foreign <target>embassy</target> issued a travel warning to its citizens, advising them to avoid visiting the high-risk areas during the festival.","translation":"該國大使館向其公民發布了旅遊警告，建議他們在節日期間避免前往高風險地區。","explanation":"名詞「大使館」。"},{"sentence":"The local police provided extra security <pattern>around</pattern> the <target>embassy</target> to prevent any protests from disrupting the official diplomatic meeting.","translation":"當地警方在大使館周圍提供了額外的安保措施，以防止任何抗議活動干擾正式的外交會議。","explanation":"名詞「大使館」。常用搭配：around the embassy。"}],"related_forms":["embassies"]}

{"headword":"emerge","explanation":"動詞「出現；顯現」。指從隱蔽處出來或真相大白。常用片語 emerge from (從...中出現/脫穎而出)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After several hours of deep discussion, a clear solution to the problem finally <target>emerged</target> from the brainstorming session.","translation":"經過幾個小時的深入討論，問題的明確解決方案終於在腦力激盪會議中出現了。","explanation":"動詞「出現」。指抽象的方案、事實或想法顯現。"},{"sentence":"As the fog slowly cleared, the beautiful peaks of the mountains <target>emerged</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the mist, surprising the hikers.","translation":"隨著霧氣緩緩消散，山脈美麗的山峰從霧中顯現，讓登山客感到驚訝。","explanation":"動詞「出現」。常用片語 emerge from (從...中出現)。"},{"sentence":"The small tech startup <target>emerged</target> <pattern>as</pattern> a leader in the industry after introducing a revolutionary new software for students.","translation":"這家小型科技初創公司在推出一款針對學生的革命性新軟體後，成為了該行業的領導者。","explanation":"動詞「顯現」。常用搭配 emerge as... (顯現為.../成為...)。"}],"related_forms":["emergence","emergent"]}

{"headword":"emphasis","explanation":"名詞「強調；重點」。常用於指對某事物的重視。常用片語 place emphasis on (強調...), put emphasis on (強調...), with an emphasis on (以...為重點)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new educational reform <pattern>places</pattern> a strong <target>emphasis</target> <pattern>on</pattern> critical thinking rather than simple memorization of facts.","translation":"新的教育改革強烈強調批判性思考，而非簡單地記憶事實。","explanation":"名詞「強調」。常用片語 place emphasis on (強調...)。"},{"sentence":"In her final presentation, the student <pattern>put</pattern> more <target>emphasis</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the practical application of the theory than on the theoretical background.","translation":"在她的最終報告中，這名學生對理論的實際應用比對理論背景投入了更多的重點。","explanation":"名詞「強調」。常用片語 put emphasis on (強調...)。"},{"sentence":"The university offers a degree <pattern>with</pattern> an <target>emphasis</target> <pattern>on</pattern> environmental science, attracting many students who care about the planet.","translation":"這所大學提供一個以環境科學為重點的學位，吸引了許多關心地球的學生。","explanation":"名詞「重點」。常用搭配 with an emphasis on (以...為重點)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"empire","explanation":"名詞「帝國」。指由一個國家或統治者控制的廣大領土或龐大的商業集團。常用搭配：Roman Empire (羅馬帝國), business empire (商業帝國)。","entries":[{"sentence":"In history class, the teacher explained how the <pattern>Roman</pattern> <target>empire</target> expanded its territory through powerful armies and efficient administration.","translation":"在歷史課上，老師解釋了羅馬帝國如何透過強大的軍隊和高效的行政管理來擴張領土。","explanation":"名詞「帝國」。常用搭配：Roman Empire。"},{"sentence":"The entrepreneur worked tirelessly for twenty years to build a global <pattern>business</pattern> <target>empire</target> spanning across multiple continents.","translation":"這位企業家不懈地工作了二十年，建立了一個橫跨多個大洲的全球商業帝國。","explanation":"名詞「帝國」。常用搭配：business empire (商業帝國)。"}],"related_forms":["imperial","imperialism"]}

{"headword":"enclose","explanation":"動詞「隨信附上；圍起來」。在書信或正式文件中常用於指將某物附在信封內。常用搭配：enclose sth with/in sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please <target>enclose</target> a copy of your passport and a recent photograph <pattern>with</pattern> your application form for the exchange program.","translation":"申請交換計畫時，請隨信附上您的護照複本和一張近照。","explanation":"動詞「隨信附上」。常用搭配：enclose sth with sth。"},{"sentence":"The school decided to <target>enclose</target> the playground <pattern>with</pattern> a tall fence to ensure that the children could play safely without leaving.","translation":"學校決定用高圍欄將操場圍起來，以確保孩子們可以在不跑出去的情況下安全地玩耍。","explanation":"動詞「圍起來」。常用搭配：enclose sth with sth。"}],"related_forms":["enclosure"]}

{"headword":"encounter","explanation":"動詞「遇到；遭遇」；名詞「邂逅；遭遇」。指意外地遇到某人或面臨困難。常用搭配：encounter a problem (遇到問題), a brief encounter (一次短暫的邂逅)。","entries":[{"sentence":"While hiking in the deep forest, the students <target>encountered</target> a rare species of bird that they had never seen before.","translation":"在深林中徒步旅行時，學生們遇到了一種他們以前從未見過的稀有鳥類。","explanation":"動詞「遇到」。指意外地遇見某物或某人。"},{"sentence":"The research team <target>encountered</target> several unexpected <pattern>technical problems</pattern> while collecting data in the remote mountain village.","translation":"研究團隊在偏遠山村收集數據時遇到了幾個意想不到的技術問題。","explanation":"動詞「遭遇」。常用搭配：encounter technical problems。"},{"sentence":"Their first <target>encounter</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the famous author was a brief conversation during a book fair, which left a lasting impression on them.","translation":"他們與這位著名作家的第一次邂逅是一次在書展期間的短暫對話，給他們留下了深刻的印象。","explanation":"名詞「邂逅」。常用搭配：encounter with sb/sth。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"endanger","explanation":"動詞「危險；使危險」。常用於指將某物置於危險之中，尤其是環境保護或動物保護。常用搭配：endanger the lives of (危及...的生命)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Driving too fast in the heavy rain can <target>endanger</target> <pattern>the lives of</pattern> other drivers and pedestrians on the road.","translation":"在暴雨中開車太快會危及道路上其他駕駛者和行人的生命。","explanation":"動詞「危及」。常用搭配：endanger the lives of sb。"},{"sentence":"The construction of the new dam may <target>endanger</target> the natural habitat of several rare fish species in the river.","translation":"興建新水壩可能會危及河流中幾個稀有魚類的自然棲息地。","explanation":"動詞「危及」。"}],"related_forms":["endangered"]}

{"headword":"endure","explanation":"動詞「忍受；持久」。指忍受痛苦或困難地持續下去。常用搭配：endure the pain (忍受痛苦), endure for years (持續多年)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The athletes had to <target>endure</target> extreme cold and strong winds while climbing to the top of the mountain.","translation":"運動員們在攀登至山頂時必須忍受極端的寒冷和強風。","explanation":"動詞「忍受」。"},{"sentence":"Although the old building was damaged by the storm, its strong foundation allowed it to <target>endure</target> <pattern>for</pattern> many decades.","translation":"儘管這棟舊建築被暴風雨損毀，但其強固的基礎使其能持續存在數十年。","explanation":"動詞「持久」。指事物持續存在。"}],"related_forms":["endurance","endurable"]}

{"headword":"enforce","explanation":"動詞「強制執行」；名詞 (enforcement) 「執行」。常用於法律、規定或協議的強制執行。常用片語 law enforcement (執法)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school administration decided to <target>enforce</target> a strict new rule against using mobile phones during class hours.","translation":"校方決定強制執行一項禁止在課堂時間使用手機的新規定。","explanation":"動詞「強制執行」。常用搭配：enforce a rule/law。"},{"sentence":"Effective <target>enforcement</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the law is essential to maintain public order and prevent crimes from happening in the city.","translation":"有效地執行法律對於維持公共秩序和防止城市中發生犯罪至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「執行」。常用片語 law enforcement (執法) 或 enforcement of the law。"}],"related_forms":["enforcement"]}

{"headword":"engineering","explanation":"名詞「工程學」。指應用科學原理來設計、建造或維護結構、機器或系統。常用搭配：civil engineering (土木工程), software engineering (軟體工程)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After graduating from high school, Mark decided to study <target>engineering</target> because he was fascinated by how bridges and skyscrapers are built.","translation":"高中畢業後，馬克決定學習工程學，因為他對橋樑和摩天大樓是如何建造的感到著迷。","explanation":"名詞「工程學」。"},{"sentence":"Modern <target>engineering</target> has allowed us to create more efficient solar panels, reducing our dependence on fossil fuels.","translation":"現代工程學讓我們能創造出更高效的太陽能板，減少我們對化石燃料的 dependence (依賴)。","explanation":"名詞「工程學」。"},{"sentence":"The university's <pattern>software</pattern> <target>engineering</target> department is world-famous for its innovative research on artificial intelligence.","translation":"這所大學的軟體工程系以其在人工智慧方面的創新研究而聞名於世。","explanation":"名詞「工程學」。常用搭配：software engineering。"}],"related_forms":["engineer"]}

{"headword":"enlarge","explanation":"動詞「擴大、放大」。常用於描述空間、規模或圖片的增加。名詞形式為 enlargement (擴大、擴大之處)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city council decided to <target>enlarge</target> the local park by purchasing the adjacent land, providing more green space for residents.","translation":"市議會決定通過購買相鄰土地來擴大當地公園，為居民提供更多綠地。","explanation":"動詞「擴大」。指增加空間或規模。"},{"sentence":"The photographer offered to <target>enlarge</target> the digital photo, allowing the details of the landscape to be seen more clearly.","translation":"攝影師提議放大這張數位照片，使風景的細節能被更清楚地看到。","explanation":"動詞「放大」。指增加圖片或影像的大小。"},{"sentence":"The school planned an <target>enlargement</target> of the library to accommodate more students and provide a wider variety of books.","translation":"學校計劃擴建圖書館，以容納更多學生並提供更多種類的書籍。","explanation":"名詞「擴建、擴大」。enlargement 常指建築物或規模的增加。"}],"related_forms":["enlarged","enlargement"]}

{"headword":"enormous","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的、極大的」。常用於描述體積、數量或程度。比 big 或 large 程度更強。","entries":[{"sentence":"The whale is an <target>enormous</target> creature, and its size always surprises people who see it for the first time in the ocean.","translation":"鯨魚是一種巨大的生物，其體積總是讓第一次在海洋中看到它的人感到驚訝。","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的」。描述體積巨大。"},{"sentence":"Building the Great Wall of China required an <target>enormous</target> <pattern>amount of</pattern> effort and resources over many centuries.","translation":"建造長城在許多世紀中需要極大的努力和資源。","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的」。常用搭配 enormous amount of (大量的)。"},{"sentence":"The company faced an <target>enormous</target> challenge when they tried to enter the new market without any prior research.","translation":"公司在嘗試進入新市場而沒有事先研究時，面臨了巨大的挑戰。","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的」。描述程度或壓力巨大。"}],"related_forms":["enormously"]}

{"headword":"ensure","explanation":"動詞「確保、保證」。常用句型 ensure that + 子句 或 ensure something。注意與 insure (保險) 和 assure (向某人保證) 的區別：ensure 側重於採取行動使某事發生；insure 側重於金錢上的保險；assure 側重於消除對方的疑慮。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please double-check your application form to <target>ensure</target> <pattern>that</pattern> all the information provided is correct and up to date.","translation":"請再次檢查您的申請表，以確保所提供的所有資訊都是正確且最新的。","explanation":"動詞「確保」。ensure that 子句。"},{"sentence":"The teacher provided a detailed guide to <target>ensure</target> the success of the group project, giving clear steps for each member.","translation":"老師提供了一份詳細的指南以確保小組專案的成功，為每位成員提供明確的步驟。","explanation":"動詞「確保」。ensure something。"},{"sentence":"The government implemented new laws to <target>ensure</target> the <pattern>safety of</pattern> citizens during the annual festival in the city center.","translation":"政府實施了新法律，以確保市民在市中心年度節慶期間的安全。","explanation":"動詞「確保」。常用搭配 ensure the safety of (確保...的安全)。"}],"related_forms":["ensured","ensuring"]}

{"headword":"entertain","explanation":"動詞「娛樂、款待」。名詞形式為 entertainment (娛樂)。常考搭配 entertain a thought (考慮某種想法)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The magician used a variety of tricks to <target>entertain</target> the crowd, making everyone laugh and wonder at his skills.","translation":"魔術師使用各種技巧來娛樂群眾，讓每個人都對他的技巧感到好奇並發笑。","explanation":"動詞「娛樂」。指提供樂趣。"},{"sentence":"The host spent the entire evening <target>entertaining</target> her guests with delicious food and interesting stories about her travels.","translation":"主人整個晚上都在款待她的客人，提供美味的食物和關於她旅行的有趣故事。","explanation":"動詞「款待」。指招待客人。"},{"sentence":"The city center offers a wide range of <target>entertainment</target> <pattern>options</pattern>, such as movie theaters, bowling alleys, and music halls.","translation":"市中心提供各種娛樂選擇，例如電影院、保齡球場和音樂廳。","explanation":"名詞「娛樂」。常用搭配 entertainment options (娛樂選擇)。"},{"sentence":"He didn't <target>entertain</target> the <pattern>idea of</pattern> quitting his job until he received a much better offer from another company.","translation":"在他收到另一家公司更好的條件之前，他並沒有考慮過辭職這個想法。","explanation":"動詞「考慮」。entertain an idea/thought 指考慮某種想法。"}],"related_forms":["entertainment","entertaining"]}
