{"headword":"enthusiasm","explanation":"名詞「熱情、熱忱」。形容詞為 enthusiastic (熱情的)。常用片語 with enthusiasm (熱情地)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students showed great <target>enthusiasm</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the new science project, spending their free time researching in the library.","translation":"學生們對新的科學專案表現出極大的熱情，利用空閒時間在圖書館研究。","explanation":"名詞「熱情」。常用搭配 enthusiasm for something (對...的熱情)。"},{"sentence":"Despite the difficult training, the athlete continued to train <pattern>with</target> <target>enthusiasm</target>, hoping to win a gold medal in the Olympics.","translation":"儘管訓練艱苦，這名運動員仍熱情地繼續訓練，希望在奧運會上贏得金牌。","explanation":"名詞「熱情」。常用片語 with enthusiasm (熱情地)。"},{"sentence":"Her <target>enthusiasm</target> <pattern>for</pattern> learning new languages is inspiring, as she can now speak four different languages fluently.","translation":"她對學習新語言的熱情令人鼓舞，因為她現在能流利地說四種不同的語言。","explanation":"名詞「熱情」。"}],"related_forms":["enthusiastic","enthusiastically"]}

{"headword":"equality","explanation":"名詞「平等」。常與 gender equality (性別平等) 或 racial equality (種族平等) 搭配。形容詞為 equal (平等的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The organization works tirelessly to promote <target>equality</target> <pattern>of</pattern> opportunity for people from all different backgrounds.","translation":"該組織不懈地努力促進不同背景的人們擁有機會平等。","explanation":"名詞「平等」。常用搭配 equality of opportunity (機會平等)。"},{"sentence":"Many countries are striving to achieve <target>equality</target> <pattern>between</pattern> men and women in the workplace, ensuring fair pay for equal work.","translation":"許多國家正努力在職場上實現男女平等，確保相同工作獲得公平的薪酬。","explanation":"名詞「平等」。常用搭配 gender equality (性別平等)。"},{"sentence":"The fight for racial <target>equality</target> has been a long struggle, but significant progress has been made in recent decades.","translation":"種族平等的鬥爭是一個漫長的過程，但近幾十年來取得了顯著的進展。","explanation":"名詞「平等」。常用搭配 racial equality (種族平等)。"}],"related_forms":["equal"]}

{"headword":"equip","explanation":"動詞「裝備、配備」。名詞形式為 equipment (設備)。常用句型 equip someone with something (使某人具備...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school decided to <target>equip</target> the new science lab <pattern>with</pattern> modern computers and advanced microscopes for students.","translation":"學校決定為新的科學實驗室配備現代電腦和先進的顯微鏡以供學生使用。","explanation":"動詞「配備」。常用句型 equip something with something。"},{"sentence":"To be successful in the future, students must <target>equip</target> themselves <pattern>with</pattern> critical thinking skills and the ability to adapt.","translation":"為了在未來取得成功，學生必須使自己具備批判性思考能力和適應能力。","explanation":"動詞「使具備」。常用句型 equip oneself with something (使自己具備...)。"},{"sentence":"The hikers carried all the necessary <target>equipment</target> for the camping trip, including a tent, sleeping bags, and a first-aid kit.","translation":"登山客攜帶了露營旅行所需的所有必要設備，包括帳篷、睡袋和急救箱。","explanation":"名詞「設備」。equipment 是不可數名詞，不可加 s。"}],"related_forms":["equipment"]}

{"headword":"era","explanation":"名詞「時代」。指一段具有特定特徵的時間段。常用搭配 a new era (一個新時代)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The invention of the internet marked the beginning of a <target>new</target> <target>era</target> in communication, changing how we interact with each other.","translation":"網路的發明標誌著通訊新時代的開始，改變了我們彼此互動的方式。","explanation":"名詞「時代」。常用搭配 a new era (一個新時代)。"},{"sentence":"Historians study the Victorian <target>era</target> to understand the social changes and industrial growth that happened in nineteenth-century Britain.","translation":"歷史學家研究維多利亞時代，以了解十九世紀英國發生的社會變遷和工業增長。","explanation":"名詞「時代」。指特定歷史時期。"},{"sentence":"The retirement of the legendary coach marked the end of an <target>era</target> for the school's basketball team, as they lost a great leader.","translation":"這位傳奇教練的退休標誌著學校籃球隊一個時代的結束，因為他們失去了一位偉大的領導者。","explanation":"名詞「時代」。指一段特定時間的結束。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"essential","explanation":"形容詞「必要的、不可或缺的」；名詞「必需品」。注意與 necessary 的區別：essential 程度更強，表示如果不具備則無法運作或成功。常考搭配 essential to/for something。","entries":[{"sentence":"Fresh water and a balanced diet are <target>essential</target> <pattern>for</pattern> maintaining good health and preventing various diseases.","translation":"新鮮的水和均衡的飲食對於維持良好健康和預防各種疾病至關重要。","explanation":"形容詞「必要的」。常用搭配 essential for/to something (對...是必要的)。"},{"sentence":"Good communication skills are <target>essential</target> <pattern>to</pattern> successful teamwork, as they allow members to share ideas and resolve conflicts.","translation":"良好的溝通技巧對於成功的團隊合作至關重要，因為它們讓成員能夠分享想法並解決衝突。","explanation":"形容詞「必要的」。常用搭配 essential to something。"},{"sentence":"When packing for a trip to the mountains, remember to bring <target>essentials</target> like a warm coat and a flashlight.","translation":"在為登山旅行準備行李時，記得攜帶溫暖的外套和手電筒等必需品。","explanation":"名詞「必需品」。essentials 常以複數形式出現，指生活所需之物。"}],"related_forms":["essentially"]}

{"headword":"establish","explanation":"動詞「建立、設立」。名詞形式為 establishment (建立、機構)。常用搭配 establish a relationship (建立關係), establish a rule (制定規則)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university worked hard to <target>establish</target> a new research center for environmental studies, attracting experts from all over the world.","translation":"這所大學努力建立一個新的環境研究中心，吸引了來自世界各地的專家。","explanation":"動詞「建立」。指建立機構或組織。"},{"sentence":"It took several years for the two countries to <target>establish</target> <pattern>diplomatic</pattern> <target>relations</target> after the long war ended.","translation":"長年的戰爭結束後，兩國花了好幾年才建立外交關係。","explanation":"動詞「建立」。常用搭配 establish diplomatic relations (建立外交關係)。"},{"sentence":"The city government decided to <target>establish</target> a <pattern>strict</pattern> <target>rule</target> against littering to keep the city streets clean and beautiful.","translation":"市政府決定制定一項嚴格的禁止亂丟垃圾的規定，以保持城市街道乾淨美觀。","explanation":"動詞「制定」。establish a rule 指制定法律或規則。"},{"sentence":"The new <target>establishment</target> in the downtown area is a cozy café that serves a variety of organic coffee and homemade cakes.","translation":"市中心的新機構是一家舒適的咖啡店，提供各種有機咖啡和手工蛋糕。","explanation":"名詞「機構、店鋪」。establishment 在此指一個經營中的商業場所。"}],"related_forms":["establishment","established"]}

{"headword":"estimate","explanation":"動詞「估計、評估」；名詞「估計值、估價單」。常用於對數量、價值或大小進行大概的判斷。注意 estimate (估計) 與 evaluate (評估) 的區別：estimate 側重於數量或價值的預估，而 evaluate 側重於質量的評估或判斷價值。","entries":[{"sentence":"The construction company provided a detailed <target>estimate</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the total cost for the new school building, but the final price was higher.","translation":"建築公司提供了新校舍總成本的詳細估價單，但最終價格更高。","explanation":"名詞「估價單」。指對未來開支的預估金額。"},{"sentence":"Experts <target>estimate</target> that the ancient ruins were built over two thousand years ago, based on the style of the architecture.","translation":"專家估計這些古代遺址是兩千多年前建造的，這是根據建築風格判斷的。","explanation":"動詞「估計」。指對數量的概略判斷。"},{"sentence":"It is difficult to <target>estimate</target> the exact number of people who will attend the graduation ceremony due to the changing weather.","translation":"由於天氣變化，很難估計將有多少人參加畢業典禮。","explanation":"動詞「估計」。"},{"sentence":"The coach tried to <target>estimate</target> the players' strengths and weaknesses to create a more effective training plan for the upcoming tournament.","translation":"教練試圖評估球員的優缺點，以便為即將到來的比賽制定更有效的訓練計畫。","explanation":"動詞「評估」。指對能力或特質的判斷。"}],"related_forms":["estimates","estimated","estimating"]}

{"headword":"ethnic","explanation":"形容詞「種族的、民族的」；名詞「少數民族的人」。常用於描述文化、傳統或身分認同。常用搭配：ethnic group (族群), ethnic food (民族美食), ethnic minority (少數民族)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city's international food festival features various <target>ethnic</target> <pattern>foods</pattern> from around the world, allowing people to taste diverse culinary traditions.","translation":"這座城市的國際美食節以來自世界各地的各種民族美食為特色，讓人們品嚐多元的烹飪傳統。","explanation":"形容詞「民族的」。常用搭配：ethnic food。"},{"sentence":"The university encourages students to learn about different <target>ethnic</target> <pattern>groups</pattern> to promote understanding and respect among diverse populations.","translation":"大學鼓勵學生了解不同的族群，以促進多元人群之間的理解與尊重。","explanation":"形容詞「種族的」。常用搭配：ethnic group。"},{"sentence":"Many <target>ethnics</target> in the region have fought for decades to preserve their unique languages and traditions from disappearing.","translation":"該地區的許多少數民族的人一直在為保護其獨特的語言和傳統不至消失而奮鬥數十年。","explanation":"名詞「少數民族的人」。"},{"sentence":"The government implemented new laws to protect the rights of <target>ethnic</target> <pattern>minorities</pattern>, ensuring they have equal access to education and healthcare.","translation":"政府實施了新法律以保護少數民族的權利，確保他們能平等地獲得教育和醫療保健。","explanation":"形容詞「種族的」。常用搭配：ethnic minority。"}],"related_forms":["ethnicity"]}

{"headword":"evaluate","explanation":"動詞「評估、評價」。指對某事物的品質、價值、重要性或性能進行系統性的分析和判斷。常用搭配：evaluate the effectiveness of (評估...的成效)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher will <target>evaluate</target> the students' performance based on their participation in class, homework assignments, and the final examination.","translation":"老師將根據學生在課堂上的參與度、作業和期末考試來評估學生的表現。","explanation":"動詞「評估」。指對表現或成果的判斷。"},{"sentence":"Before buying a used car, it is wise to have a professional mechanic <target>evaluate</target> the engine to ensure it is in good condition.","translation":"在購買二手車之前，請專業的機械師評估引擎狀況，以確保其處於良好狀態是明智的。","explanation":"動詞「評估」。指對性能或品質的分析。"},{"sentence":"Researchers must carefully <target>evaluate</target> the <pattern>effectiveness</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> the new medicine to determine if it is safe for general use.","translation":"研究人員必須仔細評估新藥的成效，以確定其是否對一般使用安全。","explanation":"動詞「評估」。常用搭配：evaluate the effectiveness of。"}],"related_forms":["evaluates","evaluated","evaluating"]}

{"headword":"evaluation","explanation":"名詞「評估、評價」。evaluate 的名詞形式。常用搭配：performance evaluation (績效評估), a thorough evaluation (徹底的評估)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company conducts an annual <target>evaluation</target> for each employee to discuss their achievements and areas for improvement in the workplace.","translation":"公司每年對每位員工進行一次評估，以討論他們在職場上的成就和需要改進之處。","explanation":"名詞「評估」。常用搭配：performance evaluation。"},{"sentence":"After a thorough <target>evaluation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the situation, the committee decided to postpone the outdoor event until the following weekend.","translation":"在對情況進行徹底評估後，委員會決定將戶外活動推遲到下個週末。","explanation":"名詞「評估」。常用搭配：evaluation of sth。"},{"sentence":"The professor provided a detailed <target>evaluation</target> of the student's thesis, highlighting both its strengths and the points that needed more research.","translation":"教授對學生的論文提供了詳細的評價，強調了其優點以及需要更多研究的要點。","explanation":"名詞「評價」。指對作品或表現的分析性評論。"}],"related_forms":["evaluate"]}

{"headword":"eventual","explanation":"形容詞「最終的、最後的」。指經過一段時間或一系列過程後才發生的結果。注意 eventual (最終的) 與 final (最後的) 的區別：eventual 側重於過程後的結果，而 final 側重於序列中的最後一個。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although the team faced many challenges during the season, their hard work led to their <target>eventual</target> <pattern>success</pattern> in the championship.","translation":"儘管該隊在賽季中面臨許多挑戰，但他們的努力最終導致了他們在錦標賽中的成功。","explanation":"形容詞「最終的」。常用搭配：eventual success。"},{"sentence":"The two countries spent months in negotiations, which led to the <target>eventual</target> <pattern>signing</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> a peace treaty.","translation":"兩國進行了數月的談判，最終導致了和平條約的簽署。","explanation":"形容詞「最終的」。常用搭配：eventual signing。"},{"sentence":"The small business struggled for years, but its <target>eventual</target> <pattern>failure</pattern> was predictable given the lack of market demand.","translation":"這家小企業奮鬥了多年，但鑑於市場需求的缺乏，其最終的失敗是可以預見的。","explanation":"形容詞「最終的」。常用搭配：eventual failure。"}],"related_forms":["eventually"]}

{"headword":"evidence","explanation":"名詞「證據」；動詞「證明」。名詞用法最為常見，常搭配介系詞 for 或 of。常用片語：clear evidence (明確的證據), lack of evidence (缺乏證據), provide evidence (提供證據)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police spent weeks searching for <target>evidence</target> <pattern>that</pattern> would link the suspect to the crime scene and prove his guilt.","translation":"警察花了好幾個星期尋找能將嫌疑人與犯罪現場聯繫起來並證明其有罪的證據。","explanation":"名詞「證據」。指證明事實的資訊。"},{"sentence":"Recent scientific studies provide strong <target>evidence</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the theory that climate change is accelerating the melting of polar ice caps.","translation":"最近的科學研究為氣候變遷加速極地冰蓋融化的理論提供了強有力的證據。","explanation":"名詞「證據」。常用搭配：provide evidence for。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer argued that there was a complete <target>lack</target> <pattern>of</pattern> <target>evidence</target> to support the witness's claims, making them unreliable.","translation":"律師辯稱完全缺乏證據來支持證人的說法，使其不可靠。","explanation":"名詞「證據」。常用搭配：lack of evidence。"},{"sentence":"The detailed fossils <target>evidenced</target> the existence of ancient creatures that once roamed the earth millions of years ago.","translation":"詳細的化石證明了數百萬年前曾在地球上漫遊的古代生物的存在。","explanation":"動詞「證明」。指透過提供證據來證明某事。"}],"related_forms":["evidential","evidentiary"]}

{"headword":"evident","explanation":"形容詞「明顯的」。指某事很容易被察覺或理解。常用搭配：become evident (變得明顯), it is evident that... (顯而易見的是...)。注意與 obvious (明顯的) 相似，但 evident 較為正式。","entries":[{"sentence":"After several hours of discussion, it became <target>evident</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the two parties could not reach an agreement on the terms.","translation":"經過幾個小時的討論後，顯而易見的是，兩方無法就條款達成協議。","explanation":"形容詞「明顯的」。常用句型：it became evident that...。"},{"sentence":"The student's passion for music was <target>evident</target> in the way she practiced her violin for hours every single day.","translation":"這名學生的音樂熱情在於她每天花好幾個小時練習小提琴的方式中顯而易見。","explanation":"形容詞「明顯的」。指容易被察覺的特質。"},{"sentence":"It was <target>evident</target> from the look on his face that he was extremely disappointed with the test results he received.","translation":"從他臉上的表情可以明顯看出他對收到的考試結果非常失望。","explanation":"形容詞「明顯的」。常用搭配：It was evident from...。"}],"related_forms":["evidently","evidence"]}

{"headword":"exaggerate","explanation":"動詞「誇大」。指將某事描述得比實際情況更重要、更大或更好。常用搭配：exaggerate the importance of (誇大...的重要性)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Some people tend to <target>exaggerate</target> their accomplishments on their resumes to make themselves look more attractive to potential employers.","translation":"有些人傾向於在簡歷中誇大他們的成就，使自己對潛在雇主更有吸引力。","explanation":"動詞「誇大」。指將事實描述得比實際更好。"},{"sentence":"The news report was criticized for <target>exaggerating</target> the dangers of the storm, causing unnecessary panic among the local residents.","translation":"該新聞報導因誇大風暴的危險而受到批評，導致當地居民產生不必要的恐慌。","explanation":"動詞「誇大」。指將情況描述得比實際更嚴重。"},{"sentence":"I know he is a great storyteller, but he often <target>exaggerates</target> the details of his adventures to make them more exciting.","translation":"我知道他是一個很棒的說故事的人，但他經常誇大其冒險的細節，使之更有趣。","explanation":"動詞「誇大」。"}],"related_forms":["exaggeration","exaggerated"]}

{"headword":"exception","explanation":"名詞「例外」。指不符合一般規則或情況的事物。常用搭配：with the exception of (除了...之外), make an exception (破例)。","entries":[{"sentence":"All students must attend the morning assembly every day, <pattern>with</pattern> the <target>exception</target> <pattern>of</pattern> those who have a medical excuse.","translation":"所有學生每天都必須參加早會，除了那些有醫療證明的人之外。","explanation":"名詞「例外」。常用片語：with the exception of (除了...之外)。"},{"sentence":"The teacher usually doesn't allow late submissions, but she decided to <pattern>make</pattern> an <target>exception</target> for the student who was ill.","translation":"老師通常不允許遲交，但她決定為生病的那位學生破例。","explanation":"名詞「例外」。常用片語：make an exception (破例)。"},{"sentence":"The new rule is very strict and applies to everyone in the school, leaving no <target>exception</target> for any specific group of students.","translation":"新規定非常嚴格且適用於學校裡的每個人，沒有為任何特定學生群體留有例外。","explanation":"名詞「例外」。"}],"related_forms":["exceptional","exceptionally"]}

{"headword":"exhaust","explanation":"動詞「使筋疲力盡」；動詞「耗盡」；名詞「廢氣」。動詞用法中 exhaust (使疲憊) 與 tire (使疲倦) 的區別在於 exhaust 程度更深，指完全耗盡所有體力或精神。","entries":[{"sentence":"The long journey from the airport to the hotel <target>exhausted</target> the tourists, leaving them too tired to explore the city.","translation":"從機場到酒店的漫長旅程讓遊客們筋疲力盡，使他們累得無法探索這座城市。","explanation":"動詞「使筋疲力盡」。指體力或精神上的完全耗盡。"},{"sentence":"The government is trying to find new energy sources because the country's natural gas reserves are slowly being <target>exhausted</target>.","translation":"政府正試圖尋找新的能源，因為該國的天然氣儲備正緩緩被耗盡。","explanation":"動詞「耗盡」。指資源或可能的選項被用完。"},{"sentence":"Modern cars are equipped with catalysts in the <target>exhaust</target> system to reduce the amount of harmful gases released into the air.","translation":"現代汽車的排氣系統中配有催化轉換器，以減少排放到空氣中的有害氣體量。","explanation":"名詞「廢氣/排氣系統」。"}],"related_forms":["exhaustion","exhaustive","exhausting","exhausted"]}

{"headword":"exhibit","explanation":"可用作名詞「展覽、展品」或動詞「展現、展出」。作動詞時，除了指將物品放置在展覽中，也常用於描述人展現出某種特質或情緒，如 exhibit patience (展現耐心)。注意與 display (展示) 相似，但 exhibit 更有正式感或指在博物館/畫廊中展出。","entries":[{"sentence":"The local museum will <target>exhibit</target> a collection of rare ancient coins next month to educate the public about early trade.","translation":"當地博物館下個月將展出的一系列稀有古幣，以教育大眾關於早期貿易的知識。","explanation":"動詞「展出」。指將物品放置在公共場所供人參觀。"},{"sentence":"The student <target>exhibited</target> <pattern>great</pattern> <target>patience</target> when explaining the complex math problem to his struggling classmates, earning the teacher's praise.","translation":"這名學生在向學習困難的同學解釋複雜的數學問題時展現了極大的耐心，贏得了老師的稱讚。","explanation":"動詞「展現」。指表現出某種特質、情緒或行為。"},{"sentence":"The artist's latest <target>exhibit</target> at the city gallery features stunning landscapes, drawing thousands of visitors from across the country.","translation":"這位藝術家的最新展覽在城市美術館展出，以令人驚嘆的風景畫為特色，吸引了全國各地的數千名參觀者。","explanation":"名詞「展覽」。指一次正式的展示活動。"},{"sentence":"Each <target>exhibit</target> in the science center provides interactive displays that help children understand the basic laws of physics.","translation":"科學中心裡的每個展品都提供了互動式展示，幫助孩子們理解物理的基本定律。","explanation":"名詞「展品」。指展覽中單個的物品。"}],"related_forms":["exhibits","exhibition"]}

{"headword":"expand","explanation":"動詞「擴張、擴大」。可指物理上的體積增加，或指範圍、規模、業務的擴大。常用片語 expand on (詳細說明)。注意與 extend (延伸) 的區別：expand 側重於體積、規模或內容的增加，而 extend 延伸側重於長度、時間或權力的擴展。","entries":[{"sentence":"Metal tends to <target>expand</target> when heated, which is why engineers leave small gaps between railway tracks to prevent accidents.","translation":"金屬在受熱時趨向於膨脹，這就是為什麼工程師在鐵路軌道之間留小縫隙以防止事故。","explanation":"動詞「膨脹」。指物理體積的增加。"},{"sentence":"The company plans to <target>expand</target> <pattern>its</pattern> <target>business</target> <pattern>into</pattern> Southeast Asia to reach more customers and increase its overall profits.","translation":"公司計劃將其業務擴張到東南亞，以接觸更多客戶並增加整體利潤。","explanation":"動詞「擴張」。指規模或範圍的增加。"},{"sentence":"The teacher asked the student to <target>expand</target> <pattern>on</pattern> his answer during the presentation, providing more examples to support his claim.","translation":"老師要求學生在演示過程中詳細說明他的答案，提供更多例子來支持他的主張。","explanation":"動詞片語 expand on 表示「詳細說明」。"}],"related_forms":["expands","expanded","expanding","expansion"]}

{"headword":"expansion","explanation":"名詞「擴張、膨脹」。是 expand 的名詞形式。常用於描述經濟成長、領土擴張或物理上的膨脹。","entries":[{"sentence":"The rapid <target>expansion</target> of the city has led to more housing projects, but it has also caused several environmental problems.","translation":"城市的快速擴張導致了更多的住房項目，但也造成了幾個環境問題。","explanation":"名詞「擴張」。指範圍或規模的增加。"},{"sentence":"Scientists observed the <target>expansion</target> of the universe, suggesting that galaxies are moving further away from each other over time.","translation":"科學家觀察到宇宙的膨脹，表明星系隨著時間推移而彼此遠離。","explanation":"名詞「膨脹」。指體積或空間的增加。"},{"sentence":"The school decided on the <target>expansion</target> of its library to accommodate more books and provide more study areas for students.","translation":"學校決定擴建其圖書館，以容納更多書籍並為學生提供更多學習區域。","explanation":"名詞「擴建」。指物理空間的增加。"}],"related_forms":["expand"]}

{"headword":"experimental","explanation":"形容詞「實驗性的」。指通過實驗來測試或嘗試新方法、新產品或新理論。常用搭配 experimental drug (實驗性藥物), experimental stage (實驗階段)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university is conducting <target>experimental</target> <pattern>research</pattern> to find a more effective way to treat the disease without harmful side effects.","translation":"大學正在進行實驗性研究，以尋找一種更有效且無有害副作用的治療該疾病的方法。","explanation":"形容詞「實驗性的」。常用搭配 experimental research (實驗性研究)。"},{"sentence":"Many of the new features in this software are still in the <target>experimental</target> <pattern>stage</pattern>, so they may not work perfectly yet.","translation":"這款軟體中的許多新功能仍處於實驗階段，因此它們可能還不能完美運行。","explanation":"形容詞「實驗性的」。常用搭配 experimental stage (實驗階段)。"},{"sentence":"The chef tried an <target>experimental</target> <pattern>recipe</pattern> that combined unusual ingredients, creating a unique flavor that surprised all the guests.","translation":"廚師嘗試了一種實驗性的食譜，將不尋常的食材結合在一起，創造出令所有客人驚訝的獨特風味。","explanation":"形容詞「實驗性的」。指嘗試新方法。"}],"related_forms":["experiment","experimentally"]}

{"headword":"explanation","explanation":"名詞「解釋、說明」。指對某事物的原因、過程或意義的詳細描述。常用片語 provide an explanation (提供解釋), a detailed explanation (詳細的解釋)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher provided a clear <target>explanation</target> of the complex scientific theory, making it easier for the students to understand the concept.","translation":"老師對這個複雜的科學理論提供了清晰的解釋，使學生更容易理解這個概念。","explanation":"名詞「解釋」。指對理論或概念的說明。"},{"sentence":"The police asked the suspect to give a detailed <target>explanation</target> for his whereabouts during the time of the crime.","translation":"警察要求嫌疑人詳細說明他在犯罪時間的行蹤。","explanation":"名詞「說明」。指對行為或事件的原因解釋。"},{"sentence":"After the mistake, the student offered a sincere <target>explanation</target> to his teacher, hoping she would understand why he missed the deadline.","translation":"出錯後，這名學生向老師提供了誠懇的解釋，希望她能理解他為什麼錯過截止日期。","explanation":"名詞「解釋」。指對錯誤或行為的理由說明。"}],"related_forms":["explain"]}

{"headword":"explosion","explanation":"名詞「爆炸、爆發」。可指物理上的爆炸，或指數量、人數或情緒的突然增加或爆發。常用搭配 population explosion (人口爆炸), emotional explosion (情緒爆發)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>explosion</target> of the old factory was heard throughout the city, causing panic among the local residents who lived nearby.","translation":"舊工廠的爆炸聲在整個城市都能聽到，引起了住在附近的當地居民的恐慌。","explanation":"名詞「爆炸」。指物理上的爆發。"},{"sentence":"The <target>explosion</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the internet has changed the way people communicate and access information, making the world feel much smaller.","translation":"網路的爆發式成長改變了人們溝通和獲取資訊的方式，讓世界感覺變得更小。","explanation":"名詞「爆發」。指數量或影響力的突然增加。"},{"sentence":"The sudden <target>explosion</target> <pattern>of</pattern> anger from the quiet student surprised everyone in the classroom, as he usually never complained.","translation":"這名安靜的學生突然爆發的憤怒令教室裡的每個人都感到驚訝，因為他通常從不抱怨。","explanation":"名詞「爆發」。指情緒的突然釋放。"}],"related_forms":["explode","explosive"]}

{"headword":"explosive","explanation":"形容詞「易爆的、爆炸性的」；名詞「爆炸物」。作形容詞時，可指物理上的易爆性質，或指情緒、情況的突然爆發（如 explosive temper (暴躁的脾氣)）。作名詞時，指用於爆炸的物質。","entries":[{"sentence":"The workers had to handle the <target>explosive</target> materials with extreme care to avoid any accidents in the chemical plant.","translation":"工人必須極其小心地處理易爆材料，以避免化學工廠中發生任何事故。","explanation":"形容詞「易爆的」。指物理性質。"},{"sentence":"The manager is known for his <target>explosive</target> <pattern>temper</pattern>, which often makes his employees feel nervous and afraid to speak up.","translation":"經理以其暴躁的脾氣著稱，這常使他的員工感到緊張且不敢發言。","explanation":"形容詞「爆炸性的」。常用搭配 explosive temper (暴躁的脾氣)。"},{"sentence":"The military team used powerful <target>explosives</target> to destroy the bridge, preventing the enemy army from crossing the river during the war.","translation":"軍方團隊使用強效爆炸物來摧毀橋樑，防止敵軍在戰爭期間渡河。","explanation":"名詞「爆炸物」。指能引起爆炸的物質。"}],"related_forms":["explode","explosion"]}

{"headword":"expose","explanation":"動詞「暴露、揭露」。可指將某物暴露在環境中（如 expose to the sun (暴露在陽光下)），或揭露真相/醜聞（如 expose a secret (揭露秘密)）。注意與 exposure (名詞) 的對應關係。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you <target>expose</target> the sensitive film to direct sunlight for too long, the images will be ruined and cannot be recovered.","translation":"如果你將敏感的底片長時間暴露在陽光下，，圖像將被毀損且無法恢復。","explanation":"動詞「暴露」。指將某物置於某種環境下。"},{"sentence":"The brave journalist worked for months to <target>expose</target> the corruption within the local government, eventually leading to the mayor's resignation.","translation":"勇敢的記者花了好幾個月時間揭露當地政府內部的腐敗，最終導致市長辭職。","explanation":"動詞「揭露」。指將隱藏的事實或醜聞公開。"},{"sentence":"Reading books from different cultures <target>exposes</target> students <pattern>to</pattern> new ways of thinking, helping them become more open-minded and tolerant.","translation":"閱讀不同文化的書籍使學生接觸到新的思考方式，幫助他們變得更開放且寬容。","explanation":"動詞片語 expose someone to something 表示「使接觸到」。"}],"related_forms":["exposure","exposed"]}

{"headword":"exposure","explanation":"名詞「暴露、接觸」。是 expose 的名詞形式。常用於描述暴露在某種環境中（如 exposure to the cold (暴露在寒冷中)）或接觸某種經驗（如 exposure to foreign languages (接觸外語)）。","entries":[{"sentence":"Prolonged <target>exposure</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the sun can cause severe skin damage, so it is essential to wear sunscreen when outdoors.","translation":"長時間暴露在陽光下會導致嚴重的皮膚損傷，因此在戶外時塗抹防曬霜至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「暴露」。常用搭配 exposure to the sun。"},{"sentence":"The exchange program provides students with valuable <target>exposure</target> <pattern>to</pattern> a different culture, helping them grow personally and emotionally.","translation":"交換計畫為學生提供了接觸不同文化的寶貴機會，幫助他們在個人和情感上成長。","explanation":"名詞「接觸」。指接觸某種經驗或環境。"},{"sentence":"After the scandal, the politician faced intense <target>exposure</target> in the national media, as everyone wanted to know the truth about the incident.","translation":"醜聞發生後，這位政治家在國家媒體上承受了巨大的曝光度，因為每個人都想知道事件的真相。","explanation":"名詞「曝光」。指被公眾注意到或在媒體上出現。"}],"related_forms":["expose"]}

{"headword":"extend","explanation":"動詞「延伸、擴展、延長」。可指物理上的長度增加，或指時間的延長（如 extend a deadline (延長截止日期)），或提供幫助/邀請（如 extend an invitation (發出邀請)）。注意與 expand (擴大) 的區別：extend 側重於長度或時間的延長。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government decided to <target>extend</target> the construction period of the high-speed railway to ensure that the safety standards were met.","translation":"政府決定延長高鐵建設期，以確保安全標準得到滿足。","explanation":"動詞「延長」。指時間的延長。"},{"sentence":"The school <target>extended</target> <pattern>an</pattern> <target>invitation</target> <pattern>to</pattern> all parents to attend the graduation ceremony and celebrate their children's success.","translation":"學校向所有家長發出了邀請，請他們參加畢業典禮並慶祝孩子們的成功。","explanation":"動詞片語 extend an invitation 表示「發出邀請」。"},{"sentence":"The old bridge was <target>extended</target> to accommodate more lanes of traffic, reducing the congestion during the morning rush hour.","translation":"這座舊橋被延伸擴建，以容納更多車道，從而減少早晨尖峰時段的交通擁堵。","explanation":"動詞「延伸」。指物理長度或空間的擴展。"},{"sentence":"The student asked the professor to <target>extend</target> the deadline for the final project, as he had fallen ill during the week.","translation":"這名學生請求教授延長期末專題的截止日期，因為他在那一週生病了。","explanation":"動詞「延長」。常用搭配 extend the deadline。"}],"related_forms":["extension","extended","extending"]}

{"headword":"extent","explanation":"名詞「程度、範圍」。常用片語 to some extent (在某種程度上) 或 to a great extent (在很大程度上)。注意與 amount (數量) 的區別：extent 強調的是程度或空間的延伸，而非單純的計量。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher was surprised by the <target>extent</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the damage to the library books after the flood, realizing many were beyond repair.","translation":"老師對洪水後圖書館書籍受損的程度感到驚訝，意識到許多書已無法修復。","explanation":"名詞「程度、範圍」。常用搭配：extent of sth。"},{"sentence":"I agree with your opinion <pattern>to</pattern> <target>some extent</target>, but I still believe that teamwork is more important than individual talent.","translation":"我在某種程度上同意你的看法，但我仍然認為團隊合作比個人才華更重要。","explanation":"常用片語 to some extent 意為「在某種程度上」。"},{"sentence":"The new government policy has contributed <pattern>to</pattern> <target>a great extent</target> to the reduction of plastic waste in the city.","translation":"新政府的政策在很大程度上促使了城市中塑料廢棄物的減少。","explanation":"常用片語 to a great extent 意為「在很大程度上」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"facial","explanation":"形容詞「臉部的、面部的」。常用於描述臉上的表情或美容療程，如 facial expressions (面部表情) 或 a facial (臉部美容)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The actress used her <target>facial</target> <pattern>expressions</pattern> to convey deep sadness and longing, even when she was not speaking a single word.","translation":"這名女演員利用她的面部表情來傳達深沉的悲傷和渴望，即使她一句話也沒說。","explanation":"形容詞「臉部的」。常用搭配：facial expressions (面部表情)。"},{"sentence":"After a long week of studying for exams, she decided to treat herself to a relaxing <target>facial</target> at the beauty salon.","translation":"在準備考試的一週後，她決定在美容院做一次放鬆的臉部美容。","explanation":"名詞用法，「臉部美容」。"},{"sentence":"The doctor examined the patient's <target>facial</target> <pattern>muscles</pattern> to determine if the nerve damage was causing the sudden paralysis.","translation":"醫生檢查了病人的面部肌肉，以確定神經損傷是否導致了突然的癱瘓。","explanation":"形容詞「臉部的」。常用搭配：facial muscles (面部肌肉)。"}],"related_forms":["facially"]}

{"headword":"facility","explanation":"名詞「設施、設備」或「能力、天賦」。指建築物或設備，常用複數 facilities 表示公共設施 (如 gym facilities, sports facilities)。作「能力」時，常搭配 a facility for sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university has invested in new sports <target>facilities</target>, including a modern gym and an Olympic-sized swimming pool for all students.","translation":"大學投資了新的體育設施，包括一個現代化的健身房和一個供所有學生使用的奧運標準游泳池。","explanation":"名詞「設施」。常用搭配：sports facilities (體育設施)。"},{"sentence":"The new community center provides a wide range of <target>facilities</target> for the elderly, such as a reading room and a health clinic.","translation":"新的社區中心為老年人提供了多種設施，如閱讀室和健康診所。","explanation":"名詞「設施」。"},{"sentence":"Some musicians possess a natural <target>facility</target> <pattern>for</pattern> learning complex melodies, allowing them to master new songs in a very short time.","translation":"有些音樂家擁有學習複雜旋律的天賦，使他們能在極短時間內掌握新歌曲。","explanation":"名詞「天賦、能力」。常用搭配：a facility for sth。"}],"related_forms":["facilitate","facilitation"]}

{"headword":"faithful","explanation":"形容詞「忠誠的、忠心的」或「忠實的 (指描述準確)」。常用於描述對人、信仰或配偶的忠誠。注意與 loyal 的區別：faithful 較常指長期且穩定的忠誠，而 loyal 則側重於支持與堅守。","entries":[{"sentence":"The dog remained <target>faithful</target> to its owner even after many years, waiting by the gate every day for his return.","translation":"這隻狗在多年後依然對主人忠誠，每天在門口等待他的回來。","explanation":"形容詞「忠誠的」。常用搭配：faithful to sb。"},{"sentence":"The witness provided a <target>faithful</target> <pattern>reproduction</pattern> of the event, helping the police identify the suspect more accurately.","translation":"證人對事件進行了忠實的還原，幫助警察更準確地識別嫌疑人。","explanation":"形容詞「忠實的」。指描述或複製與原件完全一致。"},{"sentence":"Despite the company's financial difficulties, the <target>faithful</target> employees continued to work hard to help the business recover.","translation":"儘管公司面臨財務困難，忠心的員工們依然努力工作以幫助公司恢復。","explanation":"形容詞「忠誠的」。"}],"related_forms":["faithfully","faithfulness"]}

{"headword":"fame","explanation":"名詞「名聲、聲望」。指被許多人認識和崇拜。常用片語 rise to fame (成名) 或 claim to fame (出名的地方)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young singer <pattern>rose</pattern> to <target>fame</target> almost overnight after her video went viral on social media across the world.","translation":"這名年輕歌手在她的影片在全球社交媒體上瘋傳後，幾乎在一夜之間成名。","explanation":"名詞「名聲」。片語 rise to fame 意為「成名」。"},{"sentence":"While many people dream of <target>fame</target> and wealth, some artists prefer to work in silence to avoid public attention.","translation":"雖然許多人夢想名聲與財富，但一些藝術家更喜歡在沉默中工作，以避開公眾的關注。","explanation":"名詞「名聲」。"},{"sentence":"The small town's <target>fame</target> <pattern>as</pattern> a peaceful retreat for writers attracted many tourists and creative minds every summer.","translation":"這個小鎮作為作家寧靜避風港的名聲吸引了許多遊客和創意人才在每年夏天到訪。","explanation":"名詞「名聲」。常用搭配：fame as sth。"}],"related_forms":["famous"]}

{"headword":"fantastic","explanation":"形容詞「極好的、很棒的」或「幻想的、離奇的」。在現代英語中，最常用於表達強烈的讚美或驚訝。注意與 wonderful 的區別：fantastic 語氣更強，常用於口語。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school trip to the national park was <target>fantastic</target>, as the students got to see rare animals in their natural habitat.","translation":"這次去國家公園的學校旅行太棒了，因為學生們得以在自然棲息地看到稀有動物。","explanation":"形容詞「極好的」。用於表達讚賞。"},{"sentence":"She came up with a <target>fantastic</target> <pattern>idea</pattern> for the science project that combined biology and robotics to solve pollution problems.","translation":"她為科學計畫提出了一個絕妙的想法，將生物學和機器人學結合起來解決污染問題。","explanation":"形容詞「絕妙的」。常用搭配：fantastic idea。"},{"sentence":"The novel describes a <target>fantastic</target> world where animals can speak and humans live in floating cities above the clouds.","translation":"這部小說描述了一個幻想的世界，在那裡動物會說話，人類住在雲端之上的漂浮城市中。","explanation":"形容詞「幻想的、離奇的」。指不真實、像幻想一樣的。"}],"related_forms":["fantastically"]}

{"headword":"fantasy","explanation":"名詞「幻想、幻想作品」。指想像出的不真實事物或對某事不切實際的渴望。常用搭配 fantasy world (幻想世界), escape into fantasy (逃避現實進入幻想)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The child spent hours creating a <target>fantasy</target> <pattern>world</pattern> in his mind, where he was a powerful wizard protecting the kingdom.","translation":"這孩子在腦海中花了好幾個小時創造一個幻想世界，在那裡他是保護王國的強大巫師。","explanation":"名詞「幻想」。常用搭配：fantasy world (幻想世界)。"},{"sentence":"For some people, reading novels is a way to <target>fantasy</target> <pattern>away</pattern> from the stress of their daily lives.","translation":"對某些人來說，閱讀小說是一種從日常生活的壓力中逃避到幻想中的方式。","explanation":"名詞「幻想」。"},{"sentence":"The movie is a blend of history and <target>fantasy</target>, mixing real historical figures with magical creatures and mythical lands.","translation":"這部電影結合了歷史與幻想，將真實的歷史人物與神奇生物及神話之地混合在一起。","explanation":"名詞「幻想作品」。指文學或電影的類型。"}],"related_forms":["fantastic"]}

{"headword":"farewell","explanation":"名詞或形容詞「告別、告別的」。常用於正式的場合，如 farewell party (告別派對) 或 bid farewell to (向...告別)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The classmates organized a <target>farewell</target> <pattern>party</pattern> for the exchange student who was returning to her home country next week.","translation":"同學們為下週要回國的交換學生舉辦了一場告別派對。","explanation":"形容詞「告別的」。常用搭配：farewell party (告別派對)。"},{"sentence":"After the long conversation, the old friends <pattern>bid</pattern> <target>farewell</target> <pattern>to</pattern> each other with a warm hug and a promise to stay in touch.","translation":"經過長時間的交談，老朋友們以溫暖的擁抱和保持聯繫的承諾向彼此告別。","explanation":"名詞「告別」。片語 bid farewell to sb 意為「向某人告別」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"fasten","explanation":"動詞「繫緊、固定」。常用搭配 fasten your seatbelt (繫好安全帶) 或 fasten the buttons (扣上鈕扣)。注意與 tie (繫) 的區別：fasten 常用於扣環、拉鍊或安全帶等固定裝置。","entries":[{"sentence":"The flight attendant reminded all passengers to <target>fasten</target> <pattern>their seatbelts</pattern> before the plane took off from the runway.","translation":"空服員提醒所有乘客在飛機從跑道起飛前繫好安全帶。","explanation":"動詞「繫緊」。常用搭配：fasten your seatbelt (繫好安全帶)。"},{"sentence":"She struggled to <target>fasten</target> the small buttons on her dress because her fingers were cold from the winter wind.","translation":"因為冬天的風讓她的手指很冷，她很吃力地扣上裙子上的小鈕扣。","explanation":"動詞「固定、扣上」。常用搭配：fasten the buttons (扣上鈕扣)。"},{"sentence":"The workers used strong ropes to <target>fasten</target> the heavy equipment <pattern>to</pattern> the wall to prevent it from falling during the earthquake.","translation":"工人使用強韌的繩索將沉重的設備固定在牆上，以防止在地震期間掉落。","explanation":"動詞「固定」。常用搭配：fasten sth to sth。"}],"related_forms":["fastener"]}

{"headword":"fatal","explanation":"形容詞「致命的、毀滅性的」。常用於描述導致死亡的事故 (fatal accident) 或致命的錯誤 (fatal flaw/mistake)。注意與 deadly 的區別：fatal 側重於最終導致死亡的結果，而 deadly 可指有潛力的致命性。","entries":[{"sentence":"The driver was distracted by his phone, which led to a <target>fatal</target> <pattern>accident</pattern> on the highway that claimed three lives.","translation":"駕駛被手機分心，導致高速公路上發生了一場奪走三條人命的致命事故。","explanation":"形容詞「致命的」。常用搭配：fatal accident (致命事故)。"},{"sentence":"The climber made a <target>fatal</target> <pattern>mistake</pattern> by ignoring the weather warning and continuing to climb the mountain during a storm.","translation":"登山者犯了一個致命的錯誤，無視天氣預警並在暴風雨中繼續登山。","explanation":"形容詞「毀滅性的」。常用搭配：fatal mistake (致命錯誤)。"},{"sentence":"Biologists discovered that the snake's venom is <target>fatal</target> <pattern>to</pattern> most mammals if it is not treated within an hour.","translation":"生物學家發現，如果不在一小時內治療，這種蛇的毒液對大多數哺乳動物來說是致命的。","explanation":"形容詞「致命的」。常用搭配：fatal to sb/sth。"}],"related_forms":["fatality","fatally"]}

{"headword":"favorable","explanation":"形容詞「有利的、贊成的」。常用於描述環境、條件或對某事持肯定態度。常用搭配 favorable conditions (有利條件), favorable response (正面回應)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young entrepreneur's new business plan received a <pattern>favorable</pattern> <target>response</target> from investors, who were impressed by its innovation.","translation":"這位年輕創業者的新商業計畫得到了投資者的正面回應，他們對其創新深感印象。","explanation":"形容詞「有利的、贊成的」。此處指對計畫持肯定態度。"},{"sentence":"Farmers are hoping for <target>favorable</target> <pattern>weather conditions</pattern> this spring to ensure a healthy crop and a high yield.","translation":"農民希望今年春天有有利的天氣條件，以確保作物健康且產量高。","explanation":"形容詞「有利的」。指環境條件有助於某事的達成。"},{"sentence":"The local government decided to provide <target>favorable</target> <pattern>tax breaks</pattern> to encourage more technology companies to set up offices in the city.","translation":"地方政府決定提供有利的稅收減免，以鼓勵更多科技公司在該市設立辦公室。","explanation":"形容詞「有利的」。指條件對某人或某事是有益的。"}],"related_forms":["favorably","favorability"]}

{"headword":"fax","explanation":"名詞「傳真機；傳真件」，動詞「傳真」。在現代數位時代較少見，但在正式商務文書中仍可能出現。常用搭配 send a fax (發送傳真)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although email is now the primary way to communicate, some law firms still prefer to send a <target>fax</target> for official documents.","translation":"雖然電子郵件現在是主要的溝通方式，但一些法律事務所仍然傾向於使用傳真發送正式文件。","explanation":"名詞「傳真件」。指透過傳真機發送的文字或圖片。"},{"sentence":"Please <target>fax</target> the signed contract to our office by Friday afternoon to ensure the process can move forward quickly.","translation":"請在週五下午前將簽署好的合約傳真到我們辦公室，以確保流程能快速推進。","explanation":"動詞「傳真」。指使用傳真機將文件發送到另一端。"},{"sentence":"The secretary spent the morning organizing the <target>faxes</target> that had arrived from various clients throughout the night.","translation":"秘書整個上午都在整理徹夜從各個客戶那裡傳來的傳真件。","explanation":"名詞「傳真機/傳真件」。此處為複數形式 faxes。"}],"related_forms":["faxes","faxing"]}

{"headword":"feast","explanation":"名詞「盛宴；宴會」，動詞「盡情享受美食」。常考片語 feast one's eyes on (盡情欣賞)。注意與 banquet (正式宴會) 的區別，feast 更強調食物豐盛且享受的過程。","entries":[{"sentence":"After the long harvest season, the entire village gathered for a grand <target>feast</target> to celebrate their hard work and success.","translation":"在漫長的收穫季後，全村人聚集在一起舉行一場盛宴，慶祝他們的辛勤工作與成功。","explanation":"名詞「盛宴」。指食物極其豐盛的聚餐。"},{"sentence":"The holiday dinner was a true <target>feast</target> for the senses, with aromatic dishes and colorful decorations filling the room.","translation":"節日晚餐是一場真正的感官盛宴，香氣四溢的菜餚和五彩繽紛的裝飾充盈著房間。","explanation":"名詞「盛宴」。此處用作比喻，指令人愉悅的視覺或嗅覺體驗。"},{"sentence":"The travelers stopped at a local inn and <target>feasted</target> <pattern>on</pattern> fresh seafood and local fruits after their long journey.","translation":"旅行者在一家當地旅館停留，在長途旅程後盡情享用新鮮的海鮮和當地水果。","explanation":"動詞「盡情享用」。搭配 on 表示享用特定的食物。"},{"sentence":"Visitors to the art gallery could <target>feast</target> <pattern>their eyes on</pattern> the stunning masterpieces of the Renaissance period.","translation":"藝術館的訪客可以盡情欣賞文藝復興時期的絕美傑作。","explanation":"動詞片語 feast one's eyes on 意為「盡情欣賞」。"}],"related_forms":["feasted","feasting"]}

{"headword":"feedback","explanation":"名詞「回饋；意見」。不可數名詞。常用搭配 provide feedback (提供回饋), constructive feedback (建設性的回饋)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher provided <pattern>constructive</pattern> <target>feedback</target> on the students' essays, helping them identify their mistakes and improve their writing skills.","translation":"老師對學生的文章提供了建設性的回饋，幫助他們找出錯誤並提高寫作技巧。","explanation":"名詞「回饋」。常用搭配 constructive feedback (建設性的回饋)。"},{"sentence":"Customer <target>feedback</target> is essential for companies to understand their users' needs and develop better products for the market.","translation":"客戶回饋對於公司了解使用者需求並開發出更好的產品至市場至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「回饋」。指消費者對產品或服務的評價。"},{"sentence":"After the presentation, the speaker asked the audience for <target>feedback</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the new proposal to see if it was clear.","translation":"簡報後，講者請聽眾對新提案提供回饋，以確認其是否清晰。","explanation":"名詞「回饋」。搭配介系詞 on 表示對特定事物的回饋。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"ferry","explanation":"名詞「渡輪」，動詞「運送；接送」。常用於描述在短距離水路或接駁交通之間往返運送人或物。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tourists took a <target>ferry</target> from the mainland to the island, enjoying the scenic views of the coast along the way.","translation":"遊客乘坐渡輪從大陸前往島嶼，沿途欣賞海岸的迷人風景。","explanation":"名詞「渡輪」。指在兩地之間往返接送乘客的船隻。"},{"sentence":"Every morning, the small boat would <target>ferry</target> the villagers <pattern>across</pattern> the river to the nearest market town.","translation":"每天早上，這艘小船會將村民接送穿過河流，前往最近的市鎮市場。","explanation":"動詞「運送；接送」。指將人或物從一處運送到另一處。"},{"sentence":"The city has implemented a new <target>ferry</target> <pattern>service</pattern> to reduce traffic congestion on the main bridge during rush hour.","translation":"這座城市實施了新的渡輪服務，以減少尖峰時段主橋上的交通擁堵。","explanation":"名詞「渡輪」。常用搭配 ferry service (渡輪服務)。"}],"related_forms":["ferries","ferrying"]}

{"headword":"fertile","explanation":"形容詞「肥沃的；多產的」。常用於描述土地（fertile soil）或想像力（fertile imagination）。注意與 sterile (不育的、無菌的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The river valley is known for its <target>fertile</target> <pattern>soil</pattern>, allowing farmers to grow a wide variety of healthy vegetables.","translation":"這個河谷以其肥沃的土壤而聞名，使農民能種植多種健康的蔬菜。","explanation":"形容詞「肥沃的」。常用搭配 fertile soil (肥沃的土壤)。"},{"sentence":"The writer has a <target>fertile</target> <pattern>imagination</pattern>, which allows her to create vivid and imaginative worlds in her fantasy novels.","translation":"這位作家擁有豐富的想像力，使她能在奇幻小說中創造出生動且富有想像力的世界。","explanation":"形容詞「豐富的、多產的」。常用搭配 fertile imagination (豐富的想像力)。"},{"sentence":"Ancient civilizations often developed near large rivers because the <target>fertile</target> plains provided a stable source of food for the population.","translation":"古代文明通常在大型河流附近發展，因為肥沃的平原為人口提供了穩定的食物來源。","explanation":"形容詞「肥沃的」。指土地適合種植作物。"}],"related_forms":["fertility","fertilizer"]}

{"headword":"fetch","explanation":"動詞「去拿回來；取出」，名詞「價格」。動詞用法最常見，指「去某處拿某物並帶回」。常用搭配 fetch some water (去取水)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young boy was asked to <target>fetch</target> his father's glasses from the bedroom so that he could start reading the newspaper.","translation":"那個小男孩被要求去臥室拿他父親的眼鏡，以便他能開始讀報。","explanation":"動詞「去拿回來」。指執行一個往返動作。"},{"sentence":"In some rural areas, children still have to <target>fetch</target> <pattern>water</pattern> <pattern>from</pattern> a nearby well every morning for their families.","translation":"在一些鄉村地區，孩子們每天早上仍必須從附近的井中為家人取水。","explanation":"動詞「取（水等）」。常用搭配 fetch water (取水)。"},{"sentence":"The rare antique painting by the famous artist is expected to <target>fetch</target> a high price at the upcoming auction.","translation":"這位著名藝術家的稀有古董畫作預計在即將到來的拍賣會上能拍出高價。","explanation":"動詞「賣得（價格）」。此處 fetch 表示獲得某個價格。"}],"related_forms":["fetched","fetching"]}

{"headword":"fiction","explanation":"名詞「小說；虛構的故事」。指非真實發生的事情。注意與 non-fiction (非虛構作品) 相對。常用搭配 science fiction (科幻小說)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The library has a large section dedicated to <target>fiction</target>, featuring works from various genres such as mystery, romance, and historical novels.","translation":"圖書館有一個很大的區域專門放置小說，包含推理、浪漫和歷史小說等各種類型的作品。","explanation":"名詞「小說」。指虛構的文學作品。"},{"sentence":"Many people enjoy reading <pattern>science</pattern> <target>fiction</target> because it explores the possibilities of future technology and space exploration.","translation":"許多人喜歡閱讀科幻小說，因為它探索了未來科技和太空探索的可能性。","explanation":"名詞「小說」。常用搭配 science fiction (科幻小說)。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer argued that the witness's story was pure <target>fiction</target> and had no basis in reality, attempting to discredit the testimony.","translation":"律師辯稱證人的故事完全是虛構的，沒有事實根據，試圖以此來削弱證詞的可信度。","explanation":"名詞「虛構」。指並非真實發生的事情。"}],"related_forms":["fictional","fictitious"]}

{"headword":"fierce","explanation":"形容詞「兇猛的；激烈的」。可用於描述動物的攻擊性或競爭的程度（fierce competition）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tiger is known as a <target>fierce</target> <pattern>predator</pattern> in the wild, using its strength and sharp claws to hunt its prey efficiently.","translation":"老虎被視為野外兇猛的掠食者，利用其力量和銳利的爪子高效地獵捕獵物。","explanation":"形容詞「兇猛的」。描述動物的攻擊性。"},{"sentence":"As the number of applicants increases, the <target>fierce</target> <pattern>competition</pattern> for university admissions has become more stressful for students.","translation":"隨著申請人數增加，大學入學的激烈競爭已使學生感到壓力更大。","explanation":"形容詞「激烈的」。常用搭配 fierce competition (激烈競爭)。"},{"sentence":"A <target>fierce</target> <pattern>debate</pattern> broke out among the committee members regarding how to distribute the budget for the new school library.","translation":"委員會成員之間就如何分配新學校圖書館的預算爆發了激烈的辯論。","explanation":"形容詞「激烈的」。常用搭配 fierce debate (激烈辯論)。"}],"related_forms":["fiercely","fierceness"]}

{"headword":"finance","explanation":"名詞「財務；金融」，動詞「資助；提供資金」。常用搭配 public finance (公共財務), finance a project (資助計畫)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company's <target>finance</target> <pattern>department</pattern> is responsible for managing the budget and ensuring that all expenses are carefully tracked.","translation":"公司的財務部門負責管理預算並確保所有支出都被仔細記錄。","explanation":"名詞「財務」。常用搭配 finance department (財務部門)。"},{"sentence":"Many students take out loans to <target>finance</target> their university education, hoping to pay them back after they find a stable job.","translation":"許多學生貸款以資助他們的大學教育，希望在找到穩定工作後將其償還。","explanation":"動詞「資助」。指提供資金以達成目的。"},{"sentence":"The government decided to <target>finance</target> the construction of a new high-speed railway to improve transportation and boost the local economy.","translation":"政府決定資助新建一條高速鐵路，以改善交通並促進當地經濟。","explanation":"動詞「資助」。指由政府或機構提供資金。"},{"sentence":"Understanding basic <target>finance</target> is important for young adults to manage their personal savings and investments effectively.","translation":"理解基礎財務知識對年輕人有效管理個人儲蓄和投資至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「金融/財務」。指金錢的管理。"}],"related_forms":["financial","financier"]}

{"headword":"financial","explanation":"形容詞「財務的，金融的」。常用於描述與金錢、銀行、投資或預算相關的事務。常見搭配：financial crisis (財務危機), financial support (財務支持), financial independence (財務獨立)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many students seek <target>financial</target> <pattern>support</pattern> from the government through scholarships to cover their tuition fees and living costs.","translation":"許多學生透過政府的獎學金尋求財務支持，以支付他們的學費和生活費。","explanation":"形容詞「財務的」。financial support 為常見搭配，指金錢上的援助。"},{"sentence":"The sudden global <target>financial</target> <pattern>crisis</pattern> led to many banks failing and people losing their life savings in a short period.","translation":"突然的全球財務危機導致許多銀行倒閉，人們在短時間內失去了他們的一生積蓄。","explanation":"形容詞「金融的」。financial crisis 指金融危機。"},{"sentence":"After years of hard work and smart investing, she finally achieved <target>financial</target> <pattern>independence</pattern>, allowing her to retire early and travel the world.","translation":"經過多年的努力工作和聰明投資，她終於實現了財務獨立，讓她能提前退休並環遊世界。","explanation":"形容詞「財務的」。financial independence 指財務獨立。"}],"related_forms":["finance","financially"]}

{"headword":"fireplace","explanation":"名詞「壁爐」。通常指房屋內用於取暖或裝飾的構造物。常考點在於其在西方文化中的居家生活場景描述。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the cold winter months, the family gathered around the <target>fireplace</target> to keep warm and share stories about their ancestors.","translation":"在寒冷的冬季月份，全家人聚集在壁爐旁取暖並分享關於祖先的故事。","explanation":"名詞「壁爐」。指房屋內用於生火取暖的裝置。"},{"sentence":"The cozy living room was decorated with a large stone <target>fireplace</target> that made the house feel welcoming and warm.","translation":"這間舒適的客廳裝飾有一個大型石製壁爐，使這座房子感覺溫馨且溫暖。","explanation":"名詞「壁爐」。描述其作為家居裝飾的一部分。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"flatter","explanation":"動詞「奉承，拍馬屁」。指用誇張或不真實的讚美來獲取利益。注意其另一個意思「使...顯得更美/好看」，例如 a dress that flatters your figure (一件讓你的身材顯得更好的衣服)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The employee tried to <target>flatter</target> his boss with constant praise for her leadership, hoping to get a promotion soon.","translation":"這名員工試圖用不斷的讚美來奉承他的老闆，希望很快能獲得晉升。","explanation":"動詞「奉承」。指透過誇張的讚美來獲取利益。"},{"sentence":"I am <target>flattered</target> by your kind words, but I believe there is still a lot of room for me to improve my English skills.","translation":"你的親切話語讓我感到受寵若驚，但我相信我的英文能力仍有很大的進步空間。","explanation":"動詞「受寵若驚」。此處為被動態，指對他人的讚美感到榮幸。"},{"sentence":"The photographer told her that the blue dress <target>flatters</target> her skin tone, making her look more vibrant and elegant on camera.","translation":"攝影師告訴她，這件藍色洋裝讓她的膚色顯得更好看，使她在鏡頭前看起來更活潑且優雅。","explanation":"動詞「使...顯得更好看」。指服裝、顏色等使人外貌更佳。"}],"related_forms":["flattery","flattering"]}

{"headword":"flea","explanation":"名詞「跳蚤」。一種小型寄生昆蟲。常出現於描述動物健康或生物學相關的文章中。","entries":[{"sentence":"The dog owner took his pet to the vet to get a <target>flea</target> treatment after noticing the puppy was scratching its ears constantly.","translation":"在注意到小狗不斷抓耳朵後，狗主人將寵物帶到獸醫那裡接受跳蚤治療。","explanation":"名詞「跳蚤」。指一種寄生昆蟲。"},{"sentence":"Many people use <target>flea</target> collars to protect their cats from parasites, ensuring the pets stay healthy and comfortable.","translation":"許多人使用跳蚤項圈來保護他們的貓免於寄生蟲，確保寵物保持健康和舒適。","explanation":"名詞「跳蚤」。flea collar 為常見搭配。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"flee","explanation":"動詞「逃離，逃跑」。通常指為了避開危險、戰爭或迫害而離開。注意其不規則動詞變化：flee-fled-fled。常考片語 flee from (從...逃離)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Thousands of civilians were forced to <target>flee</target> <pattern>from</pattern> their homes due to the sudden outbreak of war in the region.","translation":"由於該地區突然爆發戰爭，數千名平民被迫從家中逃離。","explanation":"動詞「逃離」。flee from sth 指從某處逃離。"},{"sentence":"The suspects <target>fled</target> the scene of the crime immediately after the police arrived, but they were caught a few hours later.","translation":"嫌疑犯在警察到達後立即逃離了犯罪現場，但他們在幾個小時後被抓住了。","explanation":"動詞「逃跑」。此處為過去式 fled。"},{"sentence":"Many animals <target>fled</target> the forest as the wildfire spread quickly, seeking safety in the nearby river and mountains.","translation":"許多動物在山火迅速蔓延時逃離了森林，在附近的河流和山脈中尋找安全地帶。","explanation":"動詞「逃離」。指為了避開危險而離開。"}],"related_forms":["fled"]}

{"headword":"flexible","explanation":"形容詞「靈活的，可彎曲的」。可用於描述物體（可彎曲）或人（能適應變化、時間靈活）。常見搭配：flexible schedule (靈活的行程), flexible thinking (靈活的思考)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher has a <target>flexible</target> <pattern>schedule</pattern>, allowing her to change the meeting time if students have conflicts with other classes.","translation":"老師的行程靈活，如果學生有其他課程衝突，她可以更改會議時間。","explanation":"形容詞「靈活的」。flexible schedule 指靈活的行程。"},{"sentence":"Gymnasts must be extremely <target>flexible</target> to perform complex movements and balance their bodies on the narrow beam.","translation":"體操運動員必須極其靈活，才能完成複雜的動作並在窄樑上保持身體平衡。","explanation":"形容詞「可彎曲的」。指身體的柔軟度。"},{"sentence":"In a rapidly changing job market, being <target>flexible</target> and open to new ideas is essential for long-term career success.","translation":"在快速變化的就業市場中，保持靈活且對新想法持開放態度對於長期的職業成功至關重要。","explanation":"形容詞「靈活的」。指心態或思考方式能適應變化。"}],"related_forms":["flexibility","flexibly"]}

{"headword":"fluent","explanation":"形容詞「流利的」。常用於描述語言能力。常見搭配：be fluent in (精通/流利地使用某語言)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After living in London for three years, she became <target>fluent</target> <pattern>in</pattern> English, which helped her excel in her university studies.","translation":"在倫敦住了三年後，她精通了英文，這對她在大學學習中取得優異成績很有幫助。","explanation":"形容詞「流利的」。be fluent in sth 指精通某種語言。"},{"sentence":"The candidate was hired because he was <target>fluent</target> <pattern>in</pattern> both Spanish and Japanese, making him ideal for the international trade company.","translation":"該候選人被錄用是因為他精通西班牙語和日語，使其成為國際貿易公司的理想人選。","explanation":"形容詞「流利的」。指語言表達的流暢度。"}],"related_forms":["fluency","fluently"]}

{"headword":"flush","explanation":"動詞「沖洗；臉紅」；名詞「臉紅；沖水」。動詞用法中 flush the toilet (沖水) 是最常見的考點。此外， flush a surface (使表面平齊) 也是較進階的用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please remember to <target>flush</target> the toilet after using the bathroom to maintain a clean and hygienic environment for everyone.","translation":"使用完浴室後請記得沖水，以維持一個乾淨且衛生的環境。","explanation":"動詞「沖水」。指使用水流沖洗馬桶。"},{"sentence":"The girl <target>flushed</target> <pattern>with</pattern> embarrassment when the teacher praised her in front of the whole class.","translation":"當老師在全班面前稱讚她時，她因尷尬而臉紅了。","explanation":"動詞「臉紅」。flush with embarrassment 意為「因尷尬而臉紅」。"},{"sentence":"The sudden surge of water <target>flushed</target> the debris <pattern>out of</pattern> the small pipe, clearing the blockage and restoring the flow.","translation":"y-水流的突然增加將碎片沖出了小管子，清除了堵塞並恢復了流量。","explanation":"動詞「沖洗」。指用大量水將某物沖走。"}],"related_forms":["flushed"]}

{"headword":"foam","explanation":"名詞「泡沫」。動詞「起泡」。常用於描述洗滌劑、海浪或動物的口中起泡（如狂犬病）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The barista used a steam wand to create thick <target>foam</target> on top of the cappuccino, making the coffee look professional.","translation":"咖啡師使用蒸汽棒在卡布奇諾頂部製造出厚厚的泡沫，使咖啡看起來很專業。","explanation":"名詞「泡沫」。指液體表面產生的氣泡。"},{"sentence":"The ocean waves <target>foamed</target> as they crashed against the rocky shore, leaving white bubbles on the sand.","translation":"海浪在撞擊岩石海岸時起泡，在沙灘上留下了白色氣泡。","explanation":"動詞「起泡」。指液體因劇烈運動而產生泡沫。"},{"sentence":"The injured animal was <target>foaming</target> <pattern>at</pattern> the mouth, which made the veterinarian suspect that it might have rabies.","translation":"受傷的動物口中起泡，這讓獸醫懷疑它可能患有狂犬病。","explanation":"動詞片語 foaming at the mouth 指「口中起泡」。"}],"related_forms":["foamy"]}

{"headword":"forbid","explanation":"動詞「禁止」。注意其不規則動詞變化：forbid-forbade-forbidden。常用句型：forbid someone to do something (禁止某人做某事) 或 forbid something (禁止某物)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school administration decided to <target>forbid</target> the use of smartphones <pattern>during</pattern> class to ensure students remain focused on their lessons.","translation":"學校管理層決定禁止在課堂期間使用智慧型手機，以確保學生能專注於課程。","explanation":"動詞「禁止」。forbid the use of sth 指禁止使用某物。"},{"sentence":"My parents <target>forbade</target> me <pattern>to</pattern> go out late at night, fearing that the city streets might be dangerous for a teenager.","translation":"我的父母禁止我深夜外出，擔心城市街道對青少年來說可能很危險。","explanation":"動詞「禁止」。forbid someone to do something 為常用句型。此處為過去式 forbade。"},{"sentence":"The strict rules <target>forbidden</target> the entry of unauthorized personnel into the laboratory to prevent any potential chemical leaks.","translation":"這些嚴格的規則禁止未經授權的人員進入實驗室，以防止任何潛在的化學洩漏。","explanation":"動詞「禁止」。此處為過去分詞 forbidden 作為形容詞使用。"}],"related_forms":["forbade","forbidden"]}

{"headword":"forecast","explanation":"可作為名詞或動詞，意為「預報」或「預測」。常指對未來天氣或經濟趨勢的預測。常見搭配：weather forecast (天氣預報), economic forecast (經濟預測)。","entries":[{"sentence":"According to the <pattern>weather</pattern> <target>forecast</target>, it is expected to rain heavily tomorrow, so students should remember to bring their umbrellas to school.","translation":"根據天氣預報，明天預計會有大雨，所以學生們應該記得帶傘去學校。","explanation":"名詞「預報」。常用搭配：weather forecast (天氣預報)。"},{"sentence":"Economists <target>forecast</target> that the global market will continue to grow slowly over the next few years due to increasing trade barriers.","translation":"經濟學家預測全球市場在未來幾年由於貿易壁壘增加將繼續緩慢增長。","explanation":"動詞「預測」。指對未來趨勢的分析預測。"},{"sentence":"The financial analyst's <target>forecast</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the company's future profits turned out to be accurate, impressing the board of directors.","translation":"金融分析師對公司未來利潤的預測證明是準確的，給董事會留下了深刻印象。","explanation":"名詞「預測」。常用搭配：forecast of sth。"},{"sentence":"Despite the positive <target>forecasts</target>, the company decided to be cautious and save more money for potential emergencies in the future.","translation":"儘管預測結果積極，公司仍決定採取謹慎態度，為未來潛在的緊急情況儲蓄更多資金。","explanation":"名詞「預測」。複數形式 forecasts。"}],"related_forms":["forecasts","forecasting"]}

{"headword":"formation","explanation":"名詞，意為「形成」或「陣型/編隊」。常用於描述地質構造、組織建立或軍事/飛行編隊。常見搭配：cloud formation (雲層形成), rock formation (岩層構造)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The unique <pattern>rock</pattern> <target>formation</target> in the Grand Canyon provides scientists with valuable information about the Earth's geological history.","translation":"大峽谷中獨特的岩層構造為科學家提供了關於地球地質歷史的寶貴資訊。","explanation":"名詞「構造、形成」。常用搭配：rock formation (岩層構造)。"},{"sentence":"The <target>formation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the new student council took several weeks of discussion and planning to ensure a fair representation of all grades.","translation":"新學生會的成立花費了數週的討論和計劃，以確保所有年級的公平代表。","explanation":"名詞「形成、成立」。常用搭配：formation of sth。"},{"sentence":"The birds flew in a V-shaped <target>formation</target> during their migration south, which helped them save energy and fly more efficiently.","translation":"鳥類在向南遷徙時以 V 型編隊飛行，這有助於它們節省能量並更高效地飛行。","explanation":"名詞「編隊、陣型」。指物體在空間中的排列方式。"}],"related_forms":["form"]}

{"headword":"formula","explanation":"名詞，意為「公式」或「配方」。在學術情境中常指數學或化學公式；在日常情境中則指成功的秘訣或特定步驟。常見搭配：mathematical formula (數學公式), secret formula (秘密配方)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The chemistry teacher asked the students to write down the chemical <target>formula</target> <pattern>for</pattern> water, which is H2O, on the whiteboard.","translation":"化學老師要求學生在白板上寫下水的化學式 H2O。","explanation":"名詞「化學式」。常用搭配：formula for sth。"},{"sentence":"Students often struggle to memorize the complex <pattern>mathematical</pattern> <target>formulas</target> required for the advanced physics exam next week.","translation":"學生們經常苦於記憶下週高級物理考試所需的複雜數學公式。","explanation":"名詞「公式」。複數形式為 formulas 或 formulae。"},{"sentence":"Many people believe that hard work and persistence are the secret <target>formula</target> <pattern>for</pattern> success in any professional career.","translation":"許多人認為努力和堅持是任何職業生涯成功的秘密配方。","explanation":"名詞「配方、秘訣」。指達成某目標的特定方式。"}],"related_forms":["formulate","formulation"]}

{"headword":"fort","explanation":"名詞，意為「堡壘」或「要塞」。指為了防禦目的而建造的加固建築物。在歷史或地理討論中較為常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the history lesson, the teacher described how the ancient <target>fort</target> was built on a hill to give soldiers a better view of enemies.","translation":"在歷史課上，老師描述了古代堡壘是如何建在山上的，以便讓士兵能更好地觀察敵人。","explanation":"名詞「堡壘」。指防禦性的建築。"},{"sentence":"The old stone <target>fort</target> has now been turned into a museum, where tourists can learn about the military strategies of the past.","translation":"這座古老的石堡現在已被轉化為博物館，遊客可以在此了解過去的軍事策略。","explanation":"名詞「要塞」。"}],"related_forms":["forts"]}

{"headword":"fortunate","explanation":"形容詞，意為「幸運的」。常用於描述人或情況。常見搭配：be fortunate to (幸運地...), be fortunate enough to (足夠幸運而能...)。注意與 lucky 的區別：fortunate 通常較為正式。","entries":[{"sentence":"I feel very <target>fortunate</target> <pattern>to</pattern> have such supportive parents who always encourage me to pursue my dreams regardless of the cost.","translation":"我覺得很幸運能有如此支持我的父母，他們總是鼓勵我追求夢想而不計代價。","explanation":"形容詞「幸運的」。常用搭配：be fortunate to V。"},{"sentence":"The hikers were <target>fortunate</target> <pattern>enough</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> find a small village before the storm hit, avoiding a dangerous situation in the mountains.","translation":"登山者們足夠幸運，在風暴襲擊前找到了一個小村莊，避免了在山區的危險情況。","explanation":"形容詞「幸運的」。常用搭配：be fortunate enough to V。"},{"sentence":"It was <target>fortunate</target> that the student submitted his essay just minutes before the deadline, otherwise he would have lost many points.","translation":"幸運的是，該學生在截止日期前幾分鐘提交了論文，否則他將失去許多分數。","explanation":"形容詞「幸運的」。用於描述情況。"}],"related_forms":["fortunately","misfortunate","fortune"]}

{"headword":"fossil","explanation":"可作為名詞或形容詞。名詞指「化石」；形容詞指「化石的」或「過時的」。在科學課堂上常討論生物進化和地質年代。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students visited the natural history museum to see the <target>fossil</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a dinosaur, which was millions of years old.","translation":"學生們參觀了自然歷史博物館，以查看一件有數百萬年歷史的恐龍化石。","explanation":"名詞「化石」。常用搭配：fossil of sth。"},{"sentence":"Paleontologists study <target>fossils</target> to understand how animals evolved over time and what the environment was like in the ancient past.","translation":"古生物學家研究化石以了解動物如何隨時間演化以及古代環境是什麼樣子。","explanation":"名詞「化石」。複數形式 fossils。"},{"sentence":"The professor argued that using <target>fossil</target> <pattern>fuels</pattern> like coal and oil is damaging the planet and accelerating global warming.","translation":"教授主張使用煤和石油等化石燃料正在破壞地球並加速全球暖化。","explanation":"形容詞「化石的」。常用搭配：fossil fuels (化石燃料)。"}],"related_forms":["fossilize","fossilization"]}

{"headword":"foundation","explanation":"名詞，意為「基礎」或「基金會/會館」。可指建築物的地基，也可指抽象的理論、關係或知識的基礎。常見搭配：lay the foundation for (為...奠定基礎), solid foundation (堅實的基礎)。","entries":[{"sentence":"A strong <target>foundation</target> in basic mathematics is essential for any student who wants to excel in engineering or computer science.","translation":"對於任何想要在工程或電腦科學方面表現出色的學生來說，紮實的數學基礎至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「基礎」。指知識或技能的基礎。"},{"sentence":"The government established a charitable <target>foundation</target> to provide scholarships for students from low-income families to attend university.","translation":"政府成立了一個慈善基金會，為來自低收入家庭的學生提供大學獎學金。","explanation":"名詞「基金會」。"},{"sentence":"Reading many diverse books in high school <pattern>laid</pattern> the <target>foundation</target> <pattern>for</pattern> his future success as a professional writer and journalist.","translation":"在高中閱讀許多不同類型的書籍，為他未來作為專業作家和記者的成功奠定了基礎。","explanation":"名詞「基礎」。片語 lay the foundation for sth 表示「為...奠定基礎」。"},{"sentence":"Construction workers spent several months building the concrete <target>foundation</target> of the new library before they could start the walls.","translation":"建築工人花了好幾個月時間建造新圖書館的混凝土地基，然後才能開始蓋牆。","explanation":"名詞「地基」。指建築物的物理基礎。"}],"related_forms":["found","foundational"]}

{"headword":"founder","explanation":"名詞，意為「創始人」或「創辦人」。指建立公司、組織、學校或制度的人。注意不要與動詞 founder (沉沒/失敗) 混淆。","entries":[{"sentence":"Steve Jobs was one of the <target>founders</target> of Apple Inc., helping the company grow from a small garage project into a global giant.","translation":"史蒂夫·賈布斯是蘋果公司的創始人之一，幫助該公司從一個小車庫計畫成長為全球巨頭。","explanation":"名詞「創始人」。"},{"sentence":"The <target>founder</target> of the university gave a speech at the graduation ceremony, sharing the values and vision that led to the school's creation.","translation":"大學的創辦人於畢業典禮上發表演說，分享導致學校創立的價值觀和願景。","explanation":"名詞「創辦人」。"}],"related_forms":["found","founding"]}

{"headword":"fragile","explanation":"形容詞，意為「脆弱的」。可用於描述物理上的易碎品（如玻璃），也可描述身體健康、心理狀態或不穩定的關係/情況。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please be careful when moving those boxes, as they contain <target>fragile</target> <pattern>glassware</pattern> that could break easily if dropped.","translation":"搬運這些箱子時請小心，因為裡面裝有易碎的玻璃製品，如果掉落很容易破碎。","explanation":"形容詞「易碎的」。常用搭配：fragile glassware。"},{"sentence":"The elderly man's health was very <target>fragile</target>, and the doctors warned his family to keep him warm and avoid any sudden stress.","translation":"這位老人的健康狀況非常脆弱，醫生警告他的家人要讓他保持溫暖並避免任何突然的壓力。","explanation":"形容詞「脆弱的」。描述身體健康。"},{"sentence":"After the long argument, the friendship between the two students remained <target>fragile</target>, and any small misunderstanding could end it completely.","translation":"經過長久的爭論，這兩名學生之間的友誼依然脆弱，任何小的誤會都可能讓它完全結束。","explanation":"形容詞「脆弱的」。描述關係或心理狀態。"}],"related_forms":["fragility","fragilely"]}

{"headword":"frame","explanation":"名詞可指「框架」、「相框」或「身體骨架」；動詞可指「搭建框架」、「構思/制定」或「陷害」。在 GSAT 中，名詞的框架與動詞的構思/制定較常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"She put the family photo in a beautiful wooden <target>frame</target> and placed it on the desk to remember her childhood memories.","translation":"她把全家福照片放進一個漂亮的木製相框裡，並把它放在書桌上以紀念她的童年回憶。","explanation":"名詞「相框」。"},{"sentence":"The architect designed a steel <target>frame</target> for the new skyscraper to ensure the building could withstand strong winds and earthquakes.","translation":"建築師為這座新摩天大樓設計了一個鋼製框架，以確保建築物能承受強風和地震。","explanation":"名詞「框架」。"},{"sentence":"The committee spent several hours trying to <target>frame</target> the new school rules in a way that was fair to all students.","translation":"委員會花了好幾個小時試圖以一種對所有學生都公平的方式制定新校規。","explanation":"動詞「制定、構思」。指對規則、計畫或問題的描述方式。"},{"sentence":"The police discovered that the evidence had been <target>framed</target> by the criminal to make an innocent man look guilty of the crime.","translation":"警方發現證據是被罪犯偽造的，目的是讓一個無辜的人看起來像是犯罪。","explanation":"動詞「陷害」。"}],"related_forms":["framing","frames"]}

{"headword":"frequency","explanation":"名詞，意為「頻率」或「頻次」。在 GSAT 中常出現在科學、技術或社會現象的描述中，例如 signal frequency (信號頻率) 或 the frequency of accidents (事故發生頻率)。注意與 frequent (形容詞) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The radio operator adjusted the <target>frequency</target> of the signal to ensure the communication was clear and stable during the storm.","translation":"無線電操作員調整了信號的頻率，以確保在暴風雨期間通訊清晰且穩定。","explanation":"名詞「頻率」。指波形或信號的振動次數。"},{"sentence":"Researchers noticed a high <target>frequency</target> <pattern>of</pattern> errors in the students' essays, leading them to organize a writing workshop to help.","translation":"研究人員注意到學生作文中的錯誤頻率很高，因此他們組織了一場寫作工作坊來提供幫助。","explanation":"名詞「頻次」。指某事發生的次數之多寡。"},{"sentence":"Because of the increasing <target>frequency</target> <pattern>of</pattern> natural disasters, many countries are now investing more in early warning systems.","translation":"由於自然災害發生的頻率增加，許多國家現在正投入更多資金於預警系統。","explanation":"名詞「頻次」。描述某種現象發生的頻繁程度。"}],"related_forms":["frequent","frequently"]}

{"headword":"freshman","explanation":"名詞，指「一年級新生」。在校園生活情境中非常常見。常用搭配：a college freshman (大學新生), a high school freshman (高中一年級新生)。注意 freshman 是一個集合名詞，複數形式為 freshmen。","entries":[{"sentence":"As a <target>freshman</target> in college, he felt overwhelmed by the large campus and the difficulty of his first-year university courses.","translation":"作為一名大學一年級新生，他對巨大的校園和一年級大學課程的難度感到壓力很大。","explanation":"名詞「一年級新生」。指進入大學或高中後的第一年學生。"},{"sentence":"The university organizes an orientation week to help every <target>freshman</target> adjust to the new environment and meet new friends.","translation":"大學組織了迎新週，以幫助每位一年級新生適應新環境並結識新朋友。","explanation":"名詞「一年級新生」。常用情境為校園適應。"}],"related_forms":["freshmen"]}

{"headword":"frost","explanation":"名詞「霜」；動詞「結霜」。名詞指水汽在寒冷表面凝結成冰晶。動詞則指表面被覆蓋上霜。常用搭配：heavy frost (濃霜), a layer of frost (一層霜)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The morning grass was covered in a thin layer of <target>frost</target>, making the garden look like it was made of silver.","translation":"早晨的草地覆蓋著一層薄薄的霜，使花園看起來像是用銀子製成的。","explanation":"名詞「霜」。指寒冷天氣下凝結的水汽。"},{"sentence":"Farmers are worried that a sudden <target>frost</target> <pattern>in</pattern> early spring might kill the young plants and destroy their crops.","translation":"農民擔心早春突然的霜凍可能會殺死幼苗並摧毀他們的作物。","explanation":"名詞「霜凍」。指對植物有害的低溫現象。"},{"sentence":"The cold winter air caused the window panes to <target>frost</target> over, blocking the view of the snowy landscape outside.","translation":"寒冷的冬日空氣導致窗玻璃結霜，遮擋了外面雪景的視線。","explanation":"動詞「結霜」。指表面被冰晶覆蓋。"}],"related_forms":["frosty","frosted"]}

{"headword":"frown","explanation":"動詞「皺眉」；名詞「皺眉」。通常表示不滿、困惑或深思。常考搭配：frown at (對...皺眉/表示不滿), a deep frown (深深的皺眉)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher <target>frowned</target> <pattern>at</pattern> the student who continued to talk loudly while others were trying to concentrate on the exam.","translation":"老師對那個在其他人試圖專注於考試時仍大聲交談的學生皺眉。","explanation":"動詞「皺眉」。表示不滿或警告。"},{"sentence":"She had a <target>frown</target> on her face when she read the disappointing news, showing that she was unhappy with the result.","translation":"她閱讀令人失望的消息時臉上帶著皺眉的神情，顯示她對結果並不滿意。","explanation":"名詞「皺眉」。指臉上的表情。"},{"sentence":"He sat in deep thought, his <target>frown</target> deepening as he tried to solve the complex mathematical problem in the competition.","translation":"他陷入深思，當他試圖解決比賽中複雜的數學問題時，他的皺眉程度加深了。","explanation":"名詞「皺眉」。在此處表示專注或困惑。"}],"related_forms":["frowning"]}

{"headword":"frustrate","explanation":"動詞，意為「使挫折」或「使沮喪」。常用於描述在嘗試達成目標時遇到障礙而產生的感覺。常考搭配：feel frustrated (感到沮喪), frustrate someone's efforts (使某人的努力徒勞)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The language barrier <target>frustrated</target> the foreign exchange student, who struggled to communicate his needs to the local residents.","translation":"語言障礙使這位外國交換生感到沮喪，他很難向當地居民表達自己的需求。","explanation":"動詞「使沮喪」。指因無法達成目標而感到心煩。"},{"sentence":"The team's constant mistakes <target>frustrated</target> their coach, who eventually lost his patience and shouted at them during the practice.","translation":"球隊不斷地犯錯讓他們的教練感到沮喪，教練最終失去了耐心並在練習時對他們大聲吼叫。","explanation":"動詞「使沮喪」。指因事情不如預期而感到憤怒或心煩。"},{"sentence":"Heavy rain and strong winds <target>frustrated</target> the rescue team's <pattern>efforts</pattern> to locate the missing hikers in the mountains.","translation":"大雨和強風使救援隊在山中尋找失蹤登山客的努力徒勞。","explanation":"動詞「使徒勞」。指使計畫或努力無法成功。"}],"related_forms":["frustrating","frustrated","frustration"]}

{"headword":"frustration","explanation":"名詞，意為「挫折感」或「沮喪」。是 frustrate 的名詞形式。常用搭配：out of frustration (出於挫折感), a sense of frustration (一種挫折感)。","entries":[{"sentence":"He slammed the door <pattern>out of</pattern> <target>frustration</target> after spending three hours trying to solve a computer glitch that would not disappear.","translation":"在花了三小時試圖解決一個揮之不去的電腦故障後，他出於挫折感而猛 slammed 門。","explanation":"名詞「挫折感」。指因無法達成目標而產生的負面情緒。"},{"sentence":"Many students experience a deep sense of <target>frustration</target> when they cannot grasp a difficult concept despite studying hard for weeks.","translation":"許多學生儘管努力學習數週，但仍無法理解一個困難的概念時，會感到深深的挫折感。","explanation":"名詞「挫折感」。常用搭配：a sense of frustration。"},{"sentence":"The government's failure to address the housing crisis has led to widespread <target>frustration</target> among young people in the city.","translation":"政府未能解決住房危機導致城市中的年輕人普遍感到沮喪。","explanation":"名詞「沮喪」。指社會大眾對某事的不滿。"}],"related_forms":["frustrate","frustrating","frustrated"]}

{"headword":"fulfill","explanation":"動詞，意為「實現」、「履行」或「滿足」。常用於描述實現夢想、履行承諾或滿足需求。常考搭配：fulfill a dream (實現夢想), fulfill a requirement (符合要求), fulfill a promise (履行承諾)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After years of hard work and dedication, she finally <target>fulfilled</target> <pattern>her dream</pattern> of becoming a world-famous surgeon.","translation":"經過多年的努力和奉獻，她終於實現了成為世界知名外科醫生的夢想。","explanation":"動詞「實現」。常用搭配：fulfill a dream。"},{"sentence":"To graduate from the university, students must <target>fulfill</target> all the academic <pattern>requirements</pattern> set by their chosen department.","translation":"為了從大學畢業，學生必須滿足所選系所設定的所有學術要求。","explanation":"動詞「滿足」。常用搭配：fulfill requirements。"},{"sentence":"The company failed to <target>fulfill</target> its <pattern>promise</pattern> to increase wages for its employees, leading to a strike by the workers.","translation":"公司未能履行增加員工工資的承諾，導致工人採取罷工。","explanation":"動詞「履行」。常用搭配：fulfill a promise。"}],"related_forms":["fulfillment","fulfilling"]}

{"headword":"fulfillment","explanation":"名詞，意為「實現」、「滿足感」或「完成」。指達到目標或滿足某種需求後的心理狀態。常用搭配：a sense of fulfillment (一種滿足感), personal fulfillment (個人成就感)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Helping others through volunteering at the local hospital gives her a great sense of <target>fulfillment</target> and purpose in life.","translation":"透過在當地醫院擔任志工來幫助他人，讓她在生活中獲得了巨大的滿足感和目標感。","explanation":"名詞「滿足感」。指達成某事後的心情。"},{"sentence":"Many people change their careers to find a job that provides more personal <target>fulfillment</target> than just earning a high salary.","translation":"許多人更換職業以尋找一份能提供更多個人成就感而非僅僅是高薪的工作。","explanation":"名詞「成就感」。指心理上的滿足。"},{"sentence":"The <target>fulfillment</target> of the prophecy predicted that the hero would return to save the kingdom from the dark forces.","translation":"預言的實現讓預言中英雄將會回來救王國脫離黑暗勢力。","explanation":"名詞「實現」。指某事（如預言或計畫）的完成。"}],"related_forms":["fulfill"]}

{"headword":"functional","explanation":"形容詞，意為「功能性的」或「實用的」。常用於描述物品的設計目的在於實用而非美觀。常用搭配：functional design (功能性設計), fully functional (功能完全正常的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new office furniture was <target>functional</target> and simple, focusing on comfort and efficiency rather than fancy decorations.","translation":"新的辦公家具功能實用且簡單，注重舒適度與效率而非華麗的裝飾。","explanation":"形容詞「實用的」。強調實用大於美觀。"},{"sentence":"Although the old laptop was slow, it was still <target>functional</target> enough for basic tasks like typing documents and browsing the web.","translation":"雖然舊筆記本電腦速度很慢，但對於打字文件和瀏覽網頁等基本任務來說，它仍然是可用的。","explanation":"形容詞「可用的/功能正常的」。"},{"sentence":"The architect focused on creating a <target>functional</target> <pattern>layout</pattern> for the library to ensure that students could find books easily.","translation":"建築師專注於為圖書館創建一個功能性的佈局，以確保學生能輕鬆找到書。","explanation":"形容詞「功能性的」。常用搭配：functional layout。"}],"related_forms":["function","functionally"]}

{"headword":"fundamental","explanation":"形容詞「基本的、根本的」；名詞「基本原則/基礎」。作形容詞時，常用於描述某事是核心且不可或缺的。常考搭配：fundamental right (基本權利), fundamental change (根本性的改變), the fundamentals of (...的基本原則)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Reading and writing are <target>fundamental</target> skills that every child must master before entering primary school.","translation":"閱讀和寫作是每個孩子在進入小學之前必須掌握的基本技能。","explanation":"形容詞「基本的」。指核心且必要的。"},{"sentence":"The discovery of new evidence led to a <target>fundamental</target> <pattern>shift</pattern> in how scientists understand the process of climate change.","translation":"新證據的發現導致科學家對氣候變遷過程的理解發生了根本性的轉移。","explanation":"形容詞「根本性的」。指深層且全面的改變。"},{"sentence":"Before learning advanced calculus, students should first grasp the <target>fundamentals</target> <pattern>of</pattern> algebra to build a strong foundation.","translation":"在學習進階微積分之前，學生應該首先掌握代數的基本原則，以建立強大的基礎。","explanation":"名詞「基本原則」。常用片語 the fundamentals of...。"}],"related_forms":["fundamentally"]}

{"headword":"funeral","explanation":"名詞，指「葬禮」。常用搭配：attend a funeral (參加葬禮), a funeral service (葬禮儀式)。注意其發音與其在文化情境中的使用。","entries":[{"sentence":"The entire town gathered at the church to <target>attend</target> the <target>funeral</target> of the beloved local teacher who had served for forty years.","translation":"全鎮的人都聚集在教堂參加這位服務了四十年的受人愛戴的當地老師的葬禮。","explanation":"名詞「葬禮」。常用搭配：attend a funeral。"},{"sentence":"The family chose a private <target>funeral</target> <pattern>service</pattern> to say their final goodbyes in a quiet and intimate atmosphere.","translation":"這家人選擇了一場私人葬禮儀式，以便在安靜且親密的氛圍中做最後的告別。","explanation":"名詞「葬禮儀式」。funeral service 指正式的儀式過程。"}],"related_forms":["funereal"]}

{"headword":"furious","explanation":"形容詞「極其憤怒的」。比 angry 程度深得多。常用搭配：be furious with someone (對某人感到憤怒), be furious at something (對某事感到憤怒)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher was <target>furious</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the students after discovering that they had cheated on the final exam together.","translation":"老師在發現學生們一起在期末考作弊後，感到極其憤怒。","explanation":"形容詞「極其憤怒的」。常用搭配 be furious with someone。"},{"sentence":"My parents were <target>furious</target> <pattern>at</pattern> the loud noise from the neighbors' party, which kept them awake until midnight.","translation":"我的父母對鄰居派對發出的巨大噪音感到極其憤怒，這讓他們直到午夜都無法入睡。","explanation":"形容詞「極其憤怒的」。常用搭配 be furious at something。"}],"related_forms":["furiously"]}

{"headword":"furnish","explanation":"動詞「布置、提供」。指為房間或房屋提供家具，或提供必要的資訊、證據等。常用搭配：furnish a room (布置房間), furnish evidence (提供證據)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new apartment was completely <target>furnished</target> with modern furniture, so the students didn't need to buy any new tables or chairs.","translation":"這間新公寓完全配備了現代家具，所以學生們不需要購買任何新桌子或椅子。","explanation":"動詞「布置、提供」。這裡使用被動語態 furnished，指提供家具。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer asked the witness to <target>furnish</target> <pattern>more</pattern> <pattern>details</pattern> about the accident to help the police solve the case.","translation":"律師要求證人提供更多關於事故的細節，以幫助警方解決案件。","explanation":"動詞「提供」。指提供資訊或證據。"}],"related_forms":["furniture","furnishing"]}

{"headword":"furthermore","explanation":"副詞「此外，而且」。用於在論述中增加額外的資訊，通常在句子開頭，後面接逗號。與 moreover, in addition 意思相近，但更具正式感。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new library provides a quiet space for studying; <target>furthermore</target>, it offers free online databases for all students to use.","translation":"新圖書館提供了一個安靜的學習空間；此外，它還為所有學生提供免費的在線資料庫供使用。","explanation":"副詞「此外」。用於增加額外資訊。"},{"sentence":"Regular exercise improves physical health; <target>furthermore</target>, it is known to reduce stress and improve mental well-being for many people.","translation":"定期運動能改善身體健康；此外，據知它可以減輕壓力和提高許多人的心理健康。","explanation":"副詞「此外」。用於論述中遞進。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"gallery","explanation":"名詞「美術館、畫廊」。指展示藝術品的地方。在現代語境中，也可指「觀眾席」或「手機的相冊」。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the school trip, the students visited a famous <target>gallery</target> to admire the oil paintings of the Great Masters.","translation":"在校外教學期間，學生們參觀了一家著名的美術館，以欣賞大師們的油畫。","explanation":"名詞「美術館」。指展示藝術品之處。"},{"sentence":"She spent hours browsing through the <target>gallery</target> on her phone to find the perfect photo for her social media post.","translation":"她花了好幾個小時瀏覽手機裡的相冊，想為她的社交媒體貼文找到最完美的照片。","explanation":"名詞「相冊」。指手機中存放照片的區域。"}],"related_forms":["galleries"]}

{"headword":"gaze","explanation":"動詞或名詞「凝視」。指長時間地、專注地看。常搭配 gaze at (凝視...)。注意與 look, stare 的區別：gaze 較多帶有欽佩、思考或夢幻的感覺；stare 通常指驚訝或不禮貌地盯著看。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young artist spent hours <target>gazing</target> <pattern>at</pattern> the landscape, trying to capture the perfect light in her painting.","translation":"這位年輕的藝術家花了好幾個小時凝視著風景，試圖在她的畫中捕捉到完美的光線。","explanation":"動詞「凝視」。常用搭配 gaze at。"},{"sentence":"He stood in silence, his <target>gaze</target> <pattern>fixed</pattern> <pattern>on</pattern> the old photograph of his grandparents, remembering the happy times they shared.","translation":"他靜靜地站著，目光固定在祖父母的老照片上，回憶著他們共同度過的快樂時間。","explanation":"名詞「凝視、目光」。常用搭配 gaze fixed on。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"gear","explanation":"名詞「裝備、齒輪、檔位」；動詞「調整」。名詞時，gear 常指特定活動所需的器材。動詞時，常用於片語 gear up for (為...做好準備)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Before heading to the mountains for the hiking trip, make sure you have all the necessary camping <target>gear</target> in your backpack.","translation":"在前往山區徒步旅行之前，請確保你的背包裡有所有必要的露營裝備。","explanation":"名詞「裝備」。指特定活動所需的器材。"},{"sentence":"The school is <target>gearing</target> <pattern>up</pattern> <pattern>for</pattern> the annual sports meet, and students are practicing their events every afternoon.","translation":"學校正為年度運動會做準備，學生們每天下午都在練習他們的項目。","explanation":"動詞片語 gear up for 表示「為...做好準備」。"},{"sentence":"The driver shifted the car into a lower <target>gear</target> to climb the steep hill more easily.","translation":"駕駛將汽車換到低檔位，以便更容易地攀爬陡峭的山丘。","explanation":"名詞「檔位」。指機械上的齒輪或檔位。"}],"related_forms":["gears"]}

{"headword":"gender","explanation":"名詞「性別」。在現代語言學和社會學中，gender 區分了生物學上的 sex (生理性別) 與社會文化定義的 gender (社會性別)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university is promoting programs that ensure equal opportunities for all students, regardless of their <target>gender</target> or background.","translation":"大學正在推廣確保所有學生無論性別或背景都能獲得平等機會的計畫。","explanation":"名詞「性別」。指社會或文化定義的性別。"},{"sentence":"In the sociology class, students discussed how <target>gender</target> <pattern>roles</pattern> have changed over the last few decades in different cultures.","translation":"在社會學課上，學生討論了在不同文化中，性別角色在過去幾十年中是如何改變的。","explanation":"名詞「性別」。常用搭配 gender roles (性別角色)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"gene","explanation":"名詞「基因」。生物學術語，指遺傳的基本單位。常用搭配：gene therapy (基因治療), genetic information (遺傳資訊)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Scientists have discovered a specific <target>gene</target> that makes some people more likely to develop certain health conditions.","translation":"科學家發現了一個特定的基因，使得某些人更容易患上某些健康狀況。","explanation":"名詞「基因」。指遺傳的單位。"},{"sentence":"The researchers are studying how a <target>gene</target> can be <target>mutated</target> by environmental factors, affecting the physical traits of organisms.","translation":"研究人員正在研究環境因素如何導致基因突變，進而影響生物的身體特徵。","explanation":"名詞「基因」。這裡提到基因突變 (mutation)。"}],"related_forms":["genetic","genetics"]}
