{"headword":"generation","explanation":"名詞「一代人、世代」。指大約同一時間出生的人。常用搭配：the older generation (年長的一代), the younger generation (年輕的一代), generation gap (世代差距)。","entries":[{"sentence":"There is often a significant <target>generation</target> <pattern>gap</pattern> between parents and children, leading to misunderstandings about music and fashion.","translation":"父母與孩子之間經常存在顯著的世代差距，導致對音樂和時尚的誤解。","explanation":"名詞「世代」。常用搭配 generation gap (世代差距)。"},{"sentence":"The <target>generation</target> of new ideas is essential for the growth of a company, as it allows them to stay competitive in the market.","translation":"新想法的產生（生成）是公司成長的關鍵，因為這讓他們能在市場中保持競爭力。","explanation":"名詞「產生、生成」。指某事物的產生過程。"},{"sentence":"The <target>younger</target> <target>generation</target> is generally more comfortable with technology and digital tools than their grandparents.","translation":"年輕一代通常比他們的祖父母更擅長使用科技和數位工具。","explanation":"名詞「一代人」。指同一時間出生的人。"}],"related_forms":["generate","generator"]}

{"headword":"generosity","explanation":"名詞「慷慨、大方」。指樂於分享或給予他人金錢、時間或幫助的品質。形容詞為 generous。","entries":[{"sentence":"Thanks to the <target>generosity</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the local business owners, the school was able to buy new computers for the computer lab.","translation":"由於當地企業主的慷慨，學校得以為電腦教室購買新電腦。","explanation":"名詞「慷慨」。常用搭配 generosity of someone。"},{"sentence":"The teacher praised the student's <target>generosity</target> for sharing his notes and helping his classmates study for the final exam.","translation":"老師稱讚該名學生慷慨地分享他的筆記並幫助同學複習期末考。","explanation":"名詞「慷慨」。指樂於幫助他人。"}],"related_forms":["generous"]}

{"headword":"genius","explanation":"名詞「天才」。指具有卓越才華或極高智力的人。常用於描述在藝術、科學或音樂方面有天賦的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young pianist was hailed as a musical <target>genius</target> after performing a complex concerto with perfect precision and emotion.","translation":"這名年輕的鋼琴家在完美且富有情感地演奏了一首複雜的協奏曲後，被譽為音樂天才。","explanation":"名詞「天才」。指在特定領域擁有極高天賦的人。"},{"sentence":"Many people believe that Albert Einstein was a <target>genius</target> whose theories fundamentally changed our understanding of the universe.","translation":"許多人認為艾爾伯特·愛因斯坦是一位天才，他的理論從根本上改變了我們對宇宙的理解。","explanation":"名詞「天才」。描述極高的智力水平。"}],"related_forms":["geniuses"]}

{"headword":"genuine","explanation":"形容詞「真實的；真誠的」。指事物非偽造且為真品，或人的情感與態度誠實且不造作。注意與 fake, artificial 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The art collector hired an expert to verify if the painting was a <target>genuine</target> masterpiece or a clever imitation.","translation":"藝術收藏家聘請了一位專家來驗證這幅畫是真正的傑作還是巧妙的模仿品。","explanation":"形容詞「真實的」。指非偽造的真品。"},{"sentence":"She showed <target>genuine</target> <pattern>concern</pattern> for her classmates' wellbeing by offering help during the final exam period.","translation":"她在期末考期間提供幫助，對同學的福祉表現出真誠的關心。","explanation":"形容詞「真誠的」。常用搭配：genuine concern (真誠的關心), genuine interest (真誠的興趣)。"}],"related_forms":["genuinely"]}

{"headword":"germ","explanation":"名詞「細菌；病菌」。指引起疾病的微小生物。常用於健康、衛生與醫療主題。","entries":[{"sentence":"Teachers always remind students to wash their hands with soap before meals to prevent the spread of <target>germs</target> in the school.","translation":"老師總是提醒學生在餐前用肥皂洗手，以防止學校內病菌的傳播。","explanation":"名詞「細菌」。常用複數形式 germs。"},{"sentence":"Using a hand sanitizer can help kill <target>germs</target> on your skin, especially when you cannot find a sink nearby.","translation":"使用酒精洗手液可以幫助殺死皮膚上的病菌，尤其是在附近找不到洗手台時。","explanation":"名詞「細菌」。"}],"related_forms":["germs"]}

{"headword":"gifted","explanation":"形容詞「有天賦的」。指在某些方面具有天然能力的人，尤其是兒童或學生。常用搭配 gifted child, gifted student。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school provides special advanced classes for <target>gifted</target> <pattern>students</pattern> who can master difficult concepts much faster than their peers.","translation":"學校為那些能比同儕快得多地掌握困難概念的天賦學生提供特殊的進階課程。","explanation":"形容詞「有天賦的」。常用搭配：gifted students (天賦學生)。"},{"sentence":"Although she was <target>gifted</target> in mathematics, she realized that hard work and discipline were still necessary to achieve success.","translation":"儘管她在數學方面很有天賦，但她意識到努力工作和紀律對於取得成功仍然是必要的。","explanation":"形容詞「有天賦的」。常用於描述特定技能的天賦。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"gigantic","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的」。指尺寸或規模極大。同義詞包括 huge, enormous, massive。常用於描述建築物、自然景觀或問題。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tourists were amazed by the <target>gigantic</target> <pattern>statue</pattern> located in the center of the city, which towered over the surrounding buildings.","translation":"遊客們對位於市中心的巨大雕像感到驚訝，它高聳在周圍的建築物之上。","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的」。常用於描述體積巨大的實體。"},{"sentence":"Building the new bridge required a <target>gigantic</target> <pattern>effort</pattern> from the government and thousands of skilled workers over several years.","translation":"建造這座新橋需要政府和數千名熟練工人花費數年時間付出巨大的努力。","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的」。可用於描述抽象的程度，如巨大努力。"}],"related_forms":["giganticly"]}

{"headword":"giggle","explanation":"名詞「咯咯笑」；動詞「咯咯笑」。指因為緊張、尷尬或覺得好笑而發出的短促、高頻率的笑聲。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students could not stop <target>giggling</target> when they saw their teacher accidentally wear two different colored socks to class.","translation":"當學生們看到老師不小心穿著兩隻不同顏色的襪子來上課時，他們忍不住咯咯笑。","explanation":"動詞「咯咯笑」。描述一種不耐煩或輕率的笑法。"},{"sentence":"A soft <target>giggle</target> <pattern>escaped</pattern> from the back of the classroom, making the teacher stop and look around for the cause.","translation":"教室後方傳來一聲輕微的咯咯笑聲，使老師停下來環顧四周尋找原因。","explanation":"名詞「咯咯笑聲」。常用搭配：a giggle escaped (咯咯笑聲逸出)。"}],"related_forms":["giggles","giggling"]}

{"headword":"ginger","explanation":"名詞「生薑」。一種常用於烹飪和藥用（如緩解噁心）的植物根莖。","entries":[{"sentence":"My grandmother often adds a small piece of <target>ginger</target> to the tea to help soothe her stomach and reduce nausea.","translation":"我奶奶經常在茶中加入一小塊生薑，以幫助舒緩她的胃部並減輕噁心感。","explanation":"名詞「生薑」。常用於飲食與健康語境。"},{"sentence":"Fresh <target>ginger</target> is a key ingredient in many Asian dishes, providing a sharp and warm flavor that complements the meat.","translation":"新鮮生薑是許多亞洲菜餚中的關鍵成分，提供了一種辛辣且溫暖的味道，能與肉類相輔相成。","explanation":"名詞「生薑」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"glimpse","explanation":"名詞「一瞥」；動詞「瞥見」。指短暫地看到某物或某人。常用片語 catch a glimpse of (瞥見)。","entries":[{"sentence":"As the train departed, I managed to <target>catch</target> a <target>glimpse</target> <pattern>of</pattern> my friend waving goodbye from the platform.","translation":"當火車開走時，我設法瞥見了我的朋友在月台上揮手告別。","explanation":"名詞「一瞥」。常用片語 catch a glimpse of (瞥見)。"},{"sentence":"The documentary provides a fascinating <target>glimpse</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the daily lives of people living in remote mountain villages.","translation":"這部紀錄片提供了一個迷人的機會，讓人得以一窺偏遠山村居民的日常生活。","explanation":"名詞「一瞥」。常用搭配 glimpse into (一窺...的內部情況)。"},{"sentence":"He <target>glimpsed</target> the missing keys on the table as he hurried out of the house, but he did not notice them until later.","translation":"他匆忙走出家門時瞥見了桌上的失蹤鑰匙，但他直到後來才注意到。","explanation":"動詞「瞥見」。指短暫地看到。"}],"related_forms":["glimpsed","glimpsing"]}

{"headword":"globe","explanation":"名詞「地球；球體」。常用於指代全球範圍，如 the entire globe (整個地球) 或 across the globe (在全球範圍內)。注意與 world 的區別：globe 強調地球的球形或地理上的全球性。","entries":[{"sentence":"With the help of the internet, students can now communicate with peers <target>across</target> the <target>globe</target> in real time.","translation":"在網路的幫助下，學生現在可以即時地與全球各地的同儕交流。","explanation":"名詞「地球」。常用搭配 across the globe (在全球)。"},{"sentence":"The geography teacher used a large <target>globe</target> in the classroom to show the students the exact locations of different continents.","translation":"地理老師在教室中使用一個大型地球儀，向學生展示不同大洲的準確位置。","explanation":"名詞「地球儀」。"}],"related_forms":["global","globalization"]}

{"headword":"glorious","explanation":"形容詞「光榮的；燦爛的」。可用於描述成就、歷史或天氣（如 a glorious day）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The athlete felt a <target>glorious</target> <pattern>sense</pattern> of achievement after winning the gold medal in the international competition.","translation":"這名運動員在國際比賽中贏得金牌後，感受到一種光榮的成就感。","explanation":"形容詞「光榮的」。常用搭配：glorious sense of achievement (光榮的成就感)。"},{"sentence":"We spent a <target>glorious</target> <pattern>day</pattern> at the beach, enjoying the bright sunshine and the clear blue sky.","translation":"我們在海邊度過了一個燦爛的一天，享受著明亮的陽光和晴朗的藍天。","explanation":"形容詞「燦爛的」。常用於描述極佳的天氣。"}],"related_forms":["glory","gloriously"]}

{"headword":"goods","explanation":"名詞「商品、貨物」。注意 goods 恆為複數形式，且不可數（不可加 s 變單數）。常考片語：consumer goods (消費品), luxury goods (奢侈品), goods and services (商品與服務)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The shipping company specializes in transporting luxury <target>goods</target>, such as high-end watches and designer handbags, across the globe.","translation":"這家運輸公司專門在全球運輸奢侈品，例如高階手錶和設計師手提包。","explanation":"名詞「商品」。常用搭配：luxury goods (奢侈品)。"},{"sentence":"Many local farmers sell their fresh <target>goods</target> <pattern>at</pattern> the weekly street market to earn a living for their families.","translation":"許多當地農民在每週一次的街道市場販售他們的新鮮產品，以維持家庭生計。","explanation":"名詞「貨物」。常用於描述販售的商品。"},{"sentence":"The government introduced new taxes on imported <target>goods</target> to protect local businesses from unfair foreign competition.","translation":"政府對進口商品徵收新稅，以保護當地企業免於不公平的外國競爭。","explanation":"名詞「商品」。常用於貿易或經濟語境。"},{"sentence":"The economic report highlights the growing demand for consumer <target>goods</target> in developing countries over the past decade.","translation":"經濟報告強調了過去十年來開發中國家對消費品的日益增長的需求。","explanation":"名詞「商品」。常用搭配：consumer goods (消費品)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"gown","explanation":"名詞「長袍、禮服」。常用於正式場合，如 graduation gown (畢業袍) 或 wedding gown (婚紗)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students felt a sense of pride as they put on their <target>gowns</target> and caps for the graduation ceremony.","translation":"學生們穿上畢業袍和方帽參加畢業典禮時，感到一種自豪感。","explanation":"名詞「長袍/禮服」。常用搭配：graduation gown (畢業袍)。"},{"sentence":"She spent months choosing the perfect wedding <target>gown</target> to ensure she looked elegant on her special day.","translation":"她花了數月時間選擇最完美的婚紗，以確保她在特別的那一天看起來優雅。","explanation":"名詞「禮服」。常用搭配：wedding gown (婚紗)。"},{"sentence":"The doctors at the hospital must wear sterile surgical <target>gowns</target> during operations to maintain a clean and safe environment.","translation":"醫院的醫生在手術期間必須穿著無菌手術袍，以維持清潔且安全的環境。","explanation":"名詞「長袍」。常用於醫療場景。"}],"related_forms":["gowns"]}

{"headword":"grace","explanation":"名詞「優雅；恩寵；祈禱」。動詞「使優雅；使增光」。注意名詞用法中，grace can be used to describe a person's movement or quality. 動詞用法中常見搭配 grace sth with one's presence (蒞臨)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The ballet dancer moved across the stage with such <target>grace</target> that the audience was completely captivated by her performance.","translation":"芭蕾舞者在舞台上舞姿如此優雅，以至於觀眾完全被她的表演所吸引。","explanation":"名詞「優雅」。描述人的動作或風範。"},{"sentence":"Despite the harsh criticism from the media, the politician handled the situation with <target>grace</target> and dignity.","translation":"儘管媒體的嚴厲批評，這位政治家仍以優雅且有尊嚴的方式處理此事。","explanation":"名詞「優雅/風範」。指在壓力下保持得體的舉止。"},{"sentence":"We were honored when the famous professor decided to <target>grace</target> our small seminar <pattern>with</pattern> his presence.","translation":"當那位著名的教授決定蒞臨我們的小型研討會時，我們感到非常榮幸。","explanation":"動詞「使增光/蒞臨」。常用片語 grace sth with one's presence。"},{"sentence":"The family said a short <target>grace</target> before starting their holiday dinner to show gratitude for the food they had.","translation":"這家人在開始節日晚餐前進行了短暫的祈禱，以表達對食物的感激之情。","explanation":"名詞「祈禱」。指餐前或餐後的感恩祈禱。"}],"related_forms":["gracious","graceful"]}

{"headword":"graceful","explanation":"形容詞「優雅的、輕盈的」。常用於描述動作、外形或風格。與 gracious (親切的) 不同，graceful 強調的是視覺上的美感與流暢度。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>graceful</target> movements of the swan on the lake made the scene look like a painting from a dream.","translation":"天鵝在湖上的優雅動作使這個場景看起來像夢中的一幅畫。","explanation":"形容詞「優雅的」。描述動物或人的肢體動作。"},{"sentence":"She wrote a <target>graceful</target> letter of resignation, thanking her boss for the opportunities and avoiding any negative comments.","translation":"她寫了一封優雅的辭職信，感謝老闆提供的機會，並避免任何負面評論。","explanation":"形容詞「優雅的/得體的」。描述處理事情的方式。"},{"sentence":"The architect designed a <target>graceful</target> bridge that blended perfectly with the surrounding natural landscape of the valley.","translation":"建築師設計了一座優雅的橋樑，使其與山谷周圍的自然景觀完美融合。","explanation":"形容詞「優雅的」。描述物體的外形或線條。"}],"related_forms":["grace","gracefully"]}

{"headword":"gracious","explanation":"形容詞「親切的、寬厚的、優雅的」。與 graceful 不同，gracious 側重於對他人表現出的禮貌、慷慨或友善的態度，而非視覺上的優雅。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>gracious</target> host made everyone feel welcome and comfortable by introducing the guests to each other with a smile.","translation":"這位親切的主人讓每個人都感到受歡迎且舒適，他微笑著將客人們互相介紹。","explanation":"形容詞「親切的」。描述對人的態度。"},{"sentence":"Even after winning the championship, the athlete remained <target>gracious</target> <pattern>in</pattern> victory and praised his opponent's hard work.","translation":"即便在贏得冠軍後，這名運動員在勝利中依然保持謙卑親切，並讚揚對手的努力。","explanation":"形容詞「親切的/寬厚的」。常用搭配：gracious in victory/defeat。"},{"sentence":"The queen was known for her <target>gracious</target> manner, always treating her servants with kindness and respect regardless of their status.","translation":"女王以其親切的舉止著稱，無論地位高低，總是以親切和尊重對待她的僕人。","explanation":"形容詞「親切的」。描述人的性格或風範。"}],"related_forms":["grace","graciously"]}

{"headword":"graduation","explanation":"名詞「畢業」。常用於指畢業典禮 (graduation ceremony) 或畢業後的狀態。注意搭配介系詞 from (畢業於...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After four years of hard work, the students finally reached their <target>graduation</target> day, marking the end of their college life.","translation":"經過四年的努力，學生們終於迎來了畢業日，標誌著他們大學生活的結束。","explanation":"名詞「畢業」。"},{"sentence":"The university held a grand <target>graduation</target> <pattern>ceremony</pattern> in the main stadium, where thousands of graduates received their diplomas.","translation":"大學在主體育場舉行了一場盛大的畢業典禮，數千名畢業生在那裡領取了他們的畢業證書。","explanation":"名詞「畢業」。常用搭配：graduation ceremony (畢業典禮)。"},{"sentence":"Her <target>graduation</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the medical school was a moment of great joy for her parents, who had supported her throughout.","translation":"她從醫學院畢業是一個讓她父母非常高興的時刻，因為他們一直支持著她。","explanation":"名詞「畢業」。常用搭配：graduation from (畢業於...)。"}],"related_forms":["graduate"]}

{"headword":"grammar","explanation":"名詞「文法、語法」。指語言的結構規則。常考搭配：basic grammar (基礎文法), correct grammar (正確的文法)。","entries":[{"sentence":"To improve your writing skills, it is essential to study the basic <target>grammar</target> of the language and practice regularly.","translation":"為了提高你的寫作技能，學習該語言的基礎文法並練習是至關重要的。","explanation":"名詞「文法」。"},{"sentence":"The teacher pointed out several <target>grammar</target> <pattern>mistakes</pattern> in the student's essay, explaining how to fix them for better clarity.","translation":"老師在學生的文章中指出了幾個文法錯誤，並解釋如何修改以使其更加清晰。","explanation":"名詞「文法」。常用搭配：grammar mistakes (文法錯誤)。"},{"sentence":"Although he spoke the language fluently, he still struggled with some of the complex <target>grammar</target> rules in formal writing.","translation":"雖然他能流利地說這門語言，但在正式寫作中，他仍然對一些複雜的文法規則感到吃力。","explanation":"名詞「文法」。"}],"related_forms":["grammatical"]}

{"headword":"grammatical","explanation":"形容詞「文法的、符合文法的」。常用於描述規則或錯誤。注意區分 grammatical (符合文法的) 與 ungrammatical (不符合文法的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student's sentence was <target>grammatical</target>, but the choice of words was slightly unnatural for a native speaker.","translation":"學生的句子符合文法，但用詞對於母語人士來說稍微有些不自然。","explanation":"形容詞「符合文法的」。"},{"sentence":"Learning <target>grammatical</target> <pattern>structures</pattern> helps students understand how to organize their thoughts logically in a foreign language.","translation":"學習文法結構有助於學生理解如何在外語中邏輯地組織他們的思想。","explanation":"形容詞「文法的」。常用搭配：grammatical structures (文法結構)。"},{"sentence":"The editor made several <target>grammatical</target> <pattern>corrections</pattern> to the manuscript to ensure it met the professional standards of the journal.","translation":"編輯對原稿進行了幾次文法修正，以確保它符合期刊的專業標準。","explanation":"形容詞「文法的」。常用搭配：grammatical corrections (文法修正)。"}],"related_forms":["grammar"]}

{"headword":"graph","explanation":"名詞「圖表、圖形」。動詞「用圖表表示」。在 GSAT 閱讀中，常用於描述數據趨勢 (trend) 或分析分析圖表 (analyze a graph)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The science student created a <target>graph</target> to show the relationship between temperature and the growth rate of the plants.","translation":"這名科學學生創建了一個圖表來顯示溫度與植物生長率之間的關係。","explanation":"名詞「圖表」。"},{"sentence":"By analyzing the <target>graph</target>, we can see a clear <pattern>upward trend</pattern> in the number of tourists visiting the city each year.","translation":"透過分析圖表，我們可以看到每年造訪這座城市的遊客數量有明顯的上升趨勢。","explanation":"名詞「圖表」。常用搭配：upward trend (上升趨勢)。"},{"sentence":"The researcher <target>graphed</target> the data collected from the survey to make the results easier for the audience to understand.","translation":"研究人員將調查收集到的數據用圖表表示，使結果更容易讓觀眾理解。","explanation":"動詞「用圖表表示」。此處為過去式 graphed。"}],"related_forms":["graphical"]}

{"headword":"grateful","explanation":"形容詞「感激的」。常用搭配：be grateful to someone for something (對某人某事感到感激)。注意與 gratitude (名詞) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"I am extremely <target>grateful</target> <pattern>to</pattern> my teacher <pattern>for</pattern> all the guidance and support she provided during my final year.","translation":"對於老師在我最後一年提供的所有指導和支持，我深感感激。","explanation":"形容詞「感激的」。常用搭配：be grateful to sb for sth。"},{"sentence":"The community was <target>grateful</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the quick response of the firefighters, who saved the historic library from burning down.","translation":"社區對消防員的迅速反應感到感激，他們將這座歷史悠久的圖書館從火災中救了出來。","explanation":"形容詞「感激的」。常用搭配：be grateful for sth。"},{"sentence":"He felt <target>grateful</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the second chance the company gave him to prove his abilities and improve his performance.","translation":"他對公司給他第二次機會來證明自己的能力並提高表現感到感激。","explanation":"形容詞「感激的」。"}],"related_forms":["gratitude","gratefully"]}

{"headword":"gratitude","explanation":"名詞「感激、感恩」。常用於表達對他人幫助的感謝之情。注意搭配介系詞 for 或 to。常考片語：express gratitude to sb for sth (向某人表達對某事的感激)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After the surgery, the patient <pattern>expressed</pattern> her deep <target>gratitude</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the doctors <pattern>for</pattern> their professional care and kindness.","translation":"手術後，病人向醫生表達了她對其專業照顧和親切的深深感激。","explanation":"名詞「感激」。常用片語 express gratitude to sb for sth。"},{"sentence":"The students wrote thank-you notes to their teacher to show their <target>gratitude</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the guidance and support they received throughout the year.","translation":"學生們寫了感謝卡給老師，以表達他們一年來所收到的指導與支持的感激之情。","explanation":"名詞「感激」。常用搭配 gratitude for sth。"}],"related_forms":["grateful"]}

{"headword":"grave","explanation":"名詞「墳墓」；形容詞「嚴重的、莊重的」。作為形容詞時，常用於描述情況危險或表情肅穆。注意與 general (一般的) 或 greedy (貪婪的) 拼寫區分。","entries":[{"sentence":"The family gathered at the <target>grave</target> of their ancestors to pay their respects and remember the lives of those who had passed away.","translation":"家人聚集在祖先的墳墓前，以表達敬意並緬懷逝者的生活。","explanation":"名詞「墳墓」。"},{"sentence":"The doctor informed the family that the patient's condition was <target>grave</target>, meaning there was a very small chance of recovery.","translation":"醫生告知家屬病人的情況非常嚴重，意味著康復的機會非常渺茫。","explanation":"形容詞「嚴重的」。常用於描述疾病或危機狀態。"},{"sentence":"The president spoke with a <target>grave</target> <pattern>expression</pattern> as he announced the news of the natural disaster to the nation.","translation":"總統在向全國宣布自然災害的消息時，表情莊重且肅穆。","explanation":"形容詞「莊重的、肅穆的」。常用搭配 grave expression (莊重的表情)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"greasy","explanation":"形容詞「油膩的」。可用於描述食物、皮膚或表面。常考搭配：greasy food (油膩食物), greasy hair (油膩的頭髮)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many students avoid eating <target>greasy</target> <pattern>food</pattern> like fried chicken and french fries before a big exam to keep their minds clear.","translation":"許多學生在重大考試前避免食用像炸雞和薯條這樣的油膩食物，以保持頭腦清醒。","explanation":"形容詞「油膩的」。常用搭配 greasy food。"},{"sentence":"After working in the car repair shop all afternoon, his hands were <target>greasy</target> and covered in black engine oil.","translation":"在汽車維修店工作整個下午後，他的手變得油膩且佈滿了黑色的引擎油。","explanation":"形容詞「油膩的」。描述表面被油脂覆蓋的狀態。"}],"related_forms":["grease"]}

{"headword":"greeting","explanation":"名詞「問候、招呼」。常用複數形式 greetings。常考片語：warm greetings (熱情的問候), send greetings (傳達問候)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hotel manager welcomed the guests with a warm <target>greeting</target>, making them feel comfortable and welcome from the moment they arrived.","translation":"酒店經理用熱情的問候迎接賓客，讓他們從抵達那一刻起就感到舒適和受歡迎。","explanation":"名詞「問候」。"},{"sentence":"She sent her warmest <target>greetings</target> <pattern>to</pattern> her old classmates in Taiwan while she was studying for her degree in London.","translation":"她在倫敦攻讀學位期間，向她在台灣的老同學傳達了最溫暖的問候。","explanation":"名詞「問候」。常用複數形式 greetings，搭配介系詞 to。"}],"related_forms":["greet"]}

{"headword":"grief","explanation":"名詞「極大的悲痛」。通常指因喪親而產生的深沉悲傷。注意與 sadness (一般的悲傷) 區別：grief 程度更深且更正式。","entries":[{"sentence":"The entire community shared in the <target>grief</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the family after the sudden passing of the beloved local leader.","translation":"在深受愛戴的當地領袖突然去世後，整個社區與該家庭共同分擔悲痛。","explanation":"名詞「悲痛」。常用搭配 grief of sb。"},{"sentence":"It took several months for the young woman to overcome her <target>grief</target> after losing her pet dog, which had been her only companion.","translation":"這名年輕女子在失去她的寵物狗（她唯一的陪伴）後，花了幾個月的時間才走出悲痛。","explanation":"名詞「悲痛」。常用搭配 overcome one's grief (走出悲痛)。"}],"related_forms":["grieve"]}

{"headword":"grind","explanation":"動詞「磨碎、碾壓」；名詞「枯燥乏味的工作」。動詞常用於描述將固體轉變為粉末。名詞用法常出現在口語或非正式語境中。","entries":[{"sentence":"The chef uses a special machine to <target>grind</target> the coffee beans <pattern>into</pattern> a fine powder before brewing the fresh espresso.","translation":"主廚使用一台特殊的機器將咖啡豆磨成細粉，然後才沖泡新鮮的濃縮咖啡。","explanation":"動詞「磨碎」。常用搭配 grind sth into powder。"},{"sentence":"After years of the same <target>grind</target> <pattern>of</pattern> commuting to the city every day, he decided to quit his job and travel the world.","translation":"在經歷了多年每天通勤到城市的枯燥工作中，他決定辭職去環遊世界。","explanation":"名詞「枯燥乏味的工作」。指重複性高且令人疲憊的日常工作。"},{"sentence":"The heavy stones were <target>ground</target> <pattern>down</pattern> by the constant flow of the river over thousands of years, becoming smooth pebbles.","translation":"沉重的石頭在數千年的河水不斷沖刷下被磨平，變成了光滑的卵石。","explanation":"動詞「磨碎、磨損」。此處為過去分詞 ground (grind-ground-ground)。"}],"related_forms":["grinder"]}

{"headword":"guarantee","explanation":"動詞「保證、擔保」；名詞「保證書、保固」。常考片語：guarantee that... (保證...), under guarantee (在保固期內)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company <target>guarantees</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the new smartphone will be delivered to your home within three business days of ordering.","translation":"公司保證新手機在訂購後三個工作日內會送到您的家中。","explanation":"動詞「保證」。常用結構 guarantee that + 子句。"},{"sentence":"You should keep the receipt because the laptop comes with a one-year <target>guarantee</target> <pattern>against</pattern> manufacturing defects.","translation":"你應該保留收據，因為這台筆記型電腦提供一年的製造缺陷保固。","explanation":"名詞「保固」。常用搭配 guarantee against sth。"},{"sentence":"The government cannot <target>guarantee</target> <pattern>absolute</pattern> safety for every citizen, but they can implement measures to reduce the risks.","translation":"政府無法保證每個公民的絕對安全，但他們可以實施措施來降低風險。","explanation":"動詞「保證」。常用形容詞搭配：absolute guarantee。"}],"related_forms":["guaranteed"]}

{"headword":"guardian","explanation":"名詞「監護人、保護者」。指法律上負責照顧未成年人或無行為能力之人的成年人。常用搭配：legal guardian (法定監護人)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Since both of his parents were working abroad, his grandmother was appointed as his <target>guardian</target> to take care of his daily needs.","translation":"由於父母都在國外工作，他的祖母被任命為他的監護人，負責照顧他的日常生活需求。","explanation":"名詞「監護人」。"},{"sentence":"The school requires a signature from a <pattern>legal</pattern> <target>guardian</target> before students can participate in the overnight camping trip.","translation":"學生在參加過夜露營旅行前，學校要求必須有法定監護人的簽名。","explanation":"名詞「監護人」。常用搭配 legal guardian (法定監護人)。"}],"related_forms":["guard"]}

{"headword":"guilt","explanation":"名詞「內疚感、罪責」。指意識到自己做了錯事而產生的心理壓力。注意與 guilty (形容詞) 區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"He was overcome with <target>guilt</target> <pattern>after</pattern> lying to his parents about his poor grades on the final mathematics exam.","translation":"在對父母隱瞞期末數學考試成績不佳後，他被內疚感所淹沒。","explanation":"名詞「內疚感」。常用搭配 be overcome with guilt。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer tried to prove that his client felt deep <target>guilt</target> <pattern>for</pattern> his past mistakes and was sincerely trying to make amends.","translation":"律師試圖證明他的當事人對過去的錯誤感到深切的內疚，並在誠心地嘗試彌補。","explanation":"名詞「內疚感」。常用搭配 guilt for sth。"}],"related_forms":["guilty"]}

{"headword":"guilty","explanation":"形容詞「有罪的、內疚的」。常用片語：feel guilty about... (對...感到內疚), be found guilty of... (被判定有罪)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The jury <pattern>found</pattern> the defendant <target>guilty</target> <pattern>of</pattern> theft after reviewing all the evidence presented during the trial.","translation":"在審查了審判期間提交的所有證據後，陪審團判定被告盜竊罪名成立。","explanation":"形容詞「有罪的」。常用片語 be found guilty of sth。"},{"sentence":"I <pattern>feel</pattern> <target>guilty</target> <pattern>about</pattern> spending so much money on video games instead of saving for my future college tuition.","translation":"對於花這麼多錢買電子遊戲而不是為未來的大學學費儲蓄，我感到很內疚。","explanation":"形容詞「內疚的」。常用片語 feel guilty about sth。"},{"sentence":"The student looked <target>guilty</target> when the teacher asked who had accidentally broken the window in the classroom.","translation":"當老師詢問是誰不小心打破教室窗戶時，那名學生看起來心虛（內疚）。","explanation":"形容詞「內疚的」。描述外在表現出的心虛狀態。"}],"related_forms":["guilt"]}

{"headword":"gulf","explanation":"名詞「海灣」或「巨大的分歧/鴻溝」。前者指地理上的海灣，後者常用于比喻兩者之間在觀念、地位或文化上的巨大差異。","entries":[{"sentence":"The cruise ship sailed through the <target>gulf</target>, offering passengers breathtaking views of the crystal-clear water and sandy beaches.","translation":"郵輪在海灣中航行，為乘客提供晶瑩剔透的水域和沙灘的壯麗景色。","explanation":"名詞「海灣」。指地理上的水域。"},{"sentence":"Over the years, a wide <target>gulf</target> <pattern>has grown between</pattern> the two old friends due to their completely different political beliefs.","translation":"多年來，由於政治信仰完全不同，這兩位老朋友之間產生了巨大的分歧。","explanation":"名詞「鴻溝/分歧」。比喻兩人或兩群體之間無法逾越的差異。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"habitual","explanation":"形容詞「習慣性的」。常用於描述長期養成且難以改變的行為，例如 habitual liar (慣犯/慣常說謊的人)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite the doctor's warning, his <target>habitual</target> <pattern>smoking</pattern> made it difficult for him to recover fully from the respiratory illness.","translation":"儘管醫生警告，他習慣性的抽菸讓他很難從呼吸道疾病中完全恢復。","explanation":"形容詞「習慣性的」。描述長期且重複的行為。"},{"sentence":"She began her morning with her <target>habitual</target> <pattern>routine</pattern> of drinking a glass of warm water and stretching for ten minutes.","translation":"她以每天早晨喝一杯溫水並伸展十分鐘的習慣流程開始她的一天。","explanation":"形容詞「習慣性的」。描述日常規律。"}],"related_forms":["habitually"]}

{"headword":"halt","explanation":"動詞「停止、使停止」；名詞「停止」。常用片語 bring to a halt (使停止) 或 come to a halt (停止)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The sudden appearance of a deer on the highway forced the driver to <target>halt</target> the car immediately to avoid an accident.","translation":"高速公路上突然出現的一隻鹿，迫使駕駛立即停止車輛以避免事故。","explanation":"動詞「停止」。指突然地或強制地停止動作。"},{"sentence":"Production at the factory <target>came</target> <pattern>to a halt</pattern> when the power outage affected all the machinery, causing a significant delay.","translation":"當停電影響所有機器時，工廠的生產停止了，導致了嚴重的延遲。","explanation":"名詞「停止」。片語 come to a halt 表示動作或進程的停止。"},{"sentence":"The government decided to <target>halt</target> the construction of the new bridge until a full environmental impact study was completed.","translation":"政府決定暫停新橋的建設，直到完整的環境影響研究完成為止。","explanation":"動詞「使停止」。指官方或權威地停止某項計劃或工程。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"handwriting","explanation":"名詞「筆跡、手寫」。常用於描述筆跡的清晰度，如 clear handwriting (清晰的筆跡) 或 illegible handwriting (難以辨認的筆跡)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher struggled to grade the essays because the student's <target>handwriting</target> was so messy that it was almost impossible to read.","translation":"老師在評分作文時感到很吃力，因為學生的筆跡太亂，幾乎不可能讀懂。","explanation":"名詞「筆跡」。指寫字的方式。"},{"sentence":"In the digital age, fewer students practice their <target>handwriting</target>, leading to a decline in the art of calligraphy in many schools.","translation":"在數位時代，越來越少的學生練習手寫，導致許多學校的書法藝術有所衰退。","explanation":"名詞「手寫」。指書寫的行為或結果。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"hardship","explanation":"名詞「艱難、困苦」。通常指生活條件惡劣或缺乏基本需求而導致的痛苦狀態，常用於複數 hardships (各種艱辛)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many refugees faced extreme <target>hardships</target> during their long journey, including a lack of food, clean water, and safe shelter.","translation":"許多難民在漫長的旅程中面臨著極端的艱辛，包括缺乏食物、乾淨的水和安全的避難所。","explanation":"名詞「艱難」。常用於複數，指多種困難的情況。"},{"sentence":"The scholarship was designed to help students who have experienced financial <target>hardship</target> pursue their higher education goals without worry.","translation":"這項獎學金旨在幫助經歷過經濟困難的學生在無需擔心的情況下追求他們的高等教育目標。","explanation":"名詞「困苦」。指經濟上的缺乏。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"hardware","explanation":"名詞「硬體」。在電腦科學中指實體元件；在日常生活中則指金屬工具或五金配件。","entries":[{"sentence":"When upgrading your computer, you need to consider both the <target>hardware</target>, such as the CPU and RAM, and the software programs.","translation":"升級電腦時，你需要同時考慮硬體（如 CPU 和記憶體）以及軟體程式。","explanation":"名詞「硬體」。指電腦的實體元件。"},{"sentence":"My father went to the local <target>hardware</target> store to buy some nails and a new hammer to fix the broken fence in our backyard.","translation":"我的父親去當地的五金店買了一些釘子和一把新錘子，用來修理後院破損的籬笆。","explanation":"名詞「硬體/五金」。指金屬工具和配件。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"harmony","explanation":"名詞「和諧、協調」。可指人際關係的和諧，也可指音樂上的和聲。常用片語 in harmony with (與...和諧/一致)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The community worked together in perfect <target>harmony</target>, ensuring that the neighborhood remained clean, safe, and welcoming for everyone.","translation":"社區共同努力，處於完美的和諧狀態，確保鄰里環境保持乾淨、安全且對每個人都友好。","explanation":"名詞「和諧」。指人際關係的融洽。"},{"sentence":"Architects often strive to design buildings that exist <pattern>in</pattern> <target>harmony</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the surrounding natural environment to reduce urban stress.","translation":"建築師通常努力設計與周圍自然環境和諧共存的建築，以減少都市壓力。","explanation":"名詞「和諧」。片語 in harmony with 表示與...一致或協調。"},{"sentence":"The choir's beautiful <target>harmony</target> filled the room, as the singers combined their voices in a way that sounded pleasing to the ear.","translation":"合唱團美麗的和聲填滿了房間，因為歌手們將他們的聲音以一種悅耳的方式結合在一起。","explanation":"名詞「和聲」。指音樂上的協調。"}],"related_forms":["harmonious","harmonize"]}

{"headword":"harsh","explanation":"形容詞「嚴厲的、殘酷的、惡劣的」。可用於描述法律、批評、環境或聲音。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher gave the student some <target>harsh</target> criticism regarding his lack of effort, but the goal was to motivate him to study harder.","translation":"老師對該學生缺乏努力地給予了一些嚴厲的批評，但目的是為了激勵他更努力學習。","explanation":"形容詞「嚴厲的」。用於描述批評或言語。"},{"sentence":"Many animals have developed unique adaptations to survive in the <target>harsh</target> conditions of the Arctic, where temperatures often drop below zero.","translation":"許多動物為了在北極惡劣的條件下生存，演化出了獨特的適應方式，而那裡的溫度經常跌至零度以下。","explanation":"形容詞「惡劣的」。用於描述自然環境。"},{"sentence":"The government implemented <target>harsh</target> penalties for those who illegally dump waste in the nature reserve to protect the local wildlife.","translation":"政府對那些非法地在自然保護區傾倒廢棄物的人實施了嚴厲的處罰，以保護當地野生動物。","explanation":"形容詞「殘酷的/嚴厲的」。用於描述法律或處罰。"}],"related_forms":["harshly","harshness"]}

{"headword":"haste","explanation":"名詞「匆促、急忙」。常用片語 in haste (匆忙地) 或 make haste (趕快)。注意：More haste, less speed (欲速則不達)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Because she wrote the letter <pattern>in</pattern> <target>haste</target>, she made several spelling mistakes that made the message difficult for the reader to understand.","translation":"因為她匆忙地寫這封信，所以犯了幾個拼寫錯誤，使得讀者很難理解信中的訊息。","explanation":"名詞「匆促」。片語 in haste 表示匆忙地。"},{"sentence":"The traveler decided to <target>make</target> <target>haste</target> to reach the airport before the check-in counter closed for the final time.","translation":"旅行者決定趕快到達機場，以免在登機櫃檯最後一次關閉前錯過航班。","explanation":"名詞「匆促」。片語 make haste 表示趕快。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"hasten","explanation":"動詞「加速、催促」。常用於描述加速某個過程或趕快行動。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new medicine was designed to <target>hasten</target> the healing process of the wound, allowing the patient to recover and return to school faster.","translation":"這種新藥旨在加速傷口的癒合過程，讓患者能更快康復並回到學校。","explanation":"動詞「加速」。指使某件事更快發生。"},{"sentence":"As the storm approached, the hikers <target>hastened</target> <pattern>back</pattern> to their camp to find shelter before the heavy rain started.","translation":"隨著風暴接近，登山客們趕快回到營地，在暴雨開始前尋找避難所。","explanation":"動詞「趕快」。指加快速度行動。"}],"related_forms":["hastening"]}

{"headword":"hatred","explanation":"名詞「恨，憎恨」。指強烈的厭惡或仇恨之情。注意與 hate (動詞/名詞) 的區別：hate 較常用於一般的不喜歡，而 hatred 則強調一種深刻且持久的負面情感。","entries":[{"sentence":"The long-standing <target>hatred</target> between the two families led to decades of conflict, making it impossible for them to find peace.","translation":"兩家人之間長久以來的憎恨導致了數十年的衝突，使他們不可能找到和平。","explanation":"名詞「憎恨」。描述一種強烈且持久的負面情感。"},{"sentence":"The community worked together to promote tolerance and love, aiming to replace <target>hatred</target> <pattern>with</pattern> understanding and compassion.","translation":"社區共同努力推廣寬容與愛，旨在以理解與同情取代憎恨。","explanation":"名詞「憎恨」。常用片語 replace hatred with sth (用某物取代憎恨)。"}],"related_forms":["hate"]}

{"headword":"hawk","explanation":"名詞「鷹」。指一種猛禽。在政治或外交語境中，hawk (鷹派) 指傾向於採取強硬手段或支持戰爭的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>hawk</target> soared high in the sky, using its keen eyesight to spot small animals in the grassy field below.","translation":"鷹在空中高高飛翔，利用其敏銳的視力發現下方草地上的小動物。","explanation":"名詞「鷹」。指一種猛禽。"},{"sentence":"In the government's debate over the trade dispute, the <target>hawks</target> argued for stricter sanctions to force the other country to comply.","translation":"在政府關於貿易爭端的辯論中，鷹派人士主張採取更嚴格的制裁，以強迫對方國家遵守規定。","explanation":"名詞「鷹派」。指傾向於採取強硬立場的人。"}],"related_forms":["hawks"]}

{"headword":"helicopter","explanation":"名詞「直升機」。指一種利用旋轉翼產生升力的航空器。","entries":[{"sentence":"The rescue team used a <target>helicopter</target> to evacuate the injured hikers from the remote mountain peak after the severe storm.","translation":"救援隊使用直升機將受傷的登山客從遙遠的山頂撤離，就在那場強烈的風暴之後。","explanation":"名詞「直升機」。常用於救援或交通場景。"},{"sentence":"Due to the heavy traffic in the city, the CEO of the large company often travels by <target>helicopter</target> to save time.","translation":"由於城市交通擁堵，這家大公司的執行長經常乘坐直升機以節省時間。","explanation":"名詞「直升機」。描述交通方式。"}],"related_forms":["helicopters"]}

{"headword":"herd","explanation":"名詞「（畜群）群」。動詞「趕（群畜）；使聚集」。常用於描述牛、羊等食草動物的群體。注意 herd mentality (從眾心理) 是 GSAT 常考的心理學術語。","entries":[{"sentence":"The farmer carefully guided the <target>herd</target> <pattern>of</pattern> cows toward the barn as the sun began to set over the hills.","translation":"當太陽開始在山丘上落下時，農夫小心地引導著一群牛走向牛棚。","explanation":"名詞「（畜群）群」。常用搭配 a herd of + 動物 (複數)。"},{"sentence":"Psychologists warn that <target>herd</target> <pattern>mentality</pattern> can lead people to make poor decisions simply because they want to follow the crowd.","translation":"心理學家警告說，從眾心理會導致人們僅僅因為想要隨波逐流而做出錯誤的決定。","explanation":"名詞「群」。herd mentality 指「從眾心理」。"},{"sentence":"The sheepdog worked tirelessly to <target>herd</target> the scattered sheep back into the pen, ensuring none of them were lost.","translation":"牧羊犬不懈地工作，將分散的羊群趕回羊圈，確保沒有一隻走丟。","explanation":"動詞「趕（群畜）」。指將動物聚集在一起並引導方向。"}],"related_forms":["herds"]}

{"headword":"hesitation","explanation":"名詞「猶豫，遲疑」。指在採取行動或做出決定前的不確定感。常用片語 without hesitation (毫不猶豫地)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After thinking for a moment, the student answered the difficult question <pattern>without</pattern> <target>hesitation</target>, impressing the teacher with her confidence.","translation":"思考片刻後，該學生毫不猶豫地回答了那個困難的問題，給老師留下了自信的印象。","explanation":"名詞「猶豫」。片語 without hesitation 表示「毫不猶豫地」。"},{"sentence":"There was a brief <target>hesitation</target> in his voice when he was asked about his childhood memories, suggesting he was feeling emotional.","translation":"當被問到童年記憶時，他的聲音中有一絲猶豫，暗示他當時心情激動。","explanation":"名詞「猶豫」。指在說話或行動時的短暫停頓。"}],"related_forms":["hesitate","hesitating"]}

{"headword":"hive","explanation":"名詞「蜂巢」。指蜜蜂居住和生產蜂蜜的地方。也可比喻為「繁忙的地方」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The beekeeper carefully opened the <target>hive</target> to check the health of the colony and ensure the queen bee was safe.","translation":"養蜂人小心地打開蜂巢以檢查蜂群的健康狀況並確保蜂王安全。","explanation":"名詞「蜂巢」。指蜜蜂的居住地。"},{"sentence":"During the final exam week, the school library becomes a <target>hive</target> <pattern>of</pattern> activity, with students studying intensely for their tests.","translation":"在期末考週，學校圖書館變成了活動繁忙之地，學生們為了考試而刻苦學習。","explanation":"名詞「蜂巢」。在此處為比喻用法，hive of activity 指「繁忙的地方」。"}],"related_forms":["hives"]}

{"headword":"homeland","explanation":"名詞「故鄉，祖國」。指一個人出生或具有強烈情感聯繫的國家或地區。","entries":[{"sentence":"After living in Europe for ten years, the immigrant felt a deep longing to return to his <target>homeland</target> and reunite with family.","translation":"在歐洲生活十年後，這位移民深切地渴望回到他的祖國並與家人團聚。","explanation":"名詞「故鄉」。指一個人出生或成長的國家。"},{"sentence":"The soldiers fought bravely to protect their <target>homeland</target> from foreign invasion, showing great loyalty and courage in battle.","translation":"士兵們勇敢地戰鬥以保護他們的祖國免於外國入侵，表現出戰鬥中極大的忠誠與勇氣。","explanation":"名詞「祖國」。指一個國家的人對其國家的歸屬感。"}],"related_forms":["homelands"]}

{"headword":"honeymoon","explanation":"名詞「蜜月」。指新婚夫婦在婚後立即進行的旅行。動詞「度蜜月」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The newlywed couple decided to spend their <target>honeymoon</target> in the Maldives, enjoying the white sandy beaches and clear blue water.","translation":"這對新婚夫婦決定在馬爾地夫度蜜月，享受白色的沙灘和清澈的藍色海水。","explanation":"名詞「蜜月」。指新婚後的旅行。"},{"sentence":"Many couples <target>honeymoon</target> in exotic locations to create lasting memories and celebrate the start of their new life together.","translation":"許多夫婦在異國情調的地方度蜜月，以創造持久的記憶並慶祝他們共同新生活的開始。","explanation":"動詞「度蜜月」。指新婚後進行的旅行行為。"}],"related_forms":["honeymoons"]}

{"headword":"hook","explanation":"名詞「鉤子」。動詞「用鉤子勾住；吸引」。常用於描述釣魚或掛東西。在寫作中，a hook 指「吸引讀者的開頭」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The fisherman used a sharp <target>hook</target> to catch a large fish, but the fish managed to escape just before it reached the shore.","translation":"漁夫使用一個尖銳的鉤子釣到一條大魚，但那條魚在到達岸邊之前設法逃脫了。","explanation":"名詞「鉤子」。指釣魚用的鉤子。"},{"sentence":"She hung her heavy coat on a metal <target>hook</target> by the door, making it easy to find when she left the house.","translation":"她將沉重的外套掛在門邊的一個金屬鉤子上，使其在離開家時很容易找到。","explanation":"名詞「鉤子」。指掛物用的鉤子。"},{"sentence":"The author began her essay with a surprising fact to <target>hook</target> the readers' attention and encourage them to keep reading.","translation":"作者以一個令人驚訝的事實開始她的文章，以吸引讀者的注意力並鼓勵他們繼續閱讀。","explanation":"動詞「吸引」。比喻用法，指吸引某人的注意或興趣。"},{"sentence":"The singer's new song has a catchy <target>hook</target> that stays in your head long after the music stops playing.","translation":"名詞「記憶點」。在音樂中，hook 指一段容易被記住的旋律或歌詞。 ","explanation":"名詞「記憶點」。指音樂中吸引人的部分。"}],"related_forms":["hooked"]}

{"headword":"horizon","explanation":"名詞「地平線，水平線」。比喻用法指「視野，知識範圍」。常用片語 broaden one's horizon(s) (擴展視野)。","entries":[{"sentence":"As the sun began to set, we could see the orange and red colors reflecting on the <target>horizon</target> over the ocean.","translation":"當太陽開始落下時，我們可以看到橙色和紅色在海洋的地平線上反射。","explanation":"名詞「地平線」。指天空與地面/海面相交的線。"},{"sentence":"Traveling to different countries is a great way for students to <pattern>broaden</pattern> their <target>horizons</target> and learn about diverse cultures.","translation":"前往不同國家旅行是學生擴展視野的絕佳方式，並能學習多元文化。","explanation":"名詞「視野」。比喻用法，常用搭配 broaden one's horizons (擴展視野)。"}],"related_forms":["horizons"]}

{"headword":"horrify","explanation":"動詞「使恐慌、使驚駭」。常用於描述極端恐懼或厭惡的感受。其形容詞形式 horrifying (令人恐慌的) 和 horrified (感到恐慌的) 在 GSAT 中更為常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"The graphic images of the natural disaster <target>horrified</target> the people watching the news, showing the devastating impact on the city.","translation":"自然災害的慘烈影像讓觀看新聞的人們感到驚駭，顯示出對城市的毀滅性影響。","explanation":"動詞「使驚駭」。指讓某人感到極度恐懼或厭惡。"},{"sentence":"It <target>horrifies</target> me to think that some animals are still kept in small cages for entertainment purposes in some parts of the world.","translation":"想到世界上某些地方仍將一些動物關在狹小籠子裡作為娛樂目的，令我感到恐慌。","explanation":"動詞「使驚駭」。此處為單數現在式。"}],"related_forms":["horrified","horrifying","horror"]}

{"headword":"hose","explanation":"名詞「水管、軟管」；動詞「用軟管澆水、沖洗」。常用於園藝或清潔場景。","entries":[{"sentence":"The gardener used a long rubber <target>hose</target> to water the plants in the back garden, making sure every flower got enough water.","translation":"園丁使用一條長橡膠水管為後花園的植物澆水，確保每朵花都得到足夠的水。","explanation":"名詞「水管」。常用搭配：rubber hose, water the plants with a hose。"},{"sentence":"After the muddy hike, the students <target>hosed</target> <pattern>down</pattern> their boots before entering the classroom to keep the floor clean.","translation":"在泥濘的徒步旅行後，學生們在進入教室前用軟管沖洗靴子，以保持地板乾淨。","explanation":"動詞片語 hose down 意為「用軟管沖洗」。"}],"related_forms":["hosed","hosing"]}

{"headword":"household","explanation":"名詞「家庭、戶」。形容詞「家庭的、家用的」。常用片語 household chores (家事)、household appliances (家用電器)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many <target>households</target> now use smart devices to control their lighting and temperature, making their daily lives more convenient.","translation":"許多家庭現在使用智慧裝置來控制照明和溫度，使他們的日常生活更加便利。","explanation":"名詞「家庭」。指住在同一屋簷下的人群。"},{"sentence":"The government provides financial support to low-income <target>households</target> to help them afford basic necessities and healthcare services.","translation":"政府向低收入家庭提供財務支持，以幫助他們負擔基本生活必需品和醫療服務。","explanation":"名詞「家庭」。"},{"sentence":"Vacuum cleaners and dishwashers are essential <target>household</target> <pattern>appliances</pattern> that save people a lot of time and effort in cleaning.","translation":"吸塵器和洗碗機是不可或缺的家用電器，在清潔方面為人們節省了大量時間和精力。","explanation":"形容詞「家用的」。常用搭配：household appliances (家用電器)。"},{"sentence":"Sharing <target>household</target> <pattern>chores</pattern> equally among family members is a great way to teach children about responsibility and cooperation.","translation":"在家庭成員之間平等分擔家事是一個教導孩子責任感與合作精神的好方法。","explanation":"形容詞「家庭的」。常用搭配：household chores (家事)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"housework","explanation":"名詞「家事」。不可數名詞，注意不要加 s。常用動詞搭配 do the housework。","entries":[{"sentence":"Since both parents work full-time, they decided to divide the <target>housework</target> fairly so that no one feels overwhelmed by the tasks.","translation":"由於父母雙方都全職工作，他們決定公平地分擔家事，這樣沒有人會覺得任務過重。","explanation":"名詞「家事」。注意 housework 為不可數名詞。"},{"sentence":"The students were encouraged to help with the <target>housework</target> on weekends, such as sweeping the floor and taking out the trash.","translation":"學生們被鼓勵在週末幫忙做家事，例如掃地和倒垃圾。","explanation":"名詞「家事」。常用動詞搭配：do the housework。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"humanity","explanation":"名詞「人類、人性、仁慈」。可指全人類，也可指對他人的同情心（人性）。在學術文章中也常用於指「人文科學」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The discovery of new vaccines is a great achievement for all of <target>humanity</target>, as it saves millions of lives worldwide.","translation":"新疫苗的發現是全人類的一大成就，因為它在全世界拯救了數百萬人的生命。","explanation":"名詞「人類」。指全人類。"},{"sentence":"Showing kindness to those in need is a reflection of our shared <target>humanity</target>, bringing people closer together regardless of their background.","translation":"表現出對需要幫助的人的仁慈是我們共同人性的反映，無論背景如何都能將人們拉近。","explanation":"名詞「人性、仁慈」。指對他人的同情心。"},{"sentence":"Many university students choose to study <target>humanities</target> to better understand the history, culture, and philosophy of different civilizations.","translation":"許多大學生選擇學習人文科學，以更好地理解不同文明的歷史、文化和哲學。","explanation":"名詞「人文科學」。複數形式 humanities 指人文學科。"}],"related_forms":["human","humane"]}

{"headword":"humidity","explanation":"名詞「濕度」。常用形容詞 humid (潮濕的)。常用搭配 high humidity (高濕度)、relative humidity (相對濕度)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The high <target>humidity</target> in Taiwan during the summer makes it feel much hotter than the actual temperature on the thermometer.","translation":"台灣夏季的高濕度使得體感溫度比溫度計上的實際溫度高得多。","explanation":"名詞「濕度」。"},{"sentence":"Many people use dehumidifiers to reduce the <target>humidity</target> in their rooms, preventing mold from growing on their clothes and furniture.","translation":"許多人使用除濕機來降低房間內的濕度，防止衣服和家具上長霉。","explanation":"名詞「濕度」。常用搭配：reduce the humidity。"}],"related_forms":["humid"]}

{"headword":"hurricane","explanation":"名詞「颶風」。指一種強大的熱帶氣旋。常用搭配 hit / strike / make landfall (登陸/襲擊)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The coastal city was devastated by a powerful <target>hurricane</target> that brought strong winds and heavy rain, causing widespread flooding.","translation":"這座沿海城市被一場強大的颶風摧毀，帶來強風和暴雨，導致大範圍淹水。","explanation":"名詞「颶風」。"},{"sentence":"The local government issued a warning and urged residents to evacuate before the <target>hurricane</target> <pattern>made</pattern> <pattern>landfall</pattern>, ensuring everyone's safety.","translation":"當地政府發布警告並敦促居民在颶風登陸前撤離，以確保每個人的安全。","explanation":"名詞「颶風」。常用搭配：make landfall (登陸)。"}],"related_forms":["hurricanes"]}

{"headword":"hush","explanation":"名詞「寂靜」；動詞「使安靜、使沉默」。常用於描述突然的安靜，或用來安撫孩子。","entries":[{"sentence":"A sudden <target>hush</target> fell over the crowd as the famous singer walked onto the stage, and everyone waited in silence.","translation":"當著名歌手走上舞台時，人群中突然陷入一片寂靜，每個人都安靜地等待著。","explanation":"名詞「寂靜」。常用搭配：a hush fell over... (某處陷入寂靜)。"},{"sentence":"The mother gently <target>hushed</target> the crying baby in her arms, rocking him slowly until he finally fell asleep.","translation":"母親溫柔地安撫哭泣的嬰兒，緩緩搖晃他直到他終於睡著。","explanation":"動詞「使安靜」。指通過溫柔的方式讓某人停止哭泣或說話。"}],"related_forms":["hushed"]}

{"headword":"hydrogen","explanation":"名詞「氫」。化學元素符號為 H。常用搭配 hydrogen fuel (氫燃料)、hydrogen energy (氫能)。","entries":[{"sentence":"In science class, the teacher demonstrated how <target>hydrogen</target> and oxygen combine to form water, explaining the chemical reaction clearly.","translation":"在科學課上，老師演示了氫和氧如何結合形成水，解釋了化學反應過程。","explanation":"名詞「氫」。"},{"sentence":"Many engineers are researching <target>hydrogen</target> <pattern>fuel</pattern> as a clean energy source to replace gasoline and reduce air pollution in cities.","translation":"許多工程師正在研究氫燃料作為一種清潔能源來取代汽油，以減少城市的空氣污染。","explanation":"名詞「氫」。常用搭配：hydrogen fuel (氫燃料)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"identical","explanation":"形容詞「完全相同的」。常用於描述雙胞胎 (identical twins) 或兩樣完全一樣的東西。注意與 similar (相似的) 區別：identical 強調完全相同，similar 則僅指相似。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two sisters are <target>identical</target> <pattern>twins</pattern>, and it is often difficult for their classmates to tell them apart by their looks.","translation":"這對姐妹是同卵雙胞胎，他們的同學經常很難從外貌上將她們區分開來。","explanation":"形容詞「完全相同的」。常用搭配：identical twins (同卵雙胞胎)。"},{"sentence":"The police found two <target>identical</target> bags left at the airport, which made them suspect that there might be a security threat.","translation":"警方在機場發現了兩個完全相同的袋子，這讓他們懷疑可能存在安全威脅。","explanation":"形容詞「完全相同的」。指兩件東西在外觀上完全一樣。"},{"sentence":"Although they lived in different countries, the two students shared <target>identical</target> goals in life, both wanting to become doctors to help people.","translation":"儘管他們住在不同的國家，這兩名學生在人生目標上完全一致，都想成為醫生來幫助人們。","explanation":"形容詞「完全相同的」。此處指想法或目標一致。"}],"related_forms":["identically","identity"]}

{"headword":"identification","explanation":"名詞「身分證明」或「辨識」。常用縮寫為 ID。在 GSAT 中常考其作為「身分證明文件」的用法，搭配動詞 provide, show, check。","entries":[{"sentence":"The security officer asked the visitor to <pattern>show</pattern> his <target>identification</target> before allowing him to enter the restricted area of the building.","translation":"安保人員要求訪客在進入建築物禁區前出示身分證明。","explanation":"名詞「身分證明」。常用搭配 show identification。"},{"sentence":"The police used DNA <target>identification</target> to find the real criminal, as it provided an undeniable link between the suspect and the crime scene.","translation":"警方使用 DNA 辨識來尋找真正的罪犯，因為它提供了嫌疑人與犯罪現場之間不可否認的聯繫。","explanation":"名詞「辨識」。指確認某人或某物身分的過程。"}],"related_forms":["identifications"]}

{"headword":"identify","explanation":"動詞「辨識、認出」或「認同」。常用搭配 identify A as B (將 A 辨識為 B) 或 identify with (對...有共鳴/認同)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The witness was able to <target>identify</target> the suspect <pattern>as</pattern> the man who had stolen her bag during the crowded festival.","translation":"證人能夠將嫌疑人辨識為在擁擠的節日期間偷走她包包的人。","explanation":"動詞「辨識」。常用搭配 identify A as B。"},{"sentence":"Many teenagers <target>identify</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the main character in the novel because they face similar struggles with their parents and school.","translation":"許多青少年對小說中的主角產生共鳴，因為他們在面對父母和學校的掙扎時有著相似的經歷。","explanation":"動詞「認同」。片語 identify with sb 表示對某人產生共鳴或認同其處境。"}],"related_forms":["identified","identifying","identification"]}

{"headword":"idiom","explanation":"名詞「習語、慣用語」。指那些不能從單個單字的意思直接推論出整體含意的表達方式，是語言學習中的難點。","entries":[{"sentence":"While learning English, students often struggle with <target>idioms</target> because their meanings cannot be understood by simply translating each word individually.","translation":"學習英語時，學生經常在習語上遇到困難，因為它們的意思不能僅僅通過單個單字的翻譯來理解。","explanation":"名詞「習語」。"},{"sentence":"The teacher encouraged the students to <pattern>learn</pattern> common <target>idioms</target> to make their speaking and writing sound more natural and like a native speaker.","translation":"老師鼓勵學生學習常見的慣用語，使他們的口說和寫作聽起來更自然，更像母語人士。","explanation":"名詞「習語」。常用搭配 learn/use idioms。"}],"related_forms":["idiomatic","idiomatically"]}

{"headword":"idle","explanation":"形容詞「懶散的、閒置的」；動詞「（引擎）空轉」。形容詞用法最常見，注意與 ideal (理想的) 拼寫相似，容易混淆。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the long summer break, he spent too many <target>idle</target> hours scrolling through social media instead of preparing for his upcoming exams.","translation":"在漫長的暑假期間，他花了太多懶散的時間刷社交媒體，而不是準備即將到來的考試。","explanation":"形容詞「懶散的」。指人缺乏活動或目的。"},{"sentence":"The factory had to shut down several <target>idle</target> machines that were no longer needed for the current production process to save energy.","translation":"工廠不得不關閉幾台不再為目前生產流程所需的閒置機器，以節省能源。","explanation":"形容詞「閒置的」。指物體未被使用。"},{"sentence":"The driver let the car <target>idle</target> in the driveway for a few minutes to warm up the engine before driving in the freezing cold.","translation":"駕駛在車道上讓汽車空轉幾分鐘，以便在極寒天氣中行駛前將引擎加熱。","explanation":"動詞「（引擎）空轉」。"}],"related_forms":["idly","idleness"]}

{"headword":"idol","explanation":"名詞「偶像」或「神像」。在現代語境中，多指深受崇拜的明星或公眾人物。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young girl's favorite pop <target>idol</target> visited her school, and she was too excited to speak when she finally met him in person.","translation":"這個年輕女孩最喜歡的流行偶像來訪她的學校，當她終於親自見到他時，興奮得說不出話來。","explanation":"名詞「偶像」。指深受崇拜的明星。"},{"sentence":"Ancient civilizations often built massive stone <target>idols</target> to worship their gods and pray for a successful harvest every year.","translation":"古代文明經常建造巨大的石像來崇拜他們的神靈，並祈求每年都能五穀豐登。","explanation":"名詞「神像」。指用於崇拜的雕像。"}],"related_forms":["idols"]}

{"headword":"ignorance","explanation":"名詞「無知、不了解」。常考搭配 ignorance of (對...無知)。注意與 ignore (無視) 的區別：ignorance 是狀態，而 ignore 是主動地不理會。","entries":[{"sentence":"His complete <target>ignorance</target> <pattern>of</pattern> basic computer skills made it very difficult for him to complete the online assignment on time.","translation":"他對基本電腦技能的完全無知，使他很難準時完成線上作業。","explanation":"名詞「無知」。常用搭配 ignorance of sth。"},{"sentence":"Some people believe that <target>ignorance</target> is bliss, meaning they would rather not know the truth if it only brings them pain and sadness.","translation":"有些人認為無知即是福，意思是如果真相只會帶來痛苦和悲傷，他們寧願不知道。","explanation":"名詞「無知」。這裡使用了常見的英語諺語 ignorance is bliss。"}],"related_forms":["ignore","ignorant"]}

{"headword":"ignorant","explanation":"形容詞「無知的、不了解的」。常用搭配 ignorant of (對...無知)。注意其在不同語境下可能帶有貶義，指人缺乏教育或沒常識。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tourist was completely <target>ignorant</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the local customs, which led to some awkward moments during his stay in the village.","translation":"這位遊客完全不了解當地習俗，導致他在村莊停留期間出現了一些尷尬的時刻。","explanation":"形容詞「無知的」。常用搭配 ignorant of sth。"},{"sentence":"It is <target>ignorant</target> to assume that all students learn in the same way, as everyone has different strengths and learning styles.","translation":"假設所有學生都以相同方式學習是無知的，因為每個人都有不同的長處和學習風格。","explanation":"形容詞「無知的」。指缺乏正確資訊或知識。"}],"related_forms":["ignorance","ignorantly"]}

{"headword":"illustrate","explanation":"動詞「說明、舉例」或「用插圖說明」。在學術寫作中常作為 illustrate a point (說明一個觀點) 的用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"To <target>illustrate</target> his point about climate change, the professor used a series of photographs showing the melting glaciers in Antarctica.","translation":"為了說明他關於氣候變遷的觀點，教授使用了一系列顯示南極洲冰河融化的照片。","explanation":"動詞「說明、舉例」。常用於通過例子或圖片來讓某事變得清晰。"},{"sentence":"The textbook author decided to <target>illustrate</target> the complex biological process <pattern>with</pattern> a simple diagram to help students understand it more easily.","translation":"教科書作者決定用一個簡單的圖表來說明這個複雜的生物過程，以幫助學生更容易地理解它。","explanation":"動詞「用插圖說明」。常用搭配 illustrate with a diagram/picture。"}],"related_forms":["illustrated","illustration","illustrative"]}

{"headword":"illustration","explanation":"名詞「插圖」或「例證」。在 GSAT 閱讀中，常指用來支持論點的例子或說明。","entries":[{"sentence":"The children's book was filled with colorful <target>illustrations</target> that helped the young readers imagine the characters and the magical world.","translation":"這本兒童書充滿了色彩繽紛的插圖，幫助年輕讀者想像角色和神奇的世界。","explanation":"名詞「插圖」。指書中的圖畫。"},{"sentence":"As a clear <target>illustration</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the company's success, the CEO mentioned the rapid growth in their annual sales over the last five years.","translation":"作為公司成功的一個清晰例證，執行長提到過去五年來年銷售額的快速增長。","explanation":"名詞「例證」。指用來說明某事的具體例子。"}],"related_forms":["illustrate","illustrative"]}

{"headword":"imaginary","explanation":"形容詞「想像的、虛構的」。注意與 imaginable (可想像的) 的區別：imaginary 指的是不存在於現實中的事物，而 imaginable (通常接在最高級後) 指的是「能被想像出來的」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The little boy had an <target>imaginary</target> friend who followed him everywhere, although no one else in the family could see him.","translation":"這個小男孩有一個想像中的朋友，跟著他到處走，儘管家人中沒有其他人能看到他。","explanation":"形容詞「想像的」。指不存在於現實中的事物。"},{"sentence":"In the fantasy novel, the author created an <target>imaginary</target> world with floating islands and creatures that could speak human languages.","translation":"小說中，作者創造了一個虛構的世界，其中有漂浮的島嶼和能說人類語言的生物。","explanation":"形容詞「虛構的」。指由想像力創造出的世界或事物。"}],"related_forms":["imagine","imagination","imaginable"]}

{"headword":"imaginative","explanation":"形容詞，意為「富有想像力的」。常用於描述人或作品。注意與 imaginary (想像中的/虛構的) 的區別：imaginative 指的是具備創造力、能想出新點子的能力，例如 an imaginative child (一個富有想像力的孩子)；而 imaginary 指的是不存在於現實中的事物，例如 an imaginary friend (一個想像中的朋友) 或 an imaginary line (一條虛構的線)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young artist was praised for her <target>imaginative</target> <pattern>approach</pattern> to painting, as she used recycled materials to create stunning sculptures.","translation":"這位年輕藝術家因其富有想像力的繪畫方式而受到稱讚，因為她使用回收材料創造出令人驚嘆的雕塑。","explanation":"形容詞「富有想像力的」。常用搭配 imaginative approach (富有想像力的做法/方式)。"},{"sentence":"To make the story more exciting, the author used <target>imaginative</target> <pattern>descriptions</pattern> of futuristic cities and alien civilizations.","translation":"為了讓故事更精彩，作者對未來城市和外星文明使用了富有想像力的描述。","explanation":"形容詞「富有想像力的」。常用搭配 imaginative descriptions (富有想像力的描述)。"},{"sentence":"The teacher encouraged the students to be more <target>imaginative</target> <pattern>in</pattern> their writing to express their feelings and ideas more vividly.","translation":"老師鼓勵學生在寫作中更富有想像力，以便更生動地表達他們的感受和想法。","explanation":"形容詞「富有想像力的」。常用搭配 be imaginative in (在...方面富有想像力)。"}],"related_forms":["imagination","imagine"]}

{"headword":"imitate","explanation":"動詞，意為「模仿」。指模仿他人的行為、聲音或風格。常用搭配 imitate someone's voice (模仿某人的聲音) 或 imitate a style (模仿某風格)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Small children often <target>imitate</target> <pattern>the behavior of</pattern> their parents, learning how to speak and act through observation.","translation":"年幼的孩子經常模仿父母的行為，透過觀察學習如何說話和行動。","explanation":"動詞「模仿」。常用搭配 imitate the behavior of (模仿...的行為)。"},{"sentence":"The comedian's ability to <target>imitate</target> <pattern>famous celebrities</pattern> with precision made him a favorite among the audience.","translation":"這位喜劇演員能精準模仿著名名人的能力使他成為觀眾的最愛。","explanation":"動詞「模仿」。常用搭配 imitate famous celebrities (模仿名人)。"},{"sentence":"Some birds can <target>imitate</target> <pattern>the sounds of</pattern> other animals to attract mates or confuse predators in the wild.","translation":"某些鳥類能模仿其他動物的聲音，以在野外吸引配偶或迷惑捕食者。","explanation":"動詞「模仿」。常用搭配 imitate the sounds of (模仿...的聲音)。"}],"related_forms":["imitation","imitative"]}

{"headword":"imitation","explanation":"名詞，意為「模仿」或「贗品」。指模仿某事物的行為，或是被模仿出的產物。常用搭配 an imitation of (對...的模仿) 或 imitation leather (人造皮革)。注意與 fake 或 counterfeit 的區別：imitation 較為中性，可用於描述產品，如 imitation jewelry (模仿珠寶/人造珠寶)，而 fake 或 counterfeit 側重於欺騙或非法地偽造。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student's painting was a clever <target>imitation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a famous Impressionist masterpiece, showing his talent for detail.","translation":"這名學生的繪畫是對一件著名印象派傑作的聰明模仿，顯示出他對細節的才華。","explanation":"名詞「模仿」。常用片語 an imitation of...。"},{"sentence":"Because real leather is expensive, many fashion brands use <target>imitation</target> <pattern>leather</pattern> to make affordable bags and shoes.","translation":"因為真皮很貴，許多時尚品牌使用人造皮革來製作價格實惠的包包和鞋子。","explanation":"名詞「贗品/人造」。常用搭配 imitation leather (人造皮革)。"},{"sentence":"The child's <target>imitation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> his teacher's funny expressions made the whole class laugh out loud.","translation":"孩子對老師有趣表情的模仿讓整個班級哄堂大笑。","explanation":"名詞「模仿」。常用片語 an imitation of...。"}],"related_forms":["imitate","imitative"]}

{"headword":"immigrant","explanation":"名詞，意為「移民」。指從一個國家搬到另一個國家長期居住的人。注意與 emigrant (移出者) 的區別：immigrant 是指搬進來的人 (in)，而 emigrant 是指搬出去的人 (exit)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many <target>immigrants</target> face challenges when adjusting to a new country, such as language barriers and cultural differences.","translation":"許多移民在適應新國家時面臨挑戰，例如語言障礙和文化差異。","explanation":"名詞「移民」。指進入新國家居住的人。"},{"sentence":"The city's diverse food scene is largely due to the <target>immigrants</target> who brought their traditional cuisines from all over the world.","translation":"這座城市多樣的飲食文化在很大程度上歸功於那些將世界各地傳統美食帶來的移民。","explanation":"名詞「移民」。"},{"sentence":"The government provides support programs to help <target>immigrants</target> <pattern>integrate into</pattern> the local society and find employment.","translation":"政府提供支持計畫，幫助移民融入當地社會並尋找工作。","explanation":"名詞「移民」。常用搭配 integrate into (融入)。"}],"related_forms":["immigrate","immigration"]}

{"headword":"immigrate","explanation":"動詞，意為「移民」。指從原籍國搬到另一個國家長期居住。常用搭配 immigrate to (移民到...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"His grandparents decided to <target>immigrate</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the United States in search of better job opportunities and a higher standard of living.","translation":"他的祖父母決定移民到美國，以尋找更好的工作機會和更高的生活水準。","explanation":"動詞「移民」。常用搭配 immigrate to (移民到...)。"},{"sentence":"Many people choose to <target>immigrate</target> <pattern>to</pattern> Canada because of its welcoming policies toward skilled workers from other countries.","translation":"許多人選擇移民到加拿大，因為其對其他國家技術工人的歡迎政策。","explanation":"動詞「移民」。常用搭配 immigrate to (移民到...)。"}],"related_forms":["immigrant","immigration"]}

{"headword":"immigration","explanation":"名詞，意為「移民」或「入境管理」。指移民的過程，或負責處理入境事宜的機構。常用搭配 immigration office (移民局) 或 immigration laws (移民法)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After landing at the airport, passengers must first pass through <target>immigration</target> <pattern>control</pattern> before they can collect their luggage.","translation":"飛機降落後，乘客必須首先通過入境管理控制，然後才能領取行李。","explanation":"名詞「入境管理」。常用搭配 immigration control (入境管理)。"},{"sentence":"The government is currently debating new <target>immigration</target> <pattern>policies</pattern> to manage the number of people moving into the country.","translation":"政府目前正在討論新的移民政策，以管理進入該國的人數。","explanation":"名詞「移民」。常用搭配 immigration policies (移民政策)。"},{"sentence":"Strict <target>immigration</target> <pattern>laws</pattern> can make it difficult for foreign students to stay and work in the country after graduation.","translation":"嚴格的移民法可能會使外國學生在畢業後很難在該國停留並工作。","explanation":"名詞「移民」。常用搭配 immigration laws (移民法)。"}],"related_forms":["immigrant","immigrate"]}

{"headword":"impact","explanation":"名詞「影響」或「衝擊」；動詞「影響」或「衝擊」。作為名詞時，常用搭配 have an impact on (對...有影響)。注意與 effect 的區別：impact 較強調強烈的衝擊或重大變革，而 effect 通常指結果或產生的影響。作為動詞時，impact 常用作及物動詞，直接後接對象。","entries":[{"sentence":"The rise of social media has had a profound <target>impact</target> <pattern>on</pattern> how teenagers communicate and form social relationships.","translation":"社群媒體的興起對青少年如何溝通和建立社交關係產生了深遠的影響。","explanation":"名詞「影響」。常用搭配 have an impact on (對...有影響)。"},{"sentence":"A sudden change in weather can have a negative <target>impact</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the growth of crops and the overall harvest.","translation":"天氣的突然變化可能會對農作物的生長和整體收成產生負面影響。","explanation":"名詞「影響」。常用搭配 have a negative impact on (對...有影響)。"},{"sentence":"The economic crisis <target>impacted</target> many small businesses, forcing some of them to close down due to lack of funds.","translation":"經濟危機影響了許多小企業，迫使其中一些因缺乏資金而倒閉。","explanation":"動詞「影響」。直接後接影響對象。"},{"sentence":"The meteorite <target>impacted</target> the Earth's surface with enormous force, creating a massive crater that scientists study today.","translation":"運石撞擊地球表面，產生了巨大的力量，創造了一個科學家今天仍在研究的巨大隕石坑。","explanation":"動詞「衝擊」。指物理上的撞擊。"}],"related_forms":["impactful"]}

{"headword":"imply","explanation":"動詞，意為「暗示」或「意味著」。指不直接地表達出某個意思。常用搭配 imply that (暗示...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although the teacher didn't say it directly, her disappointed look <target>implied</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the students had not put enough effort into their project.","translation":"雖然老師沒有直接說出來，但她失望的眼神暗示了學生們在計畫中沒有付出足夠的努力。","explanation":"動詞「暗示」。常用搭配 imply that (暗示...)。"},{"sentence":"The evidence presented in court <target>implied</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the suspect was not at the scene of the crime during the incident.","translation":"法庭上提出的證據暗示了嫌疑犯在事件發生時不在犯罪現場。","explanation":"動詞「暗示」。常用搭配 imply imply that (暗示...)。"},{"sentence":"A high fever often <target>implies</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the body is fighting an infection, which is why doctors recommend resting and drinking fluids.","translation":"高燒通常意味著身體正在對抗感染，這就是為什麼醫生建議休息並補充水分。","explanation":"動詞「意味著」。指某事物的存在暗示了某種狀態。"}],"related_forms":["implication"]}

{"headword":"impose","explanation":"動詞，意為「強加」或「徵收」。常用於指強加規則、稅金或限制。常用搭配 impose ... on (將...強加於...) 或 impose a tax/fine (徵收稅金/罰金)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school board decided to <target>impose</target> <pattern>stricter rules</pattern> <pattern>on</pattern> the use of smartphones during class to improve students' focus.","translation":"學校董事會決定對課堂上使用智慧型手機的使用強加更嚴格的規則，以提高學生的專注力。","explanation":"動詞「強加」。常用搭配 impose rules on (對...強加規則)。"},{"sentence":"The government decided to <target>impose</target> <pattern>a new tax</pattern> <pattern>on</pattern> luxury goods to increase the city's revenue for public services.","translation":"政府決定對奢侈品徵收新稅，以增加城市公共服務的收入。","explanation":"動詞「徵收」。常用搭配 impose a tax on (對...徵收稅金)。"},{"sentence":"It is unfair to <target>impose</target> <pattern>your own beliefs</pattern> <pattern>on</pattern> others, as everyone has the right to their own opinions and perspectives.","translation":"將自己的信念強加於他人是不公平的，因為每個人都有權擁有自己的意見和觀點。","explanation":"動詞「強加」。常用搭配 impose beliefs on (將信念強加於他人)。"}],"related_forms":["imposition"]}

{"headword":"impression","explanation":"名詞，意為「印象」或「模仿」。指對某人或某事物的初步感覺，或模仿某人的聲音/動作。常用搭配 make an impression on (給...留下印象) 或 first impression (第一印象)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new student made a great first <target>impression</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the class by being polite and helpful to everyone.","translation":"這名新學生透過對每個人都很有禮貌且樂於助人，給班級留下了很好的第一印象。","explanation":"名詞「印象」。常用搭配 make a first impression on (給...留下第一印象)。"},{"sentence":"The candidate's confident speaking style and professional attire made a strong <target>impression</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the interviewers during the job interview.","translation":"應徵者自信的演講風格和專業的著裝在面試官面前留下了深刻的印象。","explanation":"名詞「印象」。常用搭配 make a strong impression on (對...留下深刻印象)。"},{"sentence":"The comedian's perfect <target>imitation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the president's voice was such a great <target>impression</target> that the audience roared with laughter.","translation":"喜劇演員對總統聲音的完美模仿是如此出色，以至於觀眾哄堂大笑。","explanation":"名詞「模仿」。指模仿某人的聲音或動作。"}],"related_forms":["impress","impressive"]}

{"headword":"incident","explanation":"名詞「事件」。通常指突發的、不尋常的或不愉快的事件。注意與 event (活動/盛事) 相對，event 通常指計畫好的活動。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school principal called an emergency meeting to discuss the <target>incident</target> that happened in the cafeteria during lunch break.","translation":"校長召開緊急會議，討論午休時間在食堂發生的事件。","explanation":"名詞「事件」。指突發且不愉快的事件。"},{"sentence":"Police are currently investigating a minor car <target>incident</target> on the highway, which caused a brief traffic jam this morning.","translation":"警方目前正在調查今天早上在高速公路上發生的一起輕微車禍事件，導致短暫的交通堵塞。","explanation":"名詞「事件」。常用搭配：minor incident (輕微事件), serious incident (嚴重事件)。"}],"related_forms":["incidents"]}

{"headword":"including","explanation":"介系詞「包括」。用於將某物或某人納入一個群體或列表。常用於補充說明，注意與 exclude (排除) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tour package is very affordable, <target>including</target> round-trip flight tickets, hotel accommodation, and three meals a day.","translation":"這個旅遊套裝行程非常實惠，包括往返機票、酒店住宿和一日三餐。","explanation":"介系詞「包括」。用於列舉包含的項目。"},{"sentence":"Everyone in the class, <target>including</target> the teacher, was surprised by the sudden announcement of the holiday on Friday.","translation":"班上的每個人，包括老師在內，都對週五突然宣布放假感到驚訝。","explanation":"介系詞「包括」。用於強調某個特定對象也被納入其中。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"incredible","explanation":"形容詞「難以置信的，極好的」。可指事物難以令人相信（不真實），或用來強調某事非常出色。常用搭配：incredible speed (驚人的速度), incredible effort (巨大的努力)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young pianist performed an <target>incredible</target> piece of music, leaving the audience in complete awe of her talent.","translation":"這位年輕的鋼琴家演奏了一首令人難以置信的樂曲，讓觀眾對她的才華感到完全敬畏。","explanation":"形容詞「極好的」。用於形容才華或表現非常出色。"},{"sentence":"It is <target>incredible</target> that he managed to finish the entire project in just two days despite the lack of resources.","translation":"儘管缺乏資源，他竟然能在短短兩天內完成整個計畫，真是令人難以置信。","explanation":"形容詞「難以置信的」。指事情出乎意料，難以讓人相信。"},{"sentence":"The mountain climbers showed <target>incredible</target> <pattern>strength</pattern> and determination to reach the summit before the storm arrived.","translation":"登山者在風暴到來前展現了驚人的體力和決心以到達山頂。","explanation":"形容詞「驚人的」。常用搭配：incredible strength (驚人的體力)。"}],"related_forms":["incredibly"]}

{"headword":"indication","explanation":"名詞「跡象，指示」。指某事存在的證據或信號。常用片語 an indication of (…的跡象/指示)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The sudden drop in temperature is a clear <target>indication</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the approaching winter, prompting people to wear warmer clothes.","translation":"氣溫的突然下降是冬季即將到來的一個明顯跡象，促使人們穿上更保暖的衣服。","explanation":"名詞「跡象」。常用搭配：an indication of (…的跡象)。"},{"sentence":"The student's high test scores are a strong <target>indication</target> <pattern>of</pattern> her hard work and dedication to her studies.","translation":"學生的高分是她努力學習且專注的強烈跡象。","explanation":"名詞「跡象」。指透過結果推斷出原因或狀態。"},{"sentence":"There was no <target>indication</target> that the company would announce a new product, so the news came as a complete surprise.","translation":"沒有任何跡象顯示公司會發布新產品，因此這個消息完全出乎意料。","explanation":"名詞「跡象」。常用於否定句中表示沒有預兆。"}],"related_forms":["indicate","indicative"]}

{"headword":"infant","explanation":"名詞「嬰兒」。通常指剛出生到一歲左右的小孩。注意與 baby (較廣泛的稱呼) 的區別，infant 在醫學或法律文件中更正式。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new mother carefully held her <target>infant</target> in her arms, making sure the baby was comfortable and warm.","translation":"新手媽媽小心地將她的嬰兒抱在懷裡，確保寶寶舒適且溫暖。","explanation":"名詞「嬰兒」。指剛出生的孩子。"},{"sentence":"Medical professionals emphasize that breastfeeding provides essential nutrients and antibodies to an <target>infant</target> for healthy growth.","translation":"醫療專業人員強調，母乳餵養為嬰兒提供必要的營養和抗體以促進健康成長。","explanation":"名詞「嬰兒」。常用於醫學背景。"}],"related_forms":["infancy"]}

{"headword":"infection","explanation":"名詞「感染」。指細菌或病毒進入身體導致的疾病。常用搭配：bacterial infection (細菌性感染), viral infection (病毒性感染), fight an infection (對抗感染)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor prescribed antibiotics to treat the bacterial <target>infection</target> in the student's throat, helping him recover quickly.","translation":"醫生開了抗生素來治療該學生喉嚨的細菌性感染，幫助他快速康復。","explanation":"名詞「感染」。常用搭配：bacterial infection (細菌性感染)。"},{"sentence":"To prevent a skin <target>infection</target>, it is important to clean the wound thoroughly with soap and water before applying medicine.","translation":"為了防止皮膚感染，在塗藥前用肥皂和水徹底清潔傷口是非常重要的。","explanation":"名詞「感染」。常用搭配：skin infection (皮膚感染)。"},{"sentence":"Washing your hands frequently is the most effective way to reduce the risk of a viral <target>infection</target> during flu season.","translation":"在流感季節，勤洗手是降低病毒性感染風險最有效的方法。","explanation":"名詞「感染」。常用搭配：viral infection (病毒性感染)。"}],"related_forms":["infect","infectious"]}

{"headword":"inflation","explanation":"名詞「通貨膨脹」。指物價上漲且貨幣購買力下降的現象。常用搭配：high inflation (高通膨), combat inflation (對抗通膨)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Due to high <target>inflation</target>, the price of daily necessities like bread and milk has increased significantly over the past year.","translation":"由於高通貨膨脹，麵包和牛奶等日常必需品的價格在過去一年中顯著增加。","explanation":"名詞「通貨膨脹」。指物價上漲。"},{"sentence":"The central bank decided to raise interest rates in an effort to <pattern>combat</pattern> <target>inflation</target> and stabilize the economy.","translation":"中央銀行決定提高利率，以努力對抗通貨膨脹並穩定經濟。","explanation":"名詞「通貨膨脹」。常用搭配：combat inflation (對抗通膨)。"}],"related_forms":["inflate","inflationary"]}

{"headword":"influential","explanation":"形容詞「有影響力的」。指某人或某物能改變他人的想法或行為。常用搭配：an influential person (有影響力的人), an influential book (有影響力的書)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The professor is one of the most <target>influential</target> figures in the field of psychology, and his research has changed many theories.","translation":"這位教授是心理學領域中最有影響力的人物之一，他的研究改變了許多理論。","explanation":"形容詞「有影響力的」。指在專業領域具有權威。"},{"sentence":"Social media stars have become highly <target>influential</target> in shaping the fashion choices and shopping habits of teenagers today.","translation":"社交媒體明星在塑造當今青少年的時尚選擇和購物習慣方面變得非常有影響力。","explanation":"形容詞「有影響力的」。指能影響他人行為。"},{"sentence":"The student council president gave an <target>influential</target> speech that encouraged many students to participate in the environmental protection project.","translation":"學生會會長發表了一場有影響力的演講，鼓勵許多學生參與環境保護計畫。","explanation":"形容詞「有影響力的」。指演講內容能打動人心。"}],"related_forms":["influence"]}

{"headword":"informative","explanation":"形容詞「提供豐富資訊的，有益的」。常用於描述書籍、講座、文章或對話，指其內容充實且有用。","entries":[{"sentence":"The museum guide provided an <target>informative</target> tour, explaining the historical background of each painting in great detail.","translation":"博物館導覽員提供了一次資訊豐富的導覽，詳細解釋了每幅畫的歷史背景。","explanation":"形容詞「資訊豐富的」。常用於描述導覽或演講。"},{"sentence":"I found the documentary about climate change to be very <target>informative</target>, as it explained the science behind the warming planet.","translation":"我覺得關於氣候變遷的紀錄片非常有益，因為它解釋了地球暖化背後的科學原理。","explanation":"形容詞「提供豐富資訊的」。常用於描述書籍或影片。"},{"sentence":"The teacher's feedback on the essay was highly <target>informative</target>, helping the student understand exactly how to improve his writing.","translation":"老師對論文的建議非常有益，幫助學生明確理解如何提高他的寫作能力。","explanation":"形容詞「有益的」。指提供有用的建議。"}],"related_forms":["inform","information"]}

{"headword":"ingredient","explanation":"名詞「成分，原料」。原指烹飪食材，後引申為成功或達成某事的必要條件。常用搭配：key ingredient (關鍵要素)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Fresh herbs and organic vegetables are the main <target>ingredients</target> in this healthy salad, giving it a natural and fresh taste.","translation":"新鮮香草和有機蔬菜是這道健康沙拉的主要成分，賦予其自然且清新的口感。","explanation":"名詞「成分」。指烹飪用的食材。"},{"sentence":"Hard work and persistence are the <pattern>key</pattern> <target>ingredients</target> for success in any academic pursuit, regardless of the subject.","translation":"無論是什麼科目，努力和堅持都是學業追求成功的關鍵要素。","explanation":"名詞「要素」。指達成某目標的必要條件。常用搭配：key ingredient (關鍵要素)。"},{"sentence":"The chef carefully measured each <target>ingredient</target> before mixing them together to ensure the cake would rise perfectly.","translation":"廚師在將所有成分混合之前小心地測量每項成分，以確保蛋糕能完美地膨脹。","explanation":"名詞「成分」。指烹飪中的原料。"}],"related_forms":["ingredients"]}

{"headword":"initial","explanation":"形容詞「最初的、初步的」，名詞「首字母」。作形容詞時，常與 initial stage (初步階段) 或 initial reaction (初步反應) 搭配。注意與 primary (主要的) 的區別：initial 強調時間上的順序，指最開始的時候；而 primary 強調重要性或等級。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the <target>initial</target> <pattern>stage</pattern> of the project, the team focused on gathering data and defining the goals of their research.","translation":"在計畫的初步階段，團隊專注於收集數據並定義他們研究的目標。","explanation":"形容詞用法，表示「最初的」。常用搭配 initial stage (初步階段)。"},{"sentence":"Her <target>initial</target> <pattern>reaction</pattern> to the news was one of shock and disbelief, but she gradually accepted the situation over time.","translation":"她對這則消息的初步反應是震驚與不信，但隨著時間推移，她逐漸接受了這個情況。","explanation":"形容詞用法，表示「初步的」。常用搭配 initial reaction (初步反應)。"},{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to write their <target>initials</target> at the bottom of each page to confirm that they had read the documents.","translation":"老師要求學生在每一頁底部寫下他們的名字首字母，以確認他們已經閱讀了這些文件。","explanation":"名詞用法，表示「首字母」。通常使用複數型 initials。"}],"related_forms":["initially"]}

{"headword":"injure","explanation":"動詞「傷害、使受傷」。通常指身體上的傷害。常用於被動語態，如 be injured in an accident (在事故中受傷)。注意與 hurt 的區別：injure 較為正式且通常指較嚴重的物理損害；hurt 則較通用，可用於身體或精神上的疼痛。","entries":[{"sentence":"The athlete was seriously <target>injured</target> <pattern>in</pattern> a car accident, which unfortunately forced him to retire from professional sports early.","translation":"這名運動員在一次車禍中受了重傷，不幸地迫使他提前從職業體育界退休。","explanation":"動詞用法，常用於被動語態，表示「在...中受傷」。"},{"sentence":"If you do not warm up properly before exercising, you may <target>injure</target> your muscles and face a long recovery period.","translation":"如果你在運動前沒有適當地熱身，你可能會傷到肌肉並面臨漫長的恢復期。","explanation":"動詞用法，表示「使受傷」。指物理上的損害。"}],"related_forms":["injury","injured"]}

{"headword":"innocence","explanation":"名詞「清白、天真」。可指法律上的無罪，也可指性格上的純真。常用於 prove one's innocence (證明清白) 或 loss of innocence (失去天真)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The lawyer worked tirelessly to <pattern>prove</pattern> his client's <target>innocence</target> by presenting new evidence that the police had previously overlooked.","translation":"律師不懈地工作以證明其客戶的清白，提出了警方先前忽略的新證據。","explanation":"名詞「清白」。常用搭配 prove one's innocence (證明清白)。"},{"sentence":"Many people believe that children possess a natural <target>innocence</target> that allows them to see the world with wonder and without prejudice.","translation":"許多人認為孩子擁有天生的純真，使他們能以好奇且無偏見的眼光看待世界。","explanation":"名詞「天真、純真」。指性格上的純真。"}],"related_forms":["innocent"]}

{"headword":"input","explanation":"名詞「輸入、投入、建議」，動詞「輸入」。名詞時，常用於指數據輸入或對某事的貢獻/建議 (give input)。動詞時，指將資訊輸入電腦。","entries":[{"sentence":"The computer programmer had to <target>input</target> the data <pattern>into</pattern> the system carefully to avoid any errors in the final report.","translation":"電腦程式設計師必須小心地將數據輸入系統，以避免最終報告中出現任何錯誤。","explanation":"動詞用法，表示「輸入」。常用搭配 input sth into sth。"},{"sentence":"The manager encouraged all team members to <pattern>provide</pattern> their <target>input</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the new marketing strategy during the weekly meeting.","translation":"經理鼓勵所有團隊成員在週會期間對新的行銷策略提供他們的建議。","explanation":"名詞用法，表示「建議、投入」。常用搭配 provide input on sth (對...提供建議)。"},{"sentence":"The quality of the final product often depends on the amount of effort and <target>input</target> provided by the design team.","translation":"最終產品的品質通常取決於設計團隊所提供的工作量和投入。","explanation":"名詞用法，表示「投入」。指投入的資源或精力。"}],"related_forms":["inputs"]}

{"headword":"insert","explanation":"動詞「插入、插入」，名詞「插頁、插圖」。動詞用法最常見，指將某物放入狹窄空間或將文字插入文中。常用搭配 insert sth into sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please <target>insert</target> your credit card <pattern>into</pattern> the machine and enter your secret PIN to complete the payment process.","translation":"請將您的信用卡插入機器並輸入您的秘密密碼以完成付款程序。","explanation":"動詞用法，表示「插入」。常用搭配 insert sth into sth。"},{"sentence":"The editor suggested that the author <target>insert</target> a few more examples <pattern>into</pattern> the second chapter to make the concepts clearer.","translation":"編輯建議作者在第二章中插入幾個更多例子，使概念更清晰。","explanation":"動詞用法，表示「插入」。指在文字或文章中加入內容。"},{"sentence":"The magazine included a special <target>insert</target> about the latest fashion trends, which was printed on a separate piece of high-quality paper.","translation":"雜誌包含了一個關於最新時尚趨勢的特別插頁，是用一張獨立的高品質紙張印刷的。","explanation":"名詞用法，表示「插頁」。"}],"related_forms":["insertion"]}

{"headword":"inspection","explanation":"名詞「檢查、視察」。指詳細且正式的檢查，常用於 ensure safety (確保安全) 或 routine inspection (例行檢查)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The building passed the safety <target>inspection</target> after the engineers checked all the structural supports and fire escape routes.","translation":"在工程師檢查了所有結構支撐和逃生路線後，這棟建築通過了安全檢查。","explanation":"名詞「檢查」。常用搭配 safety inspection (安全檢查)。"},{"sentence":"The customs officer conducted a thorough <target>inspection</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the luggage to ensure that no prohibited items were being brought into the country.","translation":"海關人員對行李進行了徹底的檢查，以確保沒有禁運物品被帶入該國。","explanation":"名詞「檢查」。常用搭配 inspection of sth (對...的檢查)。"},{"sentence":"The factory manager schedules a <pattern>routine</pattern> <target>inspection</target> every month to maintain the equipment and prevent any unexpected breakdowns.","translation":"工廠經理每個月安排一次例行檢查，以維護設備並防止任何意外故障。","explanation":"名詞「檢查」。常用搭配 routine inspection (例行檢查)。"}],"related_forms":["inspect"]}

{"headword":"inspiration","explanation":"名詞「靈感、啟發」。常用於 find inspiration (尋找靈感) 或 draw inspiration from (從...中獲得靈感)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young artist often travels to the mountains to <pattern>find</pattern> <target>inspiration</target> <pattern>for</pattern> her latest paintings and sculptures.","translation":"這位年輕藝術家經常前往山區，為她最新的畫作和雕塑尋找靈感。","explanation":"名詞「靈感」。常用搭配 find inspiration for sth (為...尋找靈感)。"},{"sentence":"The scientist <pattern>drew</pattern> <target>inspiration</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the way birds fly to design a more efficient wing for the new aircraft.","translation":"這位科學家從鳥類飛行的方式中獲得靈感，為新飛機設計了一個更高效的機翼。","explanation":"名詞「靈感」。常用搭配 draw inspiration from sth (從...中獲得靈感)。"},{"sentence":"The coach's powerful speech before the game served as a great <target>inspiration</target> to the players, encouraging them to play their best.","translation":"教練在比賽前那場強而有力的演講對球員們來說是一個巨大的啟發，鼓勵他們全力以赴。","explanation":"名詞「啟發、鼓舞」。指某人或某事能激發他人採取行動。"}],"related_forms":["inspire","inspirational"]}

{"headword":"inspire","explanation":"動詞「啟發、激勵」。指使人產生某種感覺或想法，或激發他人採取行動。常用於 inspire someone to do something (激勵某人做某事)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher's passion for history <target>inspired</target> many of her students <pattern>to</pattern> start reading more academic books on their own.","translation":"老師對歷史的熱情激勵了許多學生開始主動閱讀更多學術書籍。","explanation":"動詞用法，表示「啟發、激勵」。常用搭配 inspire someone to V (激勵某人做某事)。"},{"sentence":"The breathtaking scenery of the Grand Canyon <target>inspired</target> the photographer <pattern>to</pattern> create a series of stunning landscape photographs.","translation":"大峽谷壯麗的景色啟發了攝影師創作一系列令人驚嘆的風景照片。","explanation":"動詞用法，表示「啟發」。指受到環境或事物影響而產生創意。"},{"sentence":"A successful leader must be able to <target>inspire</target> confidence <pattern>in</pattern> their team, ensuring that everyone works together toward a common goal.","translation":"一位成功的領導者必須能夠在團隊中激發信心，確保每個人都朝著共同目標共同工作。","explanation":"動詞用法，表示「激發」。常用搭配 inspire confidence in someone (在某人心中激發信心)。"}],"related_forms":["inspiration","inspirational"]}
