{"headword":"install","explanation":"動詞「安裝」。常用於安裝軟體 (install software) 或安裝硬體設備 (install equipment)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Before using the new computer software, you must <target>install</target> it <pattern>on</pattern> your laptop and follow the setup instructions carefully.","translation":"在使用新的電腦軟體之前，你必須將其安裝在筆記型電腦上，並仔細遵循設定說明。","explanation":"動詞用法，表示「安裝軟體」。常用搭配 install sth on sth。"},{"sentence":"The school decided to <target>install</target> a new security camera system <pattern>throughout</pattern> the campus to improve overall safety for students.","translation":"學校決定在整個校區安裝一套新的安全監視器系統，以提高學生的整體安全性。","explanation":"動詞用法，表示「安裝設備」。常用搭配 install sth throughout sth (在...處處安裝)。"},{"sentence":"Many homeowners <target>install</target> solar panels <pattern>on</pattern> their roofs to reduce electricity costs and protect the environment.","translation":"許多屋主在屋頂安裝太陽能板，以降低電費並保護環境。","explanation":"動詞用法，表示「安裝」。指將設備固定於特定位置。"}],"related_forms":["installation"]}

{"headword":"instinct","explanation":"名詞「本能、直覺」。指天生的行為模式，常用於 trust one's instinct (相信直覺) 或 survival instinct (生存本能)。","entries":[{"sentence":"When the fire alarm went off, the students' <target>instinct</target> was to run toward the nearest exit without thinking about it.","translation":"當火警警報響起時，學生的本能反應是毫不思考地向最近的出口跑去。","explanation":"名詞「本能」。指天生的、不經過思考的反應。"},{"sentence":"Experienced detectives often <pattern>trust</pattern> their <target>instincts</target> when analyzing a crime scene, as these feelings often lead them to the truth.","translation":"經驗豐富的偵探在分析犯罪現場時經常相信他們的直覺，因為這些感覺通常能引導他們發現真相。","explanation":"名詞「直覺」。常用搭配 trust one's instincts (相信直覺)。"},{"sentence":"Animals have a strong <pattern>survival</pattern> <target>instinct</target> that helps them find food and avoid predators in the wild without any formal training.","translation":"動物擁有一種強烈的生存本能，幫助他們在野外無需正式訓練即可尋找食物並避開捕食者。","explanation":"名詞「本能」。常用搭配 survival instinct (生存本能)。"}],"related_forms":["instinctive","instinctively"]}

{"headword":"instruct","explanation":"動詞「指示、命令」或「指導、教學」。常用片語 instruct someone to do something (指示某人做某事)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher <target>instructed</target> the students <pattern>to</pattern> read the instructions carefully before starting the final exam.","translation":"老師指示學生在開始期末考試前仔細閱讀說明。","explanation":"動詞「指示」。常用搭配 instruct someone to do something。"},{"sentence":"The coach <target>instructed</target> the players <pattern>on</pattern> how to improve their defensive strategies to win the upcoming championship game.","translation":"教練指導球員如何改善防守策略，以贏得即將到來的冠軍賽。","explanation":"動詞「指導」。常用搭配 instruct someone on something。"}],"related_forms":["instructor","instruction","instructive"]}

{"headword":"instructor","explanation":"名詞「指導員、講師」。指在特定技能或科目上提供指導的人，常見於健身房、駕駛學校或大學。","entries":[{"sentence":"The driving <target>instructor</target> showed the teenager how to park the car safely and efficiently in a tight space.","translation":"駕駛指導員向這位青少年展示了如何在狹小空間內安全且高效地停車。","explanation":"名詞「指導員」。"},{"sentence":"After the lecture, many students approached the fitness <target>instructor</target> to ask for personalized advice on their workout routines.","translation":"講座後，許多學生向健身指導員請教關於個人化運動計畫的建議。","explanation":"名詞「指導員」。"}],"related_forms":["instruct","instruction"]}

{"headword":"insult","explanation":"動詞「侮辱」或名詞「侮辱」。注意其發音在作動詞和名詞時有所不同。常用搭配 insult someone's feelings (侮辱某人的感情)。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is never a good idea to <target>insult</target> others, as it can lead to serious conflicts and damage long-term friendships.","translation":"侮辱他人絕非良策，因為這可能導致嚴重的衝突並損害長期的友誼。","explanation":"動詞「侮辱」。"},{"sentence":"She felt that the rude comment about her accent was a personal <target>insult</target>, and she refused to speak with him again.","translation":"她覺得關於她口音的粗魯評論是一種個人侮辱，因此拒絕再次與他交談。","explanation":"名詞「侮辱」。"},{"sentence":"The athlete was penalized for <target>insulting</target> the referee during the match, which showed a lack of sportsmanship.","translation":"該運動員因在比賽中侮辱裁判而受到處罰，這顯示出缺乏運動精神。","explanation":"動詞「侮辱」的現在分詞形式。"}],"related_forms":["insulting"]}

{"headword":"insurance","explanation":"名詞「保險」。常用於財務保障或風險管理。常用片語 take out insurance (投保), insurance policy (保險單)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many families <pattern>take</pattern> <pattern>out</pattern> life <target>insurance</target> to ensure that their children are financially supported if something unexpected happens.","translation":"許多家庭投保人壽保險，以確保如果發生意外，孩子們能獲得財務支持。","explanation":"名名詞「保險」。片語 take out insurance 表示「投保」。"},{"sentence":"The company's <target>insurance</target> <pattern>policy</pattern> covers damage caused by natural disasters, such as floods and earthquakes, providing peace of mind.","translation":"該公司的保險單涵蓋了由自然災害（如洪水和地震）引起的損壞，提供了安心感。","explanation":"名詞「保險」。常用搭配 insurance policy (保險單)。"},{"sentence":"Having travel <target>insurance</target> is highly recommended when visiting foreign countries to cover potential medical expenses and flight cancellations.","translation":"前往外國旅遊時強烈建議購買旅遊保險，以涵蓋潛在的醫療費用和航班取消的情況。","explanation":"名詞「保險」。"}],"related_forms":["insure","insured"]}

{"headword":"intellectual","explanation":"形容詞「智力的、理性的」或名詞「知識分子」。常用於描述思考能力或學術討論。常用搭配 intellectual curiosity (求知欲/智力好奇心)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Reading challenging books and engaging in deep discussions can satisfy a student's <target>intellectual</target> <pattern>curiosity</pattern> and expand their horizons.","translation":"閱讀具有挑戰性的書籍並參與深入的討論可以滿足學生的求知欲並拓展他們的視野。","explanation":"形容詞「智力的」。常用搭配 intellectual curiosity。"},{"sentence":"The university is a place where <target>intellectuals</target> from different backgrounds gather to exchange ideas and debate complex social issues.","translation":"大學是一個來自不同背景的知識分子聚集在一起交流想法並辯論複雜社會問題的地方。","explanation":"名詞「知識分子」。"},{"sentence":"Developing strong <target>intellectual</target> skills is more important than simply memorizing facts for a test, as it allows for critical thinking.","translation":"培養強大的智力技能比單純為了考試而記憶事實更重要，因為這能讓學生進行批判性思考。","explanation":"形容詞「智力的」。"}],"related_forms":["intelligence","intellect"]}

{"headword":"intelligence","explanation":"名詞「智力、才智」或「情報」。在 GSAT 考題中，常指- 思考能力或 - 資訊收集。常用搭配 artificial intelligence (人工智慧)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Some experts believe that emotional <target>intelligence</target> is just as important as academic <target>intelligence</target> for achieving success in the professional world.","translation":"一些專家認為，在職業世界中，情商（情緒智力）與學業智力對於取得成功同樣重要。","explanation":"名詞「智力」。"},{"sentence":"The development of artificial <target>intelligence</target> has revolutionized the way we work and communicate, making many tasks more efficient.","translation":"人工智慧的發展徹底改變了我們工作和交流的方式，使許多任務變得更高效。","explanation":"名詞「智力」。常用搭配 artificial intelligence (AI)。"},{"sentence":"The government relies on secret <target>intelligence</target> to identify potential threats to national security and prevent possible attacks.","translation":"政府依賴秘密情報以識別對國家安全的潛在威脅並防止可能的攻擊。","explanation":"名詞「情報」。指收集到的資訊。"}],"related_forms":["intelligent","intellectual"]}

{"headword":"intend","explanation":"動詞「打算、意圖」。常用片語 intend to do something (打算做某事), be intended for (旨在於/專為...而設計)。","entries":[{"sentence":"I did not <target>intend</target> <pattern>to</pattern> hurt your feelings with my comment, but I realize now that I was being too blunt.","translation":"我並非打算用我的評論傷害你的感情，但我現在意識到我太過直率了。","explanation":"動詞「打算」。常用片語 intend to do something。"},{"sentence":"The new scholarship program is <target>intended</target> <pattern>for</pattern> students who have shown exceptional academic performance but lack financial support.","translation":"這項新獎學金計畫旨在提供給那些學業成績優異但缺乏財務支持的學生。","explanation":"動詞「意圖」。被動用法 be intended for 表示「專為...而設計」。"},{"sentence":"The students <target>intend</target> <pattern>to</pattern> organize a charity event to raise money for the local animal shelter next month.","translation":"學生們打算下個月舉辦一場慈善活動，為當地的動物收容所籌集資金。","explanation":"動詞「打算」。"}],"related_forms":["intention","intentional"]}

{"headword":"intense","explanation":"形容詞「強烈的、劇烈的」。常用於描述感覺、光線、壓力或努力。常用搭配 intense pressure (強大壓力), intense competition (激烈競爭)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Students often face <target>intense</target> <pattern>pressure</pattern> from their parents to get into a top university, which can lead to stress and anxiety.","translation":"學生經常面臨來自父母的強大壓力，要求他們進入頂尖大學，這可能導致壓力與焦慮。","explanation":"形容詞「強烈的」。常用搭配 intense pressure。"},{"sentence":"The athletes underwent <target>intense</target> <pattern>training</pattern> for several months to prepare for the Olympic Games and improve their performance.","translation":"運動員們經歷了數個月的強烈訓練，以準備奧運會並提升表現。","explanation":"形容詞「強烈的」。常用搭配 intense training。"},{"sentence":"The summer sun produced an <target>intense</target> <pattern>heat</pattern> that made it impossible for the hikers to walk comfortably during the afternoon.","translation":"夏季的陽光產生了強烈的熱氣，使登山客在下午無法舒適地行走。","explanation":"形容詞「強烈的」。常用搭配 intense heat。"}],"related_forms":["intensity","intensify","intensively"]}

{"headword":"intensity","explanation":"名詞「強度、劇烈程度」。指某事物的強烈程度，常用於描述光線、聲音、情感或顏色。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>intensity</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the sunlight was so strong that the researchers had to wear special sunglasses to protect their eyes.","translation":"陽光的強度如此之強，以至於研究人員必須佩戴特殊的太陽眼鏡以保護眼睛。","explanation":"名詞「強度」。常用片語 the intensity of sth。"},{"sentence":"As the argument grew more heated, the <target>intensity</target> <pattern>of</pattern> their voices increased, making the rest of the room feel uncomfortable.","translation":"隨著爭論變得更加激烈，他們聲音的強度增加了，使房間內其他人感到不舒服。","explanation":"名詞「強度」。"}],"related_forms":["intense","intensify"]}

{"headword":"intensive","explanation":"形容詞「強化的、集中的」。常用於描述課程或訓練，指在短時間內投入大量精力或資源。常用搭配 intensive course (強化課程), intensive care unit (加護病房/ICU)。","entries":[{"sentence":"To prepare for the exam, many students enroll in an <target>intensive</target> <pattern>course</pattern> during the summer break to catch up on their studies.","translation":"為了準備考試，而許多學生在暑假期間參加強化課程，以趕上進度。","explanation":"形容詞「強化的」。常用搭配 intensive course。"},{"sentence":"The patient was moved to the <target>intensive</target> <pattern>care unit</pattern> after the accident to receive the most constant monitoring and support.","translation":"病人被移至加護病房後，以接受最持續的監控與支持。","explanation":"形容詞「集中的」。常用搭配 intensive care unit (ICU)。"},{"sentence":"The company adopted a labor <target>intensive</target> <pattern>approach</pattern> to farming, requiring a large number of workers to harvest the crops by hand.","translation":"這家公司採取了勞動力密集型的耕作方式，需要大量工人用手採集作物。","explanation":"形容詞「集中的/密集型的」。常用搭配 labor intensive。"}],"related_forms":["intensify","intensity","intense"]}

{"headword":"intention","explanation":"名詞「意圖、目的」。常用搭配 include the intention to (包含...的意圖), have no intention of (沒有...的意圖)。注意與 intent (更正式) 及 purpose (目的) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although he apologized for the mistake, the teacher suspected that his <target>intention</target> was not to be helpful but to deceive others.","translation":"雖然他為錯誤道歉，但老師懷疑他的意圖並非提供幫助，而是欺騙他人。","explanation":"名詞「意圖」。指一個人打算做某事的計畫或目的。"},{"sentence":"I have no <target>intention</target> <pattern>of</pattern> quitting my current job until I find a more suitable position that fits my long-term goals.","translation":"在找到一個更符合我長期目標的合適職位之前，我沒有打算辭去目前的工作。","explanation":"名詞「意圖」。常用片語 have no intention of V-ing 表示「沒有意圖做某事」。"},{"sentence":"The government's <target>intention</target> <pattern>to</pattern> reduce carbon emissions is clear, but the specific plan to achieve this goal remains vague.","translation":"政府減少碳排放的意圖很明確，但達成此目標的具體計畫仍模糊不清。","explanation":"名詞「意圖」。常用搭配 intention to V 表示「打算做某事」。"}],"related_forms":["intentional","intentionally"]}

{"headword":"interact","explanation":"動詞「互動、交流」。常用搭配 interact with (與...互動)。指透過溝通或行動相互影響。","entries":[{"sentence":"Students are encouraged to <target>interact</target> <pattern>with</pattern> their classmates during the group discussion to develop their social skills and critical thinking.","translation":"在小組討論期間，學生被鼓勵與其同學互動，以培養他們的社交技巧和批判性思考。","explanation":"動詞「互動」。常用搭配 interact with sb。"},{"sentence":"Modern technology allows us to <target>interact</target> <pattern>with</pattern> people from all over the world through social media and online platforms.","translation":"現代科技讓我們能透過社群媒體和線上平台與世界各地的人互動。","explanation":"動詞「互動」。指透過數位媒介進行的交流。"}],"related_forms":["interaction","interactive","interactively"]}

{"headword":"interaction","explanation":"名詞「互動、相互作用」。常用搭配 interaction between... and... ( ...與...之間的互動)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The constant <target>interaction</target> <pattern>between</pattern> students <pattern>and</pattern> teachers is essential for creating a supportive and engaging learning environment in the classroom.","translation":"學生與老師之間持續的互動對於在教室中營造一個支持且吸引人的學習環境至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「互動」。指兩人或多者之間的溝通交流。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are studying the complex <target>interaction</target> <pattern>between</pattern> different chemical substances to understand how they affect the human body.","translation":"科學家正在研究不同化學物質之間複雜的相互作用，以了解它們如何影響人體。","explanation":"名詞「相互作用」。指物質或現象之間的相互影響。"}],"related_forms":["interact","interactive"]}

{"headword":"interfere","explanation":"動詞「干涉、干擾」。常用搭配 interfere with (干擾/影響), interfere in (干涉/介入)。注意 with 側重於對進度或過程的影響，in 側重於介入他人事務。","entries":[{"sentence":"The loud noise from the construction site next door began to <target>interfere</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the students' ability to concentrate on their exam.","translation":"隔壁建築工地的巨大噪音開始干擾學生們專注於考試的能力。","explanation":"動詞片語 interfere with sth 表示「干擾某事」，使某事難以進行。"},{"sentence":"My parents always told me that I should not <target>interfere</target> <pattern>in</pattern> other people's private lives unless I was asked for help.","translation":"我的父母總是告訴我，除非被要求幫助，否則我不應該干涉他人的私生活。","explanation":"動詞片語 interfere in sth 表示「干涉某事」，指介入他人事務。"}],"related_forms":["interference"]}

{"headword":"intermediate","explanation":"形容詞「中級的、中間的」；名詞「中級者」；動詞「調停」。在 GSAT 中最常用作形容詞，指程度或位置在中間。","entries":[{"sentence":"Since she has already mastered the basics, she decided to enroll in an <target>intermediate</target> English course to further improve her speaking skills.","translation":"由於她已經掌握了基礎，她決定報名參加中級英語課程以進一步提高她的口說能力。","explanation":"形容詞「中級的」。指程度在基礎之後，高級之前。"},{"sentence":"The <target>intermediate</target> stage of the experiment is the most critical, as researchers must carefully monitor the data before moving to the final phase.","translation":"實驗的中間階段是最關鍵的，因為研究人員在進入最終階段前必須仔細監控數據。","explanation":"形容詞「中間的」。指時間或過程中的中間位置。"},{"sentence":"He is an <target>intermediate</target> piano player who can play some complex pieces but still needs more practice to reach a professional level.","translation":"他是個中級鋼琴演奏者，能演奏一些複雜的曲目，但仍需更多練習才能達到專業水準。","explanation":"名詞「中級者」。指技能程度處於中級的人。"}],"related_forms":["intermediary"]}

{"headword":"interpret","explanation":"動詞「口譯、解釋、理解」。注意 interpret as (將...理解為)。區分 interpret (口譯) 與 translate (筆譯/口譯通用)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The diplomat hired a professional to <target>interpret</target> the foreign leader's speech <pattern>for</pattern> the local officials during the international summit.","translation":"外交官在國際峰會期間聘請了一位專業人士為當地官員口譯外國領導人的演講。","explanation":"動詞「口譯」。指將一種語言口頭地轉化為另一種語言。"},{"sentence":"Many people <target>interpret</target> the poet's use of darkness as a symbol of loneliness and despair, though the author's true meaning may differ.","translation":"許多人將詩人對黑暗的使用理解為孤獨和絕望的象徵，儘管作者的真實意圖可能不同。","explanation":"動詞「解釋、理解」。指對某種意義的分析或解讀。"},{"sentence":"It is easy to <target>interpret</target> his silence <pattern>as</pattern> a sign of agreement, but in reality, he was just too tired to speak.","translation":"很容易將他的沉默理解為同意的跡象，但實際上他只是太累了而無法說話。","explanation":"動詞片語 interpret sth as sth 表示「將...理解為...」。"}],"related_forms":["interpretation","interpreter"]}

{"headword":"interruption","explanation":"名詞「中斷、打斷」。常用搭配 cause an interruption (造成中斷), without interruption (毫無中斷地)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The online lecture was plagued by constant <target>interruptions</target> due to a poor internet connection, making it difficult for students to follow the lesson.","translation":"由於網路連接不良，線上講座一直被中斷，導致學生很難跟上課程。","explanation":"名詞「中斷」。指原本進行中的活動被突然停止。"},{"sentence":"Please wait until I finish my sentence before asking questions, as frequent <target>interruptions</target> break the flow of the presentation.","translation":"請在我說完句子之前等待再提問，因為頻繁的打斷會破壞簡報的流暢度。","explanation":"名詞「打斷」。指在他人說話或工作時介入。"}],"related_forms":["interrupt"]}

{"headword":"intimate","explanation":"形容詞「親密的、私人的」；名詞「親密的朋友」。注意其形容詞發音與動詞不同，且常用於描述關係或環境。","entries":[{"sentence":"After spending years studying together in the same library, the two students developed an <target>intimate</target> friendship based on mutual trust.","translation":"在同一間圖書館一起學習多年後，這兩名學生建立了基於互信的親密友誼。","explanation":"形容詞「親密的」。指關係非常接近。"},{"sentence":"The restaurant provided an <target>intimate</target> atmosphere with soft lighting and quiet music, making it a perfect place for a romantic dinner.","translation":"這家餐廳提供親密的氛圍，有柔和的燈光和安靜的音樂，使其成為浪漫晚餐的完美地點。","explanation":"形容詞「親密的」。此處指環境舒適、私密且溫馨。"},{"sentence":"She shared her most <target>intimate</target> secrets with her sister, knowing that her trust would never be betrayed.","translation":"她與姐姐分享了她最私密的秘密，知道她的信任永遠不會被背叛。","explanation":"形容詞「私人的、私密的」。指極其個人且不對外公開的事物。"}],"related_forms":["intimately","intimacy"]}

{"headword":"intuition","explanation":"名詞「直覺」。常用搭配 follow one's intuition (聽從直覺), trust one's intuition (相信直覺)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Even though the evidence was not yet clear, the detective followed his <target>intuition</target> and searched the basement, where he eventually found the stolen jewelry.","translation":"儘管證據尚不明顯，偵探仍聽從直覺搜尋地下室，最終在那裡找到了被盜的珠寶。","explanation":"名詞「直覺」。指不需經過邏輯推論而直接感知到的能力。"},{"sentence":"Experienced doctors often rely on their <target>intuition</target> to make quick decisions in emergency situations when there is no time for detailed analysis.","translation":"經驗豐富的醫生在沒有時間進行詳細分析的緊急情況下，通常依賴直覺來做出快速決定。","explanation":"名詞「直覺」。指基於經驗而產生的快速判斷。"}],"related_forms":["intuitive","intuitively"]}

{"headword":"invade","explanation":"動詞「入侵、侵犯」。可用於軍事入侵、生物侵入或侵犯隱私。常用搭配 invade the privacy of (侵犯...的隱私)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The army decided to <target>invade</target> the neighboring country to seize its rich oil reserves and expand its territorial boundaries.","translation":"軍隊決定入侵鄰國以奪取其豐富的石油儲備並擴大其領土邊界。","explanation":"動詞「入侵」。指軍隊進入他國領土。"},{"sentence":"Many people believe that the use of surveillance cameras in private homes may <target>invade</target> the <pattern>privacy of</pattern> residents.","translation":"許多人認為在私人住宅中使用監視攝影機可能會侵犯居民的隱私。","explanation":"動詞片語 invade the privacy of sb 表示「侵犯某人的隱私」。"},{"sentence":"In some ecosystems, non-native species can <target>invade</target> the local environment and push native plants and animals toward extinction.","translation":"在某些生態系統中，外來物種可能會入侵當地環境，並將原生植物和動物推向滅絕。","explanation":"動詞「入侵」。指生物進入非原生地而造成影響。"}],"related_forms":["invasion","invasive"]}

{"headword":"invasion","explanation":"名詞「入侵」。可指軍事上的入侵，也可指生物物種的侵入或對個人隱私的侵犯。常用搭配：invasion of privacy (侵犯隱私)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The sudden <target>invasion</target> of the neighboring country caused a global crisis, leading to widespread diplomatic tensions and economic instability.","translation":"鄰國的突然入侵引起了全球危機，導致廣泛的外交緊張和經濟不穩定。","explanation":"名詞「入侵」。指軍隊進入他國領土。"},{"sentence":"Many people feel that installing security cameras in public parks is a serious <target>invasion</target> <pattern>of</pattern> <pattern>privacy</pattern> for citizens.","translation":"許多人認為在公共公園安裝監視攝影機是對公民隱私的嚴重侵犯。","explanation":"名詞「侵犯」。片語 invasion of privacy 指對個人隱私的侵犯。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are concerned about the <target>invasion</target> of non-native plants, which can destroy the local ecosystem by competing with native species.","translation":"科學家們擔心外來植物的入侵，因為它們會透過與本土物種競爭而破壞當地的生態系統。","explanation":"名詞「入侵」。指外來物種侵入某個環境。"}],"related_forms":["invade"]}

{"headword":"invention","explanation":"名詞「發明」。指創造出之前不存在的新裝置或過程。常用搭配：the invention of (...的發明)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>invention</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the internet has completely changed the way people communicate and access information across the world.","translation":"網路的發明完全改變了人們在全球範圍內溝通和獲取資訊的方式。","explanation":"名詞「發明」。指創造出新科技或系統。"},{"sentence":"Thomas Edison is famous for his many <target>inventions</target>, including the light bulb, which brought light to millions of homes.","translation":"湯瑪斯·愛迪生因其許多發明而聞名，包括電燈，它為數百萬個家庭帶來了光明。","explanation":"名詞「發明」。指具體的發明裝置。"},{"sentence":"The student's clever <target>invention</target> for sorting recycling helped the school reduce waste more efficiently during the annual green fair.","translation":"這位學生設計的聰明回收分類發明，幫助學校在年度綠色展覽期間更有效地減少廢棄物。","explanation":"名詞「發明」。指新創造的工具或方法。"}],"related_forms":["invent"]}

{"headword":"invest","explanation":"動詞「投資」；名詞 investment「投資/投資額」。動詞常用搭配：invest money/time in (投資金錢/時間於...)。名詞常用搭配：make an investment (進行投資)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many young professionals choose to <target>invest</target> their savings <pattern>in</pattern> the stock market to build wealth for their future retirement.","translation":"許多年輕專業人士選擇將積蓄投資於股市，以為未來的退休生活累積財富。","explanation":"動詞「投資」。指投入金錢以獲利。"},{"sentence":"Parents who <target>invest</target> more time <pattern>in</pattern> their children's education often see better academic results and emotional growth in their kids.","translation":"在孩子教育上投入更多時間的父母，通常會看到孩子在學業成績和情感成長上有更好的表現。","explanation":"動詞「投資/投入」。此處指投入時間與精力。"},{"sentence":"Buying a high-quality laptop is a smart <target>investment</target> for a college student who needs a reliable tool for research and writing.","translation":"對於需要可靠工具進行研究和寫作的大學生來說，購買一台高品質的筆記型電腦是一項聰明的投資。","explanation":"名詞「投資」。指為了長期利益而投入的資源。"},{"sentence":"The government decided to <pattern>make</pattern> a heavy <target>investment</target> <pattern>in</pattern> renewable energy to reduce the country's dependence on fossil fuels.","translation":"政府決定對再生能源進行大量投資，以減少國家對化石燃料的依賴。","explanation":"名詞「投資」。片語 make an investment in...。"}],"related_forms":["investment","investor"]}

{"headword":"investigation","explanation":"名詞「調查」。指對某事進行系統性的研究或檢查以發現真相。常用搭配：conduct an investigation (進行調查), under investigation (在調查中)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police are <pattern>conducting</pattern> a thorough <target>investigation</target> into the cause of the fire to determine if it was an accident.","translation":"警方正在對起火原因進行徹底調查，以確定這是否是一場意外。","explanation":"名詞「調查」。片語 conduct an investigation into...。"},{"sentence":"After the company's financial records were leaked, the manager was put <pattern>under</pattern> <target>investigation</target> for suspected fraud.","translation":"在公司財務記錄外洩後，經理因涉嫌欺詐而被調查。","explanation":"名詞「調查」。片語 under investigation 表示「在調查中」。"},{"sentence":"The scientific <target>investigation</target> of the new planet revealed that it might have water, which could potentially support alien life.","translation":"對這顆新行星的科學調查顯示，它可能擁有水，這潛在可能支持外星生命的存在。","explanation":"名詞「調查/研究」。指系統性的科學研究。"}],"related_forms":["investigate","investigator"]}

{"headword":"involve","explanation":"動詞「涉及、包含、使參與」；名詞 involvement「參與」。動詞常用搭配：be involved in (參與/與...有關)。名詞常用搭配：direct involvement (直接參與)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new chemistry project will <target>involve</target> conducting several experiments to test how different temperatures affect chemical reactions.","translation":"這個新的化學計畫將涉及進行多次實驗，以測試不同溫度如何影響化學反應。","explanation":"動詞「涉及/包含」。指某活動必然包含的內容。"},{"sentence":"Many students were <target>involved</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the school play, taking on roles as actors, costume designers, or stage managers.","translation":"許多學生參與了學校的舞台劇，擔任演員、服裝設計師或舞台監督等角色。","explanation":"動詞「參與」。片語 be involved in...。"},{"sentence":"The police believe that the suspect was <target>involved</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the robbery because his fingerprints were found at the crime scene.","translation":"警方認為嫌疑人與搶劫案有關，因為在犯罪現場發現了他的指紋。","explanation":"動詞「與...有關」。指與某事有聯繫。"},{"sentence":"The teacher praised the student's active <target>involvement</target> <pattern>in</pattern> class discussions, noting that his questions often sparked deeper thinking.","translation":"老師稱讚該學生在課堂討論中的積極參與，並指出他的提問經常激發更深層的思考。","explanation":"名詞「參與」。指參與某活動的行為或程度。"}],"related_forms":["involvement"]}

{"headword":"isolate","explanation":"動詞「隔離、使孤立」。常用於醫療（隔離病人）、社會（使某人孤立）或科學（分離出特定物質）。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the flu outbreak, the hospital had to <target>isolate</target> the sick patients in separate rooms to prevent the virus from spreading.","translation":"在流感爆發期間，醫院必須將病患隔離在獨立的房間中，以防止病毒傳播。","explanation":"動詞「隔離」。指將病患與他人分開以防止傳染。"},{"sentence":"The boy felt <target>isolated</target> from his classmates after moving to a new city, as he struggled to make new friends.","translation":"在搬到新城市後，這個男孩覺得自己與同學之間很孤立，因為他很努力地想交新朋友。","explanation":"動詞「使孤立」。此處為被動態，指在社交上感到孤單或被排擠。"},{"sentence":"Chemists worked for months to <target>isolate</target> the active ingredient from the plant, hoping to develop a new medicine for pain.","translation":"化學家們工作了數月，試圖從植物中分離出活性成分，希望研發出一種新的止痛藥。","explanation":"動詞「分離」。指從混合物中提取出單一物質。"}],"related_forms":["isolation","isolated"]}

{"headword":"isolation","explanation":"名詞「隔離、孤立」。指處於單獨狀態或與他人/外界分開的情況。常用搭配：in isolation (孤立地/單獨地)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Long periods of <target>isolation</target> can have a negative impact on a person's mental health, leading to feelings of loneliness and depression.","translation":"長期的隔離可能會對一個人的心理健康產生負面影響，導致孤獨感和憂鬱。","explanation":"名詞「隔離/孤立」。指處於單獨狀態。"},{"sentence":"The rare bird lives in complete <target>isolation</target> on a remote island, far away from any human contact or other species.","translation":"這種稀有鳥類生活在一個遙遠島嶼的完全孤立狀態中，遠離任何人類接觸或其他物種。","explanation":"名詞「孤立」。指地理上的隔絕。"},{"sentence":"You cannot understand this grammar rule <pattern>in</pattern> <target>isolation</target>; you must look at how it is used in a full sentence.","translation":"你不能孤立地理解這個文法規則；你必須觀察它在完整句子中是如何被使用的。","explanation":"名詞「孤立」。片語 in isolation 指單獨地、不考慮周圍環境地。"}],"related_forms":["isolate","isolated"]}

{"headword":"issue","explanation":"名詞「議題、問題；發行號」；動詞「發行、發出」。名詞時，issue 與 problem 的區別在於：problem 通常指需要解決的困難，而 issue 則指引起討論或爭議的公共話題或議題。","entries":[{"sentence":"Climate change is one of the most urgent <target>issues</target> facing the world today, requiring immediate cooperation between all nations.","translation":"氣候變遷是當今世界面臨最緊迫的議題之一，需要所有國家立即合作。","explanation":"名詞「議題」。指引起大眾關注的公共問題。"},{"sentence":"The student had a personal <target>issue</target> with his teammate, but they eventually resolved it through an honest conversation.","translation":"這名學生與他的隊友之間有一個私人問題，但他們最終透過誠實的對話解決了它。","explanation":"名詞「問題」。指個人之間的爭端或困擾。"},{"sentence":"The library just received the latest <target>issue</target> of the science magazine, which features a special report on space exploration.","translation":"圖書館剛收到最新一期的科學雜誌，其中有一篇關於太空探索的特別報導。","explanation":"名詞「期號/發行號」。指期刊或雜誌的某一期。"},{"sentence":"The school decided to <target>issue</target> a formal warning to the students who were caught cheating on the final exam.","translation":"學校決定對那些在期末考被抓到作弊的學生發出正式警告。","explanation":"動詞「發出」。指正式地發布通知或警告。"},{"sentence":"The government will <target>issue</target> new passports to citizens who have lost theirs during the recent natural disaster.","translation":"政府將為在近期自然災害中遺失護照的公民發行新護照。","explanation":"動詞「發行」。指正式提供官方文件。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"jealousy","explanation":"名詞「嫉妒」。指因他人擁有自己渴望之物而產生的不快感。常用搭配：feel jealousy (感到嫉妒), out of jealousy (出於嫉妒)。","entries":[{"sentence":"His success in the competition sparked <target>jealousy</target> among his peers, some of whom began to speak ill of him.","translation":"他在比賽中的成功引起了同儕的嫉妒，其中一些人開始說他的壞話。","explanation":"名詞「嫉妒」。指對他人成就的不滿。"},{"sentence":"The two brothers often fought <pattern>out</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> <target>jealousy</target>, as each wanted their parents' undivided attention and love.","translation":"這兩兄弟經常出於嫉妒而爭吵，因為每個人都想要父母全部的關注與愛。","explanation":"名詞「嫉妒」。片語 out of jealousy 表示「出於嫉妒」。"},{"sentence":"She tried to hide her <target>jealousy</target> when her best friend won the scholarship, but her sad expression gave her away.","translation":"當她最好的朋友贏得獎學金時，她試圖掩飾自己的嫉妒，但她悲傷的表情出賣了她。","explanation":"名詞「嫉妒」。指內心的負面情緒。"}],"related_forms":["jealous"]}

{"headword":"keen","explanation":"形容詞「熱衷的、渴望的；敏銳的」。常用搭配：be keen on (熱衷於), a keen interest (濃厚的興趣), a keen eye/sense (敏銳的眼光/感覺)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student is very <target>keen</target> <pattern>on</pattern> learning Japanese because she wants to visit Tokyo during the next summer break.","translation":"這名學生非常熱衷於學習日文，因為她想在下個暑假訪問東京。","explanation":"形容詞「熱衷的」。片語 be keen on...。"},{"sentence":"He has a <target>keen</target> <pattern>interest</pattern> in ancient history and spends most of his weekends reading books about the Roman Empire.","translation":"他對古代歷史有濃厚的興趣，週末大部分時間都花在閱讀關於羅馬帝國的書上。","explanation":"形容詞「濃厚的」。常用搭配 keen interest。"},{"sentence":"The detective has a <target>keen</target> <pattern>eye</pattern> for detail, allowing him to find small clues that others often overlook.","translation":"這位偵探對細節有敏銳的眼光，使他能發現其他人經常忽略的小線索。","explanation":"形容詞「敏銳的」。常用搭配 keen eye for detail。"},{"sentence":"Dogs have a <target>keen</target> <pattern>sense</pattern> of smell, which helps them track scents and find missing people in the woods.","translation":"狗有敏銳的嗅覺，這能幫助牠們追蹤氣味並在森林中尋找失蹤的人。","explanation":"形容詞「敏銳的」。常用搭配 keen sense of smell。"}],"related_forms":["keenly","keenness"]}

{"headword":"kettle","explanation":"名詞，意為「水壺」。常用於描述煮水或準備熱飲的場景，注意與 pot (鍋) 的區別，kettle 專指用於加熱水的容器。","entries":[{"sentence":"She filled the <target>kettle</target> with water and placed it on the stove, preparing to make some hot tea for her guests.","translation":"她往水壺裡裝滿水並把它放在爐子上，準備為客人泡一些熱茶。","explanation":"名詞「水壺」。"},{"sentence":"The electric <target>kettle</target> is a convenient appliance in the dormitory, allowing students to boil water quickly for instant noodles.","translation":"電水壺是宿舍裡方便的電器，讓學生能快速燒水來泡泡麵。","explanation":"名詞「水壺」。常用搭配：electric kettle (電水壺)。"}],"related_forms":["kettles"]}

{"headword":"kneel","explanation":"動詞，意為「跪下」。常用於表達尊重、祈禱或在低處尋找物品。注意其不規則過去式 kneelled 或 knelt。","entries":[{"sentence":"The knight decided to <target>kneel</target> <pattern>before</pattern> the king to show his loyalty and accept the honor bestowed upon him.","translation":"騎士決定在國王面前跪下，以表示他的忠誠並接受授予他的榮譽。","explanation":"動詞「跪下」。常用搭配：kneel before someone。"},{"sentence":"The gardener had to <target>kneel</target> on the grass to plant the small flowers carefully without damaging their roots.","translation":"花匠不得不跪在草地上，以便小心地種植小花而不會損壞它們的根。","explanation":"動詞「跪下」。常用搭配：kneel on something。"}],"related_forms":["knelt","kneeling"]}

{"headword":"knob","explanation":"名詞，意為「旋鈕」或「把手」。常用於描述門把手或電器上的調節鈕。","entries":[{"sentence":"He gripped the door <target>knob</target> firmly and turned it slowly, hoping that the room was not locked from the inside.","translation":"他緊緊握住門把手並慢慢轉動，希望房間沒有從內部鎖住。","explanation":"名詞「把手」。常用搭配：door knob (門把手)。"},{"sentence":"To adjust the volume of the old radio, you simply need to turn the plastic <target>knob</target> clockwise until the sound is right.","translation":"要調整舊收音機的音量，你只需要順時針轉動塑料旋鈕，直到聲音正確為止。","explanation":"名詞「旋鈕」。"}],"related_forms":["knobs"]}

{"headword":"labor","explanation":"名詞指「勞動、工作」或「分娩」；動詞指「辛苦工作」。注意其英美拼法差異：labor (美) / labour (英)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The construction of the new bridge required a vast amount of manual <target>labor</target> and several years of continuous hard work.","translation":"新橋的建設需要大量的體力勞動以及數年持續的努力工作。","explanation":"名詞「勞動」。常用搭配：manual labor (體力勞動)。"},{"sentence":"After hours of intense <target>labor</target>, the mother finally gave birth to a healthy baby boy in the hospital.","translation":"經過數小時的劇烈分娩，這位母親終於在醫院生下了一個健康的男孩。","explanation":"名詞「分娩」。"},{"sentence":"The exhausted athlete <target>labored</target> <pattern>up</pattern> the steep hill, struggling to breathe as he approached the final finish line.","translation":"疲憊的運動員艱難地爬上陡峭的山丘，在接近終點線時呼吸困難。","explanation":"動詞「艱難地前進/工作」。"},{"sentence":"The government implemented new laws to protect <target>labor</target> <pattern>rights</pattern>, ensuring fair wages and safe working conditions for all employees.","translation":"政府實施了新法律以保護勞工權益，確保所有員工獲得公平的工資和安全的工作環境。","explanation":"名詞「勞工」。常用搭配：labor rights (勞工權益)。"}],"related_forms":["laborer","laborious"]}

{"headword":"laboratory","explanation":"名詞，意為「實驗室」。常用縮寫為 lab。在學術或醫療語境中極為常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"The chemistry students spent the entire afternoon in the <target>laboratory</target>, conducting experiments to test the properties of different chemicals.","translation":"化學系學生整個下午都在實驗室裡，進行實驗以測試不同化學物質的性質。","explanation":"名詞「實驗室」。"},{"sentence":"The blood samples were sent to the <target>lab</target> for further analysis, and the results were expected to be released tomorrow.","translation":"血樣被送往實驗室進行進一步分析，預計結果將於明天公布。","explanation":"名詞「實驗室」的縮寫 lab。"},{"sentence":"The university invested in a state-of-the-art <target>laboratory</target> to provide researchers with the latest equipment and a controlled environment.","translation":"大學投資建立了一個最先進的實驗室，為研究人員提供最新的設備和受控的環境。","explanation":"名詞「實驗室」。常用搭配：state-of-the-art laboratory (最先進的實驗室)。"}],"related_forms":["labs"]}

{"headword":"lag","explanation":"名詞指「延遲、落後」；動詞指「落後」或「延遲」。在現代科技語境中，常用於描述網路延遲（lagging）。","entries":[{"sentence":"Because of the poor internet connection, there was a noticeable <target>lag</target> between the speaker's voice and the video during the online meeting.","translation":"由於網路連接不良，在線上會議期間，講者的聲音和影片之間有明顯的延遲。","explanation":"名詞「延遲」。"},{"sentence":"The student began to <target>lag</target> <pattern>behind</pattern> in his history class because he missed several important lectures during the flu season.","translation":"這名學生在他的歷史課上開始落後，因為他在流感季節錯過了幾次重要的講座。","explanation":"動詞片語 lag behind (落後)。"},{"sentence":"Older computers often <target>lag</target> when running heavy software, making it difficult for designers to complete their work efficiently.","translation":"舊電腦在執行大型軟體時經常會延遲，這使得設計師很難高效地完成工作。","explanation":"動詞「延遲、卡頓」。"}],"related_forms":["lagging"]}

{"headword":"landmark","explanation":"名詞，意為「地標」或「里程碑」。前者指物理上的顯著建築，後者指歷史或發展上的重大事件。","entries":[{"sentence":"The Taipei 101 building is a famous <target>landmark</target> in the city, making it easy for tourists to find their way.","translation":"台北101大樓是這座城市著名的地標，讓遊客很容易找到方向。","explanation":"名詞「地標」。"},{"sentence":"The signing of the peace treaty was a <target>landmark</target> <pattern>event</pattern> in history, marking the end of a long and bloody war.","translation":"簽署和平條約是歷史上的一個里程碑事件，標誌著一場漫長且血腥戰爭的結束。","explanation":"名詞「里程碑」。常用搭配：landmark event (里程碑事件)。"},{"sentence":"The court's decision was a <target>landmark</target> <pattern>ruling</pattern> that changed how privacy laws are interpreted in the modern digital age.","translation":"法院的決定是一項里程碑式的裁決，改變了現代數位時代對隱私法的解釋方式。","explanation":"名詞「里程碑」。常用搭配：landmark ruling (里程碑式的裁決)。"}],"related_forms":["landmarks"]}

{"headword":"landscape","explanation":"名詞指「風景、景觀」；動詞指「美化景觀」。注意其在藝術或描述地理環境時的用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"The artist spent several weeks painting the breathtaking <target>landscape</target> of the Swiss Alps, capturing the beauty of the snow-capped mountains.","translation":"藝術家花了好幾週時間繪製瑞士阿爾卑斯山的壯麗風景，捕捉雪山的 beauty。","explanation":"名詞「風景」。"},{"sentence":"The city council decided to <target>landscape</target> the area around the park to make it more attractive to local residents and visitors.","translation":"市議會決定美化公園周邊的景觀，使其對當地居民和遊客更有吸引力。","explanation":"動詞「美化景觀」。"},{"sentence":"The digital <target>landscape</target> has changed significantly over the last decade, with social media becoming the primary source of news for many.","translation":"數位景觀在過去十年中發生了顯著變化，社交媒體已成為許多人新聞的主要來源。","explanation":"名詞「景觀（比喻用法）」。指整體環境或局勢。"}],"related_forms":["landscaping","landscaped"]}

{"headword":"largely","explanation":"副詞，意為「主要地、大部分地」。常用於描述某事的主要原因或組成部分，等同於 mainly 或 primarily。","entries":[{"sentence":"The success of the school project was <target>largely</target> <pattern>due to</pattern> the hard work and cooperation of all the team members.","translation":"學校項目的成功主要歸功於所有團隊成員的努力工作與合作。","explanation":"副詞「主要地」。常用搭配：largely due to (主要歸因於)。"},{"sentence":"Although some parts of the plan were modified, the final result remained <target>largely</target> <pattern>unchanged</pattern> from the original proposal.","translation":"儘管計劃的部分內容被修改了，但最終結果與最初的提案基本保持不變。","explanation":"副詞「主要地」。常用搭配：largely unchanged (基本不變)。"},{"sentence":"The new policy is <target>largely</target> <pattern>ignored</pattern> by the students, as they feel it does not address their actual needs in the classroom.","translation":"這項新政策在很大程度上被學生忽視了，因為他們覺得它沒有解決他們在教室裡的實際需求。","explanation":"副詞「主要地」。"}],"related_forms":["large"]}

{"headword":"launch","explanation":"動詞指「發射」或「啟動/推出」；名詞指「發射」或「發表會」。常用於航太、產品上市或計劃開始。","entries":[{"sentence":"The space agency is planning to <target>launch</target> a new satellite into orbit next month to improve global weather forecasting accuracy.","translation":"太空機構計劃下個月將一顆新衛星發射到軌道上，以提高全球天氣預報的準確性。","explanation":"動詞「發射」。"},{"sentence":"The technology company decided to <target>launch</target> a new smartphone model in autumn, hoping to attract more young customers worldwide.","translation":"科技公司決定在秋天推出一款新的智慧型手機，希望吸引全球更多年輕顧客。","explanation":"動詞「推出/啟動」。"},{"sentence":"Thousands of people attended the official <target>launch</target> <pattern>party</pattern> of the new art gallery, which showcased works by local artists.","translation":"數千人參加了新美術館的官方開幕派對，展出了當地藝術家的作品。","explanation":"名詞「發表會/啟動」。常用搭配：launch party (發表會)。"},{"sentence":"The government will <target>launch</target> an <pattern>investigation into</pattern> the cause of the accident to prevent similar tragedies from happening again.","translation":"政府將對事故原因展開調查，以防止類似的悲劇再次發生。","explanation":"動詞「展開（調查/計劃）」。常用搭配：launch an investigation into sth。"}],"related_forms":["launched","launching","launcher"]}

{"headword":"lawful","explanation":"形容詞「合法的」。指符合法律規定的。常與 illegal (非法的) 或 unlawful (違法的) 相對。注意 unlawful 較常用於描述被法律禁止的特定行為，而 lawful 側重於法律允許或認可的狀態。","entries":[{"sentence":"The lawyer advised his client that the company's actions were <target>lawful</target> under the current trade regulations of the country.","translation":"律師建議他的當事人，該公司的行為在該國目前的貿易法規下是合法的。","explanation":"形容詞「合法的」。指行為符合法律規定。"},{"sentence":"The police officer explained that they had a <target>lawful</target> <pattern>right</pattern> to search the vehicle after seeing the suspicious items inside.","translation":"警察解釋說，在看到車內可疑物品後，他們有合法的權利搜查該車輛。","explanation":"形容詞「合法的」。常用搭配：lawful right (合法權利)。"},{"sentence":"It is important for every citizen to ensure that their business operations are <target>lawful</target> to avoid facing heavy fines or lawsuits.","translation":"每位公民確保其業務運作合法以避免面臨巨額罰款或訴訟是非常重要的。","explanation":"形容詞「合法的」。"}],"related_forms":["lawfully","lawfulness"]}

{"headword":"lean","explanation":"動詞「傾斜、倚靠」；形容詞「瘦的、精實的」。動詞常用搭配 lean against (倚靠) 或 lean toward (傾向於)。形容詞 lean 常指健康的瘦，或指肉類中脂肪較少 (lean meat)。","entries":[{"sentence":"While waiting for the bus, the tired student decided to <target>lean</target> <pattern>against</pattern> the wall to take a short rest.","translation":"在等公車時，疲憊的學生決定倚靠在牆上稍作休息。","explanation":"動詞「倚靠」。常用搭配：lean against (倚靠在...上)。"},{"sentence":"Many people <target>lean</target> <pattern>toward</pattern> the opinion that technology has improved the quality of education, although some still disagree.","translation":"儘管有些人仍不認同，但許多人傾向於認為科技提高了教育品質。","explanation":"動詞「傾向於」。常用搭配：lean toward (傾向於某種觀點)。"},{"sentence":"The athlete's <target>lean</target> <pattern>physique</pattern> was the result of years of strict training and a healthy, balanced diet.","translation":"這位運動員精實的體格是多年嚴格訓練和健康均衡飲食的結果。","explanation":"形容詞「精實的、瘦的」。常用搭配：lean physique (精實的體格)。"},{"sentence":"For a healthier meal, the doctor suggested that he replace fatty pork with <target>lean</target> <pattern>meat</pattern> to reduce cholesterol levels.","translation":"為了更健康的飲食，醫生建議他用瘦肉代替肥豬肉，以降低膽固醇水平。","explanation":"形容詞「瘦的（肉類）」。常用搭配：lean meat (瘦肉)。"}],"related_forms":["leaned","leaning"]}

{"headword":"learned","explanation":"形容詞「博學的」。注意其發音為 /'lɜːrnɪd/ (兩個音節)，而非動詞 learn 的過去式 /lɜːrnd/。常用於描述對某領域有深厚知識的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The professor is known as a <target>learned</target> <pattern>scholar</pattern> who has published numerous books on ancient Greek history and philosophy.","translation":"這位教授被認為是一位博學的學者，他出版了許多關於古希臘歷史和哲學的書籍。","explanation":"形容詞「博學的」。常用搭配：learned scholar (博學的學者)。"},{"sentence":"During the conference, the guests were impressed by the <target>learned</target> <pattern>discussion</pattern> regarding the impact of climate change on biodiversity.","translation":"在會議期間，賓客們對關於氣候變遷對生物多樣性影響的博學討論印象深刻。","explanation":"形容詞「博學的」。指具有深厚知識的。"},{"sentence":"She spent years studying in various libraries to become a <target>learned</target> expert in the field of medieval literature.","translation":"她花了很多年時間在不同的圖書館學習，以成為中世紀文學領域的博學專家。","explanation":"形容詞「博學的」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"lecture","explanation":"名詞「講座、講義」或「訓斥」；動詞「講課」或「訓誡」。作為名詞時，常搭配 give a lecture (給予講座) 或 attend a lecture (參加講座)。作為動詞時，lecture someone on something 意為「就某事訓斥某人」。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many students decided to <pattern>attend</pattern> the guest <target>lecture</target> on artificial intelligence to learn about the latest trends in technology.","translation":"許多學生決定參加關於人工智慧的客座講座，以了解科技的最新趨勢。","explanation":"名詞「講座」。常用搭配：attend a lecture (參加講座)。"},{"sentence":"The professor will <target>lecture</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the causes of the French Revolution during next Tuesday's history class.","translation":"教授將在下週二的歷史課上講授法國大革命的原因。","explanation":"動詞「講課」。常用搭配：lecture on (就...講課)。"},{"sentence":"After he forgot to submit his assignment for the third time, his teacher <target>lectured</target> <pattern>him</pattern> <pattern>on</pattern> the importance of responsibility.","translation":"在他第三次忘記繳交作業後，老師訓誡他關於責任感的重要性。","explanation":"動詞「訓誡、訓斥」。常用搭配：lecture someone on something (就某事訓斥某人)。"},{"sentence":"The students spent the entire afternoon taking notes during the long <target>lecture</target>, hoping to capture all the key points for the exam.","translation":"學生們花整個下午在漫長的講座中做筆記，希望為考試捕捉所有關鍵點。","explanation":"名詞「講座」。"}],"related_forms":["lectures","lectured","lecturing"]}

{"headword":"lecturer","explanation":"名詞「講師、 lecturer」。通常指在大學或學院中授課的人。區別於 professor (教授)，lecturer 的職位通常較低或為兼任。","entries":[{"sentence":"The visiting <target>lecturer</target> from Oxford University gave an inspiring talk about the future of sustainable energy to the students.","translation":"來自牛津大學的客座講師給學生們做了一場關於永續能源未來的鼓舞人心演講。","explanation":"名詞「講師」。指在大學授課的人。"},{"sentence":"She worked as a part-time <target>lecturer</target> at the local college, teaching English literature to adult students in the evenings.","translation":"她在當地學院擔任兼任講師，在晚上教授成年學生英國文學。","explanation":"名詞「講師」。"},{"sentence":"The <target>lecturer</target> encouraged the students to ask questions and engage in discussions to deepen their understanding of the topic.","translation":"講師鼓勵學生提出問題並參與討論，以加深他們對該主題的理解。","explanation":"名詞「講師」。"}],"related_forms":["lecturers"]}

{"headword":"legend","explanation":"名詞「傳說」或「傳奇人物」。也可指地圖上的「圖例」。常考搭配：a living legend (活傳奇), according to legend (根據傳說)。","entries":[{"sentence":"According to <target>legend</target>, the hidden treasure is buried deep within the mountains and can only be found by a brave soul.","translation":"根據傳說，隱藏的寶藏埋在深山之中，只有勇敢的人才能找到。","explanation":"名詞「傳說」。常用片語：according to legend (根據傳說)。"},{"sentence":"Michael Jordan is considered a <target>legend</target> in the world of basketball because of his incredible skills and numerous championships.","translation":"由於其驚人的技巧和多次奪冠，麥可·喬丹被認為是籃球界的傳奇人物。","explanation":"名詞「傳奇人物」。指在某領域極其出名且成功的人。"},{"sentence":"Before reading the map, the hikers carefully checked the <target>legend</target> to understand what the different symbols and colors represented.","translation":"在閱讀地圖前，登山客仔細檢查了圖例，以了解不同的符號和顏色代表什麼。","explanation":"名詞「圖例」。指地圖上解釋符號的說明表。"}],"related_forms":["legends","legendary"]}

{"headword":"leisurely","explanation":"形容詞或副詞「悠閒的、從容地」。指不匆忙且放鬆的狀態。常考搭配：a leisurely stroll (悠閒的散步), at a leisurely pace (以悠閒的步調)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After finishing their final exams, the students took a <target>leisurely</target> <pattern>stroll</pattern> through the park to relax and clear their minds.","translation":"考完期末考後，學生們在公園裡悠閒地散步，以放鬆身心並清空思緒。","explanation":"形容詞「悠閒的」。常用搭配：leisurely stroll (悠閒地散步)。"},{"sentence":"The elderly couple walked <target>leisurely</target> along the beach, enjoying the sunset and talking about their memories from fifty years ago.","translation":"這對老夫婦悠閒地沿著海灘行走，享受著日落並聊起五十年前的回憶。","explanation":"副詞「悠閒地」。描述動作不匆忙。"},{"sentence":"They decided to explore the small village <pattern>at</pattern> a <target>leisurely</target> <pattern>pace</pattern>, stopping at every interesting shop they encountered.","translation":"他們決定以悠閒的步調探索這個小村莊，在遇到的每一家有趣商店前停下。","explanation":"形容詞「悠閒的」。常用搭配：at a leisurely pace (以悠閒的步調)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"lengthen","explanation":"動詞「延長、拉長」。指增加長度或時間。注意與 long (形容詞) 的區別，lengthen 是動詞。常用於描述衣服長度或日照時間。","entries":[{"sentence":"As spring approaches, the days begin to <target>lengthen</target>, providing more sunlight for people to enjoy outdoor activities in the evening.","translation":"隨著春天臨近，白天開始變長，讓人們在晚上有更多陽光可以享受戶外活動。","explanation":"動詞「延長」。指時間（日照）的增加。"},{"sentence":"The tailor suggested that she <target>lengthen</target> the hem of her skirt to make it more suitable for a formal occasion.","translation":"裁縫建議她把裙擺加長，使其更適合正式場合。","explanation":"動詞「拉長」。指物理長度的增加。"},{"sentence":"The teacher decided to <target>lengthen</target> the time limit for the essay assignment to give students more opportunity to refine their work.","translation":"老師決定延長論文作業的時間限制，以給學生更多機會完善他們的作品。","explanation":"動詞「延長」。指時間期限的增加。"}],"related_forms":["length","lengthy"]}

{"headword":"liar","explanation":"名詞「說謊者」。由動詞 lie (說謊) 演變而來。注意不要與 layer (層) 混淆。","entries":[{"sentence":"Everyone in the class knew that he was a <target>liar</target> because he often made up stories to impress his classmates.","translation":"班上每個人都知道他是個說謊者，因為他經常編造故事來給同學留下深刻印象。","explanation":"名詞「說謊者」。"},{"sentence":"Trust is the foundation of any friendship, and it is very difficult to forgive a <target>liar</tag> who has cheated you many times.","translation":"信任是任何友誼的基礎，而要原諒一個多次欺騙你的說謊者是非常困難的。","explanation":"名詞「說謊者」。"},{"sentence":"She called him a <target>liar</target> when she found the evidence that proved his claims about the accident were completely false.","translation":"當她發現證明他關於事故的說法完全是假的證據時，她稱他為說謊者。","explanation":"名詞「說謊者」。"}],"related_forms":["lie"]}

{"headword":"librarian","explanation":"名詞「圖書館管理員」。指負責管理圖書館書籍、協助讀者查找資料的人。常用搭配：consult a librarian (諮詢圖書館員)。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you cannot find the reference book you need for your research, you should <pattern>consult</pattern> the <target>librarian</target> for assistance.","translation":"如果你找不到研究需要的參考書，你應該諮詢圖書館管理員以尋求幫助。","explanation":"名詞「圖書館管理員」。常用搭配：consult a librarian (諮詢圖書館員)。"},{"sentence":"The school <target>librarian</target> organized a reading workshop to encourage students to discover the joy of reading diverse genres of books.","translation":"學校圖書館管理員舉辦了一場閱讀工作坊，以鼓勵學生發現閱讀不同類型書籍的樂趣。","explanation":"名詞「圖書館管理員」。"},{"sentence":"A professional <target>librarian</target> not only organizes books but also helps users navigate digital databases to find academic articles.","translation":"一名專業的圖書館管理員不僅整理書籍，還幫助使用者操作數位資料庫以尋找學術文章。","explanation":"名詞「圖書館管理員」。"}],"related_forms":["library"]}

{"headword":"license","explanation":"名詞「執照、許可證」；動詞「許可、授權」。名詞常用於指官方頒發的證件，如 driver's license (駕照)。動詞常用於指法律上的授權，如 license a software (授權軟體)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After passing both the written and practical tests, the teenager was finally able to obtain his driver's <target>license</target>, allowing him to drive legally.","translation":"在通過筆試和路考後，這名青少年終於拿到了駕照，使他能夠合法開車。","explanation":"名詞「執照」。常用搭配 driver's license。"},{"sentence":"The city council refused to grant a business <target>license</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the new restaurant because it failed to meet safety regulations.","translation":"市議會拒絕向這家新餐廳頒發營業執照，因為它不符合安全規定。","explanation":"名詞「許可證」。常用搭配 grant a license to someone。"},{"sentence":"The company <target>licensed</target> its patented technology <pattern>to</pattern> several other firms, enabling them to produce the product more efficiently.","translation":"該公司將其專利技術授權給其他幾家公司，使他們能更高效地生產該產品。","explanation":"動詞「授權」。常用搭配 license sth to someone。"}],"related_forms":["licensed","licensing"]}

{"headword":"lifeguard","explanation":"名詞「救生員」。指在海灘、泳池等場所負責監督安全並在緊急情況下救援的人員。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>lifeguard</target> kept a close eye on the swimmers to ensure their safety and prevent any potential accidents in the pool.","translation":"救生員密切注視著游泳者，以確保他們的安全並防止泳池中發生任何潛在事故。","explanation":"名詞「救生員」。"},{"sentence":"During the summer break, many college students apply for jobs as a <target>lifeguard</target> at local beaches to earn extra money.","translation":"在暑假期間，許多大學生申請在當地海灘擔任救生員的工作，以賺取額外收入。","explanation":"名詞「救生員」。"}],"related_forms":["lifeguards"]}

{"headword":"limitation","explanation":"名詞「限制、局限」。常用於指法律上的限制、能力的局限或資源的不足。常搭配 limit (動詞) 或 be subject to (受限於)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Every athlete has certain physical <target>limitations</target>, but with consistent training and hard work, they can often overcome these barriers.","translation":"每位運動員都有一定的身體局限，但透過持續的訓練和努力，他們通常能克服這些障礙。","explanation":"名詞「局限」。指能力或特性的限制。"},{"sentence":"The new law imposes a strict <target>limitation</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the amount of water that factories can use during the drought.","translation":"新法對工廠在乾旱期間可使用的水量設定了嚴格限制。","explanation":"名詞「限制」。常用搭配 limitation on sth。"},{"sentence":"Because of budget <target>limitations</target>, the school was unable to purchase the latest computers for the computer lab.","translation":"由於預算限制，學校無法為電腦教室購買最新的電腦。","explanation":"名詞「限制」。常用搭配 budget limitations (預算限制)。"}],"related_forms":["limit","limited"]}

{"headword":"linen","explanation":"名詞「亞麻布、亞麻製品」。常用於描述床單、桌布等家居用品。注意其材質特性，如 breathable (透氣的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"She preferred using <target>linen</target> sheets because they are more breathable and keep the bed cool during the hot summer nights.","translation":"她偏好使用亞麻床單，因為它們更透氣，且在炎熱的夏季夜晚能讓床鋪保持涼爽。","explanation":"名詞「亞麻布」。指材質。"},{"sentence":"The waiter carefully spread a clean, white <target>linen</target> tablecloth over the dining table before the formal dinner party began.","translation":"在正式晚餐會開始前，服務生小心地在餐桌上鋪了一塊乾淨的白色亞麻桌布。","explanation":"名詞「亞麻製品」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"lipstick","explanation":"名詞「口紅」。常見搭配包括 apply lipstick (塗口紅) 或 wear lipstick (擦口紅)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Before heading to the graduation ceremony, she spent a few minutes <pattern>applying</pattern> <target>lipstick</target> in front of the mirror to look more polished.","translation":"在前往畢業典禮前，她在鏡子前花了幾分鐘塗口紅，讓自己看起來更端莊。","explanation":"名詞「口紅」。常用搭配 apply lipstick。"},{"sentence":"The woman chose a bright red <target>lipstick</target> to match her elegant dress, making her stand out in the crowd.","translation":"這名女子選擇了亮紅色的口紅來搭配她的優雅禮服，使她在人群中脫穎而出。","explanation":"名詞「口紅」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"liquor","explanation":"名詞「烈酒」。指經過蒸餾的酒精飲料，如威士忌或伏特加。注意與 wine (葡萄酒) 或 beer (啤酒) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"In many countries, it is illegal to sell <target>liquor</target> to anyone under the age of twenty-one, regardless of their identity.","translation":"在許多國家，向二十一歲以下的人出售烈酒是非法的，無論其身分如何。","explanation":"名詞「烈酒」。"},{"sentence":"The luxury hotel offers a wide variety of expensive <target>liquors</target> at its bar, catering to guests with different tastes.","translation":"這家豪華酒店的酒吧提供多種昂貴的烈酒，以迎合不同口味的客人。","explanation":"名詞「烈酒」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"literary","explanation":"形容詞「文學的」。常用於描述與文學作品、寫作風格或文學批評相關的事物，如 literary works (文學作品) 或 literary talent (文學才華)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The professor encouraged the students to analyze the <target>literary</target> <pattern>devices</pattern> used by the author to create a sense of mystery in the novel.","translation":"教授鼓勵學生分析作者在小說中使用地文學技巧，以營造一種神秘感。","explanation":"形容詞「文學的」。常用搭配 literary devices (文學技巧)。"},{"sentence":"She possesses an incredible <target>literary</target> <pattern>talent</pattern>, writing poems and short stories that touch the hearts of many readers.","translation":"她擁有驚人的文學才華，寫出的詩歌和短篇故事觸動了許多讀者的心。","explanation":"形容詞「文學的」。常用搭配 literary talent (文學才華)。"},{"sentence":"The city hosts an annual <target>literary</target> <pattern>festival</pattern> where famous writers gather to discuss their books and share their experiences.","translation":"這座城市每年舉辦一次文學節，著名作家聚集在此討論他們的書並分享經驗。","explanation":"形容詞「文學的」。常用搭配 literary festival (文學節)。"}],"related_forms":["literature"]}

{"headword":"literature","explanation":"名詞「文學；文獻」。指書面作品，尤其是那些被認為具有藝術價值的作品。在學術語境中，literature 可指某個領域的相關文獻（如 review the literature (查閱文獻)）。","entries":[{"sentence":"In high school, students are often required to study classic <target>literature</target> to understand the human condition and historical contexts.","translation":"在高中，學生通常被要求學習經典文學，以理解人類處境和歷史背景。","explanation":"名詞「文學」。"},{"sentence":"Before starting his research project, the scientist spent weeks <pattern>reviewing</pattern> the <target>literature</target> to see what other researchers had already discovered.","translation":"在開始研究計畫前，這位科學家花了數週查閱文獻，以看看其他研究人員已經發現了什麼。","explanation":"名詞「文獻」。指學術領域的相關研究資料。常用搭配 review the literature。"},{"sentence":"The library contains a vast collection of English <target>literature</target>, including plays, poems, and novels from various centuries.","translation":"圖書館收藏了大量英語文學作品，包括來自不同世紀的劇本、詩歌和小說。","explanation":"名詞「文學」。"}],"related_forms":["literary"]}

{"headword":"loan","explanation":"名詞「貸款；借款」；動詞「借出」。注意 loan 與 borrow 的區別：loan 是指從某人或銀行處獲得資金（名詞）或將東西借給他人（動詞），而 borrow 是指從他人處借入東西（動詞）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student applied for a student <target>loan</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the bank to cover the high cost of tuition and living expenses in the city.","translation":"這名學生向銀行申請學生貸款，以支付城市中高昂的學費和生活費。","explanation":"名詞「貸款」。常用搭配 loan from the bank。"},{"sentence":"After years of hard work, he finally managed to <target>loan</target> some money <pattern>to</pattern> his friend who was struggling with business losses.","translation":"雖然經過多年努力，他終於能借錢給那位在生意上受挫的朋友。","explanation":"動詞「借出」。常用搭配 loan sth to someone。"},{"sentence":"The library allows students to <target>loan</target> up to five books <pattern>for</pattern> two weeks, provided they return them on time.","translation":"圖書館允許學生借出最多五本書，期限為兩週，前提是他們必須準時歸還。","explanation":"動詞「借出」。在某些地區，loan 作為動詞時與 lend 同義。"}],"related_forms":["loans"]}

{"headword":"lobster","explanation":"名詞「龍蝦」。單複數同形或 lobster/lobsters。常用於美食描述。","entries":[{"sentence":"The seafood restaurant is famous for its grilled <target>lobster</target> with garlic butter, which is considered a luxury dish by many customers.","translation":"這家海鮮餐廳以其蒜奶油烤龍蝦聞名，由於許多顧客將其視為豪華料理，因此非常受歡迎。","explanation":"名詞「龍蝦」。"},{"sentence":"Divers often find <target>lobsters</target> hiding in the crevices of the ocean floor, where they wait for their prey to pass by.","translation":"潛水員經常發現龍蝦躲在海底的縫隙中，等待獵物經過。","explanation":"名詞「龍蝦」（複數）。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"logic","explanation":"名詞「邏輯」。指推理的原則或方式。常用搭配 include internal logic (內部邏輯) 或 follow the logic (遵循邏輯)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to explain the <target>logic</target> <pattern>behind</pattern> their arguments, ensuring their conclusions were based on reasonable evidence.","translation":"老師要求學生解釋他們論點背後的邏輯，以確保他們的結論是基於合理的證據。","explanation":"名詞「邏輯」。片語 the logic behind sth 表示「...背後的邏輯」。"},{"sentence":"Although the plot of the movie was exciting, many critics felt it lacked <target>logic</target>, as the main character's actions seemed contradictory.","translation":"雖然電影的情節很刺激，但許多評論家認為它缺乏邏輯，因為主角的行為似乎自相矛盾。","explanation":"名詞「邏輯」。常用搭配 lack logic (缺乏邏輯)。"}],"related_forms":["logical","logically","logician"]}

{"headword":"logical","explanation":"形容詞「邏輯上的；合理的」。常用於描述推論、結論或行動是符合邏輯的。常與 conclusion (結論) 或 explanation (解釋) 搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"Based on the evidence provided in the report, it is the <target>logical</target> <pattern>conclusion</pattern> that the company needs to change its strategy.","translation":"根據報告中提供的證據，一個合理的結論是公司需要改變其策略。","explanation":"形容詞「合理的」。常用搭配：logical conclusion (合理的結論)。"},{"sentence":"When solving a math problem, it is important to take a <target>logical</target> <pattern>approach</pattern> to avoid making simple mistakes.","translation":"在解決數學問題時，採取邏輯化的方法以避免犯簡單錯誤是非常重要的。","explanation":"形容詞「邏輯上的」。常用搭配：logical approach (邏輯方法)。"}],"related_forms":["logic","logically"]}

{"headword":"loosen","explanation":"動詞「鬆開；放寬」。可用於物理上的鬆開（如螺絲或繩索）或抽象意義上的放寬（如規定或限制）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The mechanic used a special tool to <target>loosen</target> the rusty bolt, which had been stuck for many years due to the rain.","translation":"機械師使用一個特殊工具來鬆開生鏽的螺栓，由於雨水影響，它已經卡住了很多年。","explanation":"動詞「鬆開」。指物理上的鬆開。"},{"sentence":"The government decided to <target>loosen</target> <pattern>travel</pattern> <target>restrictions</target> gradually as the number of new cases continued to decline.","translation":"隨著新病例數持續下降，政府決定逐漸放寬旅遊限制。","explanation":"動詞「放寬」。常用搭配：loosen restrictions (放寬限制)。"},{"sentence":"After a stressful day at school, she did some light stretching to <target>loosen</target> <pattern>up</pattern> her muscles and relax her mind.","translation":"經過在學校壓力大的一天後，她做了一些簡單的伸展運動來鬆開肌肉並放鬆心情。","explanation":"動詞片語 loosen up 表示「放鬆」。可用於身體肌肉或緊張的氣氛。"}],"related_forms":["loosened","loosening"]}

{"headword":"lousy","explanation":"形容詞「糟糕的；極差的」。這是一個非正式的詞彙，常用於描述品質、天氣或感覺非常糟糕。","entries":[{"sentence":"The weather during our school trip was absolutely <target>lousy</target>, with heavy rain and strong winds making it impossible to visit the museum.","translation":"我們學校旅行期間的天氣絕對糟糕，大雨和強風讓我們無法參觀博物館。","explanation":"形容詞「糟糕的」。常用於描述天氣或品質。"},{"sentence":"I felt <target>lousy</target> after skipping breakfast and staying up late to study for the final exam, which affected my concentration in class.","translation":"在沒吃早餐且為了準備期末考而熬夜後，我感到非常不舒服，這影響了我在課堂上的注意力。","explanation":"形容詞「感覺糟糕的」。指身體不適或心情低落。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"loyal","explanation":"形容詞「忠誠的；忠心的」。可用於描述對人、國家、品牌或信念的忠誠。","entries":[{"sentence":"The dog remained <target>loyal</target> <pattern>to</pattern> its owner even after many years, waiting patiently by the gate every single day.","translation":"這隻狗即使在多年後依然對其主人忠誠，每天耐心地在門口等待。","explanation":"形容詞「忠誠的」。常用搭配：loyal to someone (對某人忠誠)。"},{"sentence":"Many long-term customers are <target>loyal</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the brand because of its high quality and excellent after-sales service.","translation":"許多長期客戶因為高品質和卓越的售後服務而對該品牌忠誠。","explanation":"形容詞「忠誠的」。常用於商業語境，指品牌忠誠度。"}],"related_forms":["loyalty","loyally"]}

{"headword":"loyalty","explanation":"名詞「忠誠」。指對某人或某物保持忠心和支持的狀態。常用搭配 include loyalty to (對...的忠誠) 或 brand loyalty (品牌忠誠度)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The soldier was honored for his unwavering <target>loyalty</target> <pattern>to</pattern> his country, receiving a medal of bravery from the president.","translation":"這名士兵因其對國家堅定的忠誠而受到表彰，並從總統那裡獲得了一枚勇敢勳章。","explanation":"名詞「忠誠」。常用搭配：loyalty to someone/something (對某人/某物的忠誠)。"},{"sentence":"Companies often create reward programs to increase customer <target>loyalty</target>, encouraging people to keep buying their products.","translation":"公司經常創建獎勵計畫以提高客戶忠誠度，鼓勵人們繼續購買他們的產品。","explanation":"名詞「忠誠」。常用搭配：customer loyalty (客戶忠誠度)。"}],"related_forms":["loyal","loyally"]}

{"headword":"luxurious","explanation":"形容詞「豪華的；奢侈的」。指提供極高舒適度或使用昂貴材料製成的事物。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hotel provided <target>luxurious</target> <pattern>suites</pattern> with ocean views, making the guests feel like royalty during their short stay.","translation":"這家飯店提供了具有海景的豪華套房，讓客人在短期停留期間感覺像皇室成員一樣。","explanation":"形容詞「豪華的」。常用搭配：luxurious suites/rooms (豪華套房/房間)。"},{"sentence":"She spent a <target>luxurious</target> <pattern>afternoon</pattern> at the spa, enjoying professional massages and high-end skincare treatments to relieve stress.","translation":"她在水療中心度過了一個奢侈的下午，享受著專業的按摩和高端皮膚護理，以緩解壓力。","explanation":"形容詞「奢侈的」。描述一種高品質且昂貴的體驗。"}],"related_forms":["luxury"]}

{"headword":"luxury","explanation":"名詞「奢侈品；奢侈」。可用於指昂貴且非必要的物品，或指一種極其舒適的狀態。常用片語 a luxury to (對...來說是奢侈的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"For many students, having a private car is a <target>luxury</target> they cannot afford, so they usually rely on public transportation.","translation":"對於許多學生來說，擁有一輛私家車是他們無法負擔的奢侈品，所以他們通常依賴大眾運輸。","explanation":"名詞「奢侈品」。指非必要但昂貴的物品。"},{"sentence":"After working hard for ten years, he finally treated himself to the <target>luxury</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a long vacation in Europe.","translation":"辛苦工作十年後，他終於犒賞自己一次在歐洲長假旅行的奢侈享受。","explanation":"名詞「奢侈」。指一種舒適且昂貴的享受。"},{"sentence":"The new apartment building offers various <target>luxuries</target>, such as a rooftop garden and a 24-hour fitness center, to attract wealthy buyers.","translation":"這棟新公寓大樓提供各種奢侈設施，例如頂樓花園和 24 小時健身中心，以吸引富裕的買家。","explanation":"名詞「奢侈品/設施」。這裡使用複數形式 luxurious items/amenities。"}],"related_forms":["luxurious"]}

{"headword":"machinery","explanation":"名詞「機械；機器」。這是一個不可數名詞，指一組機器或機械系統。注意不可加 s 或使用 a machinery。","entries":[{"sentence":"The factory installed new <target>machinery</target> to increase production efficiency, allowing them to manufacture more products in less time.","translation":"工廠安裝了新機械以提高生產效率，使他們能在更短時間內製造更多產品。","explanation":"名詞「機械」。注意其不可數性質。"},{"sentence":"Modern <target>machinery</target> is often controlled by computer systems, which reduces the need for manual labor and minimizes human error.","translation":"現代機械通常由電腦系統控制，這減少了對體力勞動的需求並將人為錯誤降至最低。","explanation":"名詞「機械」。指整體的機械系統。"}],"related_forms":["machine"]}

{"headword":"magnetic","explanation":"形容詞「磁性的；有吸引力的」。可用於物理上的磁力，或比喻義指某人具有吸引力。","entries":[{"sentence":"The scientist used a <target>magnetic</target> <pattern>field</pattern> to move the small metal pieces without touching them, demonstrating the laws of physics.","translation":"科學家利用磁場來移動微小的金屬碎片而無需接觸它們，展示了物理定律。","explanation":"形容詞「磁性的」。常用搭配：magnetic field (磁場)。"},{"sentence":"Because of his <target>magnetic</target> <pattern>personality</pattern>, he easily made friends and became the most popular student in the entire school.","translation":"因為他具有吸引力的個性，他很容易交到朋友，並成為全校最受歡迎的學生。","explanation":"形容詞「有吸引力的」。比喻義，指某人的特質能吸引他人。"}],"related_forms":["magnet","magnetism","magnetize"]}

{"headword":"magnificent","explanation":"形容詞「壯麗的、宏偉的、極好的」。常用於描述建築物、風景或成就，強調其規模之大、美感之強或品質之極高。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tourists were amazed by the <target>magnificent</target> view of the snow-capped mountains from the top of the hill.","translation":"遊客們對從山頂看到的雪山壯麗景色感到驚嘆。","explanation":"形容詞「壯麗的」。常用於描述自然景觀。"},{"sentence":"The royal palace is known for its <target>magnificent</target> architecture, featuring gold-plated walls and intricate carvings throughout the house.","translation":"皇宮以其宏偉的建築而聞名，房內到處都是鍍金的牆壁和複雜的雕刻。","explanation":"形容詞「宏偉的」。常用於描述建築物。"},{"sentence":"The pianist gave a <target>magnificent</target> performance at the concert hall, earning a standing ovation from the entire audience.","translation":"鋼琴家在音樂廳帶來了一場極好的演出，贏得了全場觀眾的起立鼓掌。","explanation":"形容詞「極好的」。用於描述高品質的表現或成就。"}],"related_forms":["magnificently","magnificence"]}

{"headword":"makeup","explanation":"名詞可指「化妝品」或「組成/構造」。注意 makeup (化妝) 與 make up (動詞片語，如補償、編造) 的區別。化妝品作為不可數名詞時常用，但指特定款式或妝容時可用作可數名詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"She spent nearly an hour applying her <target>makeup</target> before the graduation ceremony to ensure she looked her best in the photos.","translation":"在畢業典禮前，她花了大約一個小時化妝，以確保她在照片中看起來是最完美的。","explanation":"名詞「化妝品/化妝」。"},{"sentence":"The scientist explained that the genetic <target>makeup</target> of a person determines many of their physical characteristics, such as eye color.","translation":"科學家解釋說，一個人的基因組成決定了他們的許多身體特徵，例如眼睛的顏色。","explanation":"名詞「組成/構造」。指事物的內部構成或本質。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"manual","explanation":"名詞指「手冊」；形容詞指「手工的、體力的」。作為名詞時，常用於 product manual (產品手冊) 或 user manual (使用者手冊)。作為形容詞時，常與 automatic (自動的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you are not sure how to assemble the new bookshelf, you should read the <target>manual</target> carefully to avoid making mistakes.","translation":"如果你不確定如何組裝這個新書架，你應該仔細閱讀手冊，以避免犯錯。","explanation":"名詞「手冊」。指說明書。"},{"sentence":"In the past, many factories relied on <target>manual</target> <pattern>labor</pattern> to produce goods, but now most processes are fully automated by robots.","translation":"過去許多工廠依賴手工勞動來生產商品，但現在大多數過程已由機器人完全自動化。","explanation":"形容詞「手工的」。常用搭配：manual labor (手工勞動)。"},{"sentence":"Some older cars still have a <target>manual</target> <pattern>transmission</pattern>, requiring the driver to change gears by hand during the trip.","translation":"一些較舊的汽車仍使用手動變速箱，要求駕駛在旅途中手動換檔。","explanation":"形容詞「手動的」。常用搭配：manual transmission (手動變速箱)。"}],"related_forms":["manually"]}

{"headword":"manufacture","explanation":"動詞指「製造、生產」；名詞指「製造過程」。通常指大規模地使用機器在工廠中生產。注意與 make 的區別：manufacture 較正式且規模較大。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company uses advanced technology to <target>manufacture</target> high-quality medical devices that can help doctors save more patients' lives.","translation":"公司使用先進技術來製造高品質的醫療設備，可以幫助醫生挽救更多患者的生命。","explanation":"動詞「製造」。指大規模工業生產。"},{"sentence":"The <target>manufacture</target> of electric cars has increased significantly over the last decade as more people choose eco-friendly transportation.","translation":"電 Cars 的製造在過去十年中顯著增加，因為更多的人選擇環保交通工具。","explanation":"名詞「製造」。指生產的過程。"}],"related_forms":["manufactured","manufacturing"]}

{"headword":"manufacturer","explanation":"名詞「製造商」。指負責生產產品的公司或個人。常用搭配：car manufacturer (汽車製造商), electronics manufacturer (電子產品製造商)。","entries":[{"sentence":"If the electronic device stops working, you should contact the <target>manufacturer</target> to see if it is still under warranty.","translation":"如果電子設備停止工作，你應該聯繫製造商，看看它是否還在保修期內。","explanation":"名詞「製造商」。"},{"sentence":"The smartphone <target>manufacturer</target> released a new model with a better camera, attracting millions of customers worldwide.","translation":"這款智慧型手機製造商推出了一款擁有更好相機的新機型，吸引了全球數百萬名客戶。","explanation":"名詞「製造商」。"}],"related_forms":["manufacturers"]}

{"headword":"marathon","explanation":"名詞「馬拉松」。既可指 42.195 公里的長跑賽事，也可比喻指「長時間且艱苦的過程」。","entries":[{"sentence":"Training for a <target>marathon</target> requires months of hard work and a strict diet to ensure the body can handle the distance.","translation":"準備馬拉松需要數月的努力和嚴格的飲食，以確保身體能承受這個距離。","explanation":"名詞「馬拉松賽事」。"},{"sentence":"The two political parties engaged in a <target>marathon</target> <pattern>session</pattern> of negotiations that lasted for over twenty hours without a break.","translation":"兩個政黨進行了一場馬拉松式的談判會議，持續了超過二十個小時沒有休息。","explanation":"名詞「馬拉松式的」。比喻指長時間且艱苦的過程。常用搭配：marathon session (馬拉松式會議)。"}],"related_forms":["marathons"]}

{"headword":"margin","explanation":"名詞「邊緣、邊界」或「利潤」。在學術寫作中，常指頁面的空白邊緣 (page margin)；在商業中，常指利潤率 (profit margin)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to write their corrections <pattern>in</pattern> the <target>margin</target> of the paper instead of crossing out the original words.","translation":"老師要求學生將修正內容寫在紙張的邊緣，而不是將原來的字詞劃掉。","explanation":"名詞「邊緣」。指頁面邊緣的空白處。"},{"sentence":"Because the cost of raw materials increased, the company's profit <target>margin</target> <pattern>decreased</pattern> significantly this year.","translation":"由於原物料成本增加，公司今年的利潤率顯著下降。","explanation":"名詞「利潤率」。常用搭配：profit margin (利潤率)。"},{"sentence":"The candidate won the election by a narrow <target>margin</target>, with only a small percentage of difference between the two leaders.","translation":"該候選人以微弱的差距贏得了選舉，兩位領先者之間的百分比差異很小。","explanation":"名詞「差距」。指數量或程度上的微小差異。"}],"related_forms":["margins"]}

{"headword":"maturity","explanation":"名詞「成熟」。可指生理上的成熟 (physical maturity)、心智上的成熟 (emotional/mental maturity) 或金融上的到期 (financial maturity)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although he is only fifteen, he shows a level of emotional <target>maturity</target> that is far beyond his age when dealing with conflicts.","translation":"雖然他才十五歲，但在處理衝突時表現出的情感成熟度遠超他的年齡。","explanation":"名詞「成熟」。指心智或情感上的成熟。"},{"sentence":"The fruit will reach full <target>maturity</target> in a few more weeks, and then the farmers can begin to harvest it.","translation":"這種水果在再過幾週後將達到完全成熟，然後農民就可以開始採收了。","explanation":"名詞「成熟」。指生物生理上的成熟。"},{"sentence":"The investor decided to hold the bond until <target>maturity</target> to receive the full payment of the principal and interest.","translation":"投資者決定持有該債券直到到期，以領取本金和利息的全額付款。","explanation":"名詞「到期」。金融術語，指債券或保險到期。"}],"related_forms":["mature"]}

{"headword":"maximum","explanation":"形容詞「最大量的、最高限度的」；名詞「最大量」。常用搭配：maximum speed (最高速度), maximum capacity (最大容量)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The elevator has a <target>maximum</target> <pattern>capacity</pattern> of ten people, so please wait for the next one if the car is already full.","translation":"電梯的最大容量為十人，所以如果電梯已經滿了，請等待下一部。","explanation":"形容詞「最大量的」。常用搭配：maximum capacity (最大容量)。"},{"sentence":"To ensure safety, the highway has a <target>maximum</target> <pattern>speed limit</pattern> of 100 kilometers per hour, which all drivers must follow.","translation":"為了確保安全，高速公路有每小時 100 公里的最高速限，所有駕駛都必須遵守。","explanation":"形容詞「最高限度的」。常用搭配：maximum speed limit (最高速限)。"},{"sentence":"The <target>maximum</target> temperature for this summer was recorded in July, reaching an all-time high for this city.","translation":"今年夏天的最高溫度記錄在七月，達到了這個城市的歷史最高點。","explanation":"名詞「最大量/最高值」。"}],"related_forms":["maximums"]}

{"headword":"measurable","explanation":"形容詞「可測量的、顯著的」。常用於科學實驗或社會研究中，表示可以用數量或數據來量化的事物。當指「顯著的」時，常與 significant 相近。","entries":[{"sentence":"After three months of intensive training, the athlete showed a <target>measurable</target> <pattern>improvement</pattern> in her running speed and endurance.","translation":"經過三個月的強化訓練後，這名運動員在跑步速度和耐力方面表現出了顯著的進步。","explanation":"形容詞「顯著的」。常用搭配：measurable improvement (顯著的進步)。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are trying to find a <target>measurable</target> <pattern>effect</pattern> of the new drug on the patients' recovery time in this medical trial.","translation":"科學家正試圖在這次醫學試驗中尋找新藥對患者恢復時間的可測量影響。","explanation":"形容詞「可測量的」。指可以用數據量化。"},{"sentence":"The decrease in air pollution has had a <target>measurable</target> <pattern>impact</pattern> on the health of people living in the city.","translation":"空氣污染的減少對居住在城市中的人們的健康產生了顯著的影響。","explanation":"形容詞「顯著的」。常用搭配：measurable impact (顯著的影響)。"}],"related_forms":["measure","measurably"]}

{"headword":"measure","explanation":"名詞用法包括「措施」和「衡量標準」。當指「措施」時，常用複數型 measures。常見搭配：take measures (採取措施) 或 a measure of (一定程度的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government decided to <target>take</target> <pattern>measures</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> reduce air pollution by encouraging people to use public transportation instead of cars.","translation":"政府決定採取措施減少空氣污染，鼓勵人們使用大眾運輸工具而非開車。","explanation":"名詞「措施」。常用搭配 take measures to do sth。"},{"sentence":"The school implemented new security <target>measures</target> after the incident, such as installing more cameras to ensure the safety of all students.","translation":"事件發生後，學校實施了新的安全措施，例如安裝更多攝影機以確保所有學生的安全。","explanation":"名詞「措施」。指為達到某個目的而採取的行動。"},{"sentence":"The amount of waste recycled each year is a <target>measure</target> <pattern>of</pattern> how much the city cares about environmental protection.","translation":"每年回收的廢棄物數量是衡量這座城市對環境保護重視程度的一個標準。","explanation":"名詞「衡量標準」。指用來判斷某事程度或質量的基準。"},{"sentence":"There is a <target>measure</target> <pattern>of</pattern> uncertainty regarding the new law, as many citizens are not yet sure how it will affect them.","translation":"關於新法律仍存在一定程度的不確定性，因為許多公民尚未確定它將如何影響他們。","explanation":"名詞「一定程度」。常用搭配 a measure of sth。"}],"related_forms":["measures"]}

{"headword":"mechanic","explanation":"名詞「機械修理工」。指專門維修車輛或機械設備的技術人員。","entries":[{"sentence":"When my father's car broke down on the highway, we had to call a <target>mechanic</target> to come and fix the engine.","translation":"當我父親的車在高速公路上故障時，我們必須叫一名機械修理工來修理引擎。","explanation":"名詞「機械修理工」。"},{"sentence":"The skilled <target>mechanic</target> quickly identified the problem with the brakes and repaired them in less than an hour.","translation":"這名熟練的機械修理工很快地發現了剎車的問題並在不到一小時內將其修好。","explanation":"名詞「機械修理工」。"}],"related_forms":["mechanics"]}

{"headword":"mechanical","explanation":"形容詞「機械的；自動的」。可用於描述機器運作方式，或指行為像機器一樣缺乏感情或思考地重複。","entries":[{"sentence":"The old clock relies on a complex <target>mechanical</target> system of gears and springs rather than using electronic components.","translation":"這座舊鐘依賴於一個複雜的齒輪和彈簧機械系統，而不是使用電子元件。","explanation":"形容詞「機械的」。指與機器運作相關的。"},{"sentence":"Because he was so nervous during the presentation, his voice sounded <target>mechanical</target> and lacked natural emotion or enthusiasm.","translation":"因為他在簡報期間非常緊張，他的聲音聽起來很僵硬，缺乏自然的感情或熱情。","explanation":"形容詞「機械的」。指行為或表現僵硬、缺乏感情。"},{"sentence":"Many factories have replaced <target>mechanical</target> tasks with robots to increase production speed and reduce human errors.","translation":"許多工廠已將機械性工作以機器人取代，以提高生產速度並減少人為錯誤。","explanation":"形容詞「機械的」。指重複性強、不需要思考的工作。"}],"related_forms":["mechanically"]}

{"headword":"memorable","explanation":"形容詞「值得紀念的；難忘的」。常用於描述經歷、時刻或表演。","entries":[{"sentence":"The graduation ceremony was a <target>memorable</target> event for the students, as it marked the beginning of their adult lives.","translation":"畢業典禮對學生來說是一個難忘的事件，因為它標誌著他們成年生活的開始。","explanation":"形容詞「難忘的」。"},{"sentence":"Visiting the Great Wall of China was the most <target>memorable</target> experience of her trip, leaving her with lasting memories.","translation":"參觀萬里長城是她旅途中最難忘的經歷，給她留下了持久的記憶。","explanation":"形容詞「難忘的」。"}],"related_forms":["memorably"]}

{"headword":"memorial","explanation":"名詞指「紀念碑；紀念物」，形容詞指「紀念的」。常用搭配：war memorial (戰爭紀念碑)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The town built a grand <target>memorial</target> in the center of the park to honor the brave soldiers who died in the war.","translation":"小鎮在公園中心建立了一座宏偉的紀念碑，以紀念在戰爭中犧牲的勇敢士兵。","explanation":"名詞「紀念碑」。"},{"sentence":"The school held a <target>memorial</target> service to remember the students and teachers who had passed away over the last decade.","translation":"學校舉行了一場紀念儀式，以緬懷過去十年中去世的學生和教師。","explanation":"形容詞「紀念的」。"}],"related_forms":["memorials"]}

{"headword":"memorize","explanation":"動詞「背誦；記憶」。指將資訊刻意地記在腦海中，以便日後使用。","entries":[{"sentence":"Some students prefer to <target>memorize</target> the entire text of the poem for the English class, rather than just understanding its meaning.","translation":"有些學生傾向於為英文課背誦整首詩的全文，而不是僅僅理解其意義。","explanation":"動詞「背誦」。"},{"sentence":"To be successful in the chemistry exam, you need to <target>memorize</target> the periodic table and the symbols of common elements.","translation":"為了在化學考試中取得成功，你需要背誦週期表和常見元素的符號。","explanation":"動詞「記憶」。"}],"related_forms":["memorization","memorized"]}

{"headword":"merchant","explanation":"名詞「商人」。通常指從事大宗商品貿易或批發的商人。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the past, the silk <target>merchant</target> traveled across Asia to trade precious fabrics for gold and spices from other countries.","translation":"在過去，絲綢商人穿越亞洲，用珍貴的織物交換其他國家的黃金和香料。","explanation":"名詞「商人」。"},{"sentence":"The local <target>merchants</target> complained that the new shopping mall was taking away many of their regular customers.","translation":"當地商人抱怨說，新的購物中心奪走了他們的許多常客。","explanation":"名詞「商人」。"}],"related_forms":["merchandise"]}

{"headword":"mercy","explanation":"名詞「慈悲；寬恕」。常用片語 show mercy (表現出慈悲) 或 at the mercy of (受...支配/聽憑...處置)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The prisoners begged the king to <target>show</target> <pattern>mercy</pattern> and spare their lives instead of sentencing them to death.","translation":"囚犯們懇求國王表現出慈悲並饒恕他們的生命，而不是判處他們死刑。","explanation":"名詞「慈悲」。常用搭配 show mercy。"},{"sentence":"Small boats are often <target>at</target> <pattern>the mercy of</pattern> the strong ocean waves, making it dangerous for sailors during a storm.","translation":"小船經常受強大海洋波浪的支配，這使得水手在風暴期間處境危險。","explanation":"片語 at the mercy of sth 意為「受...支配」。"}],"related_forms":["merciful"]}

{"headword":"mere","explanation":"形容詞「僅僅的；單純的」。常用於強調數量少或事物簡單，常與 a mere (僅僅...) 搭配使用。","entries":[{"sentence":"The athlete was amazed that he could run the marathon in <target>a mere</target> two hours, breaking the world record.","translation":"這位運動員驚訝於他能在僅僅兩小時內跑完馬拉松，打破了世界紀錄。","explanation":"形容詞「僅僅的」。用於強調時間或數量的少。"},{"sentence":"For some people, the <target>mere</target> thought of public speaking makes them feel extremely nervous and sweaty.","translation":"對於某些人來說，僅僅想到公開演講就讓他們感到極其緊張且出汗。","explanation":"形容詞「單純的」。用於強調即使是最小的刺激也能引起反應。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"merit","explanation":"名詞「價值；功績；優點」。常用搭配：on its own merits (就其本身價值而言) 或 academic merit (學術價值)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The committee decided to judge each application <pattern>on</pattern> <target>its own merits</target>, without considering the applicants' family backgrounds.","translation":"委員會決定就每份申請的本身價值來評判，而不考慮申請人的家庭背景。","explanation":"名詞「價值」。片語 on its own merits 意為「就其本身價值而言」。"},{"sentence":"The teacher praised the student's essay for its artistic <target>merit</target>, noting that the writing style was unique and powerful.","translation":"y老師稱讚該學生的作文在藝術價值方面的表現，指出其寫作風格獨特且有力。","explanation":"名詞「價值」。"},{"sentence":"The company promotes employees based on <target>merit</target> rather than seniority, ensuring that the most capable people lead the teams.","translation":"公司根據功績來晉升員工，而非根據年資，以確保最有能力的人領導團隊。","explanation":"名詞「功績」。指因表現出色而獲得的認可。"}],"related_forms":["meritorious"]}

{"headword":"messenger","explanation":"名詞「信使，傳遞者」。指負責傳遞訊息或物品的人。在現代語境中，也常用於指電子通訊軟體（如 Facebook Messenger）。","entries":[{"sentence":"In ancient times, a <target>messenger</target> would travel long distances on horseback to deliver important military news to the king.","translation":"在古代，信使會騎馬長途跋涉，將重要的軍事消息傳遞給國王。","explanation":"名詞「信使」。指負責遞送訊息的人。"},{"sentence":"The school office sent a <target>messenger</target> to the classroom to inform the student that his parents had arrived at the gate.","translation":"學校辦公室派了一名傳遞員到教室，通知學生他的父母已經在校門口到了。","explanation":"名詞「傳遞員」。指在機構內傳遞消息的人。"},{"sentence":"I will send you the updated project files through a <target>messenger</target> app so you can check them on your phone immediately.","translation":"我會透過通訊軟體將更新後的專案檔案傳送給你，這樣你就可以立即在手機上查看。","explanation":"名詞「通訊軟體」。指用於即時訊息傳遞的電子應用程式。"}],"related_forms":["messages"]}

{"headword":"messy","explanation":"形容詞「凌亂的，雜亂的」。可用於描述實體空間（如房間）或抽象情況（如關係、過程）。常用反義詞為 tidy 或 neat。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher reminded the students to keep their desks tidy and not let them become <target>messy</target> with scrap paper and pencils.","translation":"老師提醒學生保持桌面整潔，不要讓桌面堆滿廢紙和鉛筆而變得凌亂。","explanation":"形容詞「凌亂的」。描述實體空間的雜亂。"},{"sentence":"After the art project, the classroom was incredibly <target>messy</target>, with paint splatters on the floor and brushes everywhere.","translation":"藝術專案結束後，教室變得非常凌亂，地板上到處都是油漆噴濺，刷子也散落在各處。","explanation":"形容詞「凌亂的」。描述環境的混亂。"},{"sentence":"The divorce process became very <target>messy</target> when both sides started arguing over who should keep the family dog.","translation":"當雙方開始爭論誰應該留下家裡的狗時，離婚過程變得非常混亂。","explanation":"形容詞「混亂的」。描述抽象情況或複雜且不愉快的過程。"}],"related_forms":["mess"]}

{"headword":"microscope","explanation":"名詞「顯微鏡」。科學實驗室的常用工具。常用搭配：under a microscope (在顯微鏡下)。","entries":[{"sentence":"In biology class, the students used a <target>microscope</target> to observe the structure of plant cells and draw them in their notebooks.","translation":"在生物課上，學生們使用顯微鏡觀察植物細胞的結構，並將其畫在筆記本中。","explanation":"名詞「顯微鏡」。"},{"sentence":"The scientist placed a drop of pond water <pattern>under</pattern> a <target>microscope</target> to search for tiny organisms that are invisible to the naked eye.","translation":"科學家將一滴池塘水放在顯微鏡下，以尋找肉眼看不見的微小生物。","explanation":"常用搭配 under a microscope，指在顯微鏡下觀察。"}],"related_forms":["microscopic"]}
