{"headword":"mild","explanation":"形容詞「溫和的，輕微的」。可用於描述天氣、氣候、味道或疾病的程度。常用反義詞為 severe 或 harsh。","entries":[{"sentence":"Compared to the snowy winters in Canada, the climate in Taiwan is <target>mild</target> and pleasant throughout the year.","translation":"與加拿大多雪的冬天相比，台灣的氣候全年溫和且舒適。","explanation":"形容詞「溫和的」。描述氣候。"},{"sentence":"The doctor told him that he only had a <target>mild</target> cold and should get plenty of rest for a few days to recover.","translation":"醫生告訴他，他只是患了輕微的感冒，休息幾天就能康復。","explanation":"形容詞「輕微的」。描述疾病或症狀的程度。"},{"sentence":"Since the children dislike spicy food, she prepared a <target>mild</target> curry with very little pepper and no chili peppers.","translation":"由於孩子們不喜歡辛辣的食物，她準備了味道溫和的咖哩，幾乎沒有胡椒，也沒有辣椒。","explanation":"形容詞「溫和的」。描述味道不刺激。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"mill","explanation":"名詞「磨坊，工廠」；動詞「磨碎」。名詞常指加工原物料的場所，如 wind mill (風車) 或 steel mill (鋼鐵廠)。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the old village, there was a traditional water <target>mill</target> that used the power of the river to grind grain into flour.","translation":"在那個古老的村莊裡，有一座傳統的水磨坊，利用河流的動力將穀物磨成麵粉。","explanation":"名詞「磨坊」。指利用動力磨碎穀物的場所。"},{"sentence":"The city's economy relied heavily on the large steel <target>mill</target> that provided thousands of jobs for the local residents.","translation":"城市的經濟高度依賴於那座大型鋼鐵廠，它為當地居民提供了數千個工作機會。","explanation":"名詞「工廠」。指大規模加工原物料的工業場所。"},{"sentence":"The chef used a special machine to <target>mill</target> the coffee beans into a fine powder before brewing the fresh morning coffee.","translation":"廚師使用一台特殊的機器將咖啡豆磨成細粉，然後沖泡新鮮的早晨咖啡。","explanation":"動詞「磨碎」。指將物體磨成粉末。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"millionaire","explanation":"名詞「百萬富翁」。指擁有一百萬（通常指美金或英鎊等主要貨幣）以上資產的人。常用搭配：self-made millionaire (白手起家的百萬富翁)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After years of hard work and smart investments, he finally became a <target>millionaire</target> and bought a luxury villa by the sea.","translation":"經過多年的努力和聰明的投資，他終於成為一名百萬富翁，並在海邊買了一棟豪華別墅。","explanation":"名詞「百萬富翁」。"},{"sentence":"She is a <pattern>self-made</pattern> <target>millionaire</target> who started her own software company in her garage when she was only twenty years old.","translation":"她是一位白手起家的百萬富翁，在二十歲時就在自己的車庫裡創立了自己的軟體公司。","explanation":"常用搭配 self-made millionaire，指靠自己努力而成功的富翁。"}],"related_forms":["million"]}

{"headword":"miner","explanation":"名詞「礦工」。指在礦坑中挖掘礦產的人。注意與 minor (較小的/次要的) 拼寫相似，需區分。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>miners</target> worked in deep, dark tunnels underground, facing dangerous conditions to extract coal for the city's energy.","translation":"礦工們在深邃黑暗的地下隧道中工作，面對危險的環境以提取煤炭供城市能源使用。","explanation":"名詞「礦工」。"},{"sentence":"After the earthquake, the rescue team spent three days digging through the rocks to find the trapped <target>miners</target>.","translation":"地震後，救援隊花三天時間挖掘岩石，以尋找被困的礦工。","explanation":"名詞「礦工」。"}],"related_forms":["mining"]}

{"headword":"mineral","explanation":"名詞「礦物」。指自然界中存在的無機物質。形容詞「礦物質的」。常用搭配：mineral water (礦泉水), essential minerals (必需礦物質)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The geology student collected various <target>minerals</target> from the mountains to study their crystal structures and chemical compositions.","translation":"地質學學生從山中收集了各種礦物，以研究其晶體結構和化學成分。","explanation":"名詞「礦物」。"},{"sentence":"Drinking <target>mineral</target> water can provide the body with essential nutrients that help maintain healthy bones and teeth.","translation":"飲用礦泉水可以為身體提供必需的營養素，有助於維持健康的骨骼和牙齒。","explanation":"形容詞「礦物質的」。常用搭配 mineral water。"},{"sentence":"Vegetables and fruits are rich in <pattern>essential</pattern> <target>minerals</target> such as calcium and potassium, which are vital for a healthy diet.","translation":"蔬菜和水果含有豐富的必需礦物質，如鈣和鉀，這對健康飲食至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「礦物/礦物質」。常用搭配 essential minerals。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"minimum","explanation":"形容詞「最低的，最小的」；名詞「最小值，最低限度」。常用搭配：the minimum wage (最低工資), at a minimum (最低限度)。","entries":[{"sentence":"To pass the course, students must maintain a <target>minimum</target> grade of seventy percent in all their final examinations.","translation":"為了通過這門課程，學生必須在所有期末考試中保持最低七十%的分數。","explanation":"形容詞「最低的」。"},{"sentence":"The government recently increased the <target>minimum</target> <pattern>wage</pattern> to help low-income workers cover their basic living costs in the city.","translation":"政府最近調高了最低工資，以幫助低收入工人支付在城市中的基本生活成本。","explanation":"常用搭配 the minimum wage (最低工資)。"},{"sentence":"You should spend <pattern>at a</pattern> <target>minimum</target> thirty minutes every day practicing English to improve your speaking skills effectively.","translation":"你每天應該至少花三十分鐘練習英文，才能有效地提高你的口說能力。","explanation":"常用片語 at a minimum，意為「最低限度地/至少」。"}],"related_forms":["minimal"]}

{"headword":"minister","explanation":"名詞「部長，大臣」；「牧師」。在政治語境中，指政府高層官員；在宗教語境中，指執行宗教儀式的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The Foreign <target>minister</target> traveled to Europe to discuss the new trade agreement and strengthen diplomatic relations between the two countries.","translation":"外交部長前往歐洲討論新的貿易協定，並加強兩國之間的外交關係。","explanation":"名詞「部長」。指政府部門的最高負責人。"},{"sentence":"The Prime <target>minister</target> gave a televised speech to announce the new policies regarding environmental protection and carbon reduction.","translation":"首相（總理）發表了一次電視演講，宣布關於環境保護和減碳的新政策。","explanation":"名詞「部長/首相」。Prime minister 指國家最高行政首長。"},{"sentence":"The local <target>minister</target> performed the wedding ceremony for the young couple in the small chapel on the hill.","translation":"當地牧師在山上的小教堂裡為這對年輕夫婦主持了婚禮儀式。","explanation":"名詞「牧師」。指宗教領袖。"}],"related_forms":["ministry","ministerial"]}

{"headword":"ministry","explanation":"名詞「政府部門/部」或「牧師的職務」。在 GSAT 中最常見的是指政府的行政部門（如 Ministry of Education 教育部）。注意與 department 的區別，ministry 通常指國家級的最高行政單位。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>Ministry</target> <pattern>of</pattern> Education announced new guidelines for the upcoming entrance examinations to ensure fairness for all students.","translation":"教育部宣布了即將到來的入學考試的新指南，以確保所有學生的公平性。","explanation":"名詞「政府部門」。常用搭配 Ministry of [Department Name]。"},{"sentence":"The government's <target>ministry</target> <pattern>of</pattern> health is working hard to develop a vaccination plan to protect the public from the virus.","translation":"政府的衛生部正努力制定疫苗接種計畫，以保護公眾免於病毒侵害。","explanation":"名詞「政府部門」。"},{"sentence":"After years of studying theology, he decided to enter the <target>ministry</target> to serve his community and provide spiritual guidance.","translation":"經過多年的神學研究，他決定進入牧師職務，為他的社區提供服務並提供心靈指導。","explanation":"名詞「牧師的職務」。指宗教上的服務工作。"}],"related_forms":["ministries"]}

{"headword":"mischief","explanation":"名詞「頑皮、惡作劇」。通常指不造成嚴重傷害但令人煩惱的行為。常見搭配：cause mischief (引起麻煩), get into mischief (闖禍)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The curious puppy <target>caused</target> a lot of <target>mischief</target> by chewing on the living room rug and tearing up the curtains.","translation":"這隻好奇的小狗通過啃咬客廳地毯和撕裂窗簾引起了許多麻煩。","explanation":"名詞「頑皮/惡作劇」。常用搭配 cause mischief。"},{"sentence":"The teacher warned the students that if they continued to <pattern>get</pattern> <target>into</target> <target>mischief</target>, they would lose their privilege of playing outside.","translation":"老師警告學生，如果他們繼續闖禍，他們將失去在戶外玩耍的權利。","explanation":"名詞「惡作劇」。片語 get into mischief 表示「闖禍」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"miserable","explanation":"形容詞「痛苦的、悲慘的、極其糟糕的」。可用於描述心情（極其憂鬱）或環境（天氣、生活條件）。注意與 sad 的區別，miserable 程度更深，強調一種絕望或極度不適感。","entries":[{"sentence":"The refugees lived in <target>miserable</target> conditions, lacking clean water, food, and a safe place to sleep during the winter.","translation":"難民們生活在悲慘的條件下，缺乏乾淨的水、食物和冬天睡眠的安全場所。","explanation":"形容詞「悲慘的」。描述生活條件極其糟糕。"},{"sentence":"After losing the final match of the tournament, the young athlete felt <target>miserable</target> and stayed in his room for the entire weekend.","translation":"在失去錦標賽的決賽後，這位年輕運動員感到非常痛苦，並在整個週末都待在房間裡。","explanation":"形容詞「痛苦的」。描述心情極其憂鬱。"},{"sentence":"The rainy weather made the camping trip <target>miserable</target>, as the tents leaked and the students had to stay inside all day.","translation":"陰雨的天氣讓露營之旅變得極其糟糕，因為帳篷漏水，學生們不得不整天待在室內。","explanation":"形容詞「極其糟糕的」。描述環境或體驗非常不愉快。"}],"related_forms":["miserably","miserableness"]}

{"headword":"misfortune","explanation":"名詞「不幸、不幸的事」。常用於描述運氣不好或遭遇災難。常見搭配：by misfortune (不幸地), a stroke of misfortune (一次不幸)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite his many <target>misfortunes</target>, the old man remained optimistic and continued to help others in his village.","translation":"儘管遭遇了許多不幸，這位老人依然保持樂觀，並繼續幫助村裡的其他人。","explanation":"名詞「不幸的事」。指遭遇的倒霉事。"},{"sentence":"It was a great <target>misfortune</target> that the library burned down, destroying thousands of rare books and historical documents.","translation":"圖書館被燒毀是一件極大的不幸，摧毀了數千本稀有書籍和歷史文件。","explanation":"名詞「不幸」。指一件糟糕的事情。"},{"sentence":"By <target>misfortune</target>, the team lost their most important player to an injury just a week before the championship game.","translation":"不幸地，該球隊在冠軍賽前一週，最重要的一名球員因傷缺席。","explanation":"名詞「不幸」。片語 by misfortune 表示「不幸地」。"}],"related_forms":["misfortunate"]}

{"headword":"mislead","explanation":"動詞「誤導」。指刻意或無意地讓他人產生錯誤的理解。注意其不規則變化：mislead-misled-misled。常見搭配：mislead someone into doing something (誤導某人做某事)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The advertisement <target>misled</target> the customers <pattern>into</pattern> <pattern>believing</pattern> that the product was made of pure gold, although it was actually plastic.","translation":"這則廣告誤導顧客相信該產品是由純金製成的，儘管它實際上是塑料。","explanation":"動詞「誤導」。不規則動詞變化：mislead-misled-misled。常用搭配 mislead someone into V-ing。"},{"sentence":"The witness's confusing testimony <target>misled</target> the jury, making them reach a wrong conclusion about the defendant's innocence.","translation":"證人令人困惑的證詞誤導了陪審團，使他們對被告的清白得出錯誤的結論。","explanation":"動詞「誤導」。指讓他人產生錯誤的理解。"}],"related_forms":["misleading"]}

{"headword":"misunderstand","explanation":"動詞「誤解」。指對訊息的理解錯誤。注意其不規則變化：misunderstand-misunderstood-misunderstood。常見搭配：be misunderstood (被誤解)。","entries":[{"sentence":"I am sorry that I <target>misunderstood</target> your instructions; I thought you wanted me to submit the report by Friday, not Thursday.","translation":"很抱歉我誤解了您的指示；我以為您要我在週五之前提交報告，而不是週四。","explanation":"動詞「誤解」。不規則動詞變化：misunderstand-misunderstood-misunderstood。"},{"sentence":"The artist felt <target>misunderstood</target> by the public, as most people failed to see the deeper meaning behind his abstract paintings.","translation":"這位藝術家覺得被大眾誤解了，因為大多數人未能看到他抽象畫作背後的深層含義。","explanation":"動詞「誤解」。此處為被動態 be misunderstood，表示「被誤解」。"}],"related_forms":["misunderstanding"]}

{"headword":"moderate","explanation":"形容詞「適度的、溫和的」；動詞「節制、緩和」。作為形容詞時，常用於描述程度、價格或觀點。作為動詞時，常指主持會議或減少強度。注意與 extreme 的相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor advised the patient to engage in <target>moderate</target> <pattern>exercise</pattern>, such as walking, to improve his overall health without overstraining himself.","translation":"醫生建議患者進行適度的運動，例如散步，以提高整體健康而不過度勞累。","explanation":"形容詞「適度的」。常用搭配 moderate exercise。"},{"sentence":"The hotel offers a variety of rooms at <target>moderate</target> <pattern>prices</pattern>, making it an affordable choice for budget travelers.","translation":"這家酒店提供價格適中的各種房間，使其成為預算旅行者的經濟選擇。","explanation":"形容詞「適中的」。常用搭配 moderate prices。"},{"sentence":"The teacher acted as a <target>moderate</target> during the debate, ensuring that both sides could express their views without arguing.","translation":"老師在辯論中擔任主持人，確保雙方都能在不爭吵的情況下表達自己的觀點。","explanation":"名詞/形容詞用法，此處指主持會議的人。"},{"sentence":"The government tried to <target>moderate</target> the rising costs of living by introducing new subsidies for low-income families.","translation":"政府試圖通過為低收入家庭提供新補貼來緩解生活成本的上升。","explanation":"動詞「緩和/節制」。指降低強度或程度。"}],"related_forms":["moderately","moderation","moderator"]}

{"headword":"modest","explanation":"形容詞「謙虛的、適度的、簡陋的」。常用於描述人的性格（謙虛）、數量或規模（適度/不大）。注意與 humble 的區別：modest 常指不誇大自己的成就，而 humble 更強調低調或社會地位低。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite winning the first prize in the national competition, the student remained <target>modest</target> and credited his success to hard work.","translation":"儘管在全國競賽中獲得第一名，這名學生依然保持謙虛，將他的成功歸功於努力工作。","explanation":"形容詞「謙虛的」。描述人的性格。"},{"sentence":"The family lives in a <target>modest</target> <pattern>home</pattern> in the countryside, where they enjoy a simple and peaceful life away from the city.","translation":"這家人住在鄉間一座簡陋的房子裡，在那裡他們享受著遠離城市的簡單而寧靜的生活。","explanation":"形容詞「簡陋的/適度的」。描述規模或品質不豪華。"},{"sentence":"The new company started with a <target>modest</target> <pattern>investment</pattern>, but it grew rapidly into a global business within five years.","translation":"這家新公司是以適度的投資開始的，但在五年內迅速成長為一家全球企業。","explanation":"形容詞「適度的」。描述數量或程度不大。"}],"related_forms":["modestly"]}

{"headword":"modesty","explanation":"名詞「謙虛」。指不誇大自己能力或成就的品質。常考搭配：with modesty (謙虛地)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Her <target>modesty</target> made her reluctant to talk about her achievements, even though she was the most talented musician in the school.","translation":"她的謙虛使她不願談論她的成就，儘管她是學校裡最有才華的音樂家。","explanation":"名詞「謙虛」。"},{"sentence":"He accepted the award <pattern>with</pattern> <target>modesty</target>, thanking his teachers and teammates for their constant support throughout the year.","translation":"他謙虛地接受了獎項，感謝他的老師和隊友在一年中的不斷支持。","explanation":"名詞「謙虛」。片語 with modesty 表示「謙虛地」。"}],"related_forms":["modest"]}

{"headword":"monitor","explanation":"名詞「螢幕/監視器」或「監控人員」。動詞「監控、監視」。在 GSAT 中，動詞用法（監控進度或情況）和名詞用法（螢幕）最為常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher used a computer <target>monitor</target> to display the students' work on the screen, allowing everyone to see the results clearly.","translation":"老師使用電腦螢幕將學生的作品顯示在螢幕上，讓每個人都能清楚地看到結果。","explanation":"名詞「螢幕」。"},{"sentence":"The security guard used the <target>monitor</target> <pattern>to</pattern> <pattern>keep</pattern> <pattern>an</pattern> <pattern>eye</pattern> <pattern>on</pattern> the entrance of the building to prevent any unauthorized access.","translation":"保全人員使用監視器監控大樓入口，以防止任何未經授權的進入。","explanation":"名詞「監視器」。"},{"sentence":"The health department will <target>monitor</target> the air quality <pattern>closely</pattern> during the summer to warn citizens about the pollution levels.","translation":"衛生部門將在夏天密切監控空氣品質，以警告公民關於污染程度。","explanation":"動詞「監控」。常用搭配 monitor closely。"},{"sentence":"Parents are encouraged to <target>monitor</target> their children's internet usage to ensure they are accessing safe and educational content.","translation":"家長被鼓勵監控孩子的網路使用情況，以確保他們接觸到安全且有教育意義的內容。","explanation":"動詞「監控」。指持續觀察某事物的進展或狀態。"}],"related_forms":["monitoring"]}

{"headword":"monument","explanation":"名詞「紀念碑、紀念物」。通常指為了紀念某人或某個重大事件而建立的建築物或雕像。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city built a grand <target>monument</target> in the center of the square to honor the brave soldiers who fought in the war.","translation":"這座城市在廣場中心建立了一座宏偉的紀念碑，以紀念在戰爭中奮鬥的勇敢士兵。","explanation":"名詞「紀念碑」。"},{"sentence":"Visitors from all over the world come to see the ancient <target>monuments</target> of Egypt, such as the Pyramids, to learn about its rich history.","translation":"來自世界各地的遊客都來參觀埃及的古代紀念物，例如金字塔，以了解其豐富的歷史。","explanation":"名詞「紀念物」。指具有歷史意義的建築。"}],"related_forms":["monuments"]}

{"headword":"moreover","explanation":"副詞「此外、而且」。用於在論述中增加額外資訊或強化論點，語氣較 formal，常見於寫作中。注意與 besides, furthermore 的區別：moreover 強調的是遞進關係，即後者比前者更重要或更具說服力。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new library provides a wide range of books; <target>moreover</target>, it offers free online courses for students to improve their skills.","translation":"新圖書館提供了豐富的書籍；此外，它還為學生提供免費的線上課程以提高技能。","explanation":"副詞「此外」。用於連接兩個完整的句子，增加額外資訊。"},{"sentence":"The hotel is located in a quiet neighborhood, which is ideal for resting; <target>moreover</target>, it is within walking distance of the city center.","translation":"這家酒店位於安靜的社區，非常適合休息；而且，它距離市中心很近，步行即可到達。","explanation":"副詞「而且」。用來強化論點。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"motivate","explanation":"動詞「激勵、驅使」。指給予某人做某事的理由或動力。常用搭配 motivate someone to do something。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher tried to <target>motivate</target> her students <pattern>to</pattern> study harder by offering rewards and praising their progress in class.","translation":"老師試圖透過提供獎勵和在課堂上稱讚他們的進步，來激勵學生更努力學習。","explanation":"動詞「激勵」。常用結構：motivate someone to do something。"},{"sentence":"A strong desire to help others often <target>motivates</target> many people to pursue careers in medicine or social work.","translation":"強烈的助人欲望通常會驅使許多人追求醫學或社會工作方面的職業。","explanation":"動詞「驅使」。指內在的動力。"}],"related_forms":["motivated","motivating","motivation"]}

{"headword":"motivation","explanation":"名詞「動機、動力」。指促使某人採取行動的原因或力量。常用搭配 have the motivation to do something, lack motivation。","entries":[{"sentence":"Some students have a strong internal <target>motivation</target> to learn a foreign language because they enjoy the discovering new cultures.","translation":"有些學生有強烈的內在動機去學習外語，因為他們喜歡探索新文化。","explanation":"名詞「動機」。指內在的驅動力。"},{"sentence":"When students <pattern>lack</pattern> <target>motivation</target>, they often struggle to complete their assignments on time and may lose interest in their studies.","translation":"當學生缺乏動力時，他們經常難以準時完成作業，並可能對學習失去興趣。","explanation":"名詞「動力」。常用搭配：lack motivation (缺乏動力)。"}],"related_forms":["motivate","motivated"]}

{"headword":"mountainous","explanation":"形容詞「多山的、山區的」。用於描述地形。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>mountainous</target> terrain of the region makes it difficult for engineers to build new roads and bridges for transportation.","translation":"該地區多山的 terrain 使工程師難以建造新的道路和橋橋樑以供運輸。","explanation":"形容詞「多山的」。描述地理環境。"},{"sentence":"Hiking through the <target>mountainous</target> areas of Switzerland is a popular activity for tourists who love nature and outdoor adventures.","translation":"在瑞士的山區徒步旅行是那些熱愛自然和戶外冒險的遊客的熱門活動。","explanation":"形容詞「山區的」。"}],"related_forms":["mountain"]}

{"headword":"muddy","explanation":"形容詞「泥濘的、混濁的」。可用於描述道路、衣服或水質。","entries":[{"sentence":"After the heavy rain last night, the garden path became so <target>muddy</target> that we had to walk carefully to avoid slipping.","translation":"昨晚大雨後，花園的小徑變得如此泥濘，以至於我們必須小心行走以避免滑倒。","explanation":"形容詞「泥濘的」。描述道路。"},{"sentence":"The children came home with <target>muddy</target> shoes and clothes after spending the whole afternoon playing in the park.","translation":"孩子們在公園玩了一個下午後，穿著泥濘的鞋子回到家。","explanation":"形容詞「泥濘的」。描述物品。"},{"sentence":"The river water became <target>muddy</target> after the storm, making it impossible for the fishermen to see the fish underneath.","translation":"形容詞「混濁的」。描述水質。- 翻譯：暴風雨後，河水變得混濁，使漁民無法看到水底的魚。","explanation":"形容詞「混濁的」。"}],"related_forms":["mud"]}

{"headword":"mule","explanation":"名詞「騾子」。由馬和驢交配而生，以其耐力強、耐操而聞名。在某些地區仍被用於運送貨物。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the steep and rocky mountains, farmers often use <target>mules</target> to carry heavy loads of supplies to their remote villages.","translation":"在陡峭且多岩石的山區，農民經常使用騾子來運送沉重的物資到遙遠的村莊。","explanation":"名詞「騾子」。複數形式。"},{"sentence":"The <target>mule</target> was known for being stubborn, but it was the most reliable animal for traveling through difficult terrain.","translation":"這隻騾子以頑固著稱，但它是穿越困難地形最可靠的動物。","explanation":"名詞「騾子」。"}],"related_forms":["mules"]}

{"headword":"multiple","explanation":"形容詞「多個的、多樣的」；名詞「倍數」。在 GSAT 中，常用於描述數量多或多種不同的情況。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student gave <target>multiple</target> reasons why he was late for class, but the teacher did not believe any of them.","translation":"這名學生給出了多個理由解釋為什麼他上課遲到，但老師一個都沒有相信。","explanation":"形容詞「多個的」。指數量多。"},{"sentence":"Many modern smartphones have <target>multiple</target> <pattern>functions</pattern>, such as a high-quality camera and a voice assistant, to make life more convenient.","translation":"許多現代智慧型手機具有多種功能，例如高品質的相機和語音助手，使生活更便利。","explanation":"形容詞「多樣的」。常用搭配：multiple functions (多種功能)。"},{"sentence":"In the math exam, the <target>multiple</target> <pattern>choice</pattern> questions were easier to answer than the essay questions.","translation":"在數學考試中，選擇題比申論題更容易回答。","explanation":"形容詞「多個的」。常用搭配：multiple choice (選擇題)。"}],"related_forms":["multiply"]}

{"headword":"murderer","explanation":"名詞「謀殺者」。指刻意殺害他人的人。注意與 murder (動詞/名詞) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police spent months gathering evidence to ensure the <target>murderer</target> would be caught and punished according to the law.","translation":"警方花了好幾個月收集證據，以確保謀殺者會被抓住並根據法律受到懲罰。","explanation":"名詞「謀殺者」。"},{"sentence":"In the mystery novel, the detective finally discovered that the <target>murderer</target> was the person everyone had least suspected.","translation":"在懸疑小說中，偵探最終發現謀殺者是每個人最不懷疑的那個人。","explanation":"名詞「謀殺者」。"}],"related_forms":["murder"]}

{"headword":"murmur","explanation":"名詞「低語、喃喃自語」；動詞「低語、抱怨」。指小聲地說話，通常是為了不讓他人聽到或不滿意地低語。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher heard a soft <target>murmur</target> of voices in the back of the classroom, suggesting that the students were talking privately.","translation":"老師聽到教室後方傳來微弱的低語聲，暗示學生們在私下交談。","explanation":"名詞「低語」。指小聲的說話聲。"},{"sentence":"The students began to <target>murmur</target> in dissatisfaction when the teacher announced that there would be an additional test next week.","translation":"當老師宣布下週將有一場額外考試時，學生們開始不滿地低語。","explanation":"動詞「低語、抱怨」。指不滿地小聲說話。"},{"sentence":"She leaned closer to her friend and <target>murmured</target> a secret into her ear, so that no one else could hear them.","translation":"她靠近她的朋友，在她的耳邊低語了一個秘密，以便沒有其他人能聽到他們。","explanation":"動詞「低語」。此處為過去式 murmured。"}],"related_forms":["murmurs","murmuring"]}

{"headword":"mutual","explanation":"形容詞「相互的、共同的」。常用於描述雙方共同擁有的感覺或利益，如 mutual respect (相互尊重) 或 mutual friend (共同朋友)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two companies decided to form a partnership based on <target>mutual</target> <pattern>trust</pattern> and a shared vision for future growth.","translation":"這兩家公司決定在相互信任和共同的未來成長願景基礎上建立合作夥伴關係。","explanation":"形容詞「相互的」。常用搭配：mutual trust (相互信任)。"},{"sentence":"Sarah and Emily became close friends after discovering they had a <target>mutual</target> <pattern>friend</pattern> who had introduced them at a party.","translation":"莎拉和艾蜜莉在發現她們有一個共同朋友在派對上介紹她們認識後，變成了好朋友。","explanation":"形容詞「共同的」。常用搭配：mutual friend (共同朋友)。"},{"sentence":"The treaty was signed after months of discussion, reflecting the <target>mutual</target> <pattern>benefit</pattern> for both neighboring countries involved.","translation":"在經過數月的討論後，該條約被簽署，反映了涉及的兩個鄰國之間的共同利益。","explanation":"形容詞「共同的」。常用搭配：mutual benefit (共同利益)。"}],"related_forms":["mutually"]}

{"headword":"mysterious","explanation":"形容詞「神秘的、不可思議的」。指難以解釋或理解的事物。常考搭配：a mysterious disappearance (神秘的失蹤) 或 mysterious behavior (神秘的行為)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The detective spent weeks investigating the <target>mysterious</target> <pattern>disappearance</pattern> of the painting, searching for clues that others had overlooked.","translation":"偵探花了好幾週調查那幅畫神秘的失蹤，尋找他人忽略的線索。","explanation":"形容詞「神秘的」。常用搭配：mysterious disappearance (神秘的失蹤)。"},{"sentence":"Deep in the forest, the explorers found a <target>mysterious</target> <pattern>stone</pattern> structure that seemed to belong to an ancient, forgotten civilization.","translation":"在森林深處，探險家發現了一座神秘的石造建築，似乎屬於一個古老而被遺忘的文明。","explanation":"形容詞「神秘的」。描述一個難以解釋的物件。"},{"sentence":"The new student had a <target>mysterious</target> <pattern>smile</pattern> on her face, making her classmates curious about her background and where she came from.","translation":"新轉學生臉上帶著神秘的微笑，讓同學們對她的背景和來源感到好奇。","explanation":"形容詞「神秘的」。描述人的表情或行為。"}],"related_forms":["mystery","mysteriously"]}

{"headword":"namely","explanation":"副詞「也就是說、即」。用於詳細說明前面提到的內容，相當於 that is to say。注意它通常位於要解釋的項目之前。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school provides support for students with special needs, <target>namely</target> those who require additional help with reading and writing skills.","translation":"學校為有特殊需求的學生提供支持，也就是說，那些在閱讀和寫作技能方面需要額外幫助的人。","explanation":"副詞「也就是說」。用於對前面提到的 students with special needs 進行具體說明。"},{"sentence":"We have only one major problem to solve, <target>namely</target> the lack of funding for the new science laboratory in our high school.","translation":"我們只有一個主要問題要解決，即缺乏為高中新科學實驗室提供資金。","explanation":"副詞「即」。用於明確指出具體的問題。"},{"sentence":"The athlete won three medals in the competition, <target>namely</target> a gold, a silver, and a bronze, proving his versatility.","translation":"這位運動員在比賽中獲得了三枚獎牌，也就是說，一枚金牌、一枚銀牌和一枚銅牌，證明了他的多才多藝。","explanation":"副詞「也就是說」。用於列舉具體項目。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"nationality","explanation":"名詞「國籍」。指一個人所屬的國家。注意與 nation (國家) 和 national (國民的/國家的) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"When filling out the application form for the visa, please clearly state your <target>nationality</target> and current home address.","translation":"在填寫簽證申請表時，請清楚註明您的國籍和目前的家庭住址。","explanation":"名詞「國籍」。"},{"sentence":"The international festival attracted people of many different <target>nationalities</target>, creating a vibrant atmosphere of cultural exchange.","translation":"這個國際節吸引了許多不同國籍的人，營造出充滿活力的文化交流氛圍。","explanation":"名詞「國籍」的複數形式。指多個不同的國籍。"},{"sentence":"Despite having dual <target>nationality</target>, the young man decided to settle in his father's homeland to learn more about his roots.","translation":"儘管擁有雙重國籍，這個年輕人決定定居在他父親的故鄉，以了解更多關於他的根源。","explanation":"名詞「國籍」。常用搭配：dual nationality (雙重國籍)。"}],"related_forms":["national","nation"]}

{"headword":"needy","explanation":"形容詞「貧困的、貧窮的」。通常用於描述需要幫助的人或家庭，較 poor 更有同情心或強調需求感。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student council organized a charity drive to collect warm clothes and blankets for <target>needy</target> <pattern>families</pattern> during the winter.","translation":"學生會組織了一次慈善募捐，為冬季的貧困家庭收集溫暖的衣服和毯子。","explanation":"形容詞「貧困的」。常用搭配：needy families (貧困家庭)。"},{"sentence":"Many volunteers spend their weekends visiting <target>needy</target> <pattern>children</pattern> in rural areas to provide them with educational resources.","translation":"許多志願者在週末花時間造訪鄉下貧困的孩子們，為他們提供教育資源。","explanation":"形容詞「貧困的」。常用搭配：needy children (貧困孩子)。"},{"sentence":"The government established a fund to provide financial assistance to the <target>needy</target>, ensuring basic survival for all citizens.","translation":"政府成立了一個基金，為貧困者提供財務援助，確保所有公民的基本生存。","explanation":"形容詞「貧困的」。這裡 the needy 指代一類人，意為「貧困的人們」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"neglect","explanation":"動詞「忽略、疏忽」；名詞「忽略、疏忽」。注意動詞用法：neglect to do sth (忘記/忽略做某事) 或 neglect sth/sb (疏忽照顧)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Because the student <target>neglected</target> <pattern>to study</pattern> for the final exam, he was surprised by the difficulty of the questions.","translation":"因為這名學生忽略了為期末考讀書，所以他對題目之難感到驚訝。","explanation":"動詞「忽略」。用法：neglect to do sth (忽略做某事)。"},{"sentence":"The old house had been <target>neglected</target> for many years, resulting in broken windows and a garden overgrown with weeds.","translation":"這座舊房子多年來一直被忽略，導致窗戶破碎，花園裡雜草叢生。","explanation":"動詞「疏忽」。此處為被動語態，指對物體的疏忽照顧。"},{"sentence":"The child suffered from severe <target>neglect</target> <pattern>at home</pattern>, leading to emotional problems and a lack of social skills.","translation":"這個孩子在家中遭受了嚴重的疏忽，導致情緒問題和缺乏社交技巧。","explanation":"名詞「疏忽、忽略」。指缺乏必要的照顧。"},{"sentence":"It is important not to <target>neglect</target> your physical health while focusing on your academic achievements in high school.","translation":"在高中專注於學業成就時，不要忽略你的身體健康是很重要的。","explanation":"動詞「忽略」。指在照顧或處理某事時缺乏關注。"}],"related_forms":["neglectful","negligence"]}

{"headword":"negotiate","explanation":"動詞「協商、談判」。指通過討論來達成協議。常考搭配：negotiate a deal (協商達成協議), negotiate with sb (與某人協商)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two managers spent hours trying to <target>negotiate</target> <pattern>a deal</pattern> that would benefit both of their companies in the long run.","translation":"兩位經理花了好幾個小時嘗試協商達成一個對兩家公司長期有利的協議。","explanation":"動詞「協商」。常用搭配：negotiate a deal (協商達成協議)。"},{"sentence":"The student representative <target>negotiated</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the principal to extend the deadline for the school project.","translation":"學生代表與校長協商，以延長學校計畫的截止日期。","explanation":"動詞「協商」。常用搭配：negotiate with sb (與某人協商)。"},{"sentence":"It is often difficult to <target>negotiate</target> <pattern>the terms</pattern> of a contract when the two parties have completely different goals.","translation":"當兩方有完全不同的目標時，協商合約的條款通常很困難。","explanation":"動詞「協商」。常用搭配：negotiate the terms (協商條款)。"}],"related_forms":["negotiation","negotiator"]}

{"headword":"nevertheless","explanation":"副詞「儘管如此、然而」。用於表示轉折，相當於 however 或 nonetheless。通常放在句首或句中，用逗號隔開。","entries":[{"sentence":"The weather forecast predicted heavy rain for the weekend; <target>nevertheless</target>, the hiking club decided to proceed with their planned trip.","translation":"天氣預報預測週末會下大雨；儘管如此，登山俱樂部仍決定繼續他們原定的旅程。","explanation":"副詞「儘管如此」。表示對前句內容的轉折。"},{"sentence":"The exam was extremely difficult and many students struggled; <target>nevertheless</target>, she managed to pass it with a high score.","translation":"考試極其困難，許多學生感到吃力；然而，她還是設法以高分通過了考試。","explanation":"副詞「然而」。強調儘管有困難，結果依然發生。"},{"sentence":"He had very little experience in public speaking; <target>nevertheless</target>, he delivered a confident and inspiring speech to the whole school.","translation":"他幾乎沒有公開演講的經驗；儘管如此，他還是向全校發表了一場自信且激勵人心的演講。","explanation":"副詞「儘管如此」。用於表示對比。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"nightmare","explanation":"名詞「噩夢」。既可用於指真正的睡眠中的噩夢，也可用於比喻指極其糟糕的經驗或情況。","entries":[{"sentence":"After watching a scary movie late at night, the little boy woke up screaming after having a terrible <target>nightmare</target>.","translation":"深夜看過恐怖電影後，小男孩在做了一個可怕的噩夢後尖叫著醒來。","explanation":"名詞「噩夢」。指睡眠中的恐懼夢境。"},{"sentence":"Trying to find a parking spot in the city center during the rush hour is a complete <target>nightmare</target> for every driver.","translation":"在尖峰時段在市中心找停車位對每位駕駛來說完全是一場噩夢。","explanation":"名詞「噩夢」。比喻極其混亂或糟糕的情況。"},{"sentence":"The flight was delayed for ten hours due to a technical failure, making the entire trip a total <target>nightmare</target> for the passengers.","translation":"航班因為技術故障延遲了十個小時，使整個旅程對乘客來說完全是一場噩夢。","explanation":"名詞「噩夢」。比喻極其令人沮喪的經驗。"}],"related_forms":["nightmares"]}

{"headword":"noble","explanation":"形容詞「高尚的、貴族的」；名詞「貴族」。形容詞用法常指品格高尚，如 noble character (高尚的品格)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Helping others without expecting anything in return is a <target>noble</target> <pattern>act</pattern> that deserves respect from everyone.","translation":"不求回報地幫助他人是一種高尚的行為，值得每個人的尊重。","explanation":"形容詞「高尚的」。常用搭配：noble act (高尚的行為)。"},{"sentence":"The young man showed a <target>noble</target> <pattern>spirit</pattern> by admitting his mistake and apologizing to his classmates publicly.","translation":"這個年輕人通過承認錯誤並道歉，展現了高尚的精神。","explanation":"形容詞「高尚的」。常用搭配：noble spirit (高尚的精神)。"},{"sentence":"In the history books, we learned about the <target>noble</target> <pattern>families</pattern> who once held great power and influence in the royal court.","translation":"在歷史書中，我們學習了那些曾經在皇宮中擁有巨大權力和影響力的貴族家庭。","explanation":"形容詞「貴族的」。指社會地位高的人。"},{"sentence":"The king appointed a <target>noble</target> to manage the land and collect taxes from the villagers in the northern region.","translation":"國王任命一名貴族來管理土地並向北區的村民徵收稅款。","explanation":"名詞「貴族」。指具有貴族身分的人。"}],"related_forms":["nobility","nobly"]}

{"headword":"nonsense","explanation":"名詞「胡言亂語、廢話」。指沒有意義、邏輯錯誤或荒謬的話語。常用搭配 nonsense talk (胡言亂語)，以及片語 make nonsense of (使...失去意義)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Stop talking <target>nonsense</target> and focus on the facts of the case, because we need to make a decision based on evidence.","translation":"別再說胡言亂語了，專注於案件的事實，因為我們需要根據證據做出決定。","explanation":"名詞「胡言亂語」。在此指說出的話沒有根據且荒謬。"},{"sentence":"The teacher told the students that the idea of a flat earth was complete <target>nonsense</target>, explaining the scientific reasons why the earth is round.","translation":"老師告訴學生們，地球是平的這種想法完全是胡言亂語，並解釋了地球是圓形的科學原因。","explanation":"名詞「胡言亂語」。指一種荒謬且不符合事實的觀念。"},{"sentence":"He tried to explain his mistake, but his excuse sounded like absolute <target>nonsense</target> to the committee members who heard the story.","translation":"他試圖解釋他的錯誤，但他的藉口在聽到故事的委員會成員耳中聽起來像是完全的廢話。","explanation":"名詞「廢話」。指缺乏邏輯或不可信的解釋。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"nowadays","explanation":"副詞「如今，現今」。用於描述當前的狀態或趨勢，通常與 past (過去) 相對。注意它本身就是副詞，因此不需要接介系詞，且常位於句首或句末。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many students <target>nowadays</target> prefer using digital tablets for note-taking instead of traditional notebooks, as it is more convenient for organizing information.","translation":"如今許多學生更喜歡使用數位平板電腦做筆記，而不是傳統的筆記本，因為這樣在組織資訊方面更方便。","explanation":"副詞「如今」。描述當前學生的學習習慣。"},{"sentence":"Compared to the past, <target>nowadays</target> people are more aware of the importance of protecting the environment and reducing plastic waste in the ocean.","translation":"與過去相比，現今人們更意識到保護環境和減少海洋塑料垃圾的重要性。","explanation":"副詞「現今」。用於對比過去與現在的社會趨勢。"},{"sentence":"It is becoming more common <target>nowadays</target> for young people to pursue careers in the creative industries, such as graphic design or game development.","translation":"如今年輕人追求創意產業的職業，如平面設計或遊戲開發，正變得越來越普遍。","explanation":"副詞「如今」。描述當前的職業選擇趨勢。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"nuclear","explanation":"形容詞「核能的、原子核的」。常用於 nuclear energy (核能)、nuclear power plant (核電廠)、nuclear weapon (核武器)。注意其在物理學中的基本定義指與原子核有關。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government is debating whether to build a new <target>nuclear</target> <pattern>power plant</pattern> to provide a more stable source of electricity for the growing city.","translation":"政府正在討論是否建造一座新的核電廠，以為這個成長中的城市提供更穩定的電力來源。","explanation":"形容詞「核能的」。常用搭配：nuclear power plant (核電廠)。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are researching how to safely dispose of <target>nuclear</target> <pattern>waste</pattern> to prevent long-term radiation leaks into the surrounding environment.","translation":"科學家正在研究如何安全地處理核廢料，以防止長期輻射外洩至周圍環境。","explanation":"形容詞「核能的」。常用搭配：nuclear waste (核廢料)。"},{"sentence":"The international community works together to prevent the spread of <target>nuclear</target> <pattern>weapons</pattern> to ensure global peace and security.","translation":"國際社會共同努力防止核武器的擴散，以確保全球和平與安全。","explanation":"形容詞「核能的」。常用搭配：nuclear weapons (核武器)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"numerous","explanation":"形容詞「許多、大量的」。比 many 更有正式感，常用於描述數量多且可數的事物。常用搭配 numerous times (多次), numerous opportunities (許多機會)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The professor has published <target>numerous</target> <pattern>articles</pattern> in international journals, making him a leading expert in the field of linguistics.","translation":"這位教授在國際期刊上發表了許多文章，使他成為語言學領域的領先專家。","explanation":"形容詞「許多」。用於描述可數的名詞 articles。"},{"sentence":"Despite <target>numerous</target> <pattern>attempts</pattern> to fix the old computer, the technician finally decided that it was too old to be repaired.","translation":"儘管多次嘗試修理這台舊電腦，技術員最終決定它太舊而無法修理。","explanation":"形容詞「許多」。常用搭配：numerous attempts (多次嘗試)。"},{"sentence":"There are <target>numerous</target> <pattern>reasons</pattern> why students should learn a second language, including better career prospects and a wider perspective on the world.","translation":"學生學習第二語言有許多原因，包括更好的職涯前景和更寬廣的世界觀。","explanation":"形容詞「許多」。常用搭配：numerous reasons (許多原因)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"nursery","explanation":"名詞「托兒所、苗圃」。指照顧幼兒的場所或培育幼苗的場所。注意其與 preschool (幼稚園) 的微小區別，nursery 通常指更年幼的兒童。","entries":[{"sentence":"Working parents often send their children to a <target>nursery</target> during the day, where they can play and learn basic social skills with other kids.","translation":"雙職父母經常在白天將孩子送到托兒所，讓他們能在那裡與其他孩子一起玩耍並學習基本的社交技巧。","explanation":"名詞「托兒所」。指照顧幼兒的場所。"},{"sentence":"The gardening club decided to visit a local <target>nursery</target> to buy some rare flowers and organic soil for their school garden project.","translation":"園藝俱樂部決定造訪當地的一家苗圃，為他們的學校花園計畫購買一些稀有花卉和有機土壤。","explanation":"名詞「苗圃」。指培育植物的場所。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"nutritious","explanation":"形容詞「營養的」。指食物包含身體所需的必需營養素。常用搭配 a nutritious meal (營養餐), nutritious food (營養食物)。注意與 nutrition (營養, 名詞) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"Eating a <target>nutritious</target> <pattern>breakfast</pattern> every morning provides students with the energy and focus they need to perform well in class.","translation":"每天早上吃營養的早餐能為學生提供在課堂上表現良好所需的能量和專注力。","explanation":"形容詞「營養的」。常用搭配：nutritious breakfast (營養早餐)。"},{"sentence":"The school cafeteria has introduced more <target>nutritious</target> <pattern>options</pattern>, such as fresh salads and whole grain bread, to promote healthier eating habits among students.","translation":"學校食堂引入了更多營養的選擇，如新鮮沙拉和全穀類麵包，以促進學生建立更健康的飲食習慣。","explanation":"形容詞「營養的」。常用搭配：nutritious options (營養選擇)。"},{"sentence":"Parents are encouraged to provide <target>nutritious</target> <pattern>snacks</pattern> for their children instead of sugary candies, which can lead to poor health over time.","translation":"家長被鼓勵為孩子提供營養的零食，而不是含糖量高的糖果，因為長期如此可能會導致健康狀況不佳。","explanation":"形容詞「營養的」。常用搭配：nutritious snacks (營養零食)。"}],"related_forms":["nutrition","nutritiously"]}

{"headword":"obedience","explanation":"名詞「服從、順從」。指遵守指令、法律或規則的行為。常用搭配 show obedience to (對...表現出服從), strict obedience (嚴格服從)。","entries":[{"sentence":"In some traditional schools, strict <target>obedience</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the teacher's instructions is expected, although modern education encourages more critical thinking.","translation":"在一些傳統學校中，要求對老師的指示嚴格服從，儘管現代教育鼓勵更多的批判性思考。","explanation":"名詞「服從」。常用搭配：obedience to (對...的服從)。"},{"sentence":"The trainer spent several weeks teaching the dog <target>obedience</target>, ensuring it would sit, stay, and come when called by its owner.","translation":"訓練師花了好幾週時間教導這隻狗服從訓練，確保它在主人呼喚時會坐下、待在原處並回來。","explanation":"名詞「服從」。在此指動物的訓練過程。"},{"sentence":"The soldiers were praised for their <target>obedience</target> and discipline, which allowed the army to execute the complex plan without any mistakes.","translation":"士兵們因其服從和紀律而受到稱讚，這使軍隊能毫不出錯地執行複雜的計畫。","explanation":"名詞「服從」。指遵守軍事指令的行為。"}],"related_forms":["obedient"]}

{"headword":"obedient","explanation":"形容詞「服從的、聽話的」。描述人或動物遵守指令的狀態。常用搭配 an obedient child (聽話的孩子), obedient to (服從於...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The parents were proud of their <target>obedient</target> daughter, who always followed their advice and studied hard for her exams.","translation":"父母對他們聽話的女兒感到自豪，因為她總是遵循他們的建議並努力學習準備考試。","explanation":"形容詞「服從的、聽話的」。"},{"sentence":"While the dog was generally <target>obedient</target>, it sometimes became distracted by the scent of food, causing it to ignore the owner's commands.","translation":"雖然這隻狗通常很聽話，但有時會被食物的味道吸引而分心，導致它忽略主人的指令。","explanation":"形容詞「服從的、聽話的」。"},{"sentence":"The teacher appreciated the students who were <target>obedient</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the school rules, as they helped create a peaceful learning environment for everyone.","translation":"老師欣賞那些服從學校規則的學生，因為他們幫助創造了一個對每個人都寧靜的學習環境。","explanation":"形容詞「服從的」。常用搭配：obedient to (服從於...)。"}],"related_forms":["obedience"]}

{"headword":"objection","explanation":"名詞「反對、異議」。指對某事表示不贊成或反對的理由。常用搭配 raise an objection (提出反對), have no objection to (對...沒有異議)。","entries":[{"sentence":"When the student council proposed a new uniform policy, several students <pattern>raised</pattern> an <target>objection</target> during the meeting, arguing that it limited their freedom.","translation":"當學生會提出新的制服政策時，幾名學生在會議期間提出了反對，認為這限制了他們的自由。","explanation":"名詞「反對」。常用搭配：raise an objection (提出反對)。"},{"sentence":"I have no <target>objection</target> <pattern>to</pattern> changing the meeting time to Friday afternoon, as long as it is convenient for everyone involved.","translation":"我對將會議時間改到週五下午沒有異議，只要對所有參與者都方便。","explanation":"名詞「異議」。常用搭配：have no objection to (對...沒有異議)。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer presented several strong <target>objections</target> to the witness's testimony, claiming that the evidence was not reliable enough for the court.","translation":"律師對證人的證詞提出了幾個強而有力的反對理由，聲稱該證據對法院來說不夠可靠。","explanation":"名詞「反對」。指在法律程序中提出的異議。"}],"related_forms":["object"]}

{"headword":"objective","explanation":"名詞「目標」；形容詞「客觀的」。名詞用法指設定的達成目標；形容詞用法指基於事實而非個人情感的。注意與 subjective (主觀的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The main <target>objective</target> of this research project is to find a more sustainable way to produce energy without damaging the environment.","translation":"這項研究計畫的主要目標是找到一種更永續的方式來生產能源而不會破壞環境。","explanation":"名詞「目標」。指設定的達成目標。"},{"sentence":"To achieve her long-term <target>objectives</target>, the student decided to join a few online courses to improve her speaking and writing skills.","translation":"為了達成她的長期目標，這名學生決定參加幾個線上課程來提高她的口說和寫作技巧。","explanation":"名詞「目標」。"},{"sentence":"A journalist must remain <target>objective</target> when reporting the news, ensuring that the facts are presented without any personal bias or emotion.","translation":"記者在報導新聞時必須保持客觀，確保事實的呈現沒有任何個人偏見或情緒。","explanation":"形容詞「客觀的」。指基於事實而非個人意見。"},{"sentence":"The teacher provided <target>objective</target> <pattern>criteria</pattern> for grading the essays, so students knew exactly what was required to get a high score.","translation":"老師為作文評分提供了客觀的標準，因此學生知道要獲得高分具體需要什麼。","explanation":"形容詞「客觀的」。常用搭配：objective criteria (客觀標準)。"}],"related_forms":["objectively"]}

{"headword":"observation","explanation":"名詞「觀察」或「遵守」。指透過感官獲取資訊的過程，或遵守規則/法律。常用片語 under observation (在觀察中), make an observation (做出觀察)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The biologist spent several months in the rainforest, making careful <target>observations</target> of the rare birds to understand their mating habits.","translation":"生物學家在雨林中度過了好幾個月，對稀有鳥類進行仔細觀察，以了解牠們的交配習性。","explanation":"名詞「觀察」。指透過感官記錄事物的行為或特徵。"},{"sentence":"The patient was kept <pattern>under</pattern> <target>observation</target> in the hospital for twenty-four hours to ensure there were no unexpected complications after the surgery.","translation":"病人被留在醫院觀察 24 小時，以確保手術後沒有意外的併發症。","explanation":"名詞「觀察」。常用片語 under observation 表示在醫療或科學觀察中。"},{"sentence":"The strict <target>observation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> school rules is required from all students to maintain a safe and orderly learning environment.","translation":"所有學生都必須嚴格遵守校規，以維持一個安全且有序的學習環境。","explanation":"名詞「遵守」。指遵守法律、規則或傳統。常用搭配 observation of rules/laws。"}],"related_forms":["observe","observational"]}

{"headword":"obstacle","explanation":"名詞「障礙、阻礙」。可指物理上的障礙物，也可指抽象的困難。常用搭配 overcome an obstacle (克服障礙), face an obstacle (面臨障礙)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The fallen tree across the road became a major <target>obstacle</target> for the rescue team, delaying their arrival at the village.","translation":"橫在路上的倒樹成了救援隊的一個主要障礙，延遲了他們到達村莊的時間。","explanation":"名詞「障礙物」。指物理上的阻礙。"},{"sentence":"Language barriers can be a significant <target>obstacle</target> <pattern>to</pattern> international communication, making it difficult for people from different cultures to understand each other.","translation":"語言障礙可能是國際交流的一個重大阻礙，使得來自不同文化的人們難以相互理解。","explanation":"名詞「阻礙」。指抽象的困難。常用搭配 obstacle to sth。"},{"sentence":"Despite facing many financial <target>obstacles</target>, the young entrepreneur managed to start his own company and achieve great success.","translation":"儘管面臨許多財務障礙，這位年輕的創業家仍成功創立了自己的公司並取得了巨大的成功。","explanation":"名詞「阻礙」。常用搭配 overcome obstacles (克服障礙)。"}],"related_forms":["obstruction"]}

{"headword":"obtain","explanation":"動詞「獲得、取得」。通常指經過努力、請求或特定的程序而得到某物。常用於正式語境，注意與 get 的區別：obtain 較正式且通常暗示著一個過程。","entries":[{"sentence":"Students must <target>obtain</target> written permission <pattern>from</pattern> the principal before they can take their personal laptops to the classroom.","translation":"學生在將個人筆記型電腦帶入教室之前，必須獲得校長的書面許可。","explanation":"動詞「獲得」。常用於正式請求許可或文件。"},{"sentence":"The researchers were able to <target>obtain</target> accurate data <pattern>through</pattern> a series of detailed surveys and interviews with local residents.","translation":"研究人員能夠透過一系列對當地居民的詳細調查和訪談，獲得準確的數據。","explanation":"動詞「取得」。指透過特定方法獲取資訊。"},{"sentence":"It is sometimes difficult to <target>obtain</target> a visa for certain countries, especially if you do not have a clear travel itinerary.","translation":"有時很困難能獲得某些國家的簽證，尤其是如果你沒有明確的旅行行程表。","explanation":"動詞「獲得」。指透過行政程序取得文件。"}],"related_forms":["obtainable"]}

{"headword":"occasional","explanation":"形容詞「偶爾的、間歇的」。指不經常發生的事情。常用搭配 an occasional occurrence (偶爾發生的事), on occasional occasions (在偶爾的情況下)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although he usually prefers tea, he enjoys an <target>occasional</target> cup of coffee to help him stay awake during late-night study sessions.","translation":"雖然他通常喜歡喝茶，但他在熬夜唸書時偶爾會喝杯咖啡來幫助他保持清醒。","explanation":"形容詞「偶爾的」。指不經常發生的習慣。"},{"sentence":"The quiet neighborhood is generally peaceful, except for the <target>occasional</target> sound of dogs barking in the distance.","translation":"這個安靜的社區通常很和平，除了偶爾能聽到遠處傳來的狗吠聲。","explanation":"形容詞「偶爾的」。描述事情發生的頻率低。"},{"sentence":"The teacher makes <target>occasional</target> <pattern>comments</pattern> during the lecture to encourage students to think critically about the topic.","translation":"老師在講座期間偶爾會發表評論，以鼓勵學生對該主題進行批判性思考。","explanation":"形容詞「偶爾的」。常用於描述不連續的行為。"}],"related_forms":["occasionally","occasion"]}

{"headword":"occupation","explanation":"名詞「職業」或「佔領」。在 GSAT 考點中，「職業」是最常見的用法，而「佔領」常出現在歷史或戰爭相關文章中。常用搭配 What is your occupation? (你的職業是什麼？)。","entries":[{"sentence":"When filling out the application form, please state your current <target>occupation</target> and the company where you are currently employed.","translation":"填寫申請表時，請註明您目前的職業以及您目前就職的公司。","explanation":"名詞「職業」。正式用法，指一個人的工作。"},{"sentence":"Teaching is a demanding <target>occupation</target> that requires not only deep knowledge of the subject but also great patience with students.","translation":"教學是一項要求很高的職業，不僅需要對學科有深厚的知識，還需要對學生有極大的耐心。","explanation":"名詞「職業」。"},{"sentence":"The history textbook describes the military <target>occupation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the city during the war, which led to widespread hardship for the citizens.","translation":"歷史教科書描述了戰爭期間軍隊對該城市的佔領，這導致市民遭受了廣泛的苦難。","explanation":"名詞「佔領」。指軍隊進入並控制某個地區。"}],"related_forms":["occupy","occupational"]}

{"headword":"occupy","explanation":"動詞「佔據、佔用」。可指空間、時間、心智或領土的佔領。常用片語 be occupied with (忙於...), occupy one's mind (佔據某人的心智)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The small apartment is too crowded because the large dining table <target>occupies</target> most of the space in the living room.","translation":"這間小公寓太擁擠了，因為巨大的餐桌佔據了客廳的大部分空間。","explanation":"動詞「佔據」。指物理空間的佔用。"},{"sentence":"During the summer break, many students <target>occupy</target> their free time <pattern>by</pattern> volunteering at local charities or learning new skills.","translation":"在暑假期間，許多學生透過在當地慈善機構擔任志工或學習新技能來填滿他們的空閒時間。","explanation":"動詞「佔用」。指時間的利用。"},{"sentence":"The thought of the upcoming final exams <target>occupied</target> her <target>mind</target> completely, making it hard for her to focus on other activities.","translation":"即將到來的期末考的想法完全佔據了她的心智，使她難以專注於其他活動。","explanation":"動詞「佔據」。指心理上的關注。"},{"sentence":"The invading army <target>occupied</target> the strategic port city for several years, controlling all the trade routes in the region.","translation":"入侵軍隊佔領了這個戰略港口城市數年，控制了該地區所有的貿易路線。","explanation":"動詞「佔領」。指領土的控制。"}],"related_forms":["occupation","occupant"]}

{"headword":"offend","explanation":"動詞「冒犯、得罪」或「觸犯(法律)」。常用搭配 offend someone (冒犯某人), be offended by (被...冒犯)。","entries":[{"sentence":"He didn't mean to <target>offend</target> his teacher, but his blunt comment about the lesson's difficulty was taken as a sign of disrespect.","translation":"他並非有意冒犯老師，但他對課程難度直率的評論被視為不尊重的表現。","explanation":"動詞「冒犯」。指使人感到不快或被侮辱。"},{"sentence":"Some people were deeply <target>offended</target> <pattern>by</pattern> the controversial images in the art exhibition, claiming they were culturally insensitive.","translation":"有些人對藝術展中具有爭議的圖像感到深切不快，聲稱這些圖像在文化上缺乏敏感度。","explanation":"動詞「冒犯」。此處為被動語態，表示「被...冒犯」。"},{"sentence":"The young man was arrested after he <target>offended</target> <pattern>against</pattern> the local laws by stealing a bicycle from the park.","translation":"這名年輕男子在觸犯當地法律偷走公園的一輛自行車後被逮捕。","explanation":"動詞「觸犯」。常用搭配 offend against the law。"}],"related_forms":["offense","offensive"]}

{"headword":"offense","explanation":"名詞「 offense」可指「罪行」或「冒犯」。在體育比賽中，指「進攻」。注意英式英語常用 offence。","entries":[{"sentence":"Driving over the speed limit is a serious traffic <target>offense</target>, and those who do so may face heavy fines or lose their license.","translation":"超速駕駛是一項嚴重的交通違規，違規者可能面臨重罰或吊銷駕照。","explanation":"名詞「罪行、違規」。指違反法律或規則的行為。"},{"sentence":"She apologized sincerely, explaining that her comment was not intended as an <target>offense</target> to anyone in the room.","translation":"她誠懇地道歉，解釋說她的評論並非意圖冒犯在場的任何人。","explanation":"名詞「冒犯」。指引起不快或憤怒的行為。"},{"sentence":"The basketball team's strong <target>offense</target> allowed them to score many points quickly, leading them to a victory in the championship game.","translation":"籃球隊強大的進攻火力使他們能快速得分，讓他們在冠軍賽中贏得了勝利。","explanation":"名詞「進攻」。體育術語。"}],"related_forms":["offend","offensive"]}

{"headword":"offensive","explanation":"形容詞「冒犯的、令人不快的」或「進攻的」。名詞可指「進攻」。常用搭配 offensive smell (難聞的氣味), launch an offensive (發起進攻)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student's <target>offensive</target> language during the debate was criticized by the judges, as it failed to show respect for the opposing view.","translation":"學生在辯論中使用的冒犯性語言受到評審的批評，因為這未能表現出對相反觀點的尊重。","explanation":"形容詞「冒犯的」。指令人感到不快或被侮辱。"},{"sentence":"The garbage disposal area emitted an <target>offensive</target> <pattern>smell</pattern> that made it impossible for anyone to walk past without holding their breath.","translation":"垃圾處理區散發出一種難聞的氣味，使任何人經過時都必須屏住呼吸。","explanation":"形容詞「令人不快的」。常用搭配 offensive smell (難聞的氣味)。"},{"sentence":"The military launched a major <target>offensive</target> in the spring to recapture the strategic hills and push the enemy back.","translation":"軍方在春季發起了一次大規模進攻，以奪回戰略高地並將敵人擊退。","explanation":"名詞「進攻」。指軍事上的攻擊行動。"}],"related_forms":["offend","offense"]}

{"headword":"opera","explanation":"名詞「歌劇」。一種結合音樂、戲劇和歌唱的藝術形式。常用搭配 go to the opera (去聽歌劇)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city's grand <target>opera</target> house is famous for its stunning architecture and world-class performances by renowned singers.","translation":"這座城市的宏偉歌劇院以其壯麗的建築和世界級名歌手的演出而聞名。","explanation":"名詞「歌劇」。"},{"sentence":"After years of studying music, the student finally had the chance to attend a professional <target>opera</target> and experience the power of live singing.","translation":"經過多年的音樂學習，這名學生終於有機會參加一場專業的歌劇演出，體驗現場演唱的力量。","explanation":"名詞「歌劇」。"}],"related_forms":["operatic","opera singer"]}

{"headword":"oppose","explanation":"動詞「反對」。指對某個計畫、想法或決定表示不贊同。常用搭配 oppose the plan/idea。注意與 opposite (相對的) 及 opposition (反對) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many parents <target>oppose</target> the school's decision to increase homework, arguing that students need more time for rest and physical activity.","translation":"許多家長反對學校增加作業的決定，認為學生需要更多時間休息和進行身體活動。","explanation":"動詞「反對」。常用搭配 oppose the decision/plan。"},{"sentence":"Despite the strong arguments in favor of the project, several committee members continued to <target>oppose</target> it <pattern>on the grounds that</pattern> it was too expensive.","translation":"儘管有強而有力的支持論點，幾位委員會成員仍以成本過高為由繼續反對該計畫。","explanation":"動詞「反對」。on the grounds that 意為「以...為理由」。"},{"sentence":"The local community strongly <target>opposed</target> the construction of the new shopping mall, fearing that it would destroy the natural beauty of the area.","translation":"當地社區強烈反對興建新的購物中心，擔心這會破壞該地區的自然美景。","explanation":"動詞「反對」。常用副詞搭配 strongly opposed。"}],"related_forms":["opposed","opposition","opponent"]}

{"headword":"option","explanation":"名詞「選項、選擇」。指在多個可能性中挑選其中一個。常用搭配 have no option but to (別無選擇只能...)、give someone an option (給某人選擇)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Since the original flight was cancelled, the travel agent told the passengers they had no <target>option</target> <pattern>but to</pattern> wait for the next available plane.","translation":"由於原定航班被取消，旅行社告訴乘客他們別無選擇，只能等待下一班飛機。","explanation":"名詞「選項」。常用片語 have no option but to (別無選擇只能...)。"},{"sentence":"The new online course provides students with several <target>options</target> for submitting their final projects, including a written report or a video presentation.","translation":"新的線上課程為學生提供了幾種提交期末專題的選項，包括書面報告或影片演示。","explanation":"名詞「選項」。常用於描述多種可能的選擇。"},{"sentence":"When choosing a university major, students should consider various <target>options</target> carefully to ensure their choice aligns with their future career goals.","translation":"在選擇大學專業時，學生應仔細考慮各種選項，以確保他們的選擇與未來的職業目標一致。","explanation":"名詞「選項」。常用於描述在多個可能性中做決定。"}],"related_forms":["optional"]}

{"headword":"orbit","explanation":"名詞「軌道」；動詞「繞行、繞軌」。指天體或人造衛星在重力作用下繞著另一個天體運行的路徑或行為。常用搭配 in orbit (在軌道上)、enter orbit (進入軌道)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The space agency successfully launched a new satellite into <target>orbit</target> to monitor global weather patterns and provide more accurate forecasts.","translation":"太空機構成功地將一顆新衛星送入軌道，以監測全球天氣模式並提供更準確的預報。","explanation":"名詞「軌道」。常用搭配 in orbit, launch into orbit。"},{"sentence":"The Earth takes approximately 365 days to <target>orbit</target> the Sun, which leads to the changing seasons we experience every year.","translation":"地球大約需要365天繞行太陽，這導致了我們每年經歷的季節變化。","explanation":"動詞「繞行」。指天體繞著另一個天體運行的行為。"},{"sentence":"Astronomers observed a small asteroid as it began to <target>orbit</target> the planet, helping them understand the gravitational forces at play in the solar system.","translation":"天文學家觀察到一顆小行星開始繞行該行星，幫助他們理解太陽系中的重力作用。","explanation":"動詞「繞行」。常用於天文學語境。"}],"related_forms":["orbital"]}

{"headword":"orchestra","explanation":"名詞「管弦樂團」。由弦樂、木管、銅管和打擊樂器組成的大型樂團。常用搭配 symphony orchestra (交響樂團)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The high school <target>orchestra</target> practiced for several weeks to perform a complex classical piece at the annual winter concert.","translation":"高中管弦樂團練習了幾個星期，以便在年度冬季音樂會上表演一段複雜的古典曲目。","explanation":"名詞「管弦樂團」。指由多種樂器組成的樂團。"},{"sentence":"The conductor led the <target>orchestra</target> with great passion, ensuring that every instrument played in perfect harmony during the final movement of the symphony.","translation":"指揮帶領著管弦樂團，以極大的熱情地演出，確保在交響曲的最後一個樂章中每件樂器都完美和諧。","explanation":"名詞「管弦樂團」。常用搭配 conductor led the orchestra。"},{"sentence":"Many students aspire to join the city's professional <target>orchestra</target> after graduating from the music conservatory to pursue a career as a professional musician.","translation":"許多學生在從音樂學院畢業後，渴望加入這座城市的專業管弦樂團，以追求成為專業音樂家的職業。","explanation":"名詞「管弦樂團」。"}],"related_forms":["orchestral"]}

{"headword":"orientation","explanation":"名詞「方向、傾向；迎新、方向說明」。在學校或公司中，orientation 指的是為新進人員提供基本資訊和適應環境的過程。常用搭配 orientation program (迎新計畫/方向說明會)。","entries":[{"sentence":"All new freshmen are required to attend the <target>orientation</target> <pattern>session</pattern> to learn about campus facilities and the university's academic rules.","translation":"所有新入學的 freshman 必須參加迎新說明會，以了解校園設施和大學的學術規則。","explanation":"名詞「迎新說明會」。常用搭配 orientation session/program。"},{"sentence":"The company's <target>orientation</target> <pattern>day</pattern> helped new employees understand the corporate culture and their specific responsibilities within the team.","translation":"公司的迎新日幫助新員工理解公司文化以及他們在團隊中的具體職責。","explanation":"名詞「迎新日」。指為新進人員提供資訊的過程。"},{"sentence":"The professor explained that the research project had a strong <target>orientation</target> <pattern>toward</pattern> practical application, rather than just theoretical study.","translation":"教授解釋說，這項研究計畫具有強烈的實務應用傾向，而非僅僅是理論研究。","explanation":"名詞「傾向」。指對某種特定方向或目標的傾向。"}],"related_forms":["orient"]}

{"headword":"orphan","explanation":"名詞「孤兒」。指父母雙亡或其中一方亡的兒童。動詞「使成為孤兒」較少見，但在文學或歷史語境中可能出現。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young <target>orphan</target> was adopted by a kind couple who provided him with a loving home and the support he needed to grow up.","translation":"這個年幼的孤兒被一對善良的夫婦收養，他們為他提供了充滿愛心的家和成長所需的支持。","explanation":"名詞「孤兒」。"},{"sentence":"After the devastating earthquake, several international organizations worked together to provide shelter and education for the <target>orphans</target> left behind.","translation":"在毀滅性的地震後，幾個國際組織共同努力為留下的孤兒提供住所和教育。","explanation":"名詞「孤兒」。"},{"sentence":"The novel tells the story of a brave <target>orphan</target> who overcomes various challenges to find his long-lost family in a distant city.","translation":"小說講述了一個勇敢的孤兒克服各種挑戰，在遙遠的城市中尋找他失散多年的家人。","explanation":"名詞「孤兒」。"}],"related_forms":["orphanage"]}

{"headword":"otherwise","explanation":"副詞「否則」。用於連接兩個句子，表示如果前述條件不滿足，將會發生另一種結果。常見搭配 otherwise, ... (否則...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"You must submit your application before the deadline; <target>otherwise</target>, the admissions office will not consider your request for enrollment.","translation":"你必須在截止日期前提交申請；否則，招生辦公室將不會考慮你的入學申請。","explanation":"副詞「否則」。用於引導出不滿足條件後的結果。"},{"sentence":"The students were told to bring their own laptops to the seminar, <target>otherwise</target> they would not be able to participate in the interactive activities.","translation":"學生們被告知要攜帶自己的筆電參加研討會，否則他們將無法參與互動活動。","explanation":"副詞「否則」。"},{"sentence":"Although the dress was a bit too large, it was <target>otherwise</target> perfect for the formal event, as the color and fabric were excellent.","translation":"雖然這件衣服稍微大了一點，但除此之外，它非常適合這次正式活動，因為顏色和面料都極佳。","explanation":"副詞「除此之外」。指在某個特定方面除了上述內容外，其他部分是某種狀態。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"outcome","explanation":"名詞「結果」。指一個過程、事件或行動之後的最終結果。常用搭配 final outcome (最終結果)、positive/negative outcome (正面/負面結果)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctors are monitoring the patient's condition closely, hoping for a positive <target>outcome</target> after the surgery to ensure a full recovery.","translation":"醫生正在密切監控患者的病情，希望手術後有正面的結果以確保完全康復。","explanation":"名詞「結果」。常用搭配 positive outcome。"},{"sentence":"The final <target>outcome</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the election was unexpected, as a candidate who was not widely known had won the majority of votes.","translation":"選舉的最終結果出乎意料，因為一位不被廣泛認知的候選人贏得了大多數選票。","explanation":"名詞「結果」。常用搭配 outcome of sth。"},{"sentence":"Many students worry about the <target>outcome</target> of their final exams, but the teacher encouraged them to stay calm and focus on their preparation.","translation":"許多學生擔心期末考的結果，但老師鼓勵他們保持冷靜並專注於準備工作。","explanation":"名詞「結果」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"outstanding","explanation":"形容詞「卓越的、傑出的」；「未支付的、未解決的」。注意這兩個完全不同的意思。前者常用於描述能力或成就，後者常用於財務或法律語境。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student received a scholarship because of her <target>outstanding</target> <pattern>academic performance</pattern>, which impressed all the professors in the department.","translation":"這名學生因為卓越的學業表現而獲得獎學金，這讓系上所有教授都印象深刻。","explanation":"形容詞「卓越的、傑出的」。常用搭配 outstanding academic performance。"},{"sentence":"The athlete's <target>outstanding</target> <pattern>contribution</pattern> to the sport has earned him a place in the hall of fame, inspiring millions of young people.","translation":"這位運動員對這項運動的傑出貢獻使他進入了名人堂，激勵了數百萬年輕人。","explanation":"形容詞「傑出的」。常用搭配 outstanding contribution。"},{"sentence":"The company sent a reminder email to the client, noting that there was an <target>outstanding</target> <pattern>balance</pattern> on their account that needed to be paid.","translation":"公司向客戶發送了一封提醒郵件，指出其帳戶中有一筆未支付的餘額需要支付。","explanation":"形容詞「未支付的、未解決的」。常用搭配 outstanding balance, outstanding debt。"}],"related_forms":["outstandingly"]}

{"headword":"oval","explanation":"形容詞「橢圓形的」；名詞「橢圓形」。常用於描述物體的形狀，如 an oval table (橢圓形桌子) 或 an oval office (橢圓形辦公室)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The dining room features an <target>oval</target> <pattern>table</pattern>, which allows more people to sit comfortably without any sharp corners in the room.","translation":"餐廳裡有一張橢圓形桌子，讓更多人能舒適地坐著，且房間內沒有任何尖銳的角。","explanation":"形容詞「橢圓形的」。常用搭配 oval table。"},{"sentence":"The planet's <target>orbit</target> around the sun is not a perfect circle, but rather an <target>oval</target> <pattern>shape</pattern>, which affects the distance between them.","translation":"行星繞太陽的軌道不是一個完美的圓形，而是橢圓形，這影響了兩者之間的距離。","explanation":"形容詞「橢圓形的」。常用搭配 oval shape。"},{"sentence":"The students were asked to draw an <target>oval</target> on the whiteboard to demonstrate how a certain type of cell is structured in biology class.","translation":"學生們被要求在白板上畫一個橢圓形，以演示某種細胞的類形在生物課上是如何構造的。","explanation":"名詞「橢圓形」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"overcoat","explanation":"名詞「大衣」。指在冬天或寒冷天氣穿在最外層的厚外套，以提供保暖。","entries":[{"sentence":"As the temperature dropped below freezing, he put on a heavy <target>overcoat</target> to keep warm while walking to the train station.","translation":"由於氣溫降至冰點以下，他在走路去火車站時穿上了一件厚大衣以保暖。","explanation":"名詞「大衣」。指最外層的保暖外套。"},{"sentence":"She carefully hung her <target>overcoat</target> in the cloakroom before entering the fancy restaurant for the formal dinner party.","translation":"進入高級餐廳參加正式晚餐派對前，她小心地將大衣掛在衣帽間裡。","explanation":"名詞「大衣」。常用於正式場合或極寒天氣。"},{"sentence":"The detective noticed a small, mysterious key hidden in the pocket of the suspect's <target>overcoat</target> during the investigation.","translation":"在調查過程中，偵探注意到嫌疑犯大衣口袋裡藏著一把神秘的小鑰匙。","explanation":"名詞「大衣」。"}],"related_forms":["overcoats"]}

{"headword":"overcome","explanation":"動詞「克服、戰勝」。用於描述克服困難、恐懼或情緒。注意其不規則變化：overcome-overcame-overcome。","entries":[{"sentence":"With hard work and determination, the student managed to <target>overcome</target> <pattern>his fear of</pattern> public speaking before the final presentation.","translation":"憑藉著努力與決心，這名學生在期末發表前成功克服了對公開演講的恐懼。","explanation":"動詞「克服」。常用搭配 overcome one's fear of sth。"},{"sentence":"The team worked together to <target>overcome</target> <pattern>the challenges</pattern> posed by the unexpected weather changes during their mountain expedition.","translation":"團隊共同努力，以克服登山遠征期間因天氣突然變化而帶來的挑戰。","explanation":"動詞「克服」。常用搭配 overcome challenges/difficulties。"},{"sentence":"She was <target>overcome</target> <pattern>by</pattern> grief after losing her beloved pet, finding it difficult to speak or even move for several days.","translation":"在失去心愛的寵物後，她被悲痛所淹沒，好幾天都難以開口或行動。","explanation":"動詞「被...淹沒/壓倒」。這裡使用被動語態 overcome by (emotion)。"}],"related_forms":["overcame","overcoming"]}

{"headword":"overlook","explanation":"動詞「忽略；俯瞰」。注意其多義性：一是指不小心漏掉或沒注意到某事；二是指建築物或窗戶面向某處。","entries":[{"sentence":"The editor carefully checked the manuscript, but he still <target>overlooked</target> <pattern>a few</pattern> spelling mistakes in the second chapter.","translation":"編輯仔細檢查了原稿，但他在第二章還是忽略了幾個拼字錯誤。","explanation":"動詞「忽略」。指不小心漏掉某事。"},{"sentence":"The manager decided to <target>overlook</target> the employee's minor mistake this time, as it was his first time making such an error.","translation":"經理決定這次忽略員工的小錯誤，因為這是他第一次犯這樣的錯。","explanation":"動詞「寬恕/忽略」。指故意不追究某個小問題。"},{"sentence":"The luxury hotel's balcony <target>overlooks</target> <pattern>the beautiful</pattern> blue ocean, providing guests with a breathtaking view of the coast.","translation":"這家豪華酒店的陽台俯瞰著美麗的藍色大海，為客人提供了令人驚嘆的海岸風景。","explanation":"動詞「俯瞰」。指從高處向下看。"}],"related_forms":["overlooked"]}

{"headword":"overnight","explanation":"副詞「一夜之間」；形容詞「突然的；隔夜的」。常用於描述快速的改變或旅途中的臨時住宿。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young singer became an <target>overnight</target> <pattern>success</pattern> after her video went viral on social media, gaining millions of followers.","translation":"這位年輕歌手在她的影片在社群媒體上瘋傳後，一夜之間成名了，贏得了數百萬名追隨者。","explanation":"形容詞「突然的」。overnight success 指「一夜成名」。"},{"sentence":"Because the flight was delayed for several hours, the airline provided the passengers with <target>overnight</target> <pattern>accommodation</pattern> at a nearby hotel.","translation":"由於航班延誤了數小時，航空公司在附近的飯店為乘客提供了隔夜住宿。","explanation":"形容詞「隔夜的」。overnight accommodation 指「隔夜住宿」。"},{"sentence":"She stayed up <target>overnight</target> to finish her research paper, as the deadline was the following morning at eight o'clock.","translation":"她熬夜直到天亮才完成她的研究報告，因為截止日期是隔天早上八點。","explanation":"副詞「一夜之間/整晚」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"overthrow","explanation":"動詞「推翻」。通常用於描述推翻政府、政權或現有的體制。","entries":[{"sentence":"The rebels organized a secret plan to <target>overthrow</target> <pattern>the oppressive</pattern> <target>government</target> and establish a new democratic system.","translation":"反叛者策劃了一個秘密計劃，旨在推翻壓迫性的政府並建立一個新的民主制度。","explanation":"動詞「推翻」。常用搭配 overthrow the government。"},{"sentence":"Throughout history, many revolutions have occurred when people tried to <target>overthrow</target> <pattern>the ruling</pattern> <target>regime</target> to gain more freedom.","translation":"在歷史上，許多革命發生在人們試圖推翻統治政權以獲得更多自由的時候。","explanation":"動詞「推翻」。常用搭配 overthrow the regime。"},{"sentence":"The military coup was an attempt to <target>overthrow</target> the president and seize control of the country's political power.","translation":"軍事政變是一次試圖推翻總統並奪取國家政治權力的嘗試。","explanation":"動詞「推翻」。"}],"related_forms":["overthrown"]}

{"headword":"oxygen","explanation":"名詞「氧氣」。一種無色無味且維持生命所必需的氣體。","entries":[{"sentence":"Humans and animals need a constant supply of <target>oxygen</target> to survive, which is primarily produced by plants through photosynthesis.","translation":"人類和動物需要持續的氧氣供應才能生存，而氧氣主要是由植物透過光合作用產生的。","explanation":"名詞「氧氣」。"},{"sentence":"Mountain climbers must carry <target>oxygen</target> <pattern>tanks</pattern> when ascending to the summit of Mount Everest due to the thin air at high altitudes.","translation":"登山者在攀登聖母峰頂端時必須攜帶氧氣瓶，因為在高海拔地區空氣稀薄。","explanation":"名詞「氧氣」。常用搭配 oxygen tank (氧氣瓶)。"},{"sentence":"The diver used a special <target>oxygen</target> <pattern>mask</pattern> to breathe underwater, allowing him to explore the coral reefs for a longer period.","translation":"潛水員使用特殊的氧氣面罩在水下呼吸，使他能夠在更長時間內探索珊瑚礁。","explanation":"名詞「氧氣」。常用搭配 oxygen mask (氧氣面罩)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"pace","explanation":"名詞「速度；步伐」；動詞「來回走動」。名詞時常考搭配 pace of life (生活步調)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The fast <target>pace</target> <pattern>of</pattern> life in Taipei often makes people feel stressed and exhausted, leading many to seek a quieter lifestyle.","translation":"台北快節奏的生活步調常使人們感到壓力大且疲憊，導致許多人追求更安靜的生活方式。","explanation":"名詞「速度/步調」。常用搭配 pace of life。"},{"sentence":"The teacher told the students to slow down the <target>pace</target> <pattern>of</pattern> their reading so that everyone could follow the lesson clearly.","translation":"老師告訴學生放慢閱讀速度，以便每個人都能清楚地跟上課程。","explanation":"名詞「速度」。"},{"sentence":"He <target>paced</target> <pattern>back and forth</pattern> in the waiting room, feeling extremely nervous while waiting for the exam results to be announced.","translation":"他在候診室中來回走動，在等待考試結果公布時感到極其緊張。","explanation":"動詞「來回走動」。常用搭配 pace back and forth。"}],"related_forms":["paced","pacing"]}

{"headword":"panel","explanation":"名詞「面板；專家小組」。指一個平面的部分，或是一組被選來討論或決定某事的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The solar <target>panel</target> on the roof of the house converts sunlight into electricity, helping the family save money on energy bills.","translation":"屋頂上的太陽能板將陽光轉化為電能，幫助這家人節省電費。","explanation":"名詞「面板」。指太陽能板等平面裝置。"},{"sentence":"A <target>panel</target> <pattern>of</pattern> experts was invited to discuss the impact of artificial intelligence on future jobs during the university seminar.","translation":"大學研討會邀請了一組專家小組來討論人工智慧對未來工作的影響。","explanation":"名詞「專家小組」。常用搭配 a panel of experts。"},{"sentence":"The control <target>panel</target> of the machine was designed to be user-friendly, with clear labels and buttons for each function.","translation":"這台機器的控制面板設計得非常易於使用，標籤和按鈕對每個功能都標寫得非常清楚。","explanation":"名詞「面板」。指設備上的控制面板。"}],"related_forms":["panels"]}

{"headword":"parachute","explanation":"名詞「降落傘」；動詞「乘坐降落傘跳下」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The pilot had to use his <target>parachute</target> to jump from the plane after the engine failed suddenly mid-flight.","translation":"飛機在飛行中途引擎突然故障後，飛行員不得不使用降落傘跳機。","explanation":"名詞「降落傘」。"},{"sentence":"Before jumping out of the aircraft, the instructors carefully checked if the <target>parachute</target> was <pattern>packed</pattern> <pattern>correctly</pattern> to ensure safety.","translation":"在跳出飛機前，教練們仔細檢查降落傘是否正確地摺疊，以確保安全。","explanation":"名詞「降落傘」。常用搭配 pack a parachute。"},{"sentence":"The soldiers were trained to <target>parachute</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the enemy territory under the cover of darkness to complete their secret mission.","translation":"士兵們接受訓練，在掩護的黑暗中乘坐降落傘跳入敵方領土以完成他們的秘密任務。","explanation":"動詞「乘坐降落傘跳下」。"}],"related_forms":["parachutes"]}

{"headword":"paragraph","explanation":"名詞「段落」。指文章中由多個句子組成的一個區塊，通常用於表達一個完整的想法。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to write a short <target>paragraph</target> summarizing the main idea of the story they had just read.","translation":"老師要求學生寫一段短小的段落，總結他們剛讀過的故事的主旨。","explanation":"名詞「段落」。"},{"sentence":"Please read the second <target>paragraph</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the letter and explain why the author feels so frustrated with the current situation.","translation":"請閱讀信件的第二段，並解釋為什麼作者對目前的狀況感到如此沮喪。","explanation":"名詞「段落」。"},{"sentence":"A well-structured <target>paragraph</target> should begin with a topic sentence that clearly states the main point of the section.","translation":"一個結構良好的段落應該以一個主題句開始，以清楚地陳述該部分的重點。","explanation":"名詞「段落」。"}],"related_forms":["paragraphs"]}

{"headword":"partial","explanation":"形容詞「部分的」或「偏心的」。常用於描述不完整的情況，或指對某人或事有偏好而缺乏公正。常考片語：partial to (偏好...的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The solar eclipse was only <target>partial</target>, so the sky did not turn completely dark, but the light became strangely dim.","translation":"這次日食只是部分的，所以天空沒有完全變暗，但光線變得異常昏暗。","explanation":"形容詞「部分的」。指不完整或非全面的狀態。"},{"sentence":"A fair judge must remain objective and avoid being <target>partial</target> when making decisions about the legal cases in court.","translation":"一名公正的法官在做出法律案件決定時必須保持客觀，避免偏心。","explanation":"形容詞「偏心的」。指缺乏公正，對某一方有偏好。"},{"sentence":"My younger brother is very <target>partial</target> <pattern>to</pattern> chocolate cake, often choosing it over any other dessert at the party.","translation":"我的弟弟非常偏好巧克力蛋糕，在派對上經常選擇它而不是其他任何甜點。","explanation":"形容詞「偏好的」。片語 partial to sth 表示對某事物有特別的喜好。"}],"related_forms":["partially","partiality"]}

{"headword":"participation","explanation":"名詞「參與」。指加入某項活動或參與某個過程。常用搭配：active participation (積極參與), encourage participation (鼓勵參與)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher encouraged active <target>participation</target> in the classroom, giving extra credit to students who frequently shared their ideas.","translation":"老師鼓勵課堂上的積極參與，給予經常分享想法的學生額外加分。","explanation":"名詞「參與」。常用搭配 active participation (積極參與)。"},{"sentence":"Due to the heavy rain, the level of student <target>participation</target> in the outdoor sports day was much lower than expected.","translation":"由於大雨，學生參與戶外運動會的程度比預期低得多。","explanation":"名詞「參與」。指加入活動的行為。"}],"related_forms":["participate","participant"]}

{"headword":"partnership","explanation":"名詞「合作夥伴關係、合夥關係」。指兩人或兩組織為了共同目標而建立的協作關係。常用搭配：form a partnership (建立合作關係), in partnership with (與...合作)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two tech companies decided to <pattern>form</pattern> a <target>partnership</target> to develop a new smartphone that combines the strengths of both firms.","translation":"這兩家科技公司決定建立合作夥伴關係，以開發一款結合兩家公司優勢的新智慧型手機。","explanation":"名詞「合作夥伴關係」。常用動詞搭配 form a partnership。"},{"sentence":"Our school is working <pattern>in</pattern> <target>partnership</target> <pattern>with</pattern> a local museum to provide students with more hands-on history lessons.","translation":"我們學校正與當地博物館合作，為學生提供更多實作的歷史課程。","explanation":"名詞「合作夥伴關係」。片語 in partnership with 表示「與...合作」。"}],"related_forms":["partner"]}

{"headword":"passive","explanation":"形容詞「被動的、消極的」。常用於描述對事物沒有主動反應的情況，或指語法上的被動語態。注意與 active (主動的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"Instead of taking a <target>passive</target> role in the group project, Sarah decided to lead the team and organize the schedule.","translation":"莎拉決定領導團隊並組織時間表，而不是在小組計畫中扮演被動的角色。","explanation":"形容詞「被動的」。指缺乏主動採取行動的態度。"},{"sentence":"The teacher explained that the <target>passive</target> <pattern>voice</pattern> is used when the focus is on the action or the receiver, rather than the doer.","translation":"老師解釋說，被動語態用於當焦點在於動作或接收者，而非執行者時。","explanation":"形容詞「被動的」。常用搭配 passive voice (被動語態)。"},{"sentence":"Some students are <target>passive</target> learners who only listen to lectures without asking questions or engaging in discussions.","translation":"有些學生是被動學習者，他們只聽講座而不提問或參與討論。","explanation":"形容詞「被動的」。指學習方式缺乏主動性。"}],"related_forms":["passively","passivity"]}

{"headword":"pasta","explanation":"名詞「義大利麵」。這是一個集合名詞，通常不可數。常見種類包括 spaghetti, penne, fusilli 等。","entries":[{"sentence":"For a quick and healthy dinner, my mother often cooks <target>pasta</target> with fresh vegetables and a light olive oil sauce.","translation":"為了快速且健康的晚餐，我母親經常煮義大利麵，搭配新鮮蔬菜和輕盈的橄欖油醬。","explanation":"名詞「義大利麵」。"},{"sentence":"The Italian restaurant is famous for its handmade <target>pasta</target>, which is made from durum wheat and high-quality eggs.","translation":"這家義大利餐廳以其手工製作的義大利麵聞名，由杜蘭小麥和高品質雞蛋製成。","explanation":"名詞「義大利麵」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"paw","explanation":"名詞「（動物的）爪子」；動詞「用爪子觸摸」。指具有肉墊的動物（如狗、貓）的足部。","entries":[{"sentence":"The playful puppy used its <target>paw</target> to touch the ball, trying to get its owner's attention to play together.","translation":"那隻調皮的小狗用它的爪子觸碰球，試圖引起主人的注意一起玩。","explanation":"名詞「爪子」。指動物的足部。"},{"sentence":"The cat <target>pawed</target> at the door, hoping that someone would open it and let her go outside into the garden.","translation":"貓用爪子拍門，希望有人能開門讓她走到花園裡。","explanation":"動詞「用爪子觸摸/拍」。"}],"related_forms":["paws"]}

{"headword":"peculiar","explanation":"形容詞「古怪的、獨特的」。常用於描述某人行為奇怪或某事物具有特定且不尋常的特徵。常考片語：peculiar to (為...所特有的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The old house had a <target>peculiar</target> smell of old paper and dust, which made the visitors feel a bit uneasy.","translation":"這座舊房子有一種古怪的舊紙和灰塵的味道，讓訪客感到有些不安。","explanation":"形容詞「古怪的」。指不尋常或奇怪的。"},{"sentence":"The teacher noticed a <target>peculiar</target> behavior in the student, as he started talking to himself during the exam.","translation":"老師注意到這名學生有種古怪的行為，因為他在考試期間開始自言自語。","explanation":"形容詞「古怪的」。指行為不符合常理。"},{"sentence":"This specific type of bird is <target>peculiar</target> <pattern>to</pattern> this remote island, meaning it cannot be found anywhere else in the world.","translation":"這種特定類型的鳥類是這個偏遠島嶼所特有的，意味著在世界上其他任何地方都找不到。","explanation":"形容詞「獨特的」。片語 peculiar to... 表示「為...所特有」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"peep","explanation":"名詞或動詞「偷看、窺視」或「（小鳥）唧唧叫」。動詞常用片語 peep through (從...偷看)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The curious child tried to <target>peep</target> <pattern>through</pattern> the keyhole to see what the adults were discussing in the private meeting.","translation":"好奇的孩子試圖從鑰匙孔偷看，看看大人們在私人會議中討論什麼。","explanation":"動詞「偷看」。片語 peep through 表示從某處窺視。"},{"sentence":"I heard a faint <target>peep</target> from the box and discovered a tiny, newborn bird trying to find its food.","translation":"我聽到盒子裡傳來微弱的唧唧聲，然後發現了一隻微小的新生鳥兒正試圖尋找食物。","explanation":"名詞「唧唧聲」。指小鳥發出的短促聲音。"},{"sentence":"She took a quick <target>peep</target> at her notes before the presentation started, just to make sure she remembered the main points.","translation":"在簡報開始前，她快速地瞥了一眼筆記，以確保她記得要點。","explanation":"名詞「偷看/瞥一眼」。"}],"related_forms":["peeping"]}

{"headword":"peer","explanation":"名詞「同儕、同輩」；動詞「凝視、吃力地看」。名詞在 GSAT 中常考同儕壓力 (peer pressure)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many teenagers feel strong <target>peer</target> <pattern>pressure</pattern> to dress in a certain way to fit in with their classmates.","translation":"許多青少年感受到強烈的同儕壓力，必須以某種方式穿著以融入同學之間。","explanation":"名詞「同儕」。常用搭配 peer pressure (同儕壓力)。"},{"sentence":"The scientist shared his findings with his <target>peers</target> at the international conference to receive professional feedback and suggestions.","translation":"這位科學家在國際會議上與他的同儕分享了他的發現，以獲得專業的反饋和建議。","explanation":"名詞「同儕」。指地位或年齡相仿的人。"},{"sentence":"The man <target>peered</target> <pattern>through</pattern> the thick fog to see if the bus was approaching the stop, but he could see nothing.","translation":"這個男人努力地透過濃霧凝視，看公車是否正接近車站，但什麼也看不見。","explanation":"動詞「凝視/吃力地看」。指因為視線不佳而努力地看。"}],"related_forms":["peers"]}

{"headword":"penalty","explanation":"名詞「處罰、罰金」或「（運動中的）罰球/罰球」。常用搭配：pay a penalty (付出代價), impose a penalty (施加處罰)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company had to pay a heavy financial <target>penalty</target> for failing to follow the environmental laws regarding waste disposal.","translation":"該公司因未能遵守廢棄物處理的環境法律而必須支付高額的罰金。","explanation":"名詞「罰金」。指違反規定後支付的款項。"},{"sentence":"In the final minute of the soccer match, the referee awarded a <target>penalty</target> kick to the home team after a foul.","translation":"在足球賽的最後一分鐘，裁判在一次犯規後給予主隊一次罰球機會。","explanation":"名詞「罰球」。指體育比賽中的處罰性得分機會。"},{"sentence":"If students continue to cheat on their exams, the school will <pattern>impose</pattern> a strict <target>penalty</target> on them to ensure honesty.","translation":"如果學生繼續在考試中作弊，學校將對他們施加嚴格的處罰，以確保誠實。","explanation":"名詞「處罰」。常用動詞搭配 impose a penalty。"}],"related_forms":["penalize","penalties"]}

{"headword":"percent","explanation":"名詞「百分比」。通常用於具體數字之後，表示百分之多少。注意 percent 和 percentage 的區別：percent 用於具體數字（例如 20 percent），而 percentage 則用於泛指百分比或比例（例如 a large percentage of...）。","entries":[{"sentence":"Approximately eighty <target>percent</target> of the students in our class decided to join the school's environmental club to protect the planet.","translation":"我們班大約百分之八十的學生決定加入學校的環保社團以保護地球。","explanation":"名詞「百分比」。用於具體數字之後。"},{"sentence":"Recent reports indicate that nearly fifty <target>percent</target> of the city's population now uses public transportation to commute to work every day.","translation":"最近的報告指出，市內將近百分之五十的人口現在每天使用大眾運輸工具通勤。","explanation":"名詞「百分比」。用於具體數字之後。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"percentage","explanation":"名詞「百分比；比例」。與 percent 不同，percentage 通常不用於具體數字，而是用於描述比例的高低或泛指百分比。常用搭配：a high/low percentage of... (高/低比例的...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"A large <target>percentage</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the total budget was allocated to improve the school library's resources and update the computers.","translation":"總預算的很大一部分被分配用於改善學校圖書館的資源並更新電腦。","explanation":"名詞「百分比；比例」。常用搭配 a large percentage of...。"},{"sentence":"The researcher noted that a small <target>percentage</target> <pattern>of</pattern> participants in the study showed a significant improvement in their test scores.","translation":"研究人員注意到，研究中只有小比例的參與者在測試分數上表現出顯著的進步。","explanation":"名詞「百分比；比例」。常用搭配 a small percentage of...。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"perfection","explanation":"名詞「完美」。指達到最高標準或完全沒有缺陷的狀態。常用搭配：strive for perfection (追求完美), reach perfection (達到完美)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young artist spent months refining her painting, striving for <target>perfection</target> in every single brushstroke to impress the judges.","translation":"這位年輕的藝術家花了好幾個月時間精進她的畫作，力求每一筆都達到完美，以給評審留下深刻印象。","explanation":"名詞「完美」。常用搭配 strive for perfection。"},{"sentence":"While some people believe that <target>perfection</target> is impossible to achieve, others use it as a goal to keep improving themselves.","translation":"雖然有些人認為完美是不可能實現的，但其他人將其作為一個目標來不斷改進自己。","explanation":"名詞「完美」。"}],"related_forms":["perfect"]}

{"headword":"perfume","explanation":"名詞「香水」；動詞「使芳香」。名詞用法最為常見，指一種用來增加身體或環境香味的液體。動詞用法較少見，指讓某物具有香味。","entries":[{"sentence":"She applied a small amount of <target>perfume</target> to her wrist before the interview, hoping the subtle scent would make her feel more confident.","translation":"面試前她在手腕上塗了一點香水，希望淡淡的香味能讓她更有自信。","explanation":"名詞「香水」。"},{"sentence":"The sweet scent of blooming jasmine <target>perfumed</target> the entire garden, creating a relaxing atmosphere for everyone who visited.","translation":"盛開的茉莉花的甜美香氣使整個花園充滿芳香，為每一位訪客創造了放鬆的氛圍。","explanation":"動詞「使芳香」。"}],"related_forms":["perfumed"]}
