{"headword":"permanent","explanation":"形容詞「永久的；恆定的」。指持續時間長或永遠不改變的狀態。反義詞為 temporary (臨時的)。常用搭配：permanent address (永久地址), permanent job (正式/永久職位)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After working as a substitute teacher for a year, he was finally offered a <target>permanent</target> position at the high school.","translation":"在擔任了一年代課教師後，他終於獲得了這所高中的一個正式職位。","explanation":"形容詞「永久的；正式的」。常用搭配 permanent position。"},{"sentence":"Some chemicals can cause <target>permanent</target> damage to the environment if they are not disposed of correctly by the factory.","translation":"如果工廠沒有正確處理某些化學物質，可能會對環境造成永久性的損害。","explanation":"形容詞「永久的」。"},{"sentence":"The student needed to provide a <target>permanent</target> <pattern>address</pattern> on the application form to ensure the university could send him official documents.","translation":"學生需要在申請表上提供永久地址，以確保大學能將官方文件寄送給他。","explanation":"形容詞「永久的」。常用搭配 permanent address。"}],"related_forms":["permanently","permanence"]}

{"headword":"persuasion","explanation":"名詞「說服；信念」。指用論據或理由說服他人接受某事或相信某事的過程。常用搭配：the art of persuasion (說服的藝術), power of persuasion (說服力)。","entries":[{"sentence":"It took a lot of <target>persuasion</target> from her parents to convince her to study medicine instead of art in college.","translation":"她的父母花了很大力氣說服她大學讀醫學而不是藝術。","explanation":"名詞「說服」。指說服他人的過程。"},{"sentence":"The salesman used his great power of <target>persuasion</target> to convince the customers that the new vacuum cleaner was the best choice.","translation":"銷售員利用他強大的說服力，使顧客相信這款新吸塵器是最佳選擇。","explanation":"名詞「說服力」。常用搭配 power of persuasion。"}],"related_forms":["persuade","persuasive"]}

{"headword":"persuasive","explanation":"形容詞「有說服力的」。指能讓他人相信或做某事的能力。常用搭配：a persuasive argument (有說服力的論點), persuasive speech (有說服力的演講)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The lawyer presented a <target>persuasive</target> <pattern>argument</pattern> during the trial, which eventually led the jury to reach a verdict of not guilty.","translation":"律師在審判期間提出了一個有說服力的論點，而這最終導致陪審團達成無罪判決。","explanation":"形容詞「有說服力的」。常用搭配 persuasive argument。"},{"sentence":"To win the debate competition, students must learn how to deliver a <target>persuasive</target> <pattern>speech</pattern> backed by strong evidence and logic.","translation":"為了在辯論賽中獲勝，學生必須學習如何發表一個有證據和邏輯支持的有說服力的演講。","explanation":"形容詞「有說服力的」。常用搭配 persuasive speech。"}],"related_forms":["persuade","persuasion"]}

{"headword":"pessimistic","explanation":"形容詞「悲觀的」。指傾向於預期最壞結果的態度。反義詞為 optimistic (樂觀的)。常用搭配：be pessimistic about sth (對某事感到悲觀)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite the team's recent losses, the coach encouraged the players not to be <target>pessimistic</target> <pattern>about</pattern> their chances of winning the next game.","translation":"儘管球隊最近遭遇失利，教練鼓勵球員不要對贏得下一場比賽的機會感到悲觀。","explanation":"形容詞「悲觀的」。常用搭配 be pessimistic about sth。"},{"sentence":"He has a <target>pessimistic</target> outlook on life, always expecting the worst to happen even when everything seems to be going well.","translation":"他對生活持有悲觀的看法，即使在一切似乎進展順利時，也總是期待最糟糕的事情發生。","explanation":"形容詞「悲觀的」。指對未來預期的負面態度。"}],"related_forms":["pessimism","pessimist"]}

{"headword":"pest","explanation":"名詞「害蟲；討厭的人」。指對作物或人類造成損害的昆蟲或動物，或比喻義指令人煩惱的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"Farmers use various organic methods to control <target>pests</target> in their fields, avoiding the use of harmful chemical pesticides to protect the soil.","translation":"農民在田裡使用各種有機方法來控制害蟲，避免使用有害的化學農藥以保護土壤。","explanation":"名詞「害蟲」。指對農作物造成損害的昆蟲。"},{"sentence":"The younger brother was a bit of a <target>pest</target> when he kept interrupting his sister's study time by asking constant questions.","translation":"當弟弟不斷地透過詢問問題來打斷姐姐的學習時間時，他就像個討厭的人。","explanation":"名詞「討厭的人」。比喻義。"}],"related_forms":["pesticide"]}

{"headword":"phenomenon","explanation":"名詞「現象」。指可觀察到的事實或事件，尤其是那些不尋常或令人驚訝的事物。複數形式為 phenomena。注意其複數形式的不規則變化。","entries":[{"sentence":"The Northern Lights are a natural <target>phenomenon</target> that occurs in polar regions, attracting millions of tourists to witness the spectacular view.","translation":"北極光是一種發生在極地的自然現象，吸引了數百萬遊客來見證這壯麗的景色。","explanation":"名詞「現象」。單數形式。"},{"sentence":"Sociologists are studying the <target>phenomenon</target> <pattern>of</pattern> social media addiction among teenagers, analyzing how it affects their mental health and sleep patterns.","translation":"社會學家正在研究青少年社交媒體成癮的現象，分析它如何影響他們的心理健康和睡眠模式。","explanation":"名詞「現象」。常用搭配 phenomenon of sth。"},{"sentence":"Scientists have observed several strange <target>phenomena</target> in space that cannot be explained by current physics theories, sparking new research and debates.","translation":"科學家在太空中觀察到幾個奇怪的現象，而這些現象無法用目前的物理理論來解釋，引發了新研究和辯論。","explanation":"名詞「現象」。複數形式 phenomena。"}],"related_forms":["phenomena"]}

{"headword":"philosopher","explanation":"名詞「哲學家」。指研究基本問題（如存在、知識、價值和理智）的人。常用於描述歷史上的思想家。","entries":[{"sentence":"The ancient Greek <target>philosopher</target> Socrates encouraged his students to question everything and think critically about the world around them.","translation":"古希臘哲學家蘇格拉底鼓勵他的學生質疑一切，並對周圍的世界進行批判性思考。","explanation":"名詞「哲學家」。指從事哲學研究或具有深奧思想的人。"}],"related_forms":["philosophers"]}

{"headword":"philosophical","explanation":"形容詞「哲學的」或「豁達的」。前者指與哲學相關，後者指在面對困難時能保持冷靜和理性地看待事情。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student decided to take a <target>philosophical</target> <pattern>approach</pattern> to the problem, analyzing its root cause instead of reacting emotionally.","translation":"這名學生決定用哲學的方法來處理這個問題，分析其根本原因而不是做出情緒化的反應。","explanation":"形容詞「哲學的」。常用搭配：philosophical approach (哲學方法)。"},{"sentence":"When he lost the championship game, he remained <target>philosophical</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the defeat, viewing it as a valuable learning experience.","translation":"當他輸掉冠軍賽時，他對這次失敗保持著豁達的態度，將其視為一次寶貴的學習經驗。","explanation":"形容詞「豁達的」。常用搭配：be philosophical about sth (對某事持有豁達態度)。"}],"related_forms":["philosophy","philosopher"]}

{"headword":"philosophy","explanation":"名詞「哲學」或「人生觀」。指對知識、存在和價值的一般理論，也可以指個人對生活的基本看法。","entries":[{"sentence":"During his university studies, he became fascinated by the <target>philosophy</target> <pattern>of</pattern> Immanuel Kant, exploring the limits of human understanding.","translation":"在大學就讀期間，他被伊曼紐爾·康德的哲學所吸引，探索人類理解的極限。","explanation":"名詞「哲學」。指一門學問。"},{"sentence":"Her personal <target>philosophy</target> <pattern>of</pattern> life is to treat others with kindness and respect, regardless of their background or social status.","translation":"她的人生觀是無論對方的背景或社會地位如何，都要以善良和尊重對待他人。","explanation":"名詞「人生觀」。指個人對生活的基本原則或看法。"}],"related_forms":["philosopher","philosophical"]}

{"headword":"photography","explanation":"名詞「攝影」。指使用相機記錄影像的藝術或技術。注意與 photographer (攝影師) 的區分。","entries":[{"sentence":"Digital <target>photography</target> has become incredibly popular among teenagers, allowing them to capture and share their daily lives instantly on social media.","translation":"數位攝影在青少年中變得非常流行，讓他們能立即在社群媒體上捕捉並分享他們的日常生活。","explanation":"名詞「攝影」。指一種技術或藝術形式。"},{"sentence":"The university offers a professional course in <target>photography</target>, covering everything from basic lighting techniques to advanced image editing software.","translation":"大學提供專業的攝影課程，涵蓋從基礎光線技巧到高級影像編輯軟體的所有內容。","explanation":"名詞「攝影」。指學習的科目。"}],"related_forms":["photographer","photographic"]}

{"headword":"physical","explanation":"形容詞「身體的」、「物質的」或「實體的」。常與 mental (心理的) 相對，用於描述身體健康、物質存在或物理性質。","entries":[{"sentence":"Regular exercise and a balanced diet are essential for maintaining good <target>physical</target> <pattern>health</pattern>, reducing the risk of chronic diseases.","translation":"規律的運動和均衡的飲食對於維持良好的身體健康至關重要，能降低慢性病的風險。","explanation":"形容詞「身體的」。常用搭配：physical health (身體健康)。"},{"sentence":"The teacher emphasized that <target>physical</target> <pattern>activity</pattern> during recess is important for students to release stress and improve concentration in class.","translation":"老師強調在下課時間進行身體活動對學生釋放壓力並提高課堂專注力很重要。","explanation":"形容詞「身體的」。常用搭配：physical activity (身體活動)。"},{"sentence":"In the era of digital books, some people still prefer the <target>physical</target> <pattern>copy</pattern> of a novel because they enjoy the feeling of paper.","translation":"在數位書籍時代，有些人仍然偏好小說的實體副本，因為他們喜歡紙張的觸感。","explanation":"形容詞「實體的」。指非虛擬或非數位的存在。"},{"sentence":"The scientists conducted a <target>physical</target> <pattern>examination</pattern> of the site to gather evidence and understand the geological structure of the area.","translation":"科學家對該地點進行了實體檢查，以收集證據並了解該地區的地質結構。","explanation":"形容詞「物理的/實體的」。指對物質對象的實際檢查。"}],"related_forms":["physically","physicality"]}

{"headword":"physician","explanation":"名詞「內科醫生」。指經過專業訓練的醫療從業者，通常指不進行手術的醫生。注意與 surgeon (外科醫生) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"After feeling unwell for a week, he finally visited a <target>physician</target> to get a proper diagnosis and start the necessary treatment.","translation":"在感到不適一週後，他終於去看了一位內科醫生以獲得正確的診斷並開始必要的治療。","explanation":"名詞「內科醫生」。"},{"sentence":"The family <target>physician</target> has known them for years and provides personalized care based on their detailed medical history.","translation":"家庭內科醫生認識他們多年，並根據詳細的病史提供個性化的照護。","explanation":"名詞「內科醫生」。常用搭配：family physician (家庭醫師)。"}],"related_forms":["physicians"]}

{"headword":"physicist","explanation":"名詞「物理學家」。指專門研究物理學的專業人士。","entries":[{"sentence":"The renowned <target>physicist</target> gave a lecture on quantum mechanics, explaining how subatomic particles behave in ways that defy common sense.","translation":"這位著名的物理學家就量子力學發表了演講，由於亞原子粒子以違背常識的方式運作，他解釋了其運作方式。","explanation":"名詞「物理學家」。"},{"sentence":"As a young <target>physicist</target>, she spent countless hours in the laboratory conducting experiments to prove her theory about dark matter.","translation":"作為一名年輕的物理學家，她在實驗室中度過了無數小時進行實驗，以證明她關於暗物質的理論。","explanation":"名詞「物理學家」。"}],"related_forms":["physicists"]}

{"headword":"physics","explanation":"名詞「物理學」。指研究物質、能量、空間和時間的科學。注意此詞為單數形式，動詞用單數。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many students find <target>physics</target> challenging because it requires a strong understanding of mathematical concepts and the ability to apply them to real-life scenarios.","translation":"許多學生覺得物理學很有挑戰性，因為它需要對數學概念有強大的理解能力，以及將其應用於現實生活情境的能力。","explanation":"名詞「物理學」。指一門學科。"},{"sentence":"The professor's lecture on the <target>physics</target> <pattern>of</pattern> sound explained how vibrations travel through different mediums like air and water.","translation":"教授關於聲音物理學的講座解釋了振動如何透過空氣和水等不同介質傳播。","explanation":"名詞「物理學」。常用搭配：the physics of sth (某事的物理原理)。"}],"related_forms":["physicist"]}

{"headword":"pickle","explanation":"名詞「醃漬物」或「困境」。常用片語 in a pickle (陷入困境)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The chef added some sliced <target>pickles</target> to the burger to provide a sour and salty contrast to the rich meat and melted cheese.","translation":"廚師在漢堡中加入了一些切片的醃漬黃瓜，以提供酸鹹的對比，來平衡濃郁的肉類和融化的起司。","explanation":"名詞「醃漬物」。通常指醃漬黃瓜。"},{"sentence":"He found himself <pattern>in</pattern> a <target>pickle</target> when he realized he had forgotten his wallet at home and had no way to pay for the bus fare.","translation":"當他意識到自己把錢包忘在回家後，發現自己陷入了困境，沒有辦法支付公車車費。","explanation":"名詞「困境」。片語 in a pickle 表示「陷入困境」。"}],"related_forms":["pickled"]}

{"headword":"pioneer","explanation":"名詞「先驅者」；動詞「開創」。指第一個嘗試某事或在某領域開展工作的人，或指開拓新領域的行為。","entries":[{"sentence":"Marie Curie was a <target>pioneer</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the field of radioactivity, conducting groundbreaking research that changed our understanding of science.","translation":"瑪麗·居禮是放射能領域的先驅，進行了突破性的研究，改變了我們對科學的理解。","explanation":"名詞「先驅者」。常用搭配：pioneer in sth (在某方面的先驅)。"},{"sentence":"The company aims to <target>pioneer</target> new technologies <pattern>in</pattern> renewable energy to reduce the world's reliance on fossil fuels.","translation":"這家公司旨在開創新的再生能源技術，以減少世界對化石燃料的依賴。","explanation":"動詞「開創」。指第一個開發或引入某種新方法或技術。"},{"sentence":"The early <target>pioneers</target> of the American West faced extreme hardships and traveled long distances to find a better life in new territories.","translation":"早期的美國西部先驅者面臨著極端艱難的條件，並長途跋涉以在新的領土中尋找更好的生活。","explanation":"名詞「先驅者」。指最早進入新地區定居的人。"}],"related_forms":["pioneering"]}

{"headword":"plentiful","explanation":"形容詞「豐富的、充足的」。常用於描述資源、食物或機會充足，與 scarce (缺乏的) 相對。常用搭配：plentiful supply (充足的供應), plentiful evidence (充分的證據)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Thanks to the heavy rains this season, the farmers enjoyed a <target>plentiful</target> <pattern>harvest</pattern> of corn and wheat.","translation":"由於本季雨量充足，農民們獲得了豐富的玉米和小麥收成。","explanation":"形容詞「豐富的」。常用搭配：plentiful harvest (豐富的收成)。"},{"sentence":"The library provides <target>plentiful</target> <pattern>resources</pattern> for students to conduct their research and write their term papers.","translation":"圖書館為學生提供了充足的資源來進行研究並撰寫期末論文。","explanation":"形容詞「充足的」。常用搭配：plentiful resources (充足的資源)。"},{"sentence":"In the tropical rainforest, there are <target>plentiful</target> <pattern>opportunities</pattern> to observe rare species of birds and insects.","translation":"在熱帶雨林中，有充足的機會觀察稀有鳥類和昆蟲。","explanation":"形容詞「充足的」。常用搭配：plentiful opportunities (充足的機會)。"}],"related_forms":["plenty"]}

{"headword":"plot","explanation":"名詞可用於指「情節」或「小塊土地」；動詞則指「策劃、密謀」。注意 plot (情節) 與 story (故事) 的區別：plot 側重於事件的發展邏輯和結構，而 story 側重於敘述的內容。","entries":[{"sentence":"The novel has a complex <target>plot</target> with many unexpected twists, making it a page-turner for most readers.","translation":"這部小說的情節複雜且有許多出乎意料的轉折，使大多數讀者讀起來欲罷不能。","explanation":"名詞「情節」。指故事中事件的發展過程。"},{"sentence":"The family decided to buy a small <target>plot</target> <pattern>of</pattern> <pattern>land</pattern> in the countryside to build their dream vacation home.","translation":"這家人決定在鄉下買一小塊土地來建造他們夢想的度假屋。","explanation":"名詞「小塊土地」。常用搭配：a plot of land。"},{"sentence":"The villains in the movie <target>plotted</target> <pattern>to</pattern> overthrow the government and seize power through a secret plan.","translation":"電影中的反派策劃推翻政府並通過秘密計劃奪取權力。","explanation":"動詞「策劃、密謀」。常用搭配：plot to V。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"plum","explanation":"名詞「李子」。一種常見的水果。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the summer, the local market sells fresh <target>plums</target> that are sweet and juicy, which are very popular among children.","translation":"夏天時，當地市場販售新鮮的李子，口感甜美多汁，深受孩子們喜愛。","explanation":"名詞「李子」（複數）。"},{"sentence":"She baked a delicious cake using fresh <target>plum</target> jam, which added a unique tartness to the dessert.","translation":"她用新鮮的李子醬烤了一個美味的蛋糕，為甜點增添了獨特的酸味。","explanation":"名詞「李子」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"plumber","explanation":"名詞「水電工」。專門負責安裝和修理水管、排水系統的人員。","entries":[{"sentence":"After the pipe burst in the kitchen, my father called a <target>plumber</target> to fix the leak and prevent further water damage.","translation":"廚房水管破裂後，我父親請了一位水電工來修理漏水處，以防止進一步的水災。","explanation":"名詞「水電工」。"},{"sentence":"The school hired a professional <target>plumber</target> to install a new drainage system for the chemistry laboratory.","translation":"學校聘請了一位專業的水電工為化學實驗室安裝新的排水系統。","explanation":"名詞「水電工」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"poisonous","explanation":"形容詞「有毒的」。常用於描述植物、動物或化學物質。注意與 toxic 的區別：poisonous 通常指通過攝取（如食用或被咬）而產生毒性的物質，而 toxic 則更廣泛地指對環境或身體有害的化學物質或隱喻地指有害的關係。","entries":[{"sentence":"Some species of colorful frogs in the Amazon rainforest are highly <target>poisonous</target> and should be avoided by hikers.","translation":"亞馬遜雨林中一些色彩鮮豔的青蛙具有高度毒性，登山客應避開。","explanation":"形容詞「有毒的」。"},{"sentence":"The teacher warned the students not to touch the <target>poisonous</target> <pattern>plants</pattern> during their field trip to the botanical garden.","translation":"老師警告學生在前往植物園的校外教學期間不要觸碰有毒植物。","explanation":"形容詞「有毒的」。常用搭配：poisonous plants。"},{"sentence":"The scientist analyzed the <target>poisonous</target> <pattern>gas</pattern> released by the volcano to understand its effects on the environment.","translation":"科學家分析了火山釋放的有毒氣體，以了解其對環境的影響。","explanation":"形容詞「有毒的」。常用搭配：poisonous gas。"}],"related_forms":["poison"]}

{"headword":"polish","explanation":"動詞「擦亮、磨光」；名詞「光澤、修飾」。注意 polish (擦亮) 與 refine (精煉/完善) 的區別：polish 指物理上的擦亮，也可隱喻地指對作品的最後修飾，而 refine 指對過程或技巧的進一步改進。","entries":[{"sentence":"He spent an hour using a soft cloth to <target>polish</target> his leather shoes before the formal graduation ceremony.","translation":"在正式的畢業典禮前，他花了一小時用軟布擦亮他的皮鞋。","explanation":"動詞「擦亮」。"},{"sentence":"The student spent several days <target>polishing</target> <pattern>his essay</pattern> to ensure the grammar was perfect and the logic was clear.","translation":"這名學生花了好幾天修飾他的文章，以確保文法正確且邏輯清晰。","explanation":"動詞「修飾」。指對作品進行最後的微調以使其更完美。"},{"sentence":"The antique table has a beautiful <target>polish</target> that makes the wood look shiny and new again.","translation":"這張古董桌子有一層美麗的光澤，使木頭看起來再次閃亮如新。","explanation":"名詞「光澤」。"}],"related_forms":["polished","polishing"]}

{"headword":"popularity","explanation":"名詞「流行、受歡迎程度」。常用搭配：gain popularity (獲得歡迎), win popularity (贏得歡迎), lose popularity (失去歡迎)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new social media platform has <target>gained</target> <pattern>popularity</pattern> among teenagers because of its unique video filters.","translation":"這款新的社群媒體平台因其獨特的影片濾鏡而在青少年中獲得歡迎。","explanation":"名詞「流行」。片語 gain popularity 表示「獲得歡迎」。"},{"sentence":"Despite its high price, the electric car has <target>won</target> <pattern>popularity</pattern> because people are more concerned about environmental protection.","translation":"儘管價格高昂，電動車因人們更關注環保而贏得歡迎。","explanation":"名詞「流行」。片語 win popularity 表示「贏得歡迎」。"},{"sentence":"Traditional handwritten letters have <target>lost</target> <pattern>popularity</pattern> since the rise of instant messaging apps like LINE and WhatsApp.","translation":"自從即時通訊軟體如 LINE 和 WhatsApp 興起以來，傳統的手寫信件已失去歡迎。","explanation":"名詞「流行」。片語 lose popularity 表示「失去歡迎」。"}],"related_forms":["popular"]}

{"headword":"portable","explanation":"形容詞「便攜的、可攜帶的」。常用於描述電子設備或工具，如 portable charger (行動電源), portable speaker (便攜式喇叭)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many students prefer using <target>portable</target> <pattern>laptops</pattern> instead of desktop computers to study more flexibly in the library.","translation":"許多學生更喜歡使用便攜式筆記型電腦而非桌上型電腦，以便在圖書館更靈活地學習。","explanation":"形容詞「便攜的」。常用搭配：portable laptops。"},{"sentence":"Having a <target>portable</target> <pattern>charger</pattern> is essential for travelers who rely heavily on their smartphones for navigation and communication.","translation":"對於嚴重依賴智慧型手機導航和通訊的旅客來說，擁有行動電源至關重要。","explanation":"形容詞「便攜的」。常用搭配：portable charger (行動電源)。"},{"sentence":"The company developed a <target>portable</target> <pattern>air conditioner</pattern> that can be easily moved from one room to another.","translation":"公司開發了一款便攜式冷氣機，可以輕鬆地在房間之間移動。","explanation":"形容詞「便攜的」。常用搭配：portable air conditioner (便攜式冷氣機)。"}],"related_forms":["portability"]}

{"headword":"portray","explanation":"動詞「描繪、描寫」。可用於藝術作品（畫作、雕刻）或文學作品（小說、小說、電影）中對人物或情境的描述。常用搭配：portray as (將...描繪成)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The author uses vivid descriptions to <target>portray</target> the main character as a brave and determined young woman.","translation":"作者使用生動的描述將主角描繪成一個勇敢且堅定的年輕女性。","explanation":"動詞「描繪」。指用文字描述人物特質。"},{"sentence":"In the new movie, the famous actor <target>portrays</target> a historical figure who fought for social justice and equality.","translation":"在新電影中，這位著名演員扮演了一位為社會正義和平等而奮鬥的歷史人物。","explanation":"動詞「扮演、描繪」。指在表演中呈現人物形象。"},{"sentence":"The artist's painting <target>portrays</target> a peaceful countryside scene with rolling hills and a golden sunset.","translation":"藝術家的畫作描繪了一幅寧靜的鄉村景色，有起伏的丘陵和金色的夕陽。","explanation":"動詞「描繪」。指在視覺藝術中呈現景象。"}],"related_forms":["portrayal"]}

{"headword":"possess","explanation":"動詞「擁有、具有」。比 have 更正式，常用於描述具有某種能力、特質或財產。常用搭配：possess the ability (具有能力), possess knowledge (擁有知識)。","entries":[{"sentence":"To be a successful leader, one must <target>possess</target> the <pattern>ability</pattern> to communicate effectively and inspire others.","translation":"要成為一名成功的領導者，一個人必須具有有效溝通並激勵他人的能力。","explanation":"動詞「擁有」。常用搭配：possess the ability (具有能力)。"},{"sentence":"The ancient library <target>possesses</target> a vast <pattern>collection</pattern> of rare manuscripts that provide insight into early human history.","translation":"這座古老的圖書館擁有大量稀有手稿的收藏，提供了對早期人類歷史的的見解。","explanation":"動詞「擁有」。常用搭配：possess a collection (擁有收藏)。"},{"sentence":"The student <target>possesses</target> an <pattern>extraordinary</pattern> <pattern>talent</pattern> for music, allowing her to play several instruments perfectly.","translation":"這名學生具有非凡的音樂天賦，使她能完美地演奏多種樂器。","explanation":"動詞「具有」。常用搭配：possess a talent (具有天賦)。"}],"related_forms":["possession","possessive"]}

{"headword":"possession","explanation":"名詞，意為「擁有」或「財產」。常考搭配：in possession of (擁有、持有)。注意與 possess (動詞) 的區別，possession 強調的是擁有這個狀態或所擁有的東西。","entries":[{"sentence":"The museum is proud to be <pattern>in</pattern> <target>possession</target> <pattern>of</pattern> several rare artifacts from the ancient Egyptian civilization.","translation":"博物館很自豪能擁有幾件來自古埃及文明的稀有文物。","explanation":"名詞「擁有」。常用片語 in possession of... (擁有...)。"},{"sentence":"The police asked the suspect if he had any illegal <target>possessions</target> in his bag before they searched his house.","translation":"警察在搜索嫌疑人的房子之前，詢問他包裡是否有任何非法財產。","explanation":"名詞「財產、所有物」。此處為複數型，指個人擁有的物品。"}],"related_forms":["possess","possessions"]}

{"headword":"postage","explanation":"名詞，意為「郵資」或「郵票」。常用搭配：pay the postage (支付郵資), postage stamps (郵票)。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you want to send a heavy package to another country, you must <pattern>pay</pattern> the <target>postage</target> at the local post office.","translation":"如果你想將一個沉重的包裹寄到另一個國家，你必須在當地郵局支付郵資。","explanation":"名詞「郵資」。指寄信或寄包裹所需支付的費用。"},{"sentence":"The student bought several <target>postage</target> <pattern>stamps</pattern> to mail his application letters to various universities across the country.","translation":"這名學生購買了幾枚郵票，以便將申請信寄往全國各地的多所大學。","explanation":"名詞「郵資」。postage stamps 是指「郵票」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"potential","explanation":"可作為形容詞（潛在的、可能的）或名詞（潛力、可能性）。形容詞時常用於描述尚未顯現但未來可能發展的潛能，如 potential customer (潛在客戶)；名詞時則指一個人或事物具有的發展潛能，例如 reach one's full potential (發揮全部潛能)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher noticed that the quiet student had great <target>potential</target> for music, even though he rarely spoke in class.","translation":"老師注意到那個安靜的學生在音樂方面有很大的潛力，儘管他在課堂上很少說話。","explanation":"名詞「潛力」。指尚未開發的潛能。"},{"sentence":"To reach their full <target>potential</target>, students need a supportive environment and consistent guidance from their mentors.","translation":"為了發揮他們的全部潛力，學生需要一個支持性的環境和導師的持續指導。","explanation":"名詞「潛力」。常用搭配：reach one's full potential (發揮全部潛能)。"},{"sentence":"The marketing team is trying to identify <target>potential</target> <pattern>customers</pattern> who might be interested in their new eco-friendly products.","translation":"行銷團隊正努力辨識那些可能對他們的新環保產品感興趣的潛在客戶。","explanation":"形容詞「潛在的」。常用搭配：potential customers (潛在客戶)。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are studying the <target>potential</target> <pattern>risks</pattern> of the new medicine to ensure it is safe for all patients.","translation":"科學家正在研究新藥的潛在風險，以確保它對所有患者都是安全的。","explanation":"形容詞「潛在的」。常用搭配：potential risks (潛在風險)。"}],"related_forms":["potentially"]}

{"headword":"precise","explanation":"形容詞，意為「精確的、準確的」。常與 exact 或 accurate 相近，但 precise 更強調細節上的精確度。常用搭配：precise details (精確細節), be precise about (對...精確)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The scientist provided <target>precise</target> <pattern>measurements</pattern> of the chemicals to ensure that the experiment produced consistent and reliable results.","translation":"科學家提供了化學藥劑的精確測量值，以確保實驗產生一致且可靠的結果。","explanation":"形容詞「精確的」。常用搭配：precise measurements (精確測量)。"},{"sentence":"Could you please give me the <target>precise</target> <pattern>time</pattern> of the meeting, as I do not want to be late for the presentation?","translation":"請問您能給我會議的精確時間嗎？因為我不想在簡報時遲到。","explanation":"形容詞「準確的」。常用搭配：precise time (準確時間)。"},{"sentence":"When writing a research paper, it is important to be <target>precise</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the definitions of the terms you use.","translation":"在撰寫研究論文時，對你所使用的術語定義保持精確是非常重要的。","explanation":"形容詞「精確的」。常用搭配：be precise about... (對...精確)。"}],"related_forms":["precisely","precision"]}

{"headword":"predict","explanation":"動詞，意為「預測」。常用搭配：predict that... (預測...), predict the outcome (預測結果)。注意與 prediction (名詞) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"Based on the current weather data, meteorologists can <target>predict</target> <pattern>that</pattern> a strong typhoon will hit the coast next week.","translation":"根據目前的氣象數據，氣象學家預測下週將有強颱風襲擊海岸。","explanation":"動詞「預測」。常用搭配：predict that... (預測...)。"},{"sentence":"It is often difficult to <target>predict</target> <pattern>the outcome of</pattern> a close election, as voter behavior can change quickly.","translation":"預測一場激烈的選舉結果通常很困難，因為選民的行為可能會迅速改變。","explanation":"動詞「預測」。常用搭配：predict the outcome of... (預測...的結果)。"}],"related_forms":["predictable","prediction"]}

{"headword":"prediction","explanation":"名詞，意為「預測」。由 predict (動詞) 衍生而來。常用搭配：make a prediction (做出預測), accurate prediction (準確的預測)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The economist's <target>prediction</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the stock market crash was accurate, which surprised many investors in the city.","translation":"經濟學家對股市崩盤的預測是準確的，這讓城市裡的許多投資者感到驚訝。","explanation":"名詞「預測」。常用搭配：prediction about... (關於...的預測)。"},{"sentence":"Many people try to <pattern>make</pattern> a <target>prediction</target> regarding the winner of the world cup, but the results are often surprising.","translation":"許多人試圖對世界盃的贏家做出預測，但結果往往出人意料。","explanation":"名詞「預測」。常用片語 make a prediction (做出預測)。"}],"related_forms":["predict","predictable"]}

{"headword":"pregnancy","explanation":"名詞，意為「懷孕」。指女性懷孕的狀態。常用搭配：during pregnancy (在懷孕期間), a healthy pregnancy (健康的懷孕過程)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Proper nutrition and regular medical check-ups are essential for ensuring a healthy <target>pregnancy</target> for both the mother and the baby.","translation":"適當的營養和定期醫療檢查對於確保母親和寶寶都有健康的懷孕過程至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「懷孕」。指懷孕的狀態。"},{"sentence":"Many women experience mood swings and physical changes <pattern>during</pattern> <target>pregnancy</target>, which is a normal part of the biological process.","translation":"許多女性在懷孕期間會經歷情緒起伏和身體變化，這是生物過程中的正常部分。","explanation":"名詞「懷孕」。常用搭配：during pregnancy (在懷孕期間)。"}],"related_forms":["pregnant"]}

{"headword":"pregnant","explanation":"形容詞，意為「懷孕的」。通常用 be pregnant (懷孕)。常用搭配：become pregnant (開始懷孕), be pregnant with (懷孕，肚子裡有...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The woman discovered she was <target>pregnant</target> <pattern>with</pattern> twins, which brought immense joy to her and her husband.","translation":"這名女性發現自己懷了雙胞胎，這為她和她的丈夫帶來了巨大的喜悅。","explanation":"形容詞「懷孕的」。常用搭配：be pregnant with... (懷孕，肚子裡有...)。"},{"sentence":"When a female animal <pattern>becomes</pattern> <target>pregnant</target>, her behavior often changes as she prepares to protect her future offspring.","translation":"當雌性動物開始懷孕時，她的行為通常會改變，以準備保護她未來的後代。","explanation":"形容詞「懷孕的」。常用搭配：become pregnant (開始懷孕)。"}],"related_forms":["pregnancy"]}

{"headword":"presentation","explanation":"名詞，意為「簡報、演示」或「呈現方式」。在學校或職場中，常用於指在眾人面前進行的演講或簡報。常用搭配：give a presentation (做簡報), make a presentation (做簡報)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student felt nervous before <pattern>giving</pattern> a <target>presentation</target> in front of the class, but he eventually spoke with confidence.","translation":"這名學生在全班面前做簡報前感到緊張，但最後他自信地發言。","explanation":"名詞「簡報」。常用搭配：give a presentation (做簡報)。"},{"sentence":"A clear and organized <target>presentation</target> is key to effectively communicating your ideas and persuading the audience during a business meeting.","translation":"清晰且有組織的簡報是商業會議中有效傳達想法並說服聽眾的關鍵。","explanation":"名詞「簡報」。指在眾人面前的演示或呈現。"},{"sentence":"The <target>presentation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the data was so professional that the judges were impressed by the clarity of the research findings.","translation":"數據的呈現方式如此專業，以至於評審對研究結果的清晰度印象深刻。","explanation":"名詞「呈現方式」。指資訊或事物的呈現方式。"}],"related_forms":["present"]}

{"headword":"preservation","explanation":"名詞，意為「保存、保護」。常指對自然環境、古蹟或食物的保存。常用搭配：environmental preservation (環境保護), preservation of nature (自然保護), food preservation (食物保存)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government established a national park to ensure the <target>preservation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the endangered species and their natural habitat.","translation":"政府成立了一個國家公園，以確保瀕危物種及其自然棲息地的保存。","explanation":"名詞「保存、保護」。常用搭配：preservation of... (...的保存/保護)。"},{"sentence":"Freezing and canning are common methods of food <target>preservation</target> that allow people to store food for a longer period.","translation":"冷凍和罐頭化是常見的食物保存方法，使人們能夠將食物儲存更長時間。","explanation":"名詞「保存」。指食物的保存方式。"},{"sentence":"Experts are using new technology to assist in the <target>preservation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> ancient manuscripts, preventing them from decaying over time.","translation":"專家們正利用新技術來協助保存古代手稿，防止它們隨著時間而腐爛。","explanation":"名詞「保存」。指對歷史文物的保護。"}],"related_forms":["preserve"]}

{"headword":"preserve","explanation":"動詞「保存、保護」。常用於指維持事物的原貌或防止其損壞。常考搭配：preserve the environment (保護環境), preserve tradition (保存傳統)。注意與 conserve 的區別：preserve 側重於將事物維持在現有狀態，不讓其改變或消失；而 conserve 側重於合理利用資源以防止其枯竭，如 conserve energy (節省能源)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The local government is taking urgent measures to <target>preserve</target> <pattern>the environment</pattern> of the national park to attract more tourists.","translation":"地方政府正採取緊急措施來保護國家公園的環境，以吸引更多遊客。","explanation":"動詞「保護」。指防止自然環境遭到破壞。"},{"sentence":"The museum uses a special temperature-controlled room to <target>preserve</target> ancient documents and prevent them from decaying over time.","translation":"博物館使用特殊的恆溫室來保存古代文件，防止它們隨著時間而腐爛。","explanation":"動詞「保存」。指透過技術手段維持物體的原狀。"},{"sentence":"Many elderly people believe it is important to <target>preserve</target> <pattern>cultural traditions</pattern> so that future generations can understand their roots.","translation":"許多長輩認為，保存文化傳統非常重要，這樣後代才能了解自己的根源。","explanation":"動詞「保存」。指維持習俗或傳統不被遺忘。"}],"related_forms":["preservation","preservative"]}

{"headword":"prevention","explanation":"名詞「預防」。指在問題發生前採取行動防止其發生。常用搭配：crime prevention (犯罪預防), disease prevention (疾病預防)。常考片語：prevention is better than cure (預防勝於治療)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school nurse organized a health workshop to teach students about the importance of disease <target>prevention</target> through regular exercise and a balanced diet.","translation":"學校護理師組織了一場健康工作坊，教導學生透過規律運動和均衡飲食來預防疾病的重要性。","explanation":"名詞「預防」。指採取行動防止疾病發生。"},{"sentence":"Installing security cameras in the hallways is an effective method of crime <target>prevention</target> to ensure the safety of all students on campus.","translation":"在走廊安裝監視器是一種有效的犯罪預防方法，以確保校園內所有學生的安全。","explanation":"名詞「預防」。指防止犯罪行為發生的措施。"},{"sentence":"Many doctors emphasize that <target>prevention</target> <pattern>is better than</pattern> cure, encouraging patients to live healthily to avoid serious illness.","translation":"許多醫生強調預防勝於治療，鼓勵患者健康生活以避免嚴重疾病。","explanation":"名詞「預防」。此處使用固定片語 prevention is better than cure。"}],"related_forms":["prevent","preventable"]}

{"headword":"prime","explanation":"形容詞「首要的、最好的」；名詞「全盛時期」。形容詞用法常考搭配：prime suspect (首要嫌疑人), prime example (典型例子)。名詞用法常考搭配：in one's prime (在某人的全盛時期)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The high cost of tuition is the <target>prime</target> <pattern>reason</pattern> why many students decide to apply for scholarships instead of taking loans.","translation":"學費高昂是許多學生決定申請獎學金而非貸款的首要原因。","explanation":"形容詞「首要的」。指最重要的因素。"},{"sentence":"The athlete's record-breaking performance was a <target>prime</target> <pattern>example</pattern> of how hard work and discipline can lead to success.","translation":"這位運動員打破紀錄的表現是一個典型例子，說明了努力和紀律如何能帶來成功。","explanation":"形容詞「典型的」。prime example 指「典型例子」。"},{"sentence":"The famous pianist continued to perform complex concertos with ease, even though he was no longer <target>in his prime</target>.","translation":"這位著名的鋼琴家即使不再處於全盛時期，依然能輕鬆地演奏複雜的協奏曲。","explanation":"名詞「全盛時期」。片語 in one's prime 表示「在某人的全盛時期」。"},{"sentence":"The police identified a <target>prime</target> <pattern>suspect</pattern> in the robbery case after reviewing the security footage from the nearby store.","translation":"警方在查看附近商店的監視器畫面後，在搶劫案中確定了一名首要嫌疑人。","explanation":"形容詞「首要的」。prime suspect 指「首要嫌疑人」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"primitive","explanation":"形容詞「原始的、簡陋的」。可用於描述古代文明或極其簡單的工具與設備。常考搭配：primitive tools (原始工具), primitive society (原始社會)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Archaeologists discovered <target>primitive</target> <pattern>tools</pattern> made of stone and bone, which provided clues about how early humans hunted for food.","translation":"考古學家發現了由石頭和骨頭製成的原始工具，這為早期人類如何獵食提供了線索。","explanation":"形容詞「原始的」。指早期的、未經發展的工具。"},{"sentence":"Compared to modern luxury hotels, the <target>primitive</target> <pattern>conditions</pattern> of the camping site were quite challenging for the city students.","translation":"與現代豪華酒店相比，露營地的簡陋條件對城市學生來說相當具有挑戰性。","explanation":"形容詞「簡陋的」。指設備極其簡單，缺乏舒適設施。"},{"sentence":"The textbook describes how <target>primitive</target> <pattern>societies</pattern> relied on basic instincts and shared resources to survive in harsh natural environments.","translation":"教科書描述了原始社會如何依賴基本本能和共享資源在惡劣的自然環境中生存。","explanation":"形容詞「原始的」。指人類文明發展的早期階段。"}],"related_forms":["primitively","primitivism"]}

{"headword":"priority","explanation":"名詞「優先權、優先考慮的事」。常用片語：give priority to (優先考慮), a top priority (首要任務)。注意與 prioritize (動詞) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the final exam period, studying for the most difficult subjects should be a <target>top</target> <target>priority</target> for every student.","translation":"在期末考期間，為最困難的科目讀書應該是每個學生的首要任務。","explanation":"名詞「首要任務」。top priority 指「首要任務」。"},{"sentence":"The school administration decided to <target>give</target> <pattern>priority</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> the repair of the science lab, as it was unsafe for students to use.","translation":"學校行政部門決定優先考慮維修科學實驗室，因為對學生來說使用該實驗室是不安全的。","explanation":"名詞「優先權」。片語 give priority to sth 表示「優先考慮某事」。"},{"sentence":"When organizing a large event, the committee must set clear <target>priorities</target> to ensure that the most important tasks are completed first.","translation":"在組織大型活動時，委員會必須設定明確的優先順序，以確保最重要的任務首先被完成。","explanation":"名詞「優先順序」。指需要優先處理的事項。"}],"related_forms":["prioritize"]}

{"headword":"privacy","explanation":"名詞「隱私」。指一個人不希望他人干涉或知道的私密空間或資訊。常用搭配：invade someone's privacy (侵犯某人的隱私), right to privacy (隱私權)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many teenagers feel that their parents <target>invade</target> <pattern>their</pattern> <target>privacy</target> when they check their private messages without permission.","translation":"許多青少年覺得父母在未經許可的情況下檢查他們的私訊時，侵犯了他們的隱私。","explanation":"名詞「隱私」。片語 invade someone's privacy 表示「侵犯某人的隱私」。"},{"sentence":"The new law was designed to protect the <target>privacy</target> <pattern>of</pattern> users' personal data and prevent companies from selling it to advertisers.","translation":"這項新法律旨在保護使用者的個人資料隱私，並防止公司將其出售給廣告商。","explanation":"名詞「隱私」。指個人資訊的保密性。"},{"sentence":"She prefers to work in a quiet corner of the library to maintain her <target>privacy</target> and avoid being interrupted by her classmates.","translation":"她喜歡在圖書館的一個安靜角落工作，以維持她的隱私並避免被同學打擾。","explanation":"名詞「隱私」。指不被他人干擾的私密狀態。"}],"related_forms":["private"]}

{"headword":"privilege","explanation":"名詞「特權」。指特定人群享有的特殊權利。動詞「賦予特權」。常用搭配：a privilege to (有幸...), a sense of privilege (特權感)。","entries":[{"sentence":"It was a great <target>privilege</target> <pattern>to</pattern> meet the Nobel Prize winner and hear his thoughts on the future of science.","translation":"能與諾貝爾獎得主見面並聽取他對科學未來的看法，是一件非常幸運的事。","explanation":"名詞「特權/幸運」。片語 a privilege to V 表示「有幸做某事」。"},{"sentence":"Some people believe that attending an elite private school is a <target>privilege</target> that provides students with an unfair advantage in life.","translation":"有些人認為就讀精英私立學校是一種特權，為學生在生活中提供了不公平的優勢。","explanation":"名詞「特權」。指特定群體享有的特殊權利。"},{"sentence":"The company <target>privileged</target> certain employees with access to the internal database, allowing them to see sensitive information before others.","translation":"公司賦予某些員工進入內部資料庫的權限，使他們能在他人之前看到敏感資訊。","explanation":"動詞「賦予特權」。指允許特定人士使用某些權利。"}],"related_forms":["privileged"]}

{"headword":"procedure","explanation":"名詞「程序、步驟」。指完成某項工作所需的一系列正式步驟。常用搭配：standard procedure (標準程序), follow the procedure (遵循程序)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher explained the safety <target>procedure</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the chemistry experiment, emphasizing that students must wear goggles at all times.","translation":"老師解釋了化學實驗的安全程序，強調學生必須隨時佩戴護目鏡。","explanation":"名詞「程序」。指完成實驗所需的安全步驟。"},{"sentence":"Following the <target>standard</target> <target>procedure</target> is essential in medical clinics to ensure that every patient receives the correct treatment.","translation":"在醫療診所遵循標準程序對於確保每位患者收到正確治療至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「程序」。standard procedure 指「標準程序」。"},{"sentence":"If you wish to apply for a transfer to another class, please <target>follow</target> the <target>procedure</target> outlined in the student handbook.","translation":"如果您想申請轉班，請遵循學生手冊中概述的程序。","explanation":"名詞「程序」。follow the procedure 表示「遵循程序」。"}],"related_forms":["procedural"]}

{"headword":"proceed","explanation":"動詞「繼續進行、前進」。常用搭配：proceed with (繼續進行), proceed to (接著做...)。注意與 process (處理) 或 procedure (程序) 的混淆。","entries":[{"sentence":"After the short break, the principal <target>proceeded</target> <pattern>with</pattern> his speech, discussing the school's plans for the upcoming semester.","translation":"短暫休息後，校長繼續進行他的演講，討論學校對下個學期的計畫。","explanation":"動詞「繼續進行」。片語 proceed with sth 表示「繼續進行某事」。"},{"sentence":"Once you have filled out the application form and signed it, you may <target>proceed</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the payment counter to pay the fee.","translation":"一旦您填好申請表並簽名，就請前往付款櫃檯支付費用。","explanation":"動詞「前進/接著做」。片語 proceed to sth/V 表示「前往某處」或「接著做某事」。"},{"sentence":"The police officer asked the driver to step out of the car and <target>proceed</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the sidewalk for a safety inspection.","translation":"警察要求駕駛走出車內並前往人行道進行安全檢查。","explanation":"動詞「前進」。指移動到某個位置。"}],"related_forms":["proceeding","proceeds"]}

{"headword":"productive","explanation":"形容詞「富有成效的、多產的」。常用於描述工作、討論或農作物。常用搭配：a productive discussion (富有成效的討論), productive effort (有效的努力)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The group project was a success because the students had a <target>productive</target> <pattern>discussion</pattern> and divided the tasks efficiently.","translation":"這項小組計畫很成功，因為學生們進行了富有成效的討論並高效地分工。","explanation":"形容詞「富有成效的」。指產出結果良好。"},{"sentence":"By using a digital planner to organize their tasks, many students find they can be more <target>productive</target> during their study hours.","translation":"透過使用數位計畫表來組織任務，許多學生發現他們在學習時間內能變得更有成效。","explanation":"形容詞「富有成效的」。指在相同時間內完成更多工作。"},{"sentence":"The valley is known for its <target>productive</target> <pattern>soil</pattern>, which allows farmers to grow a wide variety of fruits and vegetables.","translation":"這個山谷以其肥沃多產的土壤而聞名，使農民能夠種植各種水果和蔬菜。","explanation":"形容詞「多產的」。指土地能產生大量農作物。"}],"related_forms":["productivity","productively"]}

{"headword":"profession","explanation":"名詞「職業」。通常指需要經過專業訓練或高等教育才能從事的職業，如醫師、律師或教師。注意與 occupation (較泛指任何工作) 和 career (側重於長期的職業生涯) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"Entering the medical <target>profession</target> requires years of rigorous study and a strong commitment to helping others in need.","translation":"進入醫療職業需要多年的嚴格學習以及對幫助需要之人的堅定承諾。","explanation":"名詞「職業」。常用搭配：medical profession, legal profession。"},{"sentence":"Despite the high salary, she realized that the teaching <target>profession</target> was more rewarding than she had initially expected.","translation":"儘管薪水很高，她意識到教學職業比她最初預期的更有成就感。","explanation":"名詞「職業」。"}],"related_forms":["professional"]}

{"headword":"professional","explanation":"形容詞「專業的」；名詞「專業人士」。作為形容詞時，描述行為、態度或技能達到專業水準；作為名詞時，指在特定領域擁有專業知識的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The project manager praised the intern for her <target>professional</target> <pattern>attitude</pattern> and ability to handle difficult clients calmly.","translation":"專案經理稱讚實習生專業的態度以及冷靜處理困難客戶的能力。","explanation":"形容詞「專業的」。常用搭配：professional attitude, professional behavior。"},{"sentence":"The university hosts an annual conference where <target>professionals</target> <pattern>from</pattern> various fields gather to share their latest research findings.","translation":"大學舉辦一年一度的研討會，讓來自不同領域的專業人士聚集在一起分享他們最新的研究結果。","explanation":"名詞「專業人士」。"},{"sentence":"After years of practice, he finally turned <target>professional</target>, playing tennis for a living instead of competing in amateur tournaments.","translation":"經過多年的練習，他終於轉為職業選手，以打網球維生而非參加業餘賽事。","explanation":"形容詞「職業的」。指以某項活動作為職業獲利。"}],"related_forms":["profession","professionalism"]}

{"headword":"profitable","explanation":"形容詞「獲利的，有利的」。除了指金錢上的獲利 (profit)，也可以指某件事帶來正面且有用的結果。","entries":[{"sentence":"The small business became highly <target>profitable</target> after the owner decided to <pattern>invest in</pattern> a new online marketing strategy.","translation":"在老闆決定投資新的線上行銷策略後，這家小企業變得非常獲利。","explanation":"形容詞「獲利的」。常用搭配：highly profitable。"},{"sentence":"While the experiment failed to produce a product, the data collected was <target>profitable</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the scientists' future research.","translation":"雖然實驗未能產出產品，但收集到的數據對科學家未來的研究是有利的。","explanation":"形容詞「有利的」。"}],"related_forms":["profit","profitability"]}

{"headword":"prominent","explanation":"形容詞「顯著的；著名的；突出的」。可用於描述特徵明顯、地位顯赫或地理位置突出的事物。","entries":[{"sentence":"The mayor is a <target>prominent</target> <pattern>figure</pattern> in the local community, known for his dedication to improving public education.","translation":"市長是當地社區的一個顯著人物，以致力於改善公共教育而聞名。","explanation":"形容詞「著名的，顯著的」。常用搭配：prominent figure, prominent role。"},{"sentence":"One of the most <target>prominent</target> <pattern>features</pattern> of the Gothic cathedral is its tall, pointed arches and intricate stone carvings.","translation":"哥德式大教堂最顯著的特徵之一是其高聳的尖拱和複雜的石雕。","explanation":"形容詞「顯著的」。常用搭配：prominent feature。"},{"sentence":"The tower stands in a <target>prominent</target> <pattern>position</pattern> on the hill, making it visible from almost every part of the city.","translation":"這座塔位於山上的突出位置，使其幾乎從城市的每個角落都能看見。","explanation":"形容詞「突出的」。常用搭配：prominent position。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"promising","explanation":"形容詞「有前途的；有希望的」。通常用來描述人的潛力或事情發展的良好跡象。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young pianist is considered a <target>promising</target> <pattern>talent</pattern> in the classical music world due to her exceptional technique.","translation":"這名年輕的鋼琴家因其卓越的技巧而被認為是古典音樂界一名有前途的人才。","explanation":"形容詞「有前途的」。常用搭配：promising talent, promising student。"},{"sentence":"Early results from the clinical trial show <target>promising</target> <pattern>signs</pattern> that the new drug can effectively treat the disease.","translation":"臨床試驗的早期結果顯示出有希望的跡象，表明新藥能有效治療該疾病。","explanation":"形容詞「有希望的」。常用搭配：promising signs, promising results。"}],"related_forms":["promise"]}

{"headword":"promotion","explanation":"名詞「晉升；促銷」。注意其兩種截然不同的含義：一種是在職場中職位提高；另一種是在商業中增加產品銷量。","entries":[{"sentence":"After consistently meeting all her sales targets, Sarah was thrilled to receive a <target>promotion</target> to senior manager.","translation":"在持續達成所有銷售目標後，莎拉很高興能獲得晉升為高級經理。","explanation":"名詞「晉升」。常用搭配：get/receive a promotion。"},{"sentence":"The company launched a special <target>promotion</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> attract more young customers by offering a buy-one-get-one-free deal.","translation":"公司推出了一項特別的促銷活動，通過提供買一送一的優惠來吸引更多年輕客戶。","explanation":"名詞「促銷」。常用搭配：sales promotion。"}],"related_forms":["promote"]}

{"headword":"prompt","explanation":"形容詞「迅速的」；動詞「促使；提醒」；名詞「提示詞」。注意其作為動詞時常接 follow-up 或導致某種反應。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company is known for its <target>prompt</target> <pattern>response</pattern> to customer complaints, which has helped build strong brand loyalty.","translation":"該公司以對客戶投訴的迅速回應而聞名，這有助於建立強大的品牌忠誠度。","explanation":"形容詞「迅速的」。常用搭配：prompt response, prompt delivery。"},{"sentence":"The sudden increase in air pollution <target>prompted</target> the government <pattern>to</pattern> <pattern>take</pattern> urgent action to reduce emissions.","translation":"空氣污染的突然增加促使政府採取緊急行動以減少排放。","explanation":"動詞「促使」。常用句型：prompt someone to do something。"},{"sentence":"When the speaker forgot his next point, the moderator <target>prompted</target> him with a quick whisper from the side of the stage.","translation":"當演講者忘記下一個要點時，主持人從舞台側面用快速的低聲提醒了他。","explanation":"動詞「提醒」。"},{"sentence":"Students are encouraged to enter a detailed <target>prompt</target> into the AI tool to get the most accurate and helpful answer.","translation":"鼓勵學生輸入詳細的提示詞到 AI 工具中，以獲得最準確且有幫助的答案。","explanation":"名詞「提示詞」。常用於科技與 AI 語境。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"pronunciation","explanation":"名詞「發音」。指將單字或句子說出的方式。注意與動詞 pronounce 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although he speaks English fluently, he sometimes struggles with the <target>pronunciation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> certain complex words.","translation":"雖然他英語說得很流利，但他有時在某些複雜單字的發音上會有困難。","explanation":"名詞「發音」。常用搭配：correct pronunciation, improve pronunciation。"},{"sentence":"The teacher used a recording to demonstrate the <target>pronunciation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the new vocabulary words to the entire class.","translation":"老師使用錄音向全班演示新單字的發音。","explanation":"名詞「發音」。"}],"related_forms":["pronounce"]}

{"headword":"proposal","explanation":"名詞「提案；求婚」。在 GSAT 考題中，多數情況下指計畫或建議的正式提案。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student council submitted a detailed <target>proposal</target> <pattern>for</pattern> a new recycling program to the school administration.","translation":"學生會向學校行政部門提交了一份關於新回收計畫的詳細提案。","explanation":"名詞「提案」。常用搭配：submit a proposal, formal proposal。"},{"sentence":"After months of planning and discussion, the board of directors finally approved the <target>proposal</target> <pattern>to</pattern> build a new research center.","translation":"經過數月的規劃和討論，董事會最終批准了建立新研究中心的提案。","explanation":"名詞「提案」。"}],"related_forms":["propose"]}

{"headword":"prosper","explanation":"動詞「繁榮；成功」。指在經濟、物質或健康方面取得成功或發展良好。","entries":[{"sentence":"With the support of the new trade agreement, many local businesses began to <target>prosper</target> and expand their operations worldwide.","translation":"在新的貿易協定的支持下，許多當地企業開始繁榮並將其業務擴展到全球。","explanation":"動詞「繁榮」。常用搭配：prosper economically。"},{"sentence":"The small village <target>prospered</target> <pattern>under</pattern> the leadership of the new mayor, becoming a popular tourist destination.","translation":"這個小村莊在新市長的領導下繁榮起來，成為了一個受歡迎的旅遊目的地。","explanation":"動詞「繁榮」。"}],"related_forms":["prosperity","prosperous"]}

{"headword":"prosperity","explanation":"名詞「繁榮、興旺」。常用於描述經濟或生活狀態的成功與富足。常考搭配：economic prosperity (經濟繁榮), bring prosperity to... (為...帶來繁榮)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government implemented new trade policies to encourage economic <target>prosperity</target> and create more jobs for the local people.","translation":"政府實施了新的貿易政策，以促進經濟繁榮並為當地人民創造更多就業機會。","explanation":"名詞「繁榮」。常用搭配 economic prosperity 指經濟上的繁榮。"},{"sentence":"Many families moved to the city in search of <target>prosperity</target>, hoping to find better jobs and a more comfortable life.","translation":"許多家庭為了追求繁榮而移居城市，希望找到更好的工作和更舒適的生活。","explanation":"名詞「繁榮」。在此指物質上的富足與成功。"},{"sentence":"The discovery of oil brought great <target>prosperity</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the small town, transforming it into a wealthy commercial center.","translation":"石油的發現為這個小鎮帶來了巨大的繁榮，將其轉變為一個富裕的商業中心。","explanation":"名詞「繁榮」。片語 bring prosperity to... 表示「為...帶來繁榮」。"}],"related_forms":["prosperous","prosper"]}

{"headword":"prosperous","explanation":"形容詞「繁榮的、富裕的」。可用於描述國家、城市、公司或個人。注意其名詞形式 prosperity 和動詞形式 prosper。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city became a <target>prosperous</target> trading hub because of its location near the coast, attracting merchants from all over the world.","translation":"由於靠近海岸的地理位置，這座城市成為了一個繁榮的貿易中心，吸引了來自世界各地的商人。","explanation":"形容詞「繁榮的」。描述地點或經濟狀態。"},{"sentence":"After years of hard work and smart investments, the couple finally built a <target>prosperous</target> business that supported their entire family.","translation":"經過多年的努力和聰明的投資，這對夫婦終於建立了一家繁榮的企業，供養了他們全家。","explanation":"形容詞「富裕的」。描述公司或個人財富狀態。"},{"sentence":"Farmers in the region had a <target>prosperous</target> year thanks to the perfect weather and an unusually high crop yield.","translation":"由於天氣完美且作物產量異常高，該地區的農民度過了繁榮的一年。","explanation":"形容詞「繁榮的」。指獲得成功或財富。"}],"related_forms":["prosperity","prosper"]}

{"headword":"protein","explanation":"名詞「蛋白質」。生物學及營養學常見詞彙。常考搭配：high-protein diet (高蛋白質飲食), plant-based protein (植物性蛋白質)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Athletes often consume a <pattern>high-protein</pattern> <target>protein</target> diet to help build and repair muscles after intense physical training.","translation":"運動員經常食用高蛋白質飲食，以幫助在劇烈體能訓練後建立和修復肌肉。","explanation":"名詞「蛋白質」。常用搭配 high-protein diet。"},{"sentence":"Eggs, fish, and beans are all excellent sources of <target>protein</target>, providing the essential nutrients the body needs to grow.","translation":"雞蛋、魚和豆類都是極佳的蛋白質來源，提供身體生長所需的必需營養素。","explanation":"名詞「蛋白質」。指食物中的營養成分。"},{"sentence":"Some people prefer plant-based <target>protein</target> from soy or nuts instead of animal products for health or ethical reasons.","translation":"有些人出於健康或倫理原因，更喜歡來自大豆或堅果的植物性蛋白質，而非動物產品。","explanation":"名詞「蛋白質」。"}],"related_forms":["proteins"]}

{"headword":"protest","explanation":"動詞「抗議」；名詞「抗議」。注意其發音區別：動詞重音在後 (pro'test)，名詞重音在前 ('protest)。常用搭配：protest against (抗議...)，staged a protest (發起抗議)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Thousands of students gathered in the square to <target>protest</target> <pattern>against</pattern> the new university rules regarding tuition fees.","translation":"數千名學生聚集在廣場上，抗議大學關於學費的新規定。","explanation":"動詞「抗議」。常用搭配 protest against sth。"},{"sentence":"The local community <pattern>staged a</pattern> <target>protest</target> to prevent the government from cutting down the ancient forest to build a highway.","translation":"當地社區發起了一場抗議，以防止政府砍伐古森林來修建高速公路。","explanation":"名詞「抗議」。片語 stage a protest 表示「發起/組織抗議」。"},{"sentence":"Despite the peaceful nature of the <target>protest</target>, some clashes occurred between the demonstrators and the police late at night.","translation":"儘管抗議活動性質和平，但深夜時分示威者與警察之間仍發生了一些衝突。","explanation":"名詞「抗議」。指集體表達不滿的活動。"},{"sentence":"The employees <target>protested</target> <pattern>against</pattern> the unfair working conditions by refusing to enter the factory for a whole week.","translation":"員工們透過整整一週拒絕進入工廠，來抗議不公平的工作條件。","explanation":"動詞「抗議」。"}],"related_forms":["protests","protesting","protester"]}

{"headword":"psychological","explanation":"形容詞「心理的、心理學的」。常用於描述心理狀態、影響或壓力。常考搭配：psychological impact (心理影響), psychological warfare (心理戰)。注意與 mental 的區別：psychological 更傾向於專業的心理學分析或深層的心理運作，而 mental 較廣泛地指心智或精神狀態。","entries":[{"sentence":"The sudden loss of a pet can have a deep <target>psychological</target> <pattern>impact</pattern> on a child, affecting their emotional development.","translation":"突然失去寵物可能會對孩子產生深遠的心理影響，影響他們的情感發展。","explanation":"形容詞「心理的」。常用搭配 psychological impact。"},{"sentence":"Psychologists study the <target>psychological</target> <pattern>effects</pattern> of social media on teenagers' self-esteem and overall happiness.","translation":"心理學家研究社群媒體對青少年自尊心和整體幸福感的心理影響。","explanation":"形容詞「心理的」。常用搭配 psychological effects。"},{"sentence":"Overcoming a fear of public speaking often requires <target>psychological</target> <pattern>training</pattern> to build confidence and reduce anxiety.","translation":"克服對公開演講的恐懼通常需要心理訓練，以建立信心並減少焦慮。","explanation":"形容詞「心理的」。"}],"related_forms":["psychologically","psychology"]}

{"headword":"psychologist","explanation":"名詞「心理學家」。指研究心理過程及行為的專家。注意與 psychiatrist (精神科醫生) 的區別：psychologist 通常不開藥，而 psychiatrist 是醫學院畢業且有權開藥的醫師。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school hired a professional <target>psychologist</target> to help students deal with stress and improve their emotional well-being.","translation":"學校聘請了一位專業的心理學家，幫助學生應對壓力並改善他們的情緒健康。","explanation":"名詞「心理學家」。"},{"sentence":"After the accident, he visited a <target>psychologist</target> to process the trauma and learn how to manage his anxiety.","translation":"事故發生後，他拜訪了一位心理學家，以處理創傷並學習如何管理焦慮。","explanation":"名詞「心理學家」。"},{"sentence":"The <target>psychologist</target> conducted an experiment to observe how children react to different social situations in a controlled environment.","translation":"心理學家在受控環境中進行了一項實驗，以觀察兒童對不同社交情境的反應。","explanation":"名詞「心理學家」。"}],"related_forms":["psychologists"]}

{"headword":"psychology","explanation":"名詞「心理學」。指研究心智與行為的科學。常見搭配：educational psychology (教育心理學), social psychology (社會心理學)。","entries":[{"sentence":"She decided to major in <target>psychology</target> because she was fascinated by how human emotions and thoughts influence behavior.","translation":"她決定主修心理學，因為她對人類的情緒和思想如何影響行為感到著迷。","explanation":"名詞「心理學」。指學術科目。"},{"sentence":"Understanding the <target>psychology</target> <pattern>of</pattern> consumers helps companies design better advertisements to attract more customers.","translation":"了解消費者的心理有助於公司設計更好的廣告以吸引更多顧客。","explanation":"名詞「心理」。此處指某類人的心理特徵或運作模式。"},{"sentence":"The course on social <target>psychology</target> explores how people's thoughts and feelings are influenced by the presence of others.","translation":"社會心理學課程探討人們的思想和感受如何受到他人的影響。","explanation":"名詞「心理學」。"}],"related_forms":["psychological","psychologist"]}

{"headword":"publication","explanation":"名詞「出版物、出版」。可指出版的行為，或指出版出的書、雜誌等成品。常用搭配：academic publication (學術出版物), date of publication (出版日期)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The professor was proud of his latest <target>publication</target> in a world-renowned scientific journal, which received a lot of attention.","translation":"教授對他在世界知名科學期刊上的最新出版物感到自豪，該出版物受到了很多關注。","explanation":"名詞「出版物」。指已出版的文章或書籍。"},{"sentence":"The <target>publication</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the new novel was delayed for several months due to unexpected printing problems.","translation":"由於意外的印刷問題，這本新小說的出版被推遲了幾個月。","explanation":"名詞「出版」。指將作品印刷並發行的過程。"},{"sentence":"The library has a wide collection of official <target>publications</target> from the government, providing detailed statistics on the economy.","translation":"圖書館收藏了大量政府的官方出版物，提供了關於經濟的詳細統計數據。","explanation":"名詞「出版物」。"}],"related_forms":["publish","publisher","published"]}

{"headword":"publicity","explanation":"名詞「宣傳、關注」。通常指透過媒體吸引公眾注意力的行為或狀態。注意與 publication (出版) 的區別：publication 強調「發行」，而 publicity 強調「曝光/關注」。常用搭配：get publicity (獲得關注), negative publicity (負面宣傳)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new movie received a lot of <target>publicity</target> before its release, making it a huge hit at the box office.","translation":"這部新電影在上映前獲得了大量宣傳，使其在票房上大獲成功。","explanation":"名詞「宣傳」。指透過媒體吸引注意力的行為。"},{"sentence":"The company struggled to recover from the <pattern>negative</pattern> <target>publicity</target> after a faulty product was found in their latest batch.","translation":"在最新一批產品中發現缺陷後，公司努力從負面宣傳中恢復。","explanation":"名詞「關注/宣傳」。常用搭配 negative publicity。"},{"sentence":"The charity event <pattern>gained</pattern> <target>publicity</target> when a famous celebrity decided to volunteer and share the news on social media.","translation":"當一位著名名人決定擔任志工並在社群媒體上分享消息時，這場慈善活動獲得了關注。","explanation":"名詞「關注」。片語 gain/get publicity 表示「獲得關注」。"}],"related_forms":["publicize"]}

{"headword":"publish","explanation":"動詞「出版、發表」。指將作品正式印刷或在網路公布給大眾。常用搭配：publish a book (出版書籍), publish a paper (發表論文)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young author was thrilled when a famous publishing house agreed to <target>publish</target> her first collection of short stories.","translation":"當一家著名的出版社同意出版她的第一部短篇小說集時，這位年輕作者感到非常興奮。","explanation":"動詞「出版」。指書籍的發行。"},{"sentence":"Scientists usually <target>publish</target> their research findings in academic journals so that other experts can review and verify the data.","translation":"科學家通常在學術期刊上發表他們的研究結果，以便其他專家審查和驗證數據。","explanation":"動詞「發表」。指研究結果的公布。"},{"sentence":"The university decided to <target>publish</target> the full list of scholarship winners on its official website for everyone to see.","translation":"大學決定將獎學金獲獎者的完整名單公布在官方網站上，讓每個人都能看到。","explanation":"動詞「公布」。指將資訊公開。"}],"related_forms":["publication","publisher","published"]}

{"headword":"publisher","explanation":"名詞「出版商，出版公司」。指負責編輯、印刷及銷售書籍、雜誌或報紙的機構或個人。常用搭配 include a publisher, contact a publisher。","entries":[{"sentence":"After writing her first novel, the young author spent months searching for a <target>publisher</target> who would be interested in her story.","translation":"在寫完第一本小說後，這位年輕作者花了幾個月時間尋找願意對她的故事感興趣的出版商。","explanation":"名詞「出版商」。"},{"sentence":"The <target>publisher</target> decided to print thousands of copies of the textbook to meet the high demand from schools across the country.","translation":"出版商決定印刷數千本教科書，以滿足全國學校的高需求。","explanation":"名詞「出版公司」。"},{"sentence":"Many independent <target>publishers</target> focus on niche topics, providing a platform for authors who are not supported by large companies.","translation":"許多獨立出版商專注於小眾主題，為那些沒有大公司支持的作者提供平台。","explanation":"名詞「出版商」（複數）。"}],"related_forms":["publishing","publication"]}

{"headword":"pursue","explanation":"動詞「追求；追趕」。可用於追求目標、夢想或職業，也可指追趕某人或某物。常用搭配 pursue a dream, pursue a career, pursue a goal。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite the challenges, the student decided to <target>pursue</target> a degree in medicine because she wanted to help people in need.","translation":"儘管面臨挑戰，這名學生決定追求醫學學位，因為她想幫助有需要的人。","explanation":"動詞「追求」。常用搭配 pursue a degree/career。"},{"sentence":"The police officer continued to <target>pursue</target> the suspect through the narrow streets until he finally caught him near the park.","translation":"警察繼續在狹窄的街道上追趕嫌疑犯，直到最後在公園附近將其抓獲。","explanation":"動詞「追趕」。"},{"sentence":"Many people choose to <target>pursue</target> <pattern>their dreams</pattern> by moving to a big city, hoping to find more opportunities for growth.","translation":"許多人選擇透過搬到大城市來追求他們的夢想，希望能找到更多成長的機會。","explanation":"動詞「追求」。常用搭配 pursue their dreams。"}],"related_forms":["pursuit","pursuable"]}

{"headword":"pursuit","explanation":"名詞「追求；追擊」。可指對某事物的渴望追求，或指一種活動/嗜好。常用搭配 in pursuit of (為了追求...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young artist spent his whole life <pattern>in</pattern> <target>pursuit</target> <pattern>of</pattern> artistic perfection, creating countless paintings and sculptures.","translation":"這位年輕藝術家一生都在追求藝術上的完美，創作了無數的繪畫和雕塑。","explanation":"名詞「追求」。片語 in pursuit of...。"},{"sentence":"The police were <pattern>in</pattern> <target>pursuit</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the stolen car, with sirens blaring as they chased it through the highway.","translation":"警察正在追擊被盜的汽車，在高速公路上追趕時鳴笛聲大作。","explanation":"名詞「追擊」。片語 in pursuit of...。"},{"sentence":"Reading and hiking are his favorite leisure <target>pursuits</target>, allowing him to relax and escape the stress of school work.","translation":"閱讀和登山是他最喜歡的休閒活動，讓他能放鬆並逃離學業壓力。","explanation":"名詞「活動/嗜好」。"}],"related_forms":["pursue"]}

{"headword":"quarrel","explanation":"名詞「爭吵」；動詞「爭吵」。常用搭配 have a quarrel with, quarrel about/over sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two best friends had a bitter <target>quarrel</target> <pattern>over</pattern> a small misunderstanding, and they did not speak to each other for a week.","translation":"這兩個最好的朋友因為一個小誤會而發生了激烈的爭吵，一週都沒有說話。","explanation":"名詞「爭吵」。常用搭配 quarrel over sth。"},{"sentence":"It is common for siblings to <target>quarrel</target> <pattern>about</pattern> who gets to use the computer first, but they usually make up quickly.","translation":"兄弟姊妹之間常為了誰先使用電腦而爭吵，但他們通常很快就和好。","explanation":"動詞「爭吵」。常用搭配 quarrel about sth。"},{"sentence":"She tried to mediate the <target>quarrel</target> between her classmates, hoping to restore peace and friendship in the classroom.","translation":"她試圖調解同學之間的爭吵，希望恢復教室裡的和平與友誼。","explanation":"名詞「爭吵」。"}],"related_forms":["quarrelsome"]}

{"headword":"quilt","explanation":"名詞「被子，拼接被」；動詞「縫被子」。指一種由多層布料縫合而成的厚被子。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the cold winter nights, she wrapped herself in a warm <target>quilt</target> and read a book by the soft light of a lamp.","translation":"在寒冷的冬夜，她裹著溫暖的被子，在燈光的柔光下讀書。","explanation":"名詞「被子」。"},{"sentence":"The grandmother spent months <target>quilting</target> a beautiful blanket for her grandson, using pieces of old clothes and colorful fabrics.","translation":"奶奶花了幾個月時間為她的孫子縫製一件美麗的毯子，使用了舊衣服和彩色布料。","explanation":"動詞「縫被子」。"}],"related_forms":["quilts","quilting"]}

{"headword":"quotation","explanation":"名詞「引用；引文；報價」。在學術寫作中常用於指引用他人的話語；在商業中常用於指價格報價。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student included a famous <target>quotation</target> <pattern>from</pattern> Albert Einstein in her essay to support her argument and make it more persuasive.","translation":"學生在論文中引用了愛因斯坦的一句名言，以支持她的論點並使其更具說服力。","explanation":"名詞「引文」。常用搭配 quotation from sth。"},{"sentence":"Before deciding which company to hire, the manager asked for a written <target>quotation</target> to know the exact cost of the project.","translation":"在決定雇用哪家公司之前，經理要求提供一份書面報價，以了解項目的確切成本。","explanation":"名詞「報價」。"},{"sentence":"The teacher reminded the students to put quotation marks around any <target>quotation</target> they used in their research papers.","translation":"老師提醒學生在研究論文中使用的任何引用部分都要加上引號。","explanation":"名詞「引用」。"}],"related_forms":["quote"]}

{"headword":"radar","explanation":"名詞「雷達」。用於偵測物體位置和速度的設備。常用搭配 on the radar, under the radar。","entries":[{"sentence":"The airport control tower uses <target>radar</target> to track the position of airplanes and ensure they land safely on the runway.","translation":"機場控制塔使用雷達來追蹤飛機的位置，並確保它們安全地在跑道上著陸。","explanation":"名詞「雷達」。"},{"sentence":"The police used a <target>radar</target> gun to detect the speed of cars on the highway, catching many drivers who were speeding.","translation":"警察使用雷達測速槍來偵測高速公路上的車速，抓獲了許多超速的駕駛者。","explanation":"名詞「雷達測速儀」。"},{"sentence":"The small startup company had been <pattern>under</pattern> the <target>radar</target> for years, but it suddenly became famous after releasing a new product.","translation":"這家小型創業公司多年來一直不被注意到，但在發布新產品後突然成名。","explanation":"名詞「雷達」。片語 under the radar 表「不被注意到」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"rage","explanation":"名詞「憤怒；狂熱」；動詞「發怒；猛烈地進行」。常用搭配 fly into a rage, rage against sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"The manager <pattern>flew</pattern> <target>into</target> a <target>rage</target> when he discovered that the employees had made a serious mistake in the report.","translation":"經理在發現員工在報告中犯了嚴重錯誤時大發雷霆。","explanation":"名詞「憤怒」。片語 fly into a rage 表「大發雷霆」。"},{"sentence":"The forest fire continued to <target>rage</target> for several days, destroying thousands of trees and forcing many animals to flee their homes.","translation":"森林大火持續猛烈燃燒了數天，摧毀了數千棵樹，迫使許多動物逃離家園。","explanation":"動詞「猛烈地進行」。指火災或風暴等猛烈地發生。"},{"sentence":"During the game, the player's <target>rage</target> was evident as he shouted at the referee, leading to a red card and his removal from the field.","translation":"比賽期間，球員的憤怒顯而易見，因為他對裁判大吼大叫，導致被出紅牌並被驅逐出場。","explanation":"名詞「憤怒」。"}],"related_forms":["raged","raging"]}

{"headword":"rainfall","explanation":"名詞「降雨量」。通常用於描述氣候或地理環境。常用搭配 average rainfall, heavy rainfall。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tropical rainforest receives <pattern>heavy</pattern> <target>rainfall</target> throughout the year, which allows a huge variety of plants to grow.","translation":"熱帶雨林全年降雨量大，使得各種植物能夠生長。","explanation":"名詞「降雨量」。常用搭配 heavy rainfall。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are studying how the <pattern>average</pattern> <target>rainfall</target> in this region has decreased over the last decade due to climate change.","translation":"科學家正在研究由於氣候變化，該地區過去十年的平均降雨量是如何減少的。","explanation":"名詞「降雨量」。常用搭配 average rainfall。"},{"sentence":"The farmers were worried that the lack of <target>rainfall</target> during the spring would lead to a poor harvest for their crops.","translation":"農夫們擔心春天缺乏降雨會導致作物收成不佳。","explanation":"名詞「降雨量」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"raisin","explanation":"名詞「葡萄乾」。指將葡萄脫水後製成的乾果。","entries":[{"sentence":"She added a handful of <target>raisins</target> to the oatmeal for breakfast, adding a natural sweetness and a bit of texture to the meal.","translation":"她在早餐的燕麥片中加入了一把葡萄乾，為這餐增加了天然的甜味和一點口感。","explanation":"名詞「葡萄乾」。"},{"sentence":"The baker used <target>raisins</target> in the cinnamon rolls, creating a delicious combination of sweet fruit and spicy cinnamon.","translation":"烘焙師在肉桂捲中使用了葡萄乾，創造出甜果實和辛辣肉桂的美味組合。","explanation":"名詞「葡萄乾」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"realistic","explanation":"形容詞，意為「現實的、實際的」或「寫實的」。在 GSAT 中，常用於描述計畫、目標或看法是否符合實際情況，而非僅僅是理想化的。注意與 ideal (理想的) 相反。例如，a realistic goal (一個實際的目標) 或 a realistic expectation (一個實際的期待)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Setting <target>realistic</target> goals for studying is essential for students to avoid feeling overwhelmed by too many tasks in a short time.","translation":"設定實際的學習目標對於學生來說至關重要，以避免在短時間內因任務過多而感到壓力過大。","explanation":"形容詞「實際的」。指目標符合現實情況，可達成。"},{"sentence":"The teacher advised the student to be more <target>realistic</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the amount of time needed to finish the complex project.","translation":"老師建議學生對於完成這個複雜計畫所需的時間要更加實際一些。","explanation":"形容詞「實際的」。常用搭配：be realistic about sth (對...採取實際的看法)。"},{"sentence":"The artist's paintings are highly <target>realistic</target>, capturing every tiny detail of the landscape so that it looks like a photograph.","translation":"藝術家的畫作非常寫實，捕捉了風景的每一個微小細節，使其看起來像一張照片。","explanation":"形容詞「寫實的」。指藝術風格模仿現實生活。"}],"related_forms":["realistically","realism"]}

{"headword":"rebel","explanation":"可用作名詞「反叛者、造反者」或動詞「反叛、造反」。名詞發音為 /'rebl/，動詞發音為 /ri'bel/。常考用法：rebel against sth/sb (反抗某事/某人)。","entries":[{"sentence":"In history class, we learned about the people who acted as <target>rebels</target> and fought against the unfair laws of the government.","translation":"在歷史課上，我們學習了那些作為反叛者並反抗政府不公正法律的人們。","explanation":"名詞「反叛者」。指反對權威或傳統的人。"},{"sentence":"Many teenagers tend to <target>rebel</target> <pattern>against</pattern> their parents' strict rules to express their independence and desire for freedom.","translation":"許多青少年傾向於反抗父母的 strict rules 以表達他們的獨立精神和對自由的渴望。","explanation":"動詞「反抗」。常用搭配：rebel against sth/sb (反抗某事/某人)。"},{"sentence":"The young soldier decided to <target>rebel</target> <pattern>against</pattern> the military's outdated traditions, hoping to bring about positive changes in the organization.","translation":"年輕的士兵決定反抗軍隊中過時的傳統，希望在組織中帶來積極的改變。","explanation":"動詞「反抗」。指對既有權威或規範進行反對。"}],"related_forms":["rebellion","rebellious"]}

{"headword":"recall","explanation":"動詞「回想、召回」或名詞「回憶、召回」。動詞用法中，recall 與 remember 的區別在於 recall 較側重於「刻意地從記憶中提取資訊」，而 remember 則是指「記得」或「仍保有記憶」。名詞用法常指產品的召回。常用搭配：recall from memory (從記憶中回想)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The witness struggled to <target>recall</target> the exact details of the accident, but she eventually remembered the color of the car.","translation":"證人努力回想事故的確切細節，但她最終想起了車子的顏色。","explanation":"動詞「回想」。指刻意地想起某事。"},{"sentence":"The company had to <target>recall</target> thousands of defective smartphones because of a battery problem that could cause the devices to overheat.","translation":"公司必須召回數千部有缺陷的智慧型手機，因為電池問題可能導致設備過熱。","explanation":"動詞「召回」。指製造商要求消費者將產品送回以進行維修或更換。"},{"sentence":"The sudden <target>recall</target> of the car model caused a lot of stress for many owners who had just purchased the vehicles.","translation":"該車款的突然召回讓許多剛購買車輛的所有者感到壓力很大。","explanation":"名詞「召回」。指將產品從市場上撤回的行為。"},{"sentence":"After years of living abroad, he tried to <target>recall</target> the smells and sounds of his hometown to feel closer to his family.","translation":"經過多年住在國外，他試圖回想家鄉的氣味和聲音，以感到與家人更親近。","explanation":"動詞「回想」。指對過去經驗的回憶。"}],"related_forms":["recalled","recalling"]}

{"headword":"reception","explanation":"名詞，意為「接待、接待會」或「接收（訊號）」。在 GSAT 中，常考三個主要方向：1. 社交場合的接待會（如 wedding reception）；2. 訊號的接收（如 phone reception）；3. 對某事物的反應（如 the reception of the new book）。","entries":[{"sentence":"After the wedding ceremony, the couple and their guests attended a grand <target>reception</target> with delicious food and music.","translation":"婚禮儀式後，新人及其賓客參加了一場盛大的接待會，有美味的食物和音樂。","explanation":"名詞「接待會」。指婚禮或正式場合後的社交聚會。"},{"sentence":"I tried to call my parents, but the phone <target>reception</target> in the deep mountains was too poor to maintain a clear conversation.","translation":"我想打電話給我父母，但深山裡的手機訊號接收太差，無法維持清晰的對話。","explanation":"名詞「訊號接收」。指電子設備接收訊號的能力或品質。"},{"sentence":"The new movie received a warm <target>reception</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the critics, who praised its creative storytelling and deep emotional impact.","translation":"這部新電影受到了評論家們熱烈的歡迎，他們稱讚其創意十足的敘事方式和深刻的情感衝擊。","explanation":"名詞「反應、歡迎」。指人們對某件作品或想法的反應。"}],"related_forms":["receive","receptive"]}

{"headword":"recipe","explanation":"名詞「食譜、秘訣」。除了指烹飪的步驟（cooking recipe），在比喻意義上，常指達成某種結果的「秘訣」或「方法」。常用搭配：recipe for success (成功的秘訣)。","entries":[{"sentence":"My grandmother's secret <target>recipe</target> <pattern>for</pattern> apple pie is passed down through generations and is loved by everyone in the family.","translation":"我祖母的蘋果派秘密食譜代代相傳，深受家人喜愛。","explanation":"名詞「食譜」。指烹飪食物的詳細步驟。"},{"sentence":"Many experts believe that hard work and a positive attitude are the perfect <target>recipe</target> <pattern>for</pattern> success in any career.","translation":"許多專家認為，勤奮和積極的態度是任何職業成功之完美秘訣。","explanation":"名詞「秘訣」。比喻指達成某種結果所需的一系列條件。"}],"related_forms":["recipes"]}

{"headword":"recognition","explanation":"名詞「認出、承認、認可」。常用搭配：gain recognition (獲得認可), in recognition of (為了表彰...)。注意與 recognize 的區別：recognition 側重於狀態或結果，而 recognize 則是動作。常用於描述對某人的貢獻或成就的承認。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student received a gold medal <pattern>in</pattern> <target>recognition</target> <pattern>of</pattern> his outstanding academic achievements and leadership in the school club.","translation":"這名學生獲得了一枚金牌，以表彰他在學校社團中的卓越學業成就和領導力。","explanation":"名詞「表彰、認可」。常用片語 in recognition of sth (為了表彰...)。"},{"sentence":"Due to the poor lighting in the dark hallway, it took me a few seconds of <target>recognition</target> before I realized who was standing there.","translation":"由於走廊燈光昏暗，我花了好幾秒鐘才認出站在那裡的是誰。","explanation":"名詞「認出」。指辨認出熟悉之人的過程。"},{"sentence":"After years of hard work, the scientist finally gained international <target>recognition</target> for her groundbreaking research on climate change.","translation":"經過多年的努力，這位科學家終於因其對氣候變遷的突破性研究而獲得了國際認可。","explanation":"名詞「認可」。指公認的地位或聲望。"}],"related_forms":["recognize","recognizable"]}

{"headword":"recovery","explanation":"名詞「恢復、痊癒」。常用於描述身體健康、經濟狀況或遺失物品的找回。常用搭配：make a full recovery (完全康復)。注意與 recover (動詞) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor told the patient that he would <pattern>make</pattern> a <pattern>full</pattern> <target>recovery</target> if he followed the medical advice and rested well.","translation":"醫生告訴病人，如果他遵循醫囑並充分休息，將會完全康復。","explanation":"名詞「痊癒」。常用搭配：make a full recovery (完全康復)。"},{"sentence":"Economists are hopeful that the country's financial <target>recovery</target> will happen faster after the government implements new economic policies.","translation":"經濟學家希望政府實施新經濟政策後，國家的財務恢復會更快。","explanation":"名詞「恢復」。指經濟或財務狀況的回升。"},{"sentence":"The police were praised for the quick <target>recovery</target> of the stolen paintings, which were found in a warehouse near the city center.","translation":"警方因迅速找回被盜的畫作而受到稱讚，這些畫作在市中心附近的一個倉庫中被發現。","explanation":"名詞「找回」。指將遺失或被盜之物找回。"}],"related_forms":["recover","recoverable"]}

{"headword":"recreation","explanation":"名詞「消遣、娛樂」。指在工作或學習之外，為了放鬆而進行的活動。常用搭配：recreational activities (消遣活動)。注意與 creation (創造) 相反，其前綴 re- 在此處並不表示重複，而是指重新獲得活力。","entries":[{"sentence":"The local government built a new park with swimming pools and tennis courts to provide more <target>recreation</target> <pattern>opportunities</pattern> for the citizens.","translation":"當地政府建造了一個擁有游泳池和網球場的新公園，為市民提供更多消遣機會。","explanation":"名詞「消遣」。指放鬆身心的娛樂活動。"},{"sentence":"Reading books and hiking in the mountains are my favorite forms of <target>recreation</target> because they help me relax after a stressful week.","translation":"閱讀書籍和在山中徒步旅行是我最喜歡的消遣方式，因為它們能幫我在壓力沉重的一週後放鬆。","explanation":"名詞「消遣」。指為了娛樂而進行的活動。"},{"sentence":"The school encourages students to take part in <target>recreational</target> <pattern>activities</pattern> to maintain a healthy balance between study and leisure.","translation":"學校鼓勵學生參加消遣活動，以維持學習與休閒之間的健康平衡。","explanation":"形容詞形式 recreational，搭配 activities 表示「消遣活動」。"}],"related_forms":["recreational"]}

{"headword":"recycle","explanation":"動詞「回收、循環利用」。指將廢棄物處理後重新利用。常考搭配：recycle paper/plastic/glass。注意與 reuse (重複使用) 的區別：recycle 涉及處理過程（如將塑料瓶分解成原料），而 reuse 則是指直接再次使用同一個物品。","entries":[{"sentence":"To protect the environment, the school started a program to <target>recycle</target> <pattern>used</pattern> paper and plastic bottles in every classroom.","translation":"為了保護環境，學校在每個教室開始了一項回收使用過的紙張和塑料瓶的計畫。","explanation":"動詞「回收」。指將廢棄物轉化為新產品的過程。"},{"sentence":"Many people choose to <target>recycle</target> their old electronic devices to prevent harmful chemicals from leaking into the soil and water.","translation":"許多人選擇回收他們舊的電子設備，以防止有害化學物質滲漏到土壤和水中。","explanation":"動詞「回收」。指針對電子廢棄物的循環利用。"},{"sentence":"The city's new waste management system makes it easier for residents to <target>recycle</target> <pattern>glass</pattern> and metal cans more efficiently.","translation":"這座城市的全新廢物管理系統讓居民能更有效地回收玻璃和金屬罐。","explanation":"動詞「回收」。指對特定材料的循環利用。"}],"related_forms":["recyclable","recycling"]}

{"headword":"reduction","explanation":"名詞「減少、降低」。由動詞 reduce 衍生而來。常用搭配：reduction in (某方面的減少), cost reduction (成本降低), reduction of (減少某物)。注意在 GSAT 中常出現在關於環境、經濟或健康話題中，例如 carbon reduction (碳減排)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government announced a significant <target>reduction</target> <pattern>in</pattern> air pollution levels after the city banned old diesel cars from the center.","translation":"在城市禁止舊柴油車進入中心後，政府宣布空氣污染程度顯著降低。","explanation":"名詞「減少」。常用搭配：reduction in sth (在某方面的減少)。"},{"sentence":"The company implemented a cost <target>reduction</target> plan to save money and avoid laying off employees during the economic crisis.","translation":"公司實施了一項成本降低計畫，以省錢並在經濟危機期間避免解雇員工。","explanation":"名詞「減少」。常用搭配：cost reduction (成本降低)。"},{"sentence":"Doctors recommend a <target>reduction</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the intake of sugar and salt to lower the risk of heart disease and improve overall health.","translation":"醫生建議減少糖分和鹽分的攝取，以降低心臟病的風險並改善整體健康。","explanation":"名詞「減少」。常用搭配：reduction in the intake of sth (減少對某物的攝取)。"}],"related_forms":["reduce","reducible"]}

{"headword":"refer","explanation":"動詞，意為「提及」、「參考」或「轉介」。常用片語 refer to (提及/參考/稱呼)。注意 refer to sb as sth (將某人稱作...) 是 GSAT 常考結構。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you are unsure about the meaning of a word, you should <target>refer</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the dictionary to find the correct definition.","translation":"如果你不確定一個單字的意思，你應該參考字典以找到正確的定義。","explanation":"動詞「參考」。常用片語 refer to (參考/查閱)。"},{"sentence":"The professor <target>referred</target> <pattern>to</pattern> several academic journals in her research paper to support her arguments with reliable evidence.","translation":"教授在她的研究論文中提及了幾本學術期刊，以可靠的證據來支持她的論點。","explanation":"動詞「提及」。常用片語 refer to (提到)。"},{"sentence":"Many people <target>refer</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the historical figure <pattern>as</pattern> the father of modern science because of his groundbreaking discoveries.","translation":"由於他的突破性發現，許多人將這位歷史人物稱為現代科學之父。","explanation":"動詞「稱呼」。常用結構 refer to sb/sth as sth (將...稱為...)。"},{"sentence":"The general practitioner <target>referred</target> the patient <pattern>to</pattern> a specialist for a more detailed examination of the heart condition.","translation":"全科醫生將病人轉介給專科醫生，以便對心臟狀況進行更詳細的檢查。","explanation":"動詞「轉介」。指將某人送到另一位專業人士處處理。"}],"related_forms":["referred","referring"]}

{"headword":"reference","explanation":"名詞，意為「參考」、「提及」或「推薦信」。常用搭配 reference book (參考書) 或 make reference to (提及)。注意 reference 作為動詞時，意為「將...列為參考」，但名詞用法最為常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student's essay contained several <pattern>cross</pattern> <target>references</target> to other chapters in the book, helping the reader understand the complex topic.","translation":"學生的論文包含數個指向書中其他章節的交叉參考，幫助讀者理解這個複雜的主題。","explanation":"名詞「參考」。指指向其他資訊來源的行為。"},{"sentence":"When applying for a scholarship, you may need to provide a professional <target>reference</target> from a teacher or a former employer.","translation":"申請獎學金時，你可能需要提供一份來自老師或前雇主的專業推薦信。","explanation":"名詞「推薦信」。指證明一個人能力或品格的信函。"},{"sentence":"During the lecture, the speaker <pattern>made</pattern> <target>reference</target> <pattern>to</pattern> a recent news event to illustrate his point more clearly to the students.","translation":"在講座中，演講者提及了一個最近的新聞事件，以便向學生更清楚地說明他的觀點。","explanation":"名詞「提及」。常用片語 make reference to (提及)。"}],"related_forms":["references"]}

{"headword":"reflect","explanation":"動詞，意為「反射」、「反映」或「深思」。常用搭配 reflect on (深思/反省)。注意 reflect 可描述物理上的光線反射，也可描述抽象的狀況反映。","entries":[{"sentence":"The calm surface of the lake <target>reflects</target> the surrounding mountains and the blue sky like a giant mirror.","translation":"湖泊平靜的表面像一面巨大的鏡子，反射出周圍的山脈和藍天。","explanation":"動詞「反射」。指物理上的光線反射。"},{"sentence":"The high test scores <target>reflect</target> the students' hard work and dedication throughout the entire semester.","translation":"高分反映了學生在整個學期中的努力和奉獻。","explanation":"動詞「反映」。指某事顯示出某種特質或狀態。"},{"sentence":"After the failure of the project, the manager spent several days <target>reflecting</target> <pattern>on</pattern> his mistakes to improve future performance.","translation":"專案失敗後，經理花了幾天時間反省自己的錯誤，以改善未來的表現。","explanation":"動詞片語 reflect on (深思/反省)。"}],"related_forms":["reflects","reflected","reflecting"]}

{"headword":"reflection","explanation":"名詞，意為「反射」、「反映」或「深思」。與動詞 reflect 相對應，常用搭配 reflection of ( ... 的反映)。","entries":[{"sentence":"She looked into the mirror and saw her own <target>reflection</target>, noticing that her hair was messy after the long walk.","translation":"她看向鏡子，看到了自己的倒影，發現長時間行走後她的頭髮很亂。","explanation":"名詞「反射/倒影」。指光線反射產生的影像。"},{"sentence":"The current political climate is a clear <target>reflection</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the public's growing frustration with the economic situation.","translation":"目前的政治氣候清楚地反映了公眾對經濟狀況日益增加的挫折感。","explanation":"名詞「反映」。指某事是另一件事的結果或表現。"},{"sentence":"Through quiet <target>reflection</target>, he realized that true happiness comes from helping others rather than pursuing material wealth.","translation":"透過安靜的深思，他意識到真正的快樂來自於幫助他人而非追求物質財富。","explanation":"名詞「深思」。指思考過程。"}],"related_forms":["reflections"]}

{"headword":"reform","explanation":"名詞或動詞，意為「改革」。動詞指「改善」或「修正」；名詞指「改革措施」。常用搭配 political reform (政治改革) 或 social reform (社會改革)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government introduced a series of economic <target>reforms</target> to attract more foreign investment and create more jobs for citizens.","translation":"政府推出了一系列經濟改革，以吸引更多外國投資並為公民創造更多就業機會。","explanation":"名詞「改革」。指制度上的改善。"},{"sentence":"The school board decided to <target>reform</target> the grading system to ensure that students were evaluated more fairly and accurately.","translation":"學校董事會決定改革評分制度，以確保學生能得到更公平且準確的評估。","explanation":"動詞「改革」。指對現有系統進行修正以使其更好。"},{"sentence":"Prison <target>reforms</target> are often designed to help inmates learn new skills and successfully reintegrate into society after their release.","translation":"監獄改革通常旨在幫助囚犯學習新技能，並在釋放後成功重新融入社會。","explanation":"名詞「改革」。常用搭配 prison reform (監獄改革)。"}],"related_forms":["reformer","reforming"]}
