{"headword":"refugee","explanation":"名詞，意為「難民」。指因戰爭、迫害或自然災害而被迫離開家園的人。常用搭配 refugee camp (難民營) 或 refugee crisis (難民危機)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The international organization provided food and medicine to thousands of <target>refugees</target> who had fled from the war-torn region.","translation":"國際組織為數千名從戰區逃離的難民提供了食物和藥品。","explanation":"名詞「難民」。"},{"sentence":"Many <target>refugees</target> struggle to integrate into a new culture and find employment in the host country where they seek asylum.","translation":"許多難民在尋求庇護的接收國中，努力地融入新文化並尋找工作。","explanation":"名詞「難民」。"},{"sentence":"The government set up temporary <target>refugee</target> <pattern>camps</pattern> to provide basic shelter and safety for those displaced by the earthquake.","translation":"政府建立了臨時難民營，為那些被地震驅離家園的人提供基本的遮蔽處和安全。","explanation":"名詞「難民」。常用搭配 refugee camp (難民營)。"}],"related_forms":["refugees"]}

{"headword":"refund","explanation":"名詞或動詞，意為「退款」。動詞指「將款項退還」；名詞指「退還的款項」。常用搭配 get a refund (得到退款) 或 full refund (全額退款)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Since the dress was the wrong size and had a small hole, the customer requested a <pattern>full</pattern> <target>refund</target> from the store.","translation":"由於這件洋裝尺寸不對且有一個小洞，顧客向商店要求全額退款。","explanation":"名詞「退款」。常用搭配 full refund (全額退款)。"},{"sentence":"The airline decided to <target>refund</target> the ticket price to all passengers after the flight was canceled due to severe weather conditions.","translation":"航班因惡劣天氣而取消後，航空公司決定將機票費用退還給所有乘客。","explanation":"動詞「退款」。"},{"sentence":"If the product does not meet your expectations, you can <target>refund</target> it <pattern>within</pattern> thirty days of purchase for a full return of money.","translation":"如果產品不符合您的預期，您可以在購買後三十天內退款，以獲得全額退款。","explanation":"動詞「退款」。注意 within ... days (在...天之內)。"}],"related_forms":["refunds","refunded","refunding"]}

{"headword":"refusal","explanation":"名詞，意為「拒絕」。由動詞 refuse 衍生而來。常用搭配 flat refusal (斷然拒絕) 或 refusal to do sth (拒絕做某事)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite the parents' repeated requests, the teenager's <target>refusal</target> <pattern>to</pattern> clean his room was met with a strict punishment.","translation":"儘管父母多次要求，青少年拒絕打掃房間的行為遭到了嚴厲的處罰。","explanation":"名詞「拒絕」。常用結構 refusal to + V (拒絕做某事)。"},{"sentence":"The company's <pattern>flat</pattern> <target>refusal</target> to negotiate with the union led to a long strike by the factory workers.","translation":"公司斷然拒絕與工會協商，導致工廠工人進行了長期的罷工。","explanation":"名詞「拒絕」。常用搭配 flat refusal (斷然拒絕)。"},{"sentence":"His <target>refusal</target> to accept the award was a surprise to everyone, as he believed others deserved the recognition more than he did.","translation":"他拒絕接受獎項令所有人感到驚訝，因為他認為其他人比他更值得獲得這個認可。","explanation":"名詞「拒絕」。"}],"related_forms":["refuse"]}

{"headword":"regarding","explanation":"介係詞，意為「關於」。相當於 about 或 concerning。常用於正式書信或學術論文中，用以引導出討論的主題。","entries":[{"sentence":"I am writing this email to ask for more information <target>regarding</target> the internship opportunities available at your company this summer.","translation":"我寫這封電子郵件是為了詢問關於今年夏天貴公司提供的實習機會的更多資訊。","explanation":"介係詞「關於」。常用於正式信件開頭。"},{"sentence":"The principal held a meeting with the teachers <target>regarding</target> the new school regulations and how to implement them in the classroom.","translation":"校長與老師們舉行了一次會議，討論關於學校新規定以及如何在教室中實施這些規定的問題。","explanation":"介係詞「關於」。"},{"sentence":"There have been several complaints from parents <target>regarding</target> the amount of homework given to students in the advanced English class.","translation":"家長們對高級英語班學生被分配的作業量提出了幾項關於此事的投訴。","explanation":"介係詞「關於」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"register","explanation":"動詞「登記、註冊」；名詞「登記簿、記錄」。常用搭配 register for (註冊/報名) 或 register a complaint (登記投訴)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Students must <target>register</target> <pattern>for</pattern> their elective courses online before the deadline to ensure they get the classes they want.","translation":"學生必須在截止日期前在網上報名選修課程，以確保他們能選到想要的課程。","explanation":"動詞「註冊、報名」。常用片語 register for (報名)。"},{"sentence":"The thermometer <target>registers</target> a temperature of thirty degrees Celsius, indicating that the weather is becoming quite hot.","translation":"溫度計顯示溫度為攝氏三十度，表明天氣變得相當熱。","explanation":"動詞「顯示、記錄」。指儀器顯示數值。"},{"sentence":"If you have any problems with the product, you should <target>register</target> <pattern>a complaint</pattern> with the customer service department immediately.","translation":"如果你對產品有任何問題，你應該立即向客服部門登記投訴。","explanation":"動詞「登記」。常用搭配 register a complaint (登記投訴)。"},{"sentence":"The receptionist asked the guests to sign the <target>register</target> at the front desk to keep a record of everyone visiting the building.","translation":"接待員要求客人簽名登記簿，以便記錄每位訪問大樓的人員。","explanation":"名詞「登記簿」。"}],"related_forms":["registration","registered","registering"]}

{"headword":"registration","explanation":"名詞「登記、註冊」。指將姓名、資訊等記錄在官方名單中。常用搭配 registration form (註冊表)、complete the registration (完成註冊)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Before the new semester begins, all incoming students must <pattern>complete</pattern> their <target>registration</target> <pattern>process</pattern> to select their elective courses.","translation":"在新學期開始之前，所有新生必須完成註冊程序以選擇他們的選修課程。","explanation":"名詞「註冊」。complete the registration process 意為完成註冊程序。"},{"sentence":"Please fill out the <target>registration</target> <pattern>form</pattern> carefully and provide your current address and phone number to receive the event notifications.","translation":"請仔細填寫註冊表，並提供您目前的地址和電話號碼，以便接收活動通知。","explanation":"名詞「登記表」。registration form 是常見的搭配。"},{"sentence":"The school provides a <pattern>free</pattern> <target>registration</target> for the English competition, encouraging more students to challenge themselves and improve their skills.","translation":"學校為英語競賽提供免費註冊，鼓勵更多學生挑戰自我並提升技能。","explanation":"名詞「註冊」。"}],"related_forms":["register","registered"]}

{"headword":"regulate","explanation":"動詞「調節、管理、管制」。指透過法律、規則或機制來控制某事物的運作方式。常用搭配 regulate traffic (管制交通)、regulate temperature (調節溫度)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government has introduced new laws to <target>regulate</target> the <pattern>use of</pattern> plastic bags in supermarkets to protect the environment.","translation":"政府推出了新法律來管制超市中使用塑膠袋的情況，以保護環境。","explanation":"動詞「管制」。指透過法律來控制某事物的使用。"},{"sentence":"Modern air conditioners use smart sensors to <target>regulate</target> the <pattern>indoor temperature</pattern>, ensuring a comfortable environment for the residents.","translation":"現代空調使用智慧感測器來調節室內溫度，確保居民享有舒適的環境。","explanation":"動詞「調節」。指控制某種物理量，使其維持在適當的程度。"},{"sentence":"The teacher decided to <target>regulate</target> the <pattern>amount of</pattern> time students spent on smartphones during class to improve their focus.","translation":"老師決定管制學生在課堂上使用智慧型手機的時間，以提高他們的專注力。","explanation":"動詞「管理/控制」。"}],"related_forms":["regulation","regulator"]}

{"headword":"regulation","explanation":"名詞「規定、法規、調節」。指正式的規則或政府頒布的法律。常用搭配 in accordance with regulations (根據規定)、safety regulations (安全規定)。","entries":[{"sentence":"All students must <pattern>follow</pattern> the school's <target>regulations</target> <pattern>regarding</pattern> dress code to maintain a professional and disciplined atmosphere on campus.","translation":"所有學生必須遵守學校關於服裝規範的規定，以維持校園內專業且紀律嚴明的氛圍。","explanation":"名詞「規定」。follow regulations 意為遵守規定。"},{"sentence":"The airline staff strictly <pattern>enforced</pattern> the <target>regulations</target> <pattern>on</pattern> luggage weight to ensure the plane could take off safely.","translation":"航空公司工作人員嚴格執行行李重量的規定，以確保飛機能安全起飛。","explanation":"名詞「法規」。enforce regulations 意為執行法規。"},{"sentence":"The human body has a complex system to <target>regulation</target> the balance of water and salts, which is essential for overall health.","translation":"人體有一套複雜的系統來調節水分和鹽分的平衡，這對整體健康至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「調節」。此處指生理上的調節過程。"}],"related_forms":["regulate","regulatory"]}

{"headword":"rejection","explanation":"名詞「拒絕、排斥」。指不接受某人的請求、提案或申請。常用搭配 face rejection (面臨拒絕)、letter of rejection (拒絕信)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After applying to several prestigious universities, the student had to <pattern>cope with</pattern> the <target>rejection</target> after receiving a few negative responses.","translation":"在申請幾所頂尖大學後，這名學生在收到幾封負面回覆後不得不應對拒絕。","explanation":"名詞「拒絕」。cope with rejection 意為應對拒絕。"},{"sentence":"The writer felt discouraged after his first novel faced <pattern>complete</pattern> <target>rejection</target> from several major publishers, but he never gave up.","translation":"這位作家在第一部小說被幾家大型出版社完全拒絕後感到沮喪，但他從未放棄。","explanation":"名詞「拒絕」。指不被接受。"},{"sentence":"The patient's body showed signs of organ <target>rejection</target>, making the doctors work hard to find a suitable medicine to stop it.","translation":"患者的身體顯示出器官排斥的跡象，使醫生們努力尋找合適的藥物來阻止它。","explanation":"名詞「排斥」。指醫學上的免疫排斥反應。"}],"related_forms":["reject"]}

{"headword":"relaxation","explanation":"名詞「放鬆、放寬」。指身體或精神上的休息，或指法律/規則的放寬。常用搭配 relaxation of rules (規則的放寬)、deep relaxation (深度放鬆)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Listening to soft music and practicing meditation are great ways to achieve <target>relaxation</target> after a stressful week of studying for exams.","translation":"聽輕音樂和練習冥想是在壓力巨大的考前複習週後達到放鬆的絕佳方式。","explanation":"名詞「放鬆」。指精神上的休息。"},{"sentence":"The government announced the <target>relaxation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> travel <pattern>restrictions</pattern> to encourage more tourists to visit the local museums and parks.","translation":"政府宣布放寬旅遊限制，以鼓勵更多遊客參觀當地博物館和公園。","explanation":"名詞「放寬」。relaxation of restrictions 意為放寬限制。"},{"sentence":"Taking a warm bath before bed can lead to deep <target>relaxation</target> of the muscles, helping people fall asleep more quickly and soundly.","translation":"睡前洗個溫水澡能讓肌肉深度放鬆，幫助人們更快、更安穩地入睡。","explanation":"名詞「放鬆」。指身體上的放鬆。"}],"related_forms":["relax"]}

{"headword":"relevant","explanation":"形容詞「相關的、切題的」。指與當前討論或情況密切相關。常用搭配 relevant information (相關資訊)、be relevant to (與...相關)。","entries":[{"sentence":"When writing an essay, it is important to include only <target>relevant</target> <pattern>information</pattern> to support your main argument and avoid unnecessary details.","translation":"在寫論文時，重要的是只包含相關資訊來支持你的主論點，並避免不必要的細節。","explanation":"形容詞「相關的」。relevant information 意為相關資訊。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer asked the witness to provide all <target>relevant</target> <pattern>details</pattern> <pattern>about</pattern> the accident to help the police find the truth.","translation":"律師要求證人提供所有關於這起事故的相關細節，以幫助警方找到真相。","explanation":"形容詞「相關的」。"},{"sentence":"Many students find it difficult to see how ancient history is <target>relevant</target> <pattern>to</pattern> their daily lives in the modern world.","translation":"許多學生發現很難看出古代歷史與他們在現代世界的日常生活有什麼關聯。","explanation":"形容詞「相關的」。be relevant to sth 意為與...相關。"}],"related_forms":["relevance","relevantly"]}

{"headword":"relieve","explanation":"動詞「減輕、緩解、接替」。常用搭配 relieve stress (減輕壓力)、relieve pain (緩解疼痛)、relieve someone of their duties (接替某人的職責)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many students use exercise and sports as a way to <target>relieve</target> <pattern>stress</pattern> after spending hours studying for the final exams.","translation":"許多學生利用運動和體育活動作為在花數小時準備期末考後減輕壓力的一種方式。","explanation":"動詞「減輕」。relieve stress 意為減輕壓力。"},{"sentence":"The doctor prescribed some medicine to <target>relieve</target> the <pattern>severe pain</pattern> in the patient's back, allowing him to walk again slowly.","translation":"醫生開了一些藥來緩解患者背部劇烈的疼痛，使他能再次緩緩行走。","explanation":"動詞「緩解」。relieve pain 意為緩解疼痛。"},{"sentence":"The new security guard arrived at midnight to <target>relieve</target> the tired guard <pattern>who had been</pattern> on duty for twelve hours.","translation":"新保安在午夜到達，以接替那位已經值班十二小時的疲憊保安。","explanation":"動詞「接替」。指接替某人的工作或職責。"}],"related_forms":["relief","relieved"]}

{"headword":"reluctant","explanation":"形容詞「不情願的、勉強的」。常用搭配 be reluctant to (不情願做某事)、reluctant acceptance (勉強地接受)。注意與 hesitant (猶豫的) 的區別：reluctant 強調的是不想要做，而 hesitant 強調的是不確定是否該做。","entries":[{"sentence":"The shy student was <target>reluctant</target> <pattern>to</pattern> speak in front of the whole class, even though he knew the correct answer to the question.","translation":"這名害羞的學生不情願在全班面前發言，儘管他知道問題的正確答案。","explanation":"形容詞「不情願的」。be reluctant to do sth 意為不情願做某事。"},{"sentence":"Despite the high price, some parents are still <target>reluctant</target> <pattern>to</pattern> let their children travel alone for the first time.","translation":"儘管價格高昂，一些家長仍不情願讓孩子第一次獨自旅行。","explanation":"形容詞「不情願的」。"},{"sentence":"The manager gave a <target>reluctant</target> <pattern>nod</pattern> of approval, showing that he didn't fully agree with the plan but would allow it.","translation":"經理勉強地對著頭點頭表示贊同，顯示出他並不完全同意這項計劃，但會允許它。","explanation":"形容詞「勉強的」。"}],"related_forms":["reluctantly","reluctance"]}

{"headword":"remark","explanation":"動詞「評論、注意到」；名詞「評論、談話」。常用搭配 make a remark (發表評論)、remarkable (值得注意的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher <target>remarked</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the students had made great progress in their writing skills over the last few months.","translation":"老師評論道，學生們在過去幾個月裡在寫作技巧方面取得了巨大的進步。","explanation":"動詞「評論」。指對某事發表看法。"},{"sentence":"He made a <pattern>rude</pattern> <target>remark</target> <pattern>about</pattern> his classmate's new haircut, which made the other boy feel very sad and embarrassed.","translation":"他對同學的新髮型發表了粗魯的評論，這讓另一個男孩感到非常悲傷和尷尬。","explanation":"名詞「評論」。make a remark about sth 意為對某事發表評論。"},{"sentence":"During the walk, the guide <target>remarked</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the unusual beauty of the ancient temple, urging the tourists to take photos.","translation":"在散步過程中，指南對這座古寺的異常美感發表評論，敦促遊客拍照。","explanation":"動詞「評論」。remark on sth 意為對某事發表評論。"},{"sentence":"I <target>remarked</target> <pattern>upon</pattern> the strange silence in the room, wondering if something had happened while I was away.","translation":"我注意到了房間裡奇怪的沉默，想著在我不在的時候是否發生了某些事情。","explanation":"動詞「注意到」。"}],"related_forms":["remarkable","remarkably"]}

{"headword":"remarkable","explanation":"形容詞「卓越的、非凡的、值得注意的」。指某物或某人非常出色或不尋常。常用搭配 a remarkable achievement (卓越的成就)、remarkable progress (顯著的進步)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young pianist gave a <target>remarkable</target> <pattern>performance</pattern> at the concert, impressing the judges with her skill and emotion.","translation":"這位年輕的鋼琴家在音樂會上帶來了卓越的表演，以她的技巧和情感給評審們留下了深刻印象。","explanation":"形容詞「卓越的」。remarkable performance 意為卓越的表演。"},{"sentence":"Scientists have made <target>remarkable</target> <pattern>progress</pattern> in treating the disease, giving hope to thousands of patients around the world.","translation":"科學家在治療這種疾病方面取得了顯著的進步，給世界各地數千名患者帶來了希望。","explanation":"形容詞「顯著的」。remarkable progress 意為顯著的進步。"},{"sentence":"It is <target>remarkable</target> that the ancient building has survived for thousands of years despite the many wars and earthquakes.","translation":"令人驚訝的是，這座古建築儘管經歷了多次戰爭和地震，仍然倖存了數千年。","explanation":"形容詞「值得注意的」。指事物不尋常或令人驚訝。"}],"related_forms":["remarkably","remark"]}

{"headword":"remedy","explanation":"名詞「治療法；補救辦法」；動詞「補救；治療」。注意名詞用法常與 for 搭配，如 a remedy for the common cold。動詞用法則直接接對象，如 remedy the situation。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor suggested a natural <target>remedy</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the cough, such as drinking warm honey and lemon water every morning.","translation":"醫生建議一種治療咳嗽的天然療法，例如每天早上喝溫蜂蜜檸檬水。","explanation":"名詞「治療法」。常用搭配 a remedy for sth。"},{"sentence":"The government is trying to find an effective <target>remedy</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the housing shortage to make homes more affordable for young people.","translation":"政府正試圖尋找一個有效的補救辦法來解決住房短缺問題，使年輕人能負擔得起住房。","explanation":"名詞「補救辦法」。常用搭配 a remedy for sth。"},{"sentence":"The manager apologized for the mistake and promised to <target>remedy</target> the situation immediately by offering a full refund to the customer.","translation":"經理為這次錯誤道歉，並承諾立即補救這個情況，向客戶提供全額退款。","explanation":"動詞「補救」。指修正錯誤或改善糟糕的情況。"}],"related_forms":["remedial"]}

{"headword":"renew","explanation":"動詞「更新；恢復」。常用於合約、執照、訂閱或關係的更新。注意其名詞形式 renewal 意為「更新」或「恢復」。","entries":[{"sentence":"My library card will expire next week, so I need to go to the library to <target>renew</target> it before the deadline.","translation":"我的圖書卡下週就要到期了，所以我需要在截止日期前去圖書館辦理更新。","explanation":"動詞「更新」。指延長有效期限。"},{"sentence":"The two countries decided to <target>renew</target> their diplomatic relations after years of disagreement and tension over border issues.","translation":"這兩國在經過多年的邊境問題分歧和緊張關係後，決定恢復外交關係。","explanation":"動詞「恢復」。指重新建立或開始之前的狀態。"},{"sentence":"After a long vacation in the mountains, she felt that the fresh air and quiet environment helped her <target>renew</target> her energy.","translation":"在山區度過一個長假後，她覺得新鮮的空氣和安靜的環境幫助她恢復了精力。","explanation":"動詞「恢復」。指恢復活力或精神。"}],"related_forms":["renewal","renewable"]}

{"headword":"repetition","explanation":"名詞「重複」。常用於學習、音樂或語言練習。注意其形容詞形式 repetitive 意為「重複的」且常帶有負面意味，指令人厭煩的重複。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher emphasized that <target>repetition</target> is the key to mastering a new language, as it helps students remember vocabulary and grammar.","translation":"老師強調，重複是掌握一門新語言的關鍵，因為這能幫助學生記憶單字和語法。","explanation":"名詞「重複」。指重複做某事或說某事。"},{"sentence":"The singer's performance was a bit boring because of the constant <target>repetition</target> of the same melody throughout the entire song.","translation":"這位歌手的表演有點無聊，因為整首歌中不斷地重複同一個旋律。","explanation":"名詞「重複」。指重複出現的事物。"}],"related_forms":["repeat","repetitive"]}

{"headword":"representation","explanation":"名詞「代表；表現；描繪」。在政治語境中指「代表權」；在藝術或法律語境中指「描繪」或「陳述」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The minority group fought for better <target>representation</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the national parliament to ensure their voices were heard by the government.","translation":"少數群體爭取在國家議會中獲得更好的代表權，以確保他們的聲音能被政府聽到。","explanation":"名詞「代表權」。常用搭配 representation in sth。"},{"sentence":"The artist's painting was a realistic <target>representation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the city's skyline, capturing the beauty of the sunset perfectly.","translation":"這位藝術家的畫作是對城市天際線的寫實描繪，完美地捕捉了日落之美。","explanation":"名詞「描繪」。常用搭配 representation of sth。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer provided a detailed <target>representation</target> of the facts during the trial to persuade the judge and the jury.","translation":"律師在審判期間對事實進行了詳細的陳述，以說服法官和陪審團。","explanation":"名詞「陳述」。指對某事物的描述或說明。"}],"related_forms":["represent","representative"]}

{"headword":"reputation","explanation":"名詞「名聲；聲譽」。常用搭配：have a reputation for (以...而聞名), gain/build a reputation (建立名聲), ruin/damage a reputation (毀掉名聲)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university has a global <target>reputation</target> <pattern>for</pattern> its excellent research in biotechnology and medicine, attracting students from all over the world.","translation":"這所大學在生物技術和醫學研究方面擁有全球性的名聲，吸引了來自世界各地的學生。","explanation":"名詞「名聲」。常用搭配 have a reputation for sth。"},{"sentence":"The restaurant gained a <pattern>good</pattern> <target>reputation</target> for serving high-quality organic food and providing friendly service to its customers.","translation":"這家餐廳因提供高品質的有機食物和親切的服務而贏得了良好的名聲。","explanation":"名詞「名聲」。常用搭配 gain a good reputation。"},{"sentence":"A single dishonest act can <target>damage</target> a person's <target>reputation</target> permanently, making it very difficult to find a new job in the future.","translation":"一次不誠實的行為可能會永久地損害一個人的名聲，使得未來找新工作變得非常困難。","explanation":"名詞「名聲」。常用搭配 damage/ruin a reputation。"}],"related_forms":["reputable"]}

{"headword":"rescue","explanation":"名詞「救援」；動詞「營救」。注意其名詞形式的搭配：a rescue mission (救援任務), carry out a rescue (進行救援)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The coast guard launched a massive <target>rescue</target> <pattern>mission</pattern> to find the missing sailors after the heavy storm hit the coast.","translation":"在強風暴襲擊海岸後，海岸警衛隊發起了一場大規模的救援任務，以尋找失蹤的水手。","explanation":"名詞「救援」。常用搭配 rescue mission。"},{"sentence":"Firefighters worked tirelessly for ten hours to <target>rescue</target> the trapped hikers from the deep valley during the earthquake.","translation":"消防員不懈地工作了十個小時，在地震期間將受困的登山客從深谷中營救出來。","explanation":"動詞「營救」。指將人或動物從危險中救出。"},{"sentence":"The animal shelter provides a safe place for <target>rescued</target> dogs and cats, giving them a second chance at a happy life.","translation":"動物收容所為被營救的救援犬和救援貓提供了一個安全的地方，給予他們再次擁有幸福生活的機會。","explanation":"名詞/形容詞用法。指被救出的動物。"}],"related_forms":["rescuer"]}

{"headword":"research","explanation":"名詞「研究」；動詞「研究」。作為名詞時，research 是不可數名詞，不可加 s 或使用 an。常用搭配：carry out research, conduct research, do research (進行研究)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Scientists are currently <pattern>carrying out</pattern> <target>research</target> <pattern>into</pattern> how climate change affects the migration patterns of birds in East Asia.","translation":"科學家目前正在研究氣候變遷如何影響東亞鳥類的遷徙模式。","explanation":"名詞「研究」。常用搭配 carry out research into sth。"},{"sentence":"The professor encouraged his students to <target>research</target> the historical background of the topic before writing their final research paper.","translation":"教授鼓勵學生在撰寫最終研究論文前，先研究該主題的歷史背景。","explanation":"動詞「研究」。指通過蒐集資料來深入了解某事。"},{"sentence":"After years of extensive <target>research</target>, the team discovered a new species of orchid in the remote rainforest of South America.","translation":"經過多年的廣泛研究，該團隊在南美洲的偏遠熱帶雨林中發現了一個新品種的蘭花。","explanation":"名詞「研究」。常用搭配 extensive research。"}],"related_forms":["researcher"]}

{"headword":"researcher","explanation":"名詞「研究員」。指從事研究工作的人。常用搭配：lead researcher (首席研究員), senior researcher (資深研究員)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The lead <target>researcher</target> presented his findings at the international conference, explaining the cause of the new virus in detail.","translation":"首席研究員在國際會議上發表了他的發現，詳細解釋了新病毒的原因。","explanation":"名詞「研究員」。"},{"sentence":"Many young <target>researchers</target> spend most of their time in the laboratory, conducting experiments to test their theories.","translation":"許多年輕的研究員將大部分時間花在實驗室中，進行實驗以測試他們的理論。","explanation":"名詞「研究員」。"}],"related_forms":["research"]}

{"headword":"resemble","explanation":"動詞「像；與...相似」。注意它是一個及物動詞，後面直接接對象，不可加 like 或 be similar to (雖然意思相同但結構不同)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young boy <target>resembles</target> his father in both appearance and personality, which often surprises people who meet them together.","translation":"這個小男孩在長相和性格上都像他的父親，這常讓同時見到他們的人感到驚訝。","explanation":"動詞「像」。直接接對象，不可說 resemble like his father。"},{"sentence":"Some species of insects <target>resemble</target> leaves or twigs to hide from predators and increase their chances of survival in the wild.","translation":"某些昆蟲物種長得像葉子或小 twigs，以便從捕食者面前隱藏並增加在野外生存的機會。","explanation":"動詞「像」。指外觀上的相似。"}],"related_forms":["resemblance"]}

{"headword":"reservation","explanation":"名詞「預約；保留；保留意見」。常用搭配：make a reservation (預約), have reservations about (對...有保留意見/懷疑)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Since the restaurant is very popular during the weekend, it is highly recommended to <pattern>make</pattern> a <target>reservation</target> in advance.","translation":"由於這家餐廳在週末非常受歡迎，強烈建議提前預約。","explanation":"名詞「預約」。常用搭配 make a reservation。"},{"sentence":"The couple <pattern>made</pattern> hotel <target>reservations</target> for their honeymoon trip to Paris, ensuring they would have a comfortable place to stay.","translation":"這對夫婦為他們的巴黎蜜月旅行預訂了飯店，確保他們會有一個舒適的居住之處。","explanation":"名詞「預約」。"},{"sentence":"Although the plan seemed perfect, the manager still <pattern>had</pattern> <target>reservations</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the feasibility of the project within the limited budget.","translation":"雖然計劃看起來很完美，但經理對該項目在有限預算內的可行性仍持有保留意見。","explanation":"名詞「保留意見」。常用搭配 have reservations about sth。"}],"related_forms":["reserve"]}

{"headword":"resign","explanation":"動詞「辭職」。常用搭配 resign from a position (從某職位辭職)。注意與 resign oneself to (甘心接受) 的片語用法區分。","entries":[{"sentence":"After ten years of service, the CEO decided to <target>resign</target> <pattern>from</pattern> his position to spend more time with his family.","translation":"服務十年後，執行長決定辭去他的職位，以便花更多時間陪伴家人。","explanation":"動詞「辭職」。常用搭配 resign from a position。"},{"sentence":"The teacher felt she could no longer handle the heavy workload and decided to <target>resign</target> her post at the end of the term.","translation":"這名老師覺得自己無法再承受沉重的工作量，決定在學期末辭去她的職位。","explanation":"動詞「辭職」。此處 resign 直接接名詞，表示辭掉某個職位。"},{"sentence":"Despite the difficult situation, he <target>resigned</target> <pattern>himself</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> the fact that he would not win the competition this year.","translation":"儘管情況困難，他甘心接受今年他不會贏得比賽這個事實。","explanation":"動詞片語 resign oneself to sth 意為「甘心接受」或「認命」。"}],"related_forms":["resigns","resigned","resigning"]}

{"headword":"resignation","explanation":"名詞「辭職」或「順從/認命」。前者指職位的放棄，後者指對不可避免之事的接受。","entries":[{"sentence":"The manager was surprised when he received the employee's <target>resignation</target> letter on Monday morning, as they had a great relationship.","translation":"經理在週一早晨收到員工的辭職信時感到很驚訝，因為他們之間的關係很好。","explanation":"名詞「辭職」。指放棄職位的事宜。"},{"sentence":"She accepted her failure <pattern>with</pattern> <target>resignation</target>, knowing that she had done her best and there was nothing more she could change.","translation":"她以順從的心態接受了她的失敗，因為她知道自己已經盡了最大努力，且沒有什麼能改變的。","explanation":"名詞「順從/認命」。指對不可避免之事的接受。"},{"sentence":"The board of directors discussed the <target>resignation</target> of the head coach after the team lost five consecutive games in the season.","translation":"在球隊本賽季連續輸掉五場比賽後，董事會討論了總教練的辭職問題。","explanation":"名詞「辭職」。"}],"related_forms":["resign"]}

{"headword":"resistance","explanation":"名詞「抵抗、阻力」。可用於物理上的抵抗（如電阻、風阻）或心理/社會上的反對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The brave soldiers put up strong <target>resistance</target> <pattern>against</pattern> the invading army, refusing to surrender despite the overwhelming odds.","translation":"勇敢的士兵們對入侵軍隊展開了強烈的抵抗，儘管處於絕對劣勢，仍拒絕投降。","explanation":"名詞「抵抗」。常用搭配 put up resistance against sth。"},{"sentence":"Some older people show strong <target>resistance</target> <pattern>to</pattern> new technology, preferring traditional methods of communication over smartphones.","translation":"一些年長者對新技術表現出強烈的抵制，比起智慧型手機，他們更喜歡傳統的溝通方式。","explanation":"名詞「抵抗/反對」。常用搭配 resistance to sth。"},{"sentence":"The engineer explained that the <target>resistance</target> of the wire depends on its material, length, and thickness in an electrical circuit.","translation":"工程師解釋說，電線的電阻取決於其材質、長度以及在電路中的厚度。","explanation":"名詞「電阻」。物理學術語。"}],"related_forms":["resist","resistant","resistible"]}

{"headword":"resolution","explanation":"名詞「決心、解決方案、解析度」。常用搭配 make a resolution (下定決心), reach a resolution (達成解決方案)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Every New Year, many people <target>make</target> a <target>resolution</target> to exercise more and eat healthier food to improve their overall well-being.","translation":"每年新年，許多人都下定決心要多運動並食用更健康的食物，以改善整體健康。","explanation":"名詞「決心」。常用搭配 make a resolution。"},{"sentence":"After hours of intense debate, the two countries finally <target>reached</target> a <target>resolution</target> to the long-standing border dispute.","translation":"經過數小時的激烈辯論，兩國終於就長期存在的邊界爭端達成了一項解決方案。","explanation":"名詞「解決方案」。常用搭配 reach a resolution。"},{"sentence":"The photographer chose a camera with high <target>resolution</target> to capture every tiny detail of the landscape with perfect clarity.","translation":"攝影師選擇了一台高解析度的相機，以完美清晰地捕捉風景中的每一個微小細節。","explanation":"名詞「解析度」。指影像的清晰程度。"}],"related_forms":["resolve"]}

{"headword":"resolve","explanation":"動詞「解決、下定決心」；名詞「決心」。動詞常用 resolve to do sth 或 resolve a problem。名詞 resolve 表示強烈的意志力。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government is working hard to <target>resolve</target> the conflict between the company and the workers to prevent any further strikes.","translation":"政府正努力解決公司與工人之間的衝突，以防止進一步的罷工。","explanation":"動詞「解決」。常用搭配 resolve a conflict/problem。"},{"sentence":"After failing the first exam, she <target>resolved</target> <pattern>to</pattern> study harder and manage her time more effectively for the next one.","translation":"在第一次考試失敗後，她下定決心要更努力學習並更有效地管理時間以應對下一次考試。","explanation":"動詞「下定決心」。常用搭配 resolve to do sth。"},{"sentence":"Despite the many challenges he faced, his <target>resolve</target> to succeed remained strong, driving him to work late into the night.","translation":"儘管面臨許多挑戰，他成功的決心依然堅定，驅使他工作到深夜。","explanation":"名詞「決心」。指強烈的意志力。"}],"related_forms":["resolution","resolvable"]}

{"headword":"respectable","explanation":"形容詞「值得尊敬的、體面的」。常用於描述人的社會地位、行為或數量達到可接受的標準。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young man grew up to become a <target>respectable</target> member of society, known for his honesty and willingness to help others.","translation":"這個年輕人長大後成為社會上一個值得尊敬的成員，以其誠實和樂於助人而聞名。","explanation":"形容詞「值得尊敬的」。指品格高尚。"},{"sentence":"She wore a <target>respectable</target> outfit to the job interview, wanting to make a professional first impression on the potential employer.","translation":"她在求職面試時穿了一套體面的衣服，希望能給潛在雇主留下專業的第一印象。","explanation":"形容詞「體面的」。指外表得體。"},{"sentence":"Although the team didn't win the championship, they earned a <target>respectable</target> score that showed their hard work throughout the season.","translation":"儘管球隊沒有贏得冠軍，但他們獲得了一個相當不錯的分數，顯示了他們整個賽季的努力。","explanation":"形容詞「相當不錯的/可接受的」。常用於描述數量或程度。"}],"related_forms":["respect","respectability"]}

{"headword":"respectful","explanation":"形容詞「恭敬的、有禮貌的」。常用於描述對長輩或權威者的態度。注意與 respectable (值得尊敬的) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students were very <target>respectful</target> <pattern>to</pattern> their teacher, always listening carefully and asking questions in a polite manner.","translation":"學生們對老師非常恭敬，總是專心地傾聽並以禮貌的方式提問。","explanation":"形容詞「恭敬的」。常用搭配 respectful to someone。"},{"sentence":"It is important to be <target>respectful</target> <pattern>of</pattern> other people's opinions, even if you do not agree with their points of view.","translation":"即使你不認同他人的觀點，對他人的意見保持尊重也是很重要的。","explanation":"形容詞「尊重的」。常用搭配 respectful of sth。"}],"related_forms":["respect","respectfully"]}

{"headword":"restore","explanation":"動詞「恢復、修復」。常用於描述恢復原狀（如建築、藝術品）或恢復權力、健康。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government spent millions of dollars to <target>restore</target> the ancient temple, ensuring its beauty and history are preserved for future generations.","translation":"政府花了數百萬美元來修復這座古廟，確保其美感與歷史能為後代保存。","explanation":"動詞「修復」。指將損壞的建築或物品恢復原狀。"},{"sentence":"After a long period of rest and physical therapy, the athlete was finally able to <target>restore</target> his full strength and return to the game.","translation":"經過長時間的休息和物理治療，這名運動員終於能夠恢復全部體力並重返賽場。","explanation":"動詞「恢復」。指恢復健康或力量。"},{"sentence":"The peace treaty helped <target>restore</target> order <pattern>to</pattern> the city after weeks of violent protests and social chaos.","translation":"和平條約幫助恢復了城市的秩序，在經歷了數週的暴力抗議與社會混亂之後。","explanation":"動詞「恢復」。常用搭配 restore order to sth。"}],"related_forms":["restoration","restorative"]}

{"headword":"restriction","explanation":"名詞「限制、約束」。常考搭配 impose restrictions (實施限制), lift restrictions (取消限制)。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the health crisis, the government <pattern>imposed</pattern> strict <target>restrictions</target> <pattern>on</pattern> travel to prevent the virus from spreading to other cities.","translation":"在健康危機期間，政府對旅行實施了嚴格的限制，以防止病毒傳播到其他城市。","explanation":"名詞「限制」。常用搭配 impose restrictions on sth。"},{"sentence":"The school has a strict <target>restriction</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the use of mobile phones during class to help students focus better on their studies.","translation":"學校對課堂上使用手機有嚴格的限制，以幫助學生更專注於學習。","explanation":"名詞「限制」。常用搭配 restriction on sth。"},{"sentence":"Once the situation improved, the city council decided to <pattern>lift</pattern> the <target>restrictions</target> on outdoor gatherings, allowing people to meet again.","translation":"一旦情況好轉，市議會決定取消對戶外集會的限制，讓人們能再次相聚。","explanation":"名詞「限制」。常用搭配 lift restrictions。"}],"related_forms":["restrict","restrictive"]}

{"headword":"retain","explanation":"動詞「保留、保持、留住」。常用於描述保留資訊、保持特徵或留住員工。","entries":[{"sentence":"To <target>retain</target> talented employees, the company offered higher salaries and better benefits, such as flexible working hours and health insurance.","translation":"為了留住優秀的員工，公司提供更高的薪水和更好的福利，例如彈性工作時間和健康保險。","explanation":"動詞「留住」。指防止人才流失。"},{"sentence":"Students are encouraged to use mind maps to help them <target>retain</target> the vast amount of information they learn in history class.","translation":"鼓勵學生使用心智圖來幫助他們保留大量在歷史課上學到的資訊。","explanation":"動詞「保留」。指記憶中保留資訊。"},{"sentence":"Despite the modern changes, the small town has <target>retained</target> its traditional charm and peaceful atmosphere for over a century.","translation":"儘管有了現代的改變，這個小鎮一個世紀以來依然保持著其傳統的魅力與寧靜的氛圍。","explanation":"動詞「保持」。指維持原有的特質。"}],"related_forms":["retention","retained"]}

{"headword":"retire","explanation":"動詞「退休」或「退隱」。此外，也可指「休息」或「退出」。其名詞形式為 retirement。常考點在於區分退休與休息的用法，以及 retirement 作為名詞時可指退休金或退休狀態。","entries":[{"sentence":"After forty years of teaching at the high school, Mr. Lin decided to <target>retire</target> and spend more time traveling with his grandchildren.","translation":"在高中教書四十年後，林先生決定退休，花更多時間陪著孫子們旅行。","explanation":"動詞「退休」。指停止工作，通常是因為達到法定年齡。"},{"sentence":"The athlete decided to <target>retire</target> from professional sports after suffering a severe knee injury that made it impossible to compete.","translation":"這位運動員在遭受嚴重的膝蓋受傷且無法繼續比賽後，決定從職業體育界退隱。","explanation":"動詞「退隱」。指離開某個職位或專業領域。"},{"sentence":"The tired guests <target>retired</target> <pattern>to</pattern> their bedrooms after the long dinner party, hoping to get some sleep before the next morning.","translation":"在漫長的晚餐派對後，疲憊的客人們回房休息，希望能在他明天早晨前睡個好覺。","explanation":"動詞「休息、回房」。指離開公共區域回到私人空間休息。"}],"related_forms":["retirement"]}

{"headword":"retirement","explanation":"名詞「退休」。可指退休的狀態、退休後的日子，或退休金。常用搭配 retirement plan (退休計畫), retirement fund (退休金)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many people start saving money in their twenties to ensure they have a stable <target>retirement</target> <pattern>fund</pattern> for their future.","translation":"許多人在二十多歲時就開始存錢，以確保他們未來有穩定的退休金。","explanation":"名詞「退休金」。指退休後生活所需之資金。"},{"sentence":"During her <target>retirement</target>, Mrs. Wang took up oil painting and joined a local community center to share her art with others.","translation":"在退休期間，王太太開始學習油畫，並加入當地社區中心與他人分享她的藝術作品。","explanation":"名詞「退休狀態」。指退休後的整個生活階段。"}],"related_forms":["retire"]}

{"headword":"retreat","explanation":"名詞「撤退」或「隱居處」；動詞「撤退」或「退縮」。常用片語 retreat from (從...撤退)。注意與 retreat (靜修會) 的區別，在學術或宗教背景下，可指短期的心靈淨化之旅。","entries":[{"sentence":"The army was forced to <target>retreat</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the border after suffering heavy losses during the fierce battle with the enemy.","translation":"在與敵軍的激烈戰鬥中遭受重大損失後，軍隊被迫從邊境撤退。","explanation":"動詞「撤退」。指為了安全或避免失敗而撤離。"},{"sentence":"When the tide began to rise, the small crabs quickly <target>retreated</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the safety of the sand holes along the beach.","translation":"當潮水開始上升時，小螃蟹迅速退回沙灘上的沙孔中以尋求安全。","explanation":"動詞「撤退、退縮」。指移動到更安全的位置。"},{"sentence":"The mountain cabin serves as a quiet <target>retreat</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the writer, allowing her to focus on her novel without any city noise.","translation":"這座山間小屋是這位作家的寧靜隱居處，讓她能專注於寫小說而沒有任何城市的噪音。","explanation":"名詞「隱居處」。指一個遠離喧囂、安靜的地方。"},{"sentence":"The company organized a weekend <target>retreat</target> in the forest to help employees relax and strengthen their teamwork through various activities.","translation":"公司在森林中組織了一次週末靜修會，以幫助員工放鬆並透過各種活動強化團隊合作。","explanation":"名詞「靜修會」。指短暫離開日常環境進行心靈休息或團隊建設的活動。"}],"related_forms":["retreats"]}

{"headword":"reunion","explanation":"名詞「團圓、重聚」。常用於 family reunion (家庭團聚) 或 class reunion (同學會)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Every Lunar New Year, the whole family gathers for a traditional <target>reunion</target> dinner, sharing stories and laughter around the large dining table.","translation":"每年農曆新年，全家人都會聚集在一起吃傳統的團圓飯，在大圓桌旁分享故事和歡笑。","explanation":"名詞「團圓」。常用搭配：reunion dinner (團圓飯)。"},{"sentence":"After ten years of separation, the old friends organized a <target>reunion</target> <pattern>party</pattern> to celebrate their achievements and remember their high school days.","translation":"分開十年後，老朋友們組織了一場重聚派對，以慶祝他們的成就並回憶高中時光。","explanation":"名詞「重聚」。常用搭配：reunion party (重聚派對)。"}],"related_forms":["reunite"]}

{"headword":"revenge","explanation":"名詞「報復」或動詞「報仇」。常用搭配 take revenge on someone (向某人報仇)。注意與 avenge 的區別：revenge 側重於個人情緒上的報仇，而 avenge 側重於正義的伸張或為他人報仇。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the movie, the hero spent years planning his <target>revenge</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the villain who had betrayed him and stolen his wealth.","translation":"在電影中，主角花了好幾年時間計畫向背叛他並偷走他財富的反派報仇。","explanation":"名詞「報復」。常用搭配：take revenge on someone (向某人報仇)。"},{"sentence":"Although he was angry, the teacher advised the student not to <target>revenge</target> himself on his classmates for a small mistake.","translation":"儘管他很生氣，老師還是建議學生不要因為一個小錯誤而對同學報復。","explanation":"動詞「報仇」。指以同樣的傷害方式回擊。"}],"related_forms":["avenge"]}

{"headword":"revise","explanation":"動詞「修訂」或「複習」。在美式英語中，複習多用 review，而英式英語中則常用 revise。常考搭配 revise the plan (修訂計畫) 或 revise for an exam (為考試複習)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government decided to <target>revise</target> the existing laws <pattern>to</pattern> better protect the environment and reduce air pollution in the city.","translation":"政府決定修訂現有法律，以更好地保護環境並減少城市中的空氣污染。","explanation":"動詞「修訂」。指修改內容以使其更正確或更新。"},{"sentence":"Students are encouraged to <target>revise</target> their notes <pattern>before</pattern> the final exam to ensure they have a complete understanding of the material.","translation":"學生被鼓勵在期末考之前複習筆記，以確保他們對教材有完整的理解。","explanation":"動詞「複習」。指重新閱讀或學習已學過的內容。"},{"sentence":"After receiving feedback from her professor, Sarah had to <target>revise</target> the first chapter of her thesis to make the arguments stronger.","translation":"在收到教授的建議後，莎拉必須修訂她論文的第一章，使論點更強而有力。","explanation":"動詞「修訂」。指根據建議進行修改。"}],"related_forms":["revision","revisable"]}

{"headword":"revision","explanation":"名詞「修訂」或「複習」。指對文件、計畫或知識的修改過程。常用搭配 make revisions to (對...進行修訂)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The editor suggested several <target>revisions</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the manuscript to improve the flow of the story and correct some grammatical errors.","translation":"編輯建議對原稿進行幾處修訂，以改善故事的流暢度並糾正一些文法錯誤。","explanation":"名詞「修訂」。指對文字內容的修改。"},{"sentence":"Many students spend their entire weekend on <target>revision</target> for the history exam, reading through their textbooks and highlighting key dates.","translation":"許多學生整個週末都在複習歷史考試，閱讀教科書並標記關鍵日期。","explanation":"名詞「複習」。指考試前的準備過程。"}],"related_forms":["revise"]}

{"headword":"revolution","explanation":"名詞「革命」或「旋轉」。在 GSAT 脈絡中，通常指劇烈的社會、政治變革或科技突破。常用搭配 industrial revolution (工業革命) 或 digital revolution (數位革命)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The French <target>revolution</target> changed the political system of the country and brought about significant changes in the rights of citizens.","translation":"法國大革命改變了該國的政治體系，並為公民權利帶來了重大變化。","explanation":"名詞「革命」。指劇烈的政治變革。"},{"sentence":"The invention of the internet started a digital <target>revolution</target> that completely changed how people communicate and access information worldwide.","translation":"網路的發明開啟了一場數位革命，完全改變了全球人們溝通和獲取資訊的方式。","explanation":"名詞「革命」。指科技上的重大突破。"},{"sentence":"In science class, the teacher explained that one full <target>revolution</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the Earth <pattern>around</pattern> the sun takes exactly one year.","translation":"在科學課上，老師解釋地球繞太陽公轉一圈恰好需要一年。","explanation":"名詞「旋轉/公轉」。指繞著中心點旋轉一周。"}],"related_forms":["revolutionary"]}

{"headword":"revolutionary","explanation":"形容詞「革命性的」或名詞「革命者」。形容詞用法指極具創新且能帶來重大改變的事物。常用搭配 revolutionary technology (革命性技術) 或 revolutionary idea (革命性想法)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new smartphone features a <target>revolutionary</target> <pattern>design</pattern> that allows the screen to fold in half, attracting millions of customers.","translation":"這款新智慧型手機具有革命性的設計，使螢幕可以對折，吸引了數百萬名顧客。","explanation":"形容詞「革命性的」。指極具創新且能帶來重大改變的。"},{"sentence":"The <target>revolutionary</target> believed that the old government was unfair and fought bravely to establish a new system of equality for all.","translation":"這位革命者相信舊政府是不公平的，並勇敢地戰鬥以建立一個對所有人平等的新體系。","explanation":"名詞「革命者」。指參與革命的人。"}],"related_forms":["revolution"]}

{"headword":"reward","explanation":"名詞「獎賞」或動詞「獎賞」。常用搭配 reward someone for something (因某事而獎賞某人)。注意 reward 與 prize 的區別：reward 通常指因努力、好行為或尋找失物而得到的補償，而 prize 則指比賽獲勝而得的獎品。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school offered a generous <target>reward</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the student who found the lost wallet and returned it to the office.","translation":"學校為找到失錢包並將其交還到辦公室的學生提供了一筆優厚的獎金。","explanation":"名詞「獎金/獎賞」。指因好行為而獲得的補償。"},{"sentence":"The company decided to <target>reward</target> its employees <pattern>with</pattern> a bonus after they successfully completed the difficult project ahead of schedule.","translation":"在員工們提前成功完成困難的計畫後，公司決定給他們獎金作為獎賞。","explanation":"動詞「獎賞」。常用搭配：reward someone with something。"},{"sentence":"After years of hard work and study, the high grades she received were a well-deserved <target>reward</target> <pattern>for</pattern> her dedication.","translation":"經過多年的努力學習，她獲得的高分是對她奉獻精神的應得獎賞。","explanation":"名詞「獎賞」。指努力後獲得的正向結果。"}],"related_forms":["rewarding"]}

{"headword":"rhyme","explanation":"名詞「押韻」或動詞「押韻」。常用於描述詩歌或歌曲的結構。常用片語 rhyme with (與...押韻)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The children learned a simple nursery <target>rhyme</target> in class, which helped them remember the alphabet more easily through music.","translation":"孩子們在課堂上學習了一首簡單的童謠，這幫助他們透過音樂更輕鬆地記住字母表。","explanation":"名詞「押韻/童謠」。指具有押韻特性的短詩或歌曲。"},{"sentence":"In the poetry competition, the judge noticed that the word 'blue' <target>rhymes</target> <pattern>with</pattern> 'true', creating a pleasant sound for the reader.","translation":"在詩歌競賽中，裁判注意到 'blue' 這個字與 'true' 押韻，為讀者創造了悅耳的聲音。","explanation":"動詞「押韻」。常用搭配：rhyme with something。"},{"sentence":"The songwriter struggled to find a word that would <target>rhyme</target> <pattern>with</pattern> 'heart' to finish the final line of the romantic song.","translation":"詞曲作者努力尋找一個能與 'heart' 押韻的字，以完成這首浪漫歌曲的最後一行。","explanation":"動詞「押韻」。"}],"related_forms":["rhyming","rhymed"]}

{"headword":"rhythm","explanation":"名詞「節奏」。指聲音、動作或事件在時間上的規律重複。常用搭配 include a steady rhythm (穩定的節奏), follow the rhythm (跟隨節奏), a sense of rhythm (節奏感)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The drummer maintained a <pattern>steady</pattern> <target>rhythm</target> throughout the performance, helping the other musicians stay in sync and play perfectly.","translation":"鼓手在整個演出過程中保持了穩定的節奏，幫助其他音樂家保持同步並完美地演奏。","explanation":"名詞「節奏」。常用搭配 steady rhythm (穩定的節奏)。"},{"sentence":"She spent hours practicing the dance moves to ensure she could <pattern>follow</pattern> the <target>rhythm</target> of the music without any mistakes.","translation":"她花了好幾個小時練習舞蹈動作，以確保她能跟隨音樂的節奏而沒有任何錯誤。","explanation":"名詞「節奏」。常用搭配 follow the rhythm (跟隨節奏)。"},{"sentence":"The teacher noticed that the student had a natural <pattern>sense of</pattern> <target>rhythm</target>, which made him an excellent candidate for the school band.","translation":"老師注意到這名學生天生具有節奏感，這使他成為學校樂團的絕佳人選。","explanation":"名詞「節奏感」。常用搭配 a sense of rhythm (節奏感)。"}],"related_forms":["rhythms","rhythmic","rhythmically"]}

{"headword":"riddle","explanation":"名詞「謎題」。指一個精心設計的問題，旨在讓人思考或猜測答案。常用搭配 solve a riddle (解開謎題), a challenging riddle (具挑戰性的謎題)。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the rainy afternoon, the children enjoyed <pattern>solving</pattern> a <target>riddle</target> that their teacher had given them to stimulate their thinking.","translation":"在下雨的下午，孩子們很享受解開老師給他們用來刺激思考的謎題。","explanation":"名詞「謎題」。常用搭配 solve a riddle (解開謎題)。"},{"sentence":"The old man told a <pattern>challenging</pattern> <target>riddle</target> about the wind, and no one in the room could guess the answer quickly.","translation":"老人講了一個關於風的具挑戰性的謎題，房間裡沒有人能快速猜到答案。","explanation":"名詞「謎題」。常用形容詞 challenging (具挑戰性的)。"}],"related_forms":["riddles"]}

{"headword":"robber","explanation":"名詞「強盜、搶劫者」。指用暴力或威脅手段奪取財產的人。常用搭配 a masked robber (蒙面強盜), catch a robber (逮捕強盜)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <pattern>masked</pattern> <target>robber</target> tried to escape through the back door, but the police arrived quickly and caught him before he could leave.","translation":"蒙面強盜試圖從後門逃跑，但警察很快趕到，在他離開之前就將他逮捕了。","explanation":"名詞「強盜」。常用形容詞 masked (蒙面的)。"},{"sentence":"The security cameras captured clear images of the <target>robber</target>, which helped the detective identify the suspect and solve the case.","translation":"監視器拍到了強盜的清晰影像，這幫助偵探辨識嫌疑犯並解決了案件。","explanation":"名詞「強盜」。"}],"related_forms":["rob","robbery"]}

{"headword":"romance","explanation":"名詞「浪漫；情史；浪漫小說/電影」。指浪漫的情感或描述浪漫關係的故事。常用搭配 a whirlwind romance (閃電式戀情), a romantic story (浪漫的故事)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young couple's <pattern>whirlwind</pattern> <target>romance</target> surprised everyone, as they decided to get married only three months after meeting for the first time.","translation":"這對年輕夫婦的閃電式戀情讓所有人大吃一驚，因為他們在初次見面後僅三個月就決定結婚。","explanation":"名詞「浪漫關係/情史」。常用搭配 whirlwind romance (閃電式戀情)。"},{"sentence":"She loves reading classic <target>romances</target> set in the nineteenth century, as she finds the old-fashioned ways of expressing love very touching.","translation":"她喜歡閱讀設定在十九世紀的經典浪漫小說，因為她覺得那種老派的表達愛意的方式非常令人感動。","explanation":"名詞「浪漫小說」。"},{"sentence":"The movie is a sweet <target>romance</target> about two students who fall in love while studying abroad in France, showcasing the beauty of romantic love.","translation":"這部電影是一個關於兩個在法國留學時相戀的學生的甜蜜浪漫故事，展示了浪漫之愛的美麗。","explanation":"名詞「浪漫故事」。"}],"related_forms":["romantic","romantically"]}

{"headword":"route","explanation":"名詞「路線、路徑」；動詞「規劃路線、傳送」。名詞常考搭配 include the shortest route (最短路線), change route (改變路線), on the route (在途中)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The GPS suggested the <pattern>shortest</pattern> <target>route</target> to the museum, but we decided to take a longer path to enjoy the scenery.","translation":"GPS建議前往博物館的最短路線，但我們決定走較長的路以欣賞風景。","explanation":"名詞「路線」。常用搭配 shortest route (最短路線)。"},{"sentence":"Due to the heavy rain and flooding, the bus driver had to <pattern>change</pattern> <target>route</target> to avoid the blocked roads.","translation":"由於大雨和洪水，公車司機不得不改變路線以避開封鎖的路段。","explanation":"名詞「路線」。常用搭配 change route (改變路線)。"},{"sentence":"The delivery driver stopped at several small towns <pattern>on the</pattern> <target>route</target> to the city, delivering packages to different customers.","translation":"快遞司機在前往城市的途中停在了幾個小鎮，為不同的客戶遞送包裹。","explanation":"名詞「路線」。常用片語 on the route (在途中)。"},{"sentence":"The network administrator <target>routed</target> the internet traffic <pattern>through</pattern> a different server to reduce the lag during the online exam.","translation":"網絡管理員將互聯網流量通過不同的服務器傳送，以減少在線考試期間的延遲。","explanation":"動詞「傳送、規劃路徑」。常用搭配 route sth through sth。"}],"related_forms":["routes"]}

{"headword":"ruin","explanation":"動詞「毀壞、毀滅」；名詞「廢墟、毀滅」。動詞常用搭配 ruin the mood (破壞心情), ruin a plan (毀掉計畫)。名詞常用搭配 in ruins (成為廢墟)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The sudden heavy rain <target>ruined</target> our outdoor picnic plans, forcing us to move the event inside the school cafeteria.","translation":"突然的大雨毀掉了我們的戶外野餐計畫，迫使我們將活動移至學校食堂內。","explanation":"動詞「毀掉」。常用搭配 ruin a plan (毀掉計畫)。"},{"sentence":"He accidentally spilled red wine on the white carpet, which <target>ruined</target> the expensive fabric and made it impossible to clean.","translation":"他不小心將紅酒灑在白色地毯上，這毀掉了昂貴的布料，使其無法清洗。","explanation":"動詞「毀壞」。"},{"sentence":"The tourists visited the ancient temple, which now stands <pattern>in</pattern> <target>ruins</target> after centuries of war and natural disasters.","translation":"遊客們參觀了這座古廟，在經過數個世紀的戰爭和自然災害後，現在已成為廢墟。","explanation":"名詞「廢墟」。常用片語 in ruins (成為廢墟)。"},{"sentence":"The scandal <target>ruined</target> the politician's reputation, making it difficult for him to regain the trust of the public.","translation":"這場醜聞毀了這位政治家的名聲，使他很難重新獲得公眾的信任。","explanation":"動詞「毀滅」。指名聲或地位的毀滅。"}],"related_forms":["ruined","ruining"]}

{"headword":"rural","explanation":"形容詞「鄉村的、農村的」。常用於描述地理環境或生活方式。常用搭配 rural area (鄉村地區), rural life (鄉村生活)。注意與 urban (城市) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many young people prefer living in cities, but some find <target>rural</target> <pattern>life</pattern> more peaceful and closer to nature.","translation":"許多年輕人喜歡住在城市，但有些人發現鄉村生活更和平且更親近自然。","explanation":"形容詞「鄉村的」。常用搭配 rural life (鄉村生活)。"},{"sentence":"The government is implementing new policies to improve the medical services available in <target>rural</pattern> <pattern>areas</pattern>, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare.","translation":"政府正在實施新政策以改善鄉村地區可獲得的醫療服務，確保每個人都能獲得醫療保健。","explanation":"形容詞「鄉村的」。常用搭配 rural area (鄉村地區)。"}],"related_forms":["rurally"]}

{"headword":"rusty","explanation":"形容詞「生鏽的；不熟練的」。指金屬生鏽或技能因長期不使用而變得生疏。常用搭配 rusty skills (生疏的技能)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The old bicycle had a <target>rusty</target> chain that made a loud noise every time the boy tried to pedal,","translation":"這輛舊自行車有一個生鏽的鏈條，每次男孩嘗試踩踏板時都會發出巨大的噪音。","explanation":"形容詞「生鏽的」。"},{"sentence":"Since I have not spoken English for several years, my speaking skills are a bit <target>rusty</target>, so I need more practice.","translation":"因為我好幾年沒說英語了，我的口說能力有點生疏，所以我需要更多練習。","explanation":"形容詞「不熟練的」。常用搭配 rusty skills (生疏的技能)。"}],"related_forms":["rust"]}

{"headword":"sacrifice","explanation":"名詞「犧牲」；動詞「犧牲」。常用搭配 make a sacrifice (做出犧牲), sacrifice A for B (為了B而犧牲A)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Parents often <target>sacrifice</target> their own comfort <pattern>for</pattern> their children's education, working long hours to provide a better future.","translation":"父母經常為了孩子的教育而犧牲自己的舒適，長時間工作以提供更好的未來。","explanation":"動詞「犧牲」。常用搭配 sacrifice A for B (為了B而犧牲A)。"},{"sentence":"The soldier's <pattern>great</pattern> <target>sacrifice</target> was honored by the city, as he gave his life to protect the innocent citizens during the war.","translation":"這名士兵的偉大犧牲受到了城市的表彰，因為他在戰爭期間犧牲生命以保護無辜的市民。","explanation":"名詞「犧牲」。常用形容詞 great (偉大的)。"},{"sentence":"To win the championship, the athlete had to <target>sacrifice</target> a lot of his free time and social life to train every day.","translation":"為了贏得冠軍，這名運動員不得不犧牲許多空閒時間和社交生活，每天進行訓練。","explanation":"動詞「犧牲」。"}],"related_forms":["sacrifices","sacrificed"]}

{"headword":"satellite","explanation":"名詞「衛星」。指繞著行星運行的天體或人造衛星。常用搭配 artificial satellite (人造衛星), satellite communication (衛星通信)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The space agency launched a new <target>satellite</target> <pattern>into</pattern> orbit to monitor weather patterns and predict natural disasters more accurately.","translation":"太空機構將一顆新衛星送入軌道，以監控天氣模式並更準確地預測自然災害。","explanation":"名詞「衛星」。常用搭配 launch a satellite into orbit (將衛星送入軌道)。"},{"sentence":"Modern <target>satellite</target> <pattern>communication</pattern> allows people to stay connected even in the most remote parts of the world through high-speed internet.","translation":"現代衛星通信使人們即使在世界上最偏遠的地方也能通過高速互聯網保持聯繫。","explanation":"名詞「衛星」。常用搭配 satellite communication (衛星通信)。"},{"sentence":"The moon is the only natural <target>satellite</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the Earth, affecting the tides of the oceans through its gravitational pull.","translation":"月球是地球唯一的天然衛星，通過其引力影響海洋的潮汐。","explanation":"名詞「衛星」。常用搭配 natural satellite of (...的天然衛星)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"satisfaction","explanation":"名詞「滿足感」。常用搭配 satisfaction with sth (對...感到滿足) 或 to one's satisfaction (令某人滿意地)。注意與形容詞 satisfied (感到滿足的) 和動詞 satisfy (使滿足) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"After months of hard work and dedication, the athlete felt a deep sense of <target>satisfaction</target> when she finally won the gold medal.","translation":"經過數月的努力與奉獻，這位運動員在終於贏得金牌時感到深切的滿足感。","explanation":"名詞「滿足感」。常用搭配 a sense of satisfaction。"},{"sentence":"The customer expressed her <target>satisfaction</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the new smartphone, praising its long battery life and high-quality camera.","translation":"顧客對這款新智慧型手機表達了滿意，稱讚其長效電池壽命和高品質的相機。","explanation":"名詞「滿足感」。常用片語 satisfaction with sth。"},{"sentence":"The architect modified the building plans several times until the design was completed <pattern>to</pattern> the client's <target>satisfaction</target>.","translation":"建築師多次修改建築圖紙，直到設計令客戶滿意為止。","explanation":"名詞「滿意」。常用片語 to one's satisfaction。"}],"related_forms":["satisfy","satisfied","satisfying"]}

{"headword":"scarcely","explanation":"副詞「幾乎不」。表示否定意義，常用於描述數量極少或時間極其接近。與 hardly, barely 同義。注意在句子中通常不使用 not，因為 scarcely 本身已含否定意。","entries":[{"sentence":"Because the room was so dimly lit, I could <target>scarcely</target> see the words written on the chalkboard at the back of the classroom.","translation":"因為房間光線太暗，我幾乎看不見教室後方黑板上寫的字。","explanation":"副詞「幾乎不」。常用於描述能力或可能性。"},{"sentence":"The old man had <target>scarcely</target> finished his breakfast when the phone rang, interrupting his peaceful morning routine.","translation":"老人幾乎剛吃完早餐，電話就響了，打斷了他寧靜的早晨習慣。","explanation":"副詞「幾乎不」。常用於描述時間的接近，表示「剛...就...」。"},{"sentence":"There is <target>scarcely</target> any food left in the refrigerator, so we should probably go to the supermarket and buy some groceries.","translation":"冰箱裡幾乎沒有食物剩下了，所以我們大概應該去超市買些雜貨。","explanation":"副詞「幾乎不」。常用於描述數量極少。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"scenery","explanation":"名詞「風景、景觀」。注意 scenery 是不可數名詞，不可使用 a scenery 或 sceneries。若要表達「一處風景」，可使用 a piece of scenery 或 a scenic spot。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tourists were amazed by the breathtaking <target>scenery</target> of the Swiss Alps, with its snow-capped peaks and crystal-clear lakes.","translation":"遊客們被瑞士阿爾卑斯山壯麗的風景所震撼，那裡有被雪覆蓋的山峰和晶瑩剔透的湖泊。","explanation":"名詞「風景」。描述自然景觀。"},{"sentence":"Many painters travel to the countryside to capture the peaceful <target>scenery</target> in their artworks, seeking inspiration from nature.","translation":"許多畫家前往鄉間以在作品中捕捉寧靜的風景，從自然中尋找靈感。","explanation":"名詞「風景」。"},{"sentence":"The school's drama club spent weeks building the <target>scenery</target> for the year-end play, creating a realistic forest setting on stage.","translation":"學校的戲劇社花了好幾週時間為年終劇搭建佈景，在舞台上創造了一個真實的森林場景。","explanation":"名詞「佈景」。指舞台上的裝飾物。"}],"related_forms":["scenic"]}

{"headword":"scold","explanation":"動詞「責備、訓斥」；名詞「愛抱怨的人」。在 GSAT 中，動詞用法最為常見。常用搭配 scold someone for something (因某事責備某人)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher had to <target>scold</target> the students <pattern>for</pattern> talking loudly during the library's quiet hours, reminding them to be respectful.","translation":"老師不得不因學生在圖書館安靜時段大聲說話而責備他們，提醒他們要保持尊重。","explanation":"動詞「責備」。常用搭配 scold someone for sth。"},{"sentence":"The mother <target>scolded</target> her son <pattern>for</pattern> forgetting to take out the trash, which led to a small argument between them.","translation":"母親因兒子忘記倒垃圾而責備他，導致他們之間發生了一場小爭論。","explanation":"動詞「責備」。"},{"sentence":"She was known as the neighborhood <target>scold</target> because she constantly complained about the noise made by the local children.","translation":"她被認為是社區裡的愛抱怨的人，因為她不斷地抱怨當地孩子們製造的噪音。","explanation":"名詞「愛抱怨的人」。"}],"related_forms":["scolding"]}

{"headword":"scoop","explanation":"名詞「勺子、一勺」或「獨家新聞」；動詞「舀起」或「搶先報導」。注意 scoop 在新聞術語中指搶在競爭對手之前報導的消息。","entries":[{"sentence":"The child asked the ice cream vendor for a large <target>scoop</target> of vanilla ice cream on a crunchy chocolate cone.","translation":"孩子向冰淇淋攤販要求在脆巧克力甜筒上放一大勺香草冰淇淋。","explanation":"名詞「一勺」。"},{"sentence":"The reporter spent weeks investigating the scandal and finally managed to get a <target>scoop</target> that made him famous overnight.","translation":"記者花了好幾週調查這場醜聞，最後成功獲得了一則獨家新聞，使他一夜之間成名。","explanation":"名詞「獨家新聞」。"},{"sentence":"He used a large metal <target>scoop</target> to move the dry dog food from the big bag into the plastic bowl.","translation":"他使用一個大型金屬勺將乾狗糧從大袋子移到塑膠碗中。","explanation":"名詞「勺子」。"},{"sentence":"The journalist <target>scooped</target> the other news agencies by publishing the story about the prime minister's resignation first.","translation":"這位記者搶先於其他新聞機構發表了關於總理辭職的消息，從而搶佔了先機。","explanation":"動詞「搶先報導」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"scratch","explanation":"動詞「抓、搔」或「從零開始」；名詞「抓痕、劃痕」。常用片語 from scratch (從零開始/從頭開始)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The cat <target>scratched</target> the leather sofa several times, leaving permanent marks that were impossible to remove.","translation":"貓在皮革沙發上抓了好幾次，留下了無法去除的永久痕跡。","explanation":"動詞「抓」。"},{"sentence":"The student accidentally <target>scratched</target> his glasses while cleaning them with a rough cloth, making the lenses blurry.","translation":"學生在用粗布清洗眼鏡時不小心刮傷了鏡片，導致鏡片模糊。","explanation":"動詞「劃傷」。"},{"sentence":"Since the original cake recipe failed, the baker decided to start <pattern>from</pattern> <target>scratch</target> and bake a new one.","translation":"由於原來的蛋糕食譜失敗了，烘焙師決定從零開始，重新烤一個。","explanation":"名詞片語 from scratch 表示「從零開始」。"},{"sentence":"There was a small <target>scratch</target> on the screen of the new laptop, so he decided to return it to the store.","translation":"螢幕上有一道小劃痕，所以他決定將新筆記型電腦退回商店。","explanation":"名詞「劃痕」。"}],"related_forms":["scratchy"]}

{"headword":"sculpture","explanation":"名詞「雕塑、雕刻品」；動詞「雕刻」。常考點在於區分 sculpture (雕塑作品) 與 sculpting (雕刻的過程) 或 sculpt (動詞)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The artist spent three years creating a massive marble <target>sculpture</target> that depicted the struggles of humanity in a realistic way.","translation":"藝術家花了三年時間創作了一尊巨大的大理石雕塑，以現實的方式描繪人類的掙扎。","explanation":"名詞「雕塑品」。"},{"sentence":"The modern art museum features a variety of <target>sculptures</target> made from recycled materials, encouraging visitors to think about environment protection.","translation":"現代藝術博物館展出了各種由回收材料製成的雕塑，鼓勵遊客思考環境保護。","explanation":"名詞「雕塑品」（複數）。"},{"sentence":"He spent his weekends <target>sculpting</target> small figures out of clay, hoping to improve his skills before applying to an art college.","translation":"他週末花時間用黏土雕刻小人物，希望在申請藝術學院之前提高自己的技能。","explanation":"動詞「雕刻」。此處為現在分詞形式 sculpting。"}],"related_forms":["sculpt","sculptor"]}

{"headword":"secure","explanation":"形容詞「安全的」；動詞「獲得、使固定、確保」。注意 secure 作為動詞時，常指在困難情況下成功獲得某物，如 secure a loan (獲得貸款) 或 secure a victory (確保勝利)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government implemented new laws to ensure that all citizens have <target>secure</target> access to clean drinking water and healthcare.","translation":"政府實施了新法律，以確保所有公民都能安全地獲得乾淨的飲用水和醫療保健。","explanation":"形容詞「安全的、穩定的」。"},{"sentence":"The hikers used strong ropes to <target>secure</target> their tents to the ground, preventing them from being blown away by the strong wind.","translation":"登山者使用強韌的繩索將帳篷固定在地面上，防止它們被強風吹走。","explanation":"動詞「使固定」。"},{"sentence":"After several rounds of intense interviews, the candidate finally managed to <target>secure</target> a job offer from the prestigious company.","translation":"經過幾輪激烈的面試，這位候選人終於成功獲得了這家知名公司的錄取通知。","explanation":"動詞「獲得」。常用搭配 secure a job/loan/victory。"},{"sentence":"The security guards worked tirelessly to <target>secure</target> the area around the president's hotel to prevent any potential threats.","translation":"保全人員不懈地工作，以確保總統酒店周圍區域的安全。","explanation":"動詞「確保安全」。"}],"related_forms":["security","securely"]}

{"headword":"seize","explanation":"動詞「抓住、奪取、利用」。常用搭配 seize the opportunity (抓住機會) 或 seize control (奪取控制權)。注意其過去式和過去分詞為 seized。","entries":[{"sentence":"When the manager offered a scholarship for the summer program, the student decided to <target>seize</target> <pattern>the opportunity</pattern> to study abroad.","translation":"當經理提供暑期計畫的獎學金時，學生決定抓住這個出國留學的機會。","explanation":"動詞「抓住」。常用片語 seize the opportunity。"},{"sentence":"The police officers were ordered to <target>seize</target> all the illegal documents and computers during the sudden raid on the company's office.","translation":"警員接到命令，在對公司辦公室進行突擊搜查時，沒收所有非法文件和電腦。","explanation":"動詞「沒收、奪取」。"},{"sentence":"The rebel army managed to <target>seize</target> <pattern>control of</pattern> the capital city, leading to a sudden change in the national government.","translation":"反叛軍成功奪取了首都的控制權，導致國家政府突然發生變革。","explanation":"動詞「奪取」。常用搭配 seize control of sth。"}],"related_forms":["seizure"]}

{"headword":"settler","explanation":"名詞「定居者、移居者」。指在一個新地區建立家園的人。常用搭配 early settlers (早期定居者)。注意其動詞形式 settle (定居/解決)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>settlers</target> faced many challenges, such as harsh weather and unfamiliar diseases, when they first arrived in the new land.","translation":"定居者在初抵新土地時面臨許多挑戰，例如惡劣的天氣和不熟悉的疾病。","explanation":"名詞「定居者」。"},{"sentence":"Historians study the records of early <target>settlers</target> to understand how they built their first homes and developed their early farming methods.","translation":"歷史學家研究早期定居者的記錄，以了解他們如何建造第一批房屋並發展出早期的耕作方法。","explanation":"名詞「定居者」。"},{"sentence":"Many European <target>settlers</target> moved to the Americas in the seventeenth century, hoping to find a better life and more fertile land.","translation":"許多歐洲移居者在十七世紀移居美洲，希望找到更好的生活和更肥沃的土地。","explanation":"名詞「移居者」。"}],"related_forms":["settle","settlement"]}

{"headword":"severe","explanation":"形容詞「嚴重的、嚴厲的」。常用於描述病情、天氣、處罰或條件的艱難。常見搭配：severe pain (劇痛), severe weather (極端天氣), severe punishment (嚴厲處罰)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The region experienced <target>severe</target> <pattern>weather</pattern> last winter, with record-breaking snowfall that blocked many roads and caused power outages.","translation":"該地區去年冬天經歷了嚴重的天氣，破紀錄的降雪封閉了許多道路並導致停電。","explanation":"形容詞「嚴重的」。常用於描述極端天氣。"},{"sentence":"Due to his <target>severe</target> <pattern>injury</pattern> during the basketball game, the athlete had to undergo surgery and spend months in rehabilitation.","translation":"由於在籃球賽中受了重傷，這名運動員必須接受手術並花數月時間進行康復治療。","explanation":"形容詞「嚴重的」。常用於描述傷勢或病情。"},{"sentence":"The school board decided that a <target>severe</target> <pattern>punishment</pattern> was necessary to discourage students from cheating on the final examinations.","translation":"學校董事會認為，必須採取嚴厲的處罰以防止學生在期末考試中作弊。","explanation":"形容詞「嚴厲的」。常用於描述處罰或限制。"}],"related_forms":["severely"]}

{"headword":"sew","explanation":"動詞「縫製、縫合」。注意其不規則變化：sew - sewed - sewn/sewed。常用搭配：sew by hand (手工縫製), sew a button on (縫上鈕扣)。","entries":[{"sentence":"My grandmother taught me how to <target>sew</target> a button <pattern>on</pattern> my shirt, which is a useful skill for maintaining my own clothes.","translation":"我的祖母教我如何將鈕扣縫在襯衫上，這對維護自己的衣服來說是一項有用的技能。","explanation":"動詞「縫製」。常用搭配 sew sth on sth。"},{"sentence":"The fashion student decided to <target>sew</target> the dress <pattern>by hand</pattern> to ensure that every detail was perfect and unique for the exhibition.","translation":"這名時尚系學生決定手工縫製這件洋裝，以確保展覽中的每個細節都完美且獨特。","explanation":"動詞「縫製」。常用搭配 sew by hand。"}],"related_forms":["sewing"]}

{"headword":"shade","explanation":"名詞指「陰影」或「色調」；動詞指「遮光」。注意 shade (陰影) 與 shadow (影子) 的區別：shade 是指陽光被遮住而產生的陰暗區域，而 shadow 是指物體投影在地面上的形狀。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the hot summer afternoon, the students found a cool <target>shade</target> <pattern>under</pattern> a large oak tree to read their books and relax.","translation":"在炎熱的夏季午後，學生們在一個巨大的橡樹下找到了涼爽的陰影，閱讀書籍並放鬆。","explanation":"名詞「陰影」。指陽光被遮住的區域。"},{"sentence":"The interior designer suggested a lighter <target>shade</target> <pattern>of</pattern> blue for the living room walls to make the space feel more open and bright.","translation":"室內設計師建議客廳牆壁使用較淺的藍色色調，使空間感覺更開闊、更明亮。","explanation":"名詞「色調」。常用搭配 a shade of + 顏色。"},{"sentence":"To protect her eyes from the bright sunlight, she used a small umbrella to <target>shade</target> her face while walking to school.","translation":"為了保護眼睛免受強烈陽光的照射，她在走去學校的路上用一把小傘為臉部遮光。","explanation":"動詞「遮光」。"}],"related_forms":["shading","shady"]}

{"headword":"shady","explanation":"形容詞「陰涼的」或「可疑的」。後者是指行為不誠實或不合法。常用搭配：a shady area (陰涼處), a shady character (可疑人物)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The park is a great place for a walk because it has many <target>shady</target> <pattern>paths</pattern> that keep visitors cool during the summer.","translation":"這個公園非常適合散步，因為它有許多陰涼的小徑，讓遊客在夏天能保持涼爽。","explanation":"形容詞「陰涼的」。"},{"sentence":"The detective warned the young man not to deal with <target>shady</target> <pattern>businesses</pattern> that promise quick money but lack legal licenses.","translation":"偵探警告這個年輕人不要與那些承諾快速賺錢但缺乏合法執照的可疑公司打交道。","explanation":"形容詞「可疑的」。常用搭配 shady business / shady character。"}],"related_forms":["shade"]}

{"headword":"shameful","explanation":"形容詞「可恥的、丟臉的」。常用於描述不道德或令人失望的行為。注意其名詞形式 shame (恥辱)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company's decision to dump toxic waste into the river was a <target>shameful</target> <pattern>act</pattern> that harmed the local environment and wildlife.","translation":"公司將有毒廢物排入河流的決定是一個可恥的行為，損害了當地環境和野生動物。","explanation":"形容詞「可恥的」。常用搭配 shameful act / shameful behavior。"},{"sentence":"Many people believe that bullying other students in school is <target>shameful</target> and should be strictly punished by the administration.","translation":"許多人認為在學校霸凌其他學生是可恥的，應該由校方嚴格處罰。","explanation":"形容詞「可恥的」。"}],"related_forms":["shame","shamefully"]}

{"headword":"shave","explanation":"動詞「刮（鬍鬚、頭髮）」；名詞「刮鬍子」或「勉強脫險」。動詞用法最常見，注意其不規則變化：shave - shaved - shaved。名詞片語：a close shave (死裡逃生/勉強脫險)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Every morning, the young man uses a sharp razor to <target>shave</target> his beard, ensuring a smooth and clean look for his job interview.","translation":"每天早上，這個年輕人使用鋒利的刮鬍刀刮鬍子，以確保在工作面試時有光滑且乾淨的外觀。","explanation":"動詞「刮」。常用搭配 shave one's beard/face。"},{"sentence":"The athlete had to <target>shave</target> his legs to make it easier for the trainer to treat muscle injuries with special tapes.","translation":"這名運動員必須刮掉腿上的毛，以便訓練師能更容易地使用特殊膠帶治療肌肉傷害。","explanation":"動詞「刮」。"},{"sentence":"He almost stepped in front of the speeding car, but he jumped back just in time, which was a very <pattern>close</pattern> <target>shave</target>.","translation":"他差點走到疾速行駛的車前，但及時跳回，這真是死裡逃生。","explanation":"名詞片語 a close shave 表示「死裡逃生」或「勉強脫險」。"}],"related_forms":["shaved","shaving"]}

{"headword":"shelter","explanation":"名詞指「避難所、遮蔽處」；動詞指「提供庇護」。常用搭配：take shelter (尋找避難處), seek shelter (尋找庇護)。注意 shelter 作為名詞時可指物理上的建築物，也可指抽象的庇護。","entries":[{"sentence":"When the sudden rainstorm began, the tourists quickly <pattern>took</pattern> <target>shelter</target> <pattern>under</pattern> the eaves of a small cafe to stay dry.","translation":"當突然的暴雨開始時，遊客們迅速在一家小咖啡館的屋簷下尋找避難處以保持乾爽。","explanation":"名詞「避難所」。片語 take shelter under/in sth 表「在...下尋找避難處」。"},{"sentence":"The government built an emergency <target>shelter</target> to protect the local residents from the effects of a possible earthquake or flood.","translation":"政府建造了一個緊急避難所，以保護當地居民免受可能發生的地震或洪水的影響。","explanation":"名詞「避難所」。指物理上的建築物。"},{"sentence":"The animal <target>shelter</target> provides a safe home and medical care for stray dogs and cats until they can find a loving family.","translation":"動物收容所為流浪狗和貓提供安全的家和醫療照顧，直到他們能找到一個充滿愛的家庭。","explanation":"名詞「收容所」。animal shelter 指「動物收容所」。"},{"sentence":"The mother bird tried to <target>shelter</target> her young chicks from the cold wind by spreading her wings over them.","translation":"母鳥試圖透過將翅膀展開在雛鳥身上，來保護牠們免受寒風之苦。","explanation":"動詞「提供庇護、遮蔽」。"}],"related_forms":["sheltered"]}

{"headword":"shift","explanation":"名詞指「轉移、改變」或「輪班」；動詞指「移動、改變」。常用搭配：a shift in (在...方面的轉移/改變), work the night shift (值夜班)。注意 shift 與 change 的區別：shift 通常指方向或位置的微調或系統性的轉移。","entries":[{"sentence":"There has been a significant <target>shift</target> <pattern>in</pattern> public opinion regarding environmental protection, with more people choosing sustainable products.","translation":"大眾對環境保護的看法有了顯著的轉移，更多的人選擇永續產品。","explanation":"名詞「轉移、改變」。常用搭配 a shift in sth。"},{"sentence":"The nurse explained that she <pattern>works</pattern> the <target>night</target> <pattern>shift</pattern>, which means she sleeps during the day and works at night.","translation":"這名護理師解釋說她值夜班，這意味著她在白天睡覺，晚上工作。","explanation":"名詞「輪班」。常用搭配 work the night shift。"},{"sentence":"The driver had to <target>shift</target> gears quickly to navigate the steep hill and maintain a constant speed for the car.","translation":"駕駛員必須快速換檔，以在陡峭的山坡上導航並保持汽車的恆定速度。","explanation":"動詞「移動、更換」。此處指換檔。"},{"sentence":"When the teacher entered the room, the students <target>shifted</target> their attention <pattern>from</pattern> their phones <pattern>to</pattern> the whiteboard.","translation":"當老師進入房間時，學生們將注意力從手機轉移到白板上。","explanation":"動詞「轉移」。常用搭配 shift sth from A to B。"}],"related_forms":["shifter"]}

{"headword":"sightseeing","explanation":"名詞「觀光、遊覽」。通常作為不可數名詞。常用片語：go sightseeing (去觀光)。注意 sightseeing 與 tourism (觀光業) 的區別：sightseeing 側重於觀看風景名勝。","entries":[{"sentence":"While visiting Tokyo, the students <pattern>went</pattern> <target>sightseeing</target> and visited many famous temples and museums to learn about Japanese history.","translation":"在訪問東京時，學生們去觀光，參觀了許多著名的寺廟和博物館以了解日本歷史。","explanation":"名詞「觀光」。片語 go sightseeing 表示「去觀光」。"},{"sentence":"The city's official guide provides a map and a list of the best spots for <target>sightseeing</target>, helping tourists find their way easily.","translation":"該市的官方指南提供了一張地圖和一份最佳觀光地點清單，幫助遊客輕鬆找到方向。","explanation":"名詞「觀光」。"}],"related_forms":["sightseer"]}

{"headword":"signature","explanation":"名詞「簽名」；形容詞「招牌的、典型的」。作為名詞時，常用於正式文件。作為形容詞時，指某人或某店最具代表性的特點。常用搭配：forge a signature (偽造簽名), a signature dish (招牌菜)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The lawyer asked the client to put his <target>signature</target> <pattern>at</pattern> the bottom of the contract to make the agreement official.","translation":"律師要求客戶在合約底部簽名，以使協議正式生效。","explanation":"名詞「簽名」。常用搭配 put one's signature at/on sth。"},{"sentence":"The bank manager noticed that the <target>signature</target> on the check was slightly different from the one on file, suspecting a forgery.","translation":"銀行經理注意到支票上的簽名與檔案中的簽名略有不同，懷疑是偽造的。","explanation":"名詞「簽名」。"},{"sentence":"This restaurant is famous for its <target>signature</target> <pattern>dish</pattern>, a unique blend of seafood and local spices that attracts many foodies.","translation":"這家餐廳以其招牌菜聞名，這是一道將海鮮和當地香料獨特結合的料理，吸引了許多美食家。","explanation":"形容詞「招牌的」。常用搭配 signature dish (招牌菜)。"}],"related_forms":["sign"]}

{"headword":"significance","explanation":"名詞「重要性」或「意義」。常用搭配 significance of... (…的重要性)。注意與 significant (形容詞) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The historian explained the historical <target>significance</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the ancient temple, highlighting how it reflected the culture of that era.","translation":"歷史學家解釋了這座古廟的歷史意義，強調它如何反映了那個時代的文化。","explanation":"名詞「重要性/意義」。常用搭配 significance of...。"},{"sentence":"Many students failed to realize the <target>significance</target> <pattern>of</pattern> regular study habits until they faced the final exams at the end of the semester.","translation":"許多學生直到學期末面對期末考時，才意識到養成定期學習習慣的重要性。","explanation":"名詞「重要性」。"}],"related_forms":["significant","significantly"]}

{"headword":"sincerity","explanation":"名詞「誠信」或「真誠」。常用於描述人的性格或表達方式。形容詞為 sincerity 的相關形式 sincereness，但最常用的是 sincere。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher could feel the <target>sincerity</target> in the student's voice when he apologized for his mistake and promised to improve.","translation":"當學生為自己的錯誤道歉並承諾會改進時，老師能感受到他聲音中的真誠。","explanation":"名詞「真誠」。"},{"sentence":"Her <target>sincerity</target> and honesty made her a trusted leader in the student council, as everyone knew she always spoke the truth.","translation":"她的真誠與誠實使她成為學生會中受信任的領導者，因為每個人都知道她總是說實話。","explanation":"名詞「誠信」。"}],"related_forms":["sincere","sincerely"]}

{"headword":"singular","explanation":"形容詞「單數的」或「非凡的」；名詞「單數名詞」。在語言學中， singular 與 plural (複數) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"In English grammar, we must use a <target>singular</target> verb when the subject of the sentence is a <target>singular</target> noun.","translation":"在英文文法中，當句子的主詞是一個單數名詞時，我們必須使用單數動詞。","explanation":"形容詞「單數的」。"},{"sentence":"The scientist's <target>singular</target> focus on the research project allowed her to discover a new species of plant in the rainforest.","translation":"這位科學家對研究項目的單一且非凡的專注力，使她能在雨林中發現一種新植物。","explanation":"形容詞「非凡的、單一的」。"},{"sentence":"Please write the <target>singular</target> form of the word 'children' in the blank space provided on the worksheet.","translation":"請在工作單提供的空格中寫出 'children' 這個詞的單數形式。","explanation":"名詞「單數形式」。"}],"related_forms":["singularity"]}

{"headword":"site","explanation":"名詞「地點」、「場所」或「網站」；動詞「選址」或「安置」。常用搭配 construction site (建築工地), website (網站)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city council decided to build a new library at the <target>site</target> <pattern>of</pattern> an old factory, turning it into a community center.","translation":"市議會決定在一家舊工廠的地點建造一座新圖書館，將其轉變為社區中心。","explanation":"名詞「地點」。"},{"sentence":"Many students use an online learning <target>site</target> to study for their exams, as it provides a variety of helpful resources.","translation":"許多學生使用線上學習網站來準備考試，因為它提供了多種有用的資源。","explanation":"名詞「網站」。"},{"sentence":"The engineers carefully <target>sited</target> the new hospital near the main road to ensure that ambulances could reach it quickly.","translation":"工程師們小心地將新醫院安置在主路附近，以確保救護車能迅速到達。","explanation":"動詞「選址/安置」。"}],"related_forms":["sited"]}

{"headword":"sketch","explanation":"名詞「草圖」或「素描」；動詞「畫草圖」或「簡述」。常用搭配 rough sketch (粗略的草圖)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Before starting the final painting, the artist made a <pattern>rough</pattern> <target>sketch</target> to plan the composition and the placement of the figures.","translation":"在開始最終的繪畫之前，藝術家畫了一張粗略的草圖來規劃構圖和人物的擺放位置。","explanation":"名詞「草圖」。"},{"sentence":"The witness was asked to <target>sketch</target> the face of the suspect, providing the police with a basic idea of his appearance.","translation":"證人被要求畫出嫌疑人的面孔，為警方提供關於其外貌的基本概念。","explanation":"動詞「畫草圖」。"},{"sentence":"In the introduction of the essay, the author <target>sketched</target> <pattern>out</pattern> the main arguments he would discuss in the following paragraphs.","translation":"在文章的引言中，作者簡述了他在接下來的段落中將要討論的主要論點。","explanation":"動詞片語 sketch out 意為「簡述/概述」。"}],"related_forms":["sketched","sketching"]}

{"headword":"skyscraper","explanation":"名詞「摩天大樓」。通常指極高的大樓，常見於大城市中心。","entries":[{"sentence":"Standing at the top of the <target>skyscraper</target>, the tourist could see the entire city skyline stretching toward the horizon.","translation":"站在摩天大樓的頂端，遊客可以看到整個城市的輪廓線延伸至地平線。","explanation":"名詞「摩天大樓」。"},{"sentence":"Many modern <target>skyscrapers</target> are designed with glass walls to allow more natural light into the offices, reducing energy consumption.","translation":"許多現代摩天大樓設計有玻璃牆，以讓更多自然光進入辦公室，從而減少能源消耗。","explanation":"名詞「摩天大樓」（複數）。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"slight","explanation":"形容詞「輕微的」或「微小的」；名詞「侮辱」或「enlighten」；動詞「輕視」或「侮辱」。常用搭配 a slight difference (微小差異)。","entries":[{"sentence":"There was a <target>slight</target> <pattern>delay</pattern> in the flight's departure due to a technical issue, but the plane took off shortly after.","translation":"由於技術問題，航班起飛有所輕微延遲，但飛機很快就起飛了。","explanation":"形容詞「輕微的」。"},{"sentence":"Although the two paintings looked similar, there was a <target>slight</target> <pattern>difference</pattern> in the colors used in the background.","translation":"雖然這兩幅畫看起來很相似，但背景所使用的顏色有微小差異。","explanation":"形容詞「微小的」。"},{"sentence":"He felt a <target>slight</target> in his pride when his colleagues ignored his suggestion during the meeting, making him feel unimportant.","translation":"他感到自尊心受損，因為同事們在會議中忽略了他的建議，使他覺得自己不重要。","explanation":"名詞「侮辱/輕視」。"},{"sentence":"The politician was accused of <target>slighting</target> the contributions of the smaller parties, which caused a lot of tension between them.","translation":"這位政治家被指控輕視了小黨的貢獻，這在他們之間造成了許多緊張關係。","explanation":"動詞「輕視/侮辱」。"}],"related_forms":["slightly"]}

{"headword":"slogan","explanation":"名詞「口號」。常用於廣告或政治競選中，用以吸引注意力並讓人記憶深刻。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company created a catchy <target>slogan</target> for their new product, making it easy for customers to remember the brand.","translation":"公司為其新產品創造了一個朗朗上口的口號，使顧客能輕易地記住該品牌。","explanation":"名詞「口號」。"},{"sentence":"During the environmental protest, the students carried signs with <target>slogans</target> <pattern>about</pattern> protecting the earth and reducing plastic use.","translation":"在環境保護抗議活動中，學生們拿著寫有關於保護地球和減少塑料使用口號的牌子。","explanation":"名詞「口號」（複數）。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"socket","explanation":"名詞「插座」或「孔洞」。常用搭配 power socket (電源插座), wall socket (牆壁插座)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Since the hotel room had only one <target>socket</target> in the wall, the traveler used a power strip to charge multiple devices.","translation":"由於飯店房間的牆上只有一個插座，旅客使用延長線來為多個設備充電。","explanation":"名詞「插座」。"},{"sentence":"Before plugging in the computer, make sure the <target>socket</target> is <pattern>functioning</pattern> <pattern>properly</pattern> to avoid any electrical shorts.","translation":"在將電腦插入插座前，確保插座功能正常，以避免任何電路短路。","explanation":"名詞「插座」。"}],"related_forms":["sockets"]}

{"headword":"software","explanation":" ","entries":[{"sentence":"The school decided to install new <target>software</target> on all the computers to help students learn foreign languages more effectively.","translation":"學校決定在所有電腦上安裝新軟體，以幫助學生更有效率地地學習外方向語。","explanation":"名詞「軟體」。不可數名詞。"},{"sentence":"The software developer spent several months <target>software</target> <pattern>development</pattern> to create a new app that helps students organize their tasks.","translation":"軟體開發者花了好幾個月進行軟體開發，以創造一個能幫助學生組織任務的新應用程式。","explanation":"名詞「軟體」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"solar","explanation":"形容詞，意為「太陽的」或「與太陽有關的」。常考搭配如 solar system (太陽系) 和 solar energy (太陽能)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many homeowners are installing <target>solar</target> <pattern>panels</pattern> on their roofs to reduce electricity costs and protect the environment.","translation":"許多屋主在屋頂安裝太陽能板，以降低電費並保護環境。","explanation":"形容詞「太陽能的」。常用搭配：solar panels (太陽能板)。"},{"sentence":"The science teacher explained that the Earth is just one of the eight planets in our <target>solar</target> <pattern>system</pattern>.","translation":"科學老師解釋說，地球只是我們太陽系中的八顆行星之一。","explanation":"形容詞「太陽的」。常用搭配：solar system (太陽系)。"},{"sentence":"Researchers are exploring new ways to harness <target>solar</target> <pattern>energy</pattern> to provide electricity for remote villages without power grids.","translation":"研究人員正探索利用太陽能為沒有電網的偏遠村莊提供電力的新方法。","explanation":"形容詞「太陽能的」。常用搭配：solar energy (太陽能)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"spade","explanation":"名詞，指「鏟子」或「黑桃（撲克牌）」。在 GSAT 中，主要考查其作為工具的含義。","entries":[{"sentence":"The gardener used a sturdy <target>spade</target> to dig a deep hole in the soil for planting the new apple tree.","translation":"園丁使用一把堅固的鏟子在土壤中挖一個深洞，以便種植新的蘋果樹。","explanation":"名詞「鏟子」。指用於挖掘的工具。"},{"sentence":"He grabbed a <target>spade</target> and began clearing the snow from the driveway so that his parents could drive the car out.","translation":"他拿著一把鏟子開始清理車道上的積雪，以便他的父母能將車開出去。","explanation":"名詞「鏟子」。指用於除雪或挖掘的工具。"},{"sentence":"During the card game, he was surprised to see that the final card he drew was the ace of <target>spades</target>.","translation":"在玩牌時，他很驚訝地發現他抽到的最後一張牌是黑桃 A。","explanation":"名詞「黑桃」。指撲克牌中的一種花色。"}],"related_forms":[]}
