{"headword":"spare","explanation":"詞性多變。形容詞指「多餘的、備用的」；動詞指「抽出（時間）、省去（痛苦/麻煩）」或「節省」；名詞指「備用品」。注意 spare time (空閒時間) 和 spare no effort (不遺餘力) 的常用搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"Since the main tire got a puncture, the driver had to use the <target>spare</target> tire kept in the trunk of the car.","translation":"由於主輪胎被刺破，駕駛員不得不使用後車廂裡的備胎。","explanation":"形容詞「備用的」。指多出的、可用於替代的東西。"},{"sentence":"In her <target>spare</target> <pattern>time</pattern>, Sarah enjoys painting landscapes and reading novels to relax after a stressful week at school.","translation":"在她的空閒時間，莎拉喜歡畫風景畫和讀小說，以便在學校壓力沉重的一週後放鬆心情。","explanation":"形容詞「空閒的」。常用搭配：spare time (空閒時間)。"},{"sentence":"The professor was kind enough to <target>spare</target> a few minutes to give the student some advice on his future career path.","translation":"教授很親切地抽出了幾分鐘時間，給學生一些關於未來職業路徑的建議。","explanation":"動詞「抽出」。指抽出時間或金錢給他人。"},{"sentence":"The government decided to <target>spare</target> the prisoners from the harsh punishment after discovering new evidence that proved their innocence.","translation":"政府在發現證明他們無辜的新證據後，決定免除囚犯們的嚴厲處罰。","explanation":"動詞「免除」。指避免讓某人遭受痛苦或不便。"},{"sentence":"The team <target>spared</target> <pattern>no effort</pattern> to ensure that the international conference was organized perfectly and without any errors.","translation":"團隊不遺餘力地確保國際會議組織得完美且沒有任何錯誤。","explanation":"動詞片語 spare no effort (不遺餘力)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"spark","explanation":"名詞指「火花」或「觸發點」；動詞指「引起、觸發」。常用於描述突然發生的事件或情緒的爆發。","entries":[{"sentence":"A small <target>spark</target> from the campfire could easily start a massive forest fire if the wind is strong and the grass is dry.","translation":"如果風大且草乾，營火的一個小火花很容易引起巨大的森林火災。","explanation":"名詞「火花」。指物理上的火花。"},{"sentence":"The speaker's inspiring words <target>sparked</target> a <pattern>debate</pattern> among the students about the importance of preserving traditional cultures.","translation":"演講者的鼓舞人心的話語在學生之間引起了一場關於保護傳統文化重要性的辯論。","explanation":"動詞「引起/觸發」。常用搭配：spark a debate/controversy。"},{"sentence":"The sudden increase in food prices <target>sparked</target> <pattern>protests</pattern> across the city, as many people could no longer afford basic necessities.","translation":"食品價格的突然上漲在全市引起了抗議，因為許多人再也買不起基本生活必需品。","explanation":"動詞「引起/觸發」。常用搭配：spark protests (引起抗議)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"spear","explanation":"名詞指「矛、長槍」；動詞指「用矛刺」。在現代英語中，常用於描述古代戰爭或狩獵方式。","entries":[{"sentence":"The museum exhibited an ancient <target>spear</target> used by early humans for hunting large animals and defending their territory.","translation":"博物館展出了一把早期人類用於狩獵大型動物和保衛領土的古代長槍。","explanation":"名詞「長槍」。指一種古代武器。"},{"sentence":"The warrior held his <target>spear</target> firmly and waited for the right moment to attack the enemy charging toward him.","translation":"戰士緊緊握著他的長槍，等待著攻擊向他衝來的敵人的正確時機。","explanation":"名詞「長槍」。"},{"sentence":"The fisherman used a specialized <target>spear</target> to <target>spear</target> fish in the shallow water, a technique used in some coastal regions.","translation":"漁民使用專門的長槍在淺水區叉魚，這是某些沿海地區使用的一種技術。","explanation":"名詞與動詞用法。名詞指長槍，動詞指用長槍刺。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"species","explanation":"名詞，指「物種」。注意 species 的單複數同形，即 a species (一個物種) 和 many species (許多物種) 均可。常考搭配如 endangered species (瀕危物種)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Scientists discovered a new <target>species</target> <pattern>of</pattern> tropical birds in the deep rainforest, which had never been seen by humans before.","translation":"科學家在深處的雨林中發現了一種新的熱帶鳥類物種，此前人類從未見過。","explanation":"名詞「物種」。常用片語 a species of...。"},{"sentence":"The government has implemented strict laws to protect <target>endangered</target> <target>species</target> from illegal hunting and habitat destruction.","translation":"政府實施了嚴格的法律，以保護瀕危物種免於非法狩獵和棲息地破壞。","explanation":"名詞「物種」。常用搭配：endangered species (瀕危物種)。"},{"sentence":"Because of climate change, many <target>species</target> of animals are struggling to adapt to the rising temperatures of their environment.","translation":"由於氣候變遷，許多動物物種正努力適應環境中不斷上升的溫度。","explanation":"名詞「物種」。此處為複數用法。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"spiritual","explanation":"形容詞，意為「心靈的、精神的」。注意與 material (物質的) 或 physical (身體的) 相對。常用於描述宗教或內心平靜的追求。","entries":[{"sentence":"After years of working in a high-pressure job, he decided to travel to the mountains to seek <target>spiritual</target> <pattern>peace</pattern> and inner calm.","translation":"在從事高壓工作多年後，他決定前往山區尋求心靈的平靜與內心的寧靜。","explanation":"形容詞「心靈的」。常用搭配：spiritual peace (心靈平靜)。"},{"sentence":"Many people find that meditation and yoga provide them with a sense of <target>spiritual</target> <pattern>growth</pattern> and emotional stability.","translation":"許多人發現冥想和瑜伽能給他們帶來心靈成長的感覺和情緒穩定。","explanation":"形容詞「精神的」。常用搭配：spiritual growth (精神成長)。"},{"sentence":"The ancient temple is not only an architectural marvel but also a place of deep <target>spiritual</target> <pattern>significance</pattern> for the local community.","translation":"這座古廟不僅是建築奇蹟，也是當地社區具有深厚精神意義的地方。","explanation":"形容詞「精神的」。常用搭配：spiritual significance (精神意義)。"}],"related_forms":["spiritually","spirituality"]}

{"headword":"splendid","explanation":"形容詞，意為「極好的、壯麗的」。常用於描述風景、建築或某人的表現。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tourists were amazed by the <target>splendid</target> view of the snow-capped mountains from the top of the cable car.","translation":"遊客們被纜車頂端看到的雪山壯麗景色所震撼。","explanation":"形容詞「壯麗的」。用於描述風景。"},{"sentence":"The royal palace is known for its <target>splendid</target> architecture and the luxurious decorations inside its grand halls.","translation":"皇宮以其壯麗的建築和內部大廳的豪華裝飾而聞名。","explanation":"形容詞「壯麗的」。用於描述建築。"},{"sentence":"The student gave a <target>splendid</target> performance in the piano competition, earning a standing ovation from the judges and the audience.","translation":"該學生在鋼琴比賽中表現極佳，贏得了評審和觀眾的起立鼓掌。","explanation":"形容詞「極好的」。用於描述表現或品質。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"split","explanation":"動詞指「分裂、分開」；名詞指「分裂、分開」。常用片語 split up (分開/分手) 和 split the difference (折衷)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The wooden board <target>split</target> <pattern>in half</pattern> after the carpenter applied too much pressure while trying to nail it to the wall.","translation":"木板在木工試圖將其釘在牆上並施加過多壓力後，被劈成兩半。","explanation":"動詞「劈開/分開」。常用搭配：split in half (劈成兩半)。"},{"sentence":"The couple decided to <target>split</target> <pattern>up</pattern> after realizing that their goals in life were too different to continue together.","translation":"這對情侶在意識到他們的人生目標太過不同而無法繼續在一起後，決定分開。","explanation":"動詞片語 split up (分開/分手)。"},{"sentence":"The political party <target>split</target> <pattern>into</pattern> two factions because they could not agree on the new economic policy.","translation":"這個政黨因為無法在新的經濟政策上達成共識而分裂成了兩個派系。","explanation":"動詞「分裂」。常用搭配：split into (分裂成)。"},{"sentence":"There was a clear <target>split</target> between the two groups of students regarding whether the school should allow smartphones in class.","translation":"關於學校是否應該允許在課堂上使用手機，這兩組學生之間存在明顯的分歧。","explanation":"名詞「分歧/分裂」。指觀念或群體的分裂。"},{"sentence":"When paying for the dinner, the friends decided to <target>split</target> <pattern>the bill</pattern>, making it fair for everyone involved.","translation":"在支付晚餐費用時，朋友們決定平分帳單，使其對每位參與者都公平。","explanation":"動詞「平分」。常用搭配：split the bill (平分帳單)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"sprinkle","explanation":"動詞指「灑、噴」；名詞指「少量地灑」。常用於烹飪或描述天氣（如小雨）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The baker decided to <target>sprinkle</target> <pattern>some</pattern> <target>sugar</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the top of the cake to make it look more attractive.","translation":"烘焙師決定在蛋糕頂端灑一些糖，使其看起來更吸引人。","explanation":"動詞「灑」。常用搭配：sprinkle sth on sth。"},{"sentence":"To keep the garden fresh during the hot summer, the gardener used a tool to <target>sprinkle</target> water on the plants every morning.","translation":"為了在炎熱的夏天保持花園清新，園丁每天早晨使用工具在植物上噴水。","explanation":"動詞「噴/灑」。"},{"sentence":"The afternoon walk was interrupted by a light <target>sprinkle</target> of rain, but it was not heavy enough to require an umbrella.","translation":"下午的散步被一場小雨打斷，但雨勢並不大到需要撐傘。","explanation":"名詞「少量地灑/小雨」。指雨水的少量分佈。"}],"related_forms":["sprinkled","sprinkling"]}

{"headword":"stab","explanation":"動詞「刺、戳」；名詞「刺傷、嘗試」。動詞常接對象（如 stab someone in the back 意為「背叛」）；名詞用法中 a stab at something 意為「嘗試做某事」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The surgeon carefully used a small needle to <target>stab</target> the infected area to drain the fluid and reduce the swelling.","translation":"外科醫生小心地使用一根小針刺入感染區域，以排出液體並減輕腫脹。","explanation":"動詞「刺、戳」。"},{"sentence":"After studying the difficult math problem for an hour, he decided to take a <target>stab</target> <pattern>at</pattern> solving it one more time.","translation":"研究這個困難的數學問題一個小時後，他決定再次嘗試解決它。","explanation":"名詞「嘗試」。片語 take a stab at sth 意為「嘗試做某事」。"},{"sentence":"She felt betrayed when her closest friend <target>stabbed</target> her <pattern>in the back</pattern> by telling the principal about her secret mistake.","translation":"當她最親密的朋友向校長揭露她的秘密錯誤而背叛她時，她感到被背叛了。","explanation":"動詞片語 stab someone in the back 意為「背叛某人」。"}],"related_forms":["stabbing"]}

{"headword":"statistic","explanation":"名詞「統計數據」。注意其單複數用法：當指「統計數據」時，通常使用複數形式 statistics；當指「統計學」這門學科時，使用單數形式並視為單數動詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"The latest <target>statistics</target> <pattern>show that</pattern> the number of students who study abroad has increased significantly over the past decade.","translation":"最新的統計數據顯示，過去十年中出國留學的學生人數顯著增加。","explanation":"名詞「統計數據」。常用搭配 statistics show that..."},{"sentence":"In her university application essay, she included several impressive <target>statistics</target> to support her argument about climate change.","translation":"在她的大學申請論文中，她加入了幾個令人印象深刻的統計數據來支持她關於氣候變遷的論點。","explanation":"名詞「統計數據」。"},{"sentence":"Professor Lee specializes in <target>statistics</target>, teaching students how to analyze complex data sets to find meaningful patterns.","translation":"李教授專攻統計學，教學生如何分析複雜的數據集以尋找有意義的模式。","explanation":"名詞「統計學」。指學科名稱時使用單數形式。"}],"related_forms":["statistical","statistically"]}

{"headword":"status","explanation":"名詞「地位、狀態」。常用於描述社會階級 (social status) 或某事進展的現況 (status update/report)。","entries":[{"sentence":"In many ancient societies, a person's social <target>status</target> was determined by their family's wealth and the land they owned.","translation":"在許多古代社會中，一個人的社會地位是由其家庭的財富和擁有的土地決定的。","explanation":"名詞「地位」。常用搭配 social status。"},{"sentence":"The manager asked the team for a <target>status</target> <pattern>report</pattern> to understand how much of the project had been completed.","translation":"經理要求團隊提交一份進度報告，以了解專案已完成的部分。","explanation":"名詞「狀態、進度」。常用搭配 status report。"},{"sentence":"Students are often anxious to check their application <target>status</target> online to see if they have been accepted into their dream university.","translation":"學生們經常焦急地在網上檢查他們的申請狀態，看是否被他們夢想的大學錄取。","explanation":"名詞「狀態」。"}],"related_forms":["statuses"]}

{"headword":"stem","explanation":"名詞「莖、幹」；動詞「起源於」。注意動詞片語 stem from (起源於)，這是 GSAT 常考的替代詞，可用於取代 cause 或 originate from。","entries":[{"sentence":"The botanist explained that the plant's <target>stem</target> transports water and nutrients from the roots to the leaves for growth.","translation":"植物學家解釋說，植物的莖將水分和養分從根部傳送到葉子以利於生長。","explanation":"名詞「莖」。"},{"sentence":"Many of the students' academic problems <target>stem</target> <pattern>from</pattern> a lack of basic study habits and poor time management skills.","translation":"許多學生的學習問題起源於缺乏基本的學習習慣和糟糕的時間管理能力。","explanation":"動詞片語 stem from 意為「起源於」。"},{"sentence":"The conflict between the two neighboring countries <target>stems</target> <pattern>from</pattern> a long-standing dispute over the ownership of the border territory.","translation":"這兩個鄰國之間的衝突起源於對邊境領土所有權的長期爭端。","explanation":"動詞片語 stem from 意為「起源於」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"stereo","explanation":"名詞「立體聲設備、音響」。原為 stereophonic 的縮寫，指能產生空間感的聲音播放設備。","entries":[{"sentence":"He bought a high-quality <target>stereo</target> system for his bedroom so he could listen to his favorite music with clear sound.","translation":"他在臥室買了一套高品質的音響系統，以便能以清晰的聲音聆聽他最喜愛的音樂。","explanation":"名詞「立體聲設備」。"},{"sentence":"The party was very loud because the teenagers had turned the <target>stereo</target> up to the maximum volume.","translation":"派對非常吵鬧，因為青少年們將音響的音量調到了最大。","explanation":"名詞「音響」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"stingy","explanation":"形容詞「吝嗇的、小氣的」。常用於描述人對金錢或資源不願分享。反義詞為 generous (大方的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite being a millionaire, he is so <target>stingy</target> that he refuses to tip the waiter even a small amount of money.","translation":"儘管是一位百萬富翁，他如此吝嗇，以至於即使是少量的錢也不願給服務生小費。","explanation":"形容詞「吝嗇的」。"},{"sentence":"The company was criticized for being <target>stingy</target> <pattern>with</pattern> its budget for employee training and professional development.","translation":"公司因在員工培訓和專業發展的預算上過於吝嗇而受到批評。","explanation":"形容詞「吝嗇的」。常用搭配 stingy with sth。"},{"sentence":"My brother is not <target>stingy</target> with his time; he always spends hours helping me with my difficult English homework.","translation":"我的哥哥對時間並不吝嗇；他總是花好幾個小時幫我做困難的英文作業。","explanation":"形容詞「吝嗇的」。此處指對時間或精力的慷慨。"}],"related_forms":["stinginess"]}

{"headword":"stocking","explanation":"名詞「長襪、絲襪」。通常以複數形式 stockings 出現，指覆蓋到大腿或膝蓋以上的襪子。","entries":[{"sentence":"She noticed a small hole in her <target>stockings</target> just before the graduation ceremony started, which made her feel very embarrassed.","translation":"在畢業典禮開始前，她注意到她的絲襪上有個小洞，這讓她感到非常尷尬。","explanation":"名詞「絲襪」。通常用複數。"},{"sentence":"During the winter, children often hang their <target>stockings</target> by the fireplace, hoping that Santa Claus will fill them with gifts.","translation":"冬天時，孩子們經常將長襪掛在壁爐旁，希望聖誕老人會在裡面填滿禮物。","explanation":"名詞「長襪」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"strengthen","explanation":"動詞「加強、強化」。常用搭配 strengthen the relationship (加強關係), strengthen the muscles (強化肌肉), strengthen the argument (增強論點)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two countries signed a trade agreement to <target>strengthen</target> their economic <pattern>ties</pattern> and promote mutual cooperation.","translation":"兩國簽署了一項貿易協定，以加強經濟聯繫並促進相互合作。","explanation":"動詞「加強」。常用搭配 strengthen ties。"},{"sentence":"To <target>strengthen</target> her leg muscles after the injury, the athlete followed a strict exercise plan designed by a professional therapist.","translation":"為了在受傷後強化腿部肌肉，這位運動員遵循了由專業治療師設計的嚴格運動計畫。","explanation":"動詞「強化」。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer presented new evidence in court to <target>strengthen</target> his <pattern>case</pattern> and prove the defendant's innocence.","translation":"律師在法庭上提交了新證據以加強他的論點並證明被告的清白。","explanation":"動詞「加強」。常用搭配 strengthen a case (加強論點/案情)。"}],"related_forms":["strength","strong"]}

{"headword":"stripe","explanation":"名詞「條紋」。指長條形的色彩或圖案。常用於描述動物皮毛、衣服或國旗。","entries":[{"sentence":"The zebra is easily recognized by the black and white <target>stripes</target> on its body, which help it hide in the tall grass.","translation":"斑馬很容易透過其身體上的黑白條紋而被辨識，這有助於它在長草中隱藏。","explanation":"名詞「條紋」。"},{"sentence":"The American flag features thirteen red and white <target>stripes</target>, representing the original thirteen colonies of the United States.","translation":"美國國旗上有十三條紅白條紋，代表美國最初的十三個殖民地。","explanation":"名詞「條紋」。"},{"sentence":"She wore a blue and white <target>striped</target> shirt to the beach, which made her look fresh and energetic in the sunlight.","translation":"她穿著一件藍白條紋的襯衫去海邊，讓她在陽光下看起來清新且充滿活力。","explanation":"形容詞用法。striped 為 stripe 的形容詞形式，意為「有條紋的」。"}],"related_forms":["striped"]}

{"headword":"strive","explanation":"動詞「努力、奮鬥」。常用片語 strive for (追求/努力獲得), strive to V (努力做某事)。這是一個較正式的詞彙，比 try 更有決心和持久性。","entries":[{"sentence":"All students should <target>strive</target> <pattern>to</pattern> achieve their full potential and never give up on their goals, regardless of the challenges.","translation":"所有學生都應努力發揮其全部潛能，無論面臨什麼挑戰，永遠不要放棄他們的目標。","explanation":"動詞片語 strive to V 意為「努力做某事」。"},{"sentence":"The international community continues to <target>strive</target> <pattern>for</pattern> world peace and the complete elimination of poverty in developing nations.","translation":"國際社會繼續努力追求世界和平以及在發展中國家完全消除貧困。","explanation":"動詞片語 strive for sth 意為「追求/努力獲得某事」。"},{"sentence":"Despite the limited resources, the small startup company <target>strove</target> to provide the highest quality service to its clients.","translation":"儘管資源有限，這家小型創業公司仍努力向客戶提供最高品質的服務。","explanation":"動詞「努力」。此處為 strive 的過去式 strove。"}],"related_forms":["striving"]}

{"headword":"stroke","explanation":"名詞可指「中風」、「敲擊/拍打」或「筆劃」；動詞指「輕撫」。常考用法：a stroke of luck (意外的好運)。注意區分中風 (medical condition) 與輕撫 (gentle touch) 的意義。","entries":[{"sentence":"The elderly man was rushed to the hospital after he suffered a <target>stroke</target>, which affected his ability to speak clearly.","translation":"這位老人中風後被緊急送往醫院，這影響了他清晰說話的能力。","explanation":"名詞「中風」。指腦血管問題導致的醫療狀況。"},{"sentence":"The artist carefully painted every <target>stroke</target> of the brush to create a realistic portrait of the old woman.","translation":"藝術家仔細地畫每一筆，以創造出這位老婦人的寫實肖像。","explanation":"名詞「筆劃/筆觸」。指繪畫或書寫時的一筆。"},{"sentence":"The child felt calm and happy when her father began to <target>stroke</target> her hair gently before she fell asleep.","translation":"孩子在父親在她睡前輕輕撫摸她的頭髮時感到平靜和快樂。","explanation":"動詞「輕撫」。指用手溫柔地撫摸。"},{"sentence":"Winning the scholarship was a <pattern>stroke</pattern> <target>of</target> <pattern>luck</pattern> for the poor student, as it allowed him to attend a top university.","translation":"贏得獎學金對這個貧窮的學生來說是意外的好運，因為這讓他能就讀頂尖大學。","explanation":"名詞片語 a stroke of luck 意為「意外的好運」。"}],"related_forms":["strokes"]}

{"headword":"submarine","explanation":"名詞「潛水艇」；形容詞「海底的」。作為形容詞時，常用於描述海底的地形或生態，如 submarine cables (海底電纜) 或 submarine volcanoes (海底火山)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The navy deployed a nuclear-powered <target>submarine</target> to monitor underwater activities and protect the national borders from threats.","translation":"海軍部署了一艘核動力潛水艇以監控水下活動並保護國家邊界免受威脅。","explanation":"名詞「潛水艇」。"},{"sentence":"Scientists use special equipment to study <target>submarine</target> <pattern>volcanoes</pattern>, which can cause tsunamis if they erupt under the ocean floor.","translation":"科學家使用特殊設備來研究海底火山，如果它們在海底爆發，可能會引起海嘯。","explanation":"形容詞「海底的」。常用搭配：submarine volcanoes (海底火山)。"}],"related_forms":["submarines"]}

{"headword":"sue","explanation":"動詞「起訴、控告」。指透過法律途徑要求賠償或解決爭議。常用搭配：sue someone for something (因某事起訴某人)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The customer decided to <target>sue</target> the company <pattern>for</pattern> <pattern>damages</pattern> after the faulty product caused a serious injury to his hand.","translation":"在故障產品導致他的手嚴重受傷後，該顧客決定起訴該公司要求賠償。","explanation":"動詞「起訴」。常用片語 sue someone for damages 表示「起訴某人要求賠償」。"},{"sentence":"The famous actor threatened to <target>sue</target> the newspaper <pattern>for</pattern> <pattern>defamation</pattern> because the article contained several false accusations about his private life.","translation":"這位著名演員威脅要起訴該報社誹謗，因為文章包含幾項關於他私生活的虛假指控。","explanation":"動詞「起訴」。常用搭配：sue for defamation (因誹謗而起訴)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"suggestion","explanation":"名詞「建議」。常用片語：make a suggestion (提出建議)。注意與 advice (不可數名詞) 的區別：suggestion 常用於提出一個可能的想法或選項，而 advice 則較為正式且具備指導性的建議。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher listened to the students' <target>suggestions</target> <pattern>on</pattern> how to organize the school festival to make it more enjoyable for everyone.","translation":"老師聽取了學生們關於如何組織學校祭典以使其對每個人都更有趣的建議。","explanation":"名詞「建議」。常用搭配：suggestion on/about sth。"},{"sentence":"If you are not sure which book to choose for the report, I can <pattern>make</pattern> a <target>suggestion</target> based on your interests.","translation":"如果你不確定選擇哪本書來寫報告，我可以根據你的興趣提出一個建議。","explanation":"名詞「建議」。常用片語 make a suggestion 意為「提出建議」。"}],"related_forms":["suggest"]}

{"headword":"summarize","explanation":"動詞「總結、概括」。指將長篇文章或演講的重點提取出來。常用搭配：summarize the main points (總結要點)。","entries":[{"sentence":"At the end of the presentation, the student <target>summarized</target> the <pattern>main</pattern> <pattern>points</pattern> of her research to ensure the audience understood the core message.","translation":"在簡報結束時，該學生總結了她研究的要點，以確保聽眾理解核心訊息。","explanation":"動詞「總結」。常用搭配：summarize the main points (總結要點)。"},{"sentence":"The professor asked the students to <target>summarize</target> the story in three sentences, focusing only on the most important events of the plot.","translation":"教授要求學生用三句話總結故事，僅專注於情節中最重要的事情。","explanation":"動詞「總結」。指將複雜資訊簡化為重點。"}],"related_forms":["summary","summarization"]}

{"headword":"surgeon","explanation":"名詞「外科醫生」。指專門從事手術治療的醫療專業人員。注意與 physician (內科醫生) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>surgeon</target> spent several hours in the operating room carefully removing the tumor from the patient's brain without causing any damage.","translation":"外科醫生在手術室裡花了好幾個小時，小心地從病人的大腦中切除腫瘤而沒有造成任何損害。","explanation":"名詞「外科醫生」。"},{"sentence":"After the accident, the patient was grateful to the <target>surgeon</target> who performed the complex operation that saved his life.","translation":"事故發生後，病人對那位執行複雜手術並救了他一命的外科醫生深表感激。","explanation":"名詞「外科醫生」。常用搭配：perform an operation (執行手術)。"}],"related_forms":["surgeons"]}

{"headword":"surgery","explanation":"名詞「手術」或「外科診所」。在 GSAT 中，通常指「手術」這一醫療行為。常用搭配：undergo surgery (接受手術), perform surgery (執行手術)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The athlete had to <pattern>undergo</pattern> <target>surgery</target> on his knee to repair the torn ligament, which meant he could not play for six months.","translation":"這位運動員必須接受膝蓋手術以修復撕裂的韌帶，這意味著他六個月內無法比賽。","explanation":"名詞「手術」。常用片語 undergo surgery 表示「接受手術」。"},{"sentence":"The doctors decided that <target>surgery</target> was the only way to treat the disease, so they scheduled the operation for the following Monday.","translation":"醫生決定手術是治療該疾病的唯一方法，因此他們將手術安排在下週一。","explanation":"名詞「手術」。指醫療上的切開治療。"},{"sentence":"The lead doctor carefully <pattern>performed</pattern> the <target>surgery</target> using a new robotic tool that allowed for greater precision and smaller scars.","translation":"主治醫生使用一種新型機器人工具執行了手術，這使得精度更高且疤痕更小。","explanation":"名詞「手術」。常用片語 perform surgery 表示「執行手術」。"}],"related_forms":["surgical"]}

{"headword":"surrender","explanation":"動詞「投降、放棄」；名詞「投降」。常用片語：surrender to (向...投降)。指在衝突或競爭中承認失敗並停止抵抗。","entries":[{"sentence":"After being surrounded by the enemy army for three days, the soldiers finally decided to <target>surrender</target> <pattern>to</pattern> their opponents to avoid more deaths.","translation":"在被敵軍包圍三天後，士兵們終於決定向對手投降，以避免更多死亡。","explanation":"動詞「投降」。常用片語 surrender to sth/sb 表示「向...投降」。"},{"sentence":"The criminal tried to run away from the police, but he eventually <target>surrendered</target> after realizing that there was no way to escape.","translation":"犯罪分子試圖逃離警察，但他在意識到沒有逃跑路徑後最終投降了。","explanation":"動詞「投降」。指承認失敗並停止抵抗。"},{"sentence":"The general's decision to <target>surrender</target> was seen as a strategic move to save the lives of thousands of wounded soldiers.","translation":"將軍決定投降被視為一種策略性舉措，以挽救數千名受傷士兵的生命。","explanation":"名詞「投降」。在此句中，surrender 是動詞原形，但作為名詞時，指投降這一行為。"}],"related_forms":["surrendered"]}

{"headword":"surroundings","explanation":"名詞「環境、周圍的事物」。通常以複數形式出現。指一個人或事物周圍的物理環境，如 natural surroundings (自然環境)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students felt peaceful and relaxed when they studied in their natural <target>surroundings</target>, far away from the noise of the city.","translation":"學生們在自然環境中學習時感到平靜和放鬆，遠離城市的喧囂。","explanation":"名詞「環境」。指周圍的物理空間。"},{"sentence":"A new student often takes some time to get used to his new <target>surroundings</target> before he feels completely comfortable in the classroom.","translation":"新學生通常需要一些時間來適應新環境，之前他才會在教室裡感到完全舒適。","explanation":"名詞「環境」。常用搭配：get used to one's surroundings。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"suspicious","explanation":"形容詞「可疑的、多疑的」。指認為某事不正常或某人不可信。常用搭配：be suspicious of (對...感到可疑)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The security guard became <target>suspicious</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the man who was wearing a heavy coat in the middle of a hot summer day.","translation":"保全人員對那個在盛夏時節穿著厚外套的男人感到可疑。","explanation":"形容詞「可疑的」。常用片語 be suspicious of sb/sth 表示「對...感到可疑」。"},{"sentence":"The police found a <target>suspicious</target> <pattern>package</pattern> left alone in the train station, so they called the bomb squad to investigate the area.","translation":"警察在火車站發現了一個被遺留的可疑包裹，因此他們請炸彈處理小組來調查該區域。","explanation":"形容詞「可疑的」。常用搭配：suspicious package (可疑包裹)。"},{"sentence":"She was <target>suspicious</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the email's offer of a free vacation, believing it was likely a scam to steal her personal information.","translation":"她對電子郵件中提供免費度假的提議感到可疑，認為這很可能是偷取她個人資訊的詐騙。","explanation":"形容詞「多疑的」。指對某事持有懷疑態度。"}],"related_forms":["suspicion","suspiciously"]}

{"headword":"sway","explanation":"動詞「搖擺、影響」；名詞「影響力」。動詞用法常指物理上的搖擺或心理上的影響（例如 sway someone's opinion）。名詞常用於片語 sway over something (對...有影響力)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tall trees <target>swayed</target> gently <pattern>in</pattern> the breeze, creating a peaceful atmosphere in the quiet countryside village.","translation":"高大的樹木在微風中輕輕搖擺，在安靜的鄉村村莊中營造出寧靜的氛圍。","explanation":"動詞「搖擺」。描述物理上的擺動。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer's powerful arguments were enough to <target>sway</target> the jury's <pattern>opinion</pattern> and lead them to a not-guilty verdict.","translation":"律師強而有力的論點足以影響陪審團的看法，並引導他們做出無罪判決。","explanation":"動詞「影響」。指改變某人的想法或決定。"},{"sentence":"For many years, the ancient religion held a strong <target>sway</target> <pattern>over</pattern> the local people's beliefs and daily customs.","translation":"多年來，這個古老的宗教對當地人的信仰和日常習俗具有強大的影響力。","explanation":"名詞「影響力」。常用搭配 sway over sth。"}],"related_forms":["sways","swayed","swaying"]}

{"headword":"syllable","explanation":"名詞「音節」。語言學基本術語，指一個單詞中由一個元音音素構成的發音單位。","entries":[{"sentence":"The English teacher asked the students to break the long word <pattern>into</pattern> <target>syllables</target> to make it easier to pronounce correctly.","translation":"英文老師要求學生將長單詞分解成音節，以便更容易正確發音。","explanation":"名詞「音節」。常用搭配 break into syllables。"},{"sentence":"The word 'education' has four <target>syllables</target>, which helps students understand the rhythm and stress of the word when speaking.","translation":" 'Education' 這個詞有四個音節，這有助於學生在說話時理解該詞的節奏和重音。","explanation":"名詞「音節」。"}],"related_forms":["syllables"]}

{"headword":"sympathetic","explanation":"形容詞「同情的、共鳴的」。常用於描述對他人的痛苦或困境表示理解和支持。注意與 sympathetic (共鳴的) 區分，以及名詞形式 sympathy。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher was very <target>sympathetic</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the student's struggle with the difficult project, offering extra help and guidance.","translation":"老師對學生在困難專案中的掙扎非常同情，提供了額外的幫助和指導。","explanation":"形容詞「同情的」。常用搭配 sympathetic to someone/something。"},{"sentence":"When my best friend lost her pet, I tried to be <target>sympathetic</target> and listen to her feelings without judging her.","translation":"當我最好的朋友失去她的寵物時，我試著表示同情，在不評判她的情況下傾聽她的感受。","explanation":"形容詞「同情的」。指對他人的不幸表示理解。"}],"related_forms":["sympathetically","sympathy"]}

{"headword":"sympathy","explanation":"名詞「同情、共鳴」。指對他人痛苦的理解和分享。常見片語 have sympathy for (同情...), feel sympathy for (對...感到同情)。","entries":[{"sentence":"I have deep <target>sympathy</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the victims of the earthquake, who lost their homes and families in a matter of seconds.","translation":"我對地震災民深感同情，他們在短短幾秒鐘內失去了家園和家人。","explanation":"名詞「同情」。常用搭配 have sympathy for sth/sb。"},{"sentence":"The community showed great <target>sympathy</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the family after the tragic accident, providing food and emotional support during the hard times.","translation":"社區在悲劇事故後對該家庭表現出極大的同情，提供食物並在困難時期提供情感支持。","explanation":"名詞「同情」。"}],"related_forms":["sympathetic"]}

{"headword":"systematic","explanation":"形容詞「有系統的、有條理的」。指按照一定計畫或方法逐步進行的事物。注意與 systemic (系統性的，指影響整個系統的) 區分。","entries":[{"sentence":"The researchers conducted a <target>systematic</target> <pattern>review</pattern> of all existing literature to ensure that no important data was overlooked.","translation":"研究人員對所有現有文獻進行了系統性的回顧，以確保沒有遺漏任何重要數據。","explanation":"形容詞「有系統的」。常用搭配 systematic review (系統性回顧)。"},{"sentence":"To improve his grades, the student developed a <target>systematic</target> <pattern>approach</pattern> to studying, creating a detailed schedule for every subject.","translation":"為了提高成績，該學生制定了一套有系統的學習方法，為每個科目建立了詳細的日程表。","explanation":"形容詞「有條理的」。常用搭配 systematic approach (有系統的方法)。"},{"sentence":"The police used a <target>systematic</target> <pattern>search</pattern> of the forest to find the missing hiker, dividing the area into small sections.","translation":"警察對森林進行了有系統的搜索，將該區域分成小區域，以尋找失蹤的徒步旅行者。","explanation":"形容詞「有系統的」。常用搭配 systematic search (系統性搜索)。"}],"related_forms":["systematically","system"]}

{"headword":"technician","explanation":"名詞「技術員、技師」。指經過專業訓練，負責操作或維修設備的人員。","entries":[{"sentence":"When the school's computer network crashed, the IT <target>technician</target> worked quickly to restore the connection for all the students.","translation":"當學校的電腦網路崩潰時，IT 技術員迅速工作以恢復所有學生的連線。","explanation":"名詞「技術員」。指負責電腦維修的人員。"},{"sentence":"The lab <target>technician</target> carefully prepared the chemicals and equipment for the biology experiment, ensuring everything was safe and ready.","translation":"實驗室技師小心地準備了生物實驗的化學藥品和設備，確保一切安全且就緒。","explanation":"名詞「技師」。指在實驗室中協助的人員。"}],"related_forms":["technicians"]}

{"headword":"technological","explanation":"形容詞「科技的、技術的」。常用於描述與科技發展相關的事物，如 technological progress (科技進步) 或 technological innovation (科技創新)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The rapid <target>technological</target> <pattern>advancements</pattern> in the last decade have completely changed how people communicate and work in the modern world.","translation":"過去十年中快速的科技進步完全改變了現代人溝通和工作的方式。","explanation":"形容詞「科技的」。常用搭配 technological advancements (科技進步)。"},{"sentence":"Many companies invest heavily in <target>technological</target> <pattern>innovation</pattern> to stay competitive and create more efficient products for their customers.","translation":"許多公司投入大量資金進行科技創新，以保持競爭力並為客戶創造更高效的產品。","explanation":"形容詞「技術的」。常用搭配 technological innovation (科技創新)。"}],"related_forms":["technology","technologically"]}

{"headword":"telegraph","explanation":"名詞「電報」；動詞「發電報」。雖然在現代較少使用，但在閱讀歷史文章中常出現。注意其衍生詞 telephone (電話)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Before the invention of the internet, people used the <target>telegraph</target> to send urgent messages across long distances in a few minutes.","translation":"在互聯網發明之前，人們使用電報在幾分鐘內將緊急訊息發送到長距離之外。","explanation":"名詞「電報」。"},{"sentence":"The general decided to <target>telegraph</target> the news of the victory to the capital immediately after the battle ended.","translation":"將軍決定在戰鬥結束後立即將勝利的消息以電報發送到首都。","explanation":"動詞「發電報」。"}],"related_forms":["telegraphed","telegraphing"]}

{"headword":"telescope","explanation":"名詞「望遠鏡」。指用於觀察遙遠物體（尤其是天文物體）的光學設備。","entries":[{"sentence":"Using a powerful <target>telescope</target>, the astronomy student was able to see the craters of the moon and the rings of Saturn.","translation":"使用強大的望遠鏡，天文學學生能夠看到月球的坑洞和土星環。","explanation":"名詞「望遠鏡」。"}],"related_forms":["telescopes"]}

{"headword":"tendency","explanation":"名詞「傾向、趨勢」。指某人或某事在特定情況下容易發生或表現出的傾向。常用片語 have a tendency to (傾向於...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Some students <pattern>have</pattern> a <target>tendency</target> <pattern>to</pattern> procrastinate, leaving their big assignments until the very last night before the deadline.","translation":"有些學生傾向於拖延，將其大型作業留到截止日期前的最後一個晚上。","explanation":"名詞「傾向」。片語 have a tendency to V 表示「傾向於做某事」。"},{"sentence":"Recent data shows a growing <target>tendency</target> <pattern>for</pattern> young people to move from rural areas to big cities for better jobs.","translation":"最近的數據顯示，年輕人從農村地區搬到大城市尋找更好工作的趨勢日益增長。","explanation":"名詞「傾向/趨勢」。常用搭配 tendency for someone to do sth。"},{"sentence":"The weather in this region <pattern>has</pattern> a <target>tendency</target> <pattern>to</pattern> change quickly, so it is always a good idea to carry an umbrella.","translation":"這個地區的天氣傾向於快速變化，所以隨身攜帶一把傘總是個好主意。","explanation":"名詞「傾向」。指事物容易發生的狀態。"}],"related_forms":["tendencies"]}

{"headword":"tense","explanation":"形容詞表示「緊張的、緊繃的」；動詞表示「使緊張」。在文法中，tense 也指「時態」。注意區分 tense (緊張的) 與 intense (強烈的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The atmosphere in the classroom became <target>tense</target> as the students waited for the teacher to announce the final exam results.","translation":"當學生們等待老師公布期末考成績時，教室裡的氣氛變得緊張。","explanation":"形容詞「緊張的」。描述人的情緒或環境氣氛。"},{"sentence":"After working at the computer for eight hours, he felt his shoulder muscles become <target>tense</target>, so he decided to take a short break.","translation":"長時間在電腦前工作八小時後，他感覺到肩膀肌肉變得緊繃，於是決定稍作休息。","explanation":"形容詞「緊繃的」。描述身體肌肉的狀態。"},{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to identify the <target>tense</target> of the verb in the sentence to check if they understood the grammar rules.","translation":"老師要求學生辨識句子中動詞的時態，以檢查他們是否理解文法規則。","explanation":"名詞「時態」。指語言中表示時間的文法形式。"},{"sentence":"The coach tried to <target>tense</target> the rope tightly to ensure the equipment was secure before the race began.","translation":"教練試圖將繩子拉緊，以確保比賽開始前設備穩固。","explanation":"動詞「使緊張/拉緊」。"}],"related_forms":["tensed","tensing"]}

{"headword":"tension","explanation":"名詞「緊張、壓力、張力」。常用搭配：ease the tension (緩解緊張), under tension (在壓力下)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The joke told by the teacher helped to <pattern>ease</pattern> the <target>tension</target> in the room, making the students feel more relaxed and comfortable.","translation":"老師講的笑話有助於緩解房間裡的緊張氣氛，讓學生們感到更輕鬆舒適。","explanation":"名詞「緊張氣氛」。常用搭配 ease the tension。"},{"sentence":"There was a great deal of <target>tension</target> <pattern>between</pattern> the two countries over the dispute about the border, leading to a diplomatic crisis.","translation":"兩國之間因邊境爭議而存在巨大的緊張關係，導致外交危機。","explanation":"名詞「緊張關係」。常用搭配 tension between A and B。"},{"sentence":"The engineer checked the <target>tension</target> of the bridge cables to ensure they could support the weight of the heavy traffic.","translation":"工程師檢查了橋樑鋼纜的張力，以確保它們能承受沉重交通的重量。","explanation":"名詞「張力」。指物理上的拉力。"}],"related_forms":["tensions"]}

{"headword":"terror","explanation":"名詞「恐怖、恐懼」。常用於指極度的恐懼感。注意與 horror (驚恐) 的區別：terror 通常指對未來可能發生之事的恐懼，而 horror 則是指對眼前已發生之令人厭惡之事的驚恐。","entries":[{"sentence":"The loud noise from the explosion filled the children with <target>terror</target>, causing them to scream and run for cover immediately.","translation":"爆炸產生的巨大噪音讓孩子們充滿了恐懼，導致他們立刻尖叫並尋找掩體。","explanation":"名詞「恐怖、恐懼」。指極度的恐懼感。"},{"sentence":"The movie was a masterpiece of <target>terror</target>, using dark music and sudden sounds to create a scary atmosphere throughout the film.","translation":"這部電影是一部恐怖傑作，運用陰暗的音樂和突然的聲音在整部電影中營造出恐怖的氣氛。","explanation":"名詞「恐怖」。指恐怖電影或文學的類型。"},{"sentence":"Many people lived in <target>terror</target> <pattern>of</pattern> losing their jobs during the economic crisis, as they had no other way to earn money.","translation":"經濟危機期間，許多人生活在失去工作的恐懼之中，因為他們沒有其他賺錢的途徑。","explanation":"名詞「恐懼」。常用片語 live in terror of sth。"}],"related_forms":["terrible","terrified","terrifying"]}

{"headword":"theme","explanation":"名詞「主題」。常用於討論文章、音樂、電影或討論會的主題。注意與 topic (話題) 的區別：theme 傾向於指整體的主旨或核心理念，而 topic 則是指討論的具體項目。","entries":[{"sentence":"The main <target>theme</target> of the novel is the importance of friendship and courage, which is clearly shown through the characters' actions.","translation":"這部小說的主題是友誼與勇氣的重要性，這透過角色們的行動清楚地展現出來。","explanation":"名詞「主題」。指作品的核心理念。"},{"sentence":"For the upcoming school festival, the student council decided that the <target>theme</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the party would be \"Sustainable Living\".","translation":"為了即將到來的學校祭典，學生會決定派對的主題將是「永續生活」。","explanation":"名詞「主題」。指活動的特定風格或方向。"},{"sentence":"The composer wrote a recurring <target>theme</target> in the symphony to represent the hero's journey, which the audience could easily recognize.","translation":"作曲家在交響曲中寫了一個重複出現的主題，以代表英雄的旅程，這讓聽眾能輕易辨識。","explanation":"名詞「主題」。指音樂中的主旋律。"}],"related_forms":["thematic"]}

{"headword":"thorough","explanation":"形容詞「徹底的、詳盡的」。常用搭配：a thorough investigation (徹底的調查), conduct a thorough search (進行詳盡的搜尋)。注意與 through (穿過) 和 throughout (遍及) 的拼寫區分。","entries":[{"sentence":"The detective conducted a <target>thorough</target> <pattern>investigation</pattern> of the crime scene, making sure not to miss any small pieces of evidence.","translation":"偵探對犯罪現場進行了徹底的調查，確保沒有遺漏任何微小的證據。","explanation":"形容詞「徹底的」。常用搭配 thorough investigation。"},{"sentence":"Before submitting the final report, you should do a <target>thorough</target> <pattern>review</pattern> of your work to correct any spelling errors.","translation":"在提交最終報告之前，應該對你的作品進行詳盡的檢查，以修正任何拼寫錯誤。","explanation":"形容詞「詳盡的」。常用搭配 thorough review。"},{"sentence":"She gave the room a <target>thorough</target> <pattern>cleaning</pattern> before the guests arrived, leaving the floor sparkling clean and without any dust.","translation":"在客人到達之前，她將房間徹底清理了一遍，讓地板光亮如新且沒有任何灰塵。","explanation":"形容詞「徹底的」。常用搭配 thorough cleaning。"}],"related_forms":["thoroughly"]}

{"headword":"thoughtful","explanation":"形容詞「體貼的、深思熟慮的」。常用搭配：a thoughtful gift (一份體貼的禮物), a thoughtful analysis (深思熟慮的分析)。","entries":[{"sentence":"It was very <target>thoughtful</target> of you to bring some flowers for the sick student in the hospital, which really cheered her up.","translation":"你能為住院的病學生帶來一些花，真是非常體貼，這讓她心情好多了。","explanation":"形容詞「體貼的」。指考慮到他人的需求或感受。"},{"sentence":"The professor provided a <target>thoughtful</target> <pattern>analysis</pattern> of the political situation, helping students understand the complex causes of the conflict.","translation":"教授對政治局勢提供了深思熟慮的分析，幫助學生理解衝突的複雜原因。","explanation":"形容詞「深思熟慮的」。指經過仔細考慮的。"},{"sentence":"After a long period of <target>thoughtful</target> <pattern>consideration</pattern>, she decided to apply for the scholarship to study art in France.","translation":"經過長時間的深思熟慮，她決定申請獎學金去法國學習藝術。","explanation":"形容詞「深思熟慮的」。常用搭配 thoughtful consideration。"}],"related_forms":["thoughtfully"]}

{"headword":"tickle","explanation":"動詞「使癢、逗笑」；名詞「癢感」。常用片語 tickle someone's fancy (吸引某人的興趣)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The little girl couldn't stop laughing when her father started to <target>tickle</target> her under the arms, which was very funny.","translation":"當父親開始抓她的腋下使她發癢時，小女孩忍不住大笑，這非常有趣。","explanation":"動詞「使癢」。指用手指輕觸皮膚導致發癢。"},{"sentence":"The comedian's jokes were designed to <target>tickle</target> the audience's sense of humor, making everyone in the theater laugh out loud.","translation":"喜劇演員的笑話旨在逗笑觀眾的幽默感，讓劇院裡的每個人都大聲笑起來。","explanation":"動詞「逗笑」。指使人感到有趣或好笑。"},{"sentence":"Among all the options for the graduation trip, the idea of visiting the beach <target>tickled</target> <pattern>her fancy</pattern>, as she loved the ocean.","translation":"在畢業旅行的所有選項中，去海邊的主意吸引了她的興趣，因為她熱愛大海。","explanation":"動詞片語 tickle someone's fancy 表示「吸引某人的興趣」。"}],"related_forms":["tickles","tickling"]}

{"headword":"timetable","explanation":"名詞「時間表、課表」。常用搭配：follow a strict timetable (遵循嚴格的時間表), stick to the timetable (堅持執行時間表)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Students must <pattern>follow</pattern> a strict <target>timetable</target> during the final exam week to ensure they have enough time to study all subjects.","translation":"學生在期末考週期間必須遵循嚴格的時間表，以確保他們有足夠的時間學習所有科目。","explanation":"名詞「時間表」。指預定活動的計劃。"},{"sentence":"The train <target>timetable</target> showed that the express train to Taipei would arrive at the station every hour on the dot.","translation":"火車時間表顯示，開往台北的快車每小時準時到達車站。","explanation":"名詞「時間表」。指交通工具的發車時間。"},{"sentence":"The teacher announced a change in the class <target>timetable</target>, moving the English lesson to Monday morning instead of Friday afternoon.","translation":"老師宣布了課表變更，將英文課改到週一早上而不是週五下午。","explanation":"名詞「課表」。指學校課程的安排。"}],"related_forms":["timetables"]}

{"headword":"timid","explanation":"形容詞「膽小的、羞怯的」。常用反義詞：bold, confident。注意與 shy 的區別：shy 傾向於指對陌生人的害羞，而 timid 則強調缺乏勇氣或自信心。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>timid</target> kitten hid under the sofa when the guests arrived, as it was too scared to approach the strangers.","translation":"當客人到達時，這隻膽小的幼貓躲在沙發下，因為它太害怕而不敢靠近陌生人。","explanation":"形容詞「膽小的」。描述動物或人的缺乏勇氣。"},{"sentence":"Although he was a <target>timid</target> student in class, he became very confident and loud when he spoke about his favorite hobby, coding.","translation":"雖然他在課上是一個羞怯的學生，但當他談到他最喜歡的愛好——寫程式時，他變得非常自信且大聲。","explanation":"形容詞「羞怯的」。描述性格上的缺乏自信。"},{"sentence":"The teacher encouraged the <target>timid</target> students to <pattern>speak up</pattern> and share their ideas, helping them build their self-confidence over time.","translation":"老師鼓勵那些膽小的學生大聲說出並分享他們的想法，幫助他們隨著時間建立自信心。","explanation":"形容詞「羞怯的」。常用搭配 speak up (大聲說出/表達)。"}],"related_forms":["timidly","timidness"]}

{"headword":"tolerable","explanation":"形容詞「可忍受的、尚可的」。常用搭配：barely tolerable (勉強可忍受的)。注意與 tolerant (寬容的) 的區別：tolerable 指的是事情或情況可被忍受，而 tolerant 指的是人對不同觀點或行為的寬容。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although the hotel room was very small and old, the noise from the street was <target>tolerable</target>, so they stayed there for a week.","translation":"雖然旅館房間很小且舊，但街道上的噪音在可忍受範圍內，所以他們在那裡住了一週。","explanation":"形容詞「可忍受的」。指噪音、疼痛等不適感在可接受範圍內。"},{"sentence":"The weather in the mountains was cold, but with a heavy jacket, the temperature became <target>tolerable</target> for the hiking group.","translation":"山上的天氣很冷，但穿上厚外套後，溫度對登山隊來說變成了可忍受的。","explanation":"形容詞「可忍受的」。指環境條件可被承受。"},{"sentence":"The student's performance in the music competition was <target>tolerable</target>, but the judges felt he needed more practice to reach a professional level.","translation":"這個學生在音樂比賽中的表現尚可，但評審認為他需要更多練習才能達到專業水準。","explanation":"形容詞「尚可的」。指品質或能力處於中等且可接受的程度。"}],"related_forms":["tolerate","tolerance","tolerably"]}

{"headword":"tolerance","explanation":"名詞，意為「寬容」或「耐受力」。在社交語境中指對不同意見或信仰的包容；在生物或醫學語境中指對疼痛、藥物或環境（如溫度）的承受能力。","entries":[{"sentence":"Living in a diverse city requires a high level of <target>tolerance</target> <pattern>for</pattern> different cultural beliefs and lifestyles to maintain peace.","translation":"生活在一個多元的城市需要對不同的文化信仰和生活方式有高度的寬容，以維持和平。","explanation":"名詞「寬容」。常用搭配：tolerance for sth。"},{"sentence":"Some people have a higher <target>tolerance</target> <pattern>for</pattern> pain than others, which allows them to recover from surgery more easily.","translation":"有些人比其他人對疼痛的耐受力更高，這使他們能從手術中更容易恢復。","explanation":"名詞「耐受力」。指生理上的承受能力。"}],"related_forms":["tolerant","tolerate"]}

{"headword":"tolerant","explanation":"形容詞，意為「寬容的」或「耐受的」。常用搭配 be tolerant of (對...寬容)。注意與 tolerable (可忍受的) 之區別：tolerant 描述人的態度，而 tolerable 描述事情的程度。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher is very <target>tolerant</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the students' mistakes, encouraging them to learn from their errors rather than feeling discouraged.","translation":"這位老師對學生的錯誤非常寬容，鼓勵他們從錯誤中學習，而不是感到沮喪。","explanation":"形容詞「寬容的」。常用搭配：be tolerant of sb/sth。"},{"sentence":"Certain plants are more <target>tolerant</target> <pattern>of</pattern> drought, meaning they can survive in dry environments with very little water.","translation":"某些植物更耐乾旱，這意味著它們可以在水分極少的乾燥環境中生存。","explanation":"形容詞「耐受的」。指生物能適應惡劣環境。"}],"related_forms":["tolerance","tolerate"]}

{"headword":"tolerate","explanation":"動詞，意為「容忍」或「忍受」。指在不喜歡的情況下依然接受或容許某事發生。常用搭配 tolerate sth/sb。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school administration refuses to <target>tolerate</target> any form of bullying, as they believe every student deserves a safe learning environment.","translation":"學校行政部門拒絕容忍任何形式的霸凌，因為他們認為每個學生都應該擁有安全的學習環境。","explanation":"動詞「容忍」。常用搭配 tolerate + 名詞。"},{"sentence":"I cannot <target>tolerate</target> the loud noise from the construction site next door, which makes it impossible to concentrate on my studies.","translation":"我無法忍受鄰居工地傳來的巨大噪音，這使得我無法集中精神學習。","explanation":"動詞「忍受」。指對不快之事的承受。"}],"related_forms":["tolerance","tolerant"]}

{"headword":"tomb","explanation":"名詞，意為「墳墓」。通常指石製或宏偉的建築物，用於安放死者。","entries":[{"sentence":"Tourists from all over the world visit the ancient <target>tomb</target> of the pharaoh to admire the beautiful paintings on the walls.","translation":"來自世界各地的遊客參觀法老的古墳墓，以欣賞牆上美麗的壁畫。","explanation":"名詞「墳墓」。"},{"sentence":"Archaeologists carefully cleaned the dust from the royal <target>tomb</target> to uncover hidden treasures and learn about ancient burial customs.","translation":"考古學家小心地清理了皇家墳墓中的灰塵，以揭開隱藏的寶藏並了解古代的埋葬習俗。","explanation":"名詞「墳墓」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"tortoise","explanation":"名詞，意為「陸龜」。注意與 turtle (海龜/水龜) 的區別：tortoise 通常指在陸地上生活的龜類。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the famous fable, the <target>tortoise</target> wins the race against the fast hare by remaining steady and never giving up.","translation":"在著名的寓言中，陸龜通過保持穩定且永不放棄，贏得了與快兔的競賽。","explanation":"名詞「陸龜」。"},{"sentence":"Because <target>tortoises</target> move so slowly and have hard shells, they are often used as symbols of patience and longevity.","translation":"因為陸龜移動緩慢且有硬殼，它們經常被用作耐心和長壽的象徵。","explanation":"名詞「陸龜」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"torture","explanation":"名詞「酷刑、折磨」；動詞「折磨」。可用於生理上的劇烈疼痛，也可指心理上的極大壓力或痛苦。","entries":[{"sentence":"The prisoners were subjected to terrible <target>torture</target> to force them to reveal secret information about the enemy's plans.","translation":"囚犯們遭受了可怕的酷刑，以強迫他們透露關於敵人計劃的秘密資訊。","explanation":"名詞「酷刑」。指生理上的強迫手段。"},{"sentence":"Waiting for the final exam results for two weeks was absolute <target>torture</target> for the students, who were extremely anxious.","translation":"等待期末考成績兩週對學生來說簡直是極大的折磨，他們感到非常焦慮。","explanation":"名詞「折磨」。指心理上的痛苦。"},{"sentence":"The loud, screeching noise of the old alarm clock <target>tortures</target> me every single morning, waking me up in a harsh way.","translation":"舊鬧鐘刺耳的尖叫聲每天早上都折磨我，以一種粗暴的方式將我喚醒。","explanation":"動詞「折磨」。"}],"related_forms":["tortured"]}

{"headword":"tragedy","explanation":"名詞，意為「悲劇」。可用於文學形式（悲劇劇本）或現實生活中不幸、慘痛的事件。","entries":[{"sentence":"The sudden death of the young athlete was a great <target>tragedy</target> for the entire community, as he was loved by everyone.","translation":"這位年輕運動員的突然去世對整個社區來說是一個巨大的悲劇，因為他深受大家的喜愛。","explanation":"名詞「悲劇」。指不幸的事件。"},{"sentence":"Shakespeare's plays often explore the <target>tragedy</target> of human ambition, showing how pride can lead a person to their own downfall.","translation":"莎士比亞的劇作經常探討人類野心的悲劇，展示了傲慢如何導致一個人的沒落。","explanation":"名詞「悲劇」。指文學形式。"}],"related_forms":["tragic"]}

{"headword":"tragic","explanation":"形容詞，意為「悲劇性的」或「慘痛的」。常用於描述令人極度悲傷的事件、結果或處境。","entries":[{"sentence":"The news reported a <target>tragic</target> accident on the highway, where a car crashed into a tree, leaving three people injured.","translation":"新聞報導了高速公路上一場悲劇性的事故，一輛車撞上了一棵樹，導致三人受傷。","explanation":"形容詞「悲劇性的」。"},{"sentence":"It was a <target>tragic</target> mistake that the captain forgot to check the weather report, leading to the ship's disappearance in the storm.","translation":"船長忘了檢查天氣預報，導致船隻在風暴中失蹤，這是一個慘痛的錯誤。","explanation":"形容詞「慘痛的」。"}],"related_forms":["tragedy"]}

{"headword":"transfer","explanation":"名詞「轉移、調職、轉乘」；動詞「轉移、調職、轉乘」。常用搭配 transfer to (轉移至), transfer from...to... (從...轉移到...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The employee requested a <target>transfer</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the branch office in Tokyo to be closer to his family living there.","translation":"這名員工申請調職到東京的分公司，以便更接近住在在那裡的家人。","explanation":"名詞「調職」。常用搭配 transfer to。"},{"sentence":"To reach the city center, you need to <target>transfer</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the blue line <pattern>to</pattern> the red line at the central station.","translation":"要到達市中心，你需要從中央車站的藍線轉乘到紅線。","explanation":"動詞「轉乘」。常用搭配 transfer from...to...。"},{"sentence":"The bank allows customers to <target>transfer</target> funds <pattern>between</pattern> their different accounts using a simple mobile application.","translation":"銀行允許客戶使用簡單的手機應用程式在不同帳戶之間轉移資金。","explanation":"動詞「轉移」。指金錢的移動。"},{"sentence":"The student decided to <target>transfer</target> <pattern>to</pattern> another university in the autumn, seeking a more suitable major for his interests.","translation":"學生決定在秋天轉學到另一所大學，尋找更適合他興趣的專業。","explanation":"動詞「轉學」。"}],"related_forms":["transferred","transferring"]}

{"headword":"transform","explanation":"動詞，意為「改變」或「轉換」。指外觀、性質或形式發生顯著且通常是正面的重大改變（與 change 不同，transform 強調程度更深、完全的轉化）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new government policy aimed to <target>transform</target> the old industrial zone <pattern>into</pattern> a modern creative park for artists.","translation":"新政府政策旨在將舊工業區轉化為一個為藝術家設計的現代創意園區。","explanation":"動詞「轉化」。常用搭配 transform...into...。"},{"sentence":"With hard work and a positive attitude, she managed to <target>transform</target> her life <pattern>from</pattern> a struggling student <pattern>to</pattern> a successful entrepreneur.","translation":"憑藉著努力工作和積極的態度，她成功將自己的生活從一名掙扎的學生轉變為一名成功的企業家。","explanation":"動詞「轉變」。指身份或狀態的重大改變。"},{"sentence":"The caterpillar <target>transforms</target> <pattern>into</pattern> a beautiful butterfly after spending several weeks inside a hard protective cocoon.","translation":"毛蟲在堅硬的保護繭中度過數週後，轉化為一隻美麗的蝴蝶。","explanation":"動詞「轉化」。指生物形態的改變。"}],"related_forms":["transformation","transforming","transformed"]}

{"headword":"translate","explanation":"動詞「翻譯」。指將一種語言轉換為另一種語言。常用搭配：translate A into B (將 A 翻譯成 B)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student used a dictionary to <target>translate</target> the complex Latin phrases <pattern>into</pattern> simple English for her history project.","translation":"這名學生使用字典將複雜的拉丁語短語翻譯成簡單的英文，以便完成她的歷史專題。","explanation":"動詞「翻譯」。常用搭配：translate A into B。"},{"sentence":"Many professional writers find it challenging to <target>translate</target> their thoughts <pattern>into</pattern> clear and persuasive arguments in an essay.","translation":"許多專業作家發現將他們的想法翻譯成論文中清晰且有說服力的論點是一項挑戰。","explanation":"動詞「翻譯/轉換」。此處指將抽象想法轉換為具體文字。"},{"sentence":"Because the speech was delivered in French, the conference organizers provided a simultaneous <target>translator</target> to help international guests understand the talk.","translation":"因為演講是用法語發表的，會議組織者提供了一名同聲翻譯員來幫助國際賓客理解演講內容。","explanation":"動詞相關名詞 translator，指翻譯人員。"}],"related_forms":["translation","translator"]}

{"headword":"translation","explanation":"名詞「翻譯」。指翻譯的過程或翻譯後的結果（譯文）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>translation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the ancient text was so accurate that scholars could finally understand the true meaning of the laws.","translation":"這篇古文的翻譯如此準確，以至於學者們終於能理解這些法律的真正含義。","explanation":"名詞「翻譯」。指翻譯後的結果（譯文）。"},{"sentence":"Poor <target>translation</target> can often lead to misunderstandings between people from different cultures, which is why professional services are essential.","translation":"糟糕的翻譯經常導致來自不同文化的人之間產生誤會，這就是為什麼專業服務至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「翻譯」。指翻譯的行為或過程。"}],"related_forms":["translate","translator"]}

{"headword":"translator","explanation":"名詞「翻譯人員」。指從事翻譯工作的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The diplomat relied on a skilled <target>translator</target> to ensure that every word of the treaty was understood correctly by both parties.","translation":"外交官依靠一名熟練的翻譯員來確保條約的每個字都被雙方正確理解。","explanation":"名詞「翻譯人員」。"},{"sentence":"Working as a freelance <target>translator</target> allows her to work from home and choose projects that match her language skills.","translation":"作為一名自由翻譯員，她可以在家工作並選擇符合她語言技能的項目。","explanation":"名詞「翻譯人員」。"}],"related_forms":["translate","translation"]}

{"headword":"transportation","explanation":"名詞「運輸、交通」。指將人或貨物從一處移到另一處的系統或手段。常用搭配：public transportation (大眾運輸)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city government is investing in better <target>transportation</target> <pattern>systems</pattern> to reduce traffic congestion and encourage people to use buses and trains.","translation":"市政府正在投資更好的運輸系統，以減少交通擁堵並鼓勵人們使用巴士和火車。","explanation":"名詞「運輸、交通」。常用搭配：transportation systems。"},{"sentence":"Many students rely on public <target>transportation</target> to commute to school every day because they are not yet old enough to drive.","translation":"許多學生每天依靠大眾運輸工具通勤上學，因為他們還不夠大可以開車。","explanation":"名詞「交通」。常用搭配：public transportation (大眾運輸)。"},{"sentence":"Air <target>transportation</target> is the fastest way to move goods across the ocean, although it is much more expensive than shipping by sea.","translation":"航空運輸是跨洋運送貨物最快的方式，儘管它比海運昂貴得多。","explanation":"名詞「運輸」。指貨物運輸。"}],"related_forms":["transport"]}

{"headword":"tremble","explanation":"動詞「顫抖」；名詞「顫抖」。常用於描述因恐懼、寒冷或激動而產生的身體顫抖。常用搭配：tremble with fear/cold (因恐懼/寒冷而顫抖)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young student began to <target>tremble</target> <pattern>with</pattern> fear as he stood in front of the whole class to deliver his first speech.","translation":"這名年輕的學生站在全班面前發表他的第一次演講時，開始因恐懼而顫抖。","explanation":"動詞「顫抖」。常用搭配：tremble with fear (因恐懼而顫抖)。"},{"sentence":"As the temperature dropped below zero, the hikers could feel their bodies <target>trembling</target> from the extreme cold of the mountain air.","translation":"當溫度降至零度以下時，登山客能感覺到他們的身體因山區空氣的極端寒冷而顫抖。","explanation":"動詞「顫抖」。常用搭配 tremble from cold。"},{"sentence":"A slight <target>tremble</target> in her voice revealed that she was extremely nervous despite her confident expression and steady posture.","translation":"她聲音中輕微的顫抖揭露了儘管她表情自信且姿勢穩健，但她其實非常緊張。","explanation":"名詞「顫抖」。指聲音或身體的微小顫動。"}],"related_forms":["trembling"]}

{"headword":"tremendous","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的、極大的」。常用於描述數量、程度或品質的卓越。常用搭配：tremendous pressure (巨大的壓力), tremendous amount of (大量的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new library project received a <target>tremendous</target> <pattern>amount of</pattern> support from the local community and the city council.","translation":"這個新的圖書館計畫得到了當地社區和市議會巨大的支持。","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的」。常用搭配：tremendous amount of (大量的)。"},{"sentence":"Students often feel <target>tremendous</target> <pattern>pressure</pattern> to achieve high scores on the GSAT to enter their dream universities.","translation":"學生們經常感到巨大的壓力，要在會考中取得高分以進入他們夢想的大學。","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的」。常用搭配：tremendous pressure (巨大的壓力)。"},{"sentence":"The discovery of the new vaccine was a <target>tremendous</target> <pattern>achievement</pattern> for the medical team, saving thousands of lives worldwide.","translation":"新疫苗的發現對醫療團隊來說是一個巨大的成就，在全世界拯救了數千人的生命。","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的」。常用搭配：tremendous achievement (巨大的成就)。"}],"related_forms":["tremendously"]}

{"headword":"tribal","explanation":"形容詞「部落的、種族的」。指與部落社會或特定種族相關的事物。","entries":[{"sentence":"The anthropologists spent several months studying the <target>tribal</target> <pattern>customs</pattern> of the indigenous people living deep in the Amazon rainforest.","translation":"人類學家花了好幾個月研究居住在亞馬遜雨林深處原住民的部落習俗。","explanation":"形容詞「部落的」。常用搭配：tribal customs (部落習俗)。"},{"sentence":"The museum's new exhibit features various <target>tribal</target> <pattern>artifacts</pattern>, including hand-woven baskets and traditional masks from across Africa.","translation":"博物館的新展覽展出了各種部落文物，包括來自非洲各地的手工編織籃和傳統面具。","explanation":"形容詞「部落的」。常用搭配：tribal artifacts (部落文物)。"}],"related_forms":["tribe"]}

{"headword":"triumph","explanation":"名詞「勝利、成就」；動詞「獲勝、成功」。常用於指克服困難後取得的重大勝利。常用搭配：triumph over (戰勝.../克服...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Winning the national championship after years of hard training was a great <target>triumph</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the school's basketball team.","translation":"經過多年的刻苦訓練，贏得全國冠軍對學校籃球隊來說是一個巨大的勝利。","explanation":"名詞「勝利、成就」。"},{"sentence":"The scientists' ability to cure the rare disease was a <target>triumph</target> <pattern>of</pattern> modern medicine and human persistence.","translation":"科學家治癒這種罕見疾病的能力是現代醫學和人類堅持的勝利。","explanation":"名詞「勝利」。指克服困難後取得的成就。"},{"sentence":"Through sheer determination and hard work, the small company managed to <target>triumph</target> <pattern>over</pattern> its larger competitors in the market.","translation":"憑藉著純粹的決心和努力，這家小公司成功戰勝了市場上規模較大的競爭對手。","explanation":"動詞「獲勝、成功」。常用片語：triumph over (戰勝.../克服...)。"}],"related_forms":["triumphant","triumphantly"]}

{"headword":"troublesome","explanation":"形容詞「麻煩的、令人煩惱的」。指造成不便或需要花時間處理的事物。常用搭配：troublesome problem (麻煩的問題), troublesome child (頑皮的孩子)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The old printer in the library became very <target>troublesome</target> when it started jamming the paper every few pages.","translation":"圖書館裡那台舊印表機在每隔幾頁就卡紙時，變得非常麻煩。","explanation":"形容詞「麻煩的」。指設備故障導致的不便。"},{"sentence":"Trying to find a parking space in the crowded city center during rush hour is a <target>troublesome</target> <pattern>task</pattern> for any driver.","translation":"在尖峰時段在擁擠的市中心尋找停車位對任何駕駛者來說都是一件麻煩的事。","explanation":"形容詞「麻煩的」。常用搭配：troublesome task (麻煩的任務)。"},{"sentence":"The doctor explained that the patient's <target>troublesome</target> <pattern>cough</pattern> was caused by a mild allergy to dust and pollen.","translation":"醫生解釋說，病人的那個令人煩惱的咳嗽是由對灰塵和花粉的輕微過敏引起的。","explanation":"形容詞「令人煩惱的」。常用搭配：troublesome cough (令人煩惱的咳嗽)。"}],"related_forms":["trouble"]}

{"headword":"tumble","explanation":"動詞「跌倒、滾落」；名詞「跌倒、暴跌」。指失去平衡而跌落，或價格/數值快速下降。常用搭配：tumble down (滾落)。","entries":[{"sentence":"While running across the grassy field, the young boy accidentally <target>tumbled</target> and rolled several times before stopping.","translation":"在草地上奔跑時，小男孩不小心跌倒並滾了好幾圈才停下來。","explanation":"動詞「跌倒、滾落」。"},{"sentence":"The children laughed as they watched the colorful balloons <target>tumble</target> <pattern>down</pattern> from the sky during the festival.","translation":"孩子們看著彩色氣球在節日期間從天空中飄落而開心地笑了。","explanation":"動詞片語 tumble down (滾落/飄落)。"},{"sentence":"Following the sudden economic crisis, stock prices <target>tumbled</target> quickly, causing many investors to lose a significant amount of money.","translation":"在突然的經濟危機之後，股價迅速暴跌，導致許多投資者損失了大量金錢。","explanation":"動詞「暴跌」。指數值或價格快速下降。"},{"sentence":"She took a sudden <target>tumble</target> on the icy sidewalk, but fortunately, she did not suffer any serious injuries.","translation":"她在結冰的人行道上突然摔了一跤，但幸運的是，她沒有受到任何嚴重傷勢。","explanation":"名詞「跌倒」。"}],"related_forms":["tumbled","tumbling"]}

{"headword":"twig","explanation":"名詞「小樹枝」。指樹木或灌木上長出的細小分枝。","entries":[{"sentence":"The small bird perched on a thin <target>twig</target>, singing a melodious song to greet the early morning sun.","translation":"小鳥停在細小的小樹枝上，唱著婉轉的歌迎接清晨的陽光。","explanation":"名詞「小樹枝」。指樹木上的細小分枝。"},{"sentence":"During the nature walk, the students collected various <target>twigs</target> and fallen leaves to create a natural art project in class.","translation":"在自然散步期間，學生們收集了各種小樹枝和落葉，以便在課堂上創作一個自然藝術項目。","explanation":"名詞複數形式 twigs。"},{"sentence":"The wind blew so hard that it snapped a <target>twig</target> off the nearest tree, which then rolled across the grassy field.","translation":"風刮得如此猛烈，以至於將最近的一棵樹上的小樹枝折斷，隨後在草地上滾動。","explanation":"名詞「小樹枝」。"}],"related_forms":["twigs"]}

{"headword":"universal","explanation":"形容詞「普遍的、全世界的」；名詞「通用語」。形容詞用法最為常見，指適用於所有人或所有情況的。常搭配 universal truth (普遍真理), universal language (通用語言)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The desire for peace and happiness is a <target>universal</target> <pattern>human</pattern> <pattern>experience</pattern>, regardless of where a person is born or raised.","translation":"對和平與幸福的渴望是一種普遍的人類經驗，無論一個人出生或成長在何處。","explanation":"形容詞「普遍的」。常用搭配：universal human experience。"},{"sentence":"Mathematics is often considered a <target>universal</target> <pattern>language</pattern> because its rules and symbols are understood by people all over the world.","translation":"數學通常被認為是一種通用語言，因為其規則和符號被全世界的人所理解。","explanation":"形容詞「通用的」。常用搭配：universal language。"},{"sentence":"The new environmental law aims to establish <target>universal</target> <pattern>standards</pattern> for reducing pollution to protect the planet for future generations.","translation":"新的環境法旨在建立普遍的標準以減少污染，為後代保護地球。","explanation":"形容詞「普遍的」。常用搭配：universal standards。"},{"sentence":"The concept of love is <target>universal</target>, as it transcends cultural boundaries and connects people from different backgrounds.","translation":"愛的概念是普遍的，因為它超越了文化邊界並將來自不同背景的人聯繫在一起。","explanation":"形容詞「普遍的」。"}],"related_forms":["universally","universe"]}

{"headword":"urge","explanation":"動詞「強烈要求、催促」；名詞「強烈的衝動」。動詞時常搭配 urge someone to do something。名詞時則常與 a strong urge to do something 搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher <target>urged</target> <pattern>her students to</pattern> spend more time reading English books to improve their vocabulary and speaking skills.","translation":"老師強烈要求她的學生花更多時間閱讀英文書以提高他們的詞彙量和口說能力。","explanation":"動詞「強烈要求」。常用搭配：urge someone to do something。"},{"sentence":"Despite the cold weather, the coach <target>urged</target> the team <pattern>to</pattern> keep pushing forward and not give up on the game.","translation":"儘管天氣寒冷，教練仍催促球隊繼續前進，不要放棄這場比賽。","explanation":"動詞「催促」。"},{"sentence":"After seeing the beautiful scenery of the mountains, she felt a <pattern>strong</pattern> <target>urge</target> <pattern>to</pattern> leave the city and live in the countryside.","translation":"在看到山區的美麗風景後，她感到一種強烈的衝動想要離開城市並住在鄉下。","explanation":"名詞「強烈的衝動」。常用搭配：a strong urge to do something。"},{"sentence":"He suddenly had an <target>urge</target> <pattern>to</pattern> laugh during the serious meeting, but he managed to keep a straight face.","translation":"他在嚴肅的會議中突然產生了想笑的衝動，但他設法保持面無表情。","explanation":"名詞「衝動」。"}],"related_forms":["urgent"]}

{"headword":"urgent","explanation":"形容詞「緊急的、迫切的」。常用於描述需要立即關注或處理的事物，如 urgent message (緊急訊息), urgent matter (緊急事項)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school principal received an <target>urgent</target> <pattern>message</pattern> from the government, requiring him to attend a meeting immediately.","translation":"校長收到了一封來自政府的緊急訊息，要求他立即參加會議。","explanation":"形容詞「緊急的」。常用搭配：urgent message。"},{"sentence":"Climate change is an <target>urgent</target> <pattern>issue</pattern> that requires immediate action from all countries to prevent a global disaster.","translation":"氣候變遷是一個迫切的問題，需要所有國家立即採取行動以防止全球災難。","explanation":"形容詞「迫切的」。常用搭配：urgent issue。"},{"sentence":"Due to an <target>urgent</target> <pattern>family matter</pattern>, the student had to leave school early and missed the final chemistry exam.","translation":"由於緊急的家庭事務，該學生不得不早退，並錯過了最後一次化學考試。","explanation":"形容詞「緊急的」。常用搭配：urgent family matter。"}],"related_forms":["urgently","urge"]}

{"headword":"usage","explanation":"名詞「用法、使用情況」。常用於描述語言的正確用法或某種物品的使用方式。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you are unsure about the <target>usage</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a specific English word, you should consult a reliable dictionary to check its meaning.","translation":"如果你不確定某個特定英文單字的使用方式，你應該查閱可靠的字典來檢查其意思。","explanation":"名詞「用法」。常用搭配：usage of sth。"},{"sentence":"The library has strict rules regarding the <target>usage</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the computers to ensure that all students have fair access.","translation":"圖書館對於電腦的使用有嚴格的規定，以確保所有學生都能公平地使用。","explanation":"名詞「使用情況」。"},{"sentence":"The professor explained the difference between formal and informal <target>usage</target> in writing, helping students write better academic papers.","translation":"教授解釋了書面寫作中正式與非正式用法的區別，幫助學生寫出更好的學術論文。","explanation":"名詞「用法」。"}],"related_forms":["use"]}

{"headword":"vacancy","explanation":"名詞「空缺、空房」。常用於工作職位空缺 (job vacancy) 或酒店房間空缺 (hotel vacancy)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company is currently looking for a qualified candidate to fill a <target>vacancy</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the marketing department.","translation":"公司目前正在尋找一名合格的候選人來填補行銷部門的一個空缺。","explanation":"名詞「空缺」。常用搭配：fill a vacancy。"},{"sentence":"After the manager retired, there was a <target>vacancy</target> <pattern>for</pattern> a senior accountant, which many employees applied for.","translation":"經理退休後，出現了一個資深會計師的空缺，許多員工都申請了這個職位。","explanation":"名詞「空缺」。常用搭配：vacancy for sth。"},{"sentence":"The travelers arrived at the small hotel, but the manager told them there was no <target>vacancy</target> because it was peak season.","translation":"旅人們到達了這家小酒店，但經理告訴他們沒有空房，因為現在是旺季。","explanation":"名詞「空房」。"}],"related_forms":["vacant"]}

{"headword":"vain","explanation":"形容詞「徒勞的、虛榮的」。常用片語 in vain (徒勞地、白費力氣地)。注意區分 in vain 與 in vein (血管) 或 in vane (風向標)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The rescue team searched for the missing hiker for three days, but all their efforts were <target>in vain</target>, as the man was not found.","translation":"救援隊搜尋失蹤的登山客三天，但所有的努力都徒勞無功，因為那個人沒有被找到。","explanation":"片語 in vain 表示「徒勞地、白費力氣地」。"},{"sentence":"She spent hours adjusting her makeup and hair, showing a <pattern>vain</pattern> <target>desire</target> to be the most beautiful girl at the party.","translation":"她花了數小時調整妝容和髮型，展現出想要成為派對上最漂亮女孩的虛榮心。","explanation":"形容詞「虛榮的」。常用搭配：vain desire。"},{"sentence":"He tried to convince his parents to let him go to the concert, but he <target>tried</target> <pattern>in vain</pattern> to persuade them.","translation":"他試圖說信他的父母讓他去參加音樂會，但他徒勞地嘗試說服他們。","explanation":"片語 in vain 表示「徒勞地、白費力氣地」。"}],"related_forms":["vanity"]}

{"headword":"vast","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的、廣大的」。常用於描述面積、數量或差異極大，如 vast area (廣大區域), vast amount of (大量的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The Sahara Desert is a <target>vast</target> <pattern>expanse</pattern> of sand, where very few plants can survive the extreme heat and dryness.","translation":"撒哈拉沙漠是一個廣大的沙地，在那裡極少有植物能在極端高溫和乾燥中生存。","explanation":"形容詞「廣大的」。常用搭配：vast expanse。"},{"sentence":"The internet provides a <target>vast</target> <pattern>amount of</pattern> information, allowing students to research any topic they want from home.","translation":"網路提供了大量的資訊，讓學生能在家中研究他們想要的任何主題。","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的」。常用搭配：vast amount of。"},{"sentence":"There is a <target>vast</target> <pattern>difference</pattern> between the two theories, as they provide completely different explanations for the origin of the universe.","translation":"在這兩個理論之間存在著巨大的差異，由於他們為宇宙的起源提供了完全不同的解釋。","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的」。常用搭配：vast difference。"}],"related_forms":["vastly","vastness"]}

{"headword":"vegetarian","explanation":"名詞「素食者」；形容詞「素食的」。指不吃肉類的人或食物。","entries":[{"sentence":"Since she is a <target>vegetarian</target>, she always checks the ingredients of the food before ordering at a restaurant to avoid any meat.","translation":"因為她是素食者，她在餐廳點餐前總是會檢查食物的成分，以避免任何肉類。","explanation":"名詞「素食者」。"},{"sentence":"Many people choose to become <target>vegetarians</target> for health reasons or because they believe it is more ethical to avoid eating animals.","translation":"許多人選擇成為素食者，是出於健康原因或因為他們認為避免吃動物更符合倫理。","explanation":"名詞複數形式 vegetarians。"},{"sentence":"The school cafeteria now offers a <target>vegetarian</target> <pattern>menu</pattern> to accommodate students who do not eat meat for religious or personal reasons.","translation":"學校食堂現在提供素食單，以照顧到那些因為宗教或個人原因而不吃肉的 students。","explanation":"形容詞「素食的」。常用搭配：vegetarian menu。"}],"related_forms":["vegetarianism"]}

{"headword":"vessel","explanation":"名詞「容器、船隻、血管」。詞性單一，但義項多。常考的是「船隻」和「容器」之意，醫學相關文章中則指「血管」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The ancient <target>vessel</target> was found in the ocean, containing various treasures and gold coins from a civilization that disappeared long ago.","translation":"這艘古代船隻在海洋中被發現，其中包含來自一個很久以前消失的文明的各種寶藏和金幣。","explanation":"名詞「船隻」。指大型船隻。"},{"sentence":"The scientist used a glass <target>vessel</target> to mix the chemicals, ensuring the container was completely clean before starting the experiment.","translation":"科學家使用一個玻璃容器來混合化學物質，確保容器在開始實驗前是完全乾淨的。","explanation":"名詞「容器」。指用來盛裝液體或物質的容器。"},{"sentence":"During the biology class, the teacher explained how blood <target>vessels</target> transport oxygen and nutrients to every part of the human body.","translation":"在生物課上，老師解釋了血管如何將氧氣和營養物質輸送到人體每個部位。","explanation":"名詞「血管」。常用搭配：blood vessel。"}],"related_forms":["vessels"]}

{"headword":"violate","explanation":"動詞「違反、侵害」。常指違反法律、規則或侵害他人的權利與隱私。常見搭配：violate the law (違法)、violate privacy (侵害隱私)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company was fined heavily because it <target>violated</target> several environmental laws by dumping toxic waste into the river.","translation":"這家公司因為將有毒廢物排入河流而違反了幾項環境法規，因此被處以巨額罰款。","explanation":"動詞「違反」。指不遵守法律或官方規定。"},{"sentence":"Many people believe that installing surveillance cameras in private bedrooms would <target>violate</target> the basic right to privacy.","translation":"許多人認為在私人臥室安裝監視攝影機將會侵害基本的隱私權。","explanation":"動詞「侵害」。指對權利或神聖事物的不尊重或侵犯。"}],"related_forms":["violates","violated","violating"]}

{"headword":"violation","explanation":"名詞「違反、違規、侵害」。violate 的名詞形式。常用搭配：a violation of (違反...)，例如 a violation of human rights (侵害人權)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Parking your car in front of a fire hydrant is a clear <target>violation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> traffic rules and may result in a fine.","translation":"將車停在消防栓前是明顯的交通規則違規，可能會導致被罰款。","explanation":"名詞「違規」。指不遵守規則的行為。"},{"sentence":"International organizations have strongly condemned the government's actions, calling them a serious <target>violation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> international law.","translation":"國際組織強烈譴責該政府的行為，稱其為嚴重違反國際法。","explanation":"名詞「違反」。指對法律或條約的違背。"}],"related_forms":["violations"]}

{"headword":"virtue","explanation":"名詞「美德、優點」。指具有高尚道德品質的特質。常用搭配：by virtue of (憑藉.../由於...)，此片語在 GSAT 閱讀中常出現，表示原因或方式。","entries":[{"sentence":"Patience is often considered a great <target>virtue</target> when dealing with difficult students or solving complex problems in the classroom.","translation":"在面對困難的學生或在課堂上解決複雜問題時，耐心通常被認為是一種偉大的美德。","explanation":"名詞「美德」。指高尚的道德特質。"},{"sentence":"She succeeded in the competition <pattern>by</pattern> <target>virtue</target> <pattern>of</pattern> her exceptional talent and years of hard work.","translation":"她憑藉著卓越的才華和多年的努力在比賽中取得了成功。","explanation":"片語 by virtue of 表示「憑藉」或「由於」。"}],"related_forms":["virtuous"]}

{"headword":"virus","explanation":"名詞「病毒」。可指生物學上的病毒（引起疾病）或電腦病毒（破壞系統）。","entries":[{"sentence":"Doctors warned that the flu <target>virus</target> spreads quickly in crowded areas, so people should wear masks and wash their hands often.","translation":"醫生警告說流感病毒在擁擠的區域傳播迅速，因此人們應該佩戴口罩並經常洗手。","explanation":"名詞「病毒」。指引起疾病的微小生物。"},{"sentence":"My computer started acting strangely after I clicked a suspicious link, and I soon realized that a <target>virus</target> had infected my system.","translation":"在我點擊了一個可疑連結後，我的電腦開始表現異常，我很快意識到系統被病毒感染了。","explanation":"名詞「病毒」。指惡意的電腦程式。"}],"related_forms":["viruses"]}

{"headword":"visual","explanation":"形容詞「視覺的」。常用於描述與眼睛看到的事物相關的，如 visual aids (視覺輔助工具)、visual arts (視覺藝術)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher used <target>visual</target> <pattern>aids</pattern>, such as charts and pictures, to help students understand the complex scientific process more easily.","translation":"老師使用圖表和圖片等視覺輔助工具，幫助學生更容易理解複雜的科學過程。","explanation":"形容詞「視覺的」。常用搭配 visual aids (視覺輔助工具)。"},{"sentence":"Because some students learn better through seeing, providing <target>visual</target> <pattern>examples</pattern> can significantly improve their comprehension of the material.","translation":"因為有些學生透過視覺學習效果更好，提供視覺範例可以顯著提高他們對教材的理解程度。","explanation":"形容詞「視覺的」。"}],"related_forms":["visually","visualization"]}

{"headword":"vital","explanation":"形容詞「至關重要的、生死攸關的」。比 important 更強烈。常用搭配：be vital to/for sth (對...至關重要)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Getting enough sleep is <target>vital</target> <pattern>for</pattern> students to maintain their focus and perform well during their final exams.","translation":"充足的睡眠對學生維持注意力並在期末考中表現良好至關重要。","explanation":"形容詞「至關重要的」。指對成功或生存必不可少。"},{"sentence":"The heart is a <target>vital</target> <pattern>organ</pattern> that pumps blood to the rest of the body, ensuring all cells receive oxygen.","translation":"心臟是一個至關重要的器官，負責將血液泵送到身體其他部位，確保所有細胞都能獲得氧氣。","explanation":"形容詞「至關重要的」。此處指生理上的生死攸關。"}],"related_forms":["vitality","vitally"]}

{"headword":"voluntary","explanation":"形容詞「自願的」。指不被強迫而自行決定做某事。注意與 compulsory (強制性的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school organized a <target>voluntary</target> cleaning day, and many students decided to join in to keep their campus beautiful.","translation":"學校組織了一個自願的清潔日，許多學生決定加入，以保持校園的美麗。","explanation":"形容詞「自願的」。指非強制性的活動。"},{"sentence":"Participation in the after-school sports club is <target>voluntary</target>, meaning students can choose whether to join based on their interests.","translation":"參加課後體育社團是自願的，這意味著學生可以根據自己的興趣選擇是否加入。","explanation":"形容詞「自願的」。"}],"related_forms":["voluntarily"]}

{"headword":"volunteer","explanation":"名詞「志工」；動詞「自願做」。名詞 volunteer 常指參與社會服務的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The local library is looking for <target>volunteers</target> to help organize books and assist young children with their reading skills.","translation":"當地圖書館正在尋找志工來幫助整理書籍並協助年幼的孩子練習閱讀技巧。","explanation":"名詞「志工」。指自願提供服務的人。"},{"sentence":"When the teacher asked for someone to help carry the heavy boxes to the office, a few students <target>volunteered</target> <pattern>to</pattern> do it.","translation":"當老師要求有人幫忙將重箱子搬到辦公室時，幾個學生自願幫忙。","explanation":"動詞「自願做」。常搭配 to V。"}],"related_forms":["voluntary","volunteering"]}

{"headword":"voyage","explanation":"名詞「航程、航海」；動詞「航行」。通常指長距離的旅程，尤其是水路或太空旅程。注意與 trip 或 journey 的區別：voyage 側重於長距離的水路或太空旅程。","entries":[{"sentence":"The early explorers set out on a long <target>voyage</target> across the Atlantic Ocean to discover new lands and trade routes.","translation":"早期的探險家們展開了一次跨越大西洋的長途航行，以發現新土地和貿易路線。","explanation":"名詞「航程」。指長距離的水路旅程。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are planning a <target>voyage</target> to Mars, which would be a historic milestone in human space exploration.","translation":"科學家們正在計劃一次前往火星的航行，這將是人類太空探索的一個歷史里程碑。","explanation":"名詞「航程」。此處指太空旅程。"},{"sentence":"The ancient ships <target>voyaged</target> for months across the sea, facing dangerous storms and limited food supplies.","translation":"古老的船隻在海上航行了數月之久，面對著危險的 Storms 和有限的食物供應。","explanation":"動詞「航行」。指長距離的水路移動。"}],"related_forms":["voyager"]}

{"headword":"waken","explanation":"動詞「喚醒」。與 awake, awaken 意思相近。常用於 waken someone up 或 waken to the reality (意識到現實)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The loud noise from the construction site <target>wakened</target> the students from their deep sleep, making it hard for them to focus in class.","translation":"來自建築工地的大聲噪音將學生們從深睡中喚醒，使他們在課堂上很難集中注意力。","explanation":"動詞「喚醒」。指使某人醒來。"},{"sentence":"After years of ignoring the problem, the government finally <target>wakened</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the urgency of climate change and began taking action.","translation":"經過多年忽視問題後，政府終於意識到了氣候候變的緊迫性並開始採取行動。","explanation":"動詞片語 waken to 表示「意識到」或「覺醒」。"}],"related_forms":["wake","awakened","waking"]}

{"headword":"website","explanation":"名詞「網站」。指在互聯網上的一組相關網頁。常用搭配：visit a website (訪問網站), launch a website (建立網站), official website (官方網站)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university's <target>official website</target> provides detailed information about admission requirements and available scholarships for international students.","translation":"大學的官方網站提供了關於入學要求和國際學生可用獎學金的詳細資訊。","explanation":"名詞「網站」。常用搭配 official website (官方網站)。"},{"sentence":"Many students <pattern>visit</pattern> various educational <target>websites</target> to find supplementary materials and practice tests for their upcoming exams.","translation":"許多學生訪問各種教育網站，以尋找補充教材和即將到來的考試練習題。","explanation":"名詞「網站」。常用動詞搭配 visit (訪問)。"},{"sentence":"The local government decided to <pattern>launch</pattern> a new <target>website</target> to help citizens report environmental issues more easily.","translation":"當地政府決定建立一個新網站，幫助公民更容易地報告環境問題。","explanation":"名詞「網站」。常用動詞搭配 launch (啟動/建立)。"}],"related_forms":["websites"]}

{"headword":"welfare","explanation":"名詞「福利、福祉」。指身體、心理或物質上的健康與幸福感，或指政府提供的社會救助金。常用搭配：social welfare (社會福利), animal welfare (動物福利), child welfare (兒童福利)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government implemented new <target>welfare</target> <pattern>programs</pattern> to provide financial support for low-income families and the elderly.","translation":"政府實施了新的福利計畫，為低收入家庭和年長者提供財務支持。","explanation":"名詞「福利」。指政府提供的社會救助。"},{"sentence":"Animal rights activists work tirelessly to improve <target>welfare</target> <pattern>standards</pattern> for farm animals and those in laboratories.","translation":"動物權利活動家不懈地努力，以提高農場動物和實驗室動物的福利標準。","explanation":"名詞「福祉」。指動物的生存品質。"},{"sentence":"The school counselor focuses on the emotional <target>welfare</target> of the students, ensuring they have a supportive environment to grow.","translation":"學校輔導員專注於學生的情感福祉，確保他們有一個支持性的環境來成長。","explanation":"名詞「福祉」。指心理上的健康與幸福。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"wink","explanation":"動詞「眨眼（以示意）」；名詞「眨眼」。注意與 blink (不自覺眨眼) 的區別：wink 通常是指單眼眨眼，且帶有特定目的，如分享秘密或開玩笑。","entries":[{"sentence":"The magician <target>winked</target> <pattern>at</pattern> his assistant during the performance, signaling that it was time for the next trick.","translation":"魔術師在表演過程中向他的助手眨眼，示意現在是下一個魔術的時間了。","explanation":"動詞「眨眼（示意）」。常用搭配 wink at someone。"},{"sentence":"She gave me a quick <target>wink</target> to let me know that she was just joking and not actually angry with me.","translation":"她迅速地向我眨眼，以讓我知道她只是在開玩笑，並沒有真的對我生氣。","explanation":"名詞「眨眼」。指單眼眨眼示意。"},{"sentence":"He didn't sleep a <target>wink</target> last night because he was so nervous about the final presentation in English class.","translation":"他昨晚一點都沒有睡覺，因為他對英文課的期末報告感到非常緊張。","explanation":"名詞片語 not sleep a wink 表示「完全沒有睡覺」。"}],"related_forms":["winks","winked","winking"]}

{"headword":"wit","explanation":"名詞「機智、才智」。指能快速地且幽默地表達想法的能力。常用搭配：quick wit (反應快且機智), be at one's wit's end (黔驢之技/走投無路/不知如何是好)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The comedian is famous for his <target>quick</target> <target>wit</target>, often making the audience laugh with spontaneous and clever responses.","translation":"這位喜劇演員以其敏捷的機智聞名，經常以自發且聰明的回應讓觀眾大笑。","explanation":"名詞「機智」。常用搭配 quick wit。"},{"sentence":"After trying every possible solution to the computer problem, the technician was <pattern>at</pattern> his <target>wit's</target> <pattern>end</pattern>, not knowing what to do next.","translation":"在嘗試了所有可能的電腦問題解決方案後，技術人員已走投無路，不知下一步該怎麼做。","explanation":"名詞片語 be at one's wit's end 表示「不知如何是好」。"},{"sentence":"She used all her <target>wit</target> and courage to navigate the difficult situation and find a way out of the forest.","translation":"她運用了所有的機智與勇氣，在困難的情況中穿梭並找到走出森林的方法。","explanation":"名詞「才智」。指解決問題的能力。"}],"related_forms":["witty"]}

{"headword":"witch","explanation":"名詞「女巫」。通常指在神話或故事中擁有魔力的女性。wizard 則是指「男巫」或「魔法師」，通常不限性別，但更多指男性。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the classic fairy tale, the evil <target>witch</target> tried to cast a spell on the princess to make her sleep for a hundred years.","translation":"在經典的童話故事中，這個邪惡的女巫試圖對公主施展咒語，使其睡一百年。","explanation":"名詞「女巫」。"},{"sentence":"The young boy dreamed of attending a magic school where he could learn from a powerful <target>wizard</target> and master the art of potion-making.","translation":"這個小男孩夢想著就讀一所魔法學校，在那裡他可以向一位強大的魔法師學習並掌握調製藥水的藝術。","explanation":"名詞「魔法師/男巫」。"}],"related_forms":["witches","wizards"]}

{"headword":"withdraw","explanation":"動詞「撤回、撤退、提取（款項）」。在金融方面，常用於指從銀行帳戶提取現金；在軍事或外交方面，指撤回人員或決定。","entries":[{"sentence":"I need to <target>withdraw</target> some money <pattern>from</pattern> the ATM because I don't have enough cash to pay for the textbooks.","translation":"我需要從自動提款機提取一些錢，因為我沒有足夠的現金來支付教科書的費用。","explanation":"動詞「提取（款項）」。常用搭配 withdraw money from...。"},{"sentence":"The candidate decided to <target>withdraw</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the election after realizing that he did not have enough support from the voters.","translation":"候選人意識到他沒有得到足夠的選民支持後，決定退出選舉。","explanation":"動詞「退出」。常用搭配 withdraw from...。"},{"sentence":"The army was ordered to <target>withdraw</target> its troops <pattern>from</pattern> the border to reduce tension between the two neighboring countries.","translation":"軍隊接到命令將其軍隊從邊境撤回，以減少兩個鄰國之間的緊張局勢。","explanation":"動詞「撤退」。常用搭配 withdraw troops from...。"},{"sentence":"She felt so overwhelmed by the pressure that she decided to <target>withdraw</target> <pattern>into</pattern> herself and avoid talking to anyone for a while.","translation":"她感到壓力如此之大，以至於決定將自己封閉起來，暫時避免與任何人交談。","explanation":"動詞「退縮/封閉」。常用搭配 withdraw into oneself。"}],"related_forms":["withdrawal","withdrawn"]}
