{"headword":"witness","explanation":"名詞「證人」；動詞「目擊」。名詞時指在場的見證人；動詞時指親眼看到某事發生。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police are searching for a <target>witness</target> who could provide a detailed description of the suspect's appearance during the robbery.","translation":"警方正在尋找一名證人，能夠提供關於搶劫過程中嫌疑人外貌的詳細描述。","explanation":"名詞「證人」。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer called several <target>witnesses</target> to the stand to testify about what they had seen during the car accident.","translation":"律師請幾名證人出庭作證，說明他們在車禍期間看到了什麼。","explanation":"名詞「證人」。"},{"sentence":"Luckily, several students <target>witnessed</target> the entire event, allowing the school administration to understand exactly what had happened.","translation":"幸運的是，幾名學生目擊了整個事件，讓學校行政部門能確切地了解發生了什麼事。","explanation":"動詞「目擊」。"}],"related_forms":["witnesses"]}

{"headword":"workout","explanation":"名詞「鍛鍊、健身」。通常指為了維持健康或減重而進行的體能活動。常用搭配：do a workout (進行鍛鍊), a daily workout (每日鍛鍊)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After a long day of studying, she usually does a quick <target>workout</target> at the gym to relieve stress and clear her mind.","translation":"經過漫長一天的學習後，她通常會在健身房進行快速的鍛鍊，以緩解壓力並清除心靈。","explanation":"名詞「鍛鍊」。常用動詞搭配 do a workout。"},{"sentence":"Consistent daily <target>workouts</target> can significantly improve your physical strength and overall health, provided that you maintain a balanced diet.","translation":"只要維持平衡的飲食，持續的每日鍛鍊能顯著提高你的體能和整體健康。","explanation":"名詞「鍛鍊」。"}],"related_forms":["workouts"]}

{"headword":"workplace","explanation":"名詞「工作場所」。指任何人在工作時所在的環境或空間。常用搭配：workplace culture (職場文化), workplace safety (職場安全)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company is striving to create a positive <target>workplace</target> <pattern>culture</pattern> where employees feel valued and encouraged to share their ideas.","translation":"公司正努力營造一個正面的職場文化，讓員工感到被重視並被鼓勵分享他們的想法。","explanation":"名詞「工作場所」。常用搭配 workplace culture。"},{"sentence":"To prevent accidents, the manager implemented new <target>workplace</target> <pattern>safety</pattern> <pattern>regulations</pattern> that all staff members must strictly follow.","translation":"為了防止事故，經理實施了新的職場安全規定，所有員工必須嚴格遵守。","explanation":"名詞「工作場所」。常用搭配 workplace safety regulations。"}],"related_forms":["workplaces"]}

{"headword":"wreck","explanation":"動詞「毀壞、破壞」；名詞「殘骸」。動詞時指將某物（尤其是船或飛機）毀壞；名詞時指毀壞後的殘骸。常用搭配：wreck a car (撞毀汽車), be a wreck (精神崩潰/疲憊不堪)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The violent storm <target>wrecked</target> several small fishing boats, leaving the fishermen with no means to return to the shoreline.","translation":"劇烈的風暴毀壞了幾艘小漁船，讓漁民們沒有手段返回岸邊。","explanation":"動詞「毀壞」。"},{"sentence":"Divers often explore the underwater <target>wreck</target> of an ancient ship, searching for artifacts and clues about the past.","translation":"潛水員經常探索水下古代船隻的殘骸，尋找文物和關於過去的線索。","explanation":"名詞「殘骸」。"},{"sentence":"After studying for three sleepless nights, the student felt like a complete <target>wreck</target>, barely able to concentrate on the exam.","translation":"沒睡覺學習了三個晚上後，這個學生覺得自己完全崩潰了，幾乎無法集中注意力在考試上。","explanation":"名詞「崩潰狀態」。be a wreck 表示精神或身體狀態極差。"},{"sentence":"The drunk driver accidentally <target>wrecked</target> his new car in a tree, causing significant damage to the vehicle's front end.","translation":"醉酒駕駛者不小心將他的新車撞毀在樹上，導致車輛前端受到嚴重損害。","explanation":"動詞「毀壞」。"}],"related_forms":["wreckage","wrecked"]}

{"headword":"yawn","explanation":"可用作動詞「打呵欠」或名詞「打呵欠」。在 GSAT 中，除了生理上的打呵欠，有時也可用於比喻，指某事非常枯燥乏味 (a yawning gap 指巨大的差距)。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the long and boring history lecture, several students could not help but <target>yawn</target> because they were so sleepy.","translation":"在漫長且枯燥的歷史講座中，幾名學生因為太困而忍不住打呵欠。","explanation":"動詞「打呵欠」。描述生理反應。"},{"sentence":"The teacher noticed a few <target>yawns</target> in the classroom, so she decided to take a short break to wake everyone up.","translation":"老師注意到教室裡有幾個人在打呵欠，所以她決定讓大家短暫休息一下，以喚醒所有人。","explanation":"名詞「打呵欠」。"},{"sentence":"The tired hiker let out a loud <target>yawn</target> as he sat down on the grass to rest after a long day of walking.","translation":"疲憊的登山客在走了一整天路後，坐在草地上休息時大打了一個呵欠。","explanation":"名詞「打呵欠」。"}],"related_forms":["yawns","yawned","yawning"]}

{"headword":"youthful","explanation":"形容詞，意為「年輕的」或「具有青春氣息的」。通常帶有正面含義，指外貌年輕或心態年輕。注意與 young 的區別：young 僅描述年齡小，而 youthful 側重於年輕人的特質（如活力、天真、熱情）。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite being over seventy years old, the grandfather still maintains a <target>youthful</target> <pattern>appearance</pattern> because he exercises every day.","translation":"儘管已經超過七十歲，這位祖父因為每天運動，依然保持著年輕的外貌。","explanation":"形容詞「年輕的」。常用搭配：youthful appearance (年輕的外貌)。"},{"sentence":"The coach praised the players for their <target>youthful</target> <pattern>energy</pattern> and passion, which helped the team win the game.","translation":"教練稱讚球員們年輕的活力與熱情，這幫助球隊贏得了比賽。","explanation":"形容詞「年輕的」。常用搭配：youthful energy (年輕的活力)。"},{"sentence":"She often talks about her <target>youthful</target> <pattern>mistakes</pattern>, laughing about the silly things she did when she was a teenager.","translation":"她經常談到她年輕時犯的錯，笑著講起她青少年時期做過的傻事。","explanation":"形容詞「年輕的」。常用搭配：youthful mistakes (年輕時的過錯)。"}],"related_forms":["youthfully"]}
